出版说明

出版说明
Winter 1948 with his wife Shi Songqing The novel "White Pine Syrup" was originally published in the newspaper Paintings Publication Notes汪曾祺（1920—1997），江苏高邮人，中国现当代著名作家。他从1940年开始发表作品，其创作生涯历经半个世纪，跨越两个时代。他前承五四新文化传统、师从沈从文，后启寻根文学回归民族传统的思潮。他的创作，小说、散文、戏剧、文论、新旧体诗等诸体兼备，皆取得很高艺术成就，堪称文体家；又兼及书画，多有题跋，以博雅名世。他的作品，深受中外读者喜爱，也是文学研究者普遍关注的对象。为此，我们发动社会力量、组织专家学者，钩沉辑佚、考辨真伪、校勘注释、编辑出版这部《汪曾祺全集》。
Wang Zengqi (1920-1997), a native of Gaoyou, Jiangsu Province, is a famous modern and contemporary Chinese writer. He began publishing works in 1940, and his creative career spanned half a century and spanned two eras. He inherited the new cultural tradition of May Fourth, studied under Shen Congwen, and later initiated the idea of returning to national traditions in root-seeking literature. His creations, including novels, essays, dramas, essays, new and old poems, have achieved high artistic achievements, and can be called a stylist; he also has calligraphy and painting, and is famous for his liberal arts. His works are deeply loved by Chinese and foreign readers, and are also the object of general attention of literary researchers. To this end, we mobilized social forces, organized experts and scholars, hooked and compiled, examined the authenticity, proofread and annotated, edited and published this "Complete Works of Wang Zengqi".全集收入迄今为止发现的汪曾祺全部文学作品以及书信、题跋等日常文书，共分12卷:小说3卷，散文3卷，戏剧2卷，谈艺2卷，诗歌及杂著1卷，书信1卷，并附年表。
The complete collection contains all of Wang Zengqi's literary works found so far, as well as daily documents such as letters and inscriptions, and is divided into 12 volumes: 3 volumes of novels, 3 volumes of prose, 2 volumes of dramas, 2 volumes of talks, 1 volume of poetry and miscellaneous works, 1 volume of letters, and a chronology.按照学术惯例，全集中的文学作品，以最初发表的报刊版本为底本（少量未发表作品以手稿、油印本为底本），以作者生前自己或他人编订出版的、比较优良的作品集或手稿作为参照校本，进行校勘，改正文字的错、漏、衍、倒置及标点错误。少数不能判定正误而存疑处，予以标示：误字用[]，排仿宋体；漏字用〔〕，排仿宋体；原稿漫漶无法辨认的字，用□替代。保留异体字，保留带有作家个人风格与时代印记的用语。
According to academic practice, the literary works in the complete collection are based on the originally published newspaper editions (a small number of unpublished works are based on manuscripts and mimeographs), and the author's relatively excellent collections or manuscripts compiled and published by himself or others during his lifetime are used as reference proofreading, proofreading, and correcting errors, omissions, derivations, inversions and punctuation errors in the text. A few doubts that cannot be determined are marked: typos are used [], imitating Song style; omissions are used [], imitating Song style; Words that are unrecognizable in the original manuscript are replaced with □. Variant characters are retained, and words with the writer's personal style and the imprint of the times are retained.文学作品每篇皆有题注，交代原载及收入作品集、文本改动、笔名等版本信息。保留作者原注；其他少量必要的注释，皆标明“编者注”。书信题注，介绍收信人简况，信中注释力求简约。
Each literary work has a caption, explaining the original and included in the collection, text changes, pseudonyms and other version information. Retain the author's original notes; other small necessary annotations are marked with "editor's note". The caption of the letter introduces the brief information of the recipient, and the annotations in the letter strive to be simple.全集以写作时间排列文章顺序，写作时间不详则按发表时间排序。如写作时间与发表时间均不详，则编入“未编年”。文末写作时间如非作者自属，加括号以示区别。
The complete collection is arranged in the order of the articles according to the writing time, and if the writing time is unknown, it is sorted according to the publication time. If the writing time and publication time are unknown, it will be compiled as "unannounced". If the writing time at the end of the article is not the author's own, parentheses should be added to indicate the difference.出版全集不仅是一项艰巨的编辑工作，也是艰深的学术工作，我们倾力打造的全集，肯定还存在种种不足之处，敬请读者指正。
人民文学出版社编辑部
2018年6月

小说卷说明

小说卷说明
Publishing the complete works is not only a difficult editing work, but also a difficult academic work, and there must be various shortcomings in the complete works we have worked hard to create, so please correct readers. Editorial Department of People's Literature Publishing House June 2018 Description of the novel volume此三卷是汪曾祺小说总集，收入作者自1940年创作的小说162篇（《故里三陈》记为1篇，《虎二题》记为2篇，以此类推）。同题小说，如内容改动少，仅收入创作发表在先者，在题注中说明情况，如《最响的炮仗》；如内容改动大，则统统收入，题目以序号提示，如《职业》（二）。
These three volumes are a collection of Wang Zengqi's novels, including 162 novels written by the author since 1940 ("Hometown Three Chens" is recorded as 1 article, "Tiger Two Questions" is recorded as 2 articles, and so on). Novels with the same title, if the content has few changes, only those that are created and published first are included in the caption, such as "The Loudest Firecracker"; if the content changes are large, they will all be included, and the title will be prompted by a serial number, such as "Occupation" (2).人民文学出版社编辑部

晓春，静静的日午。
为怕携归无端的烦忧，（梦乡的可怜的土产），不敢去寻访枕上的湖山。
Fishing{{id_0000}} Xiaochun, quiet noon. For fear of bringing back unwarranted worries, (the poor souvenir of the dreamland), I dare not visit the lake and mountain on my pillow.一个黑点，划成一道弧线，投向纸窗，“嗡”，是一只失路的蜜蜂。也许正惓怀于一支尚未萎落的残蕊，匆忙的小小的身躯撞去。习于播散温存的触须已经损折了，仍不肯终止这痴愚的试验，一次，两次，……“可怜虫亦可以休矣！”不耐烦替它计较了。
A black dot, drawn in an arc, thrown towards the paper window, "buzz", is a lost bee. Perhaps it is nostalgic for a stamens that have not yet withered, and its small body in a hurry crashes away. The tentacles that are accustomed to spreading warmth have been broken, and they still refuse to stop this foolish experiment, once or twice,...... "The poor insect can also rest!" Impatient to care for it.做些甚么呢？
打开旧卷，一片虞美人的轻瓣静睡在书页上。旧日的娇红已成了凝血的暗紫，边沿更镌了一圈恹恹的深黑。不想打开锈锢的记忆的键，掘出葬了的断梦，遂又悄然掩起。
What to do? Opening the old scroll, a light petal of a poppy was sleeping quietly on the page. The old red has become a dark purple of coagulated blood, and a circle of deep black is engraved on the edges. I didn't want to open the key of the rusty memory, and dug out the broken dream that had been buried, so I quietly hid it again.烟卷一分分的短了，珍惜的吐出最后一圈，掷了残蒂，一星红火，在灰烬里挣脱最后的呼吸。打开烟盒，已经空了，不禁怅然。
The cigarette roll was short, and he cherished the last circle, threw the residual stem, and broke free from his last breath in the ashes. When I opened the cigarette box, it was already empty, and I couldn't help but feel sad.提起瓷壶，斟了半天，还不见壶嘴吐出一滴，哦，还是昨晚冲的，嚼着被开水蚀去绿色的竹心，犹余清芬；想后园的竹子当抽了新篁，正好没渔竿，钓鱼去吧，别在寂寞里凝成了化石。
Lifting the porcelain pot, I poured it for a long time, and I didn't see a drop spit out of the spout, oh, it was still flushed last night, chewing the green bamboo heart eroded by boiling water, and there was still a clear fragrance; I think the bamboo in the back garden should be smoked with a new bamboo, and there is no fishing rod, go fishing, don't condense into fossils in loneliness.小时候，跟母亲纠缠了半天，以撒娇的一吻，换来一根绣花的小针，就灯火弯成钩子；到姐姐的匣内抽一根黑丝线，结系停当，捉几只蜻蝇；怀着不让人知道的喜悦，去作一次试验。学着别人的样，耐心的守着水面“浮子”（那也是请教许多先辈才晓用蒜茎做的最好）。起竿时不是太急，惊走了；便是太慢，白丢了一只蝇矢；经过了许多次的失望，终于钓得一尾鲢鱼，看它在钩上闪着银光，掀动鲜红的鳃，像发现了一件奇迹，慌乱的连手带脚的捉住，用柳枝穿了，忘了祖父的斥骂，一路叫着跳回去。
When I was a child, I was entangled with my mother for a long time, and in exchange for a coquettish kiss, I got a small embroidered needle, and the light was bent into a hook; I went to my sister's box to draw a black silk thread, tied it to a stop, and caught a few dragonflies; with the joy of not letting people know, I went to do an experiment. Learn from others and patiently guard the "float" on the water (that is also the best way to make it with garlic stems after consulting many ancestors). When I started the rod, I was not too hasty, and I was frightened away; it was too slow, and I lost a fly arrow in vain; After many disappointments, I finally caught a silver carp, watching it shine silver on the hook, lifting its bright red gills, as if I had found a miracle, I caught it in a panic, pierced it with willow branches, forgot my grandfather's scolding, and jumped back all the way.而今想来，分外亲切，不由得不跃跃欲试了。
Now that I think about it, it's so kind that I can't help but be eager to try.昨晚一定下过牛毛雨，看绵软的土径上，清晰的画出一个个脚印，一个守着油灯的盼待，拉快了这些脚步，脚掌的部分那么深，而脚跟的部分却如此轻浅，而且两个脚印的距离很长，想见归家时的急切了。你可没有要紧事，不必追迹这些脚印，尽管慢点儿。
It must have been drizzling last night, looking at the soft dirt path, clearly drawing footprints, a waiting for an oil lamp, speeding up these steps, the soles of the feet are so deep, but the heels are so light, and the distance between the two footprints is very long, I want to see the eagerness when I return home. You don't have to follow these footprints, just slow down.在往日，便是这样冷僻的小村，亦常有古旧的声音来造访的。如今，没有碎布烂铁换糖的唤卖；卖通草花的货郎的小鼓；走方郎中踉跄的串铃；即本村的瞎先生，也暂时收起算命小锣的，没有一个辛苦的命运来叩问了，正是农忙的时候呀！
In the past, such a remote village was often visited by ancient voices. Nowadays, there is no call for scraps of cloth and rotten iron for sugar; the small drum of the merchant who sells grass and flowers; the staggering string of bells among the walking doctors; Even the blind gentleman in this village has temporarily put away the fortune-telling gong, and there is no hard fate to inquire, it is the time when the farmers are busy!转过一架铺着带绿的柳条的小桥，有一棵老树，我只能叫它老树，因为它的虬干曾做过我儿时的骏马，它照料着我长大的乡下的替它起的名字，多是字典辞源上查不着的。顽皮的河水舔去覆土，露出隐秘的年青的一段，那羞涩的粉红的根须，真如一个蒲团，不妨坐下。
Turning around a small bridge covered with green willow, there is an old tree, I can only call it an old tree, because its dragon trunk used to be my childhood horse, and it took care of the name given to it by the countryside where I grew up, most of which cannot be found in the dictionary etymology. The naughty river licks off the covering soil, revealing a hidden youthful section, the shy pink roots, really like a futon, you might as well sit down.也得像个样儿理了钓丝，安上饵，轻轻的抛向水面。本不是为着鱼而来的，何必关心“浮子”的深浅。
You have to straighten the fishing line, put on the bait, and gently throw it to the water. It's not for the fish, so why care about the depth of the "float".河不宽，只消篙子一点，便可渡到彼岸了，但水这么蓝，蓝得有些神秘，你明白来往的船只为甚么不用篙子了吧！关于这河，乡下人还会告诉你一个神奇的故事，深恐你不相信，他们会急红了脸说：县里的志书上还载着。
The river is not wide, just a little pole, you can cross to the other side, but the water is so blue, blue a little mysterious, you understand why the boats don't need poles! About this river, the countrymen will also tell you a magical story, afraid that if you don't believe it, they will blush, and say: The chronicle of the county is still there.也不知是姓甚么的做皇帝的时候，——除了村馆里的先生，这村里的人都是只知道“民国”与“前清”的，顶多还晓得朱洪武是个放牛的野孩子，则“不知有汉，无论魏晋”何足为怪。这儿出了个画画的，一点不说谎，他画的玩意儿就跟真的一般，画个麻雀就会叫，画个乌龟就能爬，画个人，管少不了脸上一粒麻子。天下事都是这样，聪明人不会长寿的，他活不上三十岁，就让天老爷给收去了，临死的时候，跟他的新娶的媳妇说：“我一不耕田，二不种地，死后留给你的只有绵绵的相思……”取张素绢，画了几笔，密密卷好，叫她到城里交给他的师傅，送到京师的相爷家去，说相爷的老太太做寿，寿宴上甚么东西都有了，但是还缺少一样东西，心里很不快活，因此害了症候，若能如期送到，准可领到重赏，并且关照她千万不要拆开来看，他咽了最后的一口气，媳妇便上城去了。她心里想到底是个甚么呢？耐不住拆开来望望，一看是一片浓墨，当中有一块白的，以为丈夫骗了她，便坐在田岸上哀哀的哭起来。一阵大风，把这卷儿吹到河里去了，我的天，原来是一轮月亮啊！从此这月亮便不分日夜的在深蓝的水里放着凄冷的银光。
I don't know what the surname is,—— when he was the emperor, except for the gentleman in the village hall, the people in this village only knew the "Republic of China" and "Former Qing", and at most they knew that Zhu Hongwu was a wild child who herded cattle, so "I don't know if there is a Han Dynasty, no matter Wei and Jin", it is not surprising. There is a painter here, don't lie at all, the things he paints are like the real thing, draw a sparrow will call, draw a turtle can climb, draw a person, and care about a pockmark on the face. When he was dying, he said to his newly married daughter-in-law: "I don't farm, I don't farm, and after death, I only leave you with endless lovesickness......" 寒夜[1]
一个大车棚，靠近村子唯一通口的石桥。
[1] This article was originally published in the third issue of Volume 5 of Today's Review in 1941; it was also published in Tianjin's "Yishi Daily" on February 16, 1947, with major changes in the text. In 1941 Cold Night{{id_0000}} A large carport, near the only stone bridge leading to the village.车棚，在夏天，本是牛的天地，它在里面拉水车的轮子整天的转。现在，冬天来了，它该有一份休息，卧在温暖牛房的温暖稻草上咀嚼些往事去，（谁知道是些甚么事呢。）车棚到这时候也应该让流浪的西北风来寄寓了。但是今年，人们在它四周的带皮的弯扭的柱上络起草索，里里外外又涂上从河底搅起的稀泥，一切车水的设备，可以挪出去的也都没有了。于是车棚变了样子，我们还能再叫它车棚么，看它巍然独立的样子（车棚比普通茅房要高些走进去用不着低头。）在黄昏淡烟给人的眼睛以遐想的神力的时候，你要不以为那是一个藏着许多故事的墼楼才怪！然而乡下人长于保守，他们还是叫它车棚。
The carport, in summer, was originally a world of cattle, and it pulled the wheels of the waterwheel in it to spin all day long. Now, winter is coming, and it should have a rest, lying on the warm straw of the warm cowshed and chewing on the past (who knows what it is.) The carport should also let the wandering northwest wind come to take possession by this time. But this year, people have tied draft ropes around the twisted pillars with skin, and the mud stirred up from the bottom of the river has been smeared inside and out, and all the equipment for traffic has been removed. So the carport has changed, can we still call it a carport, look at its majestic and independent appearance (the carport is taller than an ordinary hut, and you don't have to bow your head when you walk in). When the faint smoke at dusk gives people's eyes the divine power of reverie, you don't think it's strange that it is a wall building that hides many stories! However, the countrymen are conservative, and they still call it the carport.夜，雪后，这儿没有大得嚇人的雪，但也足够遮去一切土黄苍青而有余了，一片银光在荡漾，因为是年底，没有月亮，要是有，那不知要亮成甚么样子。怕有窗子的人家也不容易知道天甚么时候明。风，从埋伏的芦叶间起了，雪结上一层膜子，又打着呼哨。茅檐下的冻铃子（冰箸）像钟乳石一样，僵成透明的，不分明的环节。狗也不大叫。在家的人一定把被角拉得更紧，也许还含含糊糊说两句甚么，马上又把头缩到被窝里去。
At night, after the snow, there was no frightening snow here, but it was enough to cover all the yellow and green soil, and a silver light was rippling, because it was the end of the year, and there was no moon. People who are afraid of windows do not easily know when it is bright. The wind rises from the ambushed reeds, and the snow is covered with a film, and it whistles. The frozen bells (ice chopsticks) under the thatched eaves are like stalactites, stiffened into transparent, indistinct links. The dog doesn't bark either. People at home must have pulled the corners of the quilt tighter, and maybe said something vaguely, and immediately shrank their heads back into the quilt.车棚中心烧了一大堆火，火领受人们的感谢，烧得更起劲了，木柴使足了力气，骨节儿毕毕直响。风用嫉妒的力量想摸进棚里，只能从泥草的隙缝间穿进一丝，且一进来便溶化在暖气里。棚边积雪绷得更紧，像生气。
A large fire was burned in the center of the carport, and the fire was thanked by the people, and it burned more vigorously, the firewood used enough strength, and the joints rattled. The wind tried to touch the shed with the power of jealousy, but it could only pass through the gaps in the mud and grass, and it melted in the heating as soon as it came in. The snow on the edge of the shed was tighter, like anger.火光照红了一棚，柱上挂枪。形式甚多，奇奇古怪的名目，听都没听见过。有的似乎只能嚇吓麻雀，却也像剑的闪着青光。除了枪，还有盛酒的葫芦，装锅巴的竹篮，及其他什物，都干净利落，好像日常必经过一只手摸抚过，拂拭过。
The fire lit a shed, and guns were hung on the pillars. There are many forms, strange names, I have never heard of them. Some seem to only scare sparrows, but they also shine like swords. 春天

春天[1]
“故乡依旧有春天，杨柳又抽芽了，这一点生机是寂灭不了的。”
The two who were asleep were still sleeping very sweetly. [1] This article was originally published in Kunming's "Central Daily" on February 13, 1941. Spring{{id_0000}} "There is still spring in my hometown, and the willows have sprouted again, and this vitality cannot be extinguished."我慢慢地，有点迟疑，（谁知道这点迟疑如何生长的，）把一叠信纸投入拆开的信封里。
Slowly, a little hesitantly, (who knows how this hesitation grows,) I put a stack of letter paper into the unpacked envelope.“——又是春天来了，——春天。”遮住我的记忆的是一片明净的蓝色，是故乡的天，真的，我走过多少地方了，总觉得别的地方的天比不上故乡，也许有比故乡更蓝的天吧，然而蓝得不跟故乡一样。还有呢，那是许多得意的散落在蓝天里的风筝，带着一种轻柔，静静的。
"——It's spring again,—— spring." What covers my memory is a bright blue, the sky of my hometown, really, how many places have I traveled, I always feel that the sky in other places is not as good as my hometown, maybe there is a bluer sky than my hometown, but it is not as blue as my hometown. Also, it is many kites scattered proudly in the blue sky, with a softness and quietness.可不是春天了么：衣裳似更轻些，更暖些了。坐在太阳里，一闭眼，（很自然的闭上眼了，）一些带有奇异彩色的碎片便在倏忽变化的衬景上翻腾起来。——你没有这个经验么？我希望你试一试，在太阳里闭上眼睛，你就会明白我的话了，我决不弄甚么玄虚。而这些碎片，又幻出些黑而大的眼睛，晶晶发光，依旧在翻腾，使我有点昏晕了，不成，睁开了眼，更晕得厉害，怎么办呢？
Isn't it spring: the clothes seem to be lighter and warmer. Sitting in the sun, as soon as I closed my eyes, some fragments with strange colors churned over the suddenly changing background. ——Don't you have this experience? I hope you will try it, close your eyes in the sun, and you will understand my words, and I will never make any mysteries. And these fragments, and some black and big eyes, shining brightly, are still churning, making me a little dizzy, no, open my eyes, even more dizzy, what should I do?我不是告诉过你许多次了么，我的童年是不寂寞的？
许是在一个春假里罢，（不是春假也就算春假，何必顶真，春假是不是所有假期里最好的一个，你说？）我们两个，玉哥儿和我，——
“你是谁？”
Haven't I told you many times that my childhood is not lonely? Maybe it's in a spring break, (not spring break, even if it's spring break, why bother to be true, isn't spring break the best of all holidays, you say?) The two of us, Brother Yu and me,—— "Who are you?"“——嗯，别打岔，你听我说下去。好，我那时叫春哥儿。告诉你，又要不离口的叫了，还当着人。”

Suddenly I stopped and looked at my hands.“怎么了，是不是，木刺戳了？”
"What's wrong, isn't it, is it a wooden thorn?"他把我的手拿起来看看，到香橼树上折到一根荆针，一挑，又对着吹吹气，虽然很疼，可是倒挑出来了。随着望一望那歪歪斜斜的未完成的建筑，拍地一脚踢倒了。我不觉得可惜，反而有点复了仇的快意。

复仇[1]——给一个孩子讲的故事
一缶客茶，半支素烛，主人的深情。
[2] It is the name of a chrysanthemum, which is mostly spring cuttings, maple leaf reeds, long purple petals, sprinkled with white spots. Revenge{{id_0000}} ——A story for a child A can of guest tea, half a plain candle, the owner's affection.“今夜竟挂了单呢”，年青人想想颇自好笑。
"I actually hung up the bill tonight," the young man thought it was quite funny.他的周身结束告诉曾经长途行脚的人，这样的一个人，走到这样冷僻的地方，即使身上没有带着钱粮，也会自己设法寻找一点东西来慰劳一天的跋涉，山上多的是松鸡野兔子。所以只说一声：
At the end of his body, he told people who had traveled long distances that such a person, even if he did not carry money and food with him, would try to find something to comfort the day's trek, and there were many grouse and hares on the mountain. So just say:“对不起，庙中没有热水，施主不能洗脚了。”
接过土缶放下烛台，深深一稽首竟自翩然去了，这一稽首里有多少无言的祝福，他知道行路的人睡眠是多么香甜，这香甜谁也没有理由分沾一点去。
"I'm sorry, there is no hot water in the temple, and the benefactor can't wash his feet." He took the clay can and put down the candlestick, bowed deeply and went away, how many wordless blessings there were in this bow, he knew how sweet the sleep of passers-by was, and no one had any reason to share a little of this sweetness.然而出家人的长袖如黄昏蝙蝠的翅子，扑落一点神秘的迷惘，淡淡的却是永久的如陈年的檀香的烟。
However, the long sleeves of monks are like the wings of a bat at dusk, throwing down a little mysterious confusion, but faintly like the smoke of old sandalwood.“竟连谢谢也不容说一声，知道明早甚么时候便会上路了呢？——这烛该是信男善女们供奉的，蜜呢，大概庙后有不少蜂巢吧，那一定有不少野生的花了啊，花许是栀子花，金银花，……”
"I can't even say thank you, do you know when you will be on the road tomorrow morning? ——This candle should be worshipped by men and women, honey, there are probably a lot of beehives behind the temple, then there must be a lot of wild flowers, the flowers are gardenias, honeysuckle,......"他伸手一弹烛焰，其实烛花并没有长。
He stretched out his hand and flicked the candle flame, but in fact, the candle did not last long.“这和尚是住持？是知客？都不是！因为我进庙后就没看见过第二个人，连狗也不养一条，然而和尚决不像一个人住着，佛座前放着两卷经，木鱼旁还有一个磬，……他许有个徒弟，到远远的地方去乞食了吧……
"This monk is the abbot? Is he a guest? Not at all! Because I haven't seen a second person since I entered the temple, and I don't even have a dog, but the monk is by no means like living alone, there are two scrolls of scriptures in front of the Buddha's seat, and there is a chime next to the wooden fish,...... He may have an apprentice who went far away to beg for food......“这样一个地方，除了做和尚是甚么都不适合的。……”
何处有丁丁的声音，像一串散落的珠子，掉入静渚的水里，一圈一圈漾开来，他知道这决不是磬。他如同醒在一个淡淡的梦外。
"Such a place is not suitable for anything but to be a monk. ……” Where was the sound of Tintin, like a string of scattered beads, falling into the water of Jingzhu, rippling round by circle, he knew that this was by no means a chime. He seemed to wake up in a faint dream.集起涣散的眼光，回顾室内：沙地，白垩墙，矮桌旁一具草榻，草榻上一个小小的行囊，行囊虽然是小的，里面有萧萧的物事，但尽够他用了，他从未为里面缺少些甚么东西而给自己加上一点不幸。
Gathering his scattered eyes, he looked back at the room: the sand, the chalk wall, a straw couch next to the low table, a small bag on the straw couch, although the bag was small, there were Xiao Xiao things in it, but it was enough for him, and he never added a little misfortune to himself for the lack of something in it.霍的抽出腰间的宝剑，烛影下寒光逼人，墙上的影子大有起舞之意。
Huo drew out the sword from his waist, the cold light under the candlelight was compelling, and the shadow on the wall had a great intention of dancing.在先，有一种力量督促他，是他自己想使宝剑驯服，现在是这宝剑不甘一刻被冷落，他归降于他的剑了，宝剑有一种夺人的魅力，她逼出年青人应有的爱情。
Previously, there was a force that urged him, it was he who wanted to tame the sword, but now this sword is unwilling to be left out in the cold for a moment, he has surrendered to his sword, the sword has a seductive charm, and she forces out the love that young people deserve.他记起离家的前夕，母亲替他裹了行囊，抽出这剑跟他说了许多话，那些话是他已经背得烂熟了的，他一日不会忘记自己的家，也决不会忘记那些话。最后还让他再念一遍父亲临死的遗嘱：
He remembered that on the eve of leaving home, his mother wrapped his bag for him, pulled out the sword and said many words to him, those words he had memorized well, he would never forget his home for a day, and he would never forget those words. Finally, he asked him to read his father's dying will again:“这剑必须饮我底仇人的血！”
当他还在母亲的肚里的时候，父亲死了，滴尽了最后一滴血，只吐出这一句话，他未叫过一声父亲，可是他深深的记得父亲，如果父亲看着他长大，也许嵌在他心上的影子不会怎么深。
"This sword must drink the blood of my enemy!" When he was still in his mother's belly, his father died, dripping the last drop of blood, only spitting out this sentence, he never called out to his father, but he remembered his father deeply, if his father had watched him grow up, maybe the shadow embedded in his heart would not be so deep.他走过多少地方，一些在他幼年的幻想之外的地方，从未对粘天的烟波发过愁，对连绵的群山出过一声叹息，即使在荒凉的沙漠里也绝不对熠熠的星辰问过路。
How many places he has traveled, some places outside his childhood fantasies, he has never been worried about the sticky smoke waves, he has sighed at the rolling mountains, and he will never ask for directions to the shining stars even in the desolate desert.起先，燕子和雁子还告诉他一些春秋的消息，但是节令的更递对于一个永远以天涯为家的人是不必有所催促的，他渐渐忘记了自己的年岁，虽然还依旧晓得那天是生日。
At first, Yanzi and Yanzi also told him some news of spring and autumn, but the passage of the seasons did not need to be urged for a person who would always call the end of the world home, he gradually forgot his age, although he still knew that day was his birthday.“是有路的地方，我都要走遍，”他曾跟母亲承诺过。
"Where there is a road, I will go all the way," he once promised his mother.曾经跟年老的舵工学得风雨晴晦的智识，向江湖的术士处得来霜雪瘴疠的经验，更从荷箱的郎中的口里掏出许多神奇的秘方，但是这些似乎对他都没有用了，除了将它们再传授给别人。
He once learned the wisdom of ups and downs from the old helmsman, gained experience in frost and snow miasma from the warlocks of the rivers and lakes, and even took out many magical secret recipes from the mouth of the doctor in the trunk, but these seemed to be useless to him, except to teach them to others.一切全是熟悉了的，倒是有时故乡的事物会勾起他一点无可奈何的思念，苦竹的篱笆，络着许多藤萝的，晨汲的井，封在滑足的青苔旁的，……他有时有意使这些淡淡的记忆淡起来，但是这些纵然如秋来潮汐，仍旧要像潮汐一样的退下去，在他这样的名分下，不容有一点乡愁，而且年青的人多半不很承认自己为故土所萦系，即使是对自己。
Everything was familiar, but sometimes the things of his hometown would evoke a little helpless longing for him, the fence of bitter bamboo, the many vines, the well of the morning water, and the ,...... next to the slippery moss. He sometimes deliberately fades these faint memories, but even though these are like the tides of autumn, they still have to recede like the tides, and in his name, there is no room for a little nostalgia, and most young people do not admit that they are haunted by their homeland, even to themselves.甚么东西带在身上都会加上一点重量（那重量很不轻啊）。曾有一个女孩子想送他一个盛水的土瓶，但是他说：
“谢谢你，好心肠的姑娘，愿山风保佑你颊上的酡红，我不要，而且到要的时候自会有的。”
Anything you carry will add a little weight to your body (that weight is not very light). There was once a girl who wanted to give him a clay bottle of water, but he said: "Thank you, kind-hearted girl, may the mountain breeze bless the blush on your cheeks, I don't want it, and it will be there when you want it."所以他一身无长物，除了一个行囊，行囊也是不必要的，但没有行囊总不像个旅客啊。
当然，“这剑必须饮我仇人的血”他深深的记着。但是太深了，像已经溶化在血里，有时他觉得这事竟似与自己无关。
So he has nothing to wear, except for a bag, the bag is also unnecessary, but without a bag is always like a passenger. Of course, "this sword must drink the blood of my enemy" he remembered deeply. But it was too deep, as if it had been dissolved in blood, and sometimes he felt that it had nothing to do with him.今晚头上有瓦（也许是茅草吧）有草榻，还有蜡烛与蜜茶，这些都是在他希冀之外的，但是他除了感激之外只有一点很少的喜悦，因为他能在风露里照样做梦。
丁丁的声音紧追着夜风。
Tonight there are tiles (maybe thatch) on his head, straw couches, candles and honey tea, all of which he hopes for, but he has little joy except gratitude, because he can still dream in the wind and dew. Tintin's voice followed the night wind.他跨出房门，（这门是廊房）。殿上一柱红火，在郁黑里招着皈依的心，他从这一点静穆的发散着香气的光里走出。山门未闭，朦胧里看的很清楚。
山门外有一片平地，正是一个舞剑的场所。
He stepped out of the door, (this door is a corridor). A pillar of red fire on the hall beckoned the heart of refuge in the darkness, and he walked out of this quiet fragrant light. The mountain gate was not closed, and it was clear in the haze. There is a flat land outside the mountain gate, which is a place for sword dance.夜已深，星很少，但是有夜的光，夜的本身的光，也够照出他的剑花朵朵，他收住最后一着，很踌躇满志，一点轻狂围住他的周身，最后他把剑平地一挥，一些断草飞起来，落在他的襟上。和着溺爱与珍惜，在丁丁的声息中，他小心地把剑插入鞘里。
The night was late, there were few stars, but there was the light of the night, the light of the night itself, and it was enough to shine on his sword flowers, he put away the last one, very ambitious, a little frivolous around his body, and finally he swung the sword flat on the ground, and some broken grass flew up and fell on his collar. With doting and cherishing, in the sound of Tintin, he carefully inserted the sword into its sheath.“施主舞得好剑！”
“见笑，”他有一点失常的高兴，羞涩这和尚甚么时候来的？“师父还未睡，法兴不浅！”
“这时候，还有人带着剑。施主想于剑上别有因缘？不是想寻访着甚么吗，走了这么多路。”
"The benefactor dances the sword well!" Laughing, "He was a little abnormally happy, shy when did this monk come?" "Master hasn't slept yet, and the Dharma is not shallow!" At this time, there were still people with swords. The benefactor wants to have a different cause on the sword? Didn't you want to find something, and walked so much. ”和尚年事已大，秃头上隐隐有剃不去的白发，但是出家人有另外一副较难磨尽的健康，炯炯眸子在黑地里越教人认识他有许多经典以外的修行，而且似并不拒绝人来叩询。
“师父好精神，不想睡么？”
The monk is old, and there are faint white hair on his bald head that cannot be shaved, but the monk has another health that is difficult to wear, and his bright eyes teach people in the dark that he has many practices outside the scriptures, and he does not seem to refuse to ask questions. "Master is so energetic, don't you want to sleep?"“出家人坐坐禅，随时都可以养神，而且既无必做的日课，又没有经谶道场，格外清闲些，施主也意不想睡，何妨谈谈呢。”
"Monks sit in meditation, they can nourish their spirits at any time, and there is no daily class that must be done, and there is no prophecy dojo, which is particularly leisurely, and the benefactor does not want to sleep, so why not talk."他很诚实的，把自己的宿志告诉和尚，也知道和尚本是行脚来到的，靠一个人的力量，把这座久已颓圮的废庙修起来，便把漫漫的行程结束在这里，出家人照样有个家的，后来又来了个远方来的头陀，由挂单而常住了。
He was very honest, told the monk about his aspirations, and knew that the monk had come by foot, and relied on the strength of one person to repair this long-collapsed abandoned temple, and ended his long journey here.“怪不道，……那个师父在那儿呢？”他想问问。
“那边，”和尚手一指，“这人似乎比施主更高一些，他说他要走遍天下没有路的地方。”
“哦——”
"His eyes—" "Blind, blind." "Oh—"“那边有一座山，山那边从未有人踏过一个脚印，他一来便发愿打通一条隧道，你听那丁丁的声音，他日夜都在圆这件功德。”
他浮游在一层无端怅惘里，“竟有这样的苦心？”
"There is a mountain over there, no one has ever stepped on a footprint on the other side of the mountain, he vowed to open a tunnel as soon as he came, you listen to that Tintin's voice, he is fulfilling this merit day and night." He floated in a layer of unprovoked melancholy, "How can there be such painstaking efforts?" ”他恨不得立即走到那丁丁的地方去，但是和尚说“天就要发白了，等明儿吧。”
明天一早，踏着草上的露水，他走到那夜来向往的山下，行囊都没有带，只带着一口剑，剑是不能离弃须臾的。
He wanted to go to Tintin's place immediately, but the monk said, "The sky is about to turn white, wait for tomorrow." ” Early tomorrow morning, stepping on the dew on the grass, he walked to the foot of the mountain he longed for that night, without any bags, only a sword, and the sword could not be abandoned for a moment.一个破蒲团，一个瘦头陀。
头陀的长发披满了双肩，也遮去他的脸，只有两只眼睛，射出饿虎似的光芒，教人触到要打个寒噤。年青人的身材面貌打扮和一口剑都照入他的眼里。
A broken futon, a thin head. Tou Tuo's long hair covered his shoulders, covering his face, and he only had two eyes, emitting a hungry tiger-like light, making people shudder when touched. The young man's figure, appearance, and a sword all shone into his eyes.头陀的袖衣上的风霜，画出他走遍的天涯，年青人想这头陀一定知道许多事情，所以这地方比任何地方更无足留连，但他不想离开一步。
头陀的话像早干涸了，但几日相处他并不拒绝回答青年人按不住的问讯。
The wind and frost on the sleeves of the head painted the ends of the world he had traveled all over, and the young man thought that this head must know many things, so this place was more worthless than anywhere else, but he didn't want to leave. Tou Tuo's words seemed to have dried up early, but he did not refuse to answer the young man's uncontrollable inquiries after a few days of getting along.“师父知道这个人么？”一回头伸出左腕，左腕上有一个蓝色的人名，那是他父亲的仇人，这名字是母亲用针刺上去的。
头陀默不作声，也伸出自己的左腕，左腕上一样有一个蓝字的人名，是年青人的父亲底。
"Does Master know this person?" As soon as he turned around, he stretched out his left wrist, and there was a blue name on his left wrist, which was his father's enemy, and this name was pricked by his mother with a needle. Tou Tuo was silent, and also stretched out his left wrist, which also had a blue name on it, which was the father of the young man.一种异样的空气袭过年青人的心，他的眼睛扑在头陀的脸上，头陀的瘦削的脸上没有表情，悠然挥动手里的斧錾。
在一阵强烈的颤抖后，年青人手按到自己宝剑柄上。
——这剑必须饮我仇人的血。
A strange air hit the young man's heart, his eyes fell on Tou Tuo's face, Tou Tuo's thin face was expressionless, and he leisurely waved the axe in his hand. After a strong tremor, the young man pressed his hand to the hilt of his sword. - This sword must drink the blood of my enemies.“孝顺的孩子，你别急，我决不想逃避欠下自己的宿债——但是这还不是时候，须待我把这山凿通了！”
像骤然解得未悬疑问，他，年青人，接受了头陀底没有丝毫祈求的命令，从此他竟然一点轻微的激动都没有了。
"Filial child, don't worry, I don't want to escape my old debts - but this is not the time, I have to wait until I dig through this mountain!" As if the suspense was suddenly solved, he, the young man, accepted the order without the slightest prayer at the bottom of the head, and since then he has not had the slightest excitement.从此丁丁的声音有了和应，青年人也备得一副斧錾，服膺在走遍没路的地方的苦心下，但他似乎忘记身旁有个头陀，正如头陀忘记身旁有一个带剑的年青人。
日子和石头损蚀在丁丁的声里。
你还要问再后么？
From then on, Tintin's voice responded, and the young man also prepared a pair of axes and chisels, and he was obedient to the painstaking work of walking all over the road, but he seemed to have forgotten that there was a head next to him, just as the head forgot that there was a young man with a sword next to him. The days and stones are eroded in the sound of Tintin. Do you still want to ask later?"一天，錾子敲在空虚里，一线天光，第一次照入永恒的幽黑。
“呵”，他们齐声礼赞。
再后呢？
宝剑在冷落里自然生锈的，骨头也在世纪的内外也一定要腐烂或凝成了化石。
One day, the chisel struck in the void, and a ray of sky light shone into the eternal darkness for the first time. "Huh," they praised in unison. What about later? The sword rusts naturally in the cold, and the bones must also rot or solidify into fossils in the middle and outside of the century.不许再往下问了，你看北斗星已经高挂在窗子上了。
Don't ask any further, you see that the Big Dipper is already hanging high on the window.

灯下

灯下[1]
一天还是那么过去的。西天又烧过了金子一样的晚霞。
Under the light{{id_0000}} The day still passed. The western sky has burned the golden sunset again.陈相公（学徒的）在屏门后服伺着新买来的礼和银行师子牌汽油灯。近来城里非常盛行汽油灯，起初只一两家大铺子用，后来，大家计算计算，这比“扑子灯”贵不了多少，可是亮得多了，所以像样一点的铺子也都用了，除了根本没有晚市的。他像是跟灯赌了气，弓着个身子，东扒扒，西戳戳，眯起一只眼睛研究研究，又撮起嘴唇吹吹，鼻涕在鼻孔里，一上一下，使他不时要用油污的手去掠一掠。已经是秋凉了，可是小伙子阳气旺，汗兀自不住的滴着。
Chen Xianggong (apprentice's) was waiting behind the screen door for the newly bought Lihe Bank Lion brand gasoline lamp. Recently, gasoline lamps have been very popular in the city, and at first only one or two big shops used them, but later, everyone calculated that this was not much more expensive than the "flutter lamp", but it was much brighter, so all the decent shops were also used, except for the one that had no dinner market at all. He seemed to have gambled with the lamp, hunched over, poked in the west, squinted one eye to study, and puffed his lips and blew on it, snot in his nostrils, up and down, so that he had to sweep it with his oily hands from time to time. It was already cool in autumn, but the young man was full of yang, and his sweat couldn't help but drip.柜台里有三个人：姓陶的和姓苏的是“同事”身份，陶先生坐在靠“山架”的凳上翻阅从甚么报上剪集起来的章回小说，（也许丢掉了一页，不接头，找来找去找不着）。一面还摸着脸上酒刺，看来不是用手去摸脸，而是以脸去就手，似乎很专心，偶尔有一只苍蝇甚么的影子飞过眼前，他也只是随意用手一挥，不作理会。苏先生把肘部支在柜台上，两手捧着个肥大下巴，用收藏家欣赏书画的神情悠然的看着滴水檐下王二手里起落的刀光。王二摆一个熏烧卤味摊子，这时正忙得紧，一面把切好的牛肉香肠用荷叶包给人，一面用油腻腻的手接钱，只一瞥，即知道数目，随便又准确的往“钱笼”里一扔，嘴里还向另外一个主顾打招呼，“二百文，肚子？”又一瞥，哪样东西快完了，便叫儿子扣子去拿。扣子在写着账，（熟人可以暂赊），很用心的画着码子，要是甚么人的姓写得不大像，便歪着头，咬咬笔杆，很像一些文雅人作诗的样子。柜台里另一位，姓卢，在来往信札上被称为“执事先生”，若是在大公司之类当是经理，这里，是“管事”，所以常常坐在账桌边。正校核着“福食”，每看完一笔，用小木戳子印一个“过”。他叫了一声陈相公，陈相公没有答应，于是又大声叫“陈——相——公——”！这回不但陈相公听见，连苏陶二位也听见了，回头一看，都扑嗤笑了，陈相公一脸胡子，垂手侍立。“今天买了几个铜板酱油？”“五个。”又各归原位，各执其事，继续未竟的工作。
There were three people at the counter: the one surnamed Tao and the one surnamed Su were "colleagues", and Mr. Tao sat on a bench leaning against the "mountain shelf" to read the chapters and novels cut from the newspaper. On the one hand, he still touched the wine thorns on his face, it seemed that he did not touch his face with his hands, but with his face, and seemed to be very attentive. Mr. Su propped his elbows on the counter, held his fat chin in both hands, and leisurely watched the light of the knife in the hands of the king under the dripping eaves with the expression of a collector appreciating calligraphy and painting. Wang Er set up a smoked braised meat stall, and was busy at this time, while wrapping the cut beef sausages in lotus leaves, while taking the money with greasy hands, only glancing at it, that is, knowing the amount, casually and accurately throwing it into the "money cage", and greeting another patron in his mouth, "Two hundred wen, belly?" Another glance, which thing is almost finished, he asked his son to buckle it up. The button was writing the account, (acquaintances can temporarily credit), and drew the yard very carefully, if someone's surname was not written similarly, he tilted his head and bit the pen barrel, very much like some elegant people writing poetry. Another person at the counter, surnamed Lu, is called "Mr. Deacon" on the letters, and if he is a manager in a large company, he is a "steward" here, so he often sits at the account table. is checking the "blessing food", and every time he reads it, he prints a "pass" with a small wooden stamp. He called out to Mr. Chen, but Mr. Chen did not agree, so he shouted loudly "Mr. Chen-Xiang-Gong-"! This time, not only Mr. Chen heard it, but also Mr. Su Tao, and when he looked back, he all sneered. "How many copper plates of soy sauce did you buy today?" "Five." Then they returned to their original positions, each doing their own thing, and continuing the unfinished business.他们似乎都在等待着甚么。等待着甚么呢？
They seem to be waiting for something. What are they waiting for?多少声音汇集起来的声音向各处流着，听惯了的耳朵不会再觉得喧闹，连无线电嗡着鼻子的唱歌说话的声音及铁钉头狠狠的划在玻璃上的开关声，也都显得非常安静。叫卖的拼着自己的嗓子喊，如极深的颜色掺入浓浓的灰色里，一经搅混，甚么痕迹也留不下。你何必喊呢？不要买的你招不来，要买的自会来找你。这些声音都要到沉默之后才会有人觉得。
The sound of how many voices gathered flowed everywhere, and the ears that were used to hearing it would no longer feel noisy, and even the sound of the radio buzzing and talking and the sound of the iron nail head hitting the glass and switching it seemed very quiet. The hawker shouted in his own voice, like a very dark color mixed into the thick gray, and once mixed, no trace could be left. Why do you shout? If you don't want to buy it, you can't recruit it, and if you want to buy it, it will come to you. These voices will not be felt until there is silence.时间在人们的眼睛里过去了。
陈相公又有了点小小得意，汽油灯毕竟亮了。他站到柜台上挂了起来，灯咝咝的响着，许多小飞虫子便在光底下闹成一大团，哪里来的这许多啊？
Time passed in people's eyes. Chen Xianggong was a little proud again, after all, the gasoline lamp was on. He stood on the counter and hung up, the lights sizzled, and many small flying insects made a big mess under the light.一个顾客懒懒的走近了柜台。“要甚么？”“丝妈糖。”“没有。”“昨天还有的？”“十个铜板起码！”柜台外的人眨眨眼睛，只得向袋里又挖挖，柜台里的把钱接过手，一看，只有八个，不再说甚么，丢入“钜万”里，包了一包带丝带粉的甚么。八个铜板买不到十个铜板的，大家明白。可是倒教苏陶二位想起来晚上还有几个必到的主顾，知道他们要甚么，要多少，便一一包好，在纸上折角作了个记号，放在固定的处所，以便来拿。
A customer lazily approached the counter. "What do you want?" "Silk candy." "No." "Yesterday?" "At least ten copper plates!" 猎猎

猎猎[1]
——寄珠湖
Written on March 18 [1] This article was originally published in the 10th issue of Volume 1 of "Chinese Monthly" in 1941. Hunting{{id_0000}} ——Jizhu Lake将暝的夕阳，把他的“问路”[2]在背河的土阶上折成一段段屈曲的影子，又一段段让它们伸直，引他慢步越过堤面，坐到临水的石级旁的土墩上，背向着长堤风尘中疏落的脚印；当牧羊人在空际振一声长鞭，驱饱食的羊群归去，一行雁字没入白头的芦丛的时候。
The sunset at dusk folded his "asking for directions" [2] into bent shadows on the earthen steps of the river, and let them straighten in one by one, leading him to walk slowly over the embankment, sitting on the mound next to the stone steps facing the water, with his back to the sparse footprints in the dust of the embankment; when the shepherd waved his long whip in the air to drive the well-fed sheep back, and a line of geese sank into the white-haired reeds.脚下，河水澌澌的流过：因为入秋，萍花藻叶早连影子也枯了，遂越显得清浏；多少年了，它永远平和又寂寞的轻轻唱着。隔河是一片茫茫的湖水，杳无边涯，遮断旅人底眼睛。
At my feet, the river flows gently: because of the autumn, the duckweed algae leaves have already withered and even the shadows, so they look more and more clear; how many years have passed, and it will always sing softly peacefully and lonely. Across the river is a vast lake, boundless, blocking the eyes of travelers.现在，暮色从烟水间合起，教人猛一转念，大为惊愕：怎么，天已经黑了！甚么时候开始的呢？像从终日相守的人底面上偶然发现一道衰老的皱纹一样，几乎是不能置信的，然而的确已经黑了，你看湖上已落了两点明灭的红光（是寒星？渔火？），而且幽冥钟声已经颤抖在渐浓的寒气里了。
Now, the twilight rose from the smoke and water, and people suddenly changed their thoughts, and they were greatly shocked: Why, it's already dark! When did it start? It was almost unbelievable, like accidentally finding an aging wrinkle on the underside of someone who had been with you all day, but it was indeed dark, you see, two flickering red lights had fallen on the lake (is it a cold star? Fishing fire?) ), and the bell of the underworld was already trembling in the thickening cold.——而他，仍以固定的姿势坐着，一任与夜同时生长的秋风在他疏疏的散发间吹出欲绝的尖音：两手抱膝，竹竿如一个入睡的孩子，欹倚在他的左肩；头微前仰，像是瞩望着辽远的，辽远的地方。
——And he still sat in a fixed posture, allowing the autumn wind that grew at the same time as the night to blow a desperate snark between his sparse hair: his hands were on his knees, and the bamboo pole was like a sleeping child, leaning on his left shoulder; his head was slightly tilted forward, as if looking at a distant, distant place.往常，当有一只小轮船泊在河下的，你看白杨的干上不是钉有一块铁皮的小牌子，那是码头的标记了。既泊船，岸边便不这般清冷，船上油灯的光从小窗铁条栏栅中漏出，会在岸上画出朦胧的，单调的黑白图案，风过处，撼得这些图案更昏晕了，一些被旅栈伙计从温热的梦中推醒的客人，打一盏灯笼，或燃一枝蘸着松脂的枯竹，缩着肩头，摇摇的走过搭在石级上的跳板（虽然永远是飘泊的，却有归家的那一点急切）。跨入舱中，随便又认真地拣一个位置，安排下行囊，然后亲热的向陌生的人点一点头（即使第一个进舱的人也必如是，尽管点头之后，一看，向自己点头的只是自己的影子，会寂寞的笑起来），我们不能诬蔑这一点头里的真诚，因为同舟人有同一的命运，而且这小舱是他们一夜的家。
Normally, when a small boat is moored at the bottom of the river, you can see that there is not a small sign nailed to the trunk of the poplar, it is a mark of the wharf. The light of the oil lamp on the boat leaks out from the iron bars of the small windows, and will draw hazy, monotonous black and white patterns on the shore, and the wind passes by, shaking these patterns even more dizzy, and some guests who are pushed awake by the innkeeper from their warm dreams play a lantern, or burn a branch of dead bamboo dipped in pine resin, shrink their shoulders, and walk staggering past the springboard on the stone steps (although they are always adrift, but there is a little eagerness to return home). Step into the cabin, choose a position casually and carefully, arrange your luggage, and then nod affectionately to the stranger (even the first person to enter the cabin must be like this, although after nodding, at first glance, it is only your own shadow who nods to yourself, and you will laugh lonely), we cannot slander the sincerity in this head, because the people in the same boat have the same fate, and this cabin is their home for the night.旅行人跨出乡土一步，便背上一份沉重的寂寞，每个人知道浮在水上的梦，不会流到亲人的枕边，所以他们都不睡觉，且不惜自己的言语，为了自己，也为了别人，话着故乡风物，船上是不容有一分拘执的。也许在奉一枝烟，借一个火中结下以后的因缘，然而这并不能把他们从寂寞中解脱出来：孤雁打更了，有人问“还有多少时候开船？”而答话大概是“快了吧？”并且，船开之后，寂寞也并不稍减，船的慢度会令年青人如夏天痱子痒起来一般的难受，于是你听：“下来多少里哩？”“还有几里？”旅行的人怀一分意料中的无聊。
Everyone knows that dreams floating on the water will not flow to the pillow of their relatives, so they do not sleep, and do not hesitate to speak their own words, for themselves, and for others, talking about the customs of their hometown, and there is no room for any restraint on the boat. Maybe they are serving a cigarette and borrowing a fire to form a cause and effect in the future, but this does not free them from loneliness: the lone goose is on the clock, and someone asks, "How long is it to sail?" And the answer is probably "It's fast?" Moreover, after the boat leaves, the loneliness does not decrease slightly, and the slowness of the boat will make young people as uncomfortable as itching in summer, so you listen: "How many miles down?" "How many miles are there?" The traveler was bored with a hint of unexpectedness.而他，便是清扫舱中堆积的寂寞者。
轮船上吹了催客的唢呐后，估量着客人大概都已要了一壶茶或四两酒，嚼着卤煮牛肉，嗑着葵花子了，他，影子似的走入舱里，寻找熟习的声音打着招呼，那语调稍带着一点卑谦：
And he is the lonely person who cleans up the cabin. After blowing the suona urging the guests on the ship, it was estimated that the guests had probably asked for a pot of tea or four taels of wine, chewing braised beef, and eating sunflower seeds, and he, like a shadow, walked into the cabin like a shadow, looking for a familiar voice to say hello, and the tone was a little humble:“李老板，近来发财！”
“哦，张先生，您还是上半月打这儿过的，这一向好哇！”
听着冲茶时的水声的徐急，辨出了那茶房是谁，于是亲狎的呼着他的小名，道一声辛苦。
人们，也都不冷落他。
"Boss Li, you've been making a fortune lately!" "Oh, Mr. Zhang, you still played here in the first half of the month, this has always been good!" Listening to the sound of water when making tea, Xu Ji recognized who the tea room was, so he called his nickname affectionately and said hard work. People did not snub him.然后，从大襟内摸出一面磁盘，两支竹筷，玎玎珰珰的敲起来。我不能说这声音怎么好听，但总不会教你讨厌就是了，在静夜里，尤能给你意外的感动。盘声乍歇，于是开始他的似白似唱的歌，他唱的沿河的景物，一些茁蔓在乡庄里的朴野又美丽的传说，他歌唱着自己，轻拍着船舷的流水，做他歌声的伴奏。
Then, he took out a disk from the placket, two bamboo chopsticks, and knocked them up. I can't say how good this sound is, but I won't teach you to hate it, in the quiet night, it can especially give you an unexpected touch. The sound of the plate suddenly stopped, so he began to sing his white songs, the scenery along the river he sang, some simple and beautiful legends that thrived in the village, he sang himself, patted the flowing water on the side of the boat, and served as an accompaniment to his singing.他的声音，清晰，但并不太响，使留连于梦的边界的人听起来，疑是来自远方的；但如果你浮游于声音之外，那你捕捉灯下醉人的呢语去，它不会惊破一分。
His voice is clear, but not too loud, so that those who linger on the border of dreams sound like they are from afar; but if you float beyond the sound, then you catch the intoxicating words under the lamp, and it will not be shocked at all.并且他会解答你许多未问出的问题，这些问题在生客是有趣味的，而老客人也决不会烦厌：
And he will answer many of your unasked questions, which are interesting to new guests and will never be annoyed by regular customers:“这儿啦，古时候不是这样的：湖在城那边，而城建立在现在湖的地方。前年旱荒时，湖水露了底，曾有人看见淤泥里有街路的痕迹，还有人拾到古瓶，说是当年城中一所大寺院的宝塔顶子。你瞧这堤面多高，哪有比城垛还高的堤？要不是刘伯温的九条铜牛镇住啊，湖水早想归到老家这边来了。”
"Here, it wasn't like this in ancient times: the lake was on the other side of the city, and the city was built where the lake is now. During the drought the year before last, the lake was exposed, and some people saw traces of streets in the silt, and some people found ancient bottles, saying that it was the top of the pagoda of a large temple in the city. Look at how high this embankment is, how can there be an embankment higher than the battlements? If it weren't for Liu Bowen's nine copper bulls, the lake would have wanted to return to his hometown. ”“这会大概是子下三刻了吧，白衣庵的钟声渐渐懒了。”
"This will be about three o'clock in the morning, and the bell of the White Clothes Monastery is gradually getting lazy."“船慢了，河面狭了呢。开快了伤了堤，两岸的庄稼人老不声不响的乱抡砖头石块儿，一回竟开枪伤了船上的客人，所以一到这段，不敢不放慢了，这年头……”
"The boat is slow, and the river is narrow. The farmers on both sides of the river were silently picking bricks and stones, and once they shot and injured the guests on the boat, so when they reached this point, they didn't dare not slow down, these days, ......."“不远便是二郎庙，你听，水声有点不同是吧，船正在拐弯儿呢。”
“船到清水潭要停的，那儿有上好的美酒，糟青鱼的味道就不用提，到万河一带的，可以往王家店一住，明儿雇个小驴儿上路。……”
"Not far away is Erlang Temple, listen, the sound of the water is a little different, right, the boat is turning." "The boat has to stop at Qingshuitan, there is good wine there, the smell of bad herring is needless to mention, to the Wanhe area, you can stay at Wangjiadian, and hire a little donkey to go on the road tomorrow. ……”船俯身过了桥洞，唢呐儿第二次响起，不管有无上下的客人，照例得停一下的，他收起盘子里零散的钱，掖了盘子，向客人们道一声珍重，上了岸了，踏上迢迢的归路。长堤对于每个脚履的亲抚都是感谢的，何况他还有一根忠实的竿儿，告诉他前面有新掘的小沟，昨天没有的土塚。夜对于他原是和白昼一样，龙王庙神龛下的草荐又在记忆中招诱着他，所以，虽然处处有秋风作被，他仍旧要返到他的“家”里去。他走着，如走在一段平凡的日子里。
The boat leaned over the bridge hole, and the suona sounded for the second time, regardless of whether there were guests up and down, as usual, he put away the scattered money on the plate, tucked the plate, said to the guests to cherish it, went ashore, and embarked on the long way home. The long embankment is grateful for the caress of every foot, not to mention that he still has a faithful pole, telling him that there is a newly dug ditch in front of him, and the mound that was not there yesterday. The night was the same for him as the day, and the grass under the shrine of the Dragon King Temple tempted him in his memory, so although there was an autumn wind everywhere, he still had to return to his "home". He walked as if he were walking in an ordinary day.他的生涯的另一方面是围在小孩们短短的手臂里：教他们唱歌，跟他们说故事，使他们澄澈的眼里梦寐着一些缥缈的事物，以换取一点安慰，点缀在他如霜的两鬓间。记得我小的时候，曾经跟他学会唱：
“巴根草，
Another aspect of his career was to surround himself with the short arms of children: to teach them to sing, to tell them stories, to make their clear eyes dream of some ethereal things, in exchange for a little comfort, to dot his frosty temples. I remember when I was a child, I used to learn to sing with him: "Bagan grass,绿，
唱个歌儿姐姐听。”
而“秋虎妈妈”的故事，还似一片落在静水里的花瓣，微风过有时会泛上一点鲜红（祝福它永远不要腐烂）。
green{{id_0000}}{{id_00001}}, Sing a song, sister. ” The story of "Autumn Tiger Mother" is like a petal falling into still water, and sometimes it will turn a little bright red after the breeze (bless it never rot).（如今怕要轮到我们的子侄辈来听他的了）。
(Now I'm afraid it's our turn to listen to him.)你要问他为甚么如此熟习于河上的风物，河又为甚么对他如此亲切吧？他是河之子，把年青的一段日子消磨在这只小轮上，那时他是个令同辈人羡嫉，老年人摇头的水手啊，而那时候，船也是年青的。
You have to ask him why he is so familiar with the scenery of the river, and why the river is so kind to him? He was a son of the river, and spent some of his youth on this small boat, when he was a sailor who was the envy of his peers and shook his head in old age, and at that time, the boat was also young.他本有一个女儿，死了，死在河那边的湖里（关于他女儿的事容我下回再告诉你吧）。
He had a daughter, who died, in the lake on the other side of the river (I will tell you about his daughter next time).他的眼睛是甚么时候瞎了的呢，我不知道，而且我们似乎忘了他是个瞎子，像他自己已经忘了不瞎的时候一样。但是他本来有一对善于问询与答话的美丽的眼睛，也许，也许他的瞎与眼睛的美丽有关系的吧？年青的人，凭自己想去吧！
I don't know when his eyes were blind, and we seem to have forgotten that he was blind, just as he himself had forgotten when he was not blind. But he originally had a pair of beautiful eyes that were good at asking and answering, perhaps, maybe his blindness had something to do with the beauty of his eyes, right? Young people, go as you wish!荒鸡在叫头遍了，被寒气一扑又把声音咽下，仍把头缩在翅膀里睡了，他还坐在猎猎的秋风里，比夜更静穆，比夜的颜色更深。
The wild chicken was crowing its head, swallowing its voice again by the cold, still shrunk its head in its wings and fell asleep, and he was still sitting in the hunting autumn wind, quieter than the night, darker than the night.轮船今夜还会来吗？它也如一个衰颓的老人，在阴天或节气时常常要闹闹筋骨酸痛甚么的。
你还等甚么呢，呵哟，你摸摸草叶子看，今夜的露水多重！
脚下，流水永远平和又寂寞的唱着，唱着。
Will the ship come again tonight? It is also like a declining old man, who often has to make a fuss on cloudy days or solar terms. What are you waiting for, hehe, you touch the grass leaves and see, how heavy is the dew tonight! Under my feet, the flowing water is always peaceful and lonely, singing.

河上

河上[1]
[1] This article was originally published in Chongqing's "Ta Kung Pao Literature and Art" on January 6, 1941, and was also published in Guilin's "Ta Kung Pao" on April 25, 1941. [2] Bamboo staff in the hands of a blind man. On the river[1]在乡下住了这些日子，甚么都惯了。在先有些不便，就原谅这是乡下，将就着过去，住了些时，连这些不便都觉不到了，对于乡下的爱慕则未稍减一分，而且变得更固执，他不断在掘发一些更美丽的。
After living in the countryside these days, I am used to everything. After living for a while, I didn't even feel these inconveniences, and my love for the countryside did not diminish at all, and I became more stubborn, and he kept digging for some more beautiful things.清晨真好，小小的风吹进鲜嫩的叶子里，在里面休息一下，又吹了出来，拂到人脸上，那么顽皮的，要想绷起脸，那简直是不可能，他把嘴唇这么舔了舔有点无可奈何的望着它们。
It's so nice in the morning, a little wind blew into the tender leaves, rested in it, blew it out again, brushed on people's faces, so naughty, if you want to stretch your face, it is simply impossible, he licked his lips like this and looked at them helplessly.田埂上干干净净的，但两旁的草常常想伸头到另一边去看看，带了累累的露珠，脚一碰到，便纷纷的落下来，那么嫩，沾到鞋上不肯再离身，他的脚全湿了，但他毫不注意，还有意去撩拨撩拨。
“山外青山楼外楼”，
The ridge was clean, but the grass on both sides often wanted to stretch out his head to the other side to take a look, with a lot of dewdrops, as soon as his feet touched them, they fell one after another, so tender, he got on his shoes and refused to leave his body, his feet were all wet, but he didn't pay attention, and he also intended to tease and tease. "Outside the mountains, the green mountains and buildings outside the buildings",他笑了，不知是为了这声音，还是因为这声音所唱出的歌，还是低着头也照样用假嗓子接唱下句：
“情郎哥哥住在村后头。”
“哈哈，李大爹，好嗓子，教你儿媳妇听见不怕笑话吗？”
He smiled, I don't know if it was for this voice, or because of the song sung by this voice, or he lowered his head and continued to sing the next sentence with a fake voice: "My lover's brother lives at the back of the village." "Haha, Uncle Li, good voice, teach your daughter-in-law not to be afraid of jokes when she hears them?"“城里人还唱这个呢。早，少爷，恁早，敢是？”
“一早上麻雀打架就醒了。下田？小秧子都绿得要滴了，今年年成好，该替你娶二媳妇了。”
"The people in the city still sing this. Morning, young master, you are early, dare you?" ” "I woke up in the morning when the sparrows fought. Go to the field? The little seedlings are so green that they are dripping, and this year is good, it's time to marry a second daughter-in-law for you. ”“我那二小子才十五哩，噢——，取笑取笑，嚇嚇，回见，少爷。昨晚上在秧池里又弄到两尾鲫鱼，过会儿跟你送来吧？”
"My second boy is only fifteen miles, oh——, make fun of him, scare, see you later, young master. I got two more crucian carp in the seedling pond last night, will I bring them to you later?" ”“今儿我上城去一趟，你养在水缸里吧，晚上我自己来拿。你要点甚么我给带来，怎么样，还是酒我知道！”
“不敢领，不敢领，谢谢了。”
"I'll go to the city today, you can keep it in the water tank, and I'll get it myself at night. I will bring you what you want, how about it, I know the wine!" ” "I don't dare to take it, I dare not take it, thank you."他回头看看，老头子笑着走了，还拾起一块石头往河里一丢，又撮起嘴吹起嘹亮的哨子，逗那歇在柳梢上逞能的画眉。
“老东西，你当心跌进河里去，水凉着哪。”
“你！”
He looked back, the old man walked away with a smile, picked up a stone and threw it into the river, picked up his mouth and blew a loud whistle to tease the thrush resting on the willow tips. "Old thing, be careful of falling into the river, where is the water cold." "You!"他放过老头子，在老头子笑着回头时转了湾。
He let go of the old man and turned around when the old man turned around with a smile.…………
“是甚么时候来的现在连那个瘫子王八都认识我了。要不是医生说我神经衰弱我怎么会来呢，这一住真不知到甚么时候才回去，我现在才知道乡下人为甚么那么看重他们的家。可是他们还一直叫我城里人，城里人城里人！”
"When did you come, and now even that paralyzed bastard knows me. If the doctor hadn't said that I had a nervous breakdown, how could I have come, I really don't know when I will go back to this stay, and now I know why the countrymen value their home so much. But they still keep calling me a city person, a city person, a city person! ”“蛇，蛇，蛇，一条大土谷蛇！”
他猛地嚇了一跳但很快的辨出这是谁的声音，便不怕了。
“你才是蛇，蛇会变个好看的女人迷人，三儿。”
“城里人怕蛇，喝喝，……”
三儿不理他，跳蹦着家去了。
"Snake, snake, snake, a big earth valley snake!" He was startled suddenly, but quickly recognized whose voice it was, and was not afraid. "You are the snake, the snake will become a good-looking woman and charming, San'er." "People in the city are afraid of snakes, drink ,......" San'er ignored him and jumped home.迎出来的是王大妈。
“早，少爷，我们马上就要下田了。早饭这就好了，吃了跟我们一块车水去。”
“谁跟他踩，笨手笨脚的，乡下生活他甚么也干不好，就学会了唱歌！”
It was Aunt Wang who greeted her. "Morning, young master, we are going to the field soon. Breakfast is fine, eat and go with us. ” "Whoever steps on him, clumsy, he can't do anything in the countryside, so he learned to sing!"三儿在里面摆着碗筷，大着声音说。
“不给你们去了，白做了一天，工钱也不给，还硬逼人吃豆油炒鸡蛋！王大妈，我今儿要上城去一趟呢。”
San'er put the dishes and chopsticks in it and said in a loud voice. "I won't go to you, I did it for nothing, I didn't pay wages, and I forced people to eat scrambled eggs with soybean oil! Aunt Wang, I'm going to go to the city today. ”早饭摆在桌上，两碗烫饭，一碗清汤蛋。三儿一听他说完那句话，便把鸡蛋抢过来吃。
“不吃蛋，我吃！”
“这死丫头，看噎住了。”
Breakfast was placed on the table, two bowls of hot rice and a bowl of clear soup eggs. As soon as San'er heard what he said, he snatched the eggs and ate them. "Don't eat eggs, I'll eat them!" "This dead girl, I choked on it."“王大妈，你藏着这么个大姑娘在家里，家神灶神都不得安宁。也不怕人恨你。”
王大妈笑着坐下了，她心里脸上有许多话。
“王大妈，我上城去，问你借两样东西，你把那条双舞剑借给我——”
"Aunt Wang, you are hiding such a big girl at home, and the family god and kitchen god are not at peace. I'm not afraid that people will hate you. ” Aunt Wang smiled and sat down, with many words on her face. "Aunt Wang, I'll go to the city and ask you to borrow two things, and you lend me that double dancing sword-"“不借，不借，船是妈的，妈是我的，我不借！”
“不借，我划了就走。”
“我叫乡长拿你。”
“乡长替你做媒呢。”
“呸！”三儿摔了筷子进她自己的房里去了。妈的早饭还没吃完，她又出来。
"Don't borrow, don't borrow, the boat is my mother, my mother is mine, I won't borrow it!" "Don't borrow it, I'll row and leave." "I'll ask the township chief to take you." "The township chief is a matchmaker for you." "Bah!" San'er dropped her chopsticks and went into her room. Mom's breakfast hadn't been finished yet, and she came out again.“妈，我先下田去了。”
“下田干吗要换身新衣裳，嗨。”
不理，一溜烟走了。

六、故事的主人公致作者的信
敬爱的朋友西门鱼先生：
Xun was tired, he grabbed a handful of wild orchids and closed his eyes, and a group of little fairies kissed him, and from tomorrow, he would only live half of time and space. 6. Letter from the protagonist of the story to the author Dear Friend Mr. Simon Yu,我仿佛是注定了要写这封信给你。不过在写下第一个字时便已知道我这信一定把我要说的话走了样。不论是较好或较坏，都不是原来的样子。有些话起初想说而没有说，有些话本不想说却又墙头草一样的不知是怎么风吹来了，有些话想说，也说出来，而且生理上起了变化令人有见了别离了二三十年的儿子的母亲的心情。这是动笔人的常事，我相信，先生写完了《匹夫》不能不与我有同感。
I seem to be destined to write this letter to you. But when I wrote the first word, I already knew that my letter must have taken what I was going to say out of shape. Whether it is better or worse, it is not the original form. Some things I wanted to say at first but didn't say, some things I didn't want to say but I don't know how the wind blew like a wallflower, some things I wanted to say and said them, and the physiological changes made people feel like a mother who had been separated from her son for twenty or thirty years. This is a common thing for people who write it, and I believe that my husband cannot help but feel the same way as me after writing "The Ordinary Man".我们谢谢你，你用我来做这个故事的连锁关节，虽然你无心为我作起居言行录，我也正不希望你那样。所以我不送我的日记给你作参考就无庸遗憾了。
We thank you for using me as the link of this story, although you have no intention of recording my daily life and deeds, I don't want you to do that. So I don't regret not sending you my diary for reference.前两月我认识一位“新诗”时代的老年青诗人，我们真有点一见如故，我很喜欢他的脾气。我们大家都会聊天，一聊就忘了时间的生灭。一回他谈起我的一位先生，说他人极可爱，却有一点不好，每每把相熟的人写到他的小说里去，一写进小说，虽然态度很好，总不免有点褒贬存在其间，令人不感快活。诗人的话我不同意。当时却也没有跟他辩论。
Two months ago, I met an old young poet in the era of "new poetry", and we really hit it off at first sight, and I liked his temper very much. We all chat, and we forget the life and death of time when we talk. Every time he talked about a gentleman of mine, he said that he was very cute, but there was a little bit of a bad thing, and every time he wrote acquaintances into his novels, as soon as he wrote them into the novel, although his attitude was very good, he couldn't help but feel a little praise and criticism in between, which made people feel unhappy. I didn't agree with the poet's words. I didn't debate with him at that time.我也感谢你不用太史公夹叙夹议的笔法，但如果你真这样，我并不反对。
I also thank you for not using the brushwork of Tai Shi Gong, but if you are like this, I am not opposed.第一，你动手描画那个人，必须对他了解，即使并不了解，也至少具有了解的勇气与诚心。这，还不值得感谢吗？对于一个人性的探险者我们必须慰问。因此写小说实在是个高贵的职业，如果写小说也算得是职业。我们这个国度的气候真不佳，了解的温情开不了花，多有几个想写小说的，哪怕，写小说的呢，我们的国度将会美丽些。
First, when you draw that person, you must understand him, and even if you don't know him, you must at least have the courage and sincerity to understand. Isn't this worth thanking? We must offer condolences to the explorers of human nature. Therefore, writing novels is really a noble profession, and if you write novels, it can be regarded as a profession. The climate in our country is really bad, and the warmth of understanding cannot bloom, and there are a few more people who want to write novels, even if they write novels, our country will be more beautiful.再说，写小说不在熟人里讨材料，难道倒去随便拉两个陌生人来吗！这一点起码是我们应该给一个作家的。
写得像，是你，忠实。写得不像，不是你，算他本领差。
Besides, if you don't ask for materials from acquaintances when writing novels, why don't you just bring two strangers! At least this is what we should give to a writer. Write like you, faithful. Write like it, not you, it's not his bad skills.恭维得当，聪明，奚落几句能恰到好处，大家应相视一笑方算得朋友。叫拍照的不要拍出脸上的麻疤那不免是乡下大姑娘的小气，不足取法。而且，对不起，正因为要使他像你，那个麻疤或许要夸大一点渲染一下。你要是计较这些，那是寻找错了人。
Compliments are appropriate, smart, and a few words of ridicule are just right, and everyone should look at each other and smile at each other to be considered friends. Tell the person who took the photo not to take pictures of the scars on his face, which is inevitably the stinginess of the big girl in the countryside, and it is not enough to take the law. And, I'm sorry, just because you want to make him look like you, that scar may have to be exaggerated a little more. If you care about this, you are looking for the wrong person.被写的人通常最怕人讽刺。关于讽刺，鲁宾孙的心理的改造上有一段说得极好，原文记不清，不具引，现在但说我一点意思。
The person who is written is usually the most afraid of sarcasm. Regarding irony, there is a passage in the transformation of Robinson's psychology that is very good, the original text is not remembered, and there is no quote, but now I will say a little meaning.有人说一切小说都是自传，这是真话，没有一个人物是不经过作者的自己的揉掺而会活在纸上的。作者愈尖刻，愈表示作者了解的深精，作者必先寄以同情，甚至喜欢，然后人物方会有人间烟火气，甚至，没有人间烟火气。字典上所以同时有骂人与讽刺两个词汇是不难明白的。
Some people say that all novels are autobiographies, this is the truth, and no character will live on paper without the author's own mixing. The more sharp the author, the more it means that the author understands deeply, and the author must first send sympathy or even like, and then the characters will have human fireworks, or even no human fireworks. It is not difficult to understand that there are two words in the dictionary at the same time: scolding and sarcasm.再者，若是有些人一直是以被讽刺为生活的，那更该感谢讽刺的人，因为你们必须依赖别人的讽刺才能活下来。他给你们一个生活的口实。不然你们必须自杀以谢人类的理由更大了。我教给你们，如果下次有人问你们就你们凭甚么也以人类的名分来吃这份粮食，“没有你们世界不更好些吗？”你们可以说：“我们可以给人讽刺。”
Furthermore, if some people have been living by being ridiculed, then you should thank the sarcastic person even more, because you have to rely on other people's sarcasm to survive. He gives you an excuse to live. Otherwise, you have to commit suicide to thank humanity. I teach you, if someone asks you next time why you eat this food as a human being, "Wouldn't the world be better without you?" You can say, "We can give irony." ”好了，我好像是知道你要将我的信发表乘机来宣教了，我知道这事瞒不过先生慧眼。
已经糟蹋了不少篇幅，有话也不能再说，何况没有话，所有的话都在题目里了。再见。

When the car was about to start, I suddenly remembered something, opened the box, put a book in, took out another book, and took out a letter from each of the two books. Suddenly thinking about it again, I hurriedly jumped out of the car. "You throw away all the jasmine." "What? - Oh. ”五年前在待车室里发了一个电报之后又写了一封快信：
“父亲：
Five years ago, after sending a telegram in the waiting room, I wrote another quick letter: "Father:这里有一种极美的花，每年只在这个时节开一次，开不了八九天，到春假完了时花也完了，容我盘玩几日吧。你愿意我有个好春天，所以我不回来了。”
“先生，车不开了。”
There is a very beautiful flower here, it only blooms once a year at this time of year, it can't bloom for eight or nine days, and the flowers are gone when the spring break is over, let me play for a few days. You want me to have a good spring, so I'm not coming back. ” "Sir, the car won't drive."“不开最好，好极了，——啊，不开了？为甚么？”
“不大清楚，谁知道为甚么呢！”
"It's best not to open it, it's great,—— oh, don't open it? Why? ” "I don't know, who knows why!"侍役说完了话，竟自走了。待车室玻璃窗上全是水，外间景物模糊，如一个满眼泪水的人所看见的天地一样。路警对于车辆太熟悉了，全不发生兴趣，在泥与水的月台上来往的走，黑色的雨衣沙沙的发声。
After the attendant finished speaking, he walked away. The glass window of the waiting room was full of water, and the scenery outside was blurred, just like the world seen by a person with tears in his eyes. The road police were too familiar with the vehicle and were not interested at all, walking back and forth on the mud and water platform, and the rustling of black raincoats.我怎么办呢。
回去。没有雨鞋，没有雨伞，头发里的水流到脖子里。好像回不去。
回去，用一张素纸写了“待车室”三字贴在墙上。
What should I do? Get back. No rain boots, no umbrella, water in my hair flows to my neck. It seems that there is no going back. Go back and write the words "waiting room" on a piece of plain paper and paste it on the wall.灯下大声读书。我的声音若是高出了你，你看一看我，低头拂一拂头发，便用更高的声音赶过了我。如今“我”也是我，“你”也是我，一个在镜子里，一个在镜子外。
Read aloud under the lamp. If my voice is higher than yours, you look at me, lower your head and brush your hair, and you will catch up with me with a higher voice. Now "I" is also me, and "you" is also me, one in the mirror and the other outside the mirror.书帮助我们过了多少日子，读着，又平放在桌上。
先生，你请坐坐吧。你累了呢。是呀，你忙得很。你一天到晚老是跑来跑去的，真是！椅子是多么好一个主人呀，它多么诚恳，多么殷勤。

Books help us live a lot of life, reading, and laying flat on the table. Sir, please sit down. You are tired. Yes, you are very busy. You run around all day long, really! What a good owner the chair is, how sincere and attentive it is. Revised December 12
