"Even if I can't find you in my life, I'm looking for you in this life." The last sentence of the voice.第二天，一天亮，他跑近一个绝壁。这真是一个尽头，回身来，他才看见天，苍碧嶙峋，不可抗拒的力量压下来。他呼吸细而急，太阳穴跳动，脸色发青，两股贴紧，汗出如浆。剑在他背上，很重。而在绝壁的里面，像是从地心里，发出丁丁的声音，坚决而从容。
The next day, at dawn, he ran close to a cliff. This was really an end, and when he turned around, he saw the sky, green and irresistible, pressing down. He breathed thin and rapidly, his temples were beating, his face was blue, his legs were tight, and he was sweating like pulp. The sword was on his back, very heavy. And inside the cliff, it seemed to come from the center of the earth, making a tintin sound, resolute and calm.他走进绝壁。好黑，半天，他甚么也看不见。退出来？他像是浸在冰水里。而他的眼睛渐渐能看见前面一两尺地方，他站了一会，稳住自己。丁，一声，一个火花，赤红的。丁，又一个。风从洞口吹进来，吹在他背上。咽了一口唾液，他走进去。他听见自己跫跫足音，这个声音鼓励他，教他不踉跄，有样子。里面越走越窄，他得弓着身子。他直视前面，一个一个火花爆出来。好了，到了尽头。到尽头，是一堆长头发，一个人，匍匐，一手錾子，一手锤头，正开凿膝前的方寸。像是没有听见有人来，他不回头。渐渐的，他向上开凿，他的手举起，举起，旅行人看见两只僧衣的袖子，他披及腰下的长发抖动一下。他举起，举起，旅行人看见那一双手，奇瘦，露骨，全是筋。旅行人向后退一步。和尚把头回过来一下。只一双眼睛，从纷披的长发后面闪出来。旅行人木然。举起举起，火花，火花，再来一个，火花！他差点没晕过去：和尚的手臂上赫然是三个字，针刺的，涂蓝的，是他父亲的名字。一时，他甚么也不见，只有那三个字。一笔一划，他在心里描了那三个字。丁，一个火花，字一跳动。时间从洞外飞逝，一卷白云从洞口掠过。他简直忘记自己背上的剑了，或则是他自己整个消失就剩得这口剑。他缩小缩小，至于没有。然后又回来，回来，好了，他的脸色由青转红，他自己充满于躯体，剑！他拔剑在手。
He walked into the cliff. It was so dark, for a long time, he couldn't see anything. Exit? He seemed to be immersed in ice water. And his eyes gradually could see a foot or two ahead, and he stood for a while, steadying himself. Ding, a sound, a spark, red. Ding, another one. The wind blew in from the hole and blew on his back. Swallowing a mouthful of saliva, he walked in. He heard his own sarcastic footsteps, which encouraged him and taught him not to stumble, to look good. It got narrower and narrower, and he had to hunch. He looked straight ahead, and sparks burst out one by one. Okay, it's over. At the end, there was a pile of long hair, a person, crawling, chiseling in one hand and hammering in the other, chiseling an inch in front of his knees. As if he didn't hear anyone coming, he didn't look back. Gradually, he chiseled upwards, his hands were raised, raised, and the traveler saw the sleeves of the two monk's robes, and his long hair below his waist shook. He lifted it up, lifted it, and the traveler saw the hands, extremely thin, exposed, full of tendons. The traveler took a step back. The monk turned his head back. Only a pair of eyes flashed out from behind the long hair. The traveler was dumbfounded. Lift up, spark, spark, another one, spark! He almost didn't faint: there were three words on the monk's arm, needle pricked, blued, and his father's name. For a while, he saw nothing, only those three words. With one stroke, he drew those three words in his heart. Ding, a spark, a word jumped. Time flew outside the cave, and a white cloud passed by the cave. He simply forgot the sword on his back, or he disappeared completely, leaving this sword behind. He shrank and shrunk, as for nothing. Then he came back, came back, okay, his face turned from green to red, and he himself was full of body, sword! He drew his sword in his hand.从容的，坚决的，丁丁的声音；火花，紫赤晶明。
忽然他相信他母亲一定已经死了。
“铿”的一声。
他的剑落回鞘里。第一朵锈。
Calm, resolute, Tintin's voice; sparks, amethyst crystals. Suddenly he believed that his mother must have died. There was a "clang". His sword fell back into its sheath. The first rust.他看了看自己脚下，脚下是新凿的痕迹。而在他脚前，另一付锤錾摆着。他俯身，拾起来。和尚稍为往旁边挪过一点。
两滴眼泪闪在庙里白发的和尚的眼睛里。
He looked at his feet, and there were traces of new chisels under his feet. And in front of his feet, another hammer was swinging. He leaned over and picked it up. The monk moved slightly to the side. Two tears flashed in the eyes of the white-haired monk in the temple.有一天，两付錾子会同时凿在空里。第一线由另一面射进来的光。

前天

前天[1]
前天，哦，我差一点送了命。
The day before yesterday{{id_0000}} The day before yesterday, oh, I almost lost my life.我很难计算这么一句话里的感情。我请你不把它看得太佻达，也不弄得太感伤，我意思本不如此。如果我说“差一点就死”，或“差点儿就送了命”，而且语气上更有点……那就不同了。
I have a hard time calculating the feelings in such a sentence. I ask you not to take it too frivolously or sentimentally, I don't mean that. If I say "almost die" or "almost die" and the tone is a little more ...... That's different.晚上，十点钟，天很黑，和一个人从城里坐马车回来。马老了，又跑了一整天，累了。车身太高，重心不稳，车夫吆喝，挥鞭，甚至说话看人都不大在行。“黄土坡！黄土坡。”他把惊叹号用错了！语气加在第一句话上。他走路时脚跟离地不多，拖里沓拉的。我断定他赶车时一定老在车下跑，不惯坐在“车夫座”上（后来证明我的观察极正确）。他不会扣点钱喝酒。或来两把“八点，十三！”他一定跟我一样，数票子数得也很慢。我对这个绝无近代生活中紧张气味的马车夫很有兴趣（倒不是说马车本身是个过去的东西。昆明一般马车夫都在农民的淳朴笨拙上盖上一层工人式的狡猾与机警，正充分象征这个暴发的都市）。高高的坐在前面，从城里的热风中回到乡下，回到清静，在星星底下，回去，睡眠等着我的疲倦。说不定我在床上还可以看一封信，……我有时严肃，有时轻扬，想及许多事情，在马蹄郭得郭得声中，柏油路上。路边杨树白天的浓荫，在星光下唤起一分沁人甘凉。
In the evening, at ten o'clock, it was very dark, and he came back in a carriage from the city with a person. The horse was old, ran all day, and was tired. The body was too high, the center of gravity was unstable, and the coachman shouted, waved his whip, and even looked at people who were not very good at talking. "Loess Slope! Loess. He used the exclamation mark wrong! The tone was added to the first sentence. He walked with his heels not much off the ground, and he dragged his feet. I concluded that he must have been running under the car all the time when he was in the car, and he was not used to sitting in the "coachman's seat" (my observation turned out to be very correct). He wouldn't deduct some money for drinking. Or two "Eight, thirteen!" He must have been like me, and he counted the votes very slowly. I am very interested in this coachman who has no smell of tension in modern life (not that the carriage itself is a thing of the past. The general coachmen in Kunming cover the simple clumsiness of the peasants with a layer of worker-like cunning and alertness, which fully symbolizes this outbreak city). Sitting high in front, returning to the countryside from the hot wind of the city, returning to the quiet, under the stars, going back, sleep waiting for my fatigue. Maybe I can read a letter in bed,...... Sometimes I am serious, sometimes light, thinking about many things, in the sound of horseshoes, on the asphalt. The thick shade of the poplars on the roadside during the day evokes a refreshing coolness under the starlight.路极熟，快了，通过铁道。我知道那个小宝塔立在右边小山上，为无边的夜色所淹没。过铁道了，车子跳一跳。跳出来我的微笑。带我向“过去”那条路走。我想起前年，是冬天，有一个时候，差不多每天早晨，和一个人沿着铁道走，向左，走得相当远。每次心里都觉得就这么走下去，多好。走下去，走到那里去呢？仿佛看到一幅画，远远的，两个人，那么一直走，一定还轻轻说点甚么，因为远了，听不见。也用不着听。这些话若从那里提出来必会失去颜色，那么娇嫩，摘不得。一直走下去，越走越远，走到那里去呢？想到那就是我，是她，于是笑了，我今天的笑就还有那种笑的记忆。但是，每次都相视一笑就回来了。而且都在差不多地方（给那里立个界碑吧）。回来时，照例在小车站上看看等火车的人。他们等车，我们等甚么，照例这些人天天改变，又总是如此就从未有印象留下。我常在站旁摊子上买一包烟。
The road is very familiar, fast, through the railway. I know that the small pagoda stands on the hill on the right, overwhelmed by the boundless night. After crossing the railway, the car jumped. Jumped out of my smile. Take me to the "past" road. I remembered the year before last, it was winter, and there was a time when I walked along the railway with a person almost every morning, to the left, quite far. Every time I feel in my heart, how good it is to just go on like this. Go down, where do you go? It's like seeing a painting, far away, two people, so if you keep walking, you must still say something softly, because you can't hear it because it's far away. You don't need to listen. If these words are brought up from there, they will lose their color, so delicate, and you can't pick them. Keep walking, go farther and farther, where do you go? I thought it was me, it was her, so I smiled, and I still have the memory of that smile today. However, every time I look at each other and smile, I come back. And they are all in the same place (let's put up a boundary marker there). When I came back, I looked at the people waiting for the train at the small station as usual. They waited for the train, what were we waiting for, as usual, these people changed every day, and they were always like this, and they never left an impression. I often buy a pack of cigarettes at the stall next to the station.“为甚么到那边买来，这不是有一个。”
“……怎么没看见？明天买这个的。”
“这个塔怎么上不去？”
"Why did you buy it over there, it's not one." “…… Why didn't you see it? I'll buy this tomorrow." ” "Why can't I go up to this tower?"这怎么回答？好像也无须回答。第一次经过塔时告诉她是个实心的。知道她不满意，塔能上去多好。一同凭塔窗眺望远景，青天，白云，一只鸟，翅膀尖蘸了点天上明蓝，……说到塔，是定得从公路右边，从我马车右边绕回去了。都在差不多时候。
How to answer this? It seems that there is no need to answer. The first time I passed the tower, I told her that she was a solid person. Knowing that she was not satisfied, it would be nice to go up to the tower. Looking at the distant view from the tower window, the blue sky, white clouds, a bird, the tips of its wings dipped in a little blue in the sky,...... Speaking of the tower, it must be from the right side of the road and back from the right side of my carriage. All at about the same time.有一天，我们看见一饼圆圆的冰，冰里开了一枝菜花，开得很好，黄黄的，楚楚可怜。结了冰，（昆明）难得的。“这无疑是曾经养在一个洋铁罐子里的。也许一时要用那个罐子，便倒在这里了。主人当是个洋车夫，或是打更的……”试捡起那块冰，拈在手里一会儿，走了一段，又好好放在路旁，事前事后都用眼睛征询她，她不说甚么，只看着我，心里似乎这么想：“他捡起这块冰，他放下。”她似乎总是用这种眼光看我作一切事情。我如果发出一声惊人的大叫？她一定也还是如此。我带了这块冰走了一段，又好好的放在路边。那天霜很大，太阳可极好，也没有甚么风。空气清新扑面，如早晨刚打开窗子。远近林树安静而清洁。她穿一件浅灰色大衣。……
One day, we saw a cake of round ice, and a cauliflower bloomed in the ice, blooming very well, yellow, and pitiful. Frozen, (Kunming) is rare. "This was undoubtedly kept in a foreign iron jar. Maybe I wanted to use that jar for a while, and it fell here. The owner should be a foreign coachman, or a night watchman...... "Try to pick up the ice, hold it in your hand for a while, walk for a while, put it on the side of the road, and ask her with her eyes before and after, she didn't say anything, just looked at me, and seemed to think in her heart: "He picked up this piece of ice, he put it down." She always seems to look at me with this kind of eyes. What if I let out a scream? She must still be like that. I took the ice for a while and put it on the side of the road. It was a very frosty day, the sun was excellent, and there was no wind. The air was fresh, as if the windows had just been opened in the morning. The trees near and far were quiet and clean. She wore a light gray coat. ……她的手非常非常软和，双手插在大衣袋里。我想我的手也应当插进去。应当的事办不到，自然是不出奇的。我不戴手套。
Her hands were very, very soft, and she was in her coat pocket. I thought my hands should be in them too. It was not surprising that things that should not be done. I don't wear gloves.忽然，全车人大叫起来。惊散了我所含的笑。等我澈底明白是怎么回事时，事情已经过去。一辆既瞎且疯的大卡车，撞在我们马车上了！车不开灯，行驶极快，又不靠左边走，司机想是个广东人，二十来岁。迎头冲原是一种广东作风！幸而车上人在撞到之前即大叫，那个司机急急转过驾驶盘，我们的外行车夫也出于本能急急向左一闪，全车人差点没给掀出来。结果碰在马车轮子上，汽车一溜烟不见了。像一个顽皮孩子扔石头扎了人脑袋，不敢看看究竟如何，头也不回，马上跑了。
Suddenly, the whole car screamed. It shattered my laughter. By the time I understood what was going on, it was over. A big truck that was blind and crazy crashed into our carriage! The car didn't turn on the lights, it was driving very fast, and it didn't go to the left, and the driver thought it was a Cantonese person, in his twenties. Head-on rushing is originally a Cantonese style! Fortunately, the person in the car shouted before hitting it, and the driver turned the steering wheel sharply, and our layman also flashed to the left out of instinct, and the whole car almost didn't lift it out. As a result, it hit the wheels of the carriage, and the car disappeared. Like a naughty child who threw a stone and stabbed someone's head, he didn't dare to see what was going on, and he ran away immediately without looking back.马车夫用外乡口音，不大得体的方式咕咕噜噜骂了几句，用意倒像是给自己听听，末了吼一声“走！”胡里胡涂老马又上了路，得郭，得郭，……
“看一看，那里坏了，能走么？”
The coachman grunted and cursed a few words in a foreign accent and in a not very decent way, but the intention was to listen to himself, and finally roared "Let's go!" The old horse of Huli Hutu went on the road again, got Guo, got Guo,...... "Take a look, it's broken there, can you leave?"“这不是走了，……”说话的人忽然也怀疑起来，车会不会一下子散了？
"Isn't this gone,......" The person who spoke suddenly wondered, will the car break up all of a sudden?轮轴转珠圈裂了，戛戛作响，单调而有节拍。车身更加摇晃。老马喘气声音更重浊。车夫简直不敢坐上来了，只在底下拢住缰辔拖。车上人忽然感到彼此间一种同船共渡的亲近。但是谁也没交谈。也许每个人都各自嚼着一串故事，呼吸声音，了了可闻。
The axle bead ring cracked, rattling, monotonous and beating. The body shook even more. The old horse's panting voice became heavier and muffler. The coachman didn't dare to sit on it, so he just grabbed the reins and dragged it underneath. The people in the car suddenly felt a sense of closeness to each other. But no one spoke. Maybe everyone chewed on a string of stories, breathed sounds, and could be heard.“算了，就慢点吧，莫打它了。”
“靠左边点，又有汽车来了。”
忽然有一个人叫“停了，不坐了，给你钱。”他给了点够到站的钱，大家看着他，不知为甚么。
"Forget it, just slow down, don't hit it." "Keep to the left, and another car is coming." Suddenly a person shouted, "Stop, don't sit down, give you money." He gave some money enough to stand, and everyone looked at him, not knowing why.下来一段路，我跟同伴说，“最多一秒钟，相差。”表声在我心里响了的答一声了。过一会，“如果把腿搁在（车厢）外边？”他说“胳臂也差不多。”
为幸运的偶然，我们笑得非常尽兴。笑得简直有点儿疯。
After a while, I said to my companion, "At most one second, the difference." The watch replied in my heart. After a while, "What if you put your legs outside (the carriage)?" He said, "The arms are about the same." ” By luck, we laughed heartily. We laughed a little crazy.到了家，同伴说，“奇怪，当时并不怕。”当然，这一点都不奇怪。他说“假如一下子……该开追悼会了。”当时似即已想到种种，看到自己遗像在许多花圈，许多零散的花上面。谁在花旁边默默站立，擦了眼泪。谁记起在那一桩事情上曾经有负于死者，一直想找个机会说开了，或不著痕迹的冰释了。谁听到一句他生前的口头语，寂寞的微笑。……我们的疲倦好像延误了，我们有些话要谈，虽然说出的话全不是要说的，他把口袋里东西清理一番，一一看过，又一一装进去，连今天的一点紧张一点笑，一点由于回忆而来的淡淡惆怅。装好时用手揣揣，似乎全都在里边。
When I got home, my companion said, "Strange, I wasn't afraid at the time." Of course, it was not surprising at all. He said, "If all of a sudden...... It's time for a memorial service." At that time, he seemed to have thought of all kinds of things, and saw his portrait on many wreaths and scattered flowers. Who stood silently next to the flowers and wiped away his tears. Who remembered that he had failed the deceased in that matter, and had always wanted to find an opportunity to open up, or the ice melted without a trace. Who heard a spoken word from his lifetime, a lonely smile. …… Our fatigue seemed to be delayed, we had something to talk about, although the words were not to be said, he cleaned up the things in his pockets, looked at them one by one, and put them in one by one, even a little nervous laughter today, a little bit of melancholy due to memories. When it was packed, it seemed that it was all inside.“昆明菜花冬天也开。冰结住了，冰在那里？”
好像没有谁听见我的话。（三月十九日记，夜二时。想起圣路易之稿。）

磨灭

磨灭[1]
苍蝇搓它的手，它的脚。
（不要打了，苍蝇搓它的手它的脚呢。）
苍蝇的翅膀上有虹彩，颜色如水面上的油花。嗡，飞起了。
天真闷。
Erase {{id_0000}} The fly rubs its hands, its feet. (Don't hit it, the fly rubs its hands and feet.) ） The wings of the fly have iridescent colors, the color is like oil on the water. Buzz, fly up. Innocent and boring.是的，天气真闷。一个乡下人买了一对蜡烛，蜡烛直滴落的油。他的鞋面上也滴了油，着油处加一层薄灰。
在路上，我走了一点二十分，天上的云没有一块变过样子，绝对没有。
Yes, the weather is so stuffy. A countryman bought a pair of candles, and the candles dripped with oil. He also dripped oil on the upper of his shoes, and added a thin layer of ash to the place where the oil was placed. On the way, I walked for a little twenty minutes, and none of the clouds in the sky had changed, absolutely not.好了，张先生大概又不在家。事情呢，本来也没有甚么，回去写信话更好说些。
他不会在家的，他常不在。
Okay, Mr. Zhang is probably not at home again. As for the matter, there was nothing in the first place, so it would be better to go back and write a letter. He won't be at home, he will always be away.我喝我的茶。不在文林街茶馆里喝茶将近两年了。我的头发里全是土！一看就知道从乡下来的。可是，我知道，没有人会注意到我的头。
门口，一个女人洗衣服，木盆里肥皂水着灰青色的泡沫。
I drink my tea. I haven't drunk tea in the Wenlin Street Teahouse for almost two years. My hair is full of dirt! At a glance, you can tell that I came from the countryside. However, I know that no one will notice my head. At the door, a woman washes clothes, and the soap water in the wooden basin is gray-blue foam.我好像喝了一口那样的水。
远远听见郭公鸟叫。
活，这家伙，——
他来了，他坐在我旁边一张桌子上。
“我在文林街看见一个人，好玩极了。”
I seemed to have taken a sip of that water. I heard Guo Gong's bird calling from a distance. Alive, this guy,—— He came, and he sat down at a table next to me. "I saw a person on Wenlin Street, it was fun."“这个人在裤带上拴一条狗，狗在他长袍摆下转来转去。人有人性，兽有兽性，人兽之间的关系，从这里看得出来。”
“噢，我看见过，除了那个打更的，这个人最怪。”
“怪，可是说人兽之间那点儿关系？”
"This man has a dog tied to his trouser belt, and the dog goes around under his robe. Man has human nature, beast has animal nature, and the relationship between man and animal can be seen from here. ” "Oh, I've seen it, except for the night watchman, this person is the weirdest." "Strange, but what about the relationship between humans and animals?"“这是个哲学问题！”
两年了，老李在广西，老张过上海，老陈，不知往那里去了，我们各有这个人一个影子，有如水手胳臂上刺一支锚，一种徽章，一个有箭头穿过的心形，温习起来时，即带来一些“过去”。
"This is a philosophical question!" It's been two years, Lao Li is in Guangxi, Lao Zhang has passed Shanghai, Lao Chen, I don't know where he went, we each have a shadow of this person, like a sailor's arm with an anchor, a kind of badge, a heart shape with an arrow through it, when reviewed, it brings some "past".这个人实在怪。
This person is really strange.那条狗，是条小狗。正是才可以啃动骨头，喜欢窜窜跳跳，对自己极有兴趣的时候。因为正在发育，行动中充满卖弄，富于表情。是一条地道中国种的狗。毛作浅灰色。有时，我想，一个画家想起它来时，大概会添上一点绿的。
That dog is a puppy. It is the time when you can gnaw on bones, like to jump, and are very interested in yourself. Because it is developing, it is full of showiness and expression. It is an authentic Chinese dog. The fur is light gray. Sometimes, I think, when a painter thinks of it, he will probably add a little green.这条狗居然长得极肥，圆头圆脑，毛茸茸的。
这是一种最省事，易成功的配色方法，那个人全身色调与那条狗都极相似。他的长袍，他的铜盆帽。
This dog is actually extremely fat, round-headed, and fluffy. This is the most trouble-free and easy to succeed color matching method, and the tones of that person's whole body are very similar to that dog. His robe, his copper basin hat.他的帽子微微掀在脑后，他的头因为帽子而显得向后扬。一饼紫酱色脸。他眉毛高举，眼角微睁，黑嘴，下唇向外略微突出。因此造成一种傲慢，一种旁若无人，玩世不恭的神情。可是这神情不会引起任何人反感愤怒。一种绝望的苦心，徒然的努力。你可以从下面看出难堪的折磨。无端的迫害与屈辱，一个逐渐疲老的灵魂不断的忍受。一个爱好花，月亮，感伤的音乐，喜欢把小孩子骑在肩上而按拍子跳舞的灵魂。细致的，敏感的灵魂。孤寂的灵魂。一个头等丑角最常有的表情。也正如一个丑角的表演，所望于人的是一阵哄笑。至少，他们许会欣赏他的为某种愿望所作的挣扎，挣扎爬出淹没他自己的愁苦和卑贱之感。哄笑吧，你们的哄笑，可以使他快乐。
His hat was slightly lifted behind his head, and his head was raised back because of the hat. A purple sauce-colored face. His eyebrows were raised high, the corners of his eyes were slightly open, his mouth was black, and his lower lip was slightly protruding outward. Thus it caused an arrogance, a look of ignorance and cynicism. But this look would not arouse anyone's anger. A desperate painstaking effort, a futile effort. You can see the embarrassing torture below. Unprovoked persecution and humiliation, a gradually tired soul endures. A soul who loves flowers, moons, sentimental music, and likes to dance to the beat with children on his shoulders. A delicate, sensitive soul. A lonely soul. The most common expression of a first-class harlequin. Just like a harlequin's performance, what is expected is a burst of laughter. At the very least, they will appreciate his struggle for a certain desire, and his struggle to climb out of the sorrow and lowliness that drowns out of him. Laugh, your laughter can make him happy.然而，没有，并没有哄笑。
天气实在闷。汗流在他颈后的皱纹里，汗沾湿他额前的头发。
他站在先生坡头，先生坡垂直于文林街。
However, no, there was no laughter. The weather was really stuffy. Sweat flowed in the wrinkles on the back of his neck, and sweat soaked the hair on his forehead. He stood at the head of Mr. Slope, which was perpendicular to Wenlin Street.文林街上人来，人往，人下先生坡，人上先生坡。他们画那个丁字，他们流汗。
一个挑水的。水桶里猪耳莲叶子一上一下。两朵淡紫色花在水里投下影子。
People come and go on Wenlin Street, people go down Mr. Slope, people go up Mr. Slope. They draw that T-shape, they sweat. One carries water. The leaves of the pig's ear lotus in the bucket go up and down. Two lilac flowers cast shadows in the water.卖白糖糕的。他的笼里落了不少灰。糕正在时间中变酸。他想吆唤一声“白糖糕，太平糕”，想叫又不叫。
Selling white sugar cakes. A lot of ash fell from his cage. The cake is turning sour in time. He wanted to shout "White sugar cake, Taiping cake", but he wanted to call but didn't.纸烟铺里一个秃头小伙计，睡着了。别睡着呀，别睡着呀，然而他睡着了。口涎沿手臂弯流到一本账簿上，红格子开来了。他笑了。一定是梦见他唯一的亲人，他的外祖母夸奖他真能干。而正在这时候，卖丁丁糖的震耳的敲过他的小小铁砧子！
A bald young man in the cigarette shop fell asleep. Don't fall asleep, don't fall asleep, but he fell asleep. Saliva flowed along his arm to an account book, and a red grid  opened. He laughed. It must have been a dream of his only relative, and his grandmother praised him for being really capable. And at this moment, the Tintin candy seller knocked on his little anvil with a deafening sound!郭公鸟在远远的地方叫。
The Guo Gong bird calls from a distance.那个人，像一朵花，开始萎了。他一切都变得模糊起来，他好像不在焦点上了。吹起他下摆的风在一个墙角撞碎了，散落了，不可收拾，他的酒气小了一点，他两颊陷进去，太阳穴发暗。他的眼睛里不是星，是云。简直，他要一滩一滩的落到地上来。
The man, like a flower, began to wither. Everything blurred in him, he seemed to be out of focus. The wind that blew up his hem shattered in a corner, scattered, out of control, his alcohol smelled a little less, his cheeks sunk, his temples darkened. His eyes were not stars, they were clouds. He was going to fall to the ground in puddles.一辆洋车过来，拐弯了，车夫大叫，声音中充满轻蔑：
“让开！”
他的小狗急急一纵跑出他脚前二尺多远。
于是，完了，一切都完了。
A foreign car came over, turned a corner, and the coachman shouted, his voice full of contempt: "Get out of the way!" His puppy hurriedly ran more than two feet away from his feet. So, it's over, it's all over.一个人若想为他做一点甚么事，最好送他的狗一个铃子，给他系上去。
如果，你要是一个画家，你画他，在背景上，在他的身后，你画许多鸽子么？你画吧。
If a man wants to do something for him, it is best to give his dog a bell and tie it to him. If you were a painter, would you paint him, on the background, behind him, many pigeons? You paint.当真他是饿了。他嘴里发苦。他咽他的唾沫。他的意识如井水的波纹。然而他说话像一个老朋友，不拘形迹，亲昵得近于玩笑，好像拍着别人肩膀说的。然而，声音洪大得不必要。
“老板，可有杂菜！”
He was really hungry. He was bitter in his mouth. He swallowed his saliva. His consciousness was like the ripples of well water. Yet he spoke like an old friend, informal, as if he were patting someone on the shoulder. However, the voice was unnecessarily loud. "Boss, can you have miscellaneous vegetables!"他的发音在他颈内周旋，像在一个坛子里。饿的人最容易为自己声音震动。他成了个音叉。他说杂菜就如同说锅贴鸟鱼五香鸽子糯米鸡。
His pronunciation swirled around his neck, like a jar. Hungry people are most likely to be shaken by their own voices. He became a tuning fork. He said that mixed vegetables are like potstickers, birds, fish, spiced pigeons, glutinous rice chicken.小馆子里几个吃饭的客人抬了一下眼睛。其中有一个为青辣椒气味所炝，打了一个极大的喷嚏。
老板炒他的菜。
半天寂静，寂静得如同一桶奶油。
一只麻雀“得”的一下飞进屋簷窠里。
阴沟里水冒气泡。
Several guests in the small restaurant raised their eyes. One of them was burned by the smell of green chili peppers and sneezed loudly. The boss fried his dishes. Silent for half a day, silent like a bucket of cream. A sparrow flew into the eaves. Water bubbles in the gutter.这老板并不胖，而且说得上是瘦。他的长颈子后面绷得很紧。他舀了一杓子油，用力倒到锅里去，几个油点溅在火里，哄的一声。他蹩足了气力，并不回头大声喷出来：
“没，得！”
This boss is not fat, and he can be said to be thin. The back of his long neck was tight. He scooped a spoonful of oil and poured it into the pot hard, and a few oil drops splashed into the fire, coaxing. He was exhausted and didn't look back and spit out loudly: "No, get it!"他挽了一挽袖子，把小粉拌好的牛肉向锅子里一兜。牛肉完了，又炒了一个番茄豆腐，锅里放上水，配了一个菠菜蛋花汤，鸡蛋打完了，水尚未开，他掏出一枝烟来，叼上，点着火，仍是不回头：
“出去。”
He rolled up his sleeves and pocketed the beef mixed with small powder into the pot. After the beef was finished, another tomato tofu was fried, water was put in the pot, and a spinach egg drop soup was served. "Get out."这两个字是他等着的，可是等得未免太久了，他本来预备好了，“是，是，是——”尾音拖长，提高。他以此娱乐自己，这十足赖皮相，满蓄一种对人世对自己的嘲笑意味。然而等得太久，这句话冷了。他显得很蠢，毫无表示，他出去，在老板的铁杓子下把一个白铁盘子承上去。
These two words were what he had been waiting for, but he had waited too long, and he had been prepared, "Yes, yes, yes—" The ending was prolonged and raised. He entertained himself with this, which was full of superficiality, full of mockery of the world and himself. However, after waiting too long, the sentence became cold. He looked stupid, without saying anything, and went out and took a white iron plate under the boss's ladle.唉，这个盘子实在太大了。
所谓杂菜，剩汁残羹倒在一个桶里准备给人的。
Alas, this plate is just too big. The so-called miscellaneous vegetables, the leftover juice is poured into a bucket and prepared for people.好老板，我看见你特为给他捞了一捞，一个几乎完整的鸡头呢。老板你自己一定也喝酒。你回过头来，你笑了一笑，你笑得好。一年来我还记得那个笑。你跟你家里一定过得不坏，她头上戴了一朵花，我看见。
Good boss, I saw that you specially fished for him, an almost complete chicken head. Boss, you must have drunk yourself. You turned around, you smiled, you smiled well. I still remember that smile for a year. You must be living well with your family, she has a flower on her head, I saw it.他来了。
He's coming.他从先生坡上来，像一只蝉蜕去皮爬出泥土。他一直向这个茶馆里来，好像并非他打定主意要来，而是注定了非来不可。像一根拉长的橡皮必须要缩短似的。那边是他的欲望；这边，他自己。他得过去，在一拥抱之间合而为一，他好像并未认清桌子椅子，像一个旅人倦游归来，甫一进门，即往床上一躺。他落在椅上，伏在桌上。他眼睛向茶馆里看了一下，像一个病人在昏睡中睁一睁眼睛，只觉一片光彩，不能构成任何印象或概念。他不戴帽子，他的头发如疾风中的草，倾倒在手臂上。他呼吸急促，气息嘘嘘。
He came up from the gentleman's slope and crawled out of the dirt like a cicada shedding its skin. He kept coming to this teahouse, as if he had not made up his mind to come, but destined to come. Like an elongated rubber that had to be shortened. Over there was his desire; this way, himself. He had to go over, and in a hug he became one, he seemed to not recognize the table and chair, like a traveler returning from a weary trip, and as soon as he entered the door, he lay down on the bed. He landed on the chair and lay down on the table. He looked into the teahouse like a patient in a coma, and felt only a brilliance that did not constitute any impression or concept. He did not wear a hat, and his hair fell on his arms like grass in a gust of wind. He was breathing rapidly, breathing heavily.“吃一碗茶来。”
"Eat a bowl of tea."他的眼已经不大撕得开，上下眼皮全紫了。一种刺痛，一种教人肌肉收紧，骨盘内缩，脚趾伸挺的煎熬从这两个发烧的球体分出去，注射及于全身。他鼻梁上抽得全是直纹。他鬓边息息跳动。他下唇拖在外面，像一种水果，为唾潄所能润泽的部分通红，熟透了，于是，画一道整齐的线，这一条线以外则不知沾了些甚么东西，全黑了。他下巴尖削，且向外卷，他胡髭已长，略形卷曲。
His eyes were not much open, and his upper and lower eyelids were purple. A tingling, a torment that taught the muscles to tighten, the bone discs to retract, and the toes to stick out, separated from these two feverish spheres and injected into the whole body. The bridge of his nose was full of straight lines. His sideburns were beating. His lower lip dragged outward, like a kind of fruit, red and ripe for the part that could be moistened by spit, so he drew a neat line, and I don't know what was on it outside this line, it was all black. His chin was sharp and curled, and his beard was long and slightly curly.“泡一碗茶。”
"Make a bowl of tea."他并不着急生气，仿佛那杯茶如果要泡来总会泡来的，他好像已经闻着那杯茶的香气，他口舌生津，喉头有点痛。于是他唱歌。他在鼻子里不知哼一种甚么调子，听起来既无节拍，又少高低，然而他浸没在他的歌里，像一只鸭子在泥水里。
He was not in a hurry to get angry, as if that cup of tea would always be brewed if it was to be brewed, he seemed to have smelled the aroma of that cup of tea, his mouth and tongue were drenched, and his throat hurt a little. So he sang. He hummed a tune in his nose, which sounded neither beat nor high, but he was immersed in his song, like a duck in muddy water.他的狗呢？
一个挑水的，你水桶里猪耳莲叶子晃动。
卖白糖糕的，你的糕发酸。
纸烟铺小伙计，打瞌睡。
苍蝇和洗衣女人！
What about his dog? A person carrying water, the leaves of the pig's ear lotus in your bucket are shaking. If you sell sugar cakes, your cakes will be sour. The cigarette shop guy dozed off. Flies and laundry women!你们都来看，看他的虱子。虱子在他的黑大衣（好热！）外面描画复杂的花纹，它们多忙碌！这个人，他干吗，他睡着了？没有没有，喝，哎哟，他把他的鼻子顶在桌上，起来，他的鼻涕流在鼻子与桌子之间，他抬起，俯下；拉长，又压扁；他吸进去又呼出来；快一点，又慢慢的。他专心一志于他的艺术，他扁嘴闭眼睛。
Come and see, look at his lice. The lice are drawing intricate patterns on the outside of his black coat (so hot!) How busy they are! This man, what is he doing, is he asleep? No, no, drink, ouch, he puts his nose on the table, gets up, his snot runs between his nose and the table, he lifts, leans down; lengthens, flattens; he sucks in and exhales; faster, and slower. He concentrates on his art, he flattens his mouth and closes his eyes.嗳嗳嗳，酒瓶酒瓶，他的酒瓶要为他的胳臂推倒了。——好，他扶住了，他一把抓住，他嘴角牵动，他大叫：
“泡，杯，茶！”
这回，真是哭。不是命令，是请求，是叫，他的欲望大叫，他的太浓的血大叫。
Hi beep, wine bottle, wine bottle, his wine bottle is going to be knocked down by his arm. ——Okay, he held on, he grabbed it, the corners of his mouth tugged, and he shouted: "Brew, cup, tea!" This time, I really cried. It was not an order, it was a request, it was a cry, his desire was screaming, his blood was too thick.郭公鸟在远远的地方叫。声音如两粒弹丸，掷过来，扔过去。令人渴望一片秧池，浅黄嫩绿，密密秧针之下看见徐徐流动的水。一片树荫。一阵好风。一条长长的丝带在风中飘。
天真是闷。
Guo Gongniao calls from afar. The sound is like two projectiles, thrown over, thrown over. It makes people yearn for a seedling pond, light yellow and green, and you can see the slowly flowing water under the dense seedling needles. A shade of trees. A good wind. A long ribbon fluttered in the wind. It's boring.

庙与僧

庙与僧[1]
[1] This article was originally published in Tianjin's Ta Kung Pao on September 2, 1946. First received the first volume of "The Complete Works of Wang Zengqi", Beijing Normal University Press, August 1998. Temple and monk[1]我的行李已经由人先放在我要住的房间里去了，我就一直走到方丈找“当家的”和尚。当家的早已经迎了出来。这个和尚整个可以用一个“黄”字括尽了。第一，他胖得很，说胖还不大对，应当说肉多得很。腮帮子坠坠的，脑后长平了又打了折，连上下眼睑都“厚夺夺的”，这么样，他不有个向外翻出的双料嘴唇，那就是不合理了。不过他的肉可不像一般胖子一样细软，似乎都割下来搁了几天再合到一块儿去的。这周身陈肉上一个一个毛孔都清清楚楚。于是，我想，你总不能再不想起你自己上菜场买小菜的那段生活了。这个胖和尚直在我面前发黄。他从头到脚都是黄的。和尚头刮过不久，直裰敞开，而脚下一双僧鞋是趿着的。僧鞋踏在脚跟的一块已经发一种深沉的油光。是夏天，他不穿袜子。说真的，最唤起我的黄的印象的是他那双肥脚，我一辈子没见过那么黄的脚。他就从肿肿的脚踵一直黄上去。黄，而发暗，不反光。没有办法，我相信，就把这个和尚切开了，里边的肉也都这种暗黄色。——我所说“黄”已经括尽了他，是主张胖也可以含在黄里的。不过人家是“当家的”，我们不应随便叫他个甚么，得称呼一声“当家”，尽管他胖而且黄，是吧？
My luggage had already been put in the room where I was going to stay, so I walked all the way to the abbot to find the "master" monk. The head of the house had already come out. This monk can be summarized with the word "yellow". First, he is very fat, and it is not right to say that he is fat, but it should be said that there is a lot of meat. The cheeks are falling, the back of the head is flattened and discounted, and even the upper and lower eyelids are "thick". However, his flesh is not as soft as that of ordinary fat people, and it seems that it was cut off and left for a few days before being put together. The pores on the meat all around the body are clear. So, I think, you can't help but think of your own life when you went to the vegetable market to buy side dishes. This fat monk turned yellow in front of me. He was yellow from head to toe. The monk's head was shaved shortly after, and his straight pants were open, and a pair of monk's shoes were lying on his feet. The part of the monk's shoes on his heels had a deep oily sheen. It was summer, and he didn't wear socks. To be honest, what evoked my yellow impression the most was his fat feet, which I had never seen in my life. He went from his swollen heels to the yellow. Yellow, but dark, not reflective. There was no way, I believe, so I cut the monk open, and the flesh inside was also this dark yellow. ——When I said "yellow", I already included him, and I advocated that fat people can also be contained in yellow. But people are "in charge", we shouldn't call him anything, we have to call him "master", even though he is fat and yellow, right?当家和尚领我进了方丈，把他两个猪眼睛摆在我面前。这真是一个“方丈”，不能更大。一张大床占去一半。床是乡下新娘子房里会可以见到的雕花大床，庙里这样床计有四张。床上粗夏布印花帐子，印的是梅兰竹菊蓝颜色的花。米缸，酒壶，咸菜罈子，一副“经担子”。后来一次当家的招呼一个老太婆“你怎么老不到庙里来坐坐，”老太婆说“你那个房子，哈叭狗都转不过身来！”她实在没有念过书，不知道有“厅事前不容旋马”这句话，她不是抄袭。当家的案上摊得一本草纸订的帐簿。一支笔正从左上角斜斜的滚过右下角。和尚请我抽一枝烟，他自己则呼呼噜噜吹起水烟袋。这个方丈里充满各种气味。这些气味我并不陌生。而当我想着如何送当家的一张香烟广告的美人图的时候，我实在不能不抬起头来看看，因为我又辨出一种气味来了；果然，一大块咸肉挂在梁上！天大概要变了，咸肉上全浸浸的发潮。地下是一块油渍，就在我椅子旁边。而一颗琥珀色油珠正凝在末端，要滴不滴的。我等着等着，半天半天，想等到听见答的一声就起身出来。——我希望你对这块咸肉不要大惊小怪，像我当初一样。庙里还养得三口小猪，准备过年时卖去两只，留一只自己杀了吃呢。
The head monk led me into the abbot and put his two pig eyes in front of me. This is really an "abbot", it can't be bigger. A big bed takes up half. The bed is a carved bed that can be seen in the bride's room in the countryside, and there are four such beds in the temple. The coarse summer cloth printed tent on the bed is printed with plum orchid, bamboo and chrysanthemum blue flowers. Rice jars, wine jugs, pickle jars, and a pair of "scripture burdens". Later, the head of the house greeted an old woman, "Why are you not old enough to sit in the temple," the old woman said, "You can't turn around in that house!" She really hadn't studied, and she didn't know that there was a saying "no horses are allowed in front of the hall", and she was not plagiarizing. On the head of the house, there was a cursive paper account book. A pen was rolling diagonally from the upper left corner to the lower right corner. The monk asked me to smoke a cigarette, and he himself snorted and blew on the hookah. This abbot is full of all kinds of smells. I am not unfamiliar with these smells. And when I thought about how to give the head of the house a picture of a beauty in a cigarette advertisement, I couldn't help but look up, because I recognized another smell; sure enough, a large piece of bacon was hanging on the beam! The sky was about to change, and the bacon was soaked in moisture. There was an oil stain on the ground, right next to my chair. And an amber oil bead was condensing at the end, trying to stop dripping. I waited for a long time, wanting to get up and come out when I heard the answer. ——I hope you don't make a fuss about this piece of salted meat, just like I did. There are also three piglets in the temple, and they are going to sell two during the Chinese New Year, and keep one to kill and eat.方丈在正殿的旁边。殿上一般供着三世佛，有鱼鼓磬钹。这殿上，在我住在庙里那么些日子之中，只有一次显得极其庄严，他们给一家拜梁王忏的那一次。庙里和尚一齐出动，还请来几个客僧，都披挂得整整齐齐，唱了好几天。屋上拖下长长的旙，炉里烧起降香，蒲团上遮了帔垫，和尚像个和尚，庙像个庙，其余的时候只是那三尊佛冷清清坐着。早晨黄昏，有个小和尚做功课。一个人矮矮的跪在长凳上，点了香，看了油，敲磬三声，含含糊糊的念起来，不知甚么道理，听来颇觉哀楚。
The abbot is next to the main hall. The hall generally enshrines the Third Buddha, with fish drums and cymbals. In this hall, in the days I lived in the temple, it was extremely solemn only once, and the time they worshipped King Liang to the family. The monks in the temple went out together, and several guest monks were invited, all neatly dressed and sang for several days. A long banner was dragged down from the roof, incense was burned in the stove, and the futon was covered with a shawl, the monk was like a monk, the temple was like a temple, and the rest of the time just the three Buddhas were sitting deserted. In the morning and dusk, a little monk was doing his homework. A man knelt on the bench in a short manner, lit incense, looked at the oil, knocked the chime three times, and read it vaguely, I don't know what the truth is, it sounds quite sad.小和尚十一二岁。虽穿了和尚衣服，可是赤着脚。坐在屋里总听见他赤脚的打在天井石板上拍拍的响。那是他跟一条狗闹着玩，或是他追黄狗，或让黄狗追他。这孩子不大见他上树捉知了，下河摸虾。比普通庄稼孩子文气得多，无野像。虽然当家和尚说他淘气得很，常常打他。一挨打，他就伏在门口布袋和尚脚下悠悠的哭，一哭半天。黄狗就扑在门槛旁边看着他。只有过年那几天我见他兴奋过一阵子。外面许多孩子跑到庙里来滚钱，他也参加了，而且似乎赢了几个。他告诉我以前还有一个小和尚，是他师兄。一天在门外河里洗澡，教水鬼拉下去了。半夜三更，现在，有时听见外面水车响动，那是他师兄踩着玩。门口那架车，他们以前老踩，河边田是庙里的。这小和尚，你知道你很懂得寂寞么？你一定想开门出去看看的。
The little monk was eleven or twelve years old. Although he was wearing monk's clothes, he was barefoot. Sitting in the house, I always heard him slapping his bare feet on the stone slabs in the courtyard. It was him playing with a dog, or he chased the yellow dog, or let the yellow dog chase him. This kid didn't see him go up the tree to catch him, and went down to the river to touch the shrimp. It is much more polite than an ordinary crop child, and there is no wild image. Although the head monk said that he was very naughty and often beat him. As soon as he was beaten, he lay at the feet of the cloth bag monk at the door and cried leisurely for a long time. The yellow dog threw himself by the threshold and looked at him. Only on the days of the Chinese New Year did I see him excited for a while. Many children outside ran to the temple to roll money, and he also participated, and he seemed to win a few. He told me that there used to be a little monk who was his senior brother. One day, he took a bath in the river outside the door and taught the water ghost to pull it down. In the middle of the night, now, sometimes I hear the sound of the water wheel outside, which is his senior brother stepping on it. The car at the door, they used to step on it, and the fields by the river were in the temple. This little monk, do you know that you know how lonely you are? You must want to open the door and go out to have a look.庙里大和尚一共三个。当家的，二师父，——乡下多叫他为二当家的，他的上下我不记得了，以小和尚口气，称之为二师父，还有一个，被称为能师父。所以有这么一个比较特别的称呼，是因为他不是在本庙出家的。
There are three great monks in the temple. The head of the house, the second master,—— the countryside often called him the second master, I don't remember his upper and lower ranks, in the tone of a little monk, he was called the second master, and there was another one, called Master Neng. So there is such a special title because he was not a monk in this temple.这能师父头上是否有疤，想不起了。我觉得他似乎尚未受戒，也许已经受过戒，我如此觉得是希望他可以随时还俗罢了。听小和尚说，他不是这里的人，虽然因为在这庙里住了很久，说话已经与别的和尚一样，听不出外乡口音。这家伙衣服总是挺挺括括，腰是腰，缝是缝，那怕是一件旧的，也称身合样。听说他还有个本领，是能够“飞铙”。这在盂兰会焰口中可以见到。是用两片大铙耍出许多花样，或让它在手指顶上的溜溜转；或哗喇喇掷向半天，用手或铙接住，反身背手，丢挡插腰，百无一失。这玩意城里大户人家不兴，大庙里和尚也不会。做盂兰会的多是湖西和尚。这能飞铙的和尚又必皆会吹笛拉胡琴，唱百种时调小曲。这在盂兰会人神共乐时用得着的。这和尚透着一股机灵鬼巧。若说他能不沾染甚么事情，教人不信。他如何会住到这么一个乡下小庙里来，就当有些缘故，决不是普通行脚挂单。能师父身材属于“三料个子”，不高不矮，薄薄的嘴唇，手上一个金戒指，袈裟多是绸的。真的，他要是留起来，一头好头发！当家的对于这么一个外客是否欢迎，不得而知。不过那些时候倒也相安无事。当家的对于能师父的爱憎只在牌桌上看得出来。
I can't remember if Master Neng has a scar on his head. I think he seems to have not been ordained yet, maybe he has already been ordained, and I think he just hopes that he can return to the secular world at any time. I heard from the little monk that he was not from here, although because he had lived in this temple for a long time, he spoke the same as other monks, and he couldn't hear a foreign accent. This guy's clothes are always quite crisp, the waist is waist, the seams are sewn, even if it is an old one, it fits well. I heard that he also has a skill, which is to be able to "fly cymbals". This can be seen in the mouth of the Yulan Society. It is to use two large cymbals to play many tricks, or make it slip on the top of the fingers; Or throw it into the sky for a long time, catch it with your hand or cymbal, turn your back on your hand, and throw it into your waist, without any mistakes. This thing is not popular in the city, and the monks in the temple will not either. Most of the monks who do the Yulan Festival are monks from Huxi. The monks who can fly cymbals must all be able to play the flute and play the huqin and sing a hundred seasonal tunes. This is useful when the people and gods of the Yulan Society have fun together. This monk has a clever and ingenious spirit. If he can say that he can not be tainted with anything, he will not believe it. How did he live in such a small rural temple, just for some reason, it is by no means an ordinary line. Master Neng's figure belongs to the "three materials", neither tall nor short, thin lips, a gold ring on his hand, and his robe is mostly silk. Really, if he keeps it, he will have good hair! It is unknown whether the head of the house welcomes such a foreign guest. But at that time, everything was fine. The master's love and hate for Master Neng can only be seen at the card table.乡下法事少，长日清闲。当家的把几天来旧账画一画，算算离收租尚远，到殿上扬声叫能师父。能师父正用修脚刀修他左边脚掌的一片老皮子，心里正想，到时候了，怎么还……，一听那个像闷在木桶里的叫唤，即放下小刀，拂去脚皮，枕头下抽出一卷票子，挑了两张破烂的，回答一声“来了。”大殿上现成有吃饭桌子，不用搭。好，打牌了。其实村上两个闲汉照例来得正巧，庙里有一副二十年老麻将，骨子面子虽有些地方脱了节，用糯米饭粘过，粘过又脱；一张二万是后补的，是张花；不过大家摸起来都顺手。也有时斗纸牌，可是簇新的江源记，三星都是加金的。我有时也到他们后头去看看，当家教我学学，说是“不难的。多用点脑筋就会了。”而正在这时他漏碰了一张绝七万。他们对于每一张牌都有一个特别称呼，这自然又多是“荤的”，与女人有关系。当家的跟我一样，不大了然。我看见能师父打了一张五索，说“女学生，花钱买不到的！”可怜当家的就只顾抽烟，把一副二五八平胡给错过了。大概除因特殊事故，上午十点到下午五六点，十六圈，闲汉散了。能师父回房，数数今天赢的，又连枕下的一齐掏出来，十块五块各放一处，叠好了锁到箱子里去。当家的则颇为不好的牌运弄得有点累了，不说话，独自坐在零乱的牌桌上，怅怅的鼓起眼睛，一副清一色，清一色，三条一张也没有现呀，……直到一个花脚大蚊子在他耳朵上狠狠的啄了一口，才找了半天，找到那双鞋子，捧了个水烟袋回方丈。
There are few rituals in the countryside, and the long days are leisurely. The head of the house drew a picture of the old account in the past few days, and it was still far from collecting rent, so he went to the hall and shouted Master Neng. Master Neng was using a pedicure knife to repair a piece of old skin on the sole of his left foot, thinking to himself, when the time came, how could he still ......, when he heard the call that seemed to be stuffy in a wooden barrel, he put down the knife, brushed off the skin of his feet, took out a roll of tickets from under the pillow, picked out two tattered ones, and replied, "Here it is." "There is a ready-made dining table in the hall, so you don't need to set it up. Okay, let's play cards. In fact, the two idlers in the village came just in time, and there was a pair of 20-year-old mahjong in the temple, although the bones and face were off in some places, glued with glutinous rice, glued and peeled off; "There is a ready-made dining table in the hall, no need to set it up. Okay, let's play cards. In fact, the two idlers in the village came just in time, there was a pair of 20-year-old mahjong in the temple, although the bones and face were out of knot in some places, they were glued with glutinous rice, glued and peeled off; A piece of 20,000 yuan is a supplement, a flower; but everyone feels comfortable with it. There are also times when playing cards, but the new Jiang Yuanji is three stars with gold. I sometimes go behind them to take a look, and the master teaches me to learn, saying, "It's not difficult. Just use more brains." And at this moment, he missed a card of 70,000. They have a special name for each card, which is naturally mostly "meaty" and has something to do with women. The master is the same as me, and he doesn't know much. I saw Master Neng play a five-rope and said, "Female student, you can't buy it with money!" Poor master just focused on smoking and missed a pair of two-five-eight flat beards. Probably except for special accidents, from ten a.m. to five or six o'clock in the afternoon, sixteen laps, the idlers dispersed. Master Neng went back to the room, counted the winners today, and took out all the ones under the pillow, put ten and five pieces in one place, folded them and locked them in the box. The master was a little tired from the bad card luck, didn't speak, sat alone at the messy card table, puffed out his eyes in melancholy, all colored, all colored, and none of the three showed up,...... It wasn't until a big mosquito pecked his ear hard that he searched for a long time, found the shoes, and took a hookah back to the abbot.二师父若是回来，则牌桌上三个光头，二师父圆圆的，眉眼口鼻都无棱角，而且一脸是笑。二师父比能师父高大，没有当家的肉多，面色红润，额门发光。他穿得整整齐齐，一个纽子都不缺，当胸一挂大念珠，鞋底都是白的。他身上东西多半是杭州货。二师父回来，一家，应当说一庙，不，还是说一家吧，一家都欢喜。小和尚第一个奔出去又奔进来，手上一个包袱，包袱里有他的芝麻饼。能师父，当家的，都上二师父屋里去了，连那个老香火道人都兴冲冲去打洗脸水，二师父那条雪白的毛巾招他爱。二师父难得回来住几天。二师父另外“有”个庙，弄得很“得法”，春上才募了一个殿子，又给菩萨开了光。有一次仿佛听说要给能师父也“弄”一个，结果不详。我与二师父见面多，因为我也有时不在庙里。
If the second master comes back, there will be three bald heads on the card table, the second master is round, the eyebrows, eyes, mouth and nose are not angular, and the face is smiling. The second master is taller than Master Neng, not as meaty as the master, his face is ruddy, and his forehead is shining. He is neatly dressed, there is no lack of buttons, and when he hangs a large rosary on his chest, the soles of his shoes are white. Most of the things on his body are Hangzhou goods. When the second master came back, a family, should be said to be a temple, no, let's say a family, the whole family is happy. The little monk was the first to run out and run in, with a baggage in his hand, and his sesame cake in the baggage. Master Neng, the head of the house, all went to the second master's house, and even the old incense Taoist rushed to wash his face, and the second master's snow-white towel attracted his love. The second master rarely came back to live for a few days. The second master "had" another temple, and it was very "lawful", so he raised a temple in the spring and opened the light to the bodhisattva. Once, it seemed that he heard that he was going to "get" one for Master Neng, but the result was unknown. I met the second master a lot because I was sometimes away from the temple.有一天，我正在庙后看小牛吃奶，小和尚来叫我。
“哎，去看，二师父回来了。”
二师父实在不比这个小牛好看，我说我不去。听说这回回来要住一阵，总要见到的。
“哎，二师父把师母接来了！”
One day, I was watching the calf nursing behind the temple, and the little monk came to call me. "Hey, go and see, the second master is back." The second master is really not as good-looking as this calf, I said I won't go. I heard that I will stay for a while when I come back this time, and I will always see it. "Hey, the second master has brought the master's wife!"这可实在有点出乎我意想之外。
This was a bit unexpected.这个，这个甚么呢？这倒真难称呼，……好吧，这个女人，这个女人高高的身材，穿一身黑香云拷纱衫裤，襟头挂一枝白兰花，脑门绞得齐齐的，长长的眼睛，有点吊，嘴里两个金牙，正坐在雕花木床前半低着头喝茶。二师父则用他的雪白的毛巾洗脸，一瓶双妹老牌花露水。——这女人我想是个寡妇。他一直住在庙里，到我走了她还没走。
This, what is this? It's really hard to call,...... Well, this woman, this woman is tall, wearing a black fragrant cloud gauze shirt and pants, a white orchid hanging from her collar, her head is twisted neatly, her eyes are a little hanging, she has two gold teeth in her mouth, and she is sitting in front of the carved wooden bed with her head down and drinking tea. The second master washed his face with his snow-white towel and a bottle of toilet water from the old brand of the two sisters. ——I think this woman is a widow. He has been living in the temple until I left.你奇怪，我怎么弄到那么一个庙里住了好几个月？你大概还想知道我终天做些甚么事情，这我一时都无从回答你。事情一晃就八九年了，我有时也想想。当家的大概总死掉了，我似乎看见他黄黄的坐在一口缸里。现在当家的应当是小和尚。能师父想是没有还俗，多半是离开到别处去了，我仿佛很能知道他打叠打叠东西，背上，跨下一只船时的心。至于二师父，他应该有两个儿子了。我还想知道那个小小院子如何了。院在殿后，迤东有两间屋，我住。有两个小门，可以关死，与外面隔绝，门上两行墨书：
You wonder, how did I get to live in such a temple for several months? You probably still want to know what I do all day long, and I can't answer you for a while. It's been eight or nine years in a flash, and I sometimes think about it. The head of the house is probably dead, and I seem to see him sitting in a jar. The little monk should be in charge now. I think Master Neng has not returned to the world, most likely he has left for another place, and I seem to know his heart when he folds things, puts them on his back, and crosses a boat. As for the second master, he should have two sons. I also want to know what happened to that small courtyard. The courtyard is behind the hall, and there are two houses in the east of Yunnan, where I live. There are two small doors that can be closed and isolated from the outside, and there are two lines of ink on the door:一人一世界
三邈三菩提
One person, one world Three Miao Three Bodhi我闲常出来走走，则从另外一个圆门回来，经过三个小石塔，那是和尚的坟。院中夏天绿杨中知了极多，现在该落满一院桐叶了吧。桐叶落在我的屋瓦上哗啦啦响。再我很怀念那个老香火道人，他须眉皆白，一腿筋疙瘩，终年在门前打草鞋，我没有听他说过一句话。若要坐船，招呼他，立刻给拿桨。船扁而小，通身漆成红色，坐到那里去，一望而知是庙里的。呵，才起水的鱼，多鲜的菱角。……
I often go out for a walk, and then I come back from another round gate, passing three small stone towers, which are the monk's grave. I know a lot about the green poplars in the courtyard in summer, and now it's time to fill the courtyard with paulownia leaves. The paulownia leaves fell on my roof tiles and rustled. I miss the old incense Taoist very much, he has white beard and eyebrows, a lump in his hamstrings, and wears straw sandals in front of the door all year round, and I haven't heard him say a word. If you want to take a boat, greet him and immediately get the oar. The boat is flat and small, painted red all over, and when you sit there, you can tell that it is from the temple. Oh, the fish that have just risen from the water, how fresh water chestnuts are. ……

最响的炮仗

最响的炮仗[1]
孟家炮仗店的孟老板，孟和，走出巷口。

刚才那两个老人是谁？
[1] This article was originally published in Tianjin's "Yishi Daily" on December 28, 1946; it was also published in Shanghai "Yishi Daily" on January 5, 1947, with slight changes in the text. In 1947 Chicken and duck master{{id_0000}} Who were those two old men just now?父亲在洗刮鸭掌，每个蹠蹼都撑开细细看过，是不是还有一丝泥垢，一片没有刮尽的皮，样子就像是作着一件精巧的手工似的。两付鸭掌，白白净净，一只一只，妥妥停停的一排。四个鸭翅，也白白净净，一只一只，妥妥停停一排。看起来简直绝对想不到那是从一只鸭子身上取下来的，仿佛天生成这么一种好吃东西，就这样生的就可以吃了，入口且一定爽糯鲜甜无比，漂亮极了，可爱极了。我忍不住伸手用指头去捏捏弄弄，觉得非常舒服。鸭翅尤其是血色和匀丰满而肉感。就是那个教我拿着简直无法下手的鸭肫，父亲也把它处理得极美，他握在手里，掂了一掂，“真不小，足有六两重！”用他那把角柄小刀从栗紫色当中闪着钢蓝色的那儿一个微微凹处轻轻一划，一翻，蓝黄色鱼子状的东西绽出来了。“你说脏，脏甚么！一点都不！”是不脏，他弄得教我觉得不脏，我甚至没有觉得臭味。洗涮了几次，往鸭掌鸭翅之间一放，样子名贵极了，一个甚么珍奇的果品似的。我看他作这一切，用他的洁白的，熨贴的，然而男性的，有精力，果断，可靠的手作这一切，看得很感动。王羲之论钟张书，“张精熟过人，”又曰“须得书意转深，点画之间皆有意，自有言所不得尽其妙者，事事皆然。”“精熟”，“有意”，说得真好。我追随他的每一动作，以心，以目，正如小时，看他作画。父亲一路来直称赞鸡鸭店那个伙计，说他拗折鸭掌鸭翅，准确极了，轻轻一来，毫不费事，毫不牵皮带肉，再三赞叹他得着了“诀窍”，所好者技，进乎道矣，相信父亲自己落到鸡鸭店作伙计，也一定能作到如此地步的！
My father was washing and scraping the duck paws, and each flipper was stretched out to see if there was still a trace of mud, a piece of skin that had not been scraped, and it looked like it was made by exquisite handiwork. Two duck paws, white and clean, one by one, in a row. The four duck wings are also white, one by one, and they stop in a row. It looks like it was taken from a duck, as if it was born with such a delicious thing, and it can be eaten raw like this. I couldn't help but reach out and pinch it with my fingers, and I felt very comfortable. Duck wings are especially blood-colored, uniform, plump and fleshy. It was the duck gizzard that taught me to hold it that I couldn't start, and my father also handled it beautifully, he held it in his hand and stroked it, "It's really not small, it's six taels heavy!" "With his horn-handled knife, he gently scratched a slight dent in the steel blue part of the chestnut purple, and when he turned it over, something blue and yellow caviar-like thing bloomed." You say dirty, what is dirty! Not at all!" "It's not dirty, he made me think it's not dirty, and I didn't even feel the smell. After washing it several times, I put it between the duck feet and wings, and it looked very precious, like some kind of rare fruit. I saw him do all this, using his white, ironed, but male, energetic, decisive, and reliable handiwork, and I was very moved. Wang Xizhi commented on Zhong Zhangshu, "Zhang Jing is extraordinary," and said, "You must have a deeper meaning of the book, and there is intention between the dots, and there are those who cannot do their best, and everything is the same." "Proficient", "intentional", it is really good. I followed his every movement, with my heart, with my eyes, just like when I was a child, watching him paint. My father praised the guy in the chicken and duck shop all the way, saying that he twisted the duck paw and duck wings, which was very accurate, and he came gently, effortlessly, without pulling the meat, and repeatedly praised him for getting the "know-how", and the skills he was good at were in the way, and he believed that his father himself would be able to do so much when he fell into the chicken and duck shop as a buddy!这个地方鸡鸭多，鸡鸭店多，教门馆子多，一定有不少回回。回回多，当有来历，是一颇有兴趣问题，我们家乡信回教的极少，数得出来的，鸡鸭店则全城似只一家。小小一间铺面，干净而寂寞，经过时总为一种深刻印象所袭，一种说不出来的东西与别人家截然不同。铺子在我舅舅家附近，出一个深巷高坡，上了大街，拐角上第一家就是。主人相貌奇古，一个非常的大鼻子，真大！鼻子上一个洞，一个洞，通红通红，十分鲜艳，一个酒糟鼻子。我从那一个鼻子上认得了什么叫酒糟鼻子。没有人告诉过我，我无师自通，一看见那个鼻子就知道了：“酒糟鼻子！”日后我在别处看见了类似而远比不上的鼻子，我就想到那个店主人。刚才在鸡鸭店我又想到那个鼻子！从来没有去买过鸡鸭，不知那个鼻子有没有那样的手段？现在那个人，那爿店，那条斜阳古柳的巷子不知如何了。……
There are many chickens and ducks in this place, many chicken and duck shops, and many restaurants, and there must be a lot of Huihui. There are very few Muslims in our hometown, and there are very few chicken and duck shops in the city. A small shop, clean and lonely, always struck by a deep impression when passing by, an indescribable thing that is completely different from other people's homes. The shop is near my uncle's house, out of a deep alley and high slope, up the street, and the first one on the corner. The owner has a strange appearance, a very big nose, really big! There is a hole in the nose, a hole, red and red, very bright, a rosacea nose. I recognized what a rosacea nose was from that nose. No one told me, I was self-taught, and I knew it as soon as I saw that nose: "Rosacea nose!" "In the future, I saw a nose that was similar but far inferior elsewhere, and I thought of the shopkeeper. I thought of that nose again at the chicken and duck shop just now! I have never been to buy chicken and duck, I wonder if that nose has such a method? Now that person, that shop, the alley of the ancient willows in the setting sun is gone. ……一串螃蟹在门后叽哩咕噜吐着泡沫。
打气炉子呼呼的响。这个机械文明在这个小院落里也发出一种古代的声音，仿佛是《天工开物》甚至《考工记》上的玩意了。

All in my heart, two words that I don't have in my pen.我们刚回来一会儿，买了鸭翅，鸭掌，鸭舌，鸭肫，八只蟹，青菜两棵，葱一小把，姜一块回来，我来看父亲，父亲整天请我吃，来了几天，吃了几天。昨天晚上隔了一层板壁，他睡在外面房间，我睡在里头，躺在床上商议明天不出去吃了，在家里自己作。不要多，菜只要两个，一个蟹，蒸一蒸，不费事，——喝酒；一个舌掌汤，放两个菜头烩一烩——吃饭。我父亲实在很会过日子，一个人在外头，一高兴就自己作饭，很会自得其乐！——那几只蟹买得好，在路上已经有两个人问过，好大蟹，甚么地方买的，多少钱一斤，很赞许的样子，一个老先生，一个女人，全都自然极了，亲切极了，可是我们一点也不认识，真有意思！大都市里恐怕很少这种情形了。

I don't know how many years I haven't eaten that kind of "clever egg". A clever egg is an egg that has not hatched from a chick. For some reason, sometimes some chicks do not grow completely, most of them have a small head, and there is still an egg below, but the color has changed, yellow, and there are a few hairs on it; some even have wings. Eggs have to be picked first, which is mostly the responsibility of the people in the egg industry, which way, which way to collect the eggs, they are all well divided, chickens and ducks also have "seed mouths", which one is easy to raise, which one grows tall, which one lays eggs, they all know. Divide it, pick one, thin shell, too small, loose yellow, messy, over time, don't want it at all. Then it's about the kang room master. In a dark room, a small round hole is opened in a door, the egg is placed on the hole, one eye is closed, and one eye is opened to look at repeatedly, which is called "taking pictures of eggs". The first time is called "head photo". The head photo is to look at the "beads", look at the ovules in the egg yolk, to see if there has been fertilization, in their words, to see if there has been a rooster, or whether there is a male duck. If you have not had a rooster or duck, you can't produce chicks and ducklings. After taking the photo, this is "going down to the kang". Three or four days after the kang, (they are talking about the time, they won't be so bearded, three or four days is my impression,) take out the photo again, called "second photo", and the second photo shows whether the beads are "full". The head photo is very simple, anyone can make it, no need to be on the door opening, hold it lightly like a tube with your hand, put the egg under it, face the light, turn around, you can see if there is such a little bit. The second photo is more important, whether the ovule is bulging a little or not, it is often not easy to conclude. The eggs removed by the second photo are sold outside, and they are still the same, and they can't be seen at all that they have been kang. As soon as the long-term worker arrived at Dangkou, he asked: "Where is Ni Er?"“倪二在白莲湖里，你赶快去看看，叫三爷也去看看，——一趟鸭子全散了！”
"Ni Er is in White Lotus Lake, you go and take a look, ask the third master to take a look,—— all the ducks are scattered!"白莲湖是一口小湖，离窑庄不远，出菱，出藕，藕肥白少渣滓，荷花倒是红的多。或散步，或乘船赶二五八集期，我们也常去的，湖边港汊甚多，密密的长着芦苇。新芦苇长得很高了。莲蓬已经采过，荷叶颜色发了黑，多半全破了，人过时常有翡翠鸟冲起掠过，翠绿的一闪，疾速如箭，切断人的思绪或低低的唱歌。
White Lotus Lake is a small lake, not far from Yaozhuang, out of water chestnuts, lotus roots, lotus fat and white with less slag, and lotus flowers are more red. Or take a walk, or take a boat to catch the 258 collection period, we also often go, there are many harbors by the lake, densely covered with reeds. The new reeds have grown very tall. The lotus pod has been picked, the color of the lotus leaves is black, most of them are broken, and there are often emerald birds rushing up and skimming by, flashing emerald green, as fast as an arrow, cutting off people's thoughts or singing lowly.小船浮在岸边，竹篙横在船上，篙子头上的破蒲扇不知那里去了。倪二呢？坐在一个石辘轳上，手里团着他的瓦块帽子，额头上破了一块皮，在一个人家晒场上，为几个人围着，他好像老了十年。他疲倦了，一清早到现在，现在是下半天了，他一定还没有吃过饭，跟这些鸭子奋斗了半日。他的饭在船上一个布口袋里，一袋子老锅巴。他坐着不动，看不出他心里甚么滋味，不时头忽然抖一抖，好像受了震动。——他的脖子里的沟好深，一方格一方格的，颜色真红，烧焦了似的。那么坐着，脚恐怕要麻了，好傻相的脚！父亲叫他：
The boat floated on the shore, the bamboo pole lay across the boat, and the broken cattail fan on the head of the pole disappeared. Where is Ni Er? Sitting on a stone wheel, with his tile hat in his hand, a piece of skin on his forehead, surrounded by several people, he seemed to be ten years old. He was tired, early in the morning, and now it is the second half of the day, he must not have eaten, and he must have struggled with these ducks for a long time. His food was in a cloth pocket on the boat, a bag of old pots. He sat still, unable to see what he felt in his heart, and his head suddenly shook from time to time, as if he had been shaken. ——The groove in his neck was so deep, square and square, the color was really red, as if it was burnt. So sitting, my feet are probably going to be numb, what a silly foot! His father called him:“倪二。”
“三爷！”
他像个孩子似的哭起来了。——怎么办呢？
“去找陆长庚，他有法子。”
“哎，除非陆长庚。”
“只有老陆，陆鸭。”
陆长庚在那里？
“多半在桥头茶馆。”
"Ni Er." "Third Master!" He cried like a child. ——What to do? "Go find Lu Changgeng, he has a way." "Hey, unless Lu Changgeng." "Only Lao Lu, Lu Ya." Where is Lu Changgeng? "Most of them are in the Bridgehead Teahouse."桥头有个茶馆，为的鲜货行客人，蛋行客人，陆陈粮行客人，区里，县里，党部里来的人谈话讲生意而设的，卖清茶，代卖烟纸，洋杂，针线，香烛，鸡蛋糕，麻酥饼，七厘散，紫金锭，菜种，草鞋，契纸，小绿颖毛笔，金不换黑墨，何通记纸牌。这一带闲散无事人常借茶馆聚赌玩钱。有时纸牌，最为文雅。有时麻雀，那付牌有一张红中丢了，配了牌九上一张杂七，这杂七于是成为桌上最关心的一张牌了。有时推牌九，下旁注的比坐下来拿牌的要多，在后头呼幺喝六，帮别人呐喊助威的更多。船从桥边过，远远的就看到一堆兴奋忘形的人头人手，走过了一段，还听得到“七七八八——不要九！”“磨一点，再磨一点，天地遇牯牛，越大越封侯！”呼声。常在后头看斜头胡的，有人指点过，那就是陆长庚，这一带放鸭的第一手，诨号陆鸭，说他自己简直就是一只老鸭。——瘦瘦小小，神情总是在发愁的样子。他已经多年不养鸭了，见到鸭就怕了，运气不好，老是瘟。
There is a teahouse at the head of the bridge, which is set up for the guests of the fresh goods shop, the egg shop, the guests of Lu Chen Grain Shop, the people from the district, the county, and the party headquarters to talk about business, selling tea, selling tobacco paper, foreign miscellaneous, needle and thread, incense candles, chicken cakes, hemp shortbread, seven cents of powder, purple gold ingots, vegetable seeds, straw sandals, deed paper, small green brushes, gold is not exchanged for black ink, and He Tongji cards. People who are idle in this area often use teahouses to gamble and play money. Sometimes cards are the most elegant. Sometimes sparrows, the cards are lost in the red, and there is a miscellaneous seven on the card nine, which becomes the most concerned card on the table. Sometimes pushing a card nine, there are more side bets than sitting down to get cards, and shouting six in the back is more to help others shout and cheer. The boat passed by the bridge, and in the distance, I saw a bunch of excited heads and hands, and after walking for a while, I could hear "Seven, seven, eight, eight - not nine!" "Grind a little, grind a little more, heaven and earth meet yak, and the bigger it is, the more marquis!" Cries. I often look at the slanted beard in the back, and someone pointed out, that is Lu Changgeng, the first hand to release ducks in this area, nicknamed Lu Duck, saying that he himself is simply an old duck. ——Thin and small, his expression is always worried. He hasn't raised ducks for many years, and he is afraid when he sees ducks, bad luck, and always plague.“不要你多，十五块洋钱。”
十五块钱在从前很是一个数目了。许多人都因为这个数目而回了回头，看看倪二，看看陆长庚，桌面上顶大的注子是一吊钱三三四，天之九吃三道。
"I don't want you more, fifteen yuan." Fifteen yuan was a lot in the past. Many people turned back because of this number, looking at Ni Er and Lu Changgeng, the top bet on the table was three three or four for a hanging coin, and the nine of the sky ate three.说了半天，讲定了，十块钱。看一家地杠通吃，红了一庄，方去。
“把鸭圈全拿好，倪二你会赶鸭子进圈的？我吆上来，你就赶，鸭子在水里好弄，上了岸七零八落的不好捉。”
After talking for a long time, it was agreed that it would be ten yuan. Seeing a family eating all, it became a red village, and then went. "Take all the duck pens, Ni Er, will you drive the ducks into the pen? I shouted up, you chase it, the ducks are easy to get in the water, and they are not easy to catch when they go ashore. ”这十块钱太赚得不费力了！拈起那根篙子，撑到湖心，人仆在船上，把篙子平着在水上扑一气，嘴里啧啧咕咕不知叫点甚么，嚇——都来了！鸭子四面八方，从芦苇缝里像来争甚么东西似的，拼命的拍着翅膀，挺着脖子，一起奔到他那只小船的四围来。本来平静寥阔湖面，一时骤然热闹起来，全是鸭子，不知为甚么，高兴极了，喜欢极了，放开喉咙大叫，不停的把头没在水里，翻来翻去。岸上人看到这情形，都忍不住大笑起来，连倪二都笑了，他笑得尤其舒服。差不多都齐了，篙子一抬，嘴子曼声唱着，鸭子马上又安静起来，文文雅雅，摆摆摇摇，向岸边游来，舒闲整齐有致。兵法用兵第一贵“和”，这个字用来形容那些鸭子真恰切极了。他唱的不知是甚么，仿佛鸭子都很爱听，听得很入神似的，真怪！
These ten yuan are too effortless to earn! Picking up the pole, holding it to the center of the lake, the man fell on the boat, put the pole flat on the water and threw himself on the water, muttering in his mouth that he didn't know what to call, scared - it's all here! The ducks were in all directions, as if they were fighting for something from the cracks in the reeds, desperately flapping their wings, holding their necks, and running around his boat together. The lake, which was originally calm and wide, suddenly became lively, full of ducks, for some reason, very happy, very happy, very happy, so happy that they let go and screamed, kept putting their heads in the water, and turning around. When the people on the shore saw this, they couldn't help but laugh, even Ni Er laughed, and he smiled particularly comfortably. Almost all of them were together, the pole was raised, the mouth was singing, and the duck immediately became quiet again, elegant, swaying, swimming towards the shore, comfortable and neat. The most expensive word in the art of war is "and", and this word is really appropriate to describe those ducks. I don't know what he was singing, as if the ducks loved to listen to it, and it was very strange to listen to it!“一共多少只？”
“三千多。”
“三千多少？”
“三千零四十二。”
他拣一个高处，四面一望。
“你数数，大概不差了。——嗨！你这里头怎么来了一只老鸭！是那一家养的老鸭教你裹来了！”
"How many in total?" "More than three thousand." "How many three thousand?" "Three thousand and forty-two." He chose a high place and looked around. "You count, it's probably not bad. ——Hi! Why did you have an old duck here! It was the old duck raised by that family that taught you to wrap it! ”倪二分辩，分辩也没有用，他一伸手捞住了。
Ni Er's argument was useless, and he stretched out his hand to catch it.“它屁股一撅，就知道。新鸭子拉稀屎，过了一年的，才硬。鸭肠子鸭头的那里有个小箍道，老鸭子就长老了。吃新鸭子，不喝酒，容易拉肚，就因为鸭肠子不老。裹了人家鸭自己还不知道，只知道多了一只！”
"As soon as it pouts its butt, it knows. New ducks poop loose shit, and it will be hard after a year. There is a small hoop on the duck head, and the old duck will grow old. Eating new ducks, not drinking, is prone to diarrhea, just because the duck intestines are not old. I don't know if I wrapped someone else's duck, I only know that there is one more! ”“我不要你多，只要两只。送不送由你。”
怎么小气，也没法不送他，他已经到鸭圈里提了两只，一手一只，拎了一拎。
“多重？”
他问人。
“你说多重？”
有人问他。
"I don't want you more, just two. It's up to you to give it or not. ” No matter how stingy he was, he couldn't help but send him, he had already gone to the duck pen to carry two, one in each hand, and carried one. "How much?" He asked. "How much do you say?" Someone asked him.“六斤四，——这一只，多一两，六斤五。这一趟里顶壮的两只。”
不相信，那里一两也分得出，就凭手拎一拎？
“不相信，不相信拿秤来称。称得不对，两只鸭算你的；对了，今天晚上上你家里喝酒。”
"Six pounds and four ,—— this one, one tael more, six pounds and five. The two strongest in this trip. ” Don't believe it, you can distinguish one or two there, just carry it by hand? "I don't believe it, I don't believe it's weighed on a scale. If you weigh it wrong, two ducks count as yours; By the way, go to your house for a drink tonight. ”称出来，一点都不错。
“拎都用不着拎，凭眼睛看，说得出这一趟鸭一个一个多重。”
Weigh it, it's not bad at all. "You don't even need to carry it, just look at it with your eyes, you can tell how heavy this duck is one by one."不过先得大叫一声才看得出来。鸭身上有毛，毛蓬松着看不出来，得惊它一惊，一惊，鸭毛就紧了，贴在身上了，这就看得出那一个肥那一个瘦。
“晚上喝酒了，在茶馆里会。不让你费事，鸭先杀好。”
But you have to scream first to see it. There is hair on the duck's body, the hair is fluffy and you can't see it, you have to be startled, and when you are startled, the duck feathers are tight and stick to the body, which shows which one is fat and the other is thin. "Drink at night, meet in the teahouse. Don't let you bother, kill the duck first. ”他刀也不用，一个指头往鸭子三岔骨处一捣，两只鸭挣扎都不挣扎就死了。
“杀的鸭子不好吃，鸭子要吃呛血的，肉才不老。”
He didn't even use a knife, and one finger hit the duck's three bones, and the two ducks died without struggling. "The duck you kill is not delicious, the duck has to eat choking blood, and the meat is not old."甚么事他都是轻描淡写，毫不大惊小怪。说话自然露出得意，可是得意之中还是有一种对于自己的嘲讽，仿佛这是并不稀奇的事，而且正因为有这点本领，他才种种不如别人。他日子过得很不如意，种一点地，种的是豆子。“懒媳妇种豆，”豆子是顶不要花工夫气力的。从前放过鸭，可是本钱都蚀光了。鸭子瘟起来不得了，只要看见一个鸭摇一摇头，就完了。还不像鸡，鸡瘟起来比较慢，灌点胡椒香油，还可以有点救。鸭，一个摇头，个个摇头，马上，都不动了。比在三岔骨上捣一指头还快。常常一趟鸭子放到荡里，回来时只有自己一个人了。看着死，毫无办法。陆长庚吃的鸭可太多了，他发誓，从此决不再养。
He understated everything and made no fuss. He naturally showed pride when he spoke, but there was still a kind of ridicule of himself in his pride, as if this was not uncommon, and it was precisely because of this skill that he was inferior to others. He had a very unsatisfactory life, planting a little land and planting beans. "Lazy daughter-in-law plants beans," beans are the best to spend no effort. In the past, ducks were released, but the capital was gone. Ducks are so plagued that as long as they see a duck shake their heads, it's over. It's not like chickens, chickens are more slow to get sick, and adding some pepper sesame oil can save a little. Ducks, one shakes their heads, and they all shake their heads, and immediately, they don't move. It's faster than pounding a finger on a three-way bone. Often the ducks are put into the swing once, and when they come back, they are the only ones. Looking at death, there is no way. Lu Changgeng ate too many ducks, and he vowed never to raise them again.“倪老二，十块钱不白要你的，我给你送到。今天晚了，你把鸭圈起来过一夜，明天一早我来。三爷，十块钱赶一趟鸭，不算顶贵噢？”
他知道这十块钱将由谁来出。
"Ni Laoer, ten yuan is not for nothing, I will deliver it to you. It's late today, you put up the duck pen for the night, and I'll come early tomorrow morning. Third master, ten yuan to drive a duck is not the most expensive, right? ” He knew who would pay the ten dollars.当然，第二天大早他来时仍是一个陆长庚，一夜七戳五在手，输得光光的。
“没有！还剩一块！”
Of course, when he came early the next morning, he was still a Lu Changgeng, and he lost all the money in his hands with seven pokes and five in his hands all night. "No! There is still one piece left! ”这两个人都老了，时候过起来真快。两个老人怎么会到这里来了呢？现在在作甚么呢？父亲也不大清楚，我请父亲给我打听打听，可是一直还没有信来。——忽然想起来，那个分鸭子的年青小伙子一定是两老人之一的儿子，而且是另一老人的女婿。我得写封信去问问。也顺便问问父亲房东家养在院子里的那只大公鸡不知怎么了。——这只公鸡，他们说它有神经病，我看大概不是神经病。一窝小鸡买进来时本来是十只，次第都已死去，只剩下这个长命。不过很怪，常常它会曲起一只脚来乱蹦乱跳一气，就像发了疯似的。可能是抽筋，不过鸡会抽筋么？它左脚有点异样，脚趾全向里弯，有点内八字，最外一个而且好像短了一截，可能是小时教甚么重东西压的。是这影响他生理上有时不大平衡么？父亲说怕是受刺激太深，与它的同伴的死有关，那当然是开玩笑。——哎哟，一年了，该没有被杀掉风起来罢？这两天正是风鸡的时候。
Both of them are old, and time flies so fast. How did the two old men come here? What are they doing now? My father didn't know much, so I asked him to inquire about me, but he never wrote to me. ——Suddenly remembered, the young man who divided the ducks must be the son of one of the two old men, and the son-in-law of the other old man. I have to write a letter to ask. By the way, I also asked my father's landlord about the big rooster in the yard. ——This rooster, they said it had a mental illness, but I don't think it's a mental illness. When a litter of chicks was bought, there were originally ten chicks, but they all died one after another, leaving only this long life. But it's very strange, often it bends one foot and jumps around like crazy. It may be cramps, but do chickens cramp? Its left foot is a bit strange, its toes are all bent inward, a little inward, and the outermost one seems to be a bit shorter. Is this affecting his physiological sometimes unbalanced? My father said that he was afraid that it was stimulated too deeply and related to the death of his companion, which was of course a joke. ——Oh, it's been a year, shouldn't the wind rise? These two days are the time for the wind chicken.

醒来

醒来[1]
一
Da Nao Records {{id_0000}} One我不知道我是怎么醒来的。既非突然，然而又不能是渐渐的。我不能分辨我的已经沉坠的生命甚么时候又开始浮了上来。仿佛从那边度到这边并不很难，那可以说是很“巧”，哪里轻轻拨动一下，有点像开一把锁，我重新活了。证实的是一个感觉：一缕风，像一角缎子，从我额上拂过，从我太阳穴下一条干去的汗渍间斜切过去，还旁及我的鼻翼，我相信，一定把我搭上眉端的两点头发带到耳边去。我光赤的上身上有一片蜻蜓翅子掠过的记忆，那是两根草。这风是贴地吹来的。这是我，这是我的手，我的左手，我的右手。我的右手按在水壶上。水壶外面一层毡子，毡子的毛。毡子上皮带，皮带的光滑。皮带上一个扣子，扣子上一点绿锈。锈斑正在我食指螺纹当中。我的左手平贴地面。胳臂弯着，肘尖靠近我的腰。我动了动左手，手掌下一个小石子儿。喔，手掌压出了一个小坑。我活了。我在这里躺着，我躺了多少时间？
I don't know how I woke up. It was neither sudden, nor gradual. I couldn't tell when my sunken life began to rise again. It seemed that it was not difficult to get from there to this side, it could be said to be very "coincidental", where I flicked it slightly, it was a bit like opening a lock, and I came back to life. What confirmed it was a feeling: a breeze, like a horn of satin, blew over my forehead, cut diagonally through a dried sweat stain under my temple, and also reached my nose, and I believed that it must bring the two strands of hair that had tied my eyebrows to my ears. There was a memory of a dragonfly's wings passing by on my bare upper body, and it was two blades of grass. The wind blew close to the ground. This is me, this is my hand, my left hand, my right hand. My right hand is pressed against the kettle. A layer of felt outside the kettle, the hair of the felt. The belt on the felt, the smoothness of the belt. A buckle on the belt, a little rust on the buckle. The rust spot is in the thread of my index finger. My left hand is flat on the ground. My arm is bent, the tip of my elbow is close to my waist. I move my left hand, a small pebble under my palm. Oh, a small hole is pressed out of my palm. I am alive. I am lying here, how long have I been lying down?我想看一看表。我的表还戴着。多少日子以来，我不想到时间上表只是习惯，现在我想看看。——我忽然想起一个弟弟生下来，午夜，我父亲用那么庄重的态度去看家里的一架老苏式钟。可是表停了，我听不见摆的声音。我没有看，我想见表针呆呆的止在那儿。然而我不知凭甚么肯定现在是八点二十分，不会错，八点二十。夜，月亮。月亮在我头的左边，好大好大。青色的光落在我身上，特别是胸上。我不知落在胸上的是夜，是月亮。我不能把月亮跟夜分开。我觉得夜是具体的，物质的。广漠的，澄清的天。泥土气味。一种山地植物的苦味。这种苦味多少日子以来充塞于我们的呼吸。噢，月亮真好，我从来没有见过这样好的月亮。不，我看见过许多次，无数次这样的月亮。这样大，这样不带浪漫气味，恬静，清澈，无私而坚定。这醒来的一刻真是奇妙。一种感兴，一种喜悦，一种纯粹，一种超乎理性和情欲的存在。一种和平。一种健康的衰弱，一种新。我逗留在一个不变的境地里，就这样，我躺了一会。
I want to look at the watch. My watch is still wearing. For many days, I didn't think that the time was just a habit, but now I want to see it. ——I suddenly remembered that at midnight when a younger brother was born, my father looked at an old Soviet-style clock in the house with such a solemn attitude. But the watch stopped, and I couldn't hear the sound of the pendulum. I didn't look, I wanted to see the watch hand stop there. But I was somehow sure it was 8:20, not wrong, 8:20. Night, moon. The moon was on the left side of my head, so big, so big. The blue light fell on me, especially on my chest. I didn't know that it was night on my chest, it was the moon. I couldn't separate the moon from the night. I thought the night was concrete, material. The desert, the clear sky. The smell of earth. The bitterness of a mountain plant. This bitterness has filled our breath for many days. Oh, the moon is so good, I have never seen such a good moon. No, I have seen such a moon many times, countless times. So big, so not romantic, quiet, clear, selfless and determined. This awakening moment is wonderful. A kind of excitement, a kind of joy, a kind of purity, a existence beyond reason and lust. A kind of peace. A kind of healthy weakness, a kind of newness. I stayed in an unchanging situation, and just like that, I lay down for a while.露水凝聚在荷叶上：我的生命在那么一个状态中停留。不知多少时候，（零与无限之间）于是，一切归向我，纷纷回来，开始充满弥漫在我之内。渐渐复合，成形，恢复我原来的样子，我的生活，我的历史，和我的渴。
The dew condensed on the lotus leaves: my life stayed in that state. I don't know how many times, (between zero and infinity), so everything came to me, came back, and began to fill me. Gradually, it came back to me, my life, my history, and my thirst.渴。整个占据了我，只有渴，更无其他。水，我要水，我要喝。我又要晕了，我连忙拿过水壶，拔了盖子，把壶口凑近我的嘴。所有动作全像一个酒醉人做的事，我以后全想不起怎么做的，可是做得满对，满敏捷。到壶嘴的锡边触到我的唇皮，我的唇皮颤缩了一下，闻到水，我的渴意一齐涌上来。我太阳穴跳动，我明白感觉身体里血液浓滞，我两眼恍惚，黑影齐眉压下来，喝，我急急喝了几口。清清楚楚知道水流入胃，立刻就注到肠子里。我应当喝得慢些，可是我的舌头急需沾湿。
Thirsty. The whole thing occupied me, only thirst, nothing else. Water, I want water, I want to drink. I was about to faint again, so I quickly took the kettle, pulled out the lid, and brought the mouth of the kettle close to my mouth. All the movements were like a drunken man's doing, and I couldn't remember how to do it later, but I did it right and agile. When I touched my lips on the tin edge of the spout, my lips trembled, and when I smelled the water, my thirst surged up. My temples were pounding, I knew that I felt the blood in my body, my eyes were in a trance, and the black shadow was suppressed down, and I drank a few sips. I knew clearly that the water flowed into my stomach and immediately poured into my intestines. I should have drunk slowly, but my tongue needed to be wet urgently.我记起，这是我们仅有的一壶水了。
I remember, this is the only pot of water we have.我支持自己的力量忽然消失了，我倒了下来。我想起，这是高黎贡山，高黎贡山。高黎贡山。高黎贡山。我记得一点事情发生过。我不是一个人。在我刚醒来不久，我思想的语言中即有“我们”两个字出现过了。……
My strength to support myself suddenly disappeared, and I collapsed. I remembered that this was Gaoligong Mountain, Gaoligong Mountain. Gaoligong Mountain. Gaoligong Mountain. I remember something happened. I am not alone. Shortly after I woke up, the word "we" appeared in the language of my thoughts. ……二
这只是两根线条，几个“笔触”。
Two These are just two lines, a few "brushstrokes".画画往往会“画过”了。一次又一次的描摹一个理想，怎么样也找不到合适的表现方法，（这自然是还未天然的成熟，）到后来越来越距初意远了，手下已全不是那么回事，看看糟塌了那么多纸，要不暂停下来也不可能了；却在一张乌黑一团，不成样子的稿子上看看有三数笔还似乎有一点意思；虽然也笨重流滑了，不忍一齐毁去，居然剪下来夹在那里。这至少是日后重新拾起的一个种子。这是把这段东西抄出来的一个理由。
Painting is often "painted". Repeatedly tracing an ideal, no matter how you can't find a suitable way to express it, (this is naturally not naturally mature,) and then it becomes more and more far from the original intention, and the subordinates are no longer like that. But it seems a little interesting to see three or a few strokes on a black and unsightly manuscript; although it is also bulky and slippery, I can't bear to destroy them all together, so I actually cut them out and put them there. This is at least a seed that I picked up again in the future. This is a reason to copy this thing out.自从我有了一个故事，三年来已经前后落笔试写了不下八次，愿意保留的只有这一点。日后再拿起来，我希望并不从这里走不下去。
Since I have a story, I have tried to write it no less than eight times in the past three years, and this is the only thing I am willing to keep. I hope to pick it up again in the future, and I hope it won't go on from here.我想讨论一点东西：（我自认现在已失去不少讨论的热情了，）一个军官在缅甸陷落战役中，（一次战役好了，）惠通桥断了，（随便一个桥吧，）失了归路，他得用平常不用的办法归来。只有一条路，爬过高黎贡山，一个人迹罕至，许多地方存留太古样子的大岭。在辛苦艰危的路程中部众或散落，或死去，最后剩下（假定）三个跟着他走。这是他们的绝路的最后一站的情形：吃的还不大愁，可喝的水很少了，就军官身上这一壶。他们四个一路来自然已经是“团结”在一起，不可分了。说“爱”，分量似觉太轻了。在疲困中，一齐倒下，晕去。第一个醒来的是军官，他。清醒之后，他想起一点事：他记得在昏糊中，那三个同伴一个一个向他滚过来，他就滚过去，避开。滚过来，躲过去，滚过来，躲过去。……
I would like to discuss something: (I think I have lost a lot of enthusiasm for discussion now,) An officer in the battle of the fall of Burma, (a battle was good,) the Huitong Bridge broke, (any bridge,) lost his way back, and he had to return in a way that he usually didn't use. There is only one road, climbing through Gaoligong Mountain, which is inaccessible, and in many places there are ancient mountains. In the middle of the hard and arduous journey, the people either scattered or died, and finally (assumed) three were left to follow him. This was the situation of their last stop: they didn't have much to eat, and there was very little water to drink, just the pot on the officer. The four of them were naturally "united" together along the way, and they were inseparable. Saying "love" seems to be too light. In exhaustion, they all fell down and fainted. The first to wake up was the officer, him. After waking up, he remembered something: he remembered that in a daze, the three companions rolled towards him one by one, and he rolled over and avoided them. Roll over, dodge, roll over, dodge. ……我对这样的事，没有办法。这是一个作者的苦。
也算是一个交待，我有一天如释重负，很高兴的告诉自己：喂，他醒来了啊，醒来，就好办了。醒了，醒了，我把这两个字越念越轻，我知道我的责任未尽。
I have no way to deal with such things. This is the author's suffering. It can be regarded as an explanation, I was relieved one day, and I happily told myself: Hey, he woke up, woke up, and it would be easy. Wake up, wake up, I read these two words lighter and lighter, and I know that my responsibility has not been fulfilled.我还不致就死，且活几年再说吧。啊唷，我可也有点累。
