I'm not going to die yet, let's live a few years. Ah, I'm a little tired too. [1] This article was originally published in Shanghai's Ta Kung Pao on January 16, 1947. First received the first volume of "The Complete Works of Wang Zengqi", Beijing Normal University Press, August 1998.

艺术家

艺术家[1]
Artist[1]抽烟的多，少；悠缓，猛烈；可以作为我的灵魂状态的记录。在一个艺术品之前，我常是大口大口的抽，深深的吸进去，浓烟弥满全肺，然后吹灭烛火似的撮着嘴唇吹出来。夹着烟的手指这时也满带表情。抽烟的样子最足以显示体内潜微的变化，最是自己容易发觉的。
smoke more, less; slowly and violently; can be used as a record of my soul state. Before a work of art, I often smoked heavily, inhaled deeply, filled my lungs with thick smoke, and then blew it out with my lips like a candle. The fingers holding the cigarette were also full of expressions at this time. The appearance of smoking is the most sufficient to show the subtle changes in the body, and it is the easiest to notice.只有一次，我有一次近于“完全”的经验。在一个展览会中，我一下子没到很高的情绪里。我眼睛睁大，眯起；胸部开张，腹下收小，我的确感到我的踝骨细起来；我走近，退后一点，猿行虎步，意气扬扬；我想把衣服全脱了，平贴着卧在地下。沉酣了，直是“尔时觉一座无人。”我对艺术的要求是能给我一种高度的欢乐，一种仙意，一种狂：我想一下子砸碎在它面前，化为一阵青烟，想死，想“没有”了。这种感情只有恋爱可与之比拟，平常或多或少我也享受到一点，为有这点享受，我才愿意活下去，在那种时候我可以得到生命的实证；但“绝对的”经验只有那么一次。我常常为“不够”所苦，像爱喝酒的人喝得不痛快，不过瘾，或是酒里有水，或是才馋起来酒就完了。或是我不够，或是作品本身不够，真正笔笔都到了，作者处处惬意，真配（作者自愿）称为“杰作”的究竟不多；（一个艺术家不能张张都是杰作，真苦！）欣赏的人又不易适逢其会的升华到精纯的地步，所以狂欢难得完全。我最易在艺术品之前敏锐的感到灵魂中的杂质，沙泥，垃圾，感到不满足；我确确实实感觉到体内的石灰质。这个时候我想尖起嗓子来长叫一声，想发泄，想破坏；最后是一阵涣散，一阵空虚掩袭上来，归于平常，归于俗。
Only once, I had an experience that was close to "complete". In an exhibition, I was not in a very high mood at once. My eyes opened wide and narrowed; my chest opened and my abdomen was retracted, and I did feel my ankle bones thin; I approached, stepped back a little, and walked with great spirit; I wanted to take off all my clothes and lie flat on the ground. I was so drunk that I felt that there was no one at that time. My requirement for art is to give me a high degree of joy, a kind of fairy, a kind of madness: I want to smash it in front of it all at once, turn into a puff of smoke, want to die, think "no". This kind of relationship can only be compared with love, and I usually enjoy a little bit of it, and for this little enjoyment, I am willing to live, and at that time I can get the empirical evidence of life; but there is only one "absolute" experience. I often suffer from "not enough", like a person who loves to drink not happily, but is not addicted, or there is water in the wine, or just greedy and the wine is over. Or I am not enough, or the work itself is not enough, the real pen has arrived, the author is comfortable everywhere, and there are not many true matches (the author voluntarily) called "masterpieces"; (An artist can't be a masterpiece, it's really bitter!) It is not easy for those who appreciate it to sublimate to the point of purity at the right time, so the carnival is rarely complete. I am most likely to feel the impurities, sand, and garbage in my soul before the artwork, and feel dissatisfied; I do feel the calcareous matter in my body. At this time, I want to raise my voice and scream for a long time, wanting to vent and destroy; Finally, there is a burst of dispersion, a burst of emptiness covering up, returning to the ordinary, to the mundane.我想学音乐的人最有福，但我于此一无所知；我有时不甘隔靴搔痒，不甘用累赘笨重的文字来表达，我喜欢画。用颜色线条究竟比较直接得多，自由得多。我对于画没有天分；没有天分，我还是喜欢拿起笔来乱涂，虽不能至，心向往之。而结果都是愤然掷笔，想痛哭。要不就是“寄沉痛于悠闲”，我会很滑稽的唱两句流行歌曲，说一句下流粗话，摹仿舞台上的声调向自己说“可怜的，亲爱的××，你可以睡了。”我画画大都在深夜，（如果我有个白天可以练习的环境，也许我可以做一个“美术放大”的画师吧！）种种怪腔，无人窥见，尽管放心。
I want to be the most blessed to study music, but I don't know anything about it; I sometimes don't want to scratch the itch through my boots, I don't want to express it with cumbersome and bulky words, I like to draw. The use of color lines is much more direct and free. I have no talent for painting; I still like to pick up a pen and scribble, although I can't get there, I yearn for it. And the result is that I throw the pen angrily and want to cry bitterly. Otherwise, I would sing two popular songs very funny, say a vulgar word, and imitate the tone on the stage to say to myself, "Poor thing, dear ××, you can sleep." "I paint mostly late at night, (if I have an environment where I can practice during the day, maybe I can be a "art magnification" painter!) All kinds of strange tones, no one can see them, but don't worry.从我的作画看画（其实是一回事）的经验，我明白“忍耐”是个甚么东西；抽着烟，我想起米盖朗皆罗，——这个巨人，这个王八旦！我也想起白马庙，想起白马庙那个哑巴画家。
From my experience of painting and looking at painting (actually one thing), I understand what "patience" is; smoking a cigarette, I think of Miguelangelo,—— this giant, this bastard! I also think of the White Horse Temple, the mute painter of the White Horse Temple.白马庙是昆明城郊一小村镇，我在那里住了一些时候。
搬到白马庙半个多月我才走过那座桥。
The White Horse Temple is a small village on the outskirts of Kunming, where I lived for some time. It took more than half a month to move to the White Horse Temple before I walked across the bridge.在从前，对于我，白马庙即是这个桥，桥是镇的代表。——我们上西山回来，必经白马庙。爬了山，走了不少路；更因为这一回去，不爬山，不走路了，人感到累。回来了，又回到一成不变的生活，又将坐在那个办公桌前，又将吃那位“毫无想象”的大师傅烧出来的饭菜，又将与许多熟脸见面，招呼，（有几张脸现在即在你身边，在同一条船上！）一想到这个，真累。没有法子，还是乖乖的，帖然就范，不作徒然的反抗。但是，有点惘然了。这点惘然实在就是一点反抗，一点残余的野。于是抱头靠在船桅上，不说话，眼睛空落落看着前面。看样子，倒真好像十分怀念那张极有个性而颇体贴的跛脚椅子，想于一杯茶，一枝烟，一点“在家”之感中求得安慰似的。于是你急于想“到”，而专心一意于白马庙。到白马庙，就快了，到白马庙看得见城中的万家灯火。——但是看到白马庙者，你看到的是那座桥。除桥而外，一无所见，房屋，田畴，侧着的那棵树，全附属于桥，是桥的一部份。（自然，没有桥，这许多景物仍可集中于另一点上，而指出这是白马庙。然而有桥呀，用不着假设。）我搬来之时即冉冉升起一个欲望：从桥上走一走。既然这个桥曾经涂抹过我那么多感情，我一直从桥下过，（在桥洞里有一种特别感觉，一种安全感，有如在母亲怀里，在胎里，）我极想以新证旧，从桥上走一走。这么一点小事，也竟然搁了半个多月！我们的日子的浪费呀。——这一段都不太相干，是我在心里刷落了好多次，而姑息的准许自己又检了起来，趁笔而书的塞在这里的废话。
In the past, for me, the White Horse Temple was this bridge, and the bridge was the representative of the town. ——When we come back from the West Mountain, we must pass through the White Horse Temple. I climbed the mountain and walked a lot; and because of this return, I don't climb the mountain or walk, and people feel tired. When I come back, I will return to the same life, I will sit at that desk, eat the food cooked by the "unimaginable" master, and meet and greet many familiar faces (a few faces are now by your side, in the same boat!) Thinking about this is really tiring. There is no way, but I am still obedient, obedient, and do not resist in vain. However, I am a little confused. This feeling of confusion is really a little resistance, a little remnant. So he leaned on the mast with his head in his hands, did not speak, and looked forward with empty eyes. It seems that he really misses the lame chair that is very unique and considerate, and wants to find comfort in a cup of tea, a cigarette, and a little feeling of "home". So you are eager to "reach" and concentrate on the White Horse Temple. When you go to the White Horse Temple, you can see the lights of thousands of houses in the city. ——But when you see the White Horse Temple, you see the bridge. Except for the bridge, you see nothing, the houses, the fields, and the tree on the side are all attached to the bridge and are part of the bridge. (Naturally, without a bridge, many of these scenes can still be concentrated on another point and point out that this is the White Horse Temple.) However, there is a bridge, so there is no need to assume.) When I moved in, a desire arose: to take a walk from the bridge. Since this bridge has smeared so many feelings on me, I have been passing under the bridge, (there is a special feeling in the bridge hole, a sense of security, as if in my mother's arms, in the womb,) I really want to walk from the bridge with the new and the old. Such a small matter has been put on hold for more than half a month! It's a waste of our days. ——This paragraph has nothing to do with it, it was I who brushed it off in my heart many times, and I allowed myself to check it again and stuff it here with a pen and a pen.这一天我终于没有甚么“事情”了，我过了桥，我到一个小茶馆里去坐坐。我早知道那边有个小茶馆。我没有一直到茶馆里去，我在堤边走了半天，看了半天。我看麦叶飘动，看油菜花一片，看黄昏，看一只黑黑的水牯牛自己缓步回家，看它偏了头，好把它的美丽的长角顺进那口窄窄的门，我这才去“访”这家茶馆。
I finally had nothing "things" that day, I crossed the bridge, and I went to a small teahouse to sit down. I knew there was a small teahouse over there. I didn't go all the way to the teahouse, I walked by the embankment for a long time, looking at it for a long time. I watched the wheat leaves fluttering, the rape flowers, the dusk, and the black water yak walking home slowly, watching it tilt its head so that its beautiful long horns could enter the narrow door, and then I went to "visit" this teahouse.第一次去，我要各处看看。
The first time I go, I want to look everywhere.进一个有门框而无门的门是一个一头不通的短巷。巷子一头是一个半人高的小花坛。花坛上一盆茶花（和其他几色花木，杜鹃，黄杨，迎春，罗汉松）。我的心立刻落在茶花上了。我脚下走，我这不是为喝茶而走，是走去看茶花。我一路看到茶花面前。我爱了花。这是我见过的最好的茶花，（云南多茶花），仿佛从我心里搬出来放在那儿的。花并不出奇，地位好。暮色沉沉，朦胧之中，红焰焰的，份量刚对。我想用舌尖舔舔花，而我的眼睛像蝴蝶从花上起来时又向前伸了出去，定在那里了，花坛后面粉壁上有画，画教我不得不看。
Entering a door with a door frame but no door is a short alley that does not pass at one end. At one end of the alley is a small flower bed half a person high. There is a pot of camellia (and several other colors of flowers and trees, rhododendrons, boxwood, Yingchun, Luo Han pine). My heart immediately fell on the camellias. I walked under my feet, I didn't walk to drink tea, I walked to see the camellias. I saw the camellia all the way. I love the flowers. This is the best camellia I have ever seen, (there are many camellias in Yunnan), as if it was moved out of my heart and placed there. The flowers are not surprising and have a good status. The twilight is gloomy, hazy, red, and the portion is just right. I wanted to lick the flower with the tip of my tongue, but my eyes stretched forward like butterflies when they got up from the flowers, and they were there, and there were paintings on the powder wall behind the flower beds, and the paintings made me have to look at them.画以墨线勾勒而成，再敷了色的。装饰性很重，可以说是图案，（一切画原都是图案，）而取材自写实中出。画若须题目，题目是“茶花”。填的颜色是黑，翠绿，赭石和大红。作风倩巧而不卖弄；含浑，含浑中觉出一种安分，然而不凝滞。线条严紧匀直，无一处虚弱苟且，笔笔诚实，不笔在意先，无中生有，不虚妄。各部份平均，对称，显见一种深厚的农民趣味。
The painting is outlined with ink lines and then colored. It is very decorative, it can be said to be a pattern, (all paintings are original patterns), and the material is taken from realism. If the painting needs a title, the title is "Camellia". The colors of the filling are black, emerald green, ochre and bright red. The style is clever but not ostentatious; it is muddy, and there is a sense of peace in the muddy, but it is not stagnant. The lines are tight and straight, there is no weakness in any place, the pen is honest, the pen is not concerned first, out of nothing, and is not false. The parts are even, symmetrical, showing a deep peasant taste.谁在这里画了这么一壁画？我心里沉吟，沉吟中已转入花坛对面一小侧门，进了屋了。我靠窗坐下，窗外是河。我招呼给我泡茶。
Who painted such a mural here? I pondered in my heart, and in the midst of my contemplation, I turned into a small side door opposite the flower bed and entered the house. I sat down by the window, and outside the window was the river. I greeted me to make tea.——这是……这是一个细木作匠手笔；这个人曾在苏州或北平从名师学艺，熟习许多雕刻花式，熟能生巧，遂能自己出样；因为战争，辗转到了此地，或是回乡，回到自己老家，住的日子久了，无适当事情可作，才能跃动，偶尔兴作，来借这堵粉壁小试牛刀来了？……
——This is ...... This is a joinery; This person has learned from famous teachers in Suzhou or Peiping, and is familiar with many carving styles. Because of the war, he moved to this place, or returned to his hometown, returned to his hometown, lived for a long time, and had nothing to do, so he could jump, occasionally work, and come to borrow this pink wall to test the knife? ……这个假设看来亦近情理，然而我笑了，我笑那个为我修板壁的木匠。
This assumption seems reasonable, but I laugh, I laugh at the carpenter who repaired the walls for me.我一搬来，一看，房子还好，只是须做一个板壁隔一隔。我请人给我找个木匠来。找了三天，才来，说还是硬挪腾出时候来的。他鞋口里还嵌着锯屑，果然是很忙的样子。这位木匠师傅样子极像他自己脚上那双方方的厚底硬帮子青布鞋子。他钉钉刨刨，刨刨钉钉，整整弄了三天，一丈来长的壁子还是一块一块的稀着缝，他自己也觉得板壁好像不应当是这样的，看看板壁看看我，笑了：
As soon as I moved in, I saw that the house was fine, but I had to make a board wall to separate it. I asked someone to find me a carpenter. After looking for three days, he came, saying that he was still moving to make time. He also had sawdust embedded in the mouth of his shoe, and he looked very busy. The carpenter looked very much like the thick-soled hard-topped blue cloth shoes on both sides of his own feet. He nailed nails, planed nails, and worked on them for three days, and the wall that was about a foot long was still sparse piece by piece, and he himself felt that the board wall should not be like this, so he looked at the board wall and looked at me, and smiled:“像入伍新兵，不会看齐！”
"Like enlisted recruits, they won't be able to keep up!"我只有随着他说：“更像是壮丁队，才从乡下抓来，没有穿制服，颜色黑一块白一块。”而且，最后一块还是我自己钉上去的。他闺女来报信，说家里猪病了，看样子不大好，他撒下头就跑。我没有办法，只有追出去，请他把含在嘴里的洋钉吐出来给我，自己动手。这一去，不回来了，过了两天才来取回他的家私。不知是猪好了，还是连猪带病吃在他的肚子里了。这个人长于聊天，说话极有风趣，作活实在不大在行。——哦，我还欠他一顿酒呢，他老是东扯西拉的没个完，谈到得意处，把斧头凿子全撂在一边，尽顾伸手问我“美国烟可还有？”我说“烟有，可是你一边做事一边抽烟？先把板壁钉好，否则我要头痛伤风。有趣的话太多，二天我们打二斤升掺市，切一盘猪耳朵，咱们痛痛快快谈谈。”这个约不必真，却也不假，他想当记在心里。可别看这位大师傅呀！他说乡下生活本来只是修水车，钉船桨，板壁不大有人家有，所以弄得不顶理想；但是除了他，更没有人干得了；白马庙一带从来就是他家三代单传，泥木两作，所以他那么忙。
I only followed him and said, "It's more like a strong team, so I caught them from the countryside, not wearing uniforms, and the color is black and white." Moreover, I nailed the last piece myself. His daughter came to report that the pig at home was sick and didn't look good, so he threw his id_0000 head and ran away. I had no choice but to chase him out and ask him to spit out the nail in his mouth and do it himself. This time, he didn't come back, and it took two days to get his furniture back. I don't know if the pig is cured, or if the pig is sick and eaten in his stomach. This person is good at chatting, talking very funny, and is really not good at work. ——Oh, I still owe him a meal of wine, he always talks about it, talks about pride, puts aside all the axes and chisels, and stretches out his hand and asks me, "Are there still American cigarettes?" I said, "There are cigarettes, but you smoke while doing things? Nail the board wall first, otherwise I will have a headache and a cold." There are too many interesting words, in two days we will mix two pounds of mixed with the market, cut a plate of pig ears, and let's talk happily. "This appointment doesn't have to be true, but it's not false, he wants to keep it in mind. Don't look at this master! He said that life in the countryside was just repairing waterwheels, nailing boat oars, and not many people had board walls, so it was not ideal; But except him, no one can do it; The area around the White Horse Temple has always been his family's three generations of single heirloom, mud and wood work, so he is so busy.这个画当然不可能是他画的。
Of course, this painting could not have been painted by him.乡下房子暗，天又晚了，黑沉沉的，眼睛拣亮处看，外头还有光，所以我坐近窗口，来喝茶的目的还就是想来凭窗而看，河里船行，岸上人走，一切在逐渐深浓起来的烟雾中活动，脉脉含情，极其新鲜；又似曾相识，十分亲切。水草气味，淤泥气味，烧饭的豆秸烟微带忧郁的焦香，窗下几束新竹，给人一种雨意，人“远”了起来。我这样望了很久，直到在场上捉迷藏的孩子都回了家，田里的苜蓿消失了紫色，野火在远远的山头晶明的游动起来，我才回过身来。
The house in the country is dark, it's late again, it's dark, my eyes pick the bright place to look, and there is light outside, so I sat close to the window, and the purpose of drinking tea was to come and look at the window, the boats in the river, the people on the shore, everything was moving in the gradually thickening smoke, the pulse was affectionate, extremely fresh; it seemed familiar and very kind. The smell of aquatic plants, the smell of silt, the slight melancholic burnt aroma of the soybean straw smoke of the rice, a few bunches of new bamboo under the window, giving people a sense of rain, and people are "far away". I looked at it like this for a long time, until the children who were playing hide and seek on the field returned home, the alfalfa in the field disappeared purple, and the wildfire was swimming brightly on the distant hilltops, and I turned around.我想起口袋里的一本小书，一个朋友今天刚送我的。我想这本书想到多时，终于他给我找得一本了。我抽出书来，用手摸摸封面。这时我本没有看书的意，只是想摸摸它罢了，而坐在炉旁的老板看见了，他叫他的小老二拿灯。为了我拿灯，多不好意思；我想说，不要，不必，我倒愿意这么黑黑的坐着，这一说，更麻烦，老板必以为我是客气；好了，拿就拿吧。
I remembered a small book in my pocket that a friend just gave me today. I think this book has been thinking about it for a long time, and finally he found one for me. I took out the book and touched the cover with my hand. At this time, I didn't mean to read the book, I just wanted to touch it, but the boss sitting by the stove saw it, and he asked his second brother to take the lamp. I'm so sorry to take the lamp for me; I want to say, no, no, I would rather sit in the dark, this is even more troublesome, the boss must think that I am polite; okay, just take it.灯来了，好亮，是电石灯。有人喝住小老二：
“挂在那边得了，有臭气，先生闻不惯。”
The lamp is coming, so bright, it's a calcium carbide lamp. Someone drank the little two: "It's hung over there, it's stenchable, and you can't get used to it."我这才看见，这可不是我们三代单传，泥木两作的大师傅吗！久违了。刚才我似乎觉得角落上有人伏在桌上打瞌睡，黑影中看不清，他是甚么时候梦回莺转的醒来了？好极了，这个时候有人聊聊再好没有。他过来，我过去；我掏烟，他摸火柴，但是他火柴划着了时我不俯首去点烟；小老二灯挂在柱子上，灯光照出，墙上也有画！我搁下他，尽顾看画了。走到墙前，我自己点了烟。
Only then did I see that this is not our master of three generations of single heirloom and mud and wood! Long time no see. Just now I seemed to feel that someone in the corner was dozing off on the table, and I couldn't see clearly in the dark shadow, when did he wake up from a dream? Great, is it good for someone to talk about at this time? He came over, I went over; I took out a cigarette, he touched the match, but I didn't bow my head to light a cigarette when he drew the match; the little second lamp was hung on the pillar, the light was shining, and there were paintings on the wall! I put him down and looked at the paintings. When I walked to the wall, I lit a cigarette myself.一望而知与花坛后面的是同一手笔。画的仍是茶花，仍是墨线勾成，敷以朱黑赭绿，墙有三丈多长，高二丈许，满墙都是画，设计气魄大，笔画也更整饬。笔笔经过一番苦心，一番挣扎，多少割舍，一个决定；高度的自觉之下透出丰满的精力，纯澈的情欲；克己节制中成就了高贵的浪漫情趣，各部份安排得对极了，妥贴极了。干净，相当简单，但不缺少深度，真不容易，不说别的，四尺长的一条线从头到底在一个力量上，不踟躇，不衰竭！如果刚才花坛后面的还有稿样的意思，深浅出入多少有可以商量地方，这一幅则作者已做到至矣尽矣地步。他一边洗手，一边依依的看一看，又看一看自己作品，大概还几度把湿的手在衣服上随便那里擦一擦，拉起笔又过去描那么两下的，但那都只是细节，极不重要，是作者舍不得离开自己作品的表示而已，他此时“提刀却立，踌躇满志，”得意达于极点，真正是“虽南面王不与易也”。这点得意与这点不舍，是他下次作画的本钱。不信试再粉白一堵墙壁，他准立刻又会欣然命笔。他余勇可贾，灵感有余。但是一洗完手，他这才感到可真有点累了。他身体各部份松下来，由一个艺术家变为一个常人，好适宜普通生活，好休息。好老板，给他泡的茶在那里？他最好吃一点甜甜的，厚厚的，一咬满口的，软软的点心，像吉庆祥的重油蛋糕即很好。
At a glance, it is the same handwriting as behind the flower bed. The painting is still a camellia, still drawn by ink lines, applied with vermilion and ochre, the wall is more than three feet long, about two feet high, the wall is full of paintings, the design is bold, and the strokes are more neat. After a lot of painstaking work, some struggle, how many lets go, a decision; a high degree of consciousness reveals full energy and pure lust; in self-denial and self-restraint has achieved noble romantic interest, and all parts are arranged correctly and appropriately. Clean, quite simple, but not lacking depth, it's really not easy, not to mention anything else, a four-foot-long line from beginning to end in a strength, no hesitation, no exhaustion! If there is still the meaning of the manuscript behind the flower bed just now, and the depth and depth are more or less negotiable, this one has reached the point where the author has reached the end. While washing his hands, he looked at it reluctantly, and then looked at his work, and probably wiped his wet hands on his clothes a few times, pulled up the pen and went over to draw it twice, but those were just details, extremely unimportant, it was just a sign that the author was reluctant to leave his work. This pride and reluctance are the capital of his next painting. If you don't believe it, try to paint a wall again, and he will be happy to write again. He is brave and inspired. But as soon as he finished washing his hands, he felt really tired. All parts of his body loosened, and he changed from an artist to an ordinary person, so that he could live an ordinary life and rest. Good boss, where is the tea he made? He had better eat a little sweet, thick, bite-filled, soft snack, like auspicious heavy oil cake.Ladies and gentlemen，来！大家一齐来，为我们的艺术家欢呼，为艺术的产生欢呼！
Ladies and gentlemen, come on! Come together, cheer for our artists, cheer for the creation of art!我站着看，看了半天，我已经抽了三枝烟，而到第四根烟掏出来，叼上，点着时，我知道我身后站着的茶馆老板，木匠师傅，甚至小老二，会告诉我许多事，我把茶杯端到当中一张桌子上，请他们说。
I stood and watched, and after watching for a long time, I had already smoked three cigarettes, and when the fourth cigarette was taken out, picked up, and lit, I knew that the teahouse owner, the carpenter, and even the second child standing behind me would tell me many things, and I brought the teacup to one of the tables and asked them to speak.（啊，怎么半天不见一个人来喝茶？）
(Ah, why didn't I see a person come to drink tea for a long time?) ）茶馆老板一望而知是个阅历极深之人。他眼睛很黑，额上皱纹深，平，一丝不乱，唇上一抹整整齐齐的浓八字胡子，他声音深沉，而清亮，说得很慢，很有条理，有时为从记忆中汲取真切的印象，左眼皮常常搭一点下来，手频频抚摸下巴，——手上一个羊脂玉扳指。我两手搁在茶碗盖上，头落在手上，听他娓娓而说。
The owner of the teahouse can tell at a glance that he is a person with deep experience. His eyes are very dark, the wrinkles on his forehead are deep, flat, and unmessy, and his lips are a neat and tidy thick mustache, his voice is deep and clear, he speaks very slowly, very organized, and sometimes in order to draw a real impression from memory, his left eyelid often falls a little, and his hand frequently strokes his chin,—— and he has a mutton fat jade finger on his hand. I rested my hands on the lid of the teacup, my head rested on my hands, and listened to him talk.这是村子里一个哑巴画的。这个人出身农家，那不知为甚么的，自小就爱画，别的孩子捉田鸡，烧蚱蜢吃，他画画；别的孩子上树掏鸟蛋，下河摸螺蛳，他画画；人抽陀螺，放风筝，他画画；黄昏时候大家捉迷藏，他画画；别人干别的，他画画，有人教过他么？——没有。他简直没有见过一个人画之前自己就已经开始能把看到的东西留个样子下来了，他见甚么，画甚么；有甚么，在甚么上画，平常倒也一样，小时能吃饭，大了学种田，一画画，他就痴了：乡下人见得少，却并不大惊小怪，他爱画，随他画去吧。他是个哑子，不能唱花灯，歪连厢，画正好让他松松，乐乐。大家见他画得不比城里摆摊子画花样的老太太画得差，就有人拿鞋面，拿枕头帐簷之类东西让他画。一到有人家娶媳妇嫁女儿，他都要忙好几天。那个时候村子里姑娘人人心中搁着这个哑巴。
This was painted by a mute in the village. This man was born in a peasant family, and for some reason, he loved to paint since he was a child, other children caught frogs, roasted grasshoppers to eat, he painted; other children went up to trees to dig out bird eggs, went down to the river to touch snails, he painted; people smoked spinning tops, flew kites, he painted; at dusk, everyone played hide and seek, he painted; others did other things, he painted, did anyone teach him? ——Nope. He had never seen a person who had already begun to leave a picture of what he saw before painting, what he saw, what he painted; What is it, what to paint on, usually the same, he can eat when he is young, and when he grows up, he learns to farm, and when he paints, he is crazy: country people see little, but they don't make a fuss, he loves to paint, let him paint. He is a mute, he can't sing lanterns, crooked and connected, and painting just makes him relaxed and happy. Everyone saw that he painted no worse than the old lady who set up a stall in the city to draw patterns, so someone took shoe uppers, pillows, curtains, and other things for him to draw. When someone marries a daughter-in-law, he has to be busy for several days. At that time, everyone in the village had this mute in their hearts.“我出过门，南北东西也走过数省，见过些古城旧峰，大庙深山，帝王宫殿，我真真假假见过一点画，我一懂不懂，我喜欢看。我看哑巴画的跟画花样的老婆子的不一样，倒跟那些古画有些地方相同。我说不出来，……”
"I have been out, I have traveled through several provinces in the north, south, east, west, and west, and I have seen some ancient cities and old peaks, large temples and deep mountains, imperial palaces, I have seen a little painting, I don't understand, I like to look at it. I see that the mute paintings are different from those of the old woman who paints patterns, but they are the same in some places as those ancient paintings. I can't tell,......"老板逐字逐句的说，越慢，越沉。我连连点头，我试体会老板要说而迟疑着的意思：
“比如说，他画得‘活’，画里有一种东西，一种说不出来的东西，看久了，人会想，想哭？”
The boss said word by word, the slower, the heavier it is. I nodded repeatedly, and I tried to understand what the boss was hesitating to say: "For example, he paints 'alive', there is something in the painting, something that cannot be said, after watching it for a long time, people will think and cry?"老板点头，点得很郑重其事。我看到老板眼中有一点湿意。
The boss nodded and nodded very solemnly. I saw a little wetness in the boss's eyes.“从前他没事常来我这里坐坐，我早就有意思请他给我画点东西。他让我买了几样颜色，说画就画。外头那个画得快。里头这张画了好些时候。他老是对着墙端详，端详，比来比去的比，这么比那么比。……”
"In the past, he often came to me to sit and sit when he had nothing to do, and I was already interested in asking him to paint something for me. He asked me to buy a few colors and paint them as soon as I said they would. The one outside painted fast. This one inside has been painted for a long time. He always looked at the wall, looked at it, compared it back and forth, and compared it so much. ……”老板的话似乎想到此为止了。他坐了坐，大拇指摸他的扳指，摸来，摸去，眼睛看在扳指上，眉头锁了一点起来。水开了，漫出壶外，嗤嗤的响。老板起来，为我提水来冲，并通了通炉子。我对着墙，细起眼睛看，似乎墙已没有了，消失了：剩下画，画凸出来，凌空而在。水冲好了，我喝了一口茶，好酽，我问：
The boss's words seemed to end there. He sat down, touched his finger with his thumb, touched it, touched it, his eyes looked at the finger, and his brows locked a little. The water turned on and overflowed out of the pot, snorting. The boss got up, brought water for me, and turned on the stove. I looked at the wall, squinting my eyes, and it seemed that the wall was gone, disappearing: the painting remained, the painting protruded, and it was in the air. The water was washed, I took a sip of tea, it was so good, I asked:“现在？——”
老板知道我问甚么，水壶往桌上一顿：
“唉，死了还不到半年。”
"Now? ——” The boss knew what I was asking, and put the kettle on the table: "Alas, it's been less than half a year since he died."我不知如何接下去说了，而木匠忽然呵呵大笑起来，笑得上气不接下气，我愕然。他说出来，他笑的是哑巴喜欢看戏，看起怪有味。他以为听又听不见，红脸杀黑脸，看个甚么！
I didn't know how to continue, but the carpenter suddenly burst into laughter, laughing out of breath, and I was stunned. He said that he was laughing at a dumb man who liked to watch plays, and it looked weird. He thought he could hear but couldn't hear, and the red face killed the black face, what to see!灯光太亮，我还是挪近窗口坐坐。窗外已经全黑了，星星在天上。水草气更浓郁，竹声箫箫。水流，静静的流，流过桥桩，旋出一个一个小涡，转一转，顺流而下。我该回去了，我看见我所住的小楼上已有灯光，有人在等我。
The light was too bright, so I moved closer to the window and sat down. It was already dark outside the window, and the stars were in the sky. The smell of water and grass was more intense, and the sound of bamboo was flute. The water flowed, quietly flowing past the bridge piles, swirling out small vortices, turning around, and flowing down the river. I should go back, and I saw that there were lights on the small building where I lived, and someone was waiting for me.散步回来之后，我一直坐在这里，坐在这张临窗的藤椅里。早晨在一瓣一瓣的开放。露水在远处的草上濛濛的白，近处的晶莹透澈，空气鲜嫩，发香，好时间，无一点宿气，未遭败坏的时间，不显陈旧的时间。我一直坐在这里，坐在小楼的窗前。树林，小河，蔷薇色的云朵，路上行人轻捷的脚步，……一切很美，很美，我眼角有一滴泪。
After returning from a walk, I have been sitting here, sitting in this wicker chair by the window. The morning is opening one petal after another. The dew is hazy white on the grass in the distance, the near is crystal clear, the air is tender, fragrant, good time, there is no lingering smell, the time that has not been spoiled, and the time that does not look old. I have been sitting here, sitting in front of the window of the small building. Trees, rivers, rose-colored clouds, and the brisk footsteps of pedestrians on the road,...... Everything is beautiful, beautiful, and there is a tear in the corner of my eye.一清早，天才亮，我在庙前河边散步，一个汉子挑了两桶泔水跟我擦身而过，七成新的泔水桶周围画了一带极其细密缠绵的串枝莲，笔笔如同乌金嵌出的。
Early in the morning, when it was dawn, I was walking by the river in front of the temple, and a man picked up two buckets of swill and brushed past me, and 70% of the new swill buckets were painted around a stretch of extremely fine and lingering lotus, and the pen was like black gold.我坐了很久，很久。我随便拿起一本书，翻，翻，摊在我面前的是龚定庵的《记王隐君》：
于外王父段先生废簏中见一诗，不能忘。于西湖僧经箱中见书《心经》，蠹且半，如遇簏中诗，益不能忘。
I sat for a long time, for a long time. I casually picked up a book, flipped through it, flipped through it, and spread it in front of me was Gong Ding'an's "Remembering Wang Yinjun": I saw a poem in the abandoned basket of Mr. Duan, the father of the king, and I couldn't forget it. I saw the book "Heart Sutra" in the West Lake monk's scripture box, and it was half wormy, and if I encountered a poem in the box, I couldn't forget it.

Donkey[1]驴浅浅的青灰色，（我要称那种颜色为“驴色”！）背脊一抹黑，渐细成一条线，拖到尾根，眼皮鼻子白粉粉的。非常的像个驴，一点都不非驴非马。一个多么可笑而淘气的畜生！仿佛它娘生它一个就不再生似的，一付自以为是的独儿子脾气。
The donkey is light blue-gray, (I want to call that color "donkey color"!) The back is black, tapering into a line, dragging to the base of the tail, and the eyelids and nose are white and pink. It looks very much like a donkey, neither a donkey nor a horse at all. What a ridiculous and mischievous beast! It was as if its mother would never grow again, and it was a self-righteous only son's temper.一下套，它叱一口豆子，挨了顾老板一铜勺把子，（顾老板正舀豆花做干子，）偏着脑袋，一溜烟奔过了那条巷子，跳过大阴沟，来了，奔过来，还没有站定，就势儿即往地上一摔，翻身。这块地教它的驴皮磨得又光又滑了。（若是这里须一地名，可就本地风光名之为“驴打滚”。）翻，——翻不过；翻，——再来一个，好嘛，喔唷喔唷，这一下，——过瘾！我家老王说，驴子不睡觉，站一站就行了；挨了半天磨，累得王八蛋似的，也只须翻一个身即浑身通泰。我相信他。因此，看它翻不过，为之着急，好像我的腰眼里也酸溜溜的了。幸而它每次都一定翻得过的。滚完了，饮水，吃草，丁零当郎摇它的耳朵，忒尔噜噜打喷嚏。——这东西把两个招风耳那么摆来摆去的干甚么呢？世界上有没有一个蜜蜂曾经冒冒失失撞到一个驴耳朵里去过？小时候我老这么想，现在也还对此极有兴趣。唔，唔，唔！它把个软软的鼻子皱两皱，（多不雅观！）忽然惊天动地的呜哇呜哇大叫起来，问老王它干甚么叫，老王说“闻到驴奶奶气味了，好不要脸的东西！”说时神情好像有看不起它。我于是不好意思看看它自身挂下来的玩艺。晋人多奇怪嗜癖，好驴鸣其一也，有以善作驴鸣得大名者，甚至到新死的朋友坟上去，“鸣”，真是非常的玄了！驴它稳稳重重的时候不是没有，但发神经病时候很多，常常本来规规矩矩，潇潇洒洒的散着步，忽然中了邪似的，脖子一缩，伸开四蹄飞奔，跑过来又跑过去；跑过去，又跑过来。看它跑，最好是俯卧在地上，眼光与地平线齐，驴在蓝天白云草紫芦花之间飞，美极了。跑也听你跑去，没有人管你，侉奶奶细着眼睛看得很有趣呢，可你别去嚼人家种在那儿的豆子，那你就有罪受的！大和二和六丁六甲似的追过来，（你跑！个杂——种！）一把捞住绳头子，拴到那棵踞满了毛毛虫的瘦骨伶仃的榆树上去了。顾家也是，为甚么把绳子弄得那么长呢？散着，它要一脚一脚的，它会一圈一圈的绕着树转，（生成牵磨的命！）转到后来，摸不着来路了，于是把个驴子头吊了起来，上下不得，干瞪两眼，两眼翻白，斜睃着自己尾毛拂动。牛虻虻，麻苍蝇都来了。这就只有两条后腿还可以活动活动，方不致因为老站着而酥麻。腿膝里是两个黑疤疤就极其显眼的露了出来。老王说这是驴子的夜眼。驴子夜里能作事，瞎眼驴子一样骑，全靠这两个膏药心似的东西。然而他又说驴子生小毛病不吃药，用个小槌子在那里敲两下；重病也只须戳一勾被针，放出点紫血就行了。这就不对了：既是眼睛，则不能敲，不能戳。然而这到底是个甚么东西？很想去摸摸这个甲虫壳似的黑疤，用指头弹弹必会叭叭的响的。还是先把它解下来吧，它腿上肉一牵一牵的跳，筋都涨起来了。——这畜生真不知好歹！狗咬吕洞宾，驴要踢我。我不知搭救了它多少次了。
As soon as it was set, it took a bite of beans and was hit by Boss Gu's copper spoon, (Boss Gu was scooping tofu pudding to make dried rice,) tilted his head, ran through the alley, jumped over the big gutter, came, ran over, and before he could stand still, he immediately fell to the ground and turned over. This piece of land taught its donkey skin to be smooth and slippery. (If you need a place name here, you can call it "donkey rolling" based on the local scenery.) ,—— can't turn over; turn over ,—— another one, okay, oh oh, this time it's ,—— enjoyable! My old Wang said that the donkey doesn't sleep, just stand for a while; After being grinded for a long time, I was so tired that I was like a bastard, and I only had to turn over one to get my whole body smooth. I believe in him. Therefore, I can't see it over, and I'm anxious about it, as if my waist and eyes are also sore. Fortunately, it will definitely be able to turn over every time. After rolling, drinking water, eating grass, Ding Ling shook its ears and sneezed. ——What is this thing doing with two wind ears swinging around like this? Has there ever been a bee in the world that has ever taken the liberty of bumping into a donkey's ear? I always thought about it when I was a child, and I am still very interested in it. Hmm, hmm, hmm! It wrinkled its soft nose in two, (how unsightly!) Suddenly screamed earth-shatteringly, and asked Lao Wang what it was calling, Lao Wang said, "I smell the smell of grandma the donkey, what a shameless thing!" When he said that, he looked down on it. I was embarrassed to look at the play it hung up. The Jin people have a lot of strange habits, good donkeys are one of them, and there are people who are famous for being good at making donkeys, and even go to the graves of their recently deceased friends, "Ming", which is really very mysterious! The donkey is not without it when it is stable and heavy, but there are many times when it is crazy, often it is well-behaved, dashing and dashing, and suddenly it is like being struck by evil, its neck shrank, it stretched its four hooves and ran, running over and over; running over and running over. Watching it run, it is best to lie on the ground, with eyes at the horizon, and the donkey flying between the blue sky and white clouds and purple reeds, which is beautiful. Run and listen to you, no one cares about you, Grandma Neung looks very interesting with her squinting eyes, but don't chew the beans planted there, then you will be guilty! Yamato Er and Liu Ding Liujia chased after them like (You run! A miscellaneous - seed!) He grabbed the rope and tied it to the skinny elm tree full of caterpillars. The Gu family is too, why did they make the rope so long? It will go around the tree in circles, (generating the life of pulling!) When I turned to the back, I couldn't find the way out, so I hung up a donkey's head, couldn't go up and down, stared dryly, rolled my eyes, and squinted at my tail hair. Gadflies and hemp flies are coming. This means that only two hind legs can still move, so as not to be numb because of standing all the time. There are two black scars in the legs and knees, which are extremely conspicuous. Lao Wang said this is the donkey's night eye. Donkeys can do things at night, and they ride like blind donkeys, all relying on these two plaster-like things. However, he also said that donkeys do not take medicine when they have minor problems, and use a small mallet to knock there twice; even if you are seriously ill, you only need to poke a hook and a needle and release some purple blood. This is not right: since it is an eye, it cannot be knocked or poked. But what is this? I really want to touch this black scar like a beetle shell, and it will make a beeping sound when I flick it with my fingers. Let's take it off first, the flesh on its legs jumped and the tendons swelled. ——This beast really doesn't know what to do! The dog bit Lu Dongbin, and the donkey wanted to kick me. I don't know how many times I rescued it.而且家里一吃粽子，我即把箬叶跟小莲一齐来送给它吃，驴特别爱这东西。小莲告诉我，须仔细捡去裹粽子的麻丝，说吃下去要缠住肚肠子。我不信，（当然不通，难道会吃到肠子外头去吗？）小莲说“骗你干甚么！大和说的，不信你去问。”我才不问，捡去就是了！小莲一片一片的送在它的嘴里，看它吃。小莲喜欢这驴，她日后将忘不了这驴。小莲你嫁给大和得了，嫁过去整天用箬叶喂驴！我心里想，不敢说出来，我怕小莲哭。我看小莲，小莲一条辫子，越来越长了。我说：
And as soon as the family eats rice dumplings, I will give them to eat with Xiaolian, and the donkey loves this thing very much. Xiaolian told me that I had to carefully pick up the hemp threads wrapped in the rice dumplings, saying that if I ate it, it would entangle my stomach. I don't believe it, (of course not, will it eat outside the intestines?) Xiaolian said, "What are you lying to!" What Yamato said, if you don't believe it, ask. "I don't ask, just pick it up! Xiaolian put it in its mouth one by one and watched it eat. Xiaolian likes this donkey, and she will never forget this donkey in the future. Xiaolian, you can marry Yamato, marry and feed the donkey with bamboo leaves all day long! I thought to myself, I didn't dare to say it, I was afraid that Xiaolian would cry. I looked at Xiaolian, Xiaolian had a braid, and it was getting longer and longer. I say:“小莲，我给它吃。”
小莲把盛箬叶的柳条畚箕给我。我想驴一定更愿意我喂。一片一片的，着急死了，我一次就是五六片，塞得它满嘴都是。而远远的叫过来了：
“那是我家的驴，踢了你我不管！”
"Xiaolian, I'll give it to eat." Xiaolian gave me a wicker dustpan filled with bamboo leaves. I think the donkey must be more willing for me to feed. One by one, I died in a hurry, I made five or six pieces at a time, stuffing it all over my mouth. And called from afar: "That's my donkey, I don't care if I kick you!"“哎唷哎唷，甚么宝贝驴！快来看看，只有一只耳朵了！”
这是老王说的。老王总是帮着我。老王来了，老王来挑水，我们一齐看过去，老王，我，小莲，为老王的话逗笑了的侉奶奶——
"Ouch, what a precious donkey! Come and take a look, there is only one ear! ” This is what Lao Wang said. Lao Wang always helps me. Lao Wang came, Lao Wang came to carry water, we looked over together, Lao Wang, I, Xiao Lian, the grandmother who laughed at Lao Wang's words -那边大喜鹊巢的老柳树上呢，大和跟二和。
大和二和每天下午到这里来。老王一见他们总要说：
“怎么着，又来放驴了？”
On the old willow tree of the big magpie's nest over there, Yamato and Erhe. Yamato Erhe came here every afternoon. When Lao Wang saw them, he always said: "What's wrong, are you releasing the donkey again?"这是淘笑他们的话。只有放牛放羊叫“放”的，驴不能叫“放”。然而该怎么说呢？“看驴”，怕也没有这么说的。老王另有个说法，“陪驴”，这其实最对。他们实在是跟在驴后面也一溜烟跑出来玩玩而已。驴子比他们哥儿俩都懂事些，倒像顾大娘把儿子交给驴，驴子带头，领着他们到荒野里来一样。这时候他们累了半夜，一早上的爸爸要睡一会，他们在家一定闹得不得安生！
This is laughing at them. Only cattle and sheep are called "release", and donkeys cannot be called "release". But what should I say? "Look at the donkey", I'm afraid it doesn't say that. Lao Wang has another saying, "accompany the donkey", which is actually the most correct. They really just ran out to play after the donkey. The donkey is more sensible than both of their brothers, just like Aunt Gu handed over her son to the donkey, and the donkey took the lead and led them into the wilderness. At this time, they were tired in the middle of the night, and their father had to sleep for a while in the morning, and they must have a bad time at home!

职业（外一篇） 

职业（外一篇） [1]
一 职业
[1] This article was originally published in the "Jingshi Daily" on June 15, 1947. Occupation (Outside Article) {{id_0000}} 1. Occupation巷子里常有卖“椒盐饼子西洋糕”的走过。所卖皆平常食物，除了油条大饼豆菜包子之外便是那种椒盐饼子跟西洋糕。椒盐饼子是马蹄形面饼，弓处微厚，平处削薄，烘得软软的，因有椒盐，颜色淡黄如秋天的银杏叶子。西洋糕是一种菱形发面方糕，松松的，厚可寸许，当中夹两层薄薄的红糖浆。穿了洁白大布衣裳，抽了几袋糯米香金堂叶子烟，泛览周王传，流观山海图，到日影很明显的偏了西，有点微饿了，沏新茶一碗，买那么两块来慢慢的嚼，大概可以尝出其中的香美；否则味道是很平淡的。老太太常买了来哄好哭作闹的孩子，因为还大，而且在她们以为比吃糖豆杂食要“养人”些。车夫苦力们吃它则不过为了充饥罢了。糕饼和那种叫卖声音都是昆明僻静里巷间所特有。虽然不知道为甚么叫作“西洋糕”，或者正因为叫“西洋糕”吧，总使人觉得其“古”，跟这个已经在它上面建立出许多新事物来的老城极相谐合。早晨或黄昏，你听他们叫：
There are often people selling "pretzels and Western cakes" in the alleys. All the food sold is ordinary food, except for fried dough sticks, flatbreads, bean and vegetable buns, there are those pretzels and cakes. Pretzels are horseshoe-shaped dough cakes, slightly thick at the bow, thin at the flat point, baked soft, because of the salt and pepper, the color is pale yellow like autumn ginkgo biloba leaves. Western cake is a diamond-shaped hair noodle square cake, loose, about an inch thick, with two thin layers of brown sugar syrup in it. Wearing white cloth clothes, smoking a few bags of glutinous rice fragrant Jintang leaf tobacco, looking at the biography of the King of Zhou, looking at the mountains and seas, to the shadow of the sun is obviously to the west, a little hungry, make a bowl of new tea, buy so two pieces to chew slowly, you can probably taste the fragrance; Otherwise, the taste is very bland. The old lady often bought it to coax the crying children, because they were still old, and they thought it was more "nourishing" than eating jelly beans and omnivorous. The coachmen and coolies ate it just to satisfy their hunger. Cakes and the sound of selling are unique to the secluded alleys of Kunming. Although I don't know why it is called "Western cake", or just because it is called "Western cake", it always makes people feel that it is "ancient", and it is very much in harmony with this old city that has built many new things on it. In the morning or at dusk, you hear them call:“椒盐饼——子西洋糕……”
若是谱出来，其音调是：
so so la——la so mi rai
"Pretzels - Sub-Western Cakes......" If it is composed, its tone is: so so la——la so mi rai这跟那种“有旧衣烂衫抓来卖”同为古城悲哀的歌唱之最具表情者。收旧衣烂衫的是女人多，嗓音多尖脆高拔。卖椒盐饼子西洋糕的常为老人及小孩。老人声音苍沉，孩子稚嫩游转，（因为巷子深，人少，回声大，不必因拼命狂叫，以致嘶嘎，）在广大的沉寂与远细的市声之上升起，搅带出许多东西，闪一闪，又溅落下来。偶然也有年青青的小伙子挎一个竹篮叫卖，令人觉得可惜，谁都不会以为这是一个理想的职业的。他们多把“椒”念成“皆”，而“洋”字因为昆明话缺少真正的鼻音，听起来成了“牙”。“盐”读为“一”，“子”字常常吃了，只舌头微顶一顶，意思到了，“西洋”两字自然切成了一个音。所以留心了好一阵我才闹清楚他们叫的是甚么，知道了自然得意十分。——是谁第一个那么叫的？这几个字的唇齿开阖（特别是在昆明话里）配搭得恰到好处，听起来悲哀，悲哀之中有时又每透出一种谐趣。（这两样感情原是极相邻近的。）孩子们为之感动，极爱效学。有时一高兴就唱成了：
This is the most expressive song of the sad song of the ancient city as "there are old clothes and ragtened clothes to sell". There are many women who collect old clothes and rags, and their voices are sharp and high. The sellers of pretzels and Western cakes are often the elderly and children. The old man's voice is pale, and the children are immature and wandering, (because the alley is deep, there are few people, and the echo is loud, so there is no need to scream desperately and hissing,) in the vast silence and the rise of the distant sound of the city, stirring up many things, flashing and splashing down. Occasionally, there are young men carrying a bamboo basket to sell, which is a pity, no one will think that this is an ideal profession. They mostly pronounce "pepper" as "all", and the word "foreign" sounds like "tooth" because of the lack of real nasal sound in Kunming dialect. "Salt" is pronounced as "one", and the word "zi" is often eaten, only the tongue is slightly pushed up, and the meaning is reached, and the word "Western" is naturally cut into one sound. So I paid attention for a while before I made a clear idea of what they were calling, and I was naturally very proud to know it. ——Who was the first to call it that? The lips and teeth of these words (especially in Kunming dialect) are just right, sounding sad, and sometimes there is a kind of humor in the sadness. (These two feelings are originally very close.) The children were moved by it and loved to learn from it. Sometimes it is sung as soon as it is happy:“捏着鼻——子吹洋号！”
一定有孩子小时学叫，稍大当真就作此生涯了的。
"Pinch your nose - blow the foreign trumpet!" There must be children who learn to call when they are young, and they will do this career when they are a little older.老在我们巷子里叫卖的一个孩子，我已见他往来卖了几年，眼看着大起来了。他举动之间已经涂抹了许多人生经验。一望而知，不那么傻，不那么怯了，头上常涂油，学会在耳后夹一枝香烟，而且不再怕那些狗。他逐渐调皮刁恶，极会幸灾乐祸的说风凉话，捉弄乡下人，欺侮瞎子。可是，他还是不得不卖他的椒盐饼子西洋糕！声音可多少改变了一点，你可以听得出一点嘲讽，委屈，疲倦，或者还有寂寞，种种说不清，混在一起的东西。
A child who used to sell in our alley, I have seen him sell for several years, and he has grown up. He has smeared a lot of life experience between his actions. At a glance, he is not so stupid, less timid, often oiled on his head, learns to hold a cigarette behind his ear, and is no longer afraid of those dogs. He gradually became naughty and mischievous, and was very good at gloating, teasing country people, and bullying blind people. However, he still had to sell his pretzels and Western cakes! The voice has changed a little, and you can hear a little mockery, grievances, tiredness, or loneliness, all kinds of indescribable things mixed together.有一天，我在门前等一个人来，他来了。也许他今天得到休息，（大姨妈家老二接亲啦，帮老板去摇一会啦，反正这一类的喜事，）也许他竟已得到机会，改了行业，（不顶像，）他这会儿显然完全从职业中解放出来。你从他身上看出一个假期，一个自在之身。没有竹篮，而且新草鞋上红带子红得真鲜。他潇潇洒洒的走过去，轻松的脚步，令人一下子想起这是四月中的好天气。而，这小子！走近巷尾时他饱满充和的吆喝了一声：
One day, I was waiting for someone to come to the door, and he came. Maybe he got a rest today, (the second child of my aunt's family picked up the relatives, helped the boss shake for a while, anyway, this kind of happy event,), maybe he had actually gotten the opportunity to change his profession, (not like that,) he was obviously completely liberated from his profession at this time. You can see a holiday in him, a free body. There is no bamboo basket, and the red straps on the new straw sandals are so bright red. He walked over in a dashing manner, and his relaxed steps suddenly reminded people that it was a good weather in April. And, this kid! As he approached the end of the alley, he shouted full and full:“椒盐饼——子西洋糕。”
听自己声音像从一团线上抽一段似的抽出来，又轻轻的来了一句：
“捏着鼻——子吹洋号……”
二 年红灯
"Pretzels - sub-Western cakes." Listening to his voice pull out of a piece of thread, he said softly: "Pinch your nose - blow the foreign trumpet......" Two years of red light走出室门，总要抬头看看。为甚么要看看呢，看甚么？——不知道。也许是想看看天。下意识的习惯，我曾在一个地方住过，天蓝起来非常的蓝；有时却多雨，阴晴不定。然而看到的却是马路对面高楼屋顶上一个铁架子，广告铁架子。这东西，无话可说，很伟大！竖那么个架子的工程可以盖好几间屋子了吧。架子上几个大字，每个字比一间屋子还大。最近，天天有人搭了长梯子在上面工作。人在上头那么小，看他们在上头动，好像动得也很慢，很轻微。仿佛完全不是普普通通像我们一样的人，因为比例不对。知道，他们是在油漆那几个字。而且，这两天在装年红灯了。——是谁想起来装的？我坐在椅子里也可以看见，很高兴一抬头看见他们都在那里。有时还可以看见他们抽烟，谈话。我坐在椅子里抽烟，或喝着一杯茶，当手里工作告了一段落，常悠然而自窗口看出去。
When you walk out of the room, you always have to look up. Why do you want to look at it, what do you see? ——I don't know. Maybe I want to see the sky. Subconsciously, I once lived in a place where the sky was very blue; sometimes it was rainy and cloudy. However, what I saw was an iron shelf on the roof of a high-rise building across the road, an advertising iron shelf. This thing has nothing to say, it's great! The project to erect such a shelf can build several rooms. There are a few big characters on the shelf, each bigger than a room. Recently, people have built long ladders to work on it every day. People are so small on top, and when you see them moving on them, they seem to be moving very slowly and slightly. It seems that they are not ordinary people like us at all, because the proportions are wrong. I know they are painting those words. Moreover, they have been pretending to be red lights for the past two days. ——Who thought of pretending? I can see it when I sit in my chair, and I am happy to see them all there when I look up. Sometimes I can see them smoking and talking. I sit in my chair and smoke, or drink a cup of tea, and when the work at hand is over, I often look out the window leisurely.一天晚上，亮了，那些年红灯亮了。红光蓝光交递转换。先是小字，一个一个出来，一排，现齐了，于是划然而显出几个大字，又抹掉似的一齐消失；接着又从头来一遍。红光蓝光交递的落在我阶前，屋顶，我的书，我的纸，我的手指头上。
One night, it was lit, and the red light was on in those years. Red light and blue light conversion. First, the small characters came out one by one, lined up, and were now all there, so a few big characters appeared, and then disappeared all together as if erased; and then started over again. The red and blue lights fell on my steps, on the roof, on my books, on my paper, and on my fingers.这几个工人他们一定也看见了。他们一定看的。
They must have seen these workers. They must have seen it.而，我在马路上看见一个人，他看广告上那些灯。从他看的样子上，我毫不怀疑的相信他即是那些工人之一，白天他还在那个架子上工作的，那是他的作品。我看了他好一会。——他心里的是甚么感觉？
And I saw a man on the road, who looked at the lights on the advertisements. From the way he looked, I had no doubt that he was one of those workers, and that he was still working on that shelf during the day, and that was his work. I looked at him for a while. What did he feel?三十六年六月中
In mid-June of the thirty-sixth year

落魄

落魄[1]
Downfall [1]他为甚么要到“内地”来？不大可解，也没有人问过他。自然，你现在要是问我为甚么大远的跑到昆明过那么几年，我也答不上来。从前很说过一番大道理，经过一个时间，知道半是虚妄，不过就是那么股子冲动，年纪轻，总希望向远处跑；而且也是事实，我要读书，学校都往里搬了；大势所趋，顺着潮流一带，就把我带过了千山万水。总是偶然，我不强说我的行为是我的思想决定的。实在我那时也说不上有甚么思想。——我并没有说现在就有。这个人呢？似乎他的身边不会有甚么偶然，那个潮流不大可能波及到他。我很知道，我们那一带，就是像我这样的年纪也多还是安土重迁的。在家千日好，出外一时难，小时候我们听老人戒说行旅的艰险决不少于“万恶的社会”的时候。他近四十边上的人了，又是“做店”的。做店人跑上五七个县份照例就是了不起的老江湖，关于各地茶馆，浴室，窑姐儿，镇水铜牛，大火烧了的庙，就够他们向人聊一辈子；这种人见过世面，已经有资格称为百事通，为人出意见，拿主意，凡事皆有他一份，社会地位极高，再也不必跑到左不过是那样的生疏地方去。他还当真走上好几千里干甚么？好马不吃窝边草，憋了甚么气，要到个亲旧耳目不及的地方来创一番事业，等将来衣锦荣归，好向家里妻子说一声“我总算对得起你们”么？看他不像是那种咬牙发狠的人，他走路说话全表示他是个慢性子，是女人们称之为“三棍子打不出个闷屁来”的角色。再说，又何必用这么远，千里之内尽可以作个跨海征东薛仁贵，楚国为官的秋胡了。也许是他受了危言耸听的宣传，觉得日本人一来，可怕到不可想象程度，或者是他遭了甚么大不幸或难为情事情，本土存身不得，恰好有个亲戚，到内地来作事，须要个能写字算账的身边人，机缘凑巧，无路可走之中他勃然打定了主意来“玩玩”了？也只是“也许”。——反正，他就是来了，而且做了完全另外一种人。
Why did he come to the "mainland"? It is not very understandable, and no one has ever asked him. Naturally, if you ask me now why I went so far to Kunming for so many years, I would not be able to answer. I used to say a lot of great truths, but after a while, I knew that it was half false, but I was so impulsive, young and always wanted to run far away; and it is also a fact, I want to study, and the school has moved in; the general trend, following the trend, has taken me through thousands of mountains and rivers. It is always accidental, and I do not insist that my behavior is determined by my thoughts. I really couldn't say anything at that time. ——I didn't say that there is now. What about this person? It seems that there will be no coincidence around him, and it is unlikely that the trend will affect him. I know very well that in our area, even people of my age are still relocated. When we were children, we heard the old man say that the hardships and dangers of travel are no less than when the "evil society". He is nearly forty people on the side, and he is a "shopkeeper" again. The shopkeepers ran to five or seven counties as usual are amazing old rivers and lakes, about teahouses, bathrooms, kiln sisters, copper cattle in the town, and temples burned by fire, it is enough for them to talk to people for a lifetime; This kind of person has seen the world, and he is already qualified to be called a jack-of-all-trades, giving opinions and making ideas, and he has a share in everything, and his social status is extremely high, and he no longer has to go to such an unfamiliar place. Why did he really walk thousands of miles to do it? A good horse doesn't eat the grass by the nest, what is it to hold back his anger, and he wants to go to a place that his relatives and friends can't see to start a career, and when he returns in the future, he can say to his wife at home, "I'm finally worthy of you"? Seeing that he doesn't look like the kind of person who grits his teeth and is ruthless, he walks and speaks all because he is a chronic child, and he is a role that women call "three sticks can't make a stuffy fart". Besides, why bother to go so far, within a thousand miles, you can be a cross-sea conquest of the east, Xue Rengui, and the Chu state is an official. Maybe he was subjected to alarmist propaganda and felt that the Japanese were unimaginably terrible when they came, or that he had suffered some great misfortune or embarrassment, and he couldn't survive in the country, and he happened to have a relative who came to the mainland to do things, and he needed someone around him who could write and settle accounts. It's just "maybe". ——Anyway, he just came, and he became a completely different kind of person.到我们认识他时，他开了个小吃食铺子，在我们学校附近。
By the time we met him, he had opened a snack shop near our school.初时，大家还带得三个月至半年的用度，而且不时还可接到汇款，生活标准比在家时低不太多，稍有借口，或谁过生，或失物复得，或接到一封字迹娟秀的信，或没有理由，大家“通过”一下，即可有人作东请客。在某个限度内还可挑一挑地方。有人说，开了个扬州馆子，那就怎么样也得巧立名目的去吃他一顿。
At the beginning, everyone still had three months to half a year's expenses, and from time to time they could also receive remittances, and the standard of living was not much lower than when they were at home, and there was a little excuse, or who lived, or lost and found, or received a letter with beautiful handwriting, or there was no reason, everyone "passed", and someone could treat them. You can also pick a place within a certain limit. Some people say that if you open a Yangzhou restaurant, you have to make a clever name to eat him.学校附近还像从前学校附近一样，开了许多小馆子。开馆子的多是外乡人。湖南的，江西的，山东的，河北的，一种同在天涯之感把老板伙计跟学生接连起来，而且他们本来直接间接的就与学校有相当关系，学生吃饭，老板伙计就坐在旁边谈天说地；而学生也喜欢到锅灶旁边站着，一边听新闻故事，一边欣赏炒菜艺术。——这位扬州人老板，一看即与别人不同，他穿了一身铁机纺绸褂裤在那儿炒菜！盘花纽子，纽绊里拖出一段银表链。雪白的细麻纱袜，一双浅口千层底直贡呢鞋。细细软软的头发向后梳得一丝不乱。左手无名指上还套了个韭叶指环。这一切在他周身那股子斯文劲儿上配合得恰到好处。除了他那点流利合拍的翻锅子动铲子的手法，他无处像个大师傅，像个吃这一行饭的。这比他的鸡丝雪里蕻，炒假螃蟹，过油肉更令我们发生兴趣。这个馆子不大，除了他自己只用了个本地孩子招呼客座，摆筷子倒茶。可是收拾得干干净净，木架子上还搁了两盆花。就是足球队员，跳高选手来，看了墙上菜单上那一笔成亲王体的字，也不便太嚣张放肆了。
There are also many small restaurants near the school, just like near the school in the past. Most of the people who open restaurants are foreigners. Hunan, Jiangxi, Shandong, Hebei, a sense of being at the end of the world connects the boss and the students, and they are directly or indirectly related to the school. And students also like to stand next to the stove, listen to the news stories, and enjoy the art of stir-frying. ——This Yangzhou boss, who is different from others at first glance, is wearing an iron machine-spun silk jacket and stir-frying there! Coiled buttons, dragging a piece of silver watch chain from the button. Snow-white fine linen gauze socks, a pair of shallow mille-feuille soled Zhigong woolen shoes. The thin and soft hair is combed back neatly. There is also a leek ring on the ring finger of his left hand. All of this is just right in terms of the refined energy around him. Except for his fluent technique of turning the pot and moving the shovel, he is nowhere to be like a master, like a person who eats this line of food. This is more interesting to us than his shredded chicken, fried fake crabs, and oily meat. This restaurant is not big, except that he only used a local child to greet the guests and set up chopsticks to pour tea. But it was cleaned up, and there were two pots of flowers on the wooden shelf. It was a football player, a high jumper, and looked at the words on the menu on the wall, which was not too arrogant and presumptuous.有时，过了热市，吃饭的只有几个人，菜都上了桌，他洗洗手，会捧了把细瓷茶壶出来，客气两句，“菜炒得不好，这里的酱油不行”，“黄芽菜教孩子切坏了，谁叫他切的！——红烧才能横切，炒，要切直丝的”。有时也谈谈时事，说点故乡消息，问问这里的名胜特产，声音低缓而有感情。我们已经喜欢去坐茶馆了，有时在茶馆也可以碰到他，独自看一张报纸或支颐眺望街上行人。他还给我们付了几回茶钱，请我们抽烟。他抽烟也是那么慢慢的，一口一口的吸，仿佛有无穷滋味。有时事完了，不喝茶，他去蹓跶，两手反背在后面，一种说不出悠徐闲散。出门少远，则穿了灰色熟罗长衫，还带了把湘妃竹折扇。想见从前他一定喜欢养养鸟，听听书，常上富春坐坐的。他自己说原在辕门桥一个大绸缎庄作事，看样子极像。然而怎么到这儿来开一个小饭馆的呢？这当中必有一段故事，他不往下说，我们也不好究问。
Sometimes, after the hot market, there are only a few people eating, and the dishes are on the table, he washes his hands, and he will hold a fine porcelain teapot and say politely, "The vegetables are not fried well, the soy sauce here is not good", "Yellow sprouts teach children to cut badly, who told him to cut them!" ——Braised can only be cut horizontally, stir-fried, and cut straight wires." Sometimes he also talks about current affairs, talks about hometown news, and asks about the famous places here, his voice is low and emotional. We already like to go to the teahouse, and sometimes we can meet him in the teahouse, reading a newspaper alone or looking at the pedestrians on the street. He also paid us for tea a few times and invited us to smoke. He smoked so slowly, sucking it one by one, as if it had an infinite taste. Sometimes when things are over, he doesn't drink tea, he goes to stagger, his hands behind his back, a kind of indescribable leisurely leisure. When he went out a little far, he wore a gray robe and brought a Xiangfei bamboo folding fan. I think he must have liked to raise birds, listen to books, and often go to Fuchun to sit. He himself said that he used to work in a large silk farm in Yuanmen Bridge, and it looked very similar. But how did you come here to open a small restaurant? There must be a story in this, and if he doesn't tell it, it's not easy for us to ask.馆子菜甚么菜都是一个滋味，家家一样，只有他那儿虽然品色不多，却莫不精致有特色。或偶尔兴发，还可以跟他商量商量，请他表演几个道地扬州菜，狮子头，芙蓉鲫鱼，叉子烧鸭，他必不惜工夫，做得跟家里请客一样，有几个菜据说在扬州本地都很少有人做得好。这位绸缎店“同事”大概平日在家极讲究吃食，学会了烹调，想不到自己竟改行作了饭师傅。这不免是降低了一级，我们去吃饭，总似乎有点歉意。也许他看得比较高一层，所以态度上从未使我们不安。他自己好像已不顶在乎了。生意好，有钱剩，也还高高兴兴的。果然半年下来，店门关了几天，贴出了条子：修理炉灶，休业数天。
Everything in the restaurant is the same taste, only he has not had many tastes, but they are all exquisite and distinctive. Or occasionally, if you are interested, you can also discuss with him and ask him to perform a few authentic Yangzhou dishes, lion's head, hibiscus crucian carp, and char roast duck, he will spare no effort to do it as well as treating guests at home, and there are several dishes that are said to be rarely done well in Yangzhou. This "colleague" of the silk shop probably pays great attention to food at home on weekdays, and learned to cook, but he didn't expect that he would change his career to become a chef. This is inevitably a lower level, and we always seem to be a little apologetic when we go to eat. Maybe he sees it higher, so his attitude has never made us uneasy. He doesn't seem to care anymore. The business is good, there is money left, and I am still happy. Sure enough, after half a year, the store door was closed for a few days, and a note was posted: repair the stove and close for a few days.新万年红硃笺招纸贴出来，一早上就川流不息的坐满了人。老板听从有人的建议，请了个南京师傅来做包子煮面，带卖早晚市了。我一去，学着扬州话，跟他道一声：
“恭喜恭喜”。
The new Wannian red red paper invitation paper was posted, and it was full of people in the morning. The boss followed someone's advice and invited a Nanjing Fu to make steamed buns and cook noodles, and sell them in the morning and evening markets. As soon as I went, I learned Yangzhou dialect and said to him: "Congratulations, congratulations".恭喜他扩充营业，同时我已经看到后面小天井里一个女人坐着拣菜，发髻上一朵双喜绒花。老板拱拱手：
“托福托福，闹着玩的。”
Congratulations on his expansion, and at the same time, I have seen a woman sitting in the small patio in the back to pick vegetables, with a double happy velvet flower on her bun. The boss arched his hands: "TOEFL TOEFL, just kidding."女人不知是谁给说的媒，好像是这条街上一个烟鬼的女儿，时常也看她蓬着头出来买香油腌菜蚊烟香，脸色黄巴巴的，样子平平常常。可是因为年纪还不顶大，拢光了头发，搽了雪花膏，还敷了点胭脂，就像是完全换了一个人，以前没的好处全露了出来。老板看样子很喜欢，不时回头，走过去低低说几句话，让她偏了头，为拈去一片草屑尘丝，他那个手势就比一首情诗还值得一看。老板自己自然也年轻了不少，或者不如说一般人都不免，而实际上一个才四十的人不应便有的老态全借了一个年轻的身体而冲失了。要到这样的年龄大概才真知道如何爱惜女人。
The woman didn't know who was talking to the matchmaker, it seemed to be the daughter of a smoker on this street, and she often saw her coming out with her hair disheveled to buy sesame oil pickles and mosquito smoke, her face was yellow, and she looked ordinary. But because she was not old, she shaved her hair, applied alabaster paste, and applied some rouge, as if she was a completely different person, and all the benefits she didn't have before were exposed. The boss seemed to like it very much, and from time to time he turned around, walked over and said a few words in a low voice, making her tilt her head, and in order to pick off a piece of grass clippings and dust, his gesture was more worth seeing than a love poem. The boss himself is naturally a lot younger, or rather, ordinary people are inevitable, but in fact, the old age that a person who is only forty should not have has was lost by borrowing a young body. It is not until this age that you probably really know how to cherish a woman.灶下，那个南京师傅集中精神在做包子。他仿佛想把他的热心变成包子的滋味，摘蒂子，刮馅心，那么捏几下，一收嘴子，全按板中节，如一个熟练的舞蹈家或魔术师的手脚。今天是第一天。他忙，没甚么工夫想甚么，就这个“第一天”一定在他脑子里闪了好多次。这三个字包含的感情很多，他自己一时也分辨不清，大体上都结成了一团希望，就像那个蒸笼冒出来的一阵一阵子的热汽。听他拍打着包子皮，声音钝钝的，手掌一定很厚！他脑袋剃得光光的，后脑杓子挤成了三四叠，一用力，直扭动。他一身老蓝布衣裤，腰里一条洋面口袋改成的围裙。从上到下，无一处不像一个当行面食店师傅，跟扬州人老板相互映照，很有趣味。
Under the stove, the Nanjing Fu was concentrating on making steamed buns. He seemed to want to turn his enthusiasm into the taste of steamed buns, pick the stems, scrape the filling, pinch a few times, close his mouth, and press the middle of the board, like the hands and feet of a skilled dancer or magician. Today is the first day. He was busy and didn't have much time to think about anything, and this "first day" must have flashed in his mind many times. These three words contain a lot of emotions, and he himself couldn't tell them clearly for a while, and they were generally a ball of hope, just like the hot steam coming out of the steamer. Listening to him slapping the bun skin, his voice was dull, and his palms must be very thick! His head was shaved clean, and the back of his head was squeezed into three or four stacks, twisting with force. He was dressed in old blue cloth clothes and pants, and an apron with a foreign face pocket at his waist. From top to bottom, there is no place that does not look like a noodle shop master, which is very interesting to reflect each other with the Yangzhou boss.然而不知甚么道理，那一顿早点没有留给我甚么印象。等的时候太长，而吃的时候太短。我自己也不好，不爱吃猪肝，为甚么叫了碗猪肝面加菠菜西红柿！面是“机器面”，没有办法，生意太好，擀面来不及。——是谁给他题了那么几个艺术字？三个月之后这几个字一定浸透了油气的，活该！
However, for some reason, that breakfast didn't leave any impression on me. The waiting time is too long, and the eating time is too short. I'm not good myself, I don't like to eat pork liver, so why did I order a bowl of pork liver noodles with spinach and tomatoes! The noodles are "machine noodles", there is no way, the business is too good, and it is too late to roll the noodles. ——Who inscribed him so many words of art? After three months, these words must be soaked in oil and gas, they deserve it!不久滇越铁路断了，各处“转进”的战事使好多人的故乡随“我的家在东北松花江上”的伤感老歌一齐失去。Cynical的习气普遍的增高，而洗衣的钱付得少了，因为旧了破了，破旧了的衣服就去卖了。渺乎其远的希望造成许多浪子。有些人对书本有兴趣，抱残守拙，显得极其孤高。希望既远，他们可看到比希望还远的地方。因为形状褴褛，倒更刺激他们精神的高贵，以作为一种补偿。这是一种斗争，沉默而坚持，在日常的委屈悲愤的世俗感情的摆落中要引接山头地底水泉来灌溉一颗心的滋长，是困苦的。有些失了节，向现实投了降，做起生意起来了，由微渐著，虽无大手笔，但以玩票姿态转而下海，不失为一个“名家”局面。后一种人数目极少。正因为少，故在校中行动常一望而可指出。这才是一个开始，唯足以启发往后的不正常。本来战争的另一名词即不正常。这点不正常就直接影响绿杨饭店的营业。——现在，绿杨饭店已经为人耳熟，代替原来的“扬州人”。在它开张了，又扩充了时候，绿杨饭店是一个名词。一个名词仿佛可有可无的。而现在绿杨饭店成了一个实体，店的一切与它的招牌分不开了。
Soon the Yunnan-Vietnam Railway was cut off, and the wars everywhere caused many people's hometowns to be lost along with the sad old song "My home is on the Songhua River in the northeast". Cynical's habits generally increased, and the money for laundry was paid less, because the old and worn-out clothes were sold. The distant hope has led to many prodigal sons. That Nanjing native, on the first day, I could tell from the back of his head that this was the kind of person who would pile up "success". He seeks truth from facts, works steadily, seizes the opportunity, he knows that money is good, it is not easy to survive, and every move has a price. For that price, so he is willing to work hard. He rushed to Xiaonanmen in the morning to buy meat in the cold and dew, because it was cheaper per catty; in order to carry two bags of flour, he could say a lot of good things or scold many bad things to the porter; while he was down, he glanced at the few loads of firewood that passed in front of the door; he picked out a yellowed vegetable leaf, picked it up and put it on the cutting board; He went to another shop twice to see what their steamed buns looked like, and when he came back, he immediately decided that tomorrow his own buns could be mixed with some bean sprouts, and adding some dried tofu was also a try. …… His bed is for sleeping, his bowl is for eating, he does not fantasize, he does not like flowers, he does not go to the teahouse to drink tea, and he always fights dogs, because although his meat is on the beam, he is still worried that the dog will eat it. He seemed to give up a little on himself, often watching him get a bowl of municipal wine, drinking it sullenly, (his beard was fierce), and suddenly he slammed his fist on the table and cursed, and he didn't know who he was scolding. If the Yangzhou man was as strong as him, he might jump on it and punch him in the nose. However, the Yangzhou people looked like they were in a cowardly state, broke their necks, and looked blankly at the flies coaxing on a bone. This made the Nanjing people even more angry, and an evil fire rose straight up from the soles of their feet. The Yangzhou people's bodies are getting worse and worse, and their backs are rickety. The corners of his mouth are always hanging a little, and his lips are always open. The most action is to grab the sleeve of the right arm with his left hand, moving up and down. It's not an itch, I don't know what it's doing! His hair has not been combed for a long time, and sometimes he actually combs it, which is even worse. When someone came, he stood up mechanically, walked mechanically, wiped the table with a black rag like a deceptive person, and put it on his shoulder after wiping:“吃甚么？有包子，有面。有牛肉面，炸酱面，菠菜猪肝面。……”声音空洞而冷漠。客人的食欲就教他那个神气，那个声音压低了一半。你就看看那个荒凉污黑的架子，看到西红柿上的黑斑，你知道黑斑那一块煮也煮不烂的；看到一个大而无当的盘子里三两个鸡蛋，鸡蛋会散黄；你还会想起扬州人跟你解释过的，“鸡蛋散黄是蚊子叮的”，你想起孑孓在水里翻跟斗。吃甚么呢，你简直没有主意。你就随便说一个，牛肉面吧。扬州人掳着他的袖子：
"What to eat? There are steamed buns and noodles. There are beef noodles, fried sauce noodles, spinach and pork liver noodles. ......" The voice was empty and indifferent. The guest's appetite taught him that look, and the voice was half lowered. Just look at the desolate and dirty black shelf, see the black spots on the tomatoes, you know that the black spot can't be cooked; you see three or two eggs on a large and inappropriate plate, and the eggs will turn yellow; You will also remember what the Yangzhou people explained to you, "Eggs are bitten by mosquitoes", and you think of somersaults in the water. What to eat, you have no idea. Just say anything, beef noodles. The Yangzhou people grabbed his sleeve:“嗷，——牛肉面一碗——。”
“牛肉早就没有了，要说多少次！”
“嗷，——牛肉没有了——”
那么随便吧。猪肝面吧。
“嗷，——猪肝面一碗——”
"Hey,—— a bowl of beef noodles——。" "Beef has long been gone, how many times do you have to say it!" "Hey,—— the beef is gone-" So whatever. Pork liver noodles. "Hey,—— a bowl of pork liver noodles—"而那个女人呢，分明已经属于南京人了。仿佛这也没有甚么奇怪。连他们晚上还同时睡在那个棚子底下也都并不奇怪。这当中应当又有一段故事的，但你也顶好别去打听，压根儿你就无法懂得他们是怎么回事，除非你能是他们本人。
And that woman clearly belonged to Nanjing. It seems that there is nothing strange about this. It is not surprising that they even slept under the shed at the same time at night. There should be another story in this, but you should not inquire, you will not be able to understand what they are doing at all, unless you can be them themselves.我已经知道，他们原来是表兄弟，而且南京人是扬州人的小舅子，这！……我不知道我应当学着去作一个小说家还是深幸自己不是。……
I already know that they turned out to be cousins, and Nanjing people are brothers-in-law of Yangzhou people, this! …… I don't know if I should learn to be a novelist or if I'm glad I'm not. ……过了好多好多时候，“炮仗响了”。云南老百姓管胜利，战争结束叫“炮仗响”。他们不说胜利，不说战争结束，而说是“炮仗响”。炮仗响那天我一点都没有想到扬州人。一直到我要离开昆明的前一天，出去买东西，偶然到一个铺子里吃东西，坐下，一抬头，哎，那不是扬州人吗。再往里看，果然南京人也在那儿，做包子，一身蓝布衣裤，面粉口袋围裙，工作得非常紧张，脑杓子直扭动，手掌敲着包子皮钝钝的响。他摘蒂子，刮馅心，那么捏几下，一收嘴子，全按板中节，仿佛想把他的热心也变成包子的滋味。他从上到下无一处不像个当行的面食店师傅。这个扬州人，你为甚么要到内地来？你是四十多岁的人了，你从前是做绸缎庄的，你要想回去向妻子儿女说一声“我总算对得起你们”？……然而仿佛他们全不成问题，成问题的倒是我！我教许多事情搅迷胡了。明天我要走了。车票在我口袋里，我不知道摸了多少次。我有个很不好的脾气，喜欢把口袋里随便甚么只捏在手里搓，搓搓就扔掉了。我丢过修表的单子，洗衣服收据，照相凭条，防疫证书，人家写给我的通信地址。每丢了一张纸，我就丢了好多东西。我真怕我把车票也丢了。我有点神经衰弱。我有点难过，想吐，这会儿饿过了火，我实在甚么也不想吃。我蠢蠢的问S说：
After many, many times, "the firecrackers sounded". The people of Yunnan are in charge of victory, and the end of the war is called "firecrackers". They don't say victory, they don't say the end of the war, but "firecrackers". On the day of the firecrackers, I didn't think of Yangzhou people at all. Until the day before I was about to leave Kunming, I went out to buy something, happened to eat in a shop, sat down, looked up, hey, isn't that a Yangzhou person? Looking inside, sure enough, Nanjing people were also there, making buns, wearing blue cloth clothes and aprons, working very nervously, twisting their brains, and tapping the bun skin with a dull sound in their palms. He picked the stem, scraped the filling, pinched it a few times, closed his mouth, and pressed the middle of the board, as if he wanted to turn his enthusiasm into the taste of steamed buns. From top to bottom, he didn't look like a noodle shop master. This Yangzhou native, why did you come to the mainland? You are in your forties, you used to be a silk shop, do you want to go back and say to your wife and children, "I am finally worthy of you"? …… However, it seems that they are not a problem at all, but I am the one who is the problem! I taught many things to confuse the nonsense. Tomorrow I am leaving. The ticket is in my pocket, I don't know how many times I touched it. I have a very bad temper, I like to rub whatever I have in my pocket in my hand, rub it and throw it away. I have lost the meter repair list, laundry receipts, photo receipts, epidemic prevention certificates, and the mailing address written to me by others. Every time I lose a piece of paper, I lose a lot of things. I'm really afraid I'll lose my ticket too. I'm a little nervous breakdown. I'm a little sad, I want to vomit, I'm too hungry at this time, I really don't want to eat anything. I asked S stupidly:“我们来了八年了？”而忽然问：
“哎，那罐火腿呢？”
S敲敲火腿罐头。在桌子下捏住我的手：
“你怎么了，D？——吃甚么？”
我振作了一下：
“猪肝面加菠菜西红柿！”
"We've been here for eight years?" And suddenly asked: "Hey, what about the can of ham?" S knock on the can of ham. Pinch my hand under the table: "What's wrong with you, D? —What do you eat? ” I cheered up: "Pork liver noodles with spinach and tomatoes!"扬州人放好筷子，坐在一张空着的桌子旁边凳上。他牙齿掉了不少，两颊好像老在吸气。而脸上又有点浮肿，一种暗淡的痴黄色。肩上一条抹布湿漉漉的。一件黑滋滋的汗衫，（还是麻纱的！）一条半长不半的裤子，像十二三岁的孩子穿的。衣裤上全有许多跳蚤血黑点。看他那个滑稽相的裤子，你想到他的肚皮一定一叠一叠的打了好多道折子！最后我的眼睛就毫不客气的死盯住他的那双脚。一双自己削成的大木屐，简直是长方形的。好脏的脚，仿佛污泥已经透入多裂纹的皮肤。十个趾甲都是灰趾甲，左脚的大拇趾极其不通的压在中趾底下，难看无比。对这个扬州人，我没有第二种感情，厌恶！我恨他，虽然没有理由。
The Yangzhou man put down his chopsticks and sat on a stool next to an empty table. He lost a lot of teeth, and his cheeks seemed to be inhaling all the time. And his face was a little swollen, a dull yellow. A rag on his shoulder was wet. A black undershirt, (still linen!) A pair of half-length pants, like a twelve or thirteen-year-old child. There are many flea blood black spots on his clothes. Looking at his funny pants, you think that his belly must have been folded layer by layer! In the end, my eyes stared at his feet unceremoniously. A pair of clogs carved by myself are simply rectangular. The feet are so dirty, as if the sludge has penetrated into the cracked skin. The ten toenails are all gray toenails, and the big toe of the left foot is extremely impassable under the middle toe, which is extremely ugly. I have no second feelings for this Yangzhou man, I hate it! I hate him, although there is no reason.去你的吧，这个人，和我这篇倒霉文章！
三十六年六月
you, this person, and my unlucky article! In June of the thirty-sixth year

绿猫

绿猫[1]
山沓水匝，树杂云合，目既往还，心亦吐纳。
春日迟迟，秋风飒飒，情往似赠，兴来如答。
——《文心雕龙·物色篇》
Green Cat{{id_0000}} The mountains are overflowing, the trees are mixed with clouds, the eyes are flickering, and the heart is filled with breath. The spring days are slow, the autumn wind is rustling, the feelings are like gifts, and the excitement is like a response. ——"Wenxin Carving Dragon: Searching"刚才我想的甚么？——又一辆汽车飞驶而过，震得我好不难受。像甚么呢，像甚么呢，说不出像甚么。汽车回家，汽车们回家了。（汽车“们”？）这时候还有甚么叫卖声音？叫的是甚么？还有三轮车，白天怎么听不到三轮车轮轴吱吱吜吜的响？——我为甚么那么钝，为甚么一无所知，为甚么跟一切都隔了一层，为甚么不能掰开撕开所有的东西看？为甚么我毫无灵感，蠢溷麻木？为甚么我不是天才！——嗐，叫卖的，你叫的甚么？你说说你的故事看。你是个高的矮的？你不快乐？你没有希望？你今天晚上会作甚么梦？——你汽车，你“呜——”，你好无礼！两点一刻了。——我刚才想的甚么？香烟又涨了，（我抽了一枝烟，）——我想甚么来了？……喔，喔喔，我想过高尔基！
What was I thinking just now? ——Another car flew by, and I was so shocked. What is it like, what is it like, I can't tell what it looks like. The cars are going home, the cars are going home. (Cars "men"?) What is the sound of selling at this time? What is it calling? And tricycles, why can't you hear the creaking of tricycle axles during the day? ——Why am I so dull, why do I know nothing, why am I separated from everything, why can't I tear everything apart? Why am I uninspired and stupid? Why am I not a genius! ——Hey, hawker, what are you calling? Tell me your story. Are you a tall and short man? Are you unhappy? Are you hopeless? What are you dreaming about tonight? —Your car, you "woo-", you are so rude! It's two o'clock. - What was I just thinking? The cigarette went up again, (I smoked a cigarette,) - What did I think? …… Oh, oh, I thought about Gorky!我想起高尔基的样子，画上的高尔基，雕像上的高尔基的样子。（我现在是甚么样子？）也许不是高尔基，汤姆士·哈代，福楼拜，奥·亨利，……随便是谁。但我想的还是他，高尔基。我今天偶然翻了一本杂志，翻开来第一页就是他，他的像，（这个杂志不知刊登了多少次他的像，这位编辑也不在意？多少杂志报纸上印出过他的像了。不用写出，就知道是谁，一看就知道是谁，不看也就知道！）刻在白云石上，选了合宜光线角度而拍出来的。高尔基斜斜的坐在那儿，一脸的“高尔基”。画家雕刻家们对他那么熟悉，比对他自己工作室所在的那条街，他买纸烟的铺子，他的房东的女儿，他自己的领带还熟悉。他们用笔用斧凿在布上石头里找出一个东西，高尔基。高尔基总是穿着马靴的？他脸上都是那个样子，他从早到晚，今年到明年，无刻不是“高尔基”？如果不是那些像，我相信，如果与他差肩而过，没有人知道他是谁。没有多少人看过了还记得他。根本在路上就不会有人看他的，即使已经知道高尔基其人，知道他是个甚么样子。高尔基是甚么样子？两撇胡子——甚么样的胡子？有一回我们演戏，彩排的时候，化装室里，一个演员拿了皱纹笔，抹了底子油，问导演，“我来个甚么样的胡子？”导演一凝眸，看了看演员脸，竖出一个指头，十分有把握：“高尔基式！”——半搭拉着眼皮，作深思状。高尔基一年到头都在深思，都作深思状？——想想高尔基执笔抽烟的样子。——高尔基要是刚从理发店里出来，甚么样子？——是甚么意思呢？我怎么想起来这个？……
I think of Gorky, Gorky in the painting, Gorky in the statue. (What am I like now?) Maybe not Gorky, Thomas Hardy, Flaubert, O. Henry,...... Whoever it is. But I still think of him, Gorky. I happened to flip through a magazine today, and the first page was him, his portrait. How many magazines and newspapers have printed his portrait. You don't have to write it down, you know who it is, you know who it is at a glance, and you know it if you don't look at it! It was engraved on the dolomite and photographed at a suitable angle of light. Gorky sat there slanting, with a "Gorky" on his face. The painters and sculptors were so familiar with him, more familiar than the street where his own studio was located, the shop where he bought cigarettes, his landlord's daughter, and his own tie. They chiseled with their pens and axes in the stones on the cloth to find something, Gorky. Gorky always wore riding boots? He looked like that on his face, from morning to night, from this year to next year, he was not "Gorky"? If it weren't for those statues, I believe, if they passed by him, no one would know who he was. Not many people had seen him and remembered him. No one would have seen him on the road, even if they already knew Gorky and what he looked like. What was Gorky like? Two mustaches - what kind of beard? Once, when we were acting, during the rehearsal, in the dressing room, an actor took a crease pen, smeared the base oil, and asked the director, "What kind of beard should I have?" The director stared, looked at the actor's face, and held out a finger, very confident: "Gorky style!" - Half-twitched eyelids and made a deep thought. Gorky thinks deeply all year round, thinks deeply? - Think about Gorky smoking a pen. - What would Gorky look like if he had just come out of the barbershop? - What does it mean? How do I remember this? ……我是想起了绿猫。（高尔基，绿猫！）——现在又是叫卖的甚么？甚么地方有关窗声音，隔壁老头儿又咳嗽了。
I thought of the green cat. (Gorky, the green cat!) ——What is it selling now? There was a sound of windows somewhere, and the old man next door coughed again.我的朋友栢要写一篇小说，写绿猫，我就想起了高尔基。今天我刚好看见了高尔基。若是看到别人，我就会想到别人。
我去看我的朋友栢。
My friend Bai was going to write a novel, about the green cat, and I thought of Gorky. Today I happened to see Gorky. If I see others, I will think of others. I went to see my friend Park.黄梅天，总是那么闷。下雨。除了直接看到雨丝，你无法从别的东西上感觉到雨。声音是也有的，但那实在不能算是“雨声”。空气中极潮湿，香烟都变得软软的，抽到嘴里也没有味，但这与“雨意”这两个字的意味差得可多么远。天空淡淡漠漠，毫无感情可言。雨下到地上，就变成了水。那里是下甚么雨，“下水”而已。（赫哈，下水！）虽然这时念一声“八表同昏”，念一声“最难风雨故人来”，觉得滑稽，可是听巷子里那个苍白的孩子一边跑，一边用稚嫩的声音哀唤：
Huangmeitian is always so stuffy. Rain. You can't feel the rain from anything other than seeing the rain directly. There are sounds, but they really can't be considered "rain sounds". The air is extremely humid, the cigarettes become soft, and there is no smell in the mouth, but this is far from the meaning of the word "rain". The sky is faint and indifferent, and there is no emotion to speak of. When the rain falls to the ground, it becomes water. What kind of rain is it there, just "going into the water". (Hehe, go into the water!) Although it was funny to recite "Eight Tables and Eight Tables at the same time" and "The Most Difficult Wind and Rain Old Man Comes", I heard the pale child in the alley cry in a childish voice while running:“有破个烂个电灯泡撂出来，
有破个烂个电灯泡撂出来，”
我可没有电灯泡撂给他，披上雨衣，决定还是去看看栢。虽然毫不热烈，摇曳着，支持着那点意思。
"There's a broken light bulb thrown out. There is a broken light bulb and pull it out," I didn't have a light bulb to throw him away, put on a raincoat, and decided to go see Bai. Although it was not enthusiastic, it swayed, supporting that meaning.怎么样从我的住处就到了栢的住处了呢？说不上来，我就是已经到了栢的门前，伸手而敲了。“既然不是乘兴，你就不要来！”我心里自己嘀咕。王子猷呀王子猷，活在现在，你也毫不希奇！想到你的得意杰作，我是又悲哀又生气。——才不，悲甚么哀呢，生的甚么气。谁也不能真正画出一幅雪夜访戴图，他不过是自得其乐。这个年头，谈不到这些，卞之琳先生说是“最不风流的时候”，有这么一句话他就活得下去，仿佛不风流害不死他。人言阿龙超，阿龙固自超，那么咱们就超吧。也罢，我明知道这门里没有甚么新鲜事情，优美，崇高，陶醉迷人事情，我还是敲门。剥啄一声，我心欢喜。心里一阵子暖，我这才知道我为甚么要来，我该来。门里至少有我一个朋友，在茫茫人海之中可以跟我谈话。“我好比：南来的雁……”我简直要唱起来了。当然没有唱，一声“请进来”，门为我而开了。我真想说一声：
How did you get from my residence to Bai's residence? I can't say it, I just arrived at Bai's door and knocked on it. "Since it's not fun, don't come!" I muttered to myself. Wang Ziyou, Wang Ziyou, living now, you are not surprised! Thinking of your proud masterpiece, I am sad and angry. ——No, what is sad, what is angry. No one can really draw a picture of a snowy night visit, he is just enjoying himself. These days, I can't talk about this, Mr. Bian Zhilin said that it was "the least romantic time", and there was such a sentence that he could live, as if he could not be killed if he was not romantic. People say that Aaron is super, and Aaron is self-surpassing, so let's surpass. Anyway, I know that there is nothing new in this door, beautiful, sublime, intoxicating and charming things, I still knock on the door. Peeling and pecking, my heart was happy. My heart warmed up for a while, and then I knew why I was here, I should come. There is at least one friend of mine in the door who can talk to me in the vast sea of people. "I'm like: a goose from the south......" I'm about to sing. Of course I didn't sing, and with a "please come in", the door opened for me. I really want to say:“啊栢，我真喜欢你！”
"Ah Bai, I really like you!"现代人都受不了舞台上的大悲剧，受不了颤抖带泪的声音，受不了“太厉害”的动作，然而虽然止于礼义也，却未尝没有发乎情的时候，他只是不让她“出来”，活生生给掐死了，而且毫不觉其残酷。当然我也不说。我为甚么要怪，要不识时务，不顺应潮流。我的朋友栢是个热情人，虽然也给压得差不多坏了，但劲儿似乎还有一点。许多人加给他的评语是“天真”。当然他不是孩子似的。他天生来是个浪漫的底子，关起门来会升天入地，在现实中淘吸出点甚么玩意儿来。——任是这么一个人，我也不能跟他说那一句会令他莫明其妙的话吧。如果我说，他一定愕然，看我一眼，略一点头，心里明白了，上来扶住我，扶到他椅子里坐下，甚至扶到他床上，给我倒水，有钱则为我买水果。他以为我醉了！如果我醉了，我就会接下去说：
Modern people can't stand the great tragedy on the stage, the trembling and tearful sounds, and the "too powerful" action, but although it is only polite and righteous, there is no time when he is in heat, he just doesn't let her "come out", strangles her to death, and doesn't feel cruel. Of course I won't say it. Why should I blame him, he doesn't know the current affairs and doesn't follow the trend. My friend Bai is a warm person, although he is almost crushed, but he seems to have a little energy. Many people commented on him as "naïve". Of course he is not like a child. He was born with a romantic foundation, and he would ascend to heaven and earth behind closed doors, and he would suck up something in reality. ——Even if it was such a person, I couldn't tell him that sentence would make him puzzled.
