I am listening, watching, encouraging and rewarding. Bai was happy, his voice was also good at this moment, and his emotions flowed naturally.“给你背一段书：
"Memorize a book for you:“古人云：形在江海之上，心存魏阙之下，神思之谓也。文之思也，其神远矣！故寂然凝虑，思接千载；悄然动容，视通万里。吟咏之间，吐纳珠玉之声；眉睫之前，卷舒风云之色，其思理之致乎。’——珠玉，风云，这是六朝人滥调，不过‘寂然’，‘悄然’形容得好！……
“古人云：形在江海之上，心存魏阙之下，神思之谓也。 文之思也，其神远矣！故寂然凝虑，思接千载；悄然动容，视通万里。 吟咏之间，吐纳珠玉之声；眉睫之前，卷舒风云之色，其思理之致乎。 ’——珠玉，风云，这是六朝人滥调，不过‘寂然’，‘悄然’形容得好！……“‘故思理为妙，神与物游。神居胸臆之间，而志气统其关键；物沿耳目，而辞令管其枢机；枢机方通，则物无隐貌，关键将塞，则神有遁心。……’”
“‘故思理为妙，神与物游。 神居胸臆之间，而志气统其关键；物沿耳目，而辞令管其枢机；枢机方通，则物无隐貌，关键将塞，则神有遁心。 ……’”我点头：
我点头：“张载说：‘心中苟有所开，即便劄记，不思则还塞之矣。’非常同情他这个‘还塞之矣’，非常沉痛。”
Zhang Zai said: 'If you open your heart, even if you write it down, if you don't think about it, you will still stuff it.' I sympathize with him very much, and it is very painful. ”“‘是以陶钧文思，贵在虚静：疏瀹五藏，澡雪精神；积学以储宝，酌理以富才，研阅以穷照，驯致以怿辞。’——真好！
“‘是以陶钧文思，贵在虚静：疏瀹五藏，澡雪精神；积学以储宝，酌理以富才，研阅以穷照，驯致以怿辞。 ’——真好！“夫神思方运，万涂竞萌，规矩虚位，刻镂无形：登山则情满于山，观海则意溢于海，我才之多少，将与风云而并驱矣！……”
“夫神思方运，万涂竞萌，规矩虚位，刻镂无形：登山则情满于山，观海则意溢于海，我才之多少，将与风云而并驱矣！……”“你背得真熟。”
“你背得真熟。 ”“因为就像是我说的！——我还是赞成背书。就是太忙。我多久没有这么‘像煞有介事’过了？从前不相信甚么会闷出病来，现在想，大概真有那么回事。我母亲，他们就说是闷出病来，死的。”
"Because it's like I said it! ——I still agree with the endorsement. It's just too busy. How long has it been since I've been so 'like a big deal'? I didn't believe in anything that made me sick, but now I think it's probably true. My mother, they said she died of suffocation. ”栢这会儿神采焕发，眸子炯然。他在椅子把四肢伸得直直的，挺了挺腰，十分舒畅的样子，看起来他比平常也长大了些。我可以体会到他身体里丰满的快感。过了好一会，雨小些了，他走了两步，重重的叹了一声：
Bai was full of energy at this moment, and his eyes were bright. He stretched his limbs straight in the chair, straightened his waist, and looked very comfortable, looking like he was a little older than usual. I could feel the pleasure of fullness in his body. After a while, the rain became lighter, he took two steps, and sighed heavily:“四序纷迴，入兴贵闲；勤靡馀暇，心肖长闲，可是我怎么闲得起来？”
"The four sequences are complicated, and the interest is precious; diligence and leisure, and the heart is long leisure, but how can I be idle? ”他长吸一口，把烟蒂灭了。打开抽屉，放好他的断稿《绿猫》。这家伙太敏感自觉，虽然对我还有时这么淋漓尽致的抒说，但也不让自己太忘形。过于恣肆固恐使我难堪，漫无节制亦为他文章义法所不取。完了，即使我紧接着，用热望的眼睛注视他，说“说下去，”他也不说了。古罗马的城楼又唱起来，而且远远的已经听到他的同事们嚷着唱着来了。栢向我笑：
He took a long breath and extinguished the cigarette butt. He opened the drawer and put away his fragmented manuscript "Green Cat". This guy is too sensitive and conscious, and although he still expresses himself so vividly to me sometimes, he does not let himself get too carried away. Being too reckless may embarrass me, and being careless is not desirable for his writing. It was over, even if I immediately followed him, looking at him with eager eyes, and said, "Go on," he didn't say anything. The ancient Roman towers sang again, and his colleagues could be heard shouting from afar. Bai smiled at me:“满城风雨近重阳。——水之积也不厚，则其负大舟也无力，我其为芥之舟乎？——甚么时候，我才能有一个比较可以长时间思索，不被干扰的时候？——你也走吧，你也不善应酬，我实在怕看你装得很会应酬的样子；而且再有半点钟你们就要开饭，我也不留你。”
"The city is full of wind and rain near the Double Ninth Festival. ——The accumulation of water is not thick, so it is not strong to carry a big boat, am I a mustard boat? ——When can I have a time when I can think for a long time and not be disturbed? ——You can go too, you are not good at socializing, I am really afraid to see you pretend to be very good at socializing; and you will have dinner at half an o'clock, and I will not keep you. ”抱起他的小猫，栢送我到门口。我看着马路对面法国梧桐的绿叶，笑。
“又笑甚么？”
Picked up his kitten and sent me to the door. I looked at the green leaves of the French sycamore across the road and smiled. "What are you laughing at?"“我想你有句甚么话要说：‘感谢你让我痛痛快快说了半天话，胡说八道，毫无道理，不要笑我。’——把你的猫送还给人家去吧，多难看！”
"I think you have something to say: 'Thank you for letting me talk happily for a long time, nonsense, without reason, don't laugh at me.' ——Give your cat back, how ugly! ”“阁下聪明，倒是，算你猜着，不愧是小说家！——才不送，我要把它染绿了呢！别把我的话记下来，说我说的，我怕挨骂，除非等我把那篇了不起的大作，文学与人生，写出来之后。——哎，你上回说的道士请神情形很有意思。真是那样？是你诌出来的？”
"Your Excellency is smart, but, you guessed it, he is worthy of being a novelist! ——I won't give it away, I'm going to dye it green! Don't write down my words, say what I said, I'm afraid of being scolded, unless I write that great masterpiece, literature and life. ——Hey, the Taoist priest's invitation to God you mentioned last time is very interesting. Is that really the case? Did you come up with it? ”“诌甚么！回去吧。过两天来。希望你的《绿猫》也写好了，猫也染绿了。”
"What! Go back. Come in two days. I hope your "Green Cat" is also written, and the cat is dyed green. ”…………
风雨如晦，鸡鸣不已。——哎呀，我已经在这里坐了几个钟头了？天已经透蓝。咦，这里居然也听得到麻雀叫？——糟糕，我伤风了。刚才我放下笔歇了一会儿，抽了两枝烟，我想了些甚么？……我想起栢文章中提到的小院子，那时我们住在一起。想起那棵大白兰花树，现在正是开花的时候了。只有在云南那样的气候，白兰花才能长得那么大，罩满了整个一天井。花时，在巷子里即闻到香气，如招如唤。我们常搬了一张竹椅，在花树下看书，听老姑娘念经敲磬。偶然一抬头，绿叶缝隙间一朵白云正施施流过，闲静无比。一个老蜂窝又大了不少。一个蜘蛛结网，忙碌辛勤，忽然跌落下来，吊在半空；不知是偶然失足，还是有意如此，好等风来吹去，转换一个方向。我们有一个长耳绿匋水瓶，用匋瓶汲取井水来喝。——这时候！我们多半已经到了呈贡，骑马下乡了。道路都在栗树园中穿过，马奔驶于阔大的绿叶之下，草头全是露，风真轻快。我们大声呼喝，震动群山。村边或有个早起老人，或穿鲜红颜色女孩子，闻声回首，目送我们过去。此乐至不可忘。——一说，也十年了，好快！——而这里，就是汽车！汽车又一辆一辆的开出来了。……
The wind and rain were dark, and the rooster crowed. - Oh, I've been sitting here for hours? The sky is already blue. Oh, you can actually hear the sparrows crowing here? - Oh, I have a cold. I put down my pen and took a break for a while, smoked two cigarettes, what did I think? …… I think of the small yard mentioned in the article when we lived together. Thinking of the big white orchid tree, it's time to bloom. Only in a climate like Yunnan can white orchids grow so big and cover the entire patio. When it blooms, you can smell the fragrance in the alley, like a call. We often moved a bamboo chair to read under the flower tree and listen to the old girl chant scriptures and ring the bell. Occasionally, when I looked up, a white cloud was flowing through the gaps in the green leaves, extremely quiet. An old honeycomb is much bigger. A spider made a web, busy and hardworking, and suddenly fell down and hung in mid-air; I don't know if it was an accidental stumbling or intentional, so that the wind could blow and change direction. We have a long-eared green water bottle, which we use to draw well water to drink. ——At this time! Most of us have already arrived in Chenggong and rode to the countryside. The roads all passed through the chestnut orchard, the horses galloped under the wide green leaves, the grass was full of dew, and the wind was really brisk. We shouted loudly, shaking the mountains. There was an old man who got up early in the village, or a girl in bright red, who looked back and watched us pass. This joy is unforgettable. ——It's been ten years, so fast! ——And here, it's a car! The cars are driving out one by one. …………怎么会想到高尔基身上去的？……喔，是想到道士请神，于是想到高尔基。
…… How could you think of going to Gorky? …… Oh, I thought of the Taoist priest asking the gods, so I thought of Gorky.凡道士做法事道场，拜斗礼坛，既爇香，例须降神。降神，就是变成一个神。其实和尚也如此，当中坐的那个戴毘卢帽的大和尚是地藏王化身。不过道士降神过程，比较长，比较顶真。偷鞋骗食的道士，自然不过略具形式而已。有道理道士则必虔诚恭敬，收视返听，匍伏坛前，良久良久，庶可脱去自己，化为太乙。旁边的小道士，这时候由“掌鱼”的领头，摇铃击磬，高声赞美，退魔障，全真灵，参助其升超。据说内行人常常可以看出变到了如何程度，是快是慢，是易是难。据说，如果降请既毕，得到灵感，——他们也叫灵感，即凡俗人，若谛细观察，亦可以觉出与平常神色不烦，端正凝祥，具好容貌，有大威仪。这似乎与理学家的功夫有相似处。噫，鬼神之事，难言之矣，小时我不怎么相信，现在也还是一样。不过那个理却似乎有的。我有兴趣的是它可以借给我作一个比喻。
All Taoist priests perform rituals in the dojo and worship the altar, both burn incense and must descend the gods. To séance is to become a god. In fact, the same is true for monks, and the great monk wearing a Pilu hat sitting in the middle is the incarnation of King Ksitigarbha. However, the process of Taoist sending gods is relatively long and more real. Taoist priests who steal shoes and cheat food are naturally only slightly formal. If it makes sense, the Taoist priest will be devout and respectful, listen to it, and prostrate in front of the altar for a long time, so that he can take off himself and become Taiyi. The little Taoist priest next to him, at this time, led by the "palm fish", rang the bell and struck the chime, praised loudly, exorcised the demonic barrier, and the whole true spirit participated in his ascension. It is said that insiders can often see how much they have changed, whether it is fast or slow, easy or difficult. It is said that if they receive inspiration after the invitation,—— they are also called inspiration, that is, ordinary people, if they observe carefully, they can also feel that they are not annoyed with their usual expressions, are upright and dignified, have good appearances, and have great majesty. This seems to have similarities with the kung fu of Confucianism. Oh, it is difficult to say about ghosts and gods, I didn't believe much when I was a child, and it is still the same now. But that principle seems to exist. What interests me is that it can lend me an analogy.高尔基就像那个道士。我是说画布上的，白云石，青铜上的，诚然是高尔基，但那是高尔基的精华。平常时候，比如从理发店里出来的时候，（高尔基也要理理发，俄国的理发匠不见得高明到那里去！）高尔基未必常如是。高尔基一定也有很不像样的时候，如果人家一定要送他一个难看的小猫他怎么样呢，大概也没有办法；而高尔基大概也不喜欢听古罗马的城楼，不喜欢四个人住一屋，不喜欢汽车声音，不见得喜欢一点都没有雨的意思的下雨天也。——那种最高尔基式的时候，当然是他写得或者读得得意的时候。像果戈里所说，写不出来，在纸上乱画，写：
Gorky is like that Taoist priest. I mean on canvas, dolomite, bronze, it is true that it is Gorky, but that is the essence of Gorky. Usually, such as when coming out of the barbershop, (Gorky also has to get a haircut, Russian barbers are not necessarily brilliant to go there!) Gorky may not always be like this. Gorky must have been very unsightly, and if someone had to give him an ugly kitten, there was probably no way; And Gorky probably didn't like to listen to ancient Roman towers, four people living in one room, the sound of cars, and he didn't necessarily like rainy days without rain at all. ——That kind of most Ergian time, of course, is when he writes or reads with pride. As Gogol said, if you can't write it, scribble on the paper and write:我今天写不出来，
我今天写不出来，
我今天写不出来！
的时候，自也有一种可以令人感动之处。不过画家雕刻家似乎看不到；看不到所以他们画不出，刻不出。这怕倒还是写小说的可以来表演一下子了。
I can't write it today, I can't write it today, I can't write it today! At that time, there is also a kind of touching thing. But painters and sculptors don't seem to be able to see it; they can't see it, so they can't paint or carve. I'm afraid that those who write novels can perform for a while.因为栢写不出文章，我想到这些。我是说高尔基可能比栢稍为可以平和安定一些，有时间可以思索，不会那么要写而不能写。——我这想的有点怪么？
Because Bai can't write articles, I think of this. I mean Gorky may be a little more peaceful and stable than Bai, have time to think, and not write so much. ——Am I thinking a bit strange?栢的《绿猫》，要写的，是一个孩子，小时极爱画画 ，可是大家都反对他。反对他画画，也反对他画的画。有一回，他画了一个得意杰作，是一头猫。他满腔热望，高高兴兴的拿给父亲看，父亲看也不看。拿给母亲看，母亲说：“作算术去！”拿给图画老师看，图画老师不知道生了甚么气，打了他十个手心，大骂他一顿：“那有这样的猫？那有这样的猫！”他画的是个绿猫。画了轮廓，他要为猫著色，打开颜色盒子，一得意，他调了一种绿色，把他的猫涂成了绿的。长大了，他作公务员，不得意。也没有甚么朋友，大家说他乖僻。他还想画画，可是画不成，乱七八糟的涂得他自己伤心。他想想毛某的《月亮和六辨士》更伤心。到后来他就老了。人家送他一个猫。猫，人家不要养了，硬说他喜欢猫，非送给他不可，没有办法，他就收养了。他整天就是抱着他的猫。有一天，他忽然把他的猫染成了绿的。看到别人看到绿猫的惊奇样子，他笑了。没有两天，他就死了。
Bai's "Green Cat" is about a child who loves to draw when he was a child, but everyone is against him. Oppose his paintings, and also oppose his paintings. Once, he painted a proud masterpiece, which was a cat. He was full of enthusiasm and happily showed it to his father, but his father didn't look at it. Show it to his mother, and her mother said, "Go do arithmetic!" I showed it to the drawing teacher, who didn't know what was angry, so he slapped him ten palms and scolded him: "Is there such a cat? There is such a cat!" He drew a green cat. After drawing the outline, he wanted to color the cat, opened the color box, and when he was proud, he adjusted a green color and painted his cat green. When he grew up, he was a civil servant and was not proud. He didn't have any friends, and everyone said he was perverse. He still wanted to paint, but he couldn't, and he was sad to paint in a mess. He was even sadder when he thought about Mao's "The Moon and the Six Debaters". Later he got old. Someone gave him a cat. He didn't want to keep a cat, insisted that he liked cats, and he had to give them to him, so he adopted them. He held his cat all day long. One day, he suddenly dyed his cat green. He smiled when he saw the surprise of others seeing the green cat. Within two days, he died.虽然我曾经警告过他，说这样的小说我没有看见过。这算甚么呢，算心理小说？心理小说在中国还是个颇“危险”的东西。中国人大概都比较简单，也许我们的小说作家以为中国人很简单，反正，没有这个东西。我想劝他还是写写高尔基式的小说。不过，还是让他写下去吧。也许他有一天会写黑猫，白猫，狸花猫，玳瑁猫的。——你也知道的，他写的是他自己。
Although I once warned him that I had never seen such a novel. What is this, psychological novels? Psychological novels are still quite a "dangerous" thing in China. Chinese are probably relatively simple, maybe our novel writers think that Chinese are very simple, anyway, there is no such thing. I would like to advise him to write Gorky-style novels. However, let him write. Maybe one day he will write about black cats, white cats, civet cats, and hawksbill cats. ——You know, he wrote about himself.我担心的倒是，猫要是个绿的，他把猫眼睛弄成个甚么颜色呢？唔，我以为这很严重。
What I'm worried about is, if the cat is green, what color will he make the cat's eyes? Well, I thought it was serious.天倒是晴了。早晴，今天一定热得很。——隔壁那个老头子咳了整整一夜。——不得了，汽车都出来了，这个世界上充满了汽车！还有，那是无线电的流行歌曲，已经唱起来也！我想起那位乖戾的哲人叔本华的那一篇荒谬绝伦的文章：《论嘈杂》。
It's sunny. It's sunny, it must be very hot today. The old man next door coughed all night. - Oh no, cars are coming out, the world is full of cars! Also, it's a popular song on the radio, and it's already being sung! I think of the ridiculous article of the obedient philosopher Schopenhauer: "On Noise".三十六年七月二日，上海

冬天

冬天[1]
July 2, 36 years, Shanghai [1] This article was originally published in Volume 5, Issue 2 of "Literature and Art Spring and Autumn", 1947. Volume 1 of "The Complete Works of Wang Zengqi", Beijing Normal University Press, August 1998. Winter[1]——小说《豆腐店》之一片段
冬天，下雪。
——A fragment of the novel "Tofu Shop" In winter, it snows.冬天下雪，大和二和不大出来。冬天的孩子在家里。孩子在母亲膝头，小猫在我的膝头。孩子穿得厚厚的。冬天教人觉得冷，我是觉得不冷。孩子的眼睛圆溜溜，孩子想。想，看看雪，想。冬天，大和二和睡觉，——我就看见他们睡觉，不睡觉他们做甚么我不知道。我作不出一篇《大和跟二和的冬天》。冬天的荒野一片白，就只有一个字，雪。要那才叫雪，甚么都没有，都不重要，只有雪。天白亮白亮的，雪花绵绵的往下飘，没有一点声息。雪的轻，积雪的软，都无可比拟。雪天教人也不是想飞，也不是想骑（马），不是俯卧在上面，教人想怎么样呢，还是走走，一步一步的走。想又不顶想，又似乎想的也不是这个，都说不清。总而言之，一种兴奋，一种快乐，内在，飘举，轻。树皮好黑，乌鸦也好黑，水池子冻得像玻璃。庙也是雪，船也是雪。侉奶奶的门不开，门槛上都是雪。……下雪有时我们还是要出去的。或是冬天来得特别早，或是学校放寒假放得晚，还没有考大考就下了很像样子的雪了。新围巾，好质料的长统胶靴，这要到雪里去。我们要打那把大伞。为孩子们把伞造得轻便些是很要紧的事，不然他们就一心支持负担伞的笨重，再也无心做别的了。伞其实我们并不真要“打”它，雪很干，雪落在眉毛上化了也很好玩，要伞我们是要撑起来旋来旋去，伞把我们都罩了起来，这很好玩，很美。看见那把伞倚在犄角，就提了我一句：我要走。我要上学去。快点，快点，找铅笔，——想想看：昨天晚上……还没有想到如何搁下笔，即记起放在那里了，准备得停停当当，心里轻松；好了，现在，“小莲我跟你买豆腐浆去，我跟你一起去，噢！”豆腐店顾老板看了那个淡蓝瓷罐子，点一点头。——顾老板差不多每天都跟这个罐子点一点头。我们会意，那等于说，“就有，等一下”。我们照例就各处看看。两大锅白浆，咕噜咕噜，从锅底翻上来，向四边滚去。热气腾腾，一直腾到屋顶。（屋顶的雪呢？）顺着上望，黑沉沉的椽子，黑沉沉的望砖。顾老板手扶锅台，看看锅里。时而把一个大铜勺拿在手里，掂一掂，又放墙上一个木架子上。一切动作全极准确，合乎理想，熟练而不流滑。看见他的动作，心里就会感动。我注意到铜勺把子后头一根钉，刚好卡搁在架子上，顾老板大概站得太久了，时而把全身重心落在脚跟，时而落在脚掌往回移动，看得出他脚面上那根筋一起一落，你可以想见他的大姆趾时而伸直，时而屈起一点。他在等，等一会儿豆腐皮子结起来。皮子结起来，用一根一根的“皮棍”那么一撩，一张；一撩，一张，一张一张的挂在木架上。唿——噎，豆腐皮往上缩，皱起来了，皱得厉害！顾老板是个瘦子，高而瘦。稍为侧一点，从后面看过去，只见他的高颧骨。我们很少正面看顾老板，不知道为甚么。偶然他回过头来，他脸色青青的，眼球发浑，全是赤丝。他没有精神，好像他非常想睡觉而不得睡的样子。这时灶后一定有人烧火，脸熏得通红通红，皮肤发紧，是顾大娘。到灶后看看，顾大娘没有梳头。她每天不知道甚么时候梳头。（小莲是扫好地梳。）——一听顾老板喊“起！”我们知道那是叫顾大娘不要烧了，这就要给我们留豆浆了，我们就赶紧去看一看驴去。驴打喷嚏，跺他的小蹄子。驴养在后面一间小屋里。一屋子干草，够它吃的。驴看到这些草想必喜欢的。我们从门口把头伸进去（它的门只有半截）。喂！驴也看见我们了，它瞟了一眼。用一根柴棒把它的长耳朵按下去，再看它竖起来，一定很有意思。而顾老板叫了：“豆腐浆！”赶紧去拿！一把瓷罐提在手里，就非走不可了。
It snows in winter, and Yamato Erhe doesn't come out. The child is at home in winter. The child is on the mother's knee, and the kitten is on my knee. The child is thickly dressed. Winter makes people feel cold, but I don't feel cold. The child's eyes are round, the child thinks. Think, look at the snow, think. In winter, Yamato and Erwa sleep,—— I see them sleeping, and I don't know what they do if they don't sleep. I can't write a "Winter of Yamato and Erwa". The wilderness in winter is white, there is only one word, snow. If you want that to be called snow, there is nothing, it doesn't matter, only snow. The sky is white and bright, and the snowflakes are floating down, without any sound. The lightness of the snow and the softness of the snow are incomparable. Snow teaches people not to fly, not to ride (horses), not to lie on it, to teach people what to think, or to walk, step by step. I can't say it clearly. All in all, a kind of excitement, a kind of happiness, internal, floating, light. The bark is so dark, the crow is so black, and the pool is as frozen as glass. The temple is also snow, and the boat is also snow. Grandma's door is not open, and the threshold is full of snow. …… When it snows, we still have to go out. Or winter comes very early, or the school is late for winter vacation, and it snows very decently before the big exam. New scarves, long-term rubber boots made of good materials, this is going to the snow. We have to make that big umbrella. It is very important to make the umbrella lighter for the children, otherwise they will support the bulkiness of the umbrella and have no intention of doing anything else. The umbrella is actually not really going to "hit" it, the snow is very dry, and it is fun when the snow falls on the eyebrows. When I saw the umbrella leaning in the corner, he mentioned to me: I want to go. I want to go to school. Hurry up, hurry up, find a pencil,—— think about it: last night...... I haven't thought about how to put down the pen, that is, I remember that I put it there, and I have to stop and prepare it, and my heart is relaxed; Okay, now, "Xiao Lian, I'll buy tofu with you, I'll go with you, oh!" Boss Gu of the tofu shop looked at the light blue porcelain jar and nodded. ——Boss Gu nods to this jar almost every day. We care, that is equivalent to saying, "Yes, wait a minute." Let's look around as usual. Two large pots of white pulp, gurgling, turned over from the bottom of the pot and rolled to the sides. It was steaming and soared all the way to the roof. (What about the snow on the roof?) Looking up, the dark rafters and the dark bricks. Boss Gu held the pot table and looked into the pot. Sometimes he took a large copper spoon in his hand, shook it, and put it on a wooden shelf on the wall. All movements are extremely accurate, ideal, skillful and not slippery. When I see his movements, my heart will be moved. I noticed that a nail on the back of the copper spoon handle was just stuck on the shelf, and Boss Gu probably stood for too long, sometimes the center of gravity of his whole body fell on his heels, and sometimes he moved back on the soles of his feet. He was waiting, waiting for a while for the tofu skin to knot. The skin was knotted, and it was lifted one by one with a "leather stick", one by one; one by one, one by one, hung on the wooden frame. Choke, the tofu skin shrank upwards, wrinkled, and wrinkled! Boss Gu is a thin man, tall and thin. Slightly sideways, looking from behind, I only saw his high cheekbones. We rarely look at Boss Gu head-on, I don't know why. Accidentally he turned around, his face was blue, his eyeballs were cloudy, and he was all red. He had no energy, as if he wanted to sleep very much but couldn't. At this time, someone must have lit a fire behind the stove, his face was red and red, and his skin was tight, it was Aunt Gu. When I went to the stove to look at it, Aunt Gu didn't comb her hair. She doesn't know when she combs her hair every day. (Xiaolian is sweeping the floor.) ——As soon as I heard Boss Gu shout, "Get up!" We knew that it was telling Aunt Gu not to burn it, so we had to leave soy milk for us, so we hurried to see the donkey. The donkey sneezed and stomped his little hooves. The donkey was kept in a hut in the back. A room full of hay was enough for it to eat. The donkey must like it when he saw the grass. We stuck our heads in through the door (its door was only half half). Feed! The donkey also saw us, and it glanced at us. It must be interesting to press down its long ears with a firewood stick and then see it stand up. And Boss Gu shouted: "Tofu pulp!" "Hurry up and get it! If you hold a porcelain jar in your hand, you have to go.但是，提罐子的这个专注于罐子，专注于走路；闲上的那个却还可以四顾一下。看一看那个榨床，看一看磨石，看一看滤豆汁的夹布兜，看一看壁上百灵机瓶改成的油灯，油灯在壁上熏出一道烟黑，若定若动。“走啊！”慢，看顾大娘出来了。顾大娘没有梳头。有人没有梳头头还是那么整齐，简直可以不梳，顾大娘为甚么那么乱？从炽旺的火边走出来，出来一定全身一寒吧？顾大娘走出来，走到锅台旁边那张床前。小莲和我都驻足回头。床上一张帐子。顾大娘撩开帐子。帐子里睡的大和跟二和。看到一角被窝，顾大娘掖一掖被窝。大和二和睡得暖呵呵的，睡得像两条小狗。如果有一个醒了，睁着眼睛醒在那儿，他一定叫一声，“妈——”顾大娘就颔首，眼睛看眼睛。我们最后一眼是那个灰黄的帐子，帐子放下来，所有这个店里的一切好像全罩在帐子里了：灰黄的帐子，一个补丁很惹眼的一方。转过身来，门外一片白雪。
However, the one who carries the jar focuses on the jar and walks; the one who is idle can still look around. Take a look at the pressing table, look at the grinding stone, look at the cloth pocket for filtering soybean juice, and look at the oil lamp on the wall that has been converted into a lark machine bottle. "Let's go!" Slow, watch Aunt Gu come out. Aunt Gu didn't comb her hair. Some people are so neat without combing their hair, they can not comb it, why is Aunt Gu so messy? Walking out of the blazing fire, you must be cold all over your body, right? Aunt Gu walked out and walked to the bed next to the pot table. Xiaolian and I both stopped and looked back. A tent on the bed. Aunt Gu lifted the tent. Yamato and Erhe slept in the tent. Seeing a corner of the quilt, Aunt Gu tucked the quilt. Yamato Erhe slept warmly, sleeping like two puppies. If one of them wakes up and wakes up there with his eyes open, he will definitely scream, "Mom-" Aunt Gu nodded and looked at her eyes. The last time we saw was the gray and yellow tent, the tent was put down, and everything in this store seemed to be covered in the tent: the gray and yellow tent, a patch that was very eye-catching. Turning around, there was white snow outside the door.…………
虽然是冬天，白天我们仍然有许多事在手上好做，身体好动。到天黑下来，火红起来，（偶尔一掀窗布，灯光铺在雪上。雪住了，——雪又大了。）我们就真个就是想了；或者说话，说出自己想的，把自己想的跟别人联起来。我们想到荒野；想到雪下的小麦；小麦种在荒野的尽头，这时它们还绿？想到野兔子，獾狗；红毛草城头上赶野兔子；每回上坟，一路都要看到许多獾狗洞；想花胡不拉的野鸡冻在雪里，想冰底下的鱼，……李三酒醒了没有？一到冬天，李三总是满身酒气。谁要李三不喝酒，你大雪里来敲敲三更看！（冬天日子真短，夜真长。）李三的木棚子在雪下。木棚底下露一片砖地，雪所不及，还很干。老王吃过李三的狗肉，他说很香。侉奶奶的屋子这时真是孤，全世界一定都把它忘了。侉奶奶点不点灯？灯光在大雪的荒野上。这一冬天她衲了多少鞋底。她那个针拔子正好借人镊猪头上的毛！（猪眼皮上毛最多。）顾大娘一定跟她借过。借针拔子，顺便就在她小屋里谈谈，看她吃甚么，看看房子还结实不结实。——如果侉奶奶的小屋教雪压垮了，第一个一定是李三知道。李三去打更。一看，可了不得了！随后李三各处去说。——不至于，那间小屋看起来还好。——然而怎么说得定！——大和二和一定很快就会知道。他们要去看。他们很久没有看见侉奶奶了，自从下雪。二和紧握着大和的手……
Although it is winter, we still have many things to do during the day, and our bodies are active. When it gets dark, the fire turns red, (occasionally lifting the window curtains, and the lights are spread on the snow.) The snow stops,—— the snow gets heavier again.) We really just think; or talk, say what we think, and connect what we think with others. We think of the wilderness; think of wheat under the snow; wheat is planted at the end of the wilderness, and they are still green? think of hares and badger dogs; chase wild rabbits on the head of the red-haired grass city; every time I go to the grave, I have to see many badger dog holes along the way; I think of the pheasant frozen in the snow, I think of the fish under the ice,...... Is Li San sober? In winter, Li San is always full of alcohol. Who wants Li San not to drink, you come to knock on the third watch in the heavy snow! (The days are so short in winter, and the nights are so long.) Li San's wooden shed is under the snow. There is a brick floor under the wooden shed, which is out of reach of the snow and is still very dry. Lao Wang has eaten Li San's dog meat, and he said it is very fragrant. Grandma's house is really lonely at this time, and the whole world must have forgotten about it. Does Grandma light up the lights? The lights are in the wilderness of heavy snow. How many soles did she wear this winter? Her needle puller just borrowed the hair on the pig's head! (The pig has the most hair on its eyelids.) Aunt Gu must have borrowed it from her. Borrowing a needle puller, we talked in her hut by the way, saw what she ate, and saw if the house was still strong. ——If Grandma's hut teaches snow to be crushed, Li San must know first. Li San went to work the night watch. At first glance, it's amazing! Then Li San went everywhere to talk. ——No, that hut looks fine. ——But how can you say! ——Yamato Erwa will definitely know soon. They want to see it. They haven't seen Grandma Niewa for a long time, since it snowed. Erhe held Yamato's hand tightly......大和二和现在，他们一定也想。想许多百读不厌的事，除非他们有甚么新鲜事情好想。他们想野兔子，獾狗，野鸡，麦，李三，侉奶奶？他们那盏百灵机瓶子做的油灯点起来了，灯焰袅出一缕烟沫。石磨子冰冷冰冷，水缸里上冻了。顾大娘丢一块木柴在水缸里的，怕缸冻破了。顾大娘做鞋子。大和二和他爸爸，顾老板干甚么呢？——他的黑布棉袄上有许多皱折，里头落了许多灰，还有头皮。二和打盹了，他爸爸说：“不要睡！要睡上床睡！”他说不说？二和醒了，他才离开这一切，又被唤回来了，他睁开惺忪的眼睛，门外沙沙的正有个人走过。二和听，大和也听，他们妈妈也一响停针而听。那人一步一步的走，渐渐走远了。这是谁，这时候还在街上走？他们一起全有点寂寞，正在把寂寞注满，又有一种平安之感，一种谢意，他们排门缝里漏出一线一线的灯光。……
Yamato Erhe Now, they must also think. Think about many things that never get tired of reading, unless they have something new to think about. They think of hares, badger dogs, pheasants, Mai, Li San, and grandma? The oil lamp made of their lark machine bottle lit up, and a wisp of smoke and foam came out of the flame. The stone mill was cold and cold, and the water tank was frozen. Aunt Gu threw a piece of firewood in the water tank, afraid that the tank would freeze and break. Aunt Gu makes shoes. Yamato Er and his father, what is Boss Gu doing? ——There are many wrinkles on his black cloth cotton jacket, a lot of ash falling from it, and a scalp. Erhe took a nap, and his father said, "Don't sleep! Go to bed!" "Did he say it? Erhe woke up, he left all this, and was called back, he opened his eyes, and someone was rustling outside the door. Erhe listened, Yamato also listened, and their mother also stopped listening. The man walked step by step, gradually walking away. Who is this, still walking on the street at this time? They were all a little lonely together, filling the loneliness, and there was a sense of peace, a kind of gratitude, and a line of light leaked out of the cracks in their row doors. ……有时我做梦梦见大和二和，还有小莲；有时会梦见大和跟我打架，那是不可能的事。第二天起来我就告诉小莲听。小莲：“一起来说梦！”然而她还是听。

[1] 本篇原载1947年7月6日《经世日报》。
Sometimes I dream of Yamato Erhe and Xiaolian; sometimes I dream that Yamato fights with me, which is impossible. When I got up the next day, I told Xiaolian. Xiaolian: "Let's dream together!" However, she still listened. [1] This article was originally published in the "Jingshi Daily" on July 6, 1947.

戴车匠

戴车匠[1]
Dai Che Maker[1]“戴车匠”在我们不但是一个人，一间小店，还是一个地名。他住在东街与草巷相交地方。东街与草巷相交处大家称为草巷口。但对我们说起来这实在不够精确。虽然东街也还比不上别处的巷子大，但街与巷相交总就有四个“口”，左边右边，这边那边。大人们凡事都含胡，因为他们生活中只须这么含胡即可对付过去。我们可不成。比如：巷口街这边有个老太婆摆摊子，卖的是桃子，杏子，香瓜，柿饼，牙枣子，风荸荠，杨花萝卜，泥娃娃，啯啯鸡；对面也有一个老太婆，卖的是啯啯鸡，泥娃娃，（有好多种，）杨花萝卜，（我在别处虽亦见过这种水红色，粗长如指，杨花飞时挑出来卖，生嚼凉拌都脆爽细嫩无比的萝卜，可是没有吃过；我总觉不是我们故乡的那一种，仅仅略具形似而已，）风荸荠，牙枣子，桃子杏子，香瓜，还有柿饼子，完全一样！你说这怎么办？有时还好，可以随便；在她们生意都还不错，在有新货下市时候，她们彼此也都和颜悦色的时候，亲热得像对老姊妹的时候，那就无所谓，我们买谁的都觉得一样。这边那边，一样。有时，可就麻烦，又要处心积虑，又要临时见机，又要为自己利害打算，又要用自己几个钱和显明的倾向态度来打抱不平。而且我们之间意见常不一样。那就得辩论，甚至出恶言恶声，吵闹起来，要麻油拌芥菜，各有心中爱，各走各的路。完了，我们之间有一道鸿沟！要十分钟，或半点钟，或半天，甚至三两天，时间才填平了它，又志同道合，莫逆无间，不恨不轻视。这两个老太婆又有时这个显得比那个穷，有时那个显得比这个弱。有时这边得到姪儿一点支助，买了一堆骄傲的货色，盛气凌人，不可一世。有时那个的女儿给她作了件新毛蓝布褂子，她就觉得不屑与裤裆里都有补丁的人相较量。她们老是骂架，一骂一整天，老是那些话，骂骂，歇歇，又骂骂。作一笔买卖，数钱拣货；青菜汤送下一大碗干饭，这就有时间准备新的武器，聚了一堆她们自以为更泼剌淋漓的言语，投过去，抛回来，希望伤人要害。这对我们说起来，未免可厌，因为骂人都不好看。尤其她们相骂时，大都是坏天气，全世界都不舒服的时候。她们的生意都非常坏，摊子上尽是些陈旧干瘪的货品，又稀少可怜。她们的恨毒注在颓老之中，像下雨天城门口的泥泞。她们的肝火焚烧她们的太阳穴，她们的头发披下来，她们都无望无助，孤苦悽怆，哀哀欲绝。——为甚么没有人劝劝她们呢？你想想看，手放在口袋里，搓摩着温热的铜钱，我们何以为情？我们立着看了半天，渐渐已忘记了想买的东西；不想吃甚么，也不想玩甚么，为一种十分深沉黏著的痛楚所孕育，所教化。——有时，她们会扭住衣角和一点小小发髻打起来。一面低嘶诅咒一面打。她们都打不动了，然而她们用艰硬的瘦骨相冲撞，撕，咬，抓头发，拉破别人的衣服。一场心长力拙，松懈干枯的争斗。她们会有一天有一个打死的。不是死在人手上，自己站脚不稳，踉跄跄一交掼在石头角上碰破脑袋死去。……阿，不说这个吧。告诉你这些只是借此而告诉你虽是那么一街之隔可是距离多远。所以不能含胡。所以不能含胡的说是“草巷口”。草巷口一边是个旱烟店，另一边是戴车匠店。你看要是有个提小面人的来了，吹糖人的来了，耍木儡戏的来了，背负韦驮，化缘的游方僧人来了，走江湖挂水椀的来了，各种各样惊心动魄的人物事情在那里出现，我们飞奔着去看，你要是说“草巷口”，那多急人。你一说“戴车匠家”，就多省事明白。大家就一直去，不需东张西望。“戴车匠”，“戴车匠”，这在我们不是三个字，是相连不可分，成为一体的符号。戴车匠是一点，集聚许多东西，是一个中心，一个底子。这是我们生活中的一格，一区，一个本土和一个异国，我们的岁月的一个见证。我们说“戴车匠家”，不说“戴车匠家门前”。一则那么说太噜嗦，再我们似把门外这一切活动，一切景物情感都收纳到他的那间小店里去，似乎是属于它，为它所有；为他，为戴车匠所有了；虽然戴车匠的铺子那么那么小，戴车匠是不沾蘸甚么的那么一个人。戴车匠是一颗珠子，从水里拿出来，不留一滴。——正因为他是那么一个人吧。
"Dai Chejiang" is not only a person, a small shop, but also a place name. He lives at the intersection of East Street and Caoxiang. The intersection of East Street and Cao Lane is called Caoxiangkou. But for us, this is really not accurate enough. Although East Street is not as big as other alleys, there are always four "mouths" where streets intersect, left and right, here and there. Adults have beards in everything, because they only need to have beards like this in their lives to deal with the past. We can't. For example: there is an old woman on this side of Xiangkou Street, selling peaches, apricots, melons, persimmons, tooth dates, water chestnuts, poplar radish, mud dolls, and chicken; There is also an old woman opposite, selling chicken, mud dolls, (there are many kinds,) poplar radish, (although I have seen this kind of water red color elsewhere, thick and long as fingers, poplar flowers are picked out and sold when they fly, and the radishes are crisp and tender when chewed raw, but I have never eaten them; I always feel that it is not the one in our hometown, it is just slightly similar,) water chestnuts, tooth dates, peaches and apricots, melons, and persimmons, exactly the same! What do you think this should do? Sometimes it's okay, you can do whatever you want; When their business is not bad, when there are new goods on the market, when they are friendly with each other, and when they are affectionate like old sisters, it doesn't matter, we feel the same when we buy it. Here and there, the same. Sometimes, it can be troublesome, and you have to be deliberate, you have to wait for opportunities, you have to plan for your own interests, and you have to use your own money and obvious tendencies to fight injustice. And we often have different opinions. Then we have to debate, even speak ill, make noise, mix sesame oil with mustard greens, each have their own love, and go their own way. It's over, there is a gap between us! It takes ten minutes, or half an o'clock, or half a day, or even three or two days, for time to fill it, and they are like-minded, inseparable, and not hateful or despised. These two old women sometimes seem poorer than the other, and sometimes the other seems weaker than the other. Sometimes I get a little support from my nephew and buy a bunch of proud goods, domineering and invincible. Sometimes that daughter made her a new woolen blue cloth coat, and she felt disdainful of competing with people with patches in their crotches. They always scolded, scolded all day, and always scolded, scolded, rested, and scolded. Make a deal, count the money to pick the goods; The green vegetable soup sent a big bowl of dry rice, which gave them time to prepare new weapons, gathered a bunch of words that they thought were more splashy, threw them over, and threw them back, hoping to hurt people. This is annoying for us, because scolding people is not good-looking. Especially when they scold each other, most of them are bad weather and the whole world is uncomfortable. Their business is very bad, and the stalls are full of old and shriveled goods, and they are sparse and pitiful. Their hatred is poured into the old age, like mud at the gate of the city on a rainy day. Their liver fire burns their temples, their hair falls down, and they are hopeless, lonely and miserable, and mournful. ——Why didn't anyone persuade them? Think about it, with our hands in our pockets, rubbing warm copper coins, how can we feel sorry for them? We stood and watched for a long time, and gradually forgot what we wanted to buy; we didn't want to eat or play anything, but we were nurtured and educated by a very deep and sticky pain. ——Sometimes, they would twist the corners of their clothes and fight with a little bun. They whispered and cursed while fighting. They couldn't fight, but they clashed with hard and skinny bones, tearing, biting, scratching hair, and tearing other people's clothes. A long-hearted, clumsy, lax and dry fight. One of them will one day be killed. It's not that they die at the hands of others, they stand unsteadily, staggering and hitting their heads on the corners of stones and dying. …… Ah, let's not talk about this. I am telling you this just to tell you how far away it is even though it is so far apart. So you can't have a beard. So you can't say that it is "grass alley entrance". At the entrance of Caoxiang is a dry tobacco shop on one side, and on the other side is a car maker shop. You see, if a person with a small face comes, a sugar blower comes, a puppet performer comes, a wandering monk who carries a belt and alms, a person who hangs a water bowl on his back, and all kinds of thrilling characters and things appear there. As soon as you say "the car craftsman's house", you will understand how much trouble you have. Everyone just keeps going, no need to look around. "Dai Che Craftsman", "Dai Che Craftsman", these are not three words in us, they are inseparable and become a one. Dai Che Ji is a point, a gathering of many things, a center, a foundation. This is a testimony of our years, a grid, a district, a local and a foreign country. We say "Dai Che Maker's House", not "In front of Dai Che Cheng's house". One is too verbose, and then we seem to put all these activities outside the door, all the scenery and emotions into his small shop, which seems to belong to it and belong to it; for him, it is owned by Dai Che Shi; Although Dai Che Shi's shop is so small, Dai Che Shi is a person who is not involved in anything. Dai Chawler is a bead, taken out of the water without leaving a drop. ——Because he is such a person.（说这些毫无意思！既已说了，说了算数。）
我记得戴车匠的板壁上贴的一付小红春联，每年都是那么两句，极普通常见的两句：
室雅何须大
花香不在多
(It's meaningless to say this!) Since it has been said, it has been said. ） I remember the small red Spring Festival couplets pasted on the wall of the carmaker, which are two sentences every year, two very ordinary and common sentences: Why does the house need to be big The fragrance of flowers is not much虽是极普通常见，甚至教人觉得俗，俗得令人厌恶反感，可是贴在戴车匠家就有意义，合适，感人。虽然他那半间店面说不上雅不雅，而且除了过年插一枝山茶，端午菖蒲艾叶石榴花，八九月或者偶然一枝桂，一朵白荷以外，平常也极少插花。——插花的壶是总有一个的，老竹根，他自己车床上琢出来的，总供在一个极高的方几上。说是“供”，不是随便说，确是觉得那有一种恭敬，一种神圣，一种寄托和一种安慰，即使旁边没有那个小小的瓦香炉，后面不贴一小幅神像。我想我不是自以为然，确是如此。我想，你若是喜爱那个竹根壶，想花钱向他买来，戴车匠准是笑笑，“不卖的。”戴车匠一生没有遇过几个这样坚老奇怪的根节，一生也不会再为自己车旋一个竹壶。它供在那里已经多少年，拿去了你不是叫他那个家整个变了个样子？他没有想得太多，可是卖这个壶是他从来没有想到过的。他只有那么一句话，笑笑，“不卖的”。别的回答他不知道，他不考虑。你若是真的去要，他也高兴。因为有人喜爱他喜爱得成了习惯的东西，你就醅新了他的感情。他也感激你，但他只能说：“我给你留意吧，要再遇到这样的竹子，会留意的。”他当真会留意的，他忘不了。有了，他就作好，放在高高的地方，等你去发现，来拿。——你自然会发现，因为你天天经过，经过了总要看一看。他那个店面是真小。小，而充实。
Although it is very common and even makes people feel vulgar and disgusting, it is meaningful, appropriate and touching to stick it in the car craftsman's house. Although his half of the store is not elegant or indecent, and except for planting a branch of camellia during the New Year, a pomegranate flower with calamus and mugwort leaves during the Dragon Boat Festival, and occasionally a branch of osmanthus and a white lotus in August and September, there are usually very few flower arrangements. ——There is always a pot for flower arrangement, the old bamboo root, which he carved out from his lathe, and is always offered on a very high square table. When I say "offering", I don't mean casually, but I do feel that there is a kind of respect, a kind of sacredness, a kind of sustenance and a kind of comfort, even if there is no small tile incense burner next to it, and there is no small statue of a god attached to it. I don't think I'm self-righteous, it's true. I think if you love that bamboo root pot and want to spend money to buy it from him, Dai Cheshi must have smiled, "I won't sell it." "Dai Cheshi has never encountered a few such old and strange root joints in his life, and he will never spin a bamboo pot for himself again in his life. How many years has it been there for you, didn't you take it and make his home look different? He didn't think too much, but selling this pot was something he had never thought of. He only had one sentence, smiled, "I won't sell it." He didn't know anything else, and he didn't think about it. If you really want it, he will be happy. Because someone likes something that he has become accustomed to, you renew his feelings. He is also grateful to you, but he can only say, "Let me pay attention to you, if you encounter such bamboo again, you will pay attention." He really pays attention, he can't forget it. If he has it, he will make it and put it in a high place, waiting for you to find it and get it. ——You will naturally find it, because you pass by every day, and you always have to take a look when you pass by. His store is really small. Small, but full.小，而充实。堆着，架着，钉着，挂着，各种各样的东西。留出来的每一空间都是必须的。从这些空间里比从那些物件上更看出安排的细心，温情，思想，习惯，习惯的修改与新习惯的养成，你看出一个人怎么样过日子。
Small, but full. Piled up, framed, nailed, hanging, all kinds of things. Every space set aside is a must. From these spaces, you can see the care, warmth, thoughts, habits, modification of habits and the formation of new habits more than from those objects, and you can see how a person lives.当门是一具横放的榉木车床，又大又重，坚硬得无从想象可以用到甚么时候。它本身即代表了永远。那是永远也不会移动的，简直好像从地里长出来的，一个稳定而不表露的生命。这个车床没有问题比戴车匠岁数还要大，必是他父亲兼业师所传留下来的。超过需要的厚实是前代人制作法式。（我们看从前的许多东西老觉得一个可以改成两个三个用。）这个车床的形貌有些地方看起来不大讲究。有的因材就用，不拘小节，歪着扭着一点就听它歪着扭着一点，不削斫太多以求其平直，然而这无妨于它大体的俨然方正。用了这许多年了，许多不光致斧凿痕迹还摸得出来，可是接榫卡缝处吻投得真紧，真确切，仿佛天生的一个架子，不是一块块拼拢来的。多少年了，不摇，不晃，不走一点样！这个车床占了几乎二分之一的店堂，显然这是最重要的东西，其余一切全附属于它，且大半是从这个车床上作出来的。大车床里头是一个小车床。戴车匠作一点小巧东西则在小车床上。那就轻便得多，秀气得多，颜色也浅，常擦摩处呈牙黄色，光泽异常，木理依约可见，这是后来戴车匠自己手制的。再往里去，一伸手是那张供香炉竹壶高几。车床后面有仅容一人的走道。挨着靠墙而放的一条桌向里去，是内室了。想来是一床，一灯案，低梁小窗，紧凑而不过分杂乱。当有一小侧门，通出去是个狭长小天井。看见一点云，一点星光，下雨天雨水流在浅浅的阴沟里。天井中置水缸二口，一吃一用；煮饭烧茶风炉两只。墙阴凤仙花自开自落，砖缝里几丝草，在轻风中摇曳，贴地爬着几片马齿苋，有灰蓝色螟蛾飞息。凡此虽非目睹，但你见过许多这样格局的房子，原是极契熟的。其实即从外面情形，亦不难想象得知。——他吃饭用的碗筷放在那里呢？条桌上首墙上，他挖开了一块，四边钉板，安小门两扇，这就成了个柜子。分成几槅，不但碗筷，他自己的茶叶罐子烟荷包，重要小工具，祖传手绘的图样，订货的底子，跟他儿子的纸笔，女人的梳头家私，全都有了妥停放处。屈半膝在骨牌凳上，可以方便取得。我小时颇希望能有个房间有那样一个柜子，觉得非常有趣。他的白蜡杆子，黄杨段子，桑木枣木梨木材料则搁在高几上一个特制架上，堆得不十分整齐，然而有一种秩序，超乎整齐以上的秩序。（车匠所需木料不多，）架子的支脚翘出如壶嘴，就正好挂一个蝈蝈笼子！
When the door is a horizontal beech lathe, it is so big and heavy that it is impossible to imagine how long it can be used. It itself represents eternity. It will never move, it seems to have grown out of the ground, a stable and unrevealed life. There is no problem with this lathe, which is older than the age of the turner, and must have been passed down by his father and part-time master. Thickness that exceeds the need is the French style of previous generations. (We see that many things in the past always think that one can be changed to two or three.) The shape of this lathe seems to be not very particular in some places. Some are used according to the material, informal, twist a little and listen to it twist a little, and do not cut too much to make it straight, but this does not prevent it from being generally square. After using it for many years, many of the axe chisel marks can still be felt, but the kiss at the mortise and mortise is really tight, really accurate, as if it is a natural shelf, not pieced together. How many years, no shaking, no shaking, no going a little! This lathe occupies almost one-half of the shop, obviously this is the most important thing, everything else is attached to it, and most of it is made from this lathe. Inside the big lathe is a small lathe. The carmaker makes a little small thing on the small lathe. It is much lighter, much more delicate, the color is lighter, the place is often rubbed yellow, the luster is abnormal, and the wood grain is vaguely visible, which was later made by the carmaker himself. Further inside, when I stretched out my hand, I saw the bamboo pot for the incense burner. There is a walkway behind the lathe that can only accommodate one person. Next to a table placed against the wall, it is the inner room. I think it is a bed, a lamp table, and a small window with low beams, compact but not too cluttered. When there is a small side door, it leads out to a small narrow patio. I saw a little cloud, a little starlight, and rainwater flowed in a shallow gutter on a rainy day. There are two water tanks in the patio, one for eating and one for use; two stoves for cooking and tea. In the shade of the wall, impatiens bloom and fall by themselves, a few traces of grass in the cracks of the bricks, swaying in the breeze, crawling on the ground, and gray-blue borer moths flying. Although you have not witnessed this, you have seen many houses with this pattern, and they are very familiar. In fact, it is not difficult to imagine the situation from the outside. ——Where are the dishes and chopsticks he uses for eating? On the first wall of the table, he dug out a piece of nail boards on all four sides and two small doors, which became a cabinet. Divided into several buckets, not only bowls and chopsticks, but also his own tea jars, cigarette purses, important gadgets, ancestral hand-drawn patterns, order bases, his son's paper and pens, and women's hair combing furniture, all have a proper parking place. Bending half a knee on the domino stool is easily accessible. When I was a child, I wished there was a room with such a cabinet, which I found very interesting. His ash poles, boxwood segments, mulberry and jujube wood materials were placed on a special shelf on a high table, stacked not very neatly, but there was an order, beyond the order above neatness. (The carpenter doesn't need much wood,) The legs of the shelf are upright like a spout, just hanging a newt cage!戴车匠年纪还不顶大，如果他有时也想想老，想得还很昧暧，不管惨切安和，总离着他还远，不迫切。他不是那种一步即跌入老境的人，他只是缓缓的，从容的与他的时光厮守。是的，他已经过了人生的峰顶。有那么一点的，颤慄着，心沉着，急促的呼吸着，张张望望，徬徨不安，不知觉中就越过了那一点。这一点并不突出，闪耀，戴车匠也许纪念着，也许忽略了。这就是所谓中年。
Dai Cheshi is not yet old, if he sometimes thinks about old age, he is still very vague, no matter how tragic and peaceful he is, he is always far away from him, not urgent. He is not the kind of person who falls into old age in one step, he just slowly and calmly stays with his time. Yes, he has passed the peak of his life. There is a little bit of it, trembling, calm, breathing rapidly, looking around, hesitating, unconsciously passing that point. This point is not prominent, shining, Dai Cheshi may commemorate or ignore. I don't know if he is like his father. ——I'm sorry, but I told you about such a dull and dull trivial thing, without ups and downs, without any cutting structure, and none of them were finished. I'm really sorry. There is really no way, we are like this, a dull city, a city without structure, a silent city; the city is full of people like Dai Chawner; if that is considered an event, it is just such an event. ——Well, not necessarily, of course, next time we can say something else. I want to think about it.卅六年七月廿四日

年红灯（二）

年红灯（二）[1]
Red Light (2) [1]走出室门，总要抬头看看，为甚么要看呢，看甚么，——不知道，也许是想看看天，我曾经住过一个地方，天蓝起来非常的蓝，有的时候多雨。然而看到的却是马路对面高楼屋顶上一个铁架子，一个广告铁架子。这东西，无话可说，很伟大，竖那么一个铁架子的工程可以盖好我的屋子的罢。架子上本来有几个大字，每个字比一间房子都大，最近，天天有人搭了长梯子在上面工作。人在上头那么小，看他们在上头动，好像动得也很慢，很轻微，仿佛完全不是一个普普通通像我们一样的人，因为比例不对，知道，他们是在油漆那几个字，而且这两天在装年红灯了。——是谁想起来装的，我坐在椅子里，也可以看见，很高兴一抬头总看见他们在那里，有时竟然看得出他们在谈话，抽烟。我坐在椅子里，手里工作告一段落，抽烟，或喝一杯茶，悠然而自窗口看出去。
When I walk out of the door, I always have to look up, why do I want to look, what ,—— I don't know, maybe I want to see the sky, I once lived in a place, the sky was very blue, sometimes it was rainy. However, what I saw was an iron shelf on the roof of a high-rise building across the road, an advertising iron shelf. This thing, there is nothing to say, it is great, the project of erecting such an iron frame can build my house. There were originally a few big characters on the shelf, each word was bigger than a house, and recently, someone built a long ladder to work on it every day. The people are so small on top, looking at them moving on top, it seems that they are moving very slowly, very slightly, as if they are not ordinary people like us at all, because the proportions are wrong, you know, they are painting those words, and they have been installing red lights for the past two days. ——Who thought of it and pretended, I sat in the chair, and I could see it, and I was happy to see them there when I looked up, and sometimes I could see them talking and smoking. I sat in the chair, my work was over, smoking, or drinking a cup of tea, and I looked out the window leisurely.一天晚上，亮了，那些年红灯亮了，红光蓝光交流转换。先是小字一个一个生出来，一排排现齐了，于是划然而呈出几个大字，又抹掉似的不见了，又重新再来一遍，红光蓝光交流的落在我阶前，屋顶，我的书，我的纸，我的手指上。
One night, it was lit, the red light was on in those years, and the red light and blue light exchanged and converted. At first, the small characters were born one by one, and the rows appeared in rows, so a few big characters were suddenly presented, and then they disappeared as if they were erased, and then they did it again, and the red and blue lights fell in front of my steps, on the roof, my books, my paper, and my fingers.这几个工人他们一定也看见了，他们一定看的。
They must have seen these workers, they must have seen it.而我在马路上看见一个人，他看广告上那些灯，从他看的样子，我毫不怀疑的相信他即是那些工人之一，白天他还在那个架子上工作的。那是他的作品，我看了他一会，——他心里是甚么感觉？
And I saw a man on the road, he looked at the lights on the advertisement, and from the way he looked, I had no doubt that he was one of those workers, and he was still working on that shelf during the day. It was his work, and I looked at him for a while,—— what did he feel?“每天都喜欢到江边来玩吗？”
“是的，这里比较清净！”
“对热闹不感兴趣？”
“女孩子固然都喜欢热闹，可是我觉得只有静时候才是真正快乐！”
“这是各人的个性，也许你的心是喜欢幽静的。”
"Do you like to go to the river every day to play?" "Yes, it's relatively clean here!" "Not interested in the excitement?" "Of course, girls like to be lively, but I think only when it's quiet is really happy!" "This is everyone's personality, maybe your heart likes to be quiet."“你觉得这地方好吗？”
"Do you think this place is good?"“大概是因为市区的空气太浮嚣，每天总想到这里来看看不断地东流的水，在这里我总可以从凝静的心里认识到人生的真谛，譬如江心的浪罢！每个浪花都负有它底使命，一个接连一个，它们永远的没有止境，也永远的不需要后退！”
"Probably because the air in the city is too noisy, I always think of coming here every day to see the water flowing eastward, and here I can always realize the true meaning of life from my quiet heart, like the waves in the heart of the river! Every wave has its underlying mission, one after another, they are never endless, and they never need to retreat! ”“这就是你对于人生的认识吗？可是我们生在现代的社会里，我们所负的使命不是比浪花更重吗？”
“也可以这么说，哦！你觉得这畸形的社会，不太令人悲伤吗？”
Is this what you know about life? But we are born in a modern society, and our mission is not heavier than the waves? ” "You can also say that, oh! Do you think this deformed society is not too sad? ”“不，只有弱者才悲哀，我们是青年，应该给人类争取幸福，也就是为自己争取幸福！”她严肃地说。……
于是他和她从此构成了一段Romance。
"No, only the weak are sad, we are young people, we should strive for happiness for mankind, that is, for ourselves!" She said seriously. …… So he and she formed a Romance from then on.在江边芦花开得正茂盛的时候，他俩的爱情也正如花儿一样的浓厚而洁白。
When the reeds by the river were blooming, their love was as thick and white as the flowers.四个月后寒冷给他带来了不幸。她失踪了。没有一个字给他，并且事先也没有一点出走的破绽。他伤心，他为人心的无恒而痛哭，他格外地沉默了，连平常藉以解闷江边也不愿去，为的是免得引起自己的愁思而增加痛苦与悲哀。
Four months later, the cold brought him misfortune. She was missing. Not a word was given to him, and there was no flaw in advance. He was sad, he wept bitterly for the impermanence of the human heart, he was particularly silent, and he did not even want to go to the river to relieve his boredom, so as not to arouse his sorrow and increase his pain and sorrow.第二年的春天，春风带来了野蔷薇的气息，他意外地接到了她底来信，报告了她“旅途”的平安，他恢复了以前对她的敬爱而且更加地佩服她崇拜她了！但是他不能写一封信，去表示他对她的崇拜与佩服，因为她没有告诉他有一定的通讯地址。
In the spring of the following year, the spring breeze brought the scent of wild roses, and he unexpectedly received a letter from her reporting the safety of her "journey", and he regained his previous love for her and admired her even more! But he could not write a letter to express his admiration and admiration for her, because she did not tell him that he had a certain correspondence address.来信里有一段是这样的。
There is a paragraph in the letter that reads.“……朋友！生命就是创造，有创造才有快乐！我不愿做一朵鲜花供给人玩赏，我要像灿烂的旭日普照四方，我不愿做水上的浮萍，随波逐流，我要学自由的鸟儿，任意飞翔，人生不需要罗绮包裹，我要生命上有血泪的创伤，眼前的安乐是靠不住的，朋友！人生需要求永久的朗照，不要一时的彩异。
“…… Friend! Life is creation, there is happiness with creation! I don't want to be a flower for people to enjoy, I want to be like a brilliant rising sun shining in all directions, I don't want to be duckweed on the water, go with the flow, I want to learn to be a free bird, fly freely, life does not need to be wrapped in Luo Qi, I want to have the trauma of blood and tears in life, and the comfort in front of me is unreliable, friend! Life needs to seek permanent brightness, not temporary colors.“现在我已经获得了生命的真谛，实现了我理想的一部分，我要牺牲自己去为大众服务，自从去年别后，我就开始了我底实际工作，我加入了长征的队伍，向世界和平追求！
"Now that I have gained the true meaning of life and realized part of my ideals, I want to sacrifice myself to serve the public, since I parted last year, I have started my practical work, I joined the Long March, and pursued world peace!“朋友！努力你底学业吧！将来继我之后……”
一直到现在，他没有接到她第二封信，也更不知道她现在甚么地方。
这是一个梦么！
"Friend! Work your studies! ...... will succeed me in the future." Until now, he has not received a second letter from her, let alone where she is now. Is this a dream?每到秋临大地的时候，他总不免从记忆里拾回这一个美丽的慷慨的破碎了的梦！

牙疼

牙疼[1]
Every time autumn comes to the earth, he can't help but pick up this beautiful and generous broken dream from his memory! [1] This article was originally published in the Ningbo Daily on August 18, 1947, and is a continuation of the author's old work with the same title. Toothache[1]我的牙齿好几年前就开始龋蛀了。我知道它真的不一点都没有坏，是因为它时常要发炎作痛。“牙疼不是病，疼起来要人命，”说得一点不错。好家伙，真够瞧的。一直懒得去看医生，因为怕麻烦。说老实话，我这人胆子小，甚么事都怯得很。医牙，我没有经验，完全外行。这想必有许多邮局银行一样的极难搞得明白的手续吧。一临到这种现代文明的杰作的手续，我张皇失措，窘态毕露，十分可笑，无法遮掩。而且我从来没有对牙医院牙医士有过一分想象。他们用甚么样的眼睛看人？那个房间里飘忽着一种甚么感觉？我并不“怕”，我小时候生过一次对口，一个近视得很厉害的老医生给我开刀，他眼镜丢了好几年，眯朦胧之中，颤颤巍巍为我划了个口子；我不骗你，骗你干甚么，他没用麻药；我哼都没哼一声，只把口袋里带的大蜜枣赶紧塞一个到口里去，抬一抬头看看正用微湿泪光的眼睛看我的父亲。我不去医牙完全是不习惯，不惯到一个生地方，不惯去见一丝毫不清楚他底细的人。——这跟我不嫖妓实出于同一心理。我太拘谨，缺少一点产生一切浪漫故事的闯劲。轻重得失那么一权衡，我怎么样都还是宁愿一次又一次的让它疼下去。
My teeth started to decay several years ago. I know it's really not bad at all, because it is often inflamed and painful. "A toothache is not a disease, it hurts and kills," he said a little better. Good guy, it's worth seeing. I have been too lazy to go to the doctor for fear of trouble. To be honest, I am a timid person and afraid of everything. I have no experience in dentistry, and I am completely a layman. This must be a procedure that is very difficult to understand like many post offices and banks. When I came to the formalities of this masterpiece of modern civilization, I was panicked and embarrassed, very ridiculous and unable to hide it. And I had never imagined a dentist in a dental hospital. What kind of eyes do they look at? What kind of feeling is floating in that room? I am not "afraid", I gave birth to a counterpart when I was a child, an old doctor with severe myopia operated on me, he lost his glasses for several years, squinted in haze id_0000, trembling and made a hole for me; I don't lie to you, why are you lying to me, he didn't use anesthetics; I didn't snort, I just quickly stuffed a big date in my pocket into my mouth, and looked up to look at my father who was looking at me with slightly wet tears. I'm completely unused to not going to dentistry, I'm not used to going to a place of birth, and I'm not used to meeting people who don't know the slightest bit of his details. ——This is the same mentality as not prostituting me. I am too restrained and lack a little bit of enthusiasm to produce all romantic stories. With such a trade-off between gains and losses, I would rather let it hurt again and again.初初几次，沉不住气，颇严重了一下。因为看样子，一点把握都没有，不知道一疼要疼多少时候，疼到一个甚么程度。慢慢经过仗阵，觉得也不过如此。“既有价钱，总好讲话。”牙是生出来的，疼的是我自己，又不是我要它疼的，似乎无庸对任何人负责，因此心安理得。既然心安理得，就无所谓了。——我也还有几个熟人朋友，虽未必痛痒相关，眼看着我挤眼咧嘴，不能一点无动于衷。这容易，我不在他们面前，在他们面前少挤挤咧咧就是了。单就这点说，我很有绅士风度。事实上连这都不必。朋友中有的无牙疼经验，子非鱼他不明白其中滋味，看到的不过是我的眼睛在那儿挤，嘴在那儿咧而已，自无所用其恻隐之心。多数牙也疼过，（我们那两年吃的全差不多，）则大半也是用跟我一样的方法对付过去。忍过事则喜，于此有明证焉。他们自己也从未严重，当然不必婆婆妈妈的来同情慰问我。想来极为惋惜，那时为甚么不成立一个牙疼俱乐部，没事儿三数人聚一聚，集体牙疼一下呢，该是多好玩的事？当时也计划过，认为有事实上的困难。（牙疼呀，你是我们的誓约，我们的纹徽，我们的国，我们的城。）慰情聊胜无，我们就不时谈谈各人牙疼的风格。这也难得很。说来说去，不外是从发痒的小腹下升起一种狠，足够把桌上的砚台，自己的手指咬下一段来；腿那么踡曲起来，想起弟弟生下来几天被捺下澡盆洗身子，想起自己也那么着过；牙疼若是画出来，一个人头，半边惨绿，半爿炽红，头上密布古象牙的细裂纹，从脖子到太阳穴扭动一条斑斓的小蛇，蛇尾开一朵（甚么颜色好呢）的大花，牙疼可创为舞，以黑人祭天的音乐伴奏，哀楚欲绝，低抑之中透出狂野无可形容。……以此为题，谈话不够支持两小时。此可见我们既缺乏自我观照，又复拙于言词，不会表现。至于牙疼之饶有诗意，则同人等皆深领默会的。曾经写过两行，写的是春天：
At first, I couldn't calm down a few times, and it was quite serious. Because it seemed, I was not sure at all, and I didn't know how long it would hurt and how much it hurt. Slowly passing through the battle, I felt that it was nothing more than that. "It's always good to talk if there is a price." Teeth are born, and it hurts myself, not because I want it to hurt, so I don't seem to be responsible for anyone, so I feel at ease. Since I feel at ease, it doesn't matter. ——I also have a few acquaintances and friends, although they may not be related to pain and itch, and I can't be indifferent at all when they see me grinning. It's easy, I don't have to be in front of them, just squeeze less in front of them. In this alone, I am very gentlemanly. In fact, I don't even have to do this. Some of my friends have no experience of toothache, and Zi Feiyu doesn't understand the taste, all he sees is my eyes squeezing there and my mouth grinning there, and I don't need to use my compassion. Most of my teeth also hurt, and most of them used the same method as me to deal with them. If you endure it, you will be happy, and this is clearly proven. They themselves have never been serious, and of course they don't need my mother-in-law to sympathize with me. I think it's a pity that why didn't a toothache club be set up at that time, and how fun it would be to get together with three or more people to get together and have a collective toothache? At that time, I also planned that there were practical difficulties. (Toothache, you are our oath, our emblem, our country, our city.) Comforting and talking is better than nothing, we will talk about everyone's toothache style from time to time. This is also very rare. Speaking of which, it is nothing more than a kind of ruthlessness rising from under the itchy lower abdomen, enough to bite off the inkstone on the table and one's own fingers; the legs are so twisted, thinking of my brother being pressed down in the bathtub to wash his body a few days after he was born, and remembering that he was also so bad; If the toothache is drawn, a person's head, half of it is pale green, half red, the head is densely covered with fine cracks of ancient ivory, a colorful little snake twists from the neck to the temples, and the snake's tail blooms a big flower (what color is good), the toothache can be created into a dance, accompanied by the music of the black sacrifice to the sky, the sorrow is excruciating, and the wildness is indescribable in the depression. …… On this topic, the conversation is not enough to support two hours. This shows that we lack both self-observation and are clumsy in words, and we cannot express ourselves. As for the poetry of toothache, everyone deeply understands it. I once wrote two lines, about spring:看一个孩子放也放不上他的风筝，
独自玩弄着一半天的比喻和牙疼。
Look at a child who can't fly his kite, Playing with metaphors and toothaches for half a day alone.诗写得极坏，唯可作死心塌地的承认牙疼的艺术价值的明证耳。我们接受上天那么多东西，难道不能尽量学习欣赏这个可遇而不可求的奇境吗？嚇。
The poem is written extremely badly, but it can only be used as a clear proof of the artistic value of toothache with a dead heart. We accept so many things from heaven, can't we try to learn to appreciate this wonderland that can be encountered but not sought? Scared.但人不能尽在艺术中呼吸，也还有许多实际问题。首先，牙一疼影响作事。这个东西解又解不下来，摔又摔不掉，赶又赶不走像夏天黏在耳根的营营的蚊雷，有时会教人失去平和宁静的；想不得，坐不住，半天写不出两行。有一回一个先生教我做一篇文章，到了交卷限期，没有办法，我只有很惭愧的把一堆断稿和一个肿得不低的腮拿给他看。他一句话不说，出去为我买了四个大黄果，令我感动得像个小姑娘，想哭。——这回事情我那先生不知还记不记得？再有，牙疼了不好吃东西，要喝牛奶，买一点软和的点心，又颇有困难。顾此失彼，弄得半饱半饥，不大愉快。而且这也影响工作。最重要的，后来一到牙疼，我就不复心安理得，老是很抱歉似的了。因为这不复是我一个人的事情。有一个人要来干涉我的生活，我一疼，她好像比我还难过。她跟我那位先生一样好几个牙都是拔了又装过的。于是就老想，那一天一定去拔，去医。
But people can't breathe in art, and there are still many practical problems. First of all, a toothache affects work. This thing can't be solved, it can't be dropped, and it can't be driven away, like the mosquito thunder sticking to the base of the ear in summer, sometimes teaching people to lose peace and tranquility; I can't think of it, I can't sit still, and I can't write two lines in a long day. Once a gentleman taught me to write an article, and when the deadline came to submit the paper, there was no way, so I had to show him a bunch of broken manuscripts and a swollen cheek with shame. Without saying a word, he went out and bought four rhubarb fruits for me, which moved me like a little girl and wanted to cry. ——Does my husband remember this incident? Also, it is quite difficult to have a toothache and not eat good food, drink milk, and buy some soft snacks. Taking care of one thing and losing the other, I was half full and half hungry, and it was not very happy. And it also affects my work. The most important thing is that when I have a toothache, I don't feel at ease and always feel sorry. Because this is no longer my business. There is someone who wants to interfere in my life, and when I hurt, she seems to be even sadder than me. Like my husband, she had several teeth extracted and installed. So I always thought that I would definitely go to the doctor that day.这时两边的牙多已次第表演过，而左下第二臼齿则完全成了一口井。不时缤纷的崩下一片来，有的半透明，有的枯白色，有的发灰，吃汤团时常裹在米粉馅心之间，吐出来实不大雅观。而且因为一直不用左边的牙，右边嚼东西就格外著力，日子久了，我的脸慢慢显得歪起来。天天看见的不大觉着，我自己偶尔照镜，明白有数。到了有一次去照相馆拍照，照相技师让我偏一点坐，说明因为我的脸两边不大一样。我当时一想，这家伙不愧是个照相技师，对于脸有研究，有经验！而我的脸一定也歪到一个不容忽视的地步了。我真不愿意脸上有特色引人注意，而且也还有点爱漂亮的，这个牙既然总要收拾的，就早点吧。——当然我的脸歪或许另有原因。但我找得出来的“借口”是牙。
At this time, most of the teeth on both sides have been performed one after another, and the second molar on the lower left has completely become a well. From time to time, it collapses colorfully, some are translucent, some are withered white, and some are gray. And because I have not used my left tooth, I chew things on the right side with extra effort, and as time goes by, my face gradually looks crooked. I don't feel much about what I see every day, but I occasionally look in the mirror and understand it. When I went to the photo studio to take pictures, the photographer asked me to sit a little later, indicating that the two sides of my face were not the same. I thought at the time, this guy is worthy of being a photographer, with research and experience in faces! And my face must have been crooked to the point where it cannot be ignored. I really don't want to have a distinctive face that attracts attention, and I also love to be beautiful, since this tooth always needs to be cleaned, let's do it early. ——Of course, there may be another reason for my crooked face. But the "excuse" I can find is the teeth.那个时候，我在昆明。昆明有个三一圣堂，三一圣堂有个修女，为人看牙。都说她治得很好，不敲钉，人还满可爱的；联大同学去，她喜欢跟你聊，聊得很有意思。多有人劝我一试。我除了这里不晓得有别的地方，颇想去看看那个修女去了。不过我总觉得牙医不像别的医生。我很愿意我父亲或儿子是个医士，我喜欢医生的职业风度。可我不大愿意他们是牙医。一则医生有老的，有年轻的，而我所见的牙医好像总是那么大年纪，仿佛既不会大起来，也没有小过，富有矿物性。牙医生我总还以为不要学问，就动动家伙，是一种手艺人。我总忘不了撑个大布伞，挂个大葫芦，以一串血渍淋漓的（我小时疑心是从死人口里拔下来的）特别长大牙齿作招牌的江湖郎中。一个女的，尤其一个修道女做这种拿刀动钳子事情，我以为不大合适。“拔”，这是个多厉害的字！但这是她的事，我管不了。有时我脑子清醒，也把医牙与宗教放在一起想过，以为可以有连通地方。我记得很清楚，我曾经三次有叩那个颇为熟习的小门的可能。第一次，我痛了好几天，到了晚上，S陪着我，几乎是央求了，让我明天一定去看。我也下了决心。可第二天，天一亮，她来找我，我已经披了衣服坐在床上给她写信了。信里第一句是：
At that time, I was in Kunming. There is a Trinity Church in Kunming, and there is a nun in Trinity Church who takes care of people's teeth. They all say that she treats very well, does not hammer , and is very cute; she likes to talk to you and has a very interesting conversation. Many people advise me to give it a try. I don't know of any other place but here, and I really want to see the nun. But I always feel that dentists are not like other doctors. I would love that my father or son is a doctor, and I like the professional demeanor of doctors. But I don't want them to be dentists. One doctor is old and young, and the dentists I see always seem to be so old, as if they are neither big nor small, full of minerals. I always thought that dentists were a kind of craftsman who didn't want to learn, so they moved guys. I can't forget the charlatan who held a big cloth umbrella, hung a big gourd, and used a string of blood-stained (I suspected it was pulled out of a dead mouth) with specially grown teeth as a signboard. I don't think it's appropriate for a woman, especially a nun to do this kind of thing with a knife and pliers. "Pull", what a powerful word! But this is her business, I can't control it. Sometimes I have a clear mind, and I also think about medicine and dentistry together, thinking that there can be a connection. I remember very clearly that I knocked on that familiar door three times. The first time, I was in pain for several days, and at night, S was with me, almost begging me to go see it tomorrow. I also made up my mind. But the next day, at dawn, she came to me, and I had already put on my clothes and sat on the bed to write to her. The first sentence in the letter was:“赞美呀，一夜之间消褪于无形的牙疼。”
"Praise for the invisible toothache that disappeared overnight."她知道我脾气，既不疼了，决不肯再去医的，还是打主意给我弄点甚么喜欢吃的东西去。第二次，又疼了，肿得更高，那一块肉成了一粒樱桃色的葡萄。不等她说，我先开口，“去，一定去。”可是去了，门上一把锁，是个礼拜天。礼拜天照例不应诊。我拍掌而叫，“顶好！”吃了许多舒发药片，也逐渐落了下去如潮，那个疼。我们那时住在乡下，进城一趟不容易，趁便把准备医牙的钱去看了一场电影。我向她保证，一定看得很舒服，比医医牙更有益，果然。第三次，则教我决定了不再去了，那位修道女回了国，换了另一个人在那里挂牌。不单是我，S也是，一阵子惆怅。她比我还甚，因为修女给她看过牙，她们认得。她一直想去看看她，有一个小纪念礼物想在她临走之前送她带去的。人走了，只有回去了。回去第一件事是在许多书里翻出那个修女所送的法文书简集，想找出夹在里头的她的本国地址。可是找来，找去，找不着。这本书曾经教一个人拿去看过，想是那时遗落了。这比牙疼令人难过得多。我们说，一本精致一点的通讯册是不可少的，将来一定要买。战争已经结束了，人家都已返国了，我们也有一个时候会回乡的吧。
She knew that my temper was not painful, and she would never go to the doctor again, so she still made up her mind to get me something I liked to eat. The second time, it hurt again, the swelling was even higher, and the piece of meat became a cherry-colored grape. Without waiting for her to speak, I spoke first, "Go, I must go." But when I went, the door was locked, and it was Sunday. I didn't go to the doctor as usual. I clapped my hands and shouted, "Okay!" After taking a lot of hair relief pills, it gradually fell like a tide, and it hurt. We lived in the countryside at that time, and it was not easy to go to the city, so we took the money to prepare dental care to watch a movie. I promised her that it would be very comfortable to watch, and it would be more beneficial than medical treatment, sure enough. The third time I decided not to go, the nun returned to China and put up a sign there with another person. Not only me, but also S, I was sad for a while. She was even more than me, because the nun had seen her teeth and they recognized her. She had always wanted to see her, and there was a small souvenir that she wanted to give her before she left. People left, only went back. The first thing I did when I went back was to dig up the collection of French documents given by the nun among many books, trying to find her home address sandwiched in it. But I searched for it, I couldn't find it. This book was once taught to a person to read, and I think it was lost at that time. It was much sadder than a toothache. We said that a more refined communication book is indispensable, and we must buy it in the future. The war is over, people have returned to China, and we will return to our hometowns at some point.还好，又陆陆续续疼了半年，疼得没有超过记录，我们当真有机会离开云南了。S回福建省亲，我只身来到上海。上海既不是我的家乡，而且与我呆了前后七年的昆明不同。到上海来干甚么呢？你问我，我问谁去！找得出的理由是来医牙齿了。S临别，满目含泪从船上扔下一本书来，书里夹一纸条，写的是：
Fortunately, it hurt for another half a year, and the pain did not exceed the record, and we really had a chance to leave Yunnan. S returned to Fujian to visit relatives, and I came to Shanghai alone. Shanghai is not my hometown, and it is different from Kunming, where I stayed for seven years. What are you doing in Shanghai? You ask me, I ask who to go! The reason I found was that I came to treat my teeth. Before leaving, S threw a book from the boat with tears in his eyes, and a note was sandwiched in it, which read:“这一去，可该好好照顾自己了。找到事，借点薪水，第一是把牙治一治去。”
感激我的师友，他们奔走托付，（还不告诉我，）为我找到一个事。我已经做了半年多，而且我一个牙齿也拔掉了。
"It's time to take good care of yourself. Find something, borrow some salary, the first is to get rid of your teeth. ” I am grateful to my teachers and friends, who went to entrust me and found something for me. I have been doing it for more than half a year, and I have had one of my teeth removed.轻拈慢拨了几回，终于来了一个暴风式的旋律。我用舌头舔舔我那块肉，我摸不到我自己，肿把我自己跟自己隔开了。我看别人工作那么紧张，那么对得起那份薪水，我不好意思请假。我跟学生说，因为牙不大舒服，说话不大清楚，脑子也不顶灵活，请他们原谅我。下了课，想想，还是看医生。前些时我跟一个朋友的母亲谈起过我的牙疼，她说她认得一个牙医，去年给她治了好几回，人蛮好的，我想请她为我介绍一下。我支了二十万块钱理直气壮的去了。
After a few strokes, a stormy melody finally came. I licked my piece of flesh with my tongue, I couldn't touch myself, and the swelling separated me from myself. I saw that other people were so nervous at work, so worthy of that salary, I was embarrassed to ask for leave. I told the students that because their teeth were not very comfortable, they couldn't speak clearly, and their brains were not flexible, so I asked them to forgive me. After class, I thought about it, I still went to the doctor. Some time ago, I talked to a friend's mother about my toothache, she said that she knew a dentist, who treated her several times last year, and she was quite good, I wanted to ask her to introduce me to me. I paid 200,000 yuan and went confidently.哈，我终于正式做了个牙齿病人！也怪，怎么牙医都是广东人，不是姓梁就是姓麦，再不就姓甘！我这位姓梁。他虽然有一种职业的关心，职业的温和，职业的安静谦虚，职业的笑，但是人入世不很深，简直似乎比我还年轻些，一个小孩子。候诊室里挂几张画，看得过去。嗐！有一本纪德的书呢。我在沙发上坐了一会，看了几页书，叫我了。进去，首先我对那张披挂穿插得极其幽默的椅子有兴趣。我看他拉拉这，动动那，谨慎而“率”，我信任他。我才一点都不紧张。我告诉他我这个牙有多少年历史，现在已残败不可收拾，得一片一片的拈出来，恐怕相当麻烦吧。我微有歉意，仿佛我早该来让他医，就省事多了。他唯唯答应，细心的检视一遍之后，说“要拔，没有别的办法了。”那还用说！给我用药棉洗了洗，又说一句，两万块。别人要两万五，×老太太介绍，少一点。我简直有点欢喜又有点失望了，就这么点数目。我真想装得老一点，说“孩子，拔吧。”打了麻药针，他问我麻不麻。甚么叫“麻”呢，我没有麻过的经验，但觉得隔了一层，我就点头。他利利落落的动钳子了。没有费甚么事，一会儿工夫牙离了我，掉在盘子里。分两块，还相当大，看样子傻里瓜几，好像没睡醒。我看不出它有甚么调皮刁钻。我猜它已经一根一根的如为水腐蚀得精瘦的桥桩，是完全错误。于此种种，得一教训，即凡事不可全凭想象。梁医生让我看了牙，问我“要不要？”唔？要它干甚么？我笑了笑。我想起一个朋友在昆明医院割去盲肠，医生用个小玻璃瓶子装了酒精把割下来的一段东西养在里头，也问他“要不要？”他斜目一看，问医生“可以不可以炒了吃？”我这两块牙不见得可以装在锦盒里当摆设吧，我摇摇头。“当”的一声，牙扔在痰盂里了。我知道，这表示我身体中少了一点东西了，这是无法复原的。有人应当很痛惜，很有感触。我没有，我只觉得轻松。稍为优待自己一下，我坐了三轮车回来。车上我想，一切如此简单，下回再有人拔牙，我愿意为他去“把场”。
Ha, I finally officially became a dental patient! It's also strange, why are all dentists from Guangdong, either surnamed Liang or Mai, or even Gan! My surname is Liang. Although he has a professional concern, a gentle profession, a quiet and modest profession, and a professional smile, he is not very deep in the world, and he seems to be younger than me, a child. There are a few paintings hanging in the waiting room, which can be seen. Alas! There is a book by Gide. I sat on the sofa for a while, read a few pages, and called me. When I went in, first of all, I was interested in the chair with extremely humorous drapes. I watched him pull this, move that, be cautious and "rateful", and I trusted him. I wasn't nervous at all. I told him how old my tooth was, and now it was out of control, and it would be quite troublesome to pull it out piece by piece. I apologized slightly, as if I should have come to let him treat me a long time ago, which would have saved me a lot of trouble. He reluctantly agreed, and after carefully examining it, he said, "If you want to pull it out, there is no other way." "Needless to say! I washed it with medicinal cotton, and then said, 20,000 yuan. Others asked for 25,000 yuan, × the old lady introduced, a little less. I was a little happy and a little disappointed, just like that. I really wanted to pretend to be older and say, "Child, pull it out." After the anesthetic injection, he asked me if I was numb. What is "hemp", I have no experience with numbness, but I feel that there is a layer apart, so I nodded. He moved the tongs neatly. It didn't take much effort, and after a while, the teeth left me and fell on the plate. Divided into two pieces, it was quite large, and it looked like it was stupid, as if it hadn't woken up. I couldn't see anything naughty about it. I guess it was completely wrong to have a bridge pile that was corroded by water one by one. In all this, there is a lesson, that is, everything cannot be based on imagination. Dr. Liang asked me to look at my teeth and asked me, "Do you want it?" "Hmm? What do you want it for?" I smiled. I remembered a friend who had his appendix cut off in Kunming Hospital, and the doctor used a small glass bottle to fill the cut piece of alcohol in it, and asked him, "Do you want it?" He squinted and asked the doctor, "Can I fry it and eat it?" "My two teeth may not be able to be used as decorations in a brocade box, I shook my head." Dang", and the tooth was thrown into the spittoon. I know that this means that something is missing in my body, which cannot be restored. Someone should be very sorry and touched. I don't, I just feel relaxed. After giving myself a little favor, I took a tricycle back. In the car, I thought that everything was so simple, and the next time someone pulled out a tooth, I would be willing to "take care of it" for him.第二天第三天我又去换了换药，梁医生说，很好，没有事了。原来有点零碎牙的地方，用舌尖探了探，空空的，不大习惯。长出一块新肉，肉很软，很嫩，有如蛤蜊。肉长得那么快，我有点惊奇。我这个身体里还积蓄不少机能，可以供我挥霍，神妙不可思议，多美！我好像还舍不得离开那张躺着很舒服的椅子，这比理发店的椅子合乎理想得多。他这屋里的阳光真好，亮得很。我半年没见过好好的太阳，我那间屋子整天都是黄昏。看一看没有别的病人，静静的，瓶里花香，我问梁医生“你没有甚么事吧？我可以不可以抽一枝烟？”他不抽烟，给我找了个火。我点着烟，才抽了一口，我决不定是跟他谈纪德的《地粮》对于病人的影响还是问问他到上海来多少时候，有时是不是寂寞。而梁开口了：“你牙齿坏了不少，我给你检查检查看。”好嚜。他用一根长杆子拨拨弄弄，（一块不小的石粒子迸出来，）他说“你有八个牙须要收拾，一个要装，两个补；三个医一医，医了补；另外两个，因为补那个牙，须锉一锉，修一修。”他说得不错，这些牙全都表演过。他在一张纸上加加减减，改改涂涂，像个小学生做算术，凑得数凑不上来，我真想帮他一手。最后算出来了，等于24万。算着算着，我觉得真是不能再少了，而一面头皮有点痒起来。我既感激又抱歉。感激他没有用算盘，我最怕看人打算盘打得又快又准确。抱歉的是我一时没有那么多钱。我笑了笑，说“月底我再来吧。”我才抽了一口的那根香烟，因为他要检查牙，取下放在烟灰牒里的，已经全烧完了。看了它一眼，我可该走了。
The next day and the third day I went to change the dressing again, and Dr. Liang said, it's fine, it's okay. The place where there were a few broken teeth was probed with the tip of my tongue, empty, not used to it. A piece of new meat grew out, the meat was very soft and tender, like a clam. I was a little surprised that the meat grew so quickly. I still have a lot of functions in my body that can be squandered for me, it's incredible, how beautiful! I lit a cigarette and took a puff, and I was sure whether I was talking to him about the impact of Gide's "Earth Grain" on patients or asking him how long he had been in Shanghai and whether he was lonely sometimes. He was right, all these teeth were performed. He added and subtracted on a piece of paper, changed and scribbled, like a primary school student doing arithmetic, and couldn't make up the number, I really wanted to help him. Finally, it was calculated, which was equal to 240,000. After calculating, I think I really can't do less, and my scalp is a little itchy. I'm grateful and sorry. I'm grateful that he didn't use an abacus, and I'm most afraid of watching people plan to play quickly and accurately. I'm sorry I don't have that much money for a while. I smiled and said, "I'll come back at the end of the month." I had just taken a puff of the cigarette because he was going to check his teeth, and he took off the one in the ash sheet, and it was all burned. After a glance at it, I should go.出了门，我另外抽了根烟。梁说那个牙要是不装，两边的牙要松，要往缺口这儿倒；上头那个牙要长长。长长，唔，我想起小时看过些老太婆，一嘴牙落完了，留得孤仃仃的一个，长得伸出嘴唇外头，觉得又好玩又可怕。唔，我这个牙？……不至于。而且梁家孩子安慰我说短时间没有关系。我要是会吹口哨，这时我想一路吹回去。八年抗战，八颗牙齿，怎么这么巧！
When I went out, I smoked another cigarette. Liang said that if the tooth is not installed, the teeth on both sides should be loose and should be poured into the gap; the tooth on top should be long. Long, well, I remember seeing some old women when I was a child, one of the teeth fell out, leaving a lonely one, long enough to stick out of the lips, I thought it was fun and scary. Hmm, my teeth? …… Not. And the Liang family child comforted me and said that it doesn't matter for a short time. If I can whistle, then I want to blow all the way back. Eight years of anti-Japanese war, eight teeth, how can it be so coincidental!这又早过了好几个月底了，那个缺口已经没有甚么不惯，仿佛那里从来也没有过一个甚么牙齿。我渐渐忘了我有一件很伟大的志气须完成，这些牙须要拾掇一下。我没有理由把我安排得那么精美的经济设计为此而要经过一番大修改。我不去唱戏，脸歪不歪也不顶在意。我这人真懒得可以。只是这两天一向偏劳它的右臼齿又微有老熟之意，教我不得不吃得更斯文，更秀气，肚子因而容易饿了，不禁有时心里要动一动。我想起梁的话，牙齿顶好不要拔，可惜的，装上去总不是自己的了。但一切如在日光下进行的事，很平和，似有若无，不留痕迹，顺流而下。我离老还很远，不用老想到身体上有甚么东西在死去。
It was already several months earlier, and there was nothing unfamiliar about the gap, as if there had never been a tooth there. I gradually forgot that I had a great ambition to complete, and that these teeth had to be picked up. I had no reason to make such a beautifully arranged economic design so overhauled for this. I didn't sing, and I didn't care whether my face was crooked or not. I'm too lazy to do it. It's just that the right molar, which has been working hard for the past two days, is slightly mature, and I have to eat more elegantly and delicately, so my stomach is hungry easily, and I can't help but feel a stir sometimes. If I think of the beam, the teeth should not be pulled out, but unfortunately, it is not my own to install it. But everything that happens in the sun is very peaceful, as if there is nothing, leaving no trace, and flowing down the river. I'm still far from getting old, so I don't have to think about what is dying in my body.前天在路上碰着一个人，好面熟，我们点了点头，点得并不僵。——这是谁？走过好几步，我这才恍然想起，哦，是给我看牙齿的那个梁医生。我跟他约过，……不要紧，在他的职业上，这样的失信人是常常会碰到的。
The day before yesterday, I met a person on the road, so familiar, we nodded, and the noddes were not stiff. ——Who is this? After walking several steps, I suddenly remembered, oh, it's Dr. Liang who showed me my teeth. I made an appointment with him,...... It doesn't matter, in his profession, such dishonest people are often encountered.战争到甚么时候才会结束？战争如海。哼，我这是说到那里去了，殆乎篇成，半折心始，我没想到会说了这么多。真不希望这让S看见，她要难过的。
When will the war end? War is like the sea. Hmph, I'm talking about where I went, almost finished, half-hearted, I didn't expect to say so much. I really don't want S to see this, she will be sad.
