Prisoner [1]我们在河堤上站了一下，让跟我们一齐出城的犯人先过浮桥。是因为某种忌讳，不愿跟他们一夥走，还是对他们有一种尊重，（对于不幸的人，受苦难的人，或比较接近死亡的人的尊重？）觉得该让他们走在前头呢？两者都有一点吧。这说不清，并无明白的意识，只是父亲跟我都自然而然的停下来了。没有说一句话，觉得要停一停。既停之后，我们才相互看了一眼。父亲和我离隔近十年，重相接处，几乎随时要忖度对方举止的意义。但是含浑而不刻露，因为契切，不求甚解。体贴之中有时不免杂一丝轻微嘲讽的，（不可药救的病症；嘲讽于那一段时间？）但像刚才那么偶然一相视却是骨肉之情的微波，风中之风，水中之水。这瞬间一小过程使我们彼此有不孤零之感，似乎我们全可从一个距离外看得到这里，父亲和儿子，差肩而立，凡此皆微妙不可具说。——看来自自然然，好像甚么都不为的站一站，好像要看一看对河长途汽车开来了没有，好像我要把提着的箱子放下来息一息力，我于此发现自己性格与父亲相似之处，纤细而含蓄。
We stood on the river embankment for a moment and let the prisoners who went out of the city with us cross the pontoon bridge first. Is it because of some kind of taboo, reluctant to go with them, or because of a respect for the unfortunate, the suffering, or those who are closer to death?) Do you think you should let them go ahead? A little bit of both. I can't explain it clearly, I don't have a clear awareness, but my father and I both stopped naturally. I didn't say a word, and I felt like I had to stop. After stopping, we looked at each other. My father and I have been separated for nearly ten years, and when we meet again, we have to think about the meaning of each other's behavior almost at any time. But it is vague and unrevealed, because it is urgent and does not seek much understanding. Thoughtfulness is sometimes mixed with a slight mockery, (an incurable disease; ridicule at that time?) But when we look at each other by chance like just now, it is the microwave of flesh and blood, the wind in the wind, and the water in the water. This small process of this moment makes us feel that we are not alone with each other, and it seems that we can all see here from a distance, father and son, standing shoulder to shoulder, all of which are subtle and indescribable. ——Seeing it comes naturally, as if standing for nothing, as if to see if the long-distance bus is coming to the river, as if I want to put down the box I am carrying to take a breather, and here I find that my personality is similar to that of my father, slender and subtle.我们差肩而立，看犯人过浮桥。
We stood shoulder to shoulder and watched the prisoners cross the pontoon bridge.犯人三个，由两个兵押着。他们本来都是兵，现在一是兵，一是犯人了。一个兵荷老七九步枪，一个则腰里一根三号左轮，模样是个副班长。——凡曾度营伍生活者皆一眼可以看出副班长与班长举动神情之间有多大差异。班长是官，副班长则常顾此失彼的要维持他的官与兵之间的两难地位，有治人的责任感，有治于人的委曲，欲仰承，欲俯就，在矛盾挣扎之中他总站不稳，而显得窝囊可笑。犯人皆交叉着绑着肩胛，背后各有长绳一根牵出，捏在后面荷枪的兵的手里。犯人也都穿着灰布军服，不过破旧污脏得多。但兵与犯人的分别还在于一个有小皮带，一个没有皮带约束而更无可假借的显出衣服的不合身。——不合身的衣服比破烂衣服更可悲悯。我忽然想起一个朋友怎么样也不肯换医院的“制服”。人格一半是衣服造成的，随便给你一件衣服就忽视了你是怎么一个人了。人要人尊重。两个犯人有帽子，但全戴得不是地方。一个还好，帽舌子歪在一边，虽然这个滑稽样子与他全身大不相称，但总算包住了他的头。另一个则没有戴实在，风一吹，或一根树枝挂一下即会落去的，看着很不舒服，令人有焦躁着急感，极想给他往下拉一拉。还有一个，则是科头，头发长得极蓊郁，（小时懒于理发，常被骂为“像个囚犯”，）很黑很黑，跟他的络腮胡子连为一片。倒是他还有点生气。他比较矮，但看起来还壮，虽经过折磨，还不是一下子即打得倒的人。（他们看样子不是新犯，已在大牢里关了不少日子，移案到甚么地方，提出来的。）他脚步较重，一步一步还照着自己意志走，似乎浮桥因为他的脚步而有看得出的起伏。他眼睛张得大大的，坦率而稚气的，农民的眼睛，不很瞀乱惊惶，健康正常的眼睛，从粗粗的眉毛下看出去。他似乎不大忧伤，不大想他作过的事和明天的运命。他简直不大想着他是个犯人。他甚么都不大想。一个简单淳朴的人。他现在若是想，想的是：我过浮桥。也许他还晓得到了对岸，坐一段汽车，过江，解到一个甚么地方去，其余他就不知道了，也不大想知道。这段路好像他曾经走过几次，很熟，也许就是生长于这一带的，所以他很有自信的走着。要是除去绳索和罪名，他像个带路人，很好的带路人。他平日一定有走在第一个的习惯。现在他们让他走在第一个也非偶然。但形式上他得服从身边那个副班长的指挥，正如平日在部队受指挥一样。副班长与他之间并无敌意，好像都是按照规矩来，你押人，我被押，大家作着一件人家派下来的事情，无从拒绝，全非得已。他们要共走一段路，共同忍受颠簸，耽误，种种不快，（到任何地方去总望能早点到达，）也许还有点同伴之谊。——他们常默默，话沉得很深，但一路上来，总有时候要谈两句甚么的吧。副班长没有一般下级军官的金牙，也没有那种可笑的狂傲。看样子他是个厚道人，他不时回头看看后面的犯人和那个荷枪的兵的眼色是可感的，好像问：走得动吗？哦，这两个犯人可不成了！他们面色灰败，一个惨白，一个蜡渣黄，折倒他们的细脖子，（领圈显得特别宽大，）已经撑不起他们的头。衰弱，虚乏，半透明，像是已经死过一次。他们机械的迁动脚步，踏不稳，不能调节快慢，每一脚都不知踏在甚么地方。恐怕用怎么节奏明显的音乐也无法让他们走得合拍，他们已经不能受感染。他们已经忘了走路的方法。他们脑子里布满破碎的，阴暗的意象，这些意象永不会结构成一串完整思想，就一直搅动，摧残，腐蚀他们淡薄的生命。他们现在并不在恐怖中，但恐怖已经把他们腌透，而留下杂乱的痕迹。脸上永远是那个样子，嘴角挂下来，像总要呕吐，眼睛茫茫瞆瞆，缩缩怯怯。一切全惨淡，没有一个形体能在他们眼睛里留一鲜明印象。除了皮肉上的痛痒之外，似乎他们已经没有感觉；而且即是痛痒也模糊昏暗了。帽子歪戴的那一个，衣服上有一大片血渍，暗赤，如铁锈，已经不少日子。荷枪的兵也瘦蒿蒿的。虽然他打着绑腿，但凄哀的神情使他跟那两个戴帽子犯人成了一组。他不时把枪往上提一提，显然不大背得动，枪托子常常要敲着他的腿。因为那个络腮胡子犯人比较吸引我，所以对后面三个人没有能细看。
There are three prisoners, escorted by two soldiers. They were all soldiers, but now one is a soldier and the other is a prisoner. One soldier carries an old 79 rifle, and the other has a No. 3 revolver at his waist, looking like a deputy squad leader. ——Anyone who has lived in the camp can see at a glance how much difference there is between the deputy squad leader and the squad leader's expression. The squad leader is an official, and the deputy squad leader often cares about one thing and the other to maintain the dilemma between his officers and soldiers. The prisoners were all crossed and tied with shoulder blades, and a long rope was pulled out behind their backs, which was pinched in the hands of the soldiers carrying guns behind. The prisoners were also wearing gray cloth uniforms, but they were much more shabby and dirty. But the difference between soldiers and prisoners is that one has a small belt, and the other has no belt restraints, and the other shows the misfit of the clothes. ——Ill-fitting clothes are more pitiful than tattered clothes. I suddenly remembered a friend who refused to change into a hospital "uniform". Half of your personality is caused by clothes, and just giving you a piece of clothing ignores how you are. People want respect. Two prisoners had hats, but they were all worn out of place. One was okay, the tongue of the hat was crooked to the side, although this funny appearance was not commensurate with his whole body, but it finally covered his head. The other one didn't wear it, it would fall when the wind blew, or a branch would fall when it was hung, which looked very uncomfortable and made people feel anxious and anxious, and they wanted to pull him down. The other is Ketou, whose hair is extremely lush, (he was lazy to get a haircut when he was a child, and was often scolded as "like a prisoner"), very dark and dark, and his beard was connected to it. But he was still a little angry. He was relatively short, but he looked strong, and although he had been tortured, he was not a person who could be defeated at once. (They didn't seem to be new criminals, they had been in prison for many days, and they moved the case somewhere and brought it up.) His steps were heavy, and he walked according to his own will, as if the pontoon had ups and downs because of his footsteps. His eyes were wide open, frank and childish, and the peasant's eyes were not very confused and panicked, and his healthy and normal eyes could be seen from under his thick eyebrows. He didn't seem to be very sad, he didn't think much about what he had done or his fate tomorrow. He didn't think much about him as a prisoner. He didn't think much about anything. A simple and simple person. If he thinks now, what he thinks: I will cross the pontoon bridge. Maybe he still knows the other side, takes a car, crosses the river, and goes to a certain place, but he doesn't know the rest, and he doesn't want to know much. He seems to have walked this road several times, he is very familiar with it, maybe he grew up in this area, so he walks with confidence. If you remove the rope and charges, he is like a guide, a good guide. He must have a habit of walking first. It is no accident that they let him walk first. But formally, he has to obey the command of the deputy squad leader next to him, just like he is usually commanded in the army. There is no hostility between the deputy squad leader and him, it seems that they all follow the rules, you detain people, I am detained, everyone is doing something sent by others, there is no way to refuse, it is completely unavoidable. They have to walk a long way together, endure bumps, delays, all kinds of unhappiness together, (wherever you go, you always hope to arrive early), and maybe there is a bit of companionship. ——They are often silent and their words are deep, but along the way, there are always times when they have to talk about something. The deputy squad leader does not have the golden teeth of ordinary junior officers, nor does he have that ridiculous arrogance. It seems that he is a kind person, and he looks back at the prisoner behind him and the soldier with the gun from time to time, and the eyes are palpable, as if asking: Can you walk? Oh, these two prisoners can't be! Their faces were gray, one pale, the other waxy, and their thin necks were broken, and they could no longer support their heads. Weak, weak, translucent, as if they had died once. Their steps were mechanically moving, unsteady, unable to adjust their speed and slowness, and they did not know where each foot was stepping. I am afraid that no rhythmic music can make them walk in sync, they can no longer be infected. They have forgotten how to walk. Their minds are full of broken, dark images that will never be structured into a complete string of thoughts, and continue to stir, destroy, and corrode their thin lives. They are not in terror now, but terror has pickled them and left a messy trace. The face was always like that, the corners of the mouth hung down, as if he was always about to vomit, his eyes were blank, and he was timid and timid. Everything was bleak, and no body could leave a clear impression in their eyes. Except for the pain and itch on the flesh, they seemed to have no feeling; and even the pain and itch were blurred and dim. The one who wore the hat crookedly had a large blood stain on his clothes, dark red, like rust, for many days. The soldier with the gun was also thin. Although he was wearing leggings, his sad expression made him a group with the two prisoners in the hat. He lifted his gun up from time to time, obviously not moving his back, and the butt of the gun often had to hit his leg. Because the bearded prisoner was more attractive to me, I couldn't take a closer look at the three people behind me.岸上人多注目于这个悲惨的队列。
他们已经过了河。
我忽然记了记今天是甚么日子。
People on the shore are paying attention to this tragic queue. They have already crossed the river. I suddenly remembered what day it was.初春，但到处仍极荒凉。泥土暗。河水为天空染得如同铅汁，泛着冷冷的光。东北风一起，也许就要飘雪。汽车路在黑色的平野上。有两三只乌鸦飞。
It was early spring, but it was still very desolate everywhere. The soil was dark. The river dyed the sky like lead juice, glowing with a cold light. With the northeast wind, it might snow. The car road was on the black plain. Two or three crows flew.城在我们后面，细碎的市声起落绸缪。好几批人从我们身边走下河堤。
父亲跟我看了一眼，不说话，我们过浮桥。
The city is behind us, and the sound of the city rises and falls. Several groups of people walked down the river embankment from us. My father glanced at me, didn't speak, and we crossed the pontoon.大家抢着上汽车。车站码头上顶容易教人悲观，大家尽量争夺一点方便舒服。但这样的场面见得也多了，已经不大有感触。等都上去了，父亲上去，然后是我。看父亲得到一个比较安稳站处，我看看有甚么地方可以拉一拉我的手。而在我后面上来了那几个犯人。他们简直弄不清楚人家怎么把他们弄上来的。车门关上，车上人窜窜动动，我被挤到一个人缝里，勉强把一只脚放平，那一只则怎么摆都不是地方，我只有伸手捞着上面的杠子，把全身重量用一只胳臂吊起来。我想把腰伸伸直，可是实在不可能。好吧，无所谓，半个多钟头就到江边。我试一回头，勉强可以看到父亲半面，他的颧骨跟一只肩膀。父亲点点头，答说：我很好，管你自己吧。我想，在人群中你无法跟要在一起的人在一起，一冲一撞，拉得多牢的手也只有撒开。我就我的头可以转动的方向一巡视，那个矮壮犯人不知在甚么地方。副班长好像没有上来，大概跟司机坐到一处去了，这点门槛他懂。那个荷枪的兵笔直的贴在车门犄角，一个乡下人的笠子刚刚顶在他的脸前面，不时要擦着他的鼻子，而逼得他一脸尴尬相。两个有帽子犯人，我知道，都在我身边。他们那里也不要在，既然已经关上了车，总就得有块地方，毫无主意的他们就被挤到这儿来了。甚么地方对他们全一样，他们没有求舒服的心，他们现在根本不知道在甚么地方。我面前是两个女客，她们是甚么模样我才不在乎，有一个好像是个老太太。我尝试怎么样可以把肋骨放平正一点，而车子剧烈的摇晃了一下，一个身体往我背上一靠，他的手拉了一下我的衣服。是我身后那个犯人。甚么样的一只手！又生满了疥疮，我皮肤一紧，这感觉是不快的。我本能的有一点避让之意。似乎我的不快立刻传过给他，拉了一下，他就放开了。他站不稳，我知道。他的胳臂无法伸直，伸直了也够不到杠子，而且这样英勇的生的争取的姿势根本就是他不会有的。他攀扶不到甚么东西，习于被播弄了。我正想我是不是不该避让，一面又向右顾看那另一个犯人的手无意识的画动了两下，第二下更大的晃动又来了，我蓦然有了个决定，像赌徒下出一注，把我的身体迎给他！他懂得，接受了我的意思，一把抓住了。这不难，在生活的不断的抉择之中，这样的事情是比较易于成就的，因为没有时间让你掂斤播两的思索。我并没有太用力激励自己。请恕我，当时我对自己是有一点满意的。我如此作并非因为全车人都嫌弃他们，在这么紧密的地方还远之唯恐不及，而我愤怒，我要反抗。我是个不大会愤怒的人，我也能知道人没有理由把不愉快事情往身上拉，现在是甚么时代！我知道他身后必尚有一点空隙，我跟他说：“你蹲下来”。蹲下来他可以舒服些。我叫右边那一个也蹲下来。这只是半点钟的事，但如果可能，我想不太伤劳我的那一只胳臂，他们一蹲下来，好像松动了一点，我可以挪一挪脚步了。可是当我偏了偏腰时，一只手上来拉住了我的袖子。我这才看了看我面前那个女客，二十大几，也许三十出头，一个粉白大团脸。她皱着眉头用两个指头拉我，我看了看那两个指头，不大方的指头，肉很多，秃秃的，一个鸡心形赤金戒指。好像这两个指头要我生了一点气，我想不理她，我凭甚么要给你遮隔住这两个囚犯，一下了车你把早上吃的稀饭吐出来也不干我的事。然而我略扁了扁嘴，不大甘愿的决定了，就这么斜吊着身子吧，好在就是半个钟头的事。这才真是牺牲！我看了看那个老太太，真可怜，她偎在座位里，耗子似的眼睛看我的脸。那个梳着在她以为很时式的头发的女人（她一定用双妹老牌生发油！）这才算放了心，努力看着窗外。
Everyone rushed to get into the car. The top of the station pier is easy to make people pessimistic, so everyone tries to compete for a little convenience and comfort. But I have seen many such scenes, and I don't feel much anymore. When everyone went up, my father went up, and then I was there. Seeing that my father got a more stable place to stand, I saw where I could pull my hand. And the prisoners came up behind me. They couldn't figure out how they got them up. The door was closed, the people in the car were moving, I was squeezed into a crack in a person, barely flattening one foot, and the other was not a place. I wanted to straighten my waist, but it was impossible. Well, it doesn't matter, it will take more than half an hour to reach the river. I tried to turn around and could barely see half of my father's face, his cheekbones and one shoulder. My father nodded and replied: I'm fine, just take care of yourself. I think you can't be with the person you want to be with in the crowd. I looked in the direction my head could turn, and the short prisoner didn't know where he was. The deputy squad leader didn't seem to come up, and probably sat in the same place with the driver, and he understood this threshold. The soldier with the gun was straight in the corner of the car door, and a countryman's hat had just been put in front of his face, brushing his nose from time to time, forcing him to look embarrassed. Two prisoners with hats, I know, are by my side. They don't want to be there, since the car has been closed, there must be a place, and they are squeezed here without any idea. What kind of place is the same for them, they don't have a comfortable heart, they don't know where they are now. There were two female guests in front of me, I didn't care what they looked like, one of them seemed to be an old lady. I tried to flatten my ribs a little, and the car shook violently, and a body leaned against my back, and his hand pulled my clothes. It was the prisoner behind me. What kind of hand! It was covered with scabies again, and my skin was tight, which was unpleasant. I instinctively had a little sense of avoidance. It seemed that my displeasure was immediately transmitted to him, and after a pull, he let go. He couldn't stand steadily, I knew. His arms couldn't be straightened, and he couldn't reach the bar even if he was straight, and he wouldn't have such a heroic posture at all. He couldn't climb anything, and he was used to being played. I was wondering if I shouldn't have avoided it, and while looking to the right, the other prisoner's hand unconsciously moved twice, and the second bigger shaking came, and I suddenly made a decision, like a gambler, to welcome my body to him! He understood, accepted my meaning, and grabbed it. This is not difficult, in the constant choice of life, such things are relatively easy to achieve, because there is no time for you to think about it. I didn't push myself too hard. Please forgive me, I was a little satisfied with myself at the time. I didn't do this because everyone in the car disliked them, and I was afraid that they would be too far away in such a close place, and I was angry, and I wanted to resist. I am not a very angry person, and I know that people have no reason to pull unpleasant things on their bodies, what kind of era it is! I knew there must be a little gap behind him, so I said to him, "You squat down." He would be more comfortable to squat. I asked the one on the right to squat down too. It was only half an o'clock, but if possible, I thought it wouldn't hurt my arm too much, and as soon as they squatted down, it seemed to loosen a little, and I could move my steps. But when I tilted my back, a hand came up and grabbed my sleeve. Only then did I look at the female guest in front of me, in her twenties, maybe in her early thirties, with a big pink and white face. She frowned and pulled me with two fingers, and I looked at those two fingers, not generous fingers, a lot of meat, bald, a chicken heart-shaped red gold ring. It seemed that these two fingers made me a little angry, I wanted to ignore her, why should I cover these two prisoners for you, and you spit out the porridge you ate in the morning and don't do my business. However, I flattened my mouth a little, and I decided not to be willing, just hang myself like this, fortunately, it was only half an hour. This is what a sacrifice! I looked at the old lady, how pitiful, she was snuggled up in the seat, looking at my face like a mouse. The woman who was combing her hair in what she thought was very fashionable (she must use her sister's old hair tonic oil!) White Pine Syrup[1]船开了，离岸已有一截子路。想下去的无法再下去，要上来的也上不来，岸边人看着船，船上人都已找到地方坐定了。人并不太多，空处尽有，不过半个多钟头即到对岸，随便哪里都行，又不是坐一辈子；常来常往的，谁说得出这船上最好的椅子是哪一张，只要没有别的原因，对于自己所占坐处都很容易满足。茶房沏茶水，打手巾，小贩叫卖吆喝，人一安定，他们开始活动起来。——进来了一个孩子。
The boat sailed, and there was a section of road offshore. Those who wanted to go down could no longer go down, and those who wanted to come up couldn't come up, and the people on the shore looked at the boat, and the people on the boat had found a place to sit. There are not too many people, there are all kinds of empty spaces, but it takes more than half an hour to reach the other side, anywhere, not for a lifetime; who can tell which chair is the best on this boat, as long as there is no other reason, it is easy to be satisfied with the place they occupy. The tea room made tea, beat handkerchiefs, vendors shouted, and as soon as the people settled down, they began to move. ——A child came in.他一身青布学生装，一顶学生常戴的军帽，青布的，不脏，也不是顶干净，大概是一星期前新洗的，但收拾得极见细心爱惜，每天晚上脱下时都好好的摺起挂好，绝不是随便往椅子上一团或顺手一撂盖在脚头被上。显然这是他最好的一件衣裳，他的一点荣光，他的财产，他的“资格”。帽舌子当然没有折断，戴得很正，比普通孩子戴得稍高一点，不扣在额头上。帽子不大挺括，好像淋过一场雨，这两天天阴，今天才放太阳。他大概……十三四岁，——不像——十六……，不，只有十三四岁！他发育得还正常，身材不高也不矮。只是样子早熟，他走进舱来的几步绝不像个十三四岁的孩子，不怯也不野，老老到到，沉沉稳稳，仿佛颇能独立，很有主意，然而实在毕竟还是个孩子，稍一注意就知道那点早熟的皮层实在很微薄，轻轻不费事即可揭去，一个孩子，一个小学六年级或者初中一二年级的太守规矩，太世故一点的好学生，一个小道学家，并不是没有调皮淘气的时候，但明白得失利害，不致闯祸犯法。若在学校里，同学多半不大会喜欢他的，也许受先生的暗示而不得不对他表示一分敬重；但先生自己尽管表面奖励，心里未尝不想他把真的一面拿出来，只是先生似乎不可以劝学生调皮淘气！幸亏有这点调皮淘气处，也许他才不致孤单离索罢。他眉目颇清秀，浅浅一个酒涡。——他进来了，走到舱中那根柱子前头，在放茶壶的那条长桌上放下皮箱，（似乎这根柱子，这张桌子给他一点依傍，让他不悬在空中似的，）站定了，鞠了一个躬，用一种虚伪做作的，文明戏式的，有腔有调，然而孩子的声音，高声朗诵起来：
He was dressed in a blue cloth student uniform, a military hat often worn by students, green cloth, not dirty, not clean, about a week ago, but it was cleaned up very carefully, and when he took it off every night, he folded it up and hung it well. Obviously this is his best dress, his little glory, his property, his "qualifications". Of course, the tongue of the hat is not broken, it is worn very properly, slightly higher than that of ordinary children, and is not buckled on the forehead. The hat is not very crisp, as if it has been drenched in a rain, and the sun has only been shining today on the cloudy sky. He probably ...... Thirteen or fourteen years old,—— not like sixteen ......, no, only thirteen or fourteen years old! He is still developing normally, neither tall nor short. It's just that he looks precocious, he walks into the cabin a few steps like a thirteen or fourteen-year-old child, neither timid nor wild, old to the extreme, calm and steady, as if he can be quite independent, very ideas, but after all, he is still a child, a little attention knows that the precocious cortex is really very thin, and it can be removed gently and without trouble. If in school, most of his classmates will not like him, maybe he will have to show some respect to him by the hint of his teacher; But although the gentleman himself was rewarded on the surface, he didn't want him to take out the real side in his heart, but the teacher didn't seem to be able to persuade the students to be naughty and naughty! Fortunately, with this bit of mischief, maybe he wouldn't be alone. His eyebrows were quite delicate, and he was a light wine vortex. ——He came in, walked to the pillar in the cabin, and put down the suitcase on the long table where the teapot was placed, (as if this pillar, this table, gave him a little support, so that he would not hang in the air,) stood still, bowed, and recited in a hypocritical and contrived, civilized drama, with a tone, but the child's voice recited loudly:“各位，我们中国人，最爱咳嗽。中国人体质衰弱，营养不良，动辄容易咳嗽吐痰。中山先生说，随便吐痰是我国人的不良习惯。吐痰固然是不良习惯，咳嗽也有伤身体，如若一时不治，难免养病成灾，影响气管肺脏，在在都极其危险可畏。咳嗽有好多种。有新咳；有老咳。有伤风外感；有五劳七伤。有干咳；有痰咳。有吐白痰；有吐黄痰。有妇人胎咳；有小儿夜咳。有五更咳；有百日咳。有年青断伤，痰中时见血丝；有老年气弱，咳时痰难吐出。有呛咳，有喘咳。……”
"Everyone, we Chinese love to cough the most. Chinese people are weak, malnourished, and prone to coughing and spitting at every turn. Mr. Sun Yat-sen said that spitting casually is a bad habit of our country. Spitting is a bad habit, and coughing can also hurt the body. There are many kinds of coughs. There is a new cough; there is an old cough. There is a cold; there is a five-labor and seven injuries. There is a dry cough; there is a phlegm cough. There is a spitting white sputum; there is spitting up yellow sputum. There is a woman's fetal cough; there is a child's night cough. There is a five-watch cough; there is whooping cough. There are young people who are broken, and blood is often seen in the phlegm; There is old age who is weak and difficult to spit out phlegm when coughing. There is choking and wheezing. ……”他说了不止五分钟，口齿十分清楚，换气，提头，顿逗呼应的地方也没有错甚么。用的是带淮安味的扬州话，有几个字是国音，阴平特别高显，入声则一律还是保留，可是那些咳嗽他多半并未见过遇过，有些字句意义他不大懂得，说起来很难动情，很难声色俱茂。他一定没有落了一句，可听起来总觉得生，腔调中如有裂缝，不是倾瓶泻水，一气呵成，不够流利。背的次数该还不顶多，也不少了，他还得老是想着背，除了一点淡漠，一点困惑，我听不出里面真的或是假的感情。就像这样，学校演说竞赛会上他可以稳稳的得个第二了，假如第一为一个圆脸大眼睛女同学拿去。在评判单上他得分最少的当是“姿势”一项，级任先生应当多教他的手臂怎么运动，伸出去，举起来，摊开手掌，一个一个竖起指头，……他这五分钟甚至脚底下都没有移动几回，就是笔直的站着说的，这未免太僵了。——唉，怯场倒不怯场了，对着这么些人，还看不出畏缩不安，可是并不吸引人，没有那种抓住听众的力量，他不是个讲演的天才，而且嗓音太高，太窄，太直，太干，有点左。
He spoke for more than five minutes, his speech was very clear, and there was nothing wrong with ventilating, raising his head, and teasing him. He used the Yangzhou dialect with Huai'an flavor, and a few words were national accents, the yin was particularly high, and the sound was still retained, but most of those coughs he had never met, and he didn't understand the meaning of some words, and it was difficult to be emotional, and it was difficult to be full of voice. He must not have dropped a sentence, but he always felt raw, and if there was a crack in the tone, it was not pouring water in one go, not fluent enough. The number of times he memorized should not be at most, not a lot, he still has to think about memorizing it, except for a little indifference, a little confusion, I can't hear the real or false feelings in it. Just like this, he can definitely get second in the school speech competition, if the first place is taken by a female classmate with a round face and big eyes. In the judging list, he scored the least in the "posture" item, and Mr. Ren should teach him how to move his arms, stretch them out, raise them, spread his palms, and raise his fingers one by one,...... He didn't even move a few times under his feet in the past five minutes, he just stood up straight and spoke, which was too stiff. ——Alas, stage fright is not stage fright, in front of such people, I can't see the cowering, but it is not attractive, without the power to grasp the audience, he is not a genius at speaking, and his voice is too high, too narrow, too straight, too dry, a little left.“……现在，敝公司精制一种白松糖浆，专治各种咳嗽。白松糖浆是以纯白的松子炼制而成的糖浆，它能化痰止咳，滋补润肺。不论久咳新咳，小儿咳，妇人咳，……有病可以治病，无病可以预防。……”
“…… Now, our company refines a kind of white pine syrup to treat all kinds of coughs. White pine syrup is a syrup made from pure white pine nuts, which can dissolve phlegm and relieve cough, nourish and moisten the lungs. Whether it is a long-term cough or a new cough, a child's cough, or a woman's cough,...... Diseases can be cured, and diseases can be prevented without diseases. ……”于是把小皮箱打开，手里拿着一瓶，摇着，走到各人面前。
“白松糖浆在上海本公司门市部售价二万六千元，镇江药房卖三万。这是广告性质，只收回清本，无非是推广介绍，只卖两万，有哪位先生要一瓶罢？……”
So he opened the small suitcase, held a bottle in his hand, shook it, and walked to everyone. "Baisong syrup is sold for 26,000 yuan in the Shanghai company's store department, and 30,000 yuan in Zhenjiang Pharmacy. This is an advertisement in nature, only the clearance is recovered, it is nothing more than a promotional introduction, only 20,000 yuan, which gentleman wants a bottle? ……”“带一瓶罢，送送人也好的。”
“要罢？……”
可是怪，这船舱里竟然没有一个咳嗽的！至少这会儿没有一个人咳一声。
"Just bring a bottle, and it's good to give it away." "Forget it? ……” But strangely, there was no one coughing in this cabin! At least no one coughed at this time.他还在一个一个问过去，态度彬彬有礼，熟习一切失望，都很含蓄，极其耐烦的一面摇着手中的瓶子，一面“劳驾”，“得罪”，从人前走过去。从演讲一变而为说话了，语调之中颇多了一点江湖习气，但确确实实更看出他真还是一个孩子，一个十三四岁的孩子，一个小学初中之间的学生！
He also asked one by one, with a polite attitude, familiar with all disappointments, very subtle, extremely impatient while shaking the bottle in his hand, while "working" and "offending", walking in front of people. From speech to speech, there is a little more jianghu habit in the tone, but it is true that he is really still a child, a thirteen or fourteen-year-old child, a student between elementary school and junior high school!当然他不单纯是为公司做广告，推销一瓶货，一定有若干好处的，公司另外还给不给报酬呢？批一批货，要不要先付一点钱？有一个什么折扣可打？他就是单在这只船上还有别的地方可去么？一天能卖多少瓶？要是一瓶也卖不出去？他趁船，不用票罢？要不要常常送船上人一点钱，或是送一瓶白松糖浆？没有病也能吃的，船上人是否因此不伤风也得咳两声？他怎么爱惜他的钱，他的货，又怎样表示大方，漂亮？要是遇到莽撞冒失人一头碰撒了他的小皮箱呢？上公司里批货，总有些手续，得说好些话？没有问题，二万绝对不是最低的价钱，一定可以讲价的，他怎样跟人讲价，怎么察言观色，见风使舵，趁热打铁？总有许多许多麻烦他得应付的，许多许多意外逼得他要哭！自负和自卑熬炼得他长大起来。他有一身衣帽——他的新鞋，家制青布鞋，鞋底还很白！
Of course, he is not just advertising for the company, promoting a bottle of goods, there must be some benefits, and the company will not pay for it? Do you want to pay a little money first? What discount is there? Is there anywhere else he can go on this ship alone? How many bottles can he sell in a day? If he can't sell a bottle? He takes advantage of the boat and doesn't need a ticket? Do you want to often give a little money to the people on the ship, or a bottle of white pine syrup? You can eat without illness, do the people on the ship have to cough twice without catching a cold? How can he cherish his money, his goods, and how can he show generosity and beauty? What if he encounters a reckless person and scatters his small suitcase? There are always some procedures in the company, and you have to say a lot of things? No problem, 20,000 yuan is definitely not the lowest price, you can definitely bargain, how does he bargain with others, how do he observe words and expressions, see the wind and steer, and strike while the iron is hot? There are always many, many troubles that he has to deal with, and many, many accidents force him to cry! Conceit and low self-esteem have made him grow up. He has a coat and hat - his new shoes, homemade blue cloth shoes, and the soles are still very white!“哎，白松糖浆，哎，纯白松子精炼所成，哎男女老幼通用，哎春夏秋冬咸宜，——”
"Hey, white pine syrup, hey, pure white pine nut refining, hey, men, women, old and young, hey, spring, summer, autumn and winter are suitable for ,——"什么时候果然进来了另外一个！一看脑袋就知道他的脚背一定很高，——高鼻梁高颧骨，高牙床，前额到后脑长极了，而左眼跟右眼距离得很近，他的屁股当然很小很小，可是声音倒是扁的，仿佛是从小腹处发出来的。
When did another one really come in! As soon as you look at your head, you know that the instep of his foot must be very high,—— high nose bridge, high cheekbones, high gums, forehead to back of the head is very long, and the left eye and right eye are very close, of course his buttocks are very small, but the sound is flat, as if it comes from the lower abdomen.他前年或是去年过了三十岁。他一百磅左右，有时他愿意自己胖一点。他胡子碴黄黄的，那倒没有甚么关系。脸上雀斑不少，似乎没有甚么办法可治。他认得字，会写信，他很喜欢“专此奉达敬请钧安”这一句，尤其是“钧安”，很能感动人。他读过千家诗，很羡慕解学士，自己也想能做做诗，他能看报，知道马歇尔杜鲁门，DDT，原子弹。他不抽烟，可是有时肯买一包，放在口袋里，到必须时拿出来请人，联络联络，他不会跟人打架，但可能有挨当兵的或甚么粗野人莫明其妙的打两个耳刮子的时候，他有时做梦得到一支自来水笔并且当了保长，眼前希望得最迫切的是有一个不管甚么样子的徽章别在身上，还有袜子后跟不要破得太大。不过公司虽然不发徽章，他现在的这个职业仍然是可感谢的，教他觉得屈辱的时候不比觉得矜骄的时候多。他老跟这个孩子搭挡，虽然当真遇到甚么事，他也不见得有办法，他没有能力，也没有胆量。不过他总以为他在提挈指导着他，他非他不可，一有机会他就训练他怎么做人，怎么处世，怎么怎么一篇大道理。他跟孩子只是职业上的关系？——有一点亲？像表兄弟？——堂兄弟？——都不像——是街坊？——是街坊？——大概。——哦，他想——孩子一定有一个寡母一个适年待字的姐姐，为他做脚上这双新鞋的姐姐，这个尖身子扁嗓子的人一定常往他家走动，看看老伯母，逢年过节还买一点礼物送去！看孩子面相他姐姐长得必不难看。她一点都不喜欢他，但当真以为弟弟会受到他好处也许——究竟她会不会嫁给他呢？
He was over thirty the year before last or last year. He weighed about a hundred pounds, and sometimes he was willing to gain a little fat himself. His beard is yellow, but it doesn't matter. There are a lot of freckles on his face, and there seems to be no way to treat it. He recognizes words, can write letters, and he likes the sentence "I specially ask Jun'an", especially "Jun'an", which is very touching. He has read thousands of poems, envied Scholar Xie, and wanted to be able to write poetry, he could read newspapers, and knew about Marshall Truman, DDT, and the atomic bomb. He doesn't smoke, but sometimes he is willing to buy a pack, put it in his pocket, take it out when necessary, contact someone, he will not fight with people, but there may be soldiers or some rough people who inexplicably scratch two ears, he sometimes dreams of getting a tap pen and becoming a security guard, and the most urgent thing in front of him is to have a badge pinned to his body no matter what it looks like, and the heel of his socks should not be too broken. However, although the company does not issue badges, he is still grateful for his current profession, teaching him that he feels humiliated no more often than when he feels proud. He always partners with this child, although he does not have a way when something happens, he has no ability, and he has no courage. But he always thought that he was guiding him, he had to be him, and whenever he had the opportunity, he would train him how to behave, how to behave, and how to make a big truth. Is he just a professional relationship with his children? - A little relative? Like a cousin? - Cousins? - Not like - are they neighbors? - Are they neighbors? - Probably. - Oh, he thought - the child must have a widow and a sister who is suitable for words, and the sister who makes these new shoes for him, this person with a pointed body and a flat voice must often walk to his house, see the old aunt, and buy some gifts for the holidays! Looking at the child's face, his sister must not be ugly. She didn't like him at all, but she really thought that her brother would benefit from him, maybe—would she marry him?孩子也并不喜欢他，他有时甚至从心底觉得他讨厌，但他还不能看清楚他，反抗他，为了自己的利益，他宁可对他服从。也许这样的依仗是虚空的，然而一点朦胧的信任使他自己可以更坚强些，在没有遇到打击之前。
The child didn't like him either, and sometimes he even felt that he hated him from the bottom of his heart, but he couldn't see him clearly, rebelled against him, and would rather obey him for his own benefit. Perhaps such a reliance is futile, but a little vague trust allows him to be stronger before he encounters a blow.“要罢？”
“有哪位先生要，带一瓶送送人？”
"Do you want it?" "Which gentleman wants to bring a bottle to give away?"然而客人兴趣更低，他手上那个瓶子反面正面都没有人再要看一眼了，阖起两只箱子，他们走出去。虽然这也许是最后一个舱了，可是他们的样子总像是还要赶到甚么地方去，匆匆忙忙，毫不颓唐懒散。只有出门的那一会他们倒极像是息息相关，合作无间的同伴，他们用同样的，经过配演的姿势走出去甚至脚步的起落都是同时的。
However, the customer's interest was even lower, and no one wanted to look at the reverse side of the bottle in his hand, so they closed the two boxes and walked out. Although this may be the last cabin, they always looked like they were going somewhere, in a hurry, not lazy. Only when they went out did they seem to be closely related and cooperative companions, and they used the same posture to walk out and even the ups and downs of their steps at the same time.一个客人，——两个，咳起来，倒不定是有病，因为要想憋着憋着，于是憋不住了。另一个伏在窗口看对岸青山的客人正抽着烟，听到咳声，忍不住一笑，往里流的烟倒呛出来，也几乎咳出声音。
There are two guests in the ,——, and when they cough, they may be sick, because they want to hold back, so they can't hold back. Another guest who was lying in the window looking at the green mountains on the other side was smoking, and when he heard the cough, he couldn't help but laugh, choking on the smoke flowing in, and almost coughed up.

邂逅

邂逅[1]
[1] This article was originally published in Tianjin's Republic of China Daily on April 12, 1948. Encounter[1]船开了一会，大家坐定下来。理理包箧，接起刚才中断的思绪，回味正在进行中的事务已过的一段的若干细节，想一想下一步骤可能发生的情形；没有目的的擒纵一些飘忽意象；漫然看着窗外江水；接过茶房递上来的手巾擦脸；掀开壶盖给茶房沏茶；口袋里摸出一张什么字条，看一看，又搁了回去；抽烟；打盹；看报；尝味着透入脏腑的机器的浑沉的震颤，——震得身体里的水起了波纹，一小圈，一小圈；暗数着身下靠背椅的一根一根木条；什么也不干，听而不闻，视而不见，近乎是虚设的“在”那里；观察，感觉，思索着这些，……各种生活式样摆设在船舱座椅上，展放出来；若真实，又若空幻，各自为政，没有章法，然而为一种什么东西范围概括起来，赋之以相同的一点颜色。——那也许是“生活”本身。在现在，则是“过江”，大家同在一条“船”上。
The boat sailed for a while, and everyone sat down. Trilobites and gladioli[1]把那一部份图书仪器送走了，心里空了好一大块。有一点感触，含浑，有重量，但是一点一点的加上来的，心理有个准备，知道总有这么一天，这么一刻，到底来了！仿佛倒很满意。怎么说，总完了一件事。相信徐之所觉所受跟我差不多。不过他似乎比我更深沉些。不敢说，这全是揣测。看一看他的眼睛，很暗，有一点纷乱。不过给我纷乱印象的也许是他的头发。今天事情忙，有几个箱子须要拆开重装，我们都没有好好梳头；公路上风也大。他的头发分开，向后。很后，好像总是逆风而行，像每根头发发根细而近末端处越来越粗，到发尖才又微收一点，好作一归宿。看起来他的脑门子就比实在的更高些了，而且头好像总向后扬一点的样子。我相当喜欢这样的头发，这至少比飞机头那种纨袴气有骨子得多，有一股子俊拔坚毅劲儿。不过头没有好好梳，刚才帮着搬抬那些箱子，无心顾到头发，忙乱中弄得他更乱，而且风把他的头发披下一片在额前了。风从我们身后吹来。——然而，大体上说，无损于他的深沉稳重。啊，我似乎太注意他的头发，我的眼睛那么巡视探究是非礼的。只因为我稍为觉得有点与平常不一样，有一点惊异。人到底不能天天是一样的！从他的密闭的嘴角上掠下来，我看看脚边车轮印子。

It seems to be very satisfied. How to say, one thing is over. I believe that Xu Zhi felt the same as me. But he seems to be deeper than me. I dare not say, this is all speculation. Looking at his eyes, they are very dark and a little chaotic. But what gave me the impression of chaos might be his hair. Today I was busy, there were a few boxes that needed to be unpacked and repacked, and we didn't comb our hair properly; the wind was also strong on the road. His hair was parted and backwards. Later, it seemed to always go against the wind, like each hair was thin at the roots and thicker near the ends, and only slightly retracted at the tips of the hair, so that it could be a destination. It seemed that his head was higher than it really was, and his head always seemed to be raised a little back. I quite like this kind of hair, at least much more bone-in than the pants at the head of an airplane, and there is a handsome and resolute spirit. But my hair was not combed properly, and I just helped carry the boxes, and I didn't care about my hair, which made him even more messy in the chaos, and the wind draped a piece of his hair in front of his forehead. Just because I felt a little different from usual, I was a little surprised. People can't be the same every day! I grabbed a few sentences like a child buckling a sparrow with a hat:这个人，他真是来“送行”了，他就是来做这么一回事，送是送了，可是不是送“人”。好像送行这回事可以单独存在，无借于行的人，即使有人吧，人是行的一部份，所有的人格只在行这一点上才有意义，或者说，一个象征。……
This person, he really came to "see off", he just came to do such a thing, to send is to send, but is it not to send "people"? It seems that the send-off can exist alone, without borrowing from the person who does it, even if there are people, people are a part of the line, and all personalities are meaningful only in this point of doing things, or in other words, a symbol. ……这一串字才成胚，我就知道不是我要的样子。我只是借题发挥。这倒是说了我自己。说出我的好高骛远的妄想。我从来不肯一步一步的走，不肯剥茧抽丝的拆开一个东西看，（我连一个表都修不好！）我记起有一次跟徐谈法布尔，我不能不承认他对这位孩子的朋友，昆虫的爱好者，比我知道得多得多，我跟他辩论过，（唯一的一次辩论；其实不是辩论，在他面前，我好像随时放弃一切我已持意见，尽找一块可以托足地位站一站，好跟他抗衡，他则以静待动的借了我而一层一层的往里说，）他说法布尔怎么样只好算个诗人，（“孩子的朋友”，“昆虫的爱好者”是他用的字，）要说他是个科学家也可以，看你对科学家下的定义如何。他说，想象是好的，那也是另一种智慧。好吧，他说我也应当去学诗，连念生物都不顶合适。——幸好我学的是植物分类，我自以为与某些性格尚相调协。我说起这些，为的是表示他和我不同；为的是我因此而对他“没有办法”。因此，我有时有一种潜沉的愤怒。我刚才那么抓了几句满不相干的话，也是借以宣泄一点我的抗议。……
This string of words just became an embryo, and I knew it wasn't what I wanted. I just borrowed the topic to play. This is about myself. Tell me my lofty delusions. I never want to go step by step, I refuse to peel off the cocoon and take apart something to look at, (I can't even fix a watch!) I remember talking to Xu about Fabre once, and I can't help but admit that he knew much more about this child's friend, an insect lover, than I knew, and I debated with him, (the only debate; In fact, it is not a debate, in front of him, I seem to give up everything I have at any time, and find a place where I can stand up to compete with him, and he borrows me in a static way and says layer by layer, he says that Fabre is a poet, ("friend of children", "lover of insects" are the words he uses), and it is okay to say that he is a scientist, depending on how you define a scientist. He said that imagination is good, and that is another kind of wisdom. Well, he said that I should also study poetry, and I am not even suitable for biology. ——Fortunately, I studied plant classification, and I thought I was still in tune with some personalities. I say this to show that he is different from me; because I have "no way" for him because of this. Therefore, I sometimes have a kind of latent anger. I just grabbed a few irrelevant words to vent my protests. ……我说他不是送“人”，是我简直怀疑他对于“人”没有兴趣。我的抗议又表示我当然并不相信如此，而且当真并不如此的。正如同我固然不是诗，他也不就是科学，人不是那么单纯的。我抗议是因为不知道他究竟对人是怎么一个看法，然而我相信他有一个看法；因为已经有，就不用说，倒好像我说了便表示实在少得很，近于没有。他又决非那种说说俏皮话自以为真轻蔑否定得了一切的人，或者许多口口声声说“一无所知”，而表示自己真知道得清楚的人。我就是想象？我的家庭，我的朋友，我的如醉如狂感情，全是想象？……不知道为甚么，我因为他简直烦恼起来，好像我活得全不值得似的，特别是我看过他的黑的，大的，不动的，真不秀气而实在有热度的眼睛。……
I said that he was not giving "people" because I simply suspected that he had no interest in "people". My protest also said that I certainly did not believe this, and that it was not so. Just as I am not a poet, he is not a science, and people are not so simple. I protest because I don't know what he thinks of people, but I believe he has an opinion; because there is already one, needless to say, but it seems that if I say it, it is really very little, close to nothing. He is by no means the kind of person who thinks that he can deny everything with witty words, or a person who says "I know nothing" and says that he really knows clearly. Am I just imagining? My family, my friends, my drunken feelings are all imaginations? …… I don't know why, but I was so annoyed by him, as if I wasn't worth living at all, especially my black, big, immoving, really undelicate and really hot eyes. ……我抗议，因为他是孤独的。我抗议，他们说他，“怪僻！”……
I protest because he is lonely. I protest, they say he, "Weird! ”……我因为我不能是他而困恼。他总是那么一整个，我真想把他拆开，搅得乱七八糟，再一点一点的凑起来。今天，我有点得意，因为他格外明显的露出他的纷乱了。当我一揭出，他就更可怜。他显得跟平常不大同。他显得矮了一点，肩膀也不那么方，不那么硬，脸上不那么一是一，二是二，不那么齐整，我甚至觉得他的腿有点虚软，大体上他好像萎了一点，皱了一点，雕刻性减少了一点，光和影含胡暧昧些。我曾经说“无损于他的深沉稳重”，是的，他仍旧是深沉稳重，但你感觉得到他在那儿支撑。虽然只是一点点剥蚀，一点裂缝，正因为本来是那么坚固，你觉得这个石像不复像平日一样在座子上立得那么泰然了。走下一段路来，说了一阵子话，我相信不是错觉。因为虽然我明天要走，我没有觉得自己有甚么剧显的变。我相信，不是“想象”！我得意，因为我居然对他有一种从未有过的感情，怜悯。不知道为甚么，我觉得他今天比我弱，至少，跟我一样的弱。
I was troubled that I couldn't be him. He was always so whole, and I really wanted to take him apart, make a mess, and put him together little by little. Today, I was a little proud because he showed his chaos very clearly. When I exposed him, he was even more pitiful. He looked different from usual. He looked a little shorter, his shoulders were not so square, not so hard, his face was not so one, two was two, not so neat, and I even felt that his legs were a little weak, and in general he seemed to be a little wilted, a little wrinkled, a little less sculptural, and the light and shadow were a little more ambiguous. I used to say that "it doesn't hurt his depth and stability", and yes, he is still deep and steady, but you can feel that he is there to support him. Although it is only a little bit of erosion and a little crack, because it is so strong, you feel that this stone statue is no longer so calm on its seat as usual. After walking for a while and talking for a while, I believe it is not an illusion. Because although I am leaving tomorrow, I do not feel that I have changed dramatically. I believe that it is not "imagination"! I am proud because I actually have a feeling for him that I have never had before, pity. I don't know why, but I feel that he is weaker than me today, at least, as weak as I am.我并不一直咬着他不放，我之所感远较我写出来的要朦胧得多，零碎，起落，正反，拾起又扔掉，迟疑中已为他事所乱，我的兴趣仍是在说说话。从车站到学校有一段路，又静又平，一棵一棵的尤加利，一粒一粒的石头，一步一步的走，脚下踹起萨萨的声音，间或一队从山里来的驮马摇着它们项下生铜铃，缓慢悠远，忽然紧碎起来，当那些马洒开四蹄飞奔的时候。我说得很多，说这里的风物，说这几年的生活，说书，说人，同学，教授。不知是甚么道理，我居然把这些东西牵连得起来，似乎还首尾相应，可以引出一个甚么来龙去脉来似的。我得到一种自由，不像平日一样的逡巡荡漾，因势利导，得心应手，时有神来之笔。直到我觉察徐原来那么听着是只须要我的声音，至于我说了些甚么，他没有在意，我于是骤然冷了下来，一种难堪的冷漠因为彼此乞求援手的旗语而更暴露了。于是话枯了，像泉水一旦见了底，我们闷着头走路我看到几次他的太阳穴耳下至颚骨颤动了一下，他想说话，这就更糟。这情形他以前极少有。我们走在这儿，像两条平行线，永不会相交。这是怎么回事？我们两个人都走得快起来，步子迈得大了，都感觉这最后一截太长。好了，前面就是墙，门，房子，我松了一口气，我简直是用了长途竞走到达终点的步子窜上了石阶，而且生怕他抢在我前头。——
I didn't keep biting him, my feelings were far more hazy than what I wrote, fragmented, up and down, up and down, up and down, picked up and thrown away, hesitating and being disturbed by other things, my interest was still talking. There is a road from the station to the school, quiet and flat, eucalyptus one by one, stone by stone, step by step, kicking the sound of sassa under my feet, occasionally a group of pack horses from the mountains shake the bronze bells under their necks, slow and far, suddenly shattered, when the horses spread their hooves and galloped. I talked a lot, about the scenery here, about the life of the past few years, about stories, about people, classmates, professors. I don't know what the reason is, but I actually implicated these things, and they seemed to correspond to each other, as if they could lead to some kind of ins and outs. I got a kind of freedom, not like the usual wandering, guided by the situation, handy, and sometimes with a genius pen. Until I realized that Xu Yuan only wanted my voice, and as for what I said, he didn't care, so I suddenly cooled down, and an embarrassing indifference was exposed even more by the banners of begging for help from each other. So the words dried up, like once the spring water had bottomed out, we walked with our heads down. I saw his temples trembling from ears to jawbones several times, and he wanted to speak, which was even worse. This situation had rarely happened to him before. We walked here, like two parallel lines, never intersecting. What's going on? Both of us walked fast, taking big steps, and both felt that this last section was too long. Well, there were walls, doors, and houses in front of me, and I breathed a sigh of relief, I simply jumped up the stone steps with a long race walk to the finish line, and I was afraid that he would get ahead of me. ——忽然他从我肩后奔跑过去，这使我的心登登一阵跳。怎么回事！坐在校医室门口的一个乡下女人一团火似的向他扑了过来？他慌忙急促的开他的锁，越乱，锁一时越弄不开，于是我一面开自己的门一面可以回头看他的样子。两个门同时开了，他的门立刻关上，两个人消失；我轻轻推，推了一半，也用力一送。——
Suddenly he ran over my shoulder, which made my heart skip a beat. What's going on! A country woman sitting at the door of the school doctor's office pounced on him like a fire? He hurriedly opened his lock, the more chaotic it was, the more difficult it was to open the lock for a while, so I could look back at him while opening my door. The two doors opened at the same time, his door closed immediately, and the two disappeared; I pushed gently, halfway, and sent hard. ——第一个思想：刚才我真不该那么看！然而我怎么办呢？立刻我好像完全明白这是怎么回事。我心里昏茫了一阵，不一会即恢复清醒。今天我所观测是确凿的，而且这一阵子我飘忽感觉原来都不该放过。我倒没有全神设想对面屋里的情形，只嚼着自己的孤单，因为无法助人。我不知道如何安排自己，我焦躁，不安，像一匹等待上鞍的马，忽然一下子我对他的印象全变了，而且根本没有印象。我构不出他的面容，只有他那对眉毛，平平黑黑的两道，在虚空中。我不晓得我现在对他感情是甚么，好像小孩子玩积木，从底下抽去一块，哗啦啦整个倒了下来！这回事情来得太突兀，超乎我的经验。最后我只有锁了门出去，我还有许多东西要买，而且我已经饿了。我原来想约徐一齐到一个本地饭馆里去吃一顿饭的，我现在决定仍是去那一家，我一个人。我看了看对面那个门，看了看那些花，明红亮白，太阳好旺。
The first thought: I really shouldn't have looked that way just now! But what should I do? Immediately I seemed to fully understand what was going on. I was confused for a while, and after a while I came back to my senses. What I observed today was conclusive, and I felt that I shouldn't have let it go for a while. I didn't think about the situation in the opposite room with all my heart, I only chewed on my loneliness because I couldn't help others. I didn't know how to arrange myself, I was restless, uneasy, like a horse waiting to be saddled, and suddenly my impression of him changed, and I had no impression at all. I couldn't make out his face, only his eyebrows, two plain and black lines, in the void. I don't know what my feelings for him are now, like a child playing with blocks, pulling a piece from the bottom, and falling down! This time it came too abruptly, beyond my experience. In the end, I had to lock the door and go out, I still had a lot of things to buy, and I was already hungry. I originally wanted to ask Xu to go to a local restaurant for a meal, but now I decided to go to that one, alone. I looked at the door opposite, looked at the flowers, bright red and white, and the sun was so bright.我睡得很晚，我有事担搁，而且也有意逗留。回来时满地月光，四处极静，看看对面屋子，没有灯。我在自己门前停了停，决定不走过去。东西都已经理好，房间里空空落落，把一本打算在车上看的小说看了三分之一，睡了，我想起前一个月一个展览会中的一幅油画，一个肥硕的女人，睡在猩红的毯子上。虽然没有衣服，正因为没有衣服，你一望而知是个乡下女人，一个夏娃一样的女人。……
I went to bed late, I had something to do, and I wanted to stay. When I came back, the ground was full of moonlight, and it was very quiet, and I looked at the room opposite, but there was no light. I stopped in front of my door and decided not to walk over. Everything was sorted out, the room was empty, I read a third of a novel I was going to read in the car, and I fell asleep, thinking of an oil painting from an exhibition the month before, a fat woman sleeping on a scarlet blanket. Although there were no clothes, it was because there were no clothes that you could tell at a glance that she was a country woman, an Eve-like woman. ……第二天起来，推开窗户一看，木匠用两个木条子交叉着钉对面房间的门。我好像并不觉得惊异，好像这正合乎理想。我过去看看，好像去看一个老炮台，旧堡垒。没有甚么，地下几张废纸，一个耗子洞很清楚的露在墙角。时候还早，我各处去看看，关照木匠把数学系的门钉了再给我钉，请他把“生物系办公室”那块小木头牌子取下来，我想带了去。我得去把那几棵美国种的剑兰块根挖出来，我是否该带一点原地的土去？……
When I got up the next day, I opened the window and saw that the carpenter had nailed the door of the opposite room with two wooden strips crossed. I didn't seem surprised, as if it was ideal. I went over to take a look, as if I was going to see an old fort, an old fortress. There was nothing, a few pieces of waste paper in the ground, and a mouse hole was clearly exposed in the corner. It was still early, so I went everywhere to look around, took care of the carpenter to nail the door of the mathematics department and then nailed it to me, and asked him to take down the small wooden sign of the "Department of Biology Office", which I wanted to take with me. I have to dig up the roots of those gladioli plants planted in the United States, should I bring some soil in place? ……我一个人上了路没有人跟我招手。再见，我们住了八年的地方！
I went on the road alone and no one waved to me. Goodbye, where we lived for eight years!陈夫妇同时去美，未及一见，也许他们知道那个女人是怎么回事。那一门功课因为原教授已经回来，照样开班。学校已经上了半年课了，迁回战前的原址。我继续教我的书，而且我的剑兰又开花了，一天一天的记载花的发育生长的日记，今天，我用一种极其庄严的态度写下：——第一朵花。
Chen and his wife went to the United States at the same time, but before they could see it, maybe they knew what was going on with that woman. That homework was still open because the original professor had returned. The school has been in class for half a year, and it has been moved back to its original location before the war. I continue to teach my books, and my gladioli blooms again, and today I write in an extremely solemn attitude: - The first flower.
[1] 本篇原载《文艺工作》1948年第一期。初收《汪曾祺全集》第一卷，北京师范大学出版社，1998年8月。

斑鸠

斑鸠[1]
[1] This article was originally published in the first issue of "Literary and Art Work" in 1948. The first volume of "The Complete Works of Wang Zengqi", Beijing Normal University Press, August 1998. Turtledove[1]我们都还小，我们在荒野上徜徉。我们从来没有过那样的精致的，深刻的秋的感觉。
秋天像一首歌，溶溶的把我们浸透。
We are all young, and we are wandering in the wilderness. We have never had such a delicate and deep autumn feeling. Autumn is like a song, soaking us meltingly.我们享受着身体的优美的运动，用使自己永远记得的轻飘的姿势，跳过了小溪，听着风流过淡白的发光的柔软的草叶，平滑而丰盈，像一点帆影，航过了一大片平地。我们到一个地方去，一个没有人去的秘密的地方，——那个林子，我们急于投身到里面而消失了。——我们的眼睛同时闪过一道深红，像听到一声出奇的高音的喊叫，一起切断了脚步。多猛厉的颜色，——一个猎人！猎人缠了那么一道深红的绑腿，移动着脚步，在外面一片阳光，里面朦朦胧胧的树林里。我们不知道我们那里也有猎人，——从来没有看见过，然而一看见我们就知道他是，非常确切的拍出了我们的梦想，即使他没有——他有一根枪。太意外又太真实，他像一个传说里的妖精出现在我们面前，我们怕。我忘不了我们的强烈的经验，忘不了——他为甚么要缠那么一道深红色的绑腿呢？他一步一步的走，秋天的树林，苍苍莽莽，重叠阴影筛下，细碎的黄金的阳光的点子，斑斑斓斓，游动，幻变，他踏着，踏着微干的草，枯叶，酥酥的压出声音，走过来，——走过去了。红绑腿，青布贴身衣裤。他长得瘦，全身收束得紧紧的。好骨干，瘦而有劲，腰股腿脚，处处结实利落，充满弹性。看他走路，不管甚么时候有一根棍子剧速的扫过来，他一定能跳起来避过去的。小脑袋，骨角停匀而显露，高鼻梁，薄嘴唇，眼目深陷，炯炯有光，锐利且坚定。——动人的是他的忧郁，一个一天难得说几句话的孤独的生活着的人才可能有的那种阴暗，美丽的，不刺痛，不是病态的幽深。冷酷么？——是的。我们从来没有见过一个这样的不动声色的人，这样不动声色对付着一个东西。一看就看出来，他所有的眼睛都向外看，所有耳朵都听，所有的知觉都集中起来，所有的肌肉都警醒，然而并不太用力，从从容容的，一步一步的走。树不密，他的路径没有太多折曲歪斜。他走着，时而略微向上看一看，简直像没有甚么目的。用不着看，他也确定的知道它在哪里。上头，一只斑鸠。我们毫不困难的就找到了那只斑鸠，他的身体给我们指了出来，这只鸟像有一根线接在他身上似的。是的，我们像猎人一样的在这整个林子里只看得见一只斑鸠了，除此之外一无所见了。斑鸠飞不高，在参差的树丛里找路，时而从枝叶的后面漏出瓦青色的肚子，灰红的胸，浅白的翅胛，甚至颈上的锦带，片段的一瞥。但是不管它怎么想不暴露它自己，它在我们眼睛里还是一个全身，从任何一点颜色我们复现得出一个完整的斑鸠。它逃不出它的形体。它也不叫唤，不出一声，只轻轻的听到一点鼓翅声音，听得出也是尽量压低的。这只鸟，它已经很知道它在甚么样的境遇里了。它在避免一个一个随时抽生出来的弹道，摆脱紧跟着它的危机，它摆脱，同时引导他走入歧途，想让他疲倦，让他废然离去。它在猎人的前面飞，又折转来，把前面变后面，叫刚才的险恶变为安全。过去，又过来，一个守着一个，谁也不放弃谁。这个林子充满一种紧张的，迫人的空气，我们都为这场无声的战斗吸住了，都屏着气，紧闭嘴唇，眼睛集中在最致命的一点上而随之转动。勇敢的鸟！它飞得镇定极了，严重，可是一点没有失了主意，它每一翅都飞得用心，有目的，有作用，煽动得匀净，调和，渐渐的，五六次来回之后，看出来飞得不大稳了，它有点慌乱，有点踉跄了。——阿呀，不行，它发抖，它怕得厉害，它的血流得失了常规，要糟！——好快！我们简直没有来得及看他怎么一抬枪，一声响，喨极了，完了，整个林子一时非常的静，非常的空，完全松了下来。和平了，只有空气里微微有点火药气味，——草里有甚么小花开了？香得很。
We enjoyed the graceful movement of our bodies, and with a light posture that we would always remember, we jumped over the stream, listening to the wind flowing through the soft blades of grass that glowed pale white, smooth and plump, like a little sail shadow, and sailed over a large flat land. We went to a place, a secret place where no one goes,—— that forest, and we hurriedly threw ourselves into it and disappeared. ——Our eyes flashed a crimson at the same time, and we cut off our steps together as if we heard a strangely high-pitched cry. What a fierce color,—— a hunter! The hunter wrapped his feet in such a crimson leggings, moving his steps, in the sun outside and the hazy woods inside. We didn't know that we had hunters there,—— we had never seen them, but as soon as we saw them, we knew he was a very accurate picture of our dreams, even if he didn't have a gun. Too unexpected and too real, he appeared in front of us like a legendary fairy, we were afraid. I can't forget our strong experience, I can't forget - why did he wrap such a crimson leggings? He walked step by step, the autumn woods, the wilderness, under the overlapping shadows, the fine golden sunlight, colorful, swimming, transforming, he stepped, stepped on the slightly dry grass, dead leaves, crisply pressed out the sound, came and ,—— walked over. Red leggings, green cloth undergarments. He is thin, and his whole body is tightly restricted. Good backbone, thin and strong, waist, legs, legs and feet, strong and neat everywhere, full of elasticity. Watching him walk, no matter when a stick swept over at high speed, he would definitely be able to jump up and avoid it. The small head, the bones are evenly revealed, the bridge of the nose is high, the lips are thin, the eyes are sunken, shining, sharp and firm. ——What is moving is his melancholy, the kind of dark, beautiful, non-stinging, not morbid depthness that a lonely person who rarely says a few words a day may have. Is it cold? ——Yes. We have never seen such a quiet person, so quiet to deal with something. At a glance, it was clear that all his eyes were looking outward, all his ears were listening, all his senses were concentrated, and all his muscles were alert, but he didn't try too hard, and he walked calmly, step by step. The trees were not dense, and his path was not too crooked. He walked, sometimes looking up slightly, as if he had no purpose. He didn't need to look, he knew for sure where it was. Up there, a turtledove. We found the turtledove without difficulty, and his body pointed out to us, and the bird seemed to have a thread attached to him. Yes, we could only see one turtledove in this whole forest like hunters, and nothing else. The turtle dove does not fly high, looking for its way through the jagged trees, and sometimes leaks out from behind the branches and leaves with a tile-blue belly, a gray-red chest, a pale white wing blade, and even a brocade band on its neck, a glimpse of it. But no matter how much it thinks not to expose itself, it is still a whole body in our eyes, and we can reproduce a complete turtledove from any color. It cannot escape its form. It does not call, does not make a sound, only hears a little sound of flapping its wings, and it can be heard as low as possible. This bird, it already knows very well what kind of situation it is in. It is avoiding the trajectory that is pumped out at any time, getting rid of the crisis that follows it, it gets rid of it, and at the same time leads him astray, trying to tire him and let him leave in vain. It flew in front of the hunter, turned again, turned the front into the back, and turned the sinister thing just now into safety. Passed, came again, one guarded the other, and no one gave up on the other. The forest was filled with a tense, compelling air, and we were all sucked in by this silent battle, holding our breath, closing our lips, and focusing our eyes on the deadliest point and turning with it. Brave bird! It flew very calmly, seriously, but did not lose its mind at all, every wing of it flew carefully, purposefully, effectively, evenly stirred and harmonious, gradually, after five or six times back and forth, it was seen that it was not flying very steadily, it was a little flustered, a little staggered. ——Oh, no, it was shaking, it was terribly scared, and its bleeding was out of order, worse! ——So fast! We didn't even have time to see how he raised his gun, and it rang out, and it was over, and the whole forest was very quiet and empty for a while, and it was completely relaxed. It was peaceful, only the air smelled of gunpowder,—— What little flowers bloomed in the grass? It was very fragrant.猎人走过去，捡了死鸟，（握在手里一定还是热的）拈去沾在毛上的一小片草叶子。斑鸠的脖子挂了下来，在他手里微微晃动，肚皮上一小块毛倒流了过来，大概是着地时擦的。他理顺了那点毛，手指温柔抚摸过去，似乎软滑的羽毛给了他一种快感。枪弹从哪里进去的呢？看不出来。小小头，精致的脚，瓦灰肚皮，锈色的肩，正是那一只啊，甚么地方都还完完整整的，好好的，“死”在甚么地方呢？他不动声色的，然而忧郁的看了它一会，一回头把斑鸠放进胁下一个布袋子里，——袋子里已经有了一只野鸡，毛色灿烂的一照。装了一粒新的子弹，背上枪，向北，他走出了这个林子，红色的绑腿到很远很远还看得见。秋天真是辽阔。
The hunter walked over, picked up the dead bird, and (it must still be hot in his hand) picked up a small blade of grass that was on the fur. The turtledove's neck hung down, swaying slightly in his hand, and a small piece of hair flowed back on his belly, probably rubbing it when he landed. He straightened out the hair, and his fingers gently stroked it, as if the soft feathers gave him a sense of pleasure. Where did the bullet come from? I can't tell it. The small head, delicate feet, gray belly, rusty shoulders, is exactly that one, it is still intact in any place, well, where is the "dead"? He looked at it calmly, but melancholy for a while, then turned around and put the turtledove into a cloth bag under his armpit,—— which already had a pheasant in it, with a brilliant coat. Loaded with a new bullet, with a gun on his back, heading north, he walked out of the forest, and the red leggings were still visible far and wide. Autumn is really vast.现在我们干甚么呢，在这个寂寞的树林里？

锁匠之死

锁匠之死[1]
What are we doing now, in this lonely woods? [1] This article was originally published in Xinlu Weekly, Volume 1, Issue 9, 1948. Death of the Locksmith[1]我们城里总是铳人。“铳”就是枪毙。不说是枪毙，说铳。你如果不说铳而说枪毙，城里人就觉得你要不是外边来的，“外路码子”；要不，假如知道你的底细，知道你的祖宗三代，你的“骨头渣子”，你是本乡人而（他们以为）故意不说本乡话，撇“官腔”，哈呀，了不起！你这两个字触犯了他们，他们一定对你侧之以目，嗤之以鼻，努之以嘴，歧视你，恨你，对你有一种敌意。小城里的人都敏感得出奇，多疑善忌，脆弱的自尊心一来就碰伤了。他们随时听得出你声音里有些甚么意思，随时觉得你笑他，看不起他，为了跟你对抗，他们在他们的城垣上增了更多的石头，把他们的固执堆积得更高。如你往大街上一看，随便问一句，“甚么事情？——是不是又枪毙人？”人丛之中一定有一个十分严厉的声音直撞撞的发出来“铳人”！你没法奈何，你觉得他像是寻事找碴儿罢，他又可以说这是好意跟你答话。你皱一皱眉毛，他那儿心里可笑开了。准保事后他一定跟人添油加醋的讲一气，把你形容得狼狈不堪。……好罢，就说是铳人。我们城里是个铳人铳得最多的地方，这简直是她的最大的特色。要是把这个特色取去，我想不不出有甚么可以代替他的。每年要是没有那么些人枪毙，我们的城是甚么样子呢？我怕我要不认得她了。我的那些尊贵的同乡们的一部分情感当然要没有搁处了。于是我们的城加给我一层阴暗。说“最多”不无有点问题，但无论如何比别的地方要“重要”，影响要大。如果说我的印象不大准确，我告诉你，我的初级中学在县城东门城脚，东门外即是杀场。出东门有一木桥，桥下的水呼呼的流得很悲惨，本来叫做东门桥，但一般都称之为“掉魂桥”，言死囚过此桥上魂即掉去也。我们在上课，忽然远远听见许多人奔跑的声音，听见那种凄厉的单调的号声，一会儿汹汹涌涌的过去了。我们的心就沉下来，沉沉的撞击，紧紧的压得难受。枪响了，听得清楚是几个人，一人挨了几枪。冲起一阵喝采的声音，再又是一阵杂沓的脚步，当中夹着一串整齐的，一队保卫团的兵，跑步，吹的号是凯旋号。有时适在下课时候，同学多随着去看。年纪都还小，很多在枪声一响的那一霎回过头来的。我则从未亲自去看过。不过有时进出东门，殷红的白，发了一点黑，破烂的尸首总会映到你眼晴里来。东门外有一个非常好的乘凉看书吹口琴放风筝的地方，有一棵极大的桑树，结了一树大紫桑椹，在摘下来要放进嘴的时候一想到枪一拨响的景象就会老大不自在，眼晴里涌出了恐怖。有一次，我刚从外面回到学校，要进校门，校门进不去了，全是人，堵得死死的，后面有人还拿了凳子爬上来看，就要来了，——又铳人。没有办法，只好站在前头。既然非看不可，我就好好的看一看。一共五个。我一个一个看过去。全是土匪。向来枪毙都是土匪。有一个，我认得！那是南门的一个锁匠。
There are always gunmen in our city. "Gun" means shooting. Don't say it's a shooting, say a gun. If you don't talk about guns but gunshot, the people in the city will think that if you are not from outside, you are a "foreign yard"; otherwise, if you know your details, know your ancestors for three generations, your "bone scum", you are from your hometown and (they think) deliberately don't speak your hometown dialect, skip the "official accent", haha, it's amazing! If you offend them with the word "you", they will definitely look at you sideways, scoff at you, try to talk to you, discriminate against you, hate you, and have a kind of hostility towards you. The people in the small town are surprisingly sensitive, suspicious, and their fragile self-esteem is hurt at the moment they come. They can hear something in your voice at any time, and at any time they feel that you laugh at him and look down on him, and in order to fight you, they add more stones to their walls and pile up their stubbornness higher. If you look down on the street and ask casually, "What's the matter?" ——Did you shoot someone again?" There must be a very stern voice in the crowd that came out of the crowd! You can't help it, you think he's just looking for something to do, and he can say that he is kind enough to answer you. You frown, and he laughs in his heart. After the incident, he will definitely talk to people and describe you in a terrible way. …… Okay, let's just say gunmen. Our city is a place with the most gunmen, and this is simply her greatest feature. If this characteristic were removed, I can't think of anything that could replace him. If there were no so many people shot every year, what would our city look like? I'm afraid I wouldn't recognize her. Of course, some of the emotions of my noble fellow villagers would have to be left unchecked. So our city added a layer of darkness to me. It is a bit problematic to say "at most", but in any case, it is more "important" than other places, and the impact is greater. If my impression is not very accurate, let me tell you that my junior high school is at the foot of the east gate of the county seat, and outside the east gate is the killing field. There is a wooden bridge outside the east gate, and the water under the bridge flows miserably, originally called the East Gate Bridge, but it is generally called the "Soul Bridge Falling Bridge", which means that the soul of a death row prisoner will fall off when he crosses this bridge. We were in class, and suddenly we heard the sound of many people running in the distance, and we heard the mournful and monotonous trumpet sound, which passed violently for a while. Our hearts sank, and the heavy impact was uncomfortable. The gunshots rang out, and I could clearly hear several people, one of whom was shot several times. There was a burst of cheers, and then a burst of chaotic footsteps, sandwiched between a neat string of soldiers from the defense regiment, running, blowing the trumpet of triumph. Sometimes at the end of class, the students mostly went to see it. They are still young, and many of them turned around the moment the gunshots rang out. I have never seen it in person. But sometimes when you go in and out of the east gate, the crimson white is a little black, and the tattered corpse will always be reflected in your eyes. There is a very good place outside the east gate to enjoy the shade, read books, play harmonica, and fly kites, there is a very large mulberry tree, a big purple mulberry, when you pick it and put it in your mouth, you will be uncomfortable at the thought of the gun ringing, and horror wells up in your eyes. Once, I just returned to school from outside, and I was about to enter the school gate, but the school gate couldn't get in, it was full of people, it was blocked, and someone behind me climbed up with a stool to look at it, and it was about to come,—— and there was a gunman. There was no way, so I had to stand in front. Since I have to see it, I will take a good look. There are five in total. I looked over one by one. All bandits. Bandits have always been shot. There is one, I recognize! It was a locksmith at the south gate.这个锁匠有一个很好的百灵。我每次经过他门前时都要看一看。我记得他那个铺子的整个的样子。我记得他的样子。他有妻子老婆，有一个孩子。他家后头有个小院子，有一棵树，树长过屋脊，在外头就看得见。……现在，这是他。他就要去枪毙了。他坐在一个柳条篮子里，被两个扛夫抬着，这样子很滑稽。滑稽得教人痛苦。是他！他没有变样子，不，这不是他。他怎么会，怎么会。是这个样子呢。你猜我当时想的甚么？我想做皇帝。我想九更天，闻太师，——我想我一点也不能救他。我白着脸站在那里。等门口人滚滚的插进跟在后面的队伍里去，松了，露出了大门，我走进去。我一个人坐在空空的学校里的空空的教室里，半天半天。一直到听见有人在隔壁弹风琴。我是个孩子！但是别笑我，那个锁匠是个了不得的人，了不得的锁匠。他的铺子，我傍晚经过时特为看了一看，果然，知道是，关上了。当然一定是关了多少日子了，我早就知道，早就听说，早就看见的。然而以前好像这是不可靠的，不真实，不明明白白的，现在，完了，划然的摆在我面前。排门上两道封条，十字交叉，白纸黑字，县政府封，月日，一颗大朱印。有一根柱子有点歪。
This locksmith had a good lark. I had to look at it every time I passed by his door. I remember the whole thing of his shop. I remember what he looked like. He had a wife and a child. There was a small yard behind his house, and there was a tree that grew over the ridge and was visible from the outside. …… Now, this is him. He's going to be shot. He's sitting in a wicker basket, carried by two porters, and it's funny. It's painful. It's him! He didn't change, no, it's not him. How could he, how could he? That's what it looks like. Guess what I was thinking at that time? I want to be emperor. I think it's the ninth watch, Wen Taishi,—— I don't think I can save him at all. I stood there with a white face. When the people at the door rolled in and into the line following me, I relaxed, revealing the door, and I walked in. I sat alone in an empty classroom in an empty school for half a day. Until I heard someone playing the organ next door. I'm a child! But don't laugh at me, that locksmith is a great person, a great locksmith. I took a look at his shop when I passed by in the evening, and sure enough, I knew it was closed. Of course, it must have been closed for a long time, I knew it for a long time, I had heard about it, and I had seen it for a long time. However, it used to seem unreliable, untrue, and unclear, but now, it's over, it's clearly in front of me. There are two seals on the row door, crossed, black and white on paper, sealed by the county government, month and day, and a large red seal. There is a pillar that is a little crooked.他的罪名是跟匪有来往，通匪。跟匪有来往不一定就是通匪。但在我们地方上人看起来没有甚么两样。至少愿意他没有两样。他的情形也比较特别一点。……主要是因为他住的地方。他住在简直是城中心，往南往北都没有几步即是闹市和富宅。这简直不得了，给他们的威胁太大了，不等于是匪都住在家里来了？随时就有危险，嘿！他们容不得这么一个大胆的人，而且那么一个聪明人，那么有心眼，机伶。而且，他倒真稳呐，一点都看不出来。看他那样子，哪里像个通匪的人，像个匪呢？（直截指之为匪了。）还怪和气的，怪规规矩矩，说话，待人，哪一样不好好的？天天还都见面呢！——个王八旦！谁料得到他里头是这么样的险！奸！他们气愤了，他们觉得他顶可恨的是他们被他蒙住了，他们像个三岁孩子似的被人欺负了，他们冤！于是从前对他的好感漫无节制的增高起来，他们简直把他说成了神，甚么不可能的，平常决不有人相信的事情大家全都相信了，临时现抓，越编越多，越编越长，越编越有声有色，委委曲曲，原原本本，一大套变成理由和证据，——杀他！因为，他们不为甚么也希望他被杀，希望有人被杀，他们要创造出这么一个人。这回花样翻新，异于往常，有趣。
His crime is to have dealings with bandits and collude with bandits. Having dealings with bandits does not necessarily mean colluding with bandits. But in our place, people seem to be no different. At least I hope he is not different. His situation is also a little more special. …… Mainly because of where he lives. He lives in the center of the city, just a few steps south and north of the downtown area and rich houses. This is simply amazing, the threat to them is too great, doesn't it mean that the bandits all live in the house? There is danger at any time, hey! 卦摊

卦摊[1]
——阙下杂记之一
His lark hung in the headquarters of the defense regiment, and he could only hear the call, but he couldn't see it. [1] This article was originally published in the Pingming Daily on July 18, 1948. Hexagram stall{{id_0000}} ——One of the miscellaneous notes of the palace初到北平，哪儿都不认识——充满了新鲜。从东安市场到沙滩不是最普普通通的一条路么？住在沙滩的人都熟，我后来也都熟透了。可是刚到的那一天，他们带我上市场吃晚饭，晚上回来，那天没有灯，黑黑的，我觉得这条路上充满了东西，全都感动我，我有点恍恍惚惚，我心里不停的有一个声音：我到了一个地方，我到了一个地方。我一点不认识，而且我根本没有要去认识路，他们告诉我“哎，转弯。”“哎，哎，曾祺。”……全都殷勤极了，我像一个空船，一点担负都没有。……我们上公园去。从沙滩坐三轮。我在三轮车上不觉路之远近，我放开眼睛看，觉得这条路很好。车子一转，“这条路好！”从街市转入冷巷，像从第一页（书）到了第二页，前面的多方的印象流入统一的，细致的叙述。车在城墙下平路上走，城墙，河水，树，柏树，胶皮轮子丝丝的响，天气好，爽快，经过一个地方，又是城墙，河水，柏树，稍为杂乱一点，一点人工，一点俗，——到了。很难找到甚么话说出我对公园的初次印象。很像一个公园。——这就是说很难产生一个印象，一个比较具体的，完整的，肯定，毫不犹豫，不由理智整理过的印象。公园总有点乱，一点俗，一点人为的痕迹。回来，我倒是记得那条路。城下的路。我记得那条路上有好些测字摊子。那条路我说不出来，我说“那条路上有好些测字摊子”，就代表了我对路的感情了，我觉得很表达出来了，听着，看到我说话的样子，他们也都懂了。这条路是一个喜悦。
When I first arrived in Peiping, I didn't know anywhere - it was full of freshness. Isn't it the most ordinary road from Dong'an Market to the beach? Everyone who lives on the beach is familiar with it, and I am familiar with it later. But on the day I first arrived, they took me to the market for dinner, and when I came back in the evening, there were no lights that day, it was dark, I felt that the road was full of things, all of them moved me, I was a little dazed, and there was a voice in my heart: I arrived at a place, I arrived at a place. I didn't know him at all, and I didn't want to know the road at all, they told me, "Hey, turn." "Hey, hey, Zeng Qi." …… They were all very attentive, I was like an empty boat, with no burden at all. …… Let's go to the park. Take a tricycle from the beach. I didn't notice the distance of the road on the tricycle, and I let go of my eyes and thought that this road was good. As soon as the car turned, "This road is good!" Turning from the market to the cold alley, it was like from the first page (book) to the second page, and the impressions of many parties in front flowed into a unified and detailed narrative. The car walked on the flat road under the city wall, the city wall, the river, the trees, the cypress trees, the rubber wheels made a slight sound, the weather was good, refreshing, passing through a place, and the city wall, river, cypress trees, a little messy, a little artificial, a little vulgar ,——. It's hard to find words to say my first impression of the park. It's like a park. ——This means that it is difficult to produce an impression, a more specific, complete, affirmative, unhesitating, and irrational impression. The park is always a bit messy, a little vulgar, a little artificial. When I came back, I remembered that road. The road under the city. I remember there were many word stalls on that road. I can't tell that road, I said "there are many word stalls on that road", which represents my feelings for the road, I think it's very expressive, listen, see the way I speak, they all understand. This road is a joy.那条路是东华门至西华门，太庙后河沿至公园后门的路，紫禁城下的路，当中所经过的那“一个地方”是午门的前面，阙左门与阙右门之间，即我现在所在的地方。我对于这个地方，这条路可以说是很熟的了。我现要说那些测字摊，卦摊。——这种摊子我一直都称之为测字摊，这也许是我的家乡土话，或者是因为我们那里这种摊子乃是以测字为主，虽其所业类皆不以测字为限，且或有根本就不给人测字者，我们则一律名之为“测字摊子”了。按测字当作拆字，拆析字画，加以添减，附会阴阳时日之数为说，为人剖置疑信灾祥之术也，但小时看测字先生放置字卷的铜制或木制小斗的正面所写的正是“测字”这两个字，遂深深的记下了。“测”自较“拆”字更深一筹。“测”者猜测之谓，许多事情本就是猜测猜测而已，哪能就当得真呢，拆字若是直白，测字似更宛转，各有所长，难可抑扬之也。我唯在昆明翠湖公园昆华图书馆前的石凳上看到过一个，那真是“拆（！）字”的。一个老头子，一个普普通通的老头子，他坐在石凳上你以为他就是坐在那里而已，是个坐在那里休息休息的人，不以为他是干甚么的。他没有布匾桌帷，没有桌子，没有八卦太极之类东西，没有一点神秘的，巫术的，没有神秘与巫术被否定了之后的漂泊的存在的嘲笑空气，使人相信的热心已经失去，但不得不对自己的热心作无望的乞怜的难堪的无力的挣扎，没有那种露出了难看的裸体，希望人家不必细看的悲哀的声音，没有“混碗饭吃吃”的最卑下的生活态度，没有“江湖气”，他有一个墨盒一枝笔，你甚至连一个墨盒一枝笔都不觉得他有，一点都不惹你注意。
That road is from Donghua Gate to Xihua Gate, along the river behind the Taimiao Temple to the back gate of the park, and the road under the Forbidden City. I am very familiar with this place, this road. Now I want to talk about those word testing stalls, hexagram stalls. ——I have always called this kind of word testing stall, this may be my hometown dialect, or because our kind of stall is mainly word testing, although its business is not limited to word testing, and there are people who do not test words at all, we all call it "word testing stall". According to the word measurement as dismantling, disassembling the calligraphy and painting, adding and subtracting, and attaching the number of yin and yang time and days, it is also the art of dissecting people's doubts and beliefs, but when I was a child, I looked at the front of the copper or wooden bucket where Mr. Meizi placed the word scroll and wrote the word "measuring" deeply. "Testing" is deeper than the word "demolition". "Testing" means guessing, many things are just guessing and guessing, how can it be taken seriously, if the word is straightforward, the word measurement seems to be more winding, each has its own strengths, and it is difficult to suppress it. I have only seen one on the stone bench in front of the Kunhua Library in Cuihu Park, Kunming, and it is really a "dismantling (!) word". An old man, an ordinary old man, he sits on a stone bench and you think he is just sitting there, a person who sits there resting and resting, and you don't think he is doing anything. His only characteristic is: simplicity. Simplicity is everything to him. We don't know how to know that he is a word tester, in fact, I still can't find any reason to conclude that he is, unless we have seen him dismantled. We rarely see it. We have all seen it, but very little, as if everyone has the opportunity to see it once, a different time, which is simply funny! He doesn't "will" at all, no, not like that. Looking at his appearance, he didn't want to say another word, and he didn't say a word. He also didn't realize that his patron was not satisfied and was still waiting. It's like pouring a bean out of a bottle, it's gone. Give money, what are you doing if you don't leave? Go, this gentleman is really inexplicable. Measuring words and divination is originally to tell you what is in your heart, to organize your way, to give you a temporary order, to deepen, deepen and connect the color of certain words, so that the original trend becomes a trend, the stagnant flow is smoother, brushing away the sediment on both sides of the river, becoming a joyful rush, so that you can hear your voice, your trembling, eating, loving language, your tears and your laughter, let you have a sweet dream. Yes, having a dream gives you comfort and courage. Warm, lyrical profession, thoughtful, imaginative, moving language, poet, not a "philosopher"! But he is simple, he does not say "to" his heart at all; he does not get what he wants: to be moved. He walked on the boulevard, his face facing the scenery, he felt thirsty, he burned for something, his body was full of deficiencies, a nest of yellow mouths (birds). There is no difference from engaging in a profession to withdrawing from a profession, there is no boundary, no process. What does it matter how much he talks, he doesn't speak, he doesn't speak, except for one sentence: he is permanently simple. He sits there, he doesn't want to. He is not empty, he has his existence, an inherent, preceding thought, an image without words. We think it's strange, we wonder how he can be a word-breaker. It's impossible, just as I can't be you. Ah no, these two old men have their own differences. The shopkeeper of the teahouse has his teahouse, and the teahouse has guests. There is Guanghuang smoke, sheep's blood and bean curd rice noodles. There are buys, there are sales. There are people who carry water to carry water, plasterers wipe the stoves, although it is rare, occasionally change a tin pot or two, there are city defense donations, business licenses, there are evening counting money, month-end checkouts, shakes, guarantees, intermittent old flower lights, fluttering news, holiday air, anniversaries The police come to call the national flag to hang, there are relatives' life and death, and even one or two days he is not in the teahouse! The teahouse is either closed or managed by someone else. Where did the old man go? ——I went as a guest! …… In short, he has operations, management, life, and personnel. In life, in personnel, he has become softer and gentler, and he sometimes looks quite complacent. He has a son! I don't care about anything all day long, usually I don't stay at home, but at home I sit in the hall of the house, three friends and four friends, put my feet on the bench, make a few bowls of tea, smoke a cigarette, talk and laugh loudly, and dress up, just like a gang member. Sometimes when drinking inside, the voice is particularly high, shaking the air in the hut and making everyone who drinks tea feel uneasy. Recently married. The teahouse was lively all day, and the two drummers played suona. But tea is still sold on the tea table outside, and there are fewer tea drinkers, and more tea drinkers are customers. So there was a young woman, wearing green satin shoes, with red eyes, smiling from time to time, swaying her freshly permed hair, and an oily head, constantly walking in and out, twisting her waist, and constantly eating, peanuts, iron beans, sunflower seeds...... However, I thought the old man was going to be unhappy, no, he was happy! This kind of young, enchanting air gave the old man an excitement, he was not so musty and understood, and he became lively. And the old man of Yunda moved home soon.为甚么来了，为甚么又走了？怎么走的？怎么完成这一个决定的？怎么发了誓，怎么拿起刀来，不可救药的那么一割？是偶然么？像我们做许多事一样，无所谓，说不出甚么理由，高兴怎么样，便怎么样了？可是宁可是荒谬吧，我知道他跟我们不同。他可以被歪曲，不可以被抹杀。我们既不能像他那样一直枯坐在那一个地方，我们就不当把这件事说得那么轻易。是这个羽翼已成的储君说了甚么话，用他的眼角，他的鞋尖，他吐的痰，泼的水对他示了意？不会。一个缝穷的老女人，一个卖山林果的孩子也许早被威严的手势赶开了，可是没有人可以赶他。他是强大的，坚持的，不可侵犯的。与其说他被排斥了不如说他排斥了这个地方，排斥了这个空间。
Why did he come, why did he leave again? How did he leave? How did he accomplish this decision? Why did he swear, how did he take up the knife, how did he cut it so hopelessly? Was it accidental? Like many things we do, it doesn't matter, there is no reason to say anything, how happy is it? But it is rather ridiculous, I know that he is different from us. He can be distorted, he cannot be erased. Since we cannot sit in that place like he did, we should not speak so lightly. What did this fledgled prince say, signaling to him with the corners of his eyes, the tips of his shoes, the phlegm he spat out, and the water he splashed? No. An old woman who is poor in seam, a child who sells mountain fruits may have been driven away by majestic gestures, but no one can drive him away. He is powerful, persistent, and inviolable. It is not so much that he is rejected, but that he rejects this place, rejects this space.后来我们才对他的摊子有比较真切的认识，不是书摊是卦摊。他的摊子也卖书，也卖卦。但起初实在很不“正式”，大概有一个样子，一个雏形而已。几本本书，疎疎的排成两列。书也很不像是一个书，都非常破旧了，不单是纸色黄暗，失去浆性，脆了硬了，卷了边，缺了角，短了书皮，失去遮护；不单是外貌，它们已经失去那种可以称之为书的本质。里面的语言已经死了，哑了，干涸了，而且也完全失去交易价值。既不是可读的，不是读物，也不可以买卖，不是商品，是我们不知道把它丢到这个世界的哪一个地方是好的“废物”、一些陈旧的形式而已。是的，形式，这是他所需要的。这个摊子就是一种形式，他的形式。他的目的不在买卖，他只须要摆那么几本书在身边，他可以靠它下来。——也不知道从哪里捡来的这么几本破纸！不是职业，是玩具。他另外一种玩具是一枝笔。——偶尔居然有人为了对于这个“形式”的兴趣，对于向“他”买，买他这个形式的一部份的兴趣而来，试一问价钱，——大得惊人！我还从未看他开过张。而且讲价都很少，多半只站着看一看而已。看一看的也很少。他整天没有事，木然的坐着而已。除了木然的坐着，他有时伏在地上写字。用纸，用拆开的香烟盒子，用薄薄的小版，因材就用，各取所宜，长短大小不一，都把它写得满满的。字体很怪，虽然是一个一个的字，而且是很认真的写，但送带之间，不依常法，扭来扭去，有如蛇行，实近乎是一种符箓。字与字连缀起来，既无语气，也无文法，牵牵挂挂，不可了解。然而似乎自有一种意义，不可了解，超乎了解的意义。——他后来搬到云大墙外，公共汽车站的后面一块空地上去了。日积月累，惨淡经营，渐渐的很有规模了，很是那么一回事，很不可忽略，很“丰富”了。书多了，占了不小一块地方。还是写字，每本书皮上都题了极大的字，题字的纸板木片已经积了好些好些，而且都用硃笔密密圈点起来，依照一种奇怪排列，有的插在地上，有的拉了好些绳子挂起来。从前本有的一个小木盒子也供得高高的了。从前不知道这是干甚么用的，现在则很明显了，这里头有一个神或一个魔。听说他会算卦。
Later, we had a more real understanding of his stall, not a book stall but a hexagram stall. His stall also sells books and hexagrams. But at first it was really not "formal", probably just a look, a prototype. Several books are sparsely arranged in two columns. The book is also very dilapidated, not only the paper is yellow and dark, losing its pulp, brittle and hard, curled edges, missing corners, short book cover, and losing its cover; not only in appearance, but also in terms of appearance, they have lost the essence of what can be called a book. The language inside is dead, dumb, dry, and completely loses its trading value. It is neither readable, nor readable, nor can it be bought or sold, it is not a commodity, it is just some old form that we don't know where in the world it is good "waste". Yes, form, this is what he needs. This stall is a form, his form. His purpose is not to buy or sell, he just needs to keep a few books around, and he can rely on it to come down. ——I don't know where I picked up these torn papers! It's not a profession, it's a toy. His other toy is a pen. ——Occasionally, someone actually comes to him for the interest in this "form", for the interest in buying from "him", about buying a part of his form, and asking for a price,—— is amazing! I have never seen him open. And there are very few bargains, most of them just stand and look at it. There are very few people to look at. He has nothing to do all day, just sitting blankly. In addition to sitting blankly, he sometimes lies on the ground to write. Use paper, use open cigarette boxes, use thin small plates, use them according to the material, each suitable, different lengths and sizes, all of which are full of writing. The font is very strange, although it is written one by one, and it is written very seriously, but between the belts, it is not according to the usual law, twisting and turning, like a snake, almost a kind of talisman. The words are connected to each other, there is neither tone nor grammar, and there is no concern, and it is incomprehensible. However, it seems to have its own meaning, which cannot be understood, and the meaning is beyond understanding. ——He later moved to an open space behind the bus stop outside the cloud wall. Over time, the business was bleak, and gradually it became very large-scale, very something, very negligible, and very "rich". There are many books, which take up a lot of space. I still write, each book cover is inscribed with very large characters, and the cardboard pieces of inscription have accumulated quite a bit, and they are all tightly circled with red pens, arranged according to a strange arrangement, some are inserted on the ground, and some are hung with many ropes. A small wooden box that used to be used was also provided high. I didn't know what it was used for before, but now it is obvious that there is a god or a demon here. I heard that he can tell fortunes.日本飞机把钱局街的一段炸成一片瓦砾，渐渐成了一块荒地，黄土堆得高高的，长了好些草。于是有耍猴子的来敲锣，玩傀儡戏的吹哨子，春天搭台唱了几天花灯，平常则经常有一个“套圈子”的摊子，有一两个人耐心的拿一把竹圈子一个一个的往地上排列着的瓷碗，泥娃娃，香烟，水果糖上投掷。才不到半年的事，简直都认不出来了，认不出当初有房屋时是甚么样了，倒塌时是甚么样子的了。有一棵小石榴树，居然开花，一个孤立的门框附了几块砖头居然还在，不知道为甚么没有推倒。而门里的一块地非常的平整，平整得令人哀伤。甚么时候老头子看上了这块地，于是把他的摊子，他的道场，他的坛，他的庙，搬了过来。他的龛子供得更高，字写得更多，布置得更繁复，而且插了一些小红旗子，他完全围在一种神秘的，妖黑的，——而凄厉悲惨的空气之中了。他完全疯了，他可以走到水里去火里去。大家知道有这么一个老头子，在那儿给人算卦。他用一种甚么方式给人家算卦呢？——喔，没有关系，他甚么都不用，凭他自己，这就够了。是的，这也还是一种玩具。可是我们还是玩点别的罢，这实在玩不起。——他大概会在那里住定下来，一直到死。
Japanese planes blew up a section of Qianju Street into rubble, and gradually became a wasteland, with loess piled high and a lot of grass. So there were monkey players who came to beat gongs, played puppet play whistles, set up a stage to sing lanterns for a few days in spring, and usually there was often a "circle" stall, and one or two people patiently took a handful of bamboo rings and threw them at the porcelain bowls, clay dolls, cigarettes, and fruit candies lined up on the ground one by one. It's been less than half a year, and I can't recognize what the house was like when it was there and what it looked like when it collapsed. There was a small pomegranate tree, which actually bloomed, and a few bricks attached to an isolated door frame were still there, I don't know why it was not knocked down. And the piece of land in the door was very flat, sadly flat. When the old man took a fancy to this land, he moved his stall, his ashram, his altar, and his temple. His niche was taller, more writing, more elaborate, and some small red flags were planted, and he was completely surrounded by a mysterious, dark,—— and miserable air. He was completely crazy, he could go into the water and go into the fire. Everyone knows that there is such an old man who gives people fortune-telling. In what way does he tell fortunes for people? --Oh, it doesn't matter, he doesn't need anything, it's enough for himself. Yes, it's still a toy. But let's play something else, which is really unaffordable. - He will probably live there until he dies.
