In 1983 Eight thousand years old Rain Get lost The earthworm seller tail Yun Zhi Qiu Xing Sunday Hometown of Sanchen Chen Xiaoshu Chen Si Chen Loach Ephemeral flowers, cranes, and ghost fires Golden Winter Heart In 1961羊舍一夕[1]
——又名：四个孩子和一个夜晚
一、夜晚
火车过来了。
“216！往北京的上行车。”老九说。
One night in the sheep barn{{id_0000}} ——Also known as: Four Kids and a Night 1. Night The train is coming. “216！ Upbound train to Beijing. Lao Jiu said.于是他们放下手里的工作，一起听火车。老九和小吕都好像看见：先是一个雪亮的大灯，亮得叫人眼睛发胀。大灯好像在拼命地往外冒光，而且冒着汽，嗤嗤地响。乌黑的铁，铮黄的铜。然后是绿色的车身，排山倒海地冲过来。车窗蜜黄色的灯光连续地映在果园东边的树墙子上，一方块，一方块，川流不息地追赶着……每回看到灯光那样猛烈地从树墙子上刮过去，你总觉得会刮下满地枝叶来似的。可是火车一过，还是那样：树墙子显得格外的安详，格外的绿。真怪。
So they put down their work and listened to the train together. Lao Jiu and Xiao Lu both seemed to see: first a snowy headlight, so bright that it made people's eyes swell. The headlights seemed to be desperately emitting light, and they were steaming and snorting. Black iron, yellow copper. Then there was the green body, rushing over. The honey-yellow light from the car window was continuously reflected on the tree wall on the east side of the orchard, and the river was chasing endlessly...... Every time you see the light scraping violently from the tree wall, you always feel as if it will scrape off the branches and leaves all over the ground. But once the train passed, it was still like that: the tree wall looked particularly peaceful and green. It's really strange.这些，老九和小吕都太熟悉了。夏天，他们睡得晚，老是到路口去看火车。可现在是冬天了。那么，现在是什么样子呢？小吕想象，灯光一定会从树墙子的枝叶空隙处漏进来，落到果园的地面上来吧。可能！他想象着那灯光映在大梨树地间作的葱地里，照着一地的大葱蓬松的，干的，发白的叶子……
These are all too familiar to Lao Jiu and Xiao Lu. In the summer, they go to bed late and always go to the intersection to see the train. But it's winter now. So, what does it look like now? Xiao Lu imagined that the light would definitely leak in through the gaps in the branches and leaves of the tree wall and fall on the ground of the orchard. Possible! He felt the fire burning his eyes, and he could even feel the heat of fire on his left forehead and cheek. His eyes narrowed and narrowed...... He experienced it in a daze, for a long time, for half a day, without moving. What's wrong with you?" ”今天晚上，老九可是专心致意地打了一晚上鞭子。你已经要去炼钢了，还编什么鞭子呢？

4. Leaving children and Ding Guijia留孩和丁贵甲是奶兄弟。这一带风俗，对奶亲看得很重。结婚时先给奶爹奶母磕头；奶爹奶母死了，像给自己的爹妈一样的戴孝。奶兄弟，奶姊妹，比姨姑兄弟姊妹都亲。丁贵甲的亲娘还没有出月子就死了，丁贵甲从小在留孩娘跟前寄奶。后来丁贵甲的爹得了腰疼病，终于也死了。他在给人家当小羊伴子以前，一直就在留孩家长大。丁贵甲有时请假说回家看看，就指的是留孩的家。除此之外，他的家便是这个场了。
Liuhui and Ding Guijia are milk brothers. The customs in this area attach great importance to wet relatives. When you get married, you first kowtow to your parents and wet nurse; when your parents and mothers die, they are filial piety like your own parents. Milk brothers, milk sisters, are closer than aunts and brothers and sisters. Ding Guijia's mother died before confinement, and Ding Guijia had been sending milk to her since she was a child. Later, Ding Guijia's father suffered from back pain and finally died. Before he was a lamb companion for others, he had always grown up in a family with children. Ding Guijia sometimes took leave to go home and see, referring to the home of the child. In addition, his home is this place.留孩一年也短不了来看他奶哥。过去大都是他爹带他来，这回是他自己来的——他爹在生产队里事忙，三五天内分不开身；而且他这回来和往回不同：他是来谈工作的。他要来顶老九的手。留孩早就想过这个场里来工作。他奶哥也早跟场领导提了。这回谈妥了，老九一走，留孩就搬过来住。

There are also sheep here. The sheep here are also different. The first time I came here, I saw at a glance that the sheep here all had dog tails. He thought it didn't look like it at first, and it was strange. Of course, I later learned that this was not a local sheep, but a hybrid of a local sheep and a Caucasian sheep. This kind of sheep, a handful of hair that can't be caught, make a leather jacket, you can lie down on the ice of the Yanghe River to sleep for three or nine days! If that's the case, then the tail doesn't look very decent, and it can be forgiven.那两头“高加索”，好家伙，比毛驴还大。那么大个脑袋（老羊倌说一个脑袋有十三斤肉），两盘大角，不知绕了多少圈，最后还旋扭着向两边支出来。脖子下的皮皱成数不清的折子，鼓鼓囊囊的，像围了一个大花领子。老是慢吞吞地，稳稳重重地在草地上踱着步。时不时地，停下来，斜着眼，这边看看，那边看看，样子很威严，很尊贵。留孩觉得它很像张士林的一本游记书上画的盛装的非洲老酋长。老九叫他骑一骑。留孩说：“羊嘛，咋骑得！”老九说：“行！”留孩当真骑上去，不想它立刻围着羊舍的场子开起小跑来，步子又匀，身子又稳！原来这两只羊已经叫老九训练得很善于做本来是驴应做的事了。

Wolves also eat grapes. ” Xiao Lu said: "This wolf is probably a vegetarian, and he is an old Taoist who is fasting!" ” Both Liuhai and Lao Jiu laughed.“都说狼会赶羊，是真的么？狼要吃哪只羊，就拿尾巴拍拍它，像哄孩子一样，羊就乖乖地在前头走，是真的么？”

"Why did that person say that?"“是这样——狼一口咬住羊的脖子，拖着羊，羊疼哩，就走，狼又用尾巴抽它，——哪是拍它！唿擞——唿擞——唿擞，看起来轻轻的，你看不清楚，就像狼赶羊，其实还是狼拖羊。它要不咬住它，它跟你走才怪哩！”

That year, he followed the sheep herd up the mountain. The mountains we have there are high and steep, and almost no one can even find the sheep road. The sheep herder went to the ditch to find water and asked Brother Guijia to watch alone for a while. When Brother Guijia saw it, a group of sheep were startled, trembling one by one, and calling in a low voice. Brother Guijia said in his heart - wolf! At first glance, it was gray and yellow, hairy, and quite large, right in the apricot bush in front of it. There was a tree next to it, and Brother Guijia was so frightened that he jumped up the tree. The wolf took a big lamb and drove its tail, and id_0000 it passed under the tree all of a sudden, which frightened Brother Guijia to pee his pants. Later, as long as there was a little urgency, urine would leak out from below. This will make him bold, and he was afraid ,—— when he was a child. ”“前两天丢了羊，也着急了，咱们问问他尿了没有！”
“对！问他！不说就扒他的裤子检查！”

The tea is on. Xiao Lu took down the casserole and turned over the yam by the fire. Lao Jiu touched in his satchel, and there was still a handful of Chaoyang melon seeds left over from yesterday, so he poured them out of his pocket and ate melon seeds while drinking from the top of the mountain. "You say, is there a ghost?" This time it was Lao Jiu who asked the question.留孩说：“有。”

People often go to listen, in the middle of the night, ping pong pong stir-frying, ladles and shovels ring, it is lively! ”“在哪里？”这小吕倒很想去听听，这又不可怕。

Liu Ai said: "Why are there no ghosts? I heard my uncle say:“有一帮河南人，到口外去割莜麦。走到半路上，前不巴村，后不巴店，天也黑夜了，有一个旧马棚，空着，也还有个门，能插上，他们就住进去了。在一个大草滩子里，没有一点人烟。都睡下了。有一个汉子烟瘾大，点了个蜡头在抽烟。听到外面有人说：
"There was a group of Henan people who went outside the mouth to cut wheat. Halfway through, there was an old horse shed, empty, and a door, which could be plugged in, so they lived in. In a big grassy beach, there was no human habitation. Everyone fell asleep. There was a man who was addicted to smoking and lit a wax head and was smoking. The next day they got up and saw that there was a new tomb. They added soil to him, and they left. ”这故事倒不怎么可怕，只是说得老九和小吕心里都为这个客死在野地里的只有一块毡子的河南人很不好受。夜已经很深了，他们也不想喝茶了，瓜子还剩一小撮，也不想吃了。
过了一会，忽然，老九的脸色一沉：
This story is not very scary, but it makes Lao Jiu and Xiao Lu feel very uncomfortable for this Henan man who died in the wilderness with only a piece of felt. It was already very late at night, and they didn't want to drink tea anymore, and there was still a handful of melon seeds left, and they didn't want to eat it. After a while, suddenly, Lao Jiu's face darkened:“什么声音？”
是的！轻轻的，但是听得很清楚，有点像羊叫，又不太像。老九一把抓起火枪：

Xiao Lu grabbed his javelin, snatched out the door in three steps, and said, "You go to the sheepfold to take a look, I'm here, and there are still things at home." ”老九、留孩用手电照了照几个羊圈，都好好的，羊都安安静静地卧着，门、窗户，都没有动。正察看着，听见小吕喊：
“在这里了！”

The ninth child shone a few sheepfolds with a flashlight, and they were all fine, the sheep were lying quietly, and the doors and windows did not move. As soon as Lao Jiu's flashlight swept down, he heard a "fluttering" sound under the bed—— "Fuck, it's you!" "Okay! You scared us! ”丁贵甲从床底下爬出来，一边爬，一边笑得捂着肚子。
“好！耍我们！打他！”

So Xiao Lu and Lao Jiu pounced on them together, pressed Ding Guijia down, one pressed his neck, the other rode his waist, and fought hard. Even Liuhai got into his hands and grabbed his leg as he tried to turn up. 六、明天
They ate, drank, talked and talked, laughed and laughed. In the middle of them were pressing, boxing, laughing, hugging, performing, gesturing. They were so happy, so happy that they almost overturned this cabin, they broke it, these little devils! They completely forgot that it was a very deep night. 6. Tomorrow明天，他们还会要回味这回事，还会说、学、表演、大笑，而且等张士林回来一定会告诉张士林，会告诉陈素花、恽美兰，并且也会说给大老张听的。将来有一天，他们聚在一起，还会谈起这一晚上的事，还会觉得非常愉快。今夜，他们笑够了，闹够了，现在都安静了，睡下了。起先，隔不一会还有人含含糊糊地说一句什么，不知是醒着还是在梦里，后来就听不到一点声息了。这间在昏黑中哗闹过、明亮过的半坡上的羊舍屋子，沉静下来，在拥抱着四山的广阔、丰美、充盈的暗夜中消融。一天就这样的过去了。夜在进行着，夜和昼在渗入，交递，开往北京的216次列车也正在轨路上奔驶。
Tomorrow, they will reminisce about this matter, talk, learn, perform, laugh, and when Zhang Shilin comes back, he will definitely tell Zhang Shilin, he will tell Chen Suhua and Yun Meilan, and he will also tell Da Lao Zhang. One day in the future, when they get together, they will talk about this night, and they will feel very happy. Tonight, they laughed enough, made enough noise, and now they are all quiet and asleep. At first, there were people who said something vaguely every now and then, whether they were awake or in a dream, and then they couldn't hear a sound. This sheep house on the half-slope, which had been noisy and bright in the dark, calmed down and melted in the vast, beautiful, and full dark night that embraced the four mountains. The day passed like this. The night is in progress, night and day are infiltrating, handing over, and the 216 train to Beijing is also running on the tracks.明天，就又是一天了。小吕将会去找黄技师，置办他的心爱的嫁接刀。老九在大家的帮助下，会把行李结束起来，走上他当一个钢铁工人的路。当然，他会把他新编得的羊鞭交给留孩。留孩将要来这个“很好的”农场里当一名新一代的牧羊工。征兵的消息已经传开，说不定场子里明天就接到通知，叫丁贵甲到曾经医好他肺结核的医院去参加体格检查，准备入伍、受训，在他所没有接触过的山水风物之间，在蓝天或绿海上，戴起一顶缀着星徽的军帽。这些，都在夜间趋变为事实。
Tomorrow, it's another day. Xiao Lu will go to Technician Huang to buy his beloved grafting knife. With everyone's help, Lao Jiu will end his luggage and embark on his path to becoming a steelworker. Of course, he will give his newly woven sheep whip to Liuhai. Liuhai will come to this "good" farm as a new generation of shepherds. The news of the conscription has spread, and maybe tomorrow he will receive a notice in the field to ask Ding Guijia to go to the hospital where he was once cured of tuberculosis to participate in a physical examination, prepare to enlist in the army, receive training, and wear a military hat decorated with star emblems between the landscapes and scenery he has not been exposed to, in the blue sky or on the green sea. These all tend to become facts at night.这也只是一个平常的夜。但是人就是这样一天一天，一黑夜一黑夜地长起来的。正如同庄稼，每天观察，差异也都不太明显，然而它发芽了，出叶了，拔节了，孕穗了，抽穗了，灌浆了，终于成熟了。这四个现在在一排并睡着的孩子（四个枕头各托着一个蓬蓬松松的脑袋），他们也将这样发育起来。在党无远弗及的阳光照煦下，经历一些必要的风风雨雨，都将迅速、结实、精壮地成长起来。
This is just an ordinary night. But this is how people grow day by day, night by night. Just like a crop, the difference is not very obvious when observed every day, but it germinates, leaves emerges, joints, boots, heads, fills, and finally matures. These four children who are now asleep in a row (each of the four pillows holds a fluffy head), they will also develop in this way. Under the sunshine of the party, through some necessary ups and downs, they will grow rapidly, strongly, and strongly.现在，他们都睡了。灯已经灭了。炉火也封住了。但是从煤块的缝隙里，有隐隐的火光在泄漏，而映得这间小屋充溢着薄薄的，十分柔和的，蔼然的红晖。
睡吧，亲爱的孩子。
一九六一年十一月二十五日写成
Now they were all asleep. The lights were out. The fire was sealed. But from the gaps in the coals, there was a faint light leaking out, and the hut was filled with a thin, very soft, bright red light. Go to sleep, dear child. Written on November 25, 1961

[5] This was originally an idiom of the stonemason who opened the mountain. Make a wish before the stone is broken: if it is opened, it will be contributed with a sheep's head or a pig's head; but if it is opened, it will not allow anything.[6] 外手边是右边。这本来是赶车人的说法。赶车人都习惯于跨坐在左辕，所以称左边为里手边或里边，右边为外手边或外边。
[7] 南北方向的小岭，两边坡上都常见阳光，形状略似椅臂者。
[6] The outer hand side is the right side. This was originally the saying of the car driver. The car driver is used to sitting on the left side, so the left side is called the inside hand or inside, and the right side is the outside hand or outside. It was good at first. Slowly, the cart driver had an opinion, because the animals were thin. They found that he was eating during the day and sleeping at night. Feeding the livestock is not at all about bringing grass and feeding in big bowls! Recently, a nail was even found in the manger! So, the production team decided to go to the horse number for a meeting and criticize him.这钉子是在青马的槽里发现的！是王全发现的。王全的眼睛整天蒙着，但是半夜里他还要瞎戳戳地摸到马圈里去，伸手到槽里摸，把蔫筋的草节拨出去。摸着摸着，他摸到一根冰凉铁硬的，——放在嘴里，拿牙咬咬：是根钉子！这王全浑身冒火了，但是，居然很快就心平气和下来。——人家每天领着他上医院，这不能不起点作用。他拿了这根钉子，摸着去找到生产队长，说是无论如何得“批批”他，这不是玩的！往后筛草、打料一定要过细一点。
This nail was found in Qingma's trough! It was Wang Quan who found it. Wang Quan's eyes were blindfolded all day long, but in the middle of the night he had to poke blindly into the horse pen, reach into the trough to touch it, and push out the wilted grass knots. Touching and touching, he touched a cold iron ,—— and put it in his mouth, and bit it with his teeth: It's a nail! Wang Quan was on fire, but he quickly calmed down. ——People lead him to the hospital every day, which can't help but work. He took the nail and touched it to find the production captain, saying that he had to "criticize" him anyway, this is not a joke! In the future, the grass and feed must be too fine.前天早上反映的情况，连着两天所里有事，决定今天晚上开会。不料，今天上午，王全把王升打了，打得相当重。
The situation reported the day before yesterday morning, and after two consecutive days, it was decided to hold a meeting tonight. Unexpectedly, this morning, Wang Quan beat Wang Sheng quite hard.原来王全发现，王升偷马料！他早就有点疑心，没敢肯定。这一阵他眼睛开刀，老在马号里呆着，仿佛听到一点动响。不过也还不能肯定。这两天他的纱布拆除了，他整天不出去，原来他随时都在盯着王升哩。果然，昨天夜里，他看见王升在门背后端了一大碗煮熟的料豆在吃！他居然沉住了气，没有发作。因为他想：单是吃，问题还不太大。今天早上，他乘王升出去弄甜菜的时候，把王升的枕头拆开：——里面不是塞的糠皮稻草，是料豆！一不做二不休，翻开他那包袱，里边还有一个枕头，也是一枕头的料豆。——本来他带了两个特大的枕头，却只枕一个；每回回去又都把枕头带回去，这就奇怪。“嗯！”王全把他的外衣脱了，等着。王升从外面回来，一看包袱里东西摊得一床，枕头拆开了；再一看王全那神情，连忙回头就跑。王全一步追上，大拳头没头没脑地砸下来，打得王升孩子似地哭，爹呀妈的乱叫，一直到别人闻声赶来，剪住王全的两手，才算住。——王升还没命地嚎哭了半天。
It turned out that Wang Quan found out that Wang Sheng stole horse feed! He had long been a little suspicious and wasn't sure. This time, his eyes were opened, and he stayed in the horse trumpet, as if he heard a little noise. But I'm not sure yet. In the past two days, his gauze has been removed, and he hasn't gone out all day, it turns out that he is staring at Wang Sheng at any time. Sure enough, last night, he saw Wang Sheng eating a large bowl of cooked beans behind the door! He actually calmed down and didn't have a seizure. Because he thought: Just eating, it's not too much of a problem. This morning, when he took Wang Sheng out to get beets, he took apart Wang Sheng's pillow: - It is not stuffed chaff straw, it is beans! If you don't do anything, you will open his baggage, and there is a pillow inside, which is also a pillow of beans. ——Originally, he brought two extra-large pillows, but only one; every time he went back, he brought the pillow back, which was strange. "Hmm!" Wang Quan took off his coat and waited. Wang Sheng came back from outside, and saw that the things in his baggage were spread out on a bed, and the pillow was disassembled; looking at Wang Quan's expression again, he quickly turned around and ran away. Wang Quan caught up with him, smashed his big fist headlessly, beating Wang Sheng like a child, and his father and mother screamed until others heard the sound and cut off Wang Quan's hands. ——Wang Sheng cried for a long time.这样，今天的会的内容不得不变一下，至少得增加一点。
In this way, the content of today's meeting has to be changed, at least a little more.但是改变得也不多。这次会是一个扩大的会，除了马号全体参加外，还有曾经领导过王升的各个组的组长，和跟他在一起干过活的老工人。大家批评了王升，也说了王全。重点还是在王升，说到王全，大都是带上一句：——“不过打人总是不对的，有什么情况，什么意见，应当向领导反映，由领导来处理。”有的说：“牛不知力大，你要是把他打坏了怎办？”也有人联系到年初王全坚决不愿喂马，这就不对！关于王升，可就说起来没完了。他撒下一大块秧来就走这一类的事原来多着哩，每个人一说就是小半点钟！因此这个会一直开到深夜。最后让王升说说。王升还是那样，一句话没有，“说不上来”。再三催促，还是“说不上来”。大家有点急了，问他：“你偷料豆，对不对？”——“不对。”“马草里混进了钉子，对不对？”——“不对。”……看来实在挤不出什么话来了，天又实在太晚，明天还要上班，只好让王全先说说。
But not much has changed. This will be an enlarged meeting, in addition to the participation of all the horses, there are also the leaders of various groups that have led Wang Sheng, and the old workers who have worked with him. Everyone criticized Wang Sheng and also said Wang Quan. The focus is still on Wang Sheng, and when it comes to Wang Quan, most of them have a sentence: ——"But it is always wrong to beat people, what is the situation, what opinions, should be reported to the leader, and the leader will deal with it." Some said: "The cow doesn't know how to be strong, what if you break him?" Some people also contacted Wang Quan at the beginning of the year and resolutely refused to feed the horse, which is not right! About Wang Sheng, but it's not over. There are many things like this kind of thing when he sows a large piece of seedling, and everyone says it is half an o'clock! So this meeting was held until late at night. Finally, let Wang Sheng talk. Wang Sheng was still like that, without saying a word, "I can't say it". Repeatedly urged, but still "can't say it". Everyone was a little anxious and asked him: "You stole beans, right?" ——"No." "There are nails mixed in the horse grass, right?" ——"No. ”…… It seems that there is really nothing to say, it is too late, and I have to go to work tomorrow, so I have to let Wang Quan talk first.“嗯！我打了他，不对！嗯！解放军不兴打人，打人是国民党。嗯！你偷吃料豆，还要往家里拿！你克扣牲口。它是哑巴，不会说话，它要是会说话，要告你！你剥削它，你是资本家！是地主！你！你故意拿钉子往马槽里放，你安心要害所里的牲口，国家的牲口！×你娘的！你看看，你把俩牲口喂成啥样了？”
"Hmm! I hit him, no! Well! The People's Liberation Army is not interested in beating people, but the Kuomintang is beating people. Well! You steal the beans and take them home! You detain the animal. It is mute and cannot speak, if it can speak, it will sue you! You exploit it, you are a capitalist! It is a landlord! You! You deliberately put nails in the manger, and you can rest assured that you will harm the animals in the institute and the livestock of the country! × damn it! Look, what did you feed the two animals? ”说着，一把揪住王升，大家赶紧上来拉住，解开，才没有又打起来。这个会暂时只好就这样开到这里了。
过了两天，我又在刘所长那里碰见他。还是那样，一推门，进来了，没头没脑：
“所长，我提个意见。”
Saying that, he grabbed Wang Sheng, and everyone hurriedly came up to grab and untie it, so that they didn't fight again. This meeting has to be here for the time being. Two days later, I met him again at Director Liu's place. Still like that, as soon as I pushed the door, I came in, without a head: "Director, let me give you an opinion."“好啊。”
“你是个好人！是个庄户佬出身！赶过个车，养活过个牲口！你是好人！是个共产党！你如今又领导这些技师啦技术员的，他们都服你——”
看见有我在座，又回过头来跟我说：
“看看！”
Wang Quan wears a small red flag on his chest, which is the symbol of the newly elected red flag bearer. "Look!"这是怎么一回事呢？原来所里在拟定明年的种植计划，让大家都来讨论，这里边有一条，是旱地一号地六十亩全部复种黑豆！
一边说着，一边把他的衣兜往桌上一掀，倒得一桌子都是花生。非常腼腆地说：
What's going on? It turned out that the institute was drawing up a planting plan for next year, so that everyone could discuss it, and there was one here, which was that all 60 acres of dry land No. 1 land were replanted with black beans! As he spoke, he lifted his pocket to the table, and the table was full of peanuts. said very shyly:“我侄儿子给我捎来五斤花生。”
说完了抹头就走。
刘所长叫住他：
“别走。你把人家打了，怎么办呢？”
“我去喂牲口呀。”
“好。把你的花生拿去，——我不‘剥削’你，人家是给你送来的！”
"My nephew brought me five pounds of peanuts." After saying that, wipe your head and leave. Director Liu stopped him: "Don't go. You beat someone, what should you do? ” "I'm going to feed the animals." "Okay. Take your peanuts,—— I don't 'exploit' you, they sent it to you! ”王全赶紧拉开门就跑，头都不回，生怕刘所长会追上来似的。——后来，这花生还是刘所长叫他的孩子给他送回去了。
Wang Quan hurriedly opened the door and ran away, not looking back, for fear that Director Liu would catch up. ——Later, Director Liu asked his child to send it back to him.过了一个多月，所里的冬季文化学习班办起来，王全来报了名，是刘所长亲自送他来上学的。我有幸当了他的启蒙老师。可是我要说老实话，这个学生真不好教，真也难怪他宁可套车去拉一车粪。他又不肯照着课本学，一定先要教会他学会四个字。他用铅笔写了无数遍，终于有了把握了，就把我写对子用的大抓笔借去，在马圈粉墙上写下四个斗大的黑字：
After more than a month, the winter cultural study class in the institute was set up, and Wang Quan came to sign up, and Director Liu personally sent him to school. I was fortunate to be his enlightenment teacher. But I have to be honest, this student is really hard to teach, and it's no wonder that he would rather take a car to pull a truck of dung. He refused to learn according to the textbook, so he must teach him four words first. He wrote countless times with a pencil, and finally got sure, so he borrowed the big pen I used to write pairs and wrote four large black characters on the pink wall of the horse pen:“王全喂马”。
字的笔划虽然很幼稚，但是写得恭恭正正，一笔不苟。谁都可以看出来，这四个字包含很多意思，这是一个人一辈子的誓约。
王全喂了牲口，生产队就热闹了。三天两头就见他进去：
"Wang Quan feeds the horse". Although the strokes of the words are very naïve, they are written respectfully and meticulously. Anyone can see that these four words contain a lot of meaning, and this is a lifelong oath. Wang Quan fed the animals, and the production team became lively. I saw him go in at both ends of the three days:“人家孩子回来，也不吃，也不喝，就是卧着，这是使狠了，累乏了！告他们，不能这样！”
“人家孩子快下了，别叫它驾辕了！”
“人家孩子”怎样怎样了……
"When the children come back, they don't eat or drink, they just lie down, which is ruthless and tired! Tell them that they can't do this! ” "The child is about to get off, don't call it a ride!" What happened to "other people's children"......我在这个地方呆了一些时候了，知道这是这一带的口头语，管小猫小狗、小鸡小鸭，甚至是小板凳，都叫做“孩子”。但是这无论如何是一种爱称。尤其是王全说起来，有一种特殊的味道。那么高大粗壮的汉子，说起牲口来，却是那么温柔。
I have been in this place for a while, and I know that this is the colloquial language in this area, whether it is kittens and puppies, chickens and ducklings, or even small benches, they are all called "children". But this is a nickname anyway. Especially Wang Quan has a special taste. Such a tall and stout man, when it comes to livestock, is so gentle.我离开这个农业科学研究所已经好几个月了，王全一直在喂马。现在，在我写这篇文章的时候，他就正在喂着马。夜已经很深了。这会，全所的灯都一定已经陆续关去，连照例关得最晚的刘所长和邵技师的屋里的灯也都关了。只有两处的灯还是亮着的。一处是大门外植保研究室的诱捕灯，这是通夜不灭的，现在正有各种虫蛾围绕着飞舞。一处是马圈。灯光照见槽头一个一个马的脑袋。它们正在安静地、严肃地咀嚼着草料。时不时的，喷一个响鼻，摇摇耳朵，顿一顿蹄子。偢六——王全，正在夹着料笸箩，弯着腰，无声地忙碌着，或者停下来，用满怀慈爱的、喜悦的眼色，看看这些贵重的牲口。
I have been away from this Institute of Agricultural Sciences for several months, and Wang Quan has been feeding the horses. Now, as I write this article, he is feeding the horses. It's already late at night. At this time, the lights in the whole institute must have been turned off one after another, even the lights in the rooms of Director Liu and Technician Shao, who were the last to turn off as usual. Only two lights are still on. One is the trapping light of the plant protection laboratory outside the gate, which is not extinguished all night, and now all kinds of insects and moths are flying around. One is the horse pen. The lights shine on the heads of horses at the troughs. They are chewing the forage quietly and seriously. From time to time, spray a snort, shake its ears, and pause its hooves. Yi Liu, Wang Quan, was holding a basket of materials, bending over, busy silently, or stopping, looking at these precious animals with loving and joyful eyes.王全的胸前佩着一枚小小的红旗，这是新选的红旗手的标志。
“看看！”
Wang Quan wears a small red flag on his chest, which is the symbol of the newly elected red flag bearer. "Look!"

The first collection was "Night in the Sheep Lodge", China Children's Publishing House, January 1963; and "Selected Short Stories of Wang Zengqi", Beijing Publishing House, February 1982, with slight changes in the text.

看水

看水[1]
下班了。小吕把擦得干干净净的铁锨搁到“小仓库”里，正在脚蹬着一个旧辘轴系鞋带，组长大老张走过来，跟他说：
“小吕，你今天看一夜水。”
Look at the water{{id_0000}} It's off work. Xiao Lu put the clean-wiped shovel in the "small warehouse", and was tying his shoelaces with an old roller on his feet. "Xiao Lu, you watched the water all night today."小吕的心略为沉了一沉。他没有这种准备。今天一天的活不轻松，小吕身上有点累。收工之前，他就想过：吃了晚饭，打一会百分，看两节《水浒》，洗一个脚，睡觉！他身上好像已经尝到伸腰展腿地躺在床上的那股舒服劲。看一夜水，甭打算睡了！这倒还没有什么。主要的是，他没有看过水，他不知道看水是怎么个看法。一个人，黑夜里，万一要是渠塌了，水跑了，淹了庄稼，灌了房子，……那他可招架不了！一种沉重的，超过他的能力和体力的责任感压迫着他。
Xiao Lu's heart sank slightly. He was not prepared for this. Today's work is not easy, and Xiao Lu is a little tired. Before finishing work, he thought: have dinner, play 100 points for a while, watch two verses of "Water Margin", wash your feet, and sleep! He seemed to have tasted the comfort of lying on the bed stretching his waist and legs. Looking at the water all night, don't plan to sleep! This is nothing yet. The main thing is that he has never looked at water, and he doesn't know what to think about water. A person, in the dark night, if the canal collapses, the water runs away, floods the crops, and floods the house,...... Then he can't resist! A heavy sense of responsibility that exceeds his ability and physical strength oppresses him.但是大老张说话的声音、语气，叫他不能拒绝。果园接连浇了三天三夜地了。各处的地都要浇，就这几天能够给果园使水，果园也非乘这几天抓紧了透透的浇一阵水不可，果子正在膨大，非常需要水。偏偏这一阵别的活又忙，葡萄绑条、山丁子喷药、西瓜除腻虫、倒栽疙瘩白、垅葱……全都挤在一起了。几个大工白日黑夜轮班倒，一天休息不了几小时，一个个眼睛红红的，全都熬得上了火。再派谁呢？派谁都不大合适。这样大老张才会想到小吕的头上来。小吕知道，大老张是想叫小吕在上头守守闸，看看水，他自己再坚持在果园浇一夜，这点地就差不多了。小吕是个小工，往小里说还是个孩子，一定不去，谁也不能说什么。过去也没有派过他干过这种活。但是小吕觉得不能这样。自己是果园的人，若是遇到紧张关头，自己总是逍遥自在，在一边作个没事人，心里也觉说不过去。看来也还就是叫自己去比较合适。无论如何，小吕也是个男子汉，——你总不能叫两个女工黑夜里在野地里看水！大老张既然叫自己去，他说咱能行，咱就试巴试巴！而且，看水，这也挺新鲜，挺有意思！小吕就说：
But the voice and tone of the big man Zhang spoke made him unable to refuse. The orchard has been watered for three days and three nights in a row. The land everywhere has to be watered, and the orchard can be watered in the past few days, and the orchard must take advantage of the past few days to water thoroughly, the fruit is expanding and needs water very much. But this time I was busy with other work, such as tying grape strips, spraying mountain dings, watermelon removing greasy insects, planting pimples white, green onions...... They were all crowded together. Several carpenters worked in shifts day and night, and they couldn't rest for a few hours a day, and their eyes were red, and they were all on fire. Who else to send? It's not suitable to send anyone. Only then will Da Lao Zhang think of Xiao Lu's head. Xiao Lu knew that Da Lao Zhang wanted Xiao Lu to guard the gate above and see the water, and he would insist on watering the orchard overnight, which was almost the same. Xiao Lu is a small worker, and he is still a child, so he must not go, and no one can say anything. He has never been sent to do this kind of work in the past. But Xiao Lu felt that it couldn't be like this. I am a person in the orchard, and if I encounter a tense moment, I am always at ease, and I feel that it is unreasonable to be a normal person on the side. It seems that it is more appropriate to ask yourself to go. In any case, Xiao Lu is also a man,—— you can't ask two female workers to watch the water in the field at night! Since Da Lao Zhang asked himself to go, he said that we can do it, so let's try it! Moreover, looking at the water, this is also quite fresh and interesting! Xiao Lu said:“好吧！”
小吕把搁进去的铁锨又拿出来，大老张又嘱咐了他几句话，他扛上铁锨就走了。
吃了晚饭，小吕早早地就上了渠。
"Okay!" Xiao Lu took out the shovel that had been put in again, and the eldest man Zhang instructed him a few more words, and he carried the shovel and left. After dinner, Xiao Lu went to the canal early.一来，小吕就去找大老张留下的两个志子。大老张告诉他，他给他在渠沿里面横插两根树枝，当作志子，一处在大闸进水处不远，一处在支渠拐弯处小石桥下。大老张说：
As soon as he came, Xiao Lu went to find the two Zhizi left by Da Lao Zhang. Da Lao Zhang told him that he inserted two branches horizontally in the canal as a will, one not far from the water inlet of the gate, and the other under the small stone bridge at the bend of the branch canal. Da Lao Zhang said:“你只要常常去看看这两根树枝。水只要不漫过志子，就不要紧，尽它浇好了！若是水把它漫下去了，就去搬闸，——拉起一块闸板，把水放掉一些，——水太大了怕渠要吃不住。若是水太小了，就放下两块闸板，让它憋一憋。没有什么，这几天水势都很平稳，不会有什么问题！”
"You just need to look at these two branches often. As long as the water doesn't overflow the will, it doesn't matter, water it as much as you can! If the water overflows it, go to the gate,—— pull up a gate, and let the water out some ,—— if the water is too big, I am afraid that the canal will not be able to eat. If the water is too small, put down the two gates and let it hold it for a while. Nothing, the water has been very stable these days, there will be no problems! ”小吕走近去，没怎么费事，就找到了。也很奇怪，这只是两根普普通通的细细的树枝，半掩半露在蒙翳披纷的杂草之间，并不特别引人注意，然而小吕用眼睛滤过去，很快就发现了，而且肯定就是它，毫不怀疑。一看见了这两根树枝，小吕心里一喜，好像找到了一件失去的心爱的东西似的。有了这两个志子，他心里有了一点底。不然，他一定会一会儿觉得，水太大了吧；一会儿又觉得，水太小了吧，搞得心里七上八下，没有主意。看看这两根插得很端正牢实的树枝，小吕从心里涌起一股对于大老张的感谢，觉得大老张真好，对他真体贴，——虽然小吕也知道大老张这样做，在他根本不算什么，一个组长，第一回叫一个没有经验的小工看水，可能都会这样。

Xiao Lu walked all the way and had already arrived in front of the culvert. There was indeed a pile of rotten firewood on the iron grate,—— the carpenters called this "slag accumulation", a lot! Xiao Lu pushed the shovel apart, and then scooped it up one by one, which was a big pile! The slag accumulation was cleaned up, and the water seemed to flow faster, and a small whirlpool could be seen swirling at the mouth of the culvert.没什么事了。小吕顺着玉米地里一条近便的田埂，走回小石桥。用手电照了照志子，水好像又落了一点。
It's okay. Xiao Lu walked back to the small stone bridge along a nearby ridge in the cornfield. I shone a flashlight on Zhizi, and the water seemed to drop a little more.小吕觉得，月光暗了。抬起头来看看。好快！它怎么一下子就跑到西边去了？什么时候跑过去的？而且，好像灯尽油干，快要熄了似的，变得很薄了，红红的，简直不亮了，好像它疲倦得不得了，在勉强支撑着。小吕知道，快了，它就要落下去了。现在大概是夜里三点钟，大老张告诉过他，这几天月亮都是这时候落。说着说着，月亮落了，好像是唿噜一下子掉下去似的。立刻，眼前一片昏黑。
Xiao Lu felt that the moonlight was dark. Look up. So fast! Why did it run to the west all of a sudden? When did it run over? Moreover, as if the light was running out and about to go out, it became very thin, red, and not lit at all, as if it was extremely tired and barely holding on. Xiao Lu knew that it was about to fall. It's about three o'clock in the night, and Da Lao Zhang told him that the moon has been setting at this time these days. As he spoke, the moon fell, as if it was falling all of a sudden. Immediately, it was dark in front of me.真黑！这是一夜里最黑的时候。小吕一时什么也看不见了，过了一会，才勉强看得见一点模模糊糊的影子。小吕忽然觉得自己也疲倦得不行，有点恶心，就靠着糖槭树坐下来，铁锨斜倚在树干上。他的头沉重起来，眼皮直往下搭拉。心里好像很明白，不要睡！不要睡！但是不由自主。他觉得自己直往一个深深的、黑黑的地方掉下去，就跟那月亮似的，拽都拽不住，他睡着了那么一小会。人有时不知道自己怎么睡着了的。
It's so dark! This is the darkest time of the night. Xiao Lu couldn't see anything for a while, and after a while, he could barely see a vague shadow. Xiao Lu suddenly felt that he was too tired and a little nauseous, so he sat down against the sugar maple tree, leaning on the trunk with the shovel. His head became heavy, and his eyelids were pulled down. I seemed to understand it very well, don't sleep! Don't sleep! But involuntarily. He felt that he was falling straight into a deep, dark place, just like the moon, he couldn't pull it, and he fell asleep for a while. People sometimes don't know how they fell asleep.忽然，他惊醒了！他觉得眼前有一道黑影子过去，他在昏糊之中异常敏锐明确地断定：——狼！一挺身站起来，抄起铁锨，按开手电一照（这一切也都做得非常迅速而准确）：已经走过去了，过了小石桥。（小吕想了想！刚才从他面前走过时，离他只有四五步！）小吕听说过，遇见狼，不能怕，不能跑，——越怕越糟；狼怕光，怕手电，怕手电一圈一圈的光，怕那些圈儿套它，狼性多疑。他想了想，就开着手电，尾随着它走，现在，看得更清楚了。狼像一只大狗，深深地低着脑袋（狗很少这样低着脑袋），搭拉着毛茸茸的挺长的尾巴（狗的尾巴也不是这样）。奇怪，它不管身边的亮光，还是那样慢吞吞地，不慌不忙地走，既不像要回过头来，也不像要拔脚飞跑，就是这样不声不响地，低着头走，像一个心事重重，哀伤憔悴的人一样。——它知道身后有人么？它在想些什么呢？小吕正在想：要不要追上去 ，揍它？它走过前面的路边小杨树丛子，拐了弯，叫杨树遮住了，手电的光照不着它了。小吕忖了忖手里的铁锨：算了！那可实在是很危险！
Suddenly, he woke up! He felt a dark shadow passing in front of him, and he concluded extremely keenly and clearly in his coma: - Wolf! Stand up, picked up the shovel, and pressed the flashlight to shine (all this was done very quickly and accurately): he had already walked past and crossed the small stone bridge. (Xiao Lu thought about it!) When I walked in front of him just now, I was only four or five steps away from him!) Xiao Lu has heard that when you meet a wolf, you can't be afraid, you can't run,—— the more you are afraid, the worse it gets; the wolf is afraid of light, the flashlight, the light of the flashlight circle after circle, and the wolf is suspicious. He thought for a while, turned on the flashlight, and followed it, and now, he could see it more clearly. The wolf is like a big dog, with its head deeply lowered (dogs rarely bow its head like this), and it has a furry long tail (the dog's tail is not like that). Strangely, regardless of the bright light around it, it still walks so slowly and unhurriedly, neither as if it wants to turn around or run away, just like this, silently, with its head down, like a worried, sad and haggard person. ——Does it know that there is someone behind it? What is it thinking? Xiao Lu was thinking: Should I chase after it and beat it? It walked past the small poplar bushes on the side of the road in front of it, turned a corner, and asked the poplar trees to cover it, and the light of the flashlight could not shine on it. Xiao Lu thought about the shovel in his hand: Forget it! That's really dangerous!小吕在石桥顶上站了一会，又回到糖槭树下。他很奇怪，他并不怎么怕。他很清醒，很理智。他到糖槭树下，采取的是守势。小吕这才想起，他选择了这个地方休息，原来就是想到狼的。这个地方很保险：后面是渠水，狼不可能泅水过来；他可以监视着前面的马路；万一不行，——上树！
Xiao Lu stood on the top of the stone bridge for a while, and then returned to the sugar maple tree. He was strange, he was not very afraid. He was very sober and sensible. He went under the sugar maple tree and took a defensive stance. Xiao Lu then remembered that he chose this place to rest, and it turned out that he was thinking of wolves. This place is very safe: there is canal water behind, and the wolf cannot swim over; he can monitor the road in front of him; if it doesn't work,—— go up the tree!小吕用手电频频向狼的去路照射。没有，狼没有回来。
Xiao Lu frequently shone the wolf's way with a flashlight. No, the wolf didn't come back.无论如何，可不敢再睡觉了！小吕在糖槭树下来回地走着。走了一会，甚至还跑到刚才决开过，经他修复了的缺口那里看了看。——一边走，一边不停地用手电四处照射。他相信狼是不会再回来了；再有别的狼，这也不大可能，但是究竟不能放心到底。
Anyway, I don't dare to sleep anymore! Xiao Lu walked back and forth under the sugar maple tree. After walking for a while, he even ran to the gap that had just been opened and repaired by him to take a look. ——As he walked, he kept shining a flashlight around with a flashlight. He believed that the wolf would not come back; it was unlikely that there would be other wolves, but he couldn't rest assured to the end.可是他越来越困。他并不怎么害怕。狼的形象没有给他十分可怕的印象。他不大因为遇见狼而得意，也不因为没有追上去打它而失悔，他现在就是困，困压倒一切。他的意识昏木起来，脑子的活动变得缓慢而淡薄了。他在竭力抵抗着沉重的、酸楚的、深入骨髓的困劲。他觉得身上很难受，而且，很冷。他迷迷糊糊地想：我要是会抽烟，这时候抽一枝烟就好了！……
But he was getting more and more sleepy. He was not very afraid. The image of the wolf did not give him a very scary impression. He was not very proud of the wolf, nor did he regret not chasing after it and hitting it, he was now sleepy, sleepy overwhelming. His consciousness was dim, and the activity of his brain became slow and weak. He was trying his best to resist the heavy, sour, deep to the bone marrow. He felt very uncomfortable, and it was cold. He thought in a daze: If I could smoke, I would smoke a cigarette at this time! ……好容易，天模糊亮了。
更亮了。
It was easy, and the sky was bright. brighter.亮了！远远近近，一片青苍苍的，灰白灰白的颜色，好像天和地也熬过了一夜，还不大有精神似的。看得清房屋，看得清树，看得清庄稼了。小吕看看他看过一夜的水，水发清了，小多了，还不到半渠，露出来一截淤泥的痕迹，流势很弱，好像也很疲倦。小吕知道，现在已经流的是“空渠水”，上游的拦河坝又封起了，不到一个小时，这渠里的水就会流完了的。——得再过几个钟头，才会又有新的水下来。果园的地大概浇完了，这点水该够用了吧？……一串铜铃声，有人了！一个早出的社员，赶着一头毛驴，驴背上驮着一个线口袋，里边鼓鼓囊囊，好像是装的西葫芦。老大爷，您早哇！好了，这真正是白天了，不会再有狼，再有漫长的、难熬的黑夜了！小吕振作一点起来。——不过他还是很困，觉得心里发虚。
It's bright! Far and near, a green, grayish-gray color, as if the sky and the earth had survived all night, and they didn't have much energy. I can see the houses, the trees, and the crops clearly. Xiao Lu looked at the water he had seen all night, and the water was clear, much smaller, less than half of the channel, revealing a trace of silt, the flow was very weak, and it seemed to be very tired. Xiao Lu knew that now it was "empty canal water", and the upstream barrage was sealed again, and in less than an hour, the water in the canal would run out. ——It will take a few more hours for new water to come down. The land in the orchard is probably watered, this water should be enough, right? …… A string of copper bells, there is someone! An early member was driving a donkey, and the donkey carried a thread pocket on its back, which was bulging, as if it were zucchini. Old man, you are early! Okay, it's really daytime, there will be no more wolves, and there will be long, difficult nights! Xiao Lu cheered up a little. ——But he was still very sleepy and felt weak.远远看见果园的两个女工，陈素花和恽美兰来了。她们这么早就出来了！小吕知道，她们是因为惦着他，特为来看他来了。小吕在心里很感激她们，但是他自己觉得那感激的劲头很不足，他困得连感激也感激不动了。
From a distance, I saw two female workers in the orchard, Chen Suhua and Yun Meilan, coming. They came out so early! Xiao Lu knew that they came to see him because they were worried about him. Xiao Lu was very grateful to them in his heart, but he himself felt that the energy of gratitude was very insufficient, and he was so sleepy that he couldn't even be grateful.陈素花给他带来了两个闷得烂烂的，滚热的甜菜。小吕一边吃甜菜，一边告诉她们，他看见狼了。他说了遇狼的经过，狼的样子。他自己都有点奇怪，他说得很平淡，一点不像他平常说话那么活灵活现的。但是陈素花和恽美兰都很惊奇，很为他的平淡的叙述所感动。她们催他赶快去睡觉，说是大老张嘱咐的：叫小吕天一亮就去睡，大闸不用管了，会有人来接。
Chen Suhua brought him two stuffy, hot beets. While eating beets, Xiao Lu told them that he saw a wolf. He told him what happened to the wolf and what the wolf looked like. He himself was a little strange, he spoke very plainly, not at all as vivid as he usually spoke. But Chen Suhua and Yun Meilan were both surprised and moved by his plain narrative. They urged him to go to bed quickly, saying that it was instructed by Da Lao Zhang: tell Xiao Lu to go to bed as soon as dawn breaks, don't worry about the gate, someone will come to pick him up.小吕喝了两碗稀饭，爬到床上，就睡着了。睡了两个钟头，醒了。他觉得浑身都很舒服，懒懒的。他只要翻一翻身，合上眼，会立刻就睡着的。但是他看了看墙上挂的一个马蹄表，不睡了。起来，到井边用凉水洗洗脸，他向果园走去。——他到果园去干什么？
Xiao Lu drank two bowls of porridge, climbed onto the bed, and fell asleep. After sleeping for two hours, he woke up. He felt comfortable and lazy. As long as he turned over and closed his eyes, he would fall asleep immediately. But he looked at a horseshoe watch hanging on the wall and stopped sleeping. He got up, went to the well to wash his face with cold water, and walked towards the orchard. ——What is he going to do in the orchard?果园还是那样。小吕昨天下午还在果园的，但是不知道为什么，他好像有好久没有来了似的。似乎果园一夜之间有了一些什么重大的变化似的。什么变化呢？也难说。满园一片浓绿，绿得过了量，绿得迫人。静悄悄的。绿叶把什么都遮隔了，一眼看不出五步远。若不是远远听见有人说话，你会以为果园一个人都没有。小吕听见大老张的声音，他知道，他正在西南拐角指挥几个人锄果树行子。小吕想：他浇了一夜地，又熬了一夜了，还不休息，真辛苦。好了，今天把这点活赶完，明天大家就可以休息一天，大老张说了：全体休息！过了这阵，就可以细水长流地干活了，一年就这么几槎紧活。小吕想：下午我就来上班。大粒白的枝叶在动，是陈素花和恽美兰领着几个参加劳动的学生在捆葡萄条。恽美兰看见小吕了，就叫：
The orchard is still like that. Xiao Lu was still in the orchard yesterday afternoon, but for some reason, he seemed to have not been here for a long time. It seems that there have been some major changes in the orchard overnight. What changes? It's hard to say. The garden is full of green, too green, too green. Quiet. The green leaves block everything, and you can't see five steps away at a glance. If you hadn't heard someone talking from a distance, you would think there was no one in the orchard. Xiao Lu heard the voice of Da Lao Zhang, and he knew that he was directing a few people to hoe the fruit trees in the southwest corner. Xiao Lu thought: He watered the ground all night, stayed up all night, and still didn't rest, it's really hard. Okay, finish this work today, everyone can rest for a day tomorrow, Da Lao Zhang said: Everyone rests! After this while, you can work in a long stream, and you can work hard a few times a year. Xiao Lu thought: I'll come to work in the afternoon. The large white branches and leaves were moving, and it was Chen Suhua and Yun Meilan leading several students who participated in the labor to tie grape sticks. When Yun Meilan saw Xiao Lu, she shouted:“小吕！你来干什么？不睡觉！”
小吕说：“我来看看！”
“看什么？快回去睡！地都浇完了。”
"Xiao Lu! What are you doing here? Don't sleep! ” Xiao Lu said: "Let me take a look!" ” "What are you looking at? Go back to sleep! The ground is all watered. ”小吕穿过葡萄丛，四边看看，果园的地果然都浇了，到处都是湿湿的，一片清凉泽润、汪汪泱泱的水气直透他的脏腑。似乎葡萄的叶子都更水淋，更绿了，葡萄蔓子和皮色也更深了。小吕挺一挺胸脯，深深地吸了两口气，舒服极了。小吕想：下回我就有经验了，可以单独地看水，顶一个大工来使了，果园就等于多了半个人。看水，没有什么。狼不狼的，问题也不大。许多事都不像想象起来那么可怕……
Xiao Lu walked through the grape bushes and looked around, and the ground in the orchard was indeed watered, it was wet everywhere, and a cool and moist water vapor penetrated his internal organs. It seems that the leaves of the grapes are more watery and greener, and the vines and skin of the grapes are darker. Xiao Lu straightened his chest and took two deep breaths, which was very comfortable. Xiao Lu thought: Next time I will have experience, I can look at the water alone, and if a big worker comes to work, the orchard will be equivalent to half an extra person. Looking at the water, there is nothing. Wolves are not wolves, and the problem is not big. Many things are not as scary as imagined......走过一棵老葡萄架下，小吕想坐一坐。一坐下，就想躺下。躺下来，看着头顶的浓密的，鲜嫩清新的，半透明的绿叶，绿叶轻轻摇晃，变软，溶成一片，好像把小吕也溶到里面了。他眼皮一麻搭，不知不觉，睡着了。小吕头枕在一根暴出地面的老葡萄蔓上，满身绿影，睡得真沉，十四岁的正在发育的年轻的胸脯均匀地起伏着。葡萄，正在恣酣地，用力地从地里吸着水，经过皮层下的导管，一直输送到梢顶，输送到每一片伸张着的绿叶，和累累的，已经有指头顶大小的淡绿色的果粒之中。——这时候，不论割破葡萄枝蔓的任何一处，都可以看出有清清的白水流出来，嗒嗒地往下滴……
Walking under an old grape trellis, Xiao Lu wanted to sit down. As soon as he sat down, he wanted to lie down. Lying down, looking at the dense, tender and fresh, translucent green leaves above his head, the green leaves swayed gently, became soft, and dissolved into one, as if Xiao Lu had also melted into it. His eyelids were numb, and before he knew it, he fell asleep. Xiao Lu's head rested on an old grape vine that protruded from the ground, covered in green shadows, sleeping soundly, and the fourteen-year-old developing young chest was rising and falling evenly. The grapes are sucking water from the ground vigorously, through the duct under the cortex, all the way to the top of the tip, to every stretched green leaf, and to the pale green fruit grains that are already the size of fingers. ——At this time, no matter where the grape branches and vines are cut, you can see that clear white water flows out and drips down......一九六二年七月二十日改成

1979年

1979年
[1] This article was originally published in Beijing Literature and Art, No. 10, 1962. The first collection was "Night in the Sheep House", China Children's Publishing House, January 1963; and "Selected Short Stories of Wang Zengqi", Beijing Publishing House, February 1982, with slight changes in the text. In 1979骑兵列传[1]
Biography of Cavalry [1]我们为了了解抗日战争时期威震后山的骑兵营的情况，访问了黄司令员——当年的黄营长。“后山”是呼和浩特人习惯的说法，泛指大青山以北地区。感谢老曹同志为我们安排了这次会见。这位老曹同志是个“红火人”，非常健谈，记性极好，生活知识非常丰富，热情好客，好饭量，好酒量。他年轻时拉过骆驼，从呼市到新疆。“阿格头子灰背青[2]，四十五天到旧城”，他现在还常唱当年唱过的爬山调。后来在大青山打过多年游击，晚上下山活动，天亮回山。“狼下山，我下山；狼回山，我回山”。他熟悉大青山的每一条路，大青山的群众熟悉他这个人。他打过很多仗，也挨过多次整。文化大革命中被薅掉一大片头发，打断过踝骨，到现在头皮上还秃了一块，走起路来一瘸一拐。可是他说起这些事，兴高采烈，眉飞色舞，好像是一场热闹有趣的戏剧。他现在还在靠边站，所以有时间陪我们。
In order to understand the situation of the cavalry battalion in Weizhen Houshan during the War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression, we interviewed Commander Huang, the battalion commander of the Huang regiment at that time. "Back mountain" is a common saying of Hohhot people, which generally refers to the area north of Daqingshan. Thank you to Comrade Lao Cao for arranging this meeting for us. This old Comrade Cao is a "red man", very talkative, has an excellent memory, is very rich in life knowledge, is hospitable, good at food, and good drink. When he was young, he pulled camels from Hushi to Xinjiang. "Age Touzi gray-backed green [2], forty-five days to the old city", he still often sings the mountain climbing tune he sang back then. Later, he fought guerrilla warfare in Daqing Mountain for many years, went down the mountain at night, and returned to the mountain at dawn. "The wolf goes down the mountain, I go down the mountain; The wolf goes back to the mountain, I go back to the mountain." He is familiar with every road in Daqingshan, and the people of Daqingshan are familiar with him as a person. He has fought many battles and suffered many times. During the Cultural Revolution, he lost a large piece of hair, broke his ankle bone, and now he is bald on his scalp and limps when he walks. But when he talked about these things, he was elated and his eyebrows were dancing, as if it was a lively and interesting drama. He is still standing aside, so he has time to accompany us.约定会见的地点在大青山坝口子底下一家当年多次掩护过八路军的老堡垒户的家里。不是老曹代约，黄司令员大概不会同意见我们。不是这地方，大概他也不会去。黄司令员的问题还没有做结论。他现在每天除了背了一枝半自动到山里去打猎，就是各处去看望那些老堡垒户。几十里，上百里，不算一回事。老曹说，约他上这家来吃一顿油糕，估计他能来。
The agreed meeting place was at the home of an old fortress household that had covered the Eighth Route Army many times under the dam entrance of Daqingshan. If it weren't for Lao Cao's appointment, Commander Huang probably wouldn't agree to see us. If it weren't for this place, he probably wouldn't have gone there. Commander Huang's question has not yet been concluded. In addition to carrying a semi-automatic to the mountains to hunt every day, he also visits those old fortress households everywhere. Dozens of miles, hundreds of miles, is not the same thing. Lao Cao said that he asked him to come to this house to eat oil cake, and it was estimated that he could come.果然，他早已就到了。没想到，这位妇孺皆知，叱咤风云的将军竟是这样一个人：中等以下的身材，长眉秀眼，高高的额头。近六十的人了，一头乌黑的头发，一嘴整齐的白牙。衬衫，军裤，青鞋，白袜。他说话的口音很特别。照老曹的说法是：他讲的话内蒙人听得懂，但是觉得很古怪；他的家乡人听起来很熟悉，但是听不懂。原来他说话的语调是江西语调，所用的字眼却全部是内蒙字眼。这位将军非常寡言。他是永新人。去年我刚刚去过永新，就跟他谈起永新的见闻，自以为这可以引起他谈话的兴趣。不料他听了半天，只答了一句：“内蒙好。”我觉得这有点文不对题。这天，他一共没有说几句话，只是抽烟，喝茶，点头，微笑。胃口却很好。油糕端上来了，在他面前堆起了高高的一盘。他不放筷子，一气吃了十四个。油糕这东西很不好消化。常言说：“三十里的莜面四十里的糕，二十里的荞面饿断腰。”他这样的身材，这样的岁数，肚子里装下十四个油糕，受得了吗？然而他若无其事。
Sure enough, he had already arrived. Unexpectedly, women and children know that this powerful general is such a person: below average build, long eyebrows and beautiful eyes, and a high forehead. Nearly sixty years old, with black hair and neat white teeth. Shirt, military pants, green shoes, white socks. His accent is very special. According to Lao Cao, what he said was understood by Inner Mongolians, but he felt very strange; his hometown people sounded familiar, but they couldn't understand it. It turned out that his tone was Jiangxi accent, but the words he used were all Inner Mongolian words. This general is very taciturn. He is a Yongxin person. I just went to Yongxin last year, and I talked to him about Yongxin's experiences, thinking that this could arouse his interest in talking. Unexpectedly, he listened for a long time and only replied: "Inner Mongolia is good." I think this is a bit off. On this day, he didn't say a few words, just smoked, drank tea, nodded, and smiled. The appetite is very good. The oil cake was served, and a high plate was piled up in front of him. He didn't put down his chopsticks and ate fourteen in one go. Oil cake is very difficult to digest. As the saying goes: "Thirty miles of noodles and forty miles of cakes, twenty miles of buckwheat noodles starve and break your waist." "With such a figure and such an age, can he stand fourteen oil cakes in his stomach? However, he was nothing.老曹这天没有吃足了油糕，他喝了很多酒，说了很多笑话。他这天专门说狼。说老母猪斗狼，小狼出疹子，说狼咬红狗子。——红狗子是大青山特有的野兽，很凶猛。老曹说它们每天一起来就要到河边去喝水，喝完水就撒尿，一泡尿要撒一个多钟头。这样没完没了地撒尿，是走不快的。狼就专在这时去咬它。……他夹说带比划，脸上的表情一会是母猪，一会是红狗子，一会是狼，把老堡垒户的两个女儿笑得趴在床上起不来。说着说着，他忽然想起来：“哎，老黄，人家找的是你，你给人家讲讲呀！”老黄说：“你讲！你讲！”——“我讲什么！我在前山多，你在后山多，我替不了你！”黄营长到了也没有给我们讲什么。最后，他说：“你们要了解骑兵营，去找找杨如意吧。他还活着。”
Lao Cao didn't eat enough oil cake that day, he drank a lot of wine and told a lot of jokes. He specifically talked about wolves that day. It is said that the old sow fights wolves, the little wolf has a rash, and the wolf bites the red dog. ——The red dog is a beast unique to Daqingshan and is very ferocious. Lao Cao said that they have to go to the river to drink water every day, and they pee after drinking water, and it takes more than an hour to pee in a bubble. Peeing endlessly like this is not fast. The wolf bites it at this time. …… He said with a gesture, and the expression on his face was a sow, a red dog, and a wolf, making the two daughters of the old fortress laugh so hard that they couldn't get up on the bed. As he spoke, he suddenly remembered: "Hey, Lao Huang, people are looking for you, you tell them!" Lao Huang said: "You speak! You speak!" ——"What am I talking about! Departing from Hohhot, we went to the banner where Yang Ruyi was on the same day. A young comrade of the Flag Revolutionary Committee introduced to us: "His house is easy to find, and when he got off the gray beam, he heard a clatter somewhere, that was his home." ”车过灰腾梁，我们禁不住要下来看看。这地方的景色真是特别。汽车在大山之间盘旋，走了半天，还是这座山。上了山顶，竟是一片一望无际的大平地。那么大，那么平！有的地开垦了，种了莜麦，麦穗正在成熟，随风摇摆，一片闪着银光的翠绿的海。有的地方还荒着，长着茎叶都很坚硬的劲草，草丛里开着高寒地区特有的紫蓝色的野花。昨天下过雨，纵横的拖拉机履带的辙印里存着积水。一辆装满柴草的牛车在天边缓缓地移动。除此之外，寂无一人。天还没有放晴，灰色的云层压下来，显得这片高山顶上的大野说不出的苍莽荒寒。听说“灰腾儿”蒙语的意思是寒冷。这个地方是够冷的。我们在山下穿的是衬衫，在山顶立了一会，就都披起预先借来的棉大衣。风，真硬。
The car passed the gray beam, and we couldn't help but come down and take a look. The scenery of this place is really special. The car circled between the mountains, and after walking for a long time, it was still this mountain. When I reached the top of the mountain, it was an endless flat land. So big, so flat! Some land has been cultivated and planted with wheat, and the ears of wheat are ripening, swaying in the wind, a green sea shining with silver light. Some places are still barren, with strong grass with hard stems and leaves, and purple-blue wildflowers unique to alpine regions bloom in the grass. It rained yesterday, and there was water in the ruts of the tractor tracks. An ox cart full of firewood moved slowly on the edge of the sky. Other than that, there was no one there. The sky has not yet cleared, and the gray clouds have pressed down, making it look indescribably wild and cold on the top of this high mountain. I heard that "gray tengger" means cold in Mongolian. This place is cold enough. We wore shirts at the bottom of the mountain, and after standing on the top of the mountain for a while, we all put on our pre-borrowed cotton coats. The wind is really hard.下了梁，我们的吉普车一直开进了一个发出哗啦哗啦的响声的院子。
Off the beam, our jeep drove into a yard that made a loud noise.这哗啦哗啦的声音是一个风车弄出来的。这院子里竖着一根高高的杆子，上面装了一个用铁片做成，有脸盆大小的铁风车。风稍大一点，它就高昂急促地喧闹起来。这玩意是干什么用的？
The clattering sound was made by a windmill. There was a tall pole erected in the yard, on which was an iron windmill the size of a basin made of iron sheets. When the wind was a little stronger, it became noisy and loud. What is this thing for?我们推开门，一个长着一对鹰眼的中年人斜着眼睛把我打量了一遍。我们说明是黄司令员介绍来的，他立刻改变了态度：“请进！上炕吧！”
We pushed open the door, and a middle-aged man with a pair of eagle eyes squinted at me. We explained that it was introduced by Commander Huang, and he immediately changed his attitude: "Please come in! Let's go to the kang!" ”我们知道他爱喝酒，给他带来了两瓶二锅头。他用牙咬开瓶盖，倒了几碗，又从酸菜缸里捞出几个蔓菁。这地方的蔓菁很有名。别处的蔓菁是青皮的，这里的蔓菁的皮是大红的，——里面的肉雪白，非常鲜嫩。他掏出蒙古人吃肉用的刀，把蔓菁切成碎块：“本来应该给你们搞一点手抓羊肉，我现在这个处境……来，喝！”
We know that he loves to drink, so we brought him two bottles of Erguotou. He bit open the bottle cap with his teeth, poured a few bowls, and fished out a few more turnips from the sauerkraut jar. The turnips in this place are famous. The turnips elsewhere are green-skinned, and the skin of the turnips here is bright red,—— and the meat inside is snow-white and very tender. He took out the knife used by Mongolians for eating meat and cut the turnips into pieces: "I should have made you some hand-grabbed mutton, but I'm in this situation now...... Come on, drink! ”我们说明了来意，他放下酒碗，皱起眉头：“你们要了解骑兵营？了解这干什么？这都成了俺们的‘严重罪行’了。人家说俺们不是干革命，是反革命。
We explained our intentions, and he put down his wine bowl and frowned: "You want to know about the cavalry battalion? What are you doing here? This has become our 'serious crime'. People say that we are not doing revolution, we are counter-revolutionary.“三十多年的事了，从哪儿说起？这样吧，过两天我要到呼市去，我去找你们。今天咱们先见见面。我想起什么，说什么；说到哪儿，算哪儿。”说着，他点起一盏灯，——铜制的，有普通电池粗细，三寸来高，当中灌煤油，上面安个捻子的灯，找出一根巴掌长的羊肩骨烟袋，就着火抽起烟来。这种烟，一次只能装一小撮，吸一口，就吹掉，叫做“一口香”。他一边抽烟，一边用一块羊皮不停地擦那盏灯。
"It's been more than thirty years, where to start? Well, I'm going to Hushi in two days, and I'll go to you. Let's meet first today. What do I remember, what do I say; where I say, where is it?" As he spoke, he lit a lamp,—— made of copper, with the thickness of an ordinary battery, about three inches high, filled with kerosene, placed a twister lamp on it, found a palm-length sheep's shoulder bone cigarette bag, and lit it and smoked. This kind of cigarette can only be filled with a small pinch at a time, and after one puff, it is blown away, which is called "a mouthful of incense". While smoking, he kept wiping the lamp with a piece of sheepskin.“你们问我是怎样参加革命的？——我小名叫个如意，从小可不如意。我父亲生我们哥儿七个。我虚岁十五上就揽了工。给汉人种地，给蒙古人放马。白天干，晚上还要找点零活。那年来了八路军。俺们这儿也成立了抗联会。有一天晚上，有人叫我。我以为是找我干点零活。原来是抗联会敛了一批军鞋，要送给八路军去。他们问我敢不敢去，——那会儿遍地是鬼子、汉奸，八路军没个准地方。我说：‘咋不敢！’八路军挺和气，还给好的吃。我说：‘下回再有这事，我还去！’去了几次，就熟了。有一次，他们走失了一匹军马，找了几天了。我问了问是哪天走失的，那天刮的是什么风，第二天，就给他们找回来了。走失的马，总是顺着风向走去的。骑兵营原本都是南方人，都是步兵。步兵改骑兵，可得有个过程。那个时候，有的人从鞍子这边跨上去，从那边就掉下来了。他们问我愿不愿留下来。我想，这比揽工好，这就参了军。
"You ask me how I joined the revolution? ——My nickname is Ruyi, and I have been unhappy since I was a child. My father gave birth to seven of our brothers. I got a job when I was fifteen years old. Farm for the Han people and herd horses for the Mongols. Work during the day and find some odd jobs at night. That year came the Eighth Route Army. We also set up the Anti-Japanese Federation here. One night, someone called me. I thought they were looking for me to do odd jobs. It turned out that the Anti-Japanese Federation had collected a batch of military shoes and wanted to give them to the Eighth Route Army. They asked me if I dared to go,—— At that time, there were devils and traitors everywhere, and the Eighth Route Army had no right place. I said, 'Why don't you dare!' The Eighth Route Army was very kind and gave me good food. I said, 'Next time this happens, I'll go!' I went a few times, and I was familiar. Once, they lost a military horse and searched for it for a few days. I asked them what day they were lost, what the wind was blowing that day, and the next day, they found them back. Lost horses always follow the direction of the wind. The cavalry battalion was originally Southerners, all infantry. There must be a process for infantry to cavalry. At that time, some people stepped on the side of the saddle and fell from there. They asked me if I wanted to stay. I thought it was better than recruiting, so I joined the army.“参军后调到山西训练了一年，我这才知道有个礼拜天。一到礼拜天，睡一天。

"Assign me to be the chief of staff. I'm a beautiful secretary! How can I get food, discuss it with the masses, and solve it all. The big guy praised me, and I didn't feel at ease. "He was originally in charge of a reservoir construction site. Over the years, many things have been unaccustomed to it, complaining all day long, saying strange things, and scolding people. "A cotton thread to wear as a hat?"“俺们的服装，原来还不错，是缴获的日本太阳布。后来只能就地解决。转山子有个供给部，给俺们做服装。莜麦秸烧灰染布面，羊毛絮里。袖子和前后身是分开两个地方做的。有一年，伪军把袖子全抢走了，俺们一冬天就穿着没有袖子的棉衣。帽子是羊绒擀的。初戴上，很像个样子，还是三块瓦。羊绒这玩意，不经搓揉，戴不几天，就不成个形了。萨克亚还把帽子搞丢了。灰腾梁这地方，没有帽子咋行呀？他可真有办法，搞了一根棉线，在脑袋上系了一圈，把耳朵贴着后脑勺系紧。就这样过了好几天。萨克亚说，他不是第一次这样干。不这样系上，耳朵就掉了。
"Our costumes turned out to be good, they were captured Japanese sun cloth. Later, it could only be solved on the spot. There is a supply department in Zhuanshanzi to make clothes for us. Wheat straw is burned ash to dye the cloth surface, in the wool wool. The sleeves and the front and back are made in two separate places. One year, the puppet army snatched all the sleeves, and we wore cotton clothes without sleeves all winter. The hat is rolled out of cashmere. When I first put it on, it looked very similar, but it was still three tiles. Cashmere, without rubbing, will not be shaped after a few days of wearing. Saqya also lost his hat.
