If you don't tie it like this, your ears will fall out.“灰腾梁，灰腾梁，你可真是个灰腾儿的梁呀！这个灰地方，五六月就能下一场白毛糊糊。我们有时在山沟里宿营，烧火做饭，完了就把热灰摊开，大家挤在一起睡。睡到半夜，冷得不行，就起来再烧。第二天起来，可就都成了‘灰人’[5]了！有时连火也不能烧，就只好抱着枪露宿。哈拉子流到枪上，结成一根冰练子。一醒来，得慢慢摇脑袋。摇快了，下嘴唇就没了，——至少扽下一块肉来。
"Gray beam, gray beam, you are really a gray beam! In this gray place, you can have a white hair in May and June. We sometimes camp in the ravine, light a fire to cook, and when we are done, we spread out the hot ashes and everyone huddles together to sleep. I slept until midnight, and it was so cold that I got up and burned again. When I got up the next day, I became a 'gray man'[5]! Sometimes you can't even burn the fire, so you have to sleep in the open air with a gun. Harazi flows onto the gun and forms an ice train. When you wake up, you have to shake your head slowly. If you shake it too fast, your lower lip will be gone,—— at least pick out a piece of meat.“可我们那时整天都是嘻嘻哈哈，快快活活的。从灰腾梁上一个马冲锋下去，冲到敌人阵子，抡开马刀，把敌人连胳臂带胸脯削下来，那叫一个痛快！打开一个地方，把大桶大桶的油，成袋成袋的面，分给群众。妇女、小孩站在路边给俺们一鼓掌，就觉得什么也值了。能活多久，没想过。黄营长常说：‘打不死就革敏（命）；打死了就不革敏（命）’。
"But we were laughing and laughing all day long. A horse charged down from the gray beam, rushed to the enemy's formation, opened the saber, and cut off the enemy's arms and chests, which was called a pleasure! Open a place and distribute large barrels of oil, bags into bags of noodles, to the masses. Women and children stood on the side of the road and applauded us, and they felt that everything was worth it. I never thought about how long I could live. Battalion Commander Huang often said: 'If you can't kill you, you will be sensitive (life); if you can't kill you, you won't be sensitive (life)'.“一九四三年，真是困难到了茶壶盖上了。以后就好转了。部队里流传一句话：‘今年打败希特勒，明年打败小日本。’我们有时也在一起谈论，仗打完了，俺们的日子会是个啥样。当时还总结了三条，以为大概是：上下班，拿现钱，娶老婆。不过，都说，这样的日子俺们是过不上了，俺们就为了二茬人吧。”
"In 1943, it was really difficult to put on the lid of the teapot. It got better after that. There is a saying in the army: 'Defeat Hitler this year, defeat Little Japan next year.' We sometimes talk together about what our days will be like when the war is over. At that time, I also summed up three points, thinking that it was roughly: commuting to and from work, getting cash, and marrying a wife. However, it is said that we can't live such a day, so let's just do it for the sake of the second stubble. ”雷声隆隆，大雨要下来了。司机又在外面按喇叭。他已经按了几次，催我们快走。我们只得告辞了。杨如意说：“本该给你们弄点山韭菜包饺子吃，让你们尝尝我这司务长的手艺，今天是不行了。”我跟他要两个蔓菁。他说：“行，送你一缸也行！”我说：“一缸我可搬不动。我只想带两个回北京，让人们见识见识这种红皮的蔓菁。”
The thunder rumbled, and the heavy rain was about to fall. The driver honked his horn outside again. He had already honked several times to urge us to leave. We had to take our leave. Yang Ruyi said: "I should have gotten you some mountain leeks to make dumplings to eat, so that you could taste my craftsmanship as a secretary, but today it won't work." I asked him for two turnips. He said, "Okay, I can give you a jar!" I said, "I can't move a jar." I just want to bring two back to Beijing so that people can see this red-skinned turnip. ”杨如意原来在灰腾梁一个金矿上负责。文化大革命曾被打断两根肋骨，现在还穿着钢马甲。
这两个蔓菁我带回了呼和浩特，装在一个塑料口袋里。没想到，过两天，都发黏了。
Yang Ruyi was originally in charge of a gold mine in Huitengliang. During the Cultural Revolution, two ribs were broken, and he still wears a steel vest. I brought these two turnips back to Hohhot and put them in a plastic bag. Unexpectedly, after two days, they were all sticky.回呼市，见了老曹，我问他：“杨如意院里装了那么一个铁风车干什么？”——“嗐！这人！那会斗得他不行，气得他整宵整宵睡不着觉。弄了那么个哗啦哗啦响的东西，就岔乎开了，不再想那些沤心的事了。你知道这哗啦哗啦响的是什么声音么？这是暴风一样的马蹄的声音，丁丁当当的马刀声音，千军万马喊杀的声音。这人！”
When I called back to the city and saw Lao Cao, I asked him: "Why is there such an iron windmill installed in Yang Ruyi's courtyard?" ——"Hey! This person! That would make him so angry that he couldn't sleep all night. After making such a loud noise, it opened up, and I no longer thought about those heart-wrenching things. Do you know what the sound of this clattering sound is? This is the sound of horses' hooves like a storm, the sound of sabers dangding, and the sound of thousands of troops shouting to kill. This person! ”“他有什么问题？”
“屁的个问题！——跟老黄的关系。”
“黄司令员是什么问题？”
"What's wrong with him?" "A fart problem! ——Relationship with Lao Huang. ” "What is the problem with Commander Huang?"“什么问题？——反党，反社会主义，反毛泽东思想！真是见他妈的鬼了！他十四岁就当了红军！他到内蒙三十五年了。从离开家乡，一直没有回去过。你听听他那一口不三不四的江西内蒙话！上次你跟他谈永新，他说‘内蒙好’，你觉得文不对题，你不懂。你不懂他和内蒙人民有多深的血肉关系。他从血里火里救出过多少群众，群众又从冰里雪里给了他多少支援啊！
"What's the problem? - Anti-party, anti-socialist, anti-Mao Zedong Thought! What a fucking ghost! He became a Red Army at the age of fourteen! He has been in Inner Mongolia for thirty-five years. Since leaving his hometown, he has never gone back. Listen to his indisputable Jiangxi Inner Mongolian dialect! Last time you talked to him about Yongxin, he said 'Inner Mongolia is good', you think the text is wrong, you don't understand. You don't understand how deep his flesh-and-blood relationship is with the people of Inner Mongolia. How many people he has rescued from the fire and blood, and how much support the masses have given him from the ice and snow!“这些整人的人，你们不了解，你们问问群众嘛！有两个造反派到金盆公社去调查老黄的材料，找到一个八十岁的老牧民。这个老牧民没说一句话。他捧出了一个镜框，里面是一张毛主席的像，毛主席的像下面压着一张他从报上剪下来的老黄的照片。他们到红台去调查，一个老太太带着一伙妇女拿苕帚把他们赶回来了。老黄还在关着的时候，他的老伴死了，只有一个女儿。他们要把她送到一个很远的地方去接受贫下中农再教育。从固阳来了十多个农民，找到有关部门，问：‘俺们是不是贫下中农？俺们能不能教育她？你把她交给俺们！’
"You don't understand these whole people, ask the masses! Two rebels went to Jinpen Commune to investigate Lao Huang's materials and found an eighty-year-old herdsman. The old herdsman didn't say a word. He held out a frame with a portrait of Chairman Mao, and under Chairman Mao's portrait was a photo of Lao Huang that he had cut out of the newspaper. They went to Hongtai to investigate, and an old lady drove them back with a broom. While Lao Huang was still in prison, his wife died and he had only one daughter. They were going to send her to a far away place to receive re-education from the poor and lower middle peasants. More than a dozen peasants came from Guyang, found the relevant departments, and asked: 'Are we poor and middle peasants? Can we educate her? You give her to us!' ’“老黄的家是个贫下中农招待所。他当年打过仗的地方的群众什么事都找他。哪里想打一口井，要买一台拖拉机，想把电线延长到他们村；谁家的房子漏了，想搞一点砖瓦；谁想到呼市就医，要找一个信得过的医生动手术；他们的子女升学就业，婚丧嫁娶，他都管。他每月工资不少，生活很简单，但是没有一个存款。
"Lao Huang's home is a poor and middle-class peasant guest house. The people in the places where he fought back then came to him for everything. Where do you want to dig a well, buy a tractor, and want to extend the wire to their village; whose house is leaking and wants to make some bricks; who wants to seek medical treatment in Hushi and find a trustworthy doctor to perform surgery; he takes care of their children's education, employment, marriage, funeral, and marriage. He has a lot of monthly salary, and his life is very simple, but he has no savings.“这些情况，谁都知道。整他的那些人也都知道。他们不是不知道啊。可是他们就是要整你，非把你整倒不可！这是什么道理呢？这次运动为什么要这样搞法呢？我真是不懂！不懂啊！……”
Everyone knows these situations. Those who him also know about it. It's not that they don't know. But they just want to punish you, and they have to punish you! What is the reasoning behind this? Why is this movement doing this? I really don't understand! I don't understand! ……”我访问这几位老同志，是在一九七四年。这篇文章是追记的，——当时也不可能写出这样的文章。因为我的记忆还停留在那个时期，所用的语气也是那时的语气。文中所有的“现在”本来都应改为“那时”才对。一时来不及逐一改正，就先这样吧。
I interviewed these old comrades in 1974. This article is postscripted,—— it was impossible to write such an article at that time. Because my memory is still stuck in that period, the tone used is also the tone of that time. All the "now" in the text should have been changed to "then". There is no time to correct them one by one, so let's do it for now.现在，——这个“现在”是真的现在，这些老同志的问题都得到令人满意的解决了，他们重返工作岗位，继续为“二茬人”在献出他们的余生。当黄司令员得到解决他的问题的通知那天，很多人到他家里去祝贺，可是找不到他。他又到坝口子那家老堡垒户家吃油糕去了。据老曹来信告诉我，那天他吃了十五个。
Now,—— this "now" is true Now, the problems of these old comrades have been satisfactorily solved, and they have returned to work and continue to dedicate the rest of their lives to the "second crop people". When Commander Huang was notified that his problem had been solved, many people went to his house to congratulate him, but they could not find him. He went to the old fortress household in Bakouzi to eat oil cakes again. According to Lao Cao's letter, he ate fifteen that day.但愿这些老同志平平安安的。但愿以后永远不搞那样的运动了。但愿不再有那么多人的肋骨、踝骨被打断。
I hope these old comrades are safe. I hope I will never engage in such sports again. I hope that so many people's ribs and ankles will not be broken.
[1] 本篇原载《人民文学》1979年第十一期；初收《汪曾祺短篇小说选》，北京出版社，1982年2月，文中注释略有改动。
[2] 阿格和灰背青是草原上的两种牧草，牲口爱吃。
[1] This article was originally published in the eleventh issue of "People's Literature" in 1979; "Selected Short Stories of Wang Zengqi", Beijing Publishing House, February 1982, with slight changes in the annotations. [2] Ager and gray-backed green are two types of grassland that livestock love to eat.[3] 驳花马是黑白相间的马。驳，读如豹。这种马古书上叫“忽雷驳”。有的旧小说和戏曲剧本里写成“呼雷豹”，是不对的。
[4] 爬场是倒楣要饭的意思。
[5] 灰人是无赖或胆大妄为的人。
[3] The flower horse is a black and white horse. Barge, read like a leopard. This kind of horse is called "Hulei Bo" in ancient books. Some old novels and opera scripts write "Hu Lei Leopard", which is not right. [4] Climbing the field means to be unlucky and ask for food. [5] Gray people are scoundrels or daredevils.

1980年

1980年
塞下人物记[1]
一、陈银娃
农民大都能赶车，但不是所有的农民都能当一个出色的车倌。
In 1980 Character Records {{id_0000}} 1. Chen Yinwa Most farmers can drive a car, but not all farmers can be an excellent driver.星期天，有三辆马车要到片石山去拉石头。我那天没有什么事，就提出跟他们的车到片石山看看。我在这个地方住了一年多了，每天上午十一点半，下午五点半，都听见片石山放炮。风雨无阻，准时不误。一直想去看看。片石山就是采石场。不知道为什么本地人都叫它片石山。
On Sunday, three carriages were going to Pianshi Mountain to pull stones. I had nothing to do that day, so I proposed to go to Pianshi Mountain with their car. I have lived in this place for more than a year, and every day at half past eleven in the morning and half past five in the afternoon, I hear the cannons fired at Pian Shishan. Rain or shine, on time. I have always wanted to see it. Pian Shi Mountain is a quarry. I don't know why the locals call it Pian Shi Mountain.马车一进山，不由得人要挺挺胸脯，深吸一口气。这是个雄壮的地方。采石的山头已经劈去了半个，露出扇面一样的青灰色的石骨，间或有几条铁锈色蜿蜒的纹道。这石骨是第一次接触空气呀。人，是了不起的。一个老把式正在清除残石。放了炮，并不是所有的石头都崩落下来，有一些仍粘连在石壁上。老把式在腰里系了一根粗绳，绳头固定在山顶，他悬在半空，拿了一根钢钎，这里捅一下，那里戳一下，——轰隆！门板大的石块就从四五层楼那样的高处落到地面。
As soon as the carriage entered the mountain, people couldn't help but straighten their chests and take a deep breath. This is a magnificent place. The top of the quarry has been cut in half, revealing a fan-like bluish-gray stone bone, with a few rust-colored winding lines occasionally. This stone bone is the first time it has come into contact with air. People are amazing. An old man is clearing the remaining stones. After firing, not all the stones collapsed, some were still stuck to the stone walls. The old man tied a thick rope around his waist, the rope was fixed to the top of the mountain, he hung in mid-air, took a steel shovel, poked here, poked there,—— boom! The stone as large as the door panel fell from a height of four or five stories to the ground.这是个石头的世界。到处是石头。
It's a world of stones. Stones everywhere.好些人在干活，搬运石头。他们把石头按大小块分别堆放。这些石头各有不同用处。大的可制碾盘、磨扇，重量都在千斤以上。有两个已经斲好的石磨就在旁边搁着。中等的有四五百斤，可做阶石、刻墓碑。小块的二三十斤、四五十斤不等，砌墙，垒堤坝。搬运石头，没有工具。四五百斤，就是搁在后腰上背着，——有的垫一条麻袋。他们都是不出声地，慢慢地，一步一步地走着。不唱歌，也不喊号子。那么多的人在活动，可是山里静悄悄的。
Many people are working, carrying stones. They stack the stones in large and small pieces. These stones have different uses. Large mills and grinding fans weigh more than 1,000 pounds. There are two stone mills that have been cut next to them. The medium ones are four or five hundred pounds, which can be used as step stones and tombstones. Small pieces range from twenty or thirty pounds to forty or fifty pounds, building walls and embankments. There are no tools to carry stones. Four or five hundred pounds are placed on the back of the waist and some ,—— carry a sack. They all walk silently, slowly, step by step. They don't sing, they don't shout. So many people are moving, but the mountains are quiet.三辆大车装满了石头，——都是小块的。下山的路，车走得很快。三辆三套大车，前后相跟，九匹马，三十六只马蹄，郭答郭答响成一片，很威风，很气派。忽然，头一辆车“误”住了。快到平地时，有一个坑。前天下过雨，积水未干。不知道是谁，拿浮土把它垫了。上山是空车，不觉得。下山是重载，一下子崴在里面了。
The three big carts were full of stones,—— all of which were small pieces. On the way down the mountain, the car went very fast. Three sets of three large carts, front and back, nine horses, thirty-six horses' hooves, Guo Da Guo Da sounded in one piece, very majestic and magnificent. Suddenly, the first car "mistakenly". When I was about to reach the flat ground, there was a pit. It rained the day before yesterday, and the water was not dry. I don't know who it was, but I took the floating soil and cushioned it. It was an empty car going up the mountain, I didn't think so. Going down the mountain was a heavy load, and it was suddenly buried in it.车倌是个很精干，也很要强的小伙子。叭——叭！接连抽了几鞭子，——没上来。他跳下车，拿铁锨把胶皮轱辘前面的土铲去一些，上车又是几鞭子。“哦嗬！——咦哦嗬！”不顶！车倌的脸通红，“咳！我日你妈！”手里的鞭子抽得山响，辕马和拉套的马一齐努力，马蹄子乱响，噼哩叭啦！噼哩叭啦！还是不顶！越陷越深，车身歪得厉害，眼见得这辆车要“扣”。第二辆车上的是个老车倌，跳下来，到前面看了看，说：“卸吧！”
The driver is a very capable and strong young man. Boom-boom! He whipped a few whips in succession,—— but he didn't come up. He jumped out of the car, took a shovel to shovel off some of the soil in front of the rubber roller, and got into the car with a few more whips. "Oh ho! ——Hey oh ho! "No top! The coachman's face turned red, "Cough! My mother!" The whip in his hand was whipped with a mountain sound, and the yoke horse and the horse in the pull worked together, and the horse's hooves were chaotic and crackling! Crackle! Still not top! The deeper it sinks, the more crooked the body is, and I see that the car is going to be "buckled". The second car was an old driver, jumped down, looked at the front, and said, "Unload!" ”这一车石头，卸下来，再装上，得多少时候？正在这时，第三辆上的车倌高声喊道：“陈银娃来啦！”
我听人们说起过陈银娃，没见过。
How long does it take to unload and reload this cart of stones? At this moment, the driver on the third car shouted loudly: "Chen Yinwa is here! ” I've heard people talk about Chen Yinwa, but I've never seen it.陈银娃是个二十五六的小伙子，眉清目秀，穿了一副大红牡丹花的“腰子”，布衫搭在肩头。——这一带夏天一天温差很大，“早穿皮袄午穿纱”，男人们兴穿一种薄棉的紧身背心，叫做“腰子”。“腰子”的布料都很鲜艳。六七十岁的老汉也穿红的，年轻人就不用提了。像陈银娃穿的这件大红牡丹花的“腰子”，并非罕见。
Chen Yinwa is a young man of twenty-five or six, with clear eyebrows and beautiful eyebrows, wearing a pair of "waists" of big red peony flowers, and a cloth shirt is worn on his shoulders. ——The temperature difference in this area is very large in summer, "wearing a leather jacket in the morning and gauze in the afternoon", and men wear a thin cotton tight vest called "waist". The fabric of the "waist" is very bright. Old men in their sixties and seventies also wear red, so young people don't need to mention it. It is not uncommon to see the "waist" of the big red peony flower worn by Chen Yinwa.老车倌跟银娃说了几句话。银娃看了看车上的石头，说：“你们真敢装！这一车够四千八百斤！”又看了看三匹马，称赞道：“好牲口！”然后掏出烟袋，点了一锅烟，说：“牲口打毛了，它不知道往哪里使劲，让它缓一缓。”
The old coachman said a few words to Yinwa. Yinwa looked at the stones on the car and said, "You really dare to pretend! This cart is enough for 4,800 pounds!" He looked at the three horses again and praised: "Good animal!" Then he took out a cigarette pouch, lit a pot of cigarettes, and said, "The animal is hairy, it doesn't know where to work, let it slow down." ”三锅烟抽罢，他接过鞭子，腾地跳上车辕，甩了一个响鞭，“叭——！”三匹牲口的耳朵都竖得直直的。“喔嗬！”辕马的肌肉直颤。紧接着，他照着辕马的两肩之间狠抽了一鞭，辕马全身力量都集中在两只前腿上，往前猛力一蹬，挽套的马就势往前一冲，——车上来了。
After smoking three pots of cigarettes, he took the whip, jumped on the yoke, and threw a whip, "Boom——! "The ears of the three animals are all straight." Oh! The yoke horse's muscles trembled. Immediately afterwards, he whipped the yoke between the shoulders of the yoke horse, and the yoke horse's whole body was concentrated on the two front legs, and with a sharp push forward, the harness horse rushed forward ,—— the cart.他跳下车，把鞭子还给车倌。
三个车倌同声向他道谢，“嗳！谢啥咧！”他已经走进了高粱地。只见他的黑黑的头发和大红牡丹花的“腰子”在油绿油绿的高粱丛中一闪一闪，走远了。
He jumped out of the car and returned the whip to the driver. The three drivers thanked him in unison, "Hey! Thank you!" He had already walked into the sorghum field. I saw his black hair and the "waist" of the big red peony flower flashing in the green sorghum bushes and walking away.老车倌告诉我，陈银娃赶车是家传，他父亲就是一个有名的车倌。有人曾经跟他打赌：那人戴了一顶毡帽，银娃的父亲一鞭子抽过去，毡帽劈成了两半，那人的头皮却纹丝未动。
也有人说，没有那么回事。
The old driver told me that Chen Yinwa's drive was a family heirloom, and his father was a famous driver. Someone once bet with him: the man was wearing a felt hat, and Yinwa's father whipped it, and the felt hat was split in half, but the man's scalp did not move. Some people say that this is not the case.二、王大力
2. Wang Dali小车站有个搬运队，有二十几个人。他们搬运的东西主要是片石山下来的石头。车站两边的月台上经常堆满了石料。他们每天要把四五百斤一块的石头，一块一块地背上火车去。他们也是那样不声不响地工作着，迈着稳稳的步子，一步一步走上月台和车厢之间的跳板。
There is a porting team at the small station, with more than 20 people. The things they carry are mainly stones from the stone mountain. The platforms on both sides of the station are often piled up with stones. They have to carry four or five hundred pounds of stones on the train one by one every day. They also worked silently, taking steady steps, step by step on the springboard between the platform and the carriage.他们的宿舍就在离车站不远的路边。夏天中午路过时，可以看到他们半躺在铺上休息，有的在抽烟。他们似乎在休息时也是不声不响的。
Their dormitory is on the side of the road not far from the station. When passing by at noon in the summer, they can be seen half-lying on the bunk resting, some smoking. They also seem to be silent when resting.有时有一个女人上他们宿舍来。她带着一个包袱，打开来，把拆洗缝补好的衣服分送给几个人；又收走一些换下来的衣服。这个女人也不说话，也是那么不声不响的。搬运工人对她好像很尊重。她来了，躺着的就都坐起来。这女人有五十上下年纪。
Sometimes a woman came to their dormitory. She took a baggage, opened it, and distributed the clothes that had been disassembled, washed, and mended to several people; and took away some of the clothes that had been changed. The woman did not speak, and she was so quiet. The porters seemed to respect her. When she came, everyone who was lying down sat up. The woman was about fifty years old.有人告诉我，这是王大力的媳妇。
王大力也是个搬运工，前五年死了。
大家都叫他王大力，没有多少人知道他的真名字。
Someone told me that this is Wang Dali's daughter-in-law. Wang Dali was also a porter and died five years ago. Everyone calls him Wang Dali, and not many people know his real name.离车站二里有一个扬旗。扬旗对面有一座孤山头，人们就叫它孤山。——这一带的山都是当地人依山的形貌取的名字，如孤山、红山、马脊梁山。孤山不算很高，不过爬到山顶，周围几十里都看得清清楚楚。我曾经上去过。空着手也不能一口气走到山顶，当中总得歇一会。有人跟王大力打赌，问他能不能扛三麻袋绿豆一口气上山。粮食里最重的是绿豆。一麻袋绿豆二百七十斤。三麻袋，八百多斤。王大力一口气扛上去了，跟没事似的。
There is a flag raising two miles from the station. There is a solitary mountain opposite the flag, and people call it Lonely Mountain. ——The mountains in this area are named by the locals based on the shape of the mountains, such as Gushan, Hongshan, and Majiliang Mountain. The solitary mountain is not very high, but when you climb to the top, you can see it clearly for dozens of miles. I have been up once. You can't walk to the top of the mountain empty-handed, and you have to rest for a while. Someone made a bet with Wang Dali and asked him if he could carry three sacks of mung beans up the mountain in one go. The heaviest food is mung beans. A sack of mung beans weighs 270 pounds. Three sacks, more than 800 pounds. Wang Dali carried it up in one go, as if nothing had happened.他吃两个人的饭，干三个人的活。
He eats for two people and does the work of three.有一次，火车过了扬旗，已经拉了汽笛，王大力发现，轨道上有一堆杉篙，——不知道这是谁干的事。他二话没说，跳下月台，一手抓起一根，乒乒乓乓往月台上扔。最后一根杉篙扔上去，火车到了。他爬上月台，脱了力，瘫下来，死了。
Once, when the train passed the flag and had already sounded the whistle, Wang Dali found that there were a bunch of fir poles on the track,—— he didn't know who did it. Without saying a word, he jumped off the platform, grabbed one in one hand, and threw it on the platform. The last fir pole was thrown up, and the train arrived. He climbed onto the platform, lost his strength, collapsed, and died.火车一阵风似的开过去了，谁也不知道车站上发生过什么事。
他留下一个媳妇，一个儿子。现在，他原先的同伴共同养活着他的家属。他们按月凑齐了钱，给他的老伴送去。她就给这些搬运工缝缝补补，洗洗涮涮。
The train drove by like a gust of wind, and no one knew what had happened at the station. He left behind a daughter-in-law and a son. Now, his former companions support his family together. They collected the money every month and sent it to his wife. She sewed and mended the porters and washed them.孤山下有两间矮矮的房子，碱土抹墙，青瓦盖顶，房顶上爬着瓜藤。有人指给我看：“那就是王大力的家。”
人们每年都要念叨：“王大力死了三年了”，“王大力死了四年了”，“王大力死了五年了”……
There are two low houses at the foot of the lonely mountain, with alkaline soil walls, green tiles covering the roof, and melon vines climbing on the roofs. Someone pointed out to me: "That's Wang Dali's home." ” Every year, people have to chant: "Wang Dali has been dead for three years", "Wang Dali has been dead for four years", "Wang Dali has been dead for five years"......三、说话押韵的人
3. People who speak rhymes我要到宁远铁厂的仓库去办一点事，找一个捡粪的老人问路。他告诉我：起这里一直往东，穿过一片大叶桑树。多会看见地皮通红，不远就是铁厂仓库。我道了谢，往前走。忽然发现：嗯？这人说话是押韵的？
I was going to the warehouse of Ningyuan Iron Works to do some errands and find an old man picking up dung and ask for directions. He told me: From here to the east, through a large-leaved mulberry tree. You will see the ground red, and not far away is the iron factory warehouse. I thanked him and walked forward. Suddenly I realized: Huh? Does this person rhyme?这人有六十开外年纪，还一点不显衰老。他是一个退休的工人，现在的任务是看守着一堆焦炭。这堆焦炭是大炼钢铁的时候存下来的。不老少，像一座小山。不知道为什么，一直不处理，也不运走，一直就在一片空地上放着。从夏天到冬天，一直放着。
This man is sixty years old, and he doesn't look old at all. He is a retired worker, and his current task is to guard a pile of coke. This pile of coke was saved when steel was smelted. Not old or young, like a hill. I don't know why, it has not been disposed of, nor has it been transported, and it has been left in an open space. From summer to winter, it has been there.他就在路边一间泥墙瓦顶的房子里住着，一个人。这间房子原是大炼钢铁时的指挥所，现在还可以看到贴在墙上的褪了色的标语。
He lived alone in a mud-walled and tiled house on the side of the road. This house was originally a command post when steel was smelted, and now you can still see the faded slogans pasted on the walls.他是个不安于闲坐的人，不常在家。但是你可以走进去，一切自便。门锁着，熟人都知道钥匙藏在什么地方。口渴了，喝水。他随时都温着一大锅开水。天气冷，可以烧一把豆秸火烤烤。甚至还可以掏出几个山药放在火里烤熟了吃。山药就在麻袋里放着，放在一个显眼的地方，敞着口。
He is a restless person who does not sit idly and is not often at home. But you can go in and do everything you want. The door is locked, and acquaintances know where the key is hidden. Thirsty, drink water. He always keeps a large pot of boiling water warm. When it's cold, you can burn a handful of bean straw and roast it. You can even take out a few yams and roast them in the fire. The yam is placed in a sack, in a conspicuous place, with its mouth open.他每天出去巡视几遍，看看那一堆焦炭。其余时间，多半是去捡粪。
He went out to inspect several times a day to see the pile of coke. The rest of the time, he mostly went to pick up dung.不远的田地上矗立着一排一排土高炉，整整齐齐，四四方方。再过三五年，没有见过大炼钢铁的盛景的年轻人将会不知道这些黄土筑成的方形建筑物是干什么用的。也许会以为这是古代一场什么战争留下的遗物。——这地方是李克用的故乡，说不定有一个考古学家会考证出这跟沙陀国有关。当年，这个地方曾经是炉火通红，照亮了半个天，——吓得几十里之内的狼都把家搬进深山里去了。现在呢，这些土高炉已经无声无息。里面毫无例外，全都结了一层厚厚的焦子。焦子结实得很。刨不动，凿不开。除非用炸药才能把它炸碎。可是谁也没想起用炸药来炸它。因此，在这片本来是好地的田野上就一直保留着一群古迹。这些古迹有一个很大的优点，既避风，走进去外面又看不见，于是就变成过往行人的一个合乎理想的厕所。这个退休工人每天就到高炉里去捡粪，在那座焦炭山旁边堆成了另一座山。这座粪山高到一定程度，他就通知公社套车来把它拉走。
Not far away stood rows of earthen blast furnaces, neat and square. In three or five years, young people who have not seen the grand scene of steelmaking will not know what these square buildings made of loess are for. You may think that this is a relic left over from some ancient war. ——This place is Li Keyong's hometown, and maybe an archaeologist will verify that this is related to the Shatuo Kingdom. Back then, this place used to be red, illuminating half the sky,—— frightening wolves within dozens of miles to move their homes into the mountains. Now, these earthen blast furnaces are silent. Without exception, they all have a thick layer of char. The coke is very strong. It can't be planed, it can't be chiseled. It can only be blown up with explosives. But no one thought of using explosives to blow it up. Therefore, a group of monuments have always been preserved on this field that was originally a good land. These monuments have a great advantage, they are sheltered from the wind and cannot be seen when you walk in, so they become an ideal toilet for passers-by. The retired worker went to the blast furnace every day to pick up dung, and piled up another mountain next to the coke mountain. When the dung mountain was high to a certain extent, he notified the commune to pull it away.我和别人到他的小屋里去过几次，喝过水，烤过火，都没有见到他。人们告诉我，他只有三顿饭时在家。
I went to his hut a few times with others, drank water, roasted the fire, but never saw him. I was told that he was only home for three meals.冬天，我又和别人路过他的家，他在。那是前半晌，他已经在做饭了。我说：“这么早就做饭？”别人说：“他到冬天都是吃两顿。”他把小米饭焖上，说：
三顿饭一顿吃两碗；
两顿饭一顿吃三碗。
In winter, I passed by his house again with others, and he was there. It was half an hour ago, and he was already cooking. I said, "Cooking so early?" Others said, "He eats two meals in winter." He stewed the small rice and said: eat two bowls of three meals at a time; Eat three bowls of two meals at a time.算来算去一边儿多，
就是少抓一遍儿锅。[2]
There are too many sides, It's just to grab the pot less. [2]人们告诉过我，这人说话从来就是这样，张口就押韵。我活到这么大，还没有遇见过一个说话全部押韵的人。莫里哀喜剧里的汝尔丹说了四十年散文，此人说了六十年韵文！
People have told me that this man has always spoken like this, rhyming when he opens his mouth. I have never met a person who rhymes with all his words in my life. Jourdan in Molière's comedy spoke prose for forty years, and this man spoke rhyme for sixty years!他的韵押得还很精巧。不是一韵到底，是转韵的。而且很复杂。除了两个“碗”字互押，“多”与“锅”押；“一边儿”、“一遍儿”也是相押的。节奏也很灵活，不是像快板或是戏曲，倒像是口语化的新诗。他说话还有个特点，很形象。结构方法也和一般人不一样。
His rhyme is still very exquisite. It is not a rhyme to the end, it is a rhyme. And it is very complicated. In addition to the two words "bowl", "more" and "pot" are rhymed together; "one side" and "once" are also rhymed together. The rhythm is also very flexible, not like allegro or opera, but like colloquial new poetry. He also has a characteristic of speaking, which is very vivid. The structure method is also different from ordinary people.这个人并不爱滑稽逗乐，平常连话也不多，就是说起话来就押韵，真怪！
四、乡下的阿基米德
This person doesn't like to be funny, and he usually doesn't even talk much, but he rhymes when he speaks, which is really strange! 4. Archimedes in the countryside阿基米德，古希腊学者。生于叙拉古。曾发现杠杆定律和阿基米德定律，确定许多物体的表面积和体积的计算方法，并设计了多种机械和建筑物。罗马进犯叙拉古时，他应用机械技术来帮助防御，城破时被害。
Archimedes, ancient Greek scholar. Born in Syracuse. He discovered the law of leverage and Archimedes' law, determined the calculation method of the surface area and volume of many objects, and designed a variety of machinery and buildings. When Rome invaded Syracuse, he applied mechanical technology to help defend, and was killed when the city was breached.——《辞海》
——"Cihai"此人可以说是其貌不扬。长脸，很长。鼻子下面的人中也特别的长。他有两个特点。一个是脾气好。多会也没见他和人红过脸嚷嚷过。不论是开会，是私底下，他总是慢条斯理的说话，脸上带着笑，眯缝着眼，有一点结巴，不厉害。他不是随风倒的人，凡事自有主见。但是表达的方式很含蓄，很简短。对某人的行为不以为然，只是说：“看看！——这人！”对某种意见不同意，只是说：“嗯！——说的！”因此得了个外号：老蔫。另一个特点是：内秀。
This person can be said to be unattractive. Long face, very long. The person under the nose is also particularly long. He has two characteristics. One is good-tempered. I haven't seen him blushing and shouting with people for a long time. Whether in meetings or in private, he always speaks slowly, with a smile on his face, squinting his eyes, and a little stuttering. He is not a person who falls with the wind, he has his own opinions on everything. But the way he expressed it was very subtle and brief. Disagree with someone's behavior, just say: "Look! ——This person!" Disagree with a certain opinion, just say: "Hmm! ——That's right!" Hence the nickname: Old Wilt. Another feature is: inner show.他是这个农业科学研究所的老工人了。主要工作是管理马铃薯试验田。但这只是相对固定。哪里需要人，他就被调去。大田、果园、菜园都干过。粉房的师傅请假回家探亲，他去漏几天粉。酒厂的师傅病了，他去烧两锅。过年杀猪，那是他的活。骡马得了小病，不用送兽医院，他会扎针。他是个好木匠，能开料，能算工。什么地方开农具革新展览会，所里总是派他去。回来后，不用图纸，两三天内，他就能照样鼓捣出几件。
He is an old worker at this Institute of Agricultural Sciences. His main job is to manage the potato experimental field. But this is only relatively fixed. Wherever people are needed, he is transferred. He has worked in fields, orchards, and vegetable gardens. The master of the powder room took leave to visit relatives, and he went to leak powder for a few days. The master of the winery was sick, so he went to burn two pots. Killing pigs for the New Year is his job. Mules and horses have minor illnesses, and they don't need to be sent to the veterinary hospital, they will prick needles. He is a good carpenter, can cut materials, and can calculate work. Wherever there is an agricultural tool innovation exhibition, the institute always sends him there. After coming back, he can still make a few pieces within two or three days without drawings.他有一对好耳朵，一个好记性。不论什么乐器，凡是他见过的，他都能摆弄，甭管是横的，竖的，吹的，拉的，弹的。他不识谱，一般的曲子，他听两遍，就能背下来。所里有个李技师，业余爱拉小提琴。这玩意工人们没有见过，给它起了个名儿，叫“歪脖拉”。他很爱这洋乐器，常常到李技师屋里去看他拉，听他拉。有一次李技师被所长请去研究问题。回来时听见有人在他屋下拉他常拉的练习曲。心想：这是谁呀？推门一看，是他！李技师当时目瞪口呆了半天。
He has a good ear and a good memory. No matter what instrument he has ever seen, he can fiddle with it, whether horizontal, vertical, blown, pulled, or played. He doesn't know music, and he can memorize ordinary songs by listening to them twice. There is a technician Li in the institute, who loves to play the violin in his spare time. The workers had never seen this thing, so they gave it a name, called "Crooked Neck La". He loved this foreign instrument very much, and often went to Technician Li's house to see him play and listen to him play. Once Technician Li was invited by the director to study the problem. When he came back, he heard someone playing the etude he often played under his house. I thought: Who is this? I pushed the door and saw that it was him! Technician Li was stunned for a long time.为了旱涝保收，所里决定冬天打井。没有人会。派他到公社打井队住了一个星期，回来，支起架子就开工了。两个冬天，打出了八口井。再打两口，就完成了计划。打井不能打打停停，因此得三班倒。为了提高效率，搞了竞赛，逐日公布各班进度。在手的这口井已经打穿了沙层，打到石层了，一两天就能出水了。井筒、油毡都已经准备好，净等着敲锣打鼓报喜了。打到石层，可就费劲了。一班出不了多少活。夜班的带班的是个干部。他搞了点物质刺激，说是拿下多少进度，他买五包牡丹烟请客。这一下，哥儿几个玩了命，而且违反了操作规程，该起锥时不起锥，该灌泥浆时不灌，一个劲地把井锥往下砸。——一下把个井锥夹住了，起不出来了。全班十二个棒小伙子鼓楸了多半夜，人人汗透了棉袄，这井锥像是生了根，动都不动，他娘的！
In order to protect the harvest from drought and flooding, the institute decided to drill wells in winter. No one will. He was sent to the commune well drilling team for a week, and when he came back, he set up a rack and started work. In two winters, eight wells were drilled. Two more wells were drilled, and the plan was completed. Drilling wells cannot be stopped, so they have to work in three shifts. In order to improve efficiency, a competition was held to announce the progress of each shift day by day. The well in hand has penetrated the sand layer and hit the stone layer, and the water can be released in a day or two. The wellbore and linoleum are ready, just waiting for the gongs and drums to announce the good news. When it reaches the stone layer, it will be difficult. There is not much work in one shift. The night shift leader is a cadre. He did some material stimulation, saying how much progress he had won, and he bought five packs of peony cigarettes to entertain guests. This time, the brothers played with their lives, and violated the operating procedures, not cone when it should be raised, not poured when it should be filled with mud, and smashed the well cone down. ——I clamped a well cone and couldn't get it out. The twelve stick boys in the class played for more than half the night, everyone was sweating through their padded jackets, and the well cone seemed to have taken root, and it didn't move, damn it!天亮了，全所的干部、工人轮流来看过，出了很多主意，全都不解决问题，锥还是一动不动。大家都很丧气。得！费了半个月，四百四十个工，还扔了一个崭新的火箭锥，这口井报废了。
When dawn broke, the cadres and workers of the whole institute took turns to come to see it, and came up with many ideas, but none of them solved the problem, and the cone remained motionless. Everyone was very dejected. Get! It took half a month, 440 labor, and a brand new rocket cone was thrown, and the well was scrapped.老蔫来看了看，围着井转了几圈，坐下来愣了半天神。后晌，他找了几个工人，扛来三十来根杉篙，一大捆粗铁丝。先在井架四角立了四根柱子，然后把杉篙横一根竖一根用铁丝绑紧，一头绑在锥杆上，一头坠了一块千数来斤重的大石头。都弄完了，天已经擦黑了。他拍拍手，对几个伙计说：“走！吃饭！饿了！”工人们走来，看看这个奇形怪状的杉木架子，都纳闷：“这是闹啥咧？”我也来看了看，心里有点明白。凭我那点物理学常识，我知道这是一套相当复杂的杠杆。
Lao Wei came to see it, circled around the well a few times, sat down and was stunned for a long time. After a while, he found a few workers and carried about 30 fir poles and a large bundle of thick iron wire. First, four pillars were erected at the four corners of the derrick, and then the fir poles were tied horizontally and vertically, one was tied to the cone rod, and a large stone weighing thousands of pounds fell at the other. It's all done, and it's already dark. He clapped his hands and said to a few guys: "Let's go! Dine! I'm hungry!" The workers came over and looked at the bizarre fir shelf, and they all wondered: "What's going on?" I also came to see it, and I understood a little. With my little knowledge of physics, I know it's a pretty complex set of levers.天刚刚亮，一个工人起来解手，大声嚷嚷起来：“嗨！起来啦！井锥起来啦！”
老蔫来看看，没有说什么话。还跟平常一样，扛着铁锨下地，脸上笑眯眯的。
Just as dawn broke, a worker got up and shouted: "Hi! Get up! The well cone is up!" ” Lao Wei came to take a look and didn't say anything. As usual, he carried the shovel to the ground with a smile on his face.按说，他够当一个劳模。几年来的评选会上，工人们都提了他。但是领导不同意。原因很简单：他不是党员。
五、俩老头
It is said that he is enough to be a model worker. At the selection meeting for several years, the workers mentioned him. But the leader disagreed. The reason is simple: he is not a party member. 5. Two old men郭老头、耿老头，俩老头。这两个老头，从前面看，像五十岁；从后面看像三十岁，他们今年都已经做过七十整寿了。身体真好！郭老头能吃饭。斤半烙饼卷成一卷，攥在手里，蘸一点汁，几口就下去了。他这辈子没有牙疼过。耿老头能喝酒。他拿了茶碗上供销社去打酒，一手接酒，一手交钱。售货员找了钱给他，他亮着个空碗：“酒呢？”售货员有点恍惚：记得是打给他了呀？——售货员低头数钱的功夫，二两酒已经进了他的肚了。俩老头非常“要好”，——这地方的方言，“要好”是爱干净爱整齐的意思。不论什么时候，上唇的胡子平斩乌黑，下巴的胡子刮得溜光。浑身的衣服，袖子是袖子，领子是领子，一个纽扣也不短。俩老头还都爱穿撒鞋，斜十字实纳帮，皮梁、薄底，是托人在北京步云斋买的。这种鞋过去是专门卖给抬轿的轿夫穿的，后来拉包月车的车夫也爱穿，抱脚，精神！俩老头焦不离孟，孟不离焦。年下办年货，一起去；四月十八奶奶庙庙会，一起去；开会，一起到场；送人情出份子，一起进门。生产队有事找他们，队长总是说：“去！找找俩老头！”“俩老头”不是“两个老头”的意思，是说他们特别亲密的关系。类似“哥俩”、“姐俩”。按说应该叫他们“老头俩”，不过没有这么说话的，所以人们只能叫他们“俩老头”。
Old man Guo, old man Geng, two old men. These two old men, looking like fifty years old from the front; looking like thirty years old from the back, they have all celebrated their seventies this year. I'm in good health! Old man Guo can eat. Roll the pancakes into a roll, hold them in your hand, dip them in a little juice, and go down in a few bites. He has never had a toothache in his life. Old man Geng can drink. He took the tea bowl to the supply and marketing cooperative to make wine, received the wine with one hand and paid the money with the other. The salesman found money for him, and he lit an empty bowl: "Where's the wine?" The salesman was a little in a trance: Do you remember calling him? ——The salesman lowered his head and counted the money, and two taels of wine had already entered his stomach. The two old men are very "good",—— the dialect of this place, "good" means to love cleanliness and tidyness. No matter when, the beard on the upper lip is flat and black, and the beard on the chin is shaved off. The clothes all over the body, the sleeves are sleeves, the collar is the collar, and a button is not short. The two old men also love to wear scattered shoes, diagonal crosses, leather beams, and thin soles, which were bought by people in Beijing Buyunzhai. In the past, this kind of shoes were specially sold to the bearers of the sedan chairs, and later the coachmen who pulled the lunar cart also loved to wear them, hugging their feet, and being energetic! The two old men are not separated from Meng, and Meng is not out of focus. New Year's goods at the end of the year, go together; April 18th, go to the temple fair of grandma; hold a meeting, and be there together; Send favors and enter the door together. When the production team came to them for something, the captain always said: "Go! Find two old men!" "Two old men" does not mean "two old men", it means that they have a very close relationship. Similar to "brothers" and "sisters". It is said that they should be called "old men", but they don't speak like that, so people can only call them "two old men".两个老头现在都是生产队的技术顾问。郭老头精通瓜菜，也懂大田；耿老头精通大田，也懂瓜菜。
两个人的身世可不一样。
The two old men are now technical consultants to the production team. Old man Guo is proficient in melons and vegetables, and also understands the fields; Old man Geng is proficient in the fields and understands melons and vegetables. The life experience of the two people is different.我第一次遇见郭老头是在一个卖老豆腐的小饭铺里。他坐在我对面，我对他看了又看，总觉得他脸上有点什么地方和别人不大一样。他看着我，知道我心里琢磨什么，搭了碴：“耳朵”。可不是！他的耳朵没有耳轮。“你拿牙咬咬！”那可不行，哪能咬人的耳朵呢！“那你用手撕撕！”我也没有撕，倒真用手指头捏了捏：他的耳朵是棒硬的！——“这是摔跤的褡膊磨出来的。”
The first time I met Old Man Guo was in a small restaurant selling old tofu. He was sitting across from me, and I looked at him again and again, always feeling that there was something on his face that was not very different from others. He looked at me, knew what I was thinking in my heart, and put on ballast: "ears". Isn't! His ears have no earrings. "You bite with your teeth!" That's not good, how can you bite people's ears! "Then you tear it with your hands!" I didn't tear it either, but really pinched it with my fingers: his ears are hard! ——"This is the wrestling arm. ”他告诉我，他不是此地人，是北京人，——他说的是一口地道北京话。安定门外住家，就在桥根底下。种一片小菜园子，自种自卖。从小爱摔跤。那会摔跤，新手初下场子，对方上来就用褡膊蹭你的耳朵。那会的褡膊都是粗帆布纳的，两下，血就下来了。他的耳朵就这么磨出来了。
He told me that he was not from here, he was from Beijing,—— and he spoke authentic Beijing. The house outside Anding Gate is under the bridge root. Plant a small vegetable garden and grow and sell yourself. I have loved wrestling since I was a child. When you are a novice and you just get off the field, the other party will rub your ears with his arms. The arms of that meeting were all made of thick canvas, and after two strokes, the blood came down. His ears were ground out like this.怎么会到这里来了呢？那年大旱，河净井干。种菜没水哪行呀？逃荒吧。逃到张家口，人地两生。怎么吃饭呢？就撂了地摔跤。不是表演，是陪人摔。那会有那么一帮阔公子，学了一招两式，喜欢下场显示显示。他陪着摔，摔完了人家给钱。这在阔公子们叫做“耗财买脸”。他说：“不能摔着他，还不能让他摔着了。让他摔着了，倒了牌子；摔着他，那哪成呀！——这跤摔的！”混了两年，觉得陪着人家“耗财买脸”，太没意思了！遇到一个熟人，在这里落了户，他也就搬了过来。一晃，四十年了。
How did you come here? That year there was a severe drought, and the river was clean and the well was dry. How can you grow vegetables without water? Flee the famine. Escape to Zhangjiakou, two lives. How to eat? Just wrestled on the ground. It's not a performance, it's a wrestling with others. There will be a group of young men who have learned a trick and two styles, and they like to show their ends. He wrestled with him, and after the fall, people gave him money. This is called "spending money to buy face" among the young masters. He said: "You can't throw him, and you can't let him fall. Let him fall, pour the sign; if you fall him, how can it be! ——This fall! After two years of mixing, I feel that it is too boring to accompany others to "spend money to buy face"! I met an acquaintance and settled here, and he moved over. In a flash, it's been forty years.我有一天傍晚从城里回来，那天是八月中秋，远远听见大队的大谷仓里有个小姑娘唱《五哥放羊》。真是好嗓子，又甜，又脆，又亮。哪来这么个小姑娘呀？去看看！走进门，是耿老头！
I came back from the city one evening, it was the Mid-Autumn Festival in August, and I heard a little girl singing "Fifth Brother Herding Sheep" in the big barn of the brigade from a distance. What a good voice, sweet, crisp, and bright. Where did such a little girl come from? Go and take a look! When I walked in the door, it was Old Man Geng!耿老头唱过二人台。艺名骆驼旦。“骆驼”和“旦”怎么能联在一起呢？再说，他哪儿也不像骆驼呀？既不驼背，也不是庞然大物，——他是个瘦瘦小小的身材，本地人所谓“三料个子”，据说年轻的扮相俊着呢。也许他小名叫个骆驼。这一点我到现在还没弄清楚。他这个“旦”是半业余的。逢年过节，成个小班子，七八个人，赶集趁庙，火红几天。平常还是在家种地。
Old man Geng sang a two-person stage. Stage name Camel Dan. How can "camel" and "dan" be connected? Besides, he doesn't look like a camel anywhere? Neither hunchbacked nor behemoth,—— he is a thin and small figure, the locals call him a "three-material man", and it is said that he is young and handsome. Maybe his nickname is a camel. I haven't figured this out yet. His "Dan" is semi-amateur. During the New Year's holidays, a small team, seven or eight people, rushed to the market to take advantage of the temple, and it was popular for a few days. I usually farm at home.俩老头都是在江湖上闯过的人，可是他们在作务庄稼上，都是一把好手。
他们现在不常下地干活了，每天只是到处转转，看看，问问，说说。
The two old men are both people who have broken through the rivers and lakes, but they are both good hands in working and farming. They don't often go to work in the fields now, they just go around every day, look, ask, and talk.俩老头转到一块瓜地。西瓜才窜出苗来，长了几片蓝绿蓝绿的叶子，水灵灵的，好看得很。俩老头围着瓜地转了一圈，咬了一会耳朵，发了话：“把这片瓜都刨了吧，种别的庄稼，种小叶芥菜吧，还能落点猪食。”——“咋啦？”——“你们把瓜籽安得太浅了，这一片瓜秧全都吊死了！”瓜籽安浅了，扎下根，够不着下面的底肥，长不大，这叫“吊死”。“看你俩说的！青苗绿叶的，就能吊死啦！你们的眼睛能看穿了沙层土板啦！真是神了！不信！”——“不信？不信，看吧！”过了两天，蓝绿蓝绿的瓜叶果然全都黄了，蔫了。刨开来看看，果然，吊死了！
The two old men turned to a melon field. The watermelon just came out of the seedlings, and a few blue, green and blue-green leaves grew, which were watery and beautiful. The two old men circled around the melon field, bit their ears for a while, and said: "Plane all this melon, plant other crops, plant small-leaved mustard, and you can also put some pig food." ——"What's wrong?" "——"You put the melon seeds too shallowly, and all the melon seedlings are hanged!" "The melon seeds are shallow, take root, can't reach the bottom fertilizer below, and don't grow big, this is called "hanging". "Look at what you two said! If the seedlings are green and leafy, you can hang yourself! Your eyes can see through the sand and soil! It's really a god! Unbelief! ——"Don't believe it? If you don't believe it, look!" After two days, the blue, green and blue-green melon leaves were all yellow and wilted. Dig it open and take a look, and sure enough, it was hanged!也许因为俩老头闯过江湖，他们不怕官。
Maybe because the two old men have broken through the rivers and lakes, they are not afraid of officials.“大跃进”那年月，市里下来一个书记，到大队蹲点。在预报产量的会上，他要求一再加码。有人害怕，有人拍马，产量高得不像个话。耿老头说：“这是种庄稼？是起哄哪？你们当官的，起了哄，一走！俺们秋后咋办呢？拿什么往上交，拿什么吃呀？”书记有点恼火，说：“你这是秋后算账派。”郭老头说：“秋后算账派有什么不好呀？就是要秋后算账嘛！秋后算账比春前瞎闹强！”胳膊拧不过大腿，产量还是按照书记要求的天文数字报上去了。措施呢？主要是密植。小麦试验田一亩下了二百斤麦种！高粱、玉米、谷子，一律缩小株行距，下种超过往年三倍。郭老头、耿老头坚决不同意，书记下不来台，又不能拍桌子，气得他说：“啊呀！你就做一次社会主义的冒失鬼行不行？”
In the year of the "Great Leap Forward", a secretary came down from the city and went to the brigade to squat. At the meeting to forecast the yield, he repeatedly asked for an increase. Some people are afraid, some people pat the horse, and the yield is too high to say. Old man Geng said: "This is growing crops? Where is it coaxing? You officials, coax, go! What should we do after autumn? What do you take to hand in and what to eat?" The secretary was a little annoyed and said, "You are a post-autumn settler." Old man Guo said: "What's wrong with settling accounts after autumn? It's just to settle accounts after autumn! Settle accounts after autumn is better than fooling around before spring!" "I couldn't twist my thigh, and the yield was still reported according to the astronomical figures required by the secretary. What about the measures? Mainly dense planting. Two hundred pounds of wheat seeds were planted per acre in the wheat test field! Sorghum, corn, and millet were all reduced to reduce the row spacing and plant more than three times as much as in previous years. Old man Guo and old man Geng resolutely disagreed, and the secretary couldn't come down to the stage, nor could he slap the table, so angry that he said: "Ah! Can you be a socialist daredevil once?" ”到了锄地时，俩老头拿着小锄，下地干起活来。他们把谷子地过密的小苗全给锄掉了。锄一棵，骂一句：“去你娘的！”——锄一棵，骂一句：“去你娘的！”队长知道了，赶紧来拦住：“啊呀！你们这是干啥呢！这是反领导呀！”俩老头一起说：“怕啥！他打不了我反革命！”
When they arrived at the hoe, the two old men took the small hoe and went to the field to work. They hoed all the seedlings that were too dense in the millet field. Hoe one and scold: "Fuck you!" - Hoe one and scold: "Fuck your mother!" The captain found out and quickly came to stop him: "Ah! What are you doing! This is an anti-leader!" The two old men said together: "What are you afraid of! He can't beat me against the revolution!" ”秋后，大田全部减产，有的地根本没有秀穗，只能割了喂老牛。只有俩老头锄过的地获得了大丰收。
After autumn, the production of all the fields was reduced, and some of the land had no spikes at all, so they could only be cut and fed to the old cows. Only the land hoeed by the two old men had a bumper harvest.在市里召开的丰产经验交流会上，俩老头当了代表，发了言，题目是：《要当老实庄稼人，不当社会主义的冒失鬼》。主持会议的就是来蹲过点的那位书记。书记致过开幕词，郭老头头一个发言，头一句话就是：“×书记叫俺们做社会主义冒失鬼……”
At the abundant experience exchange meeting held in the city, the two old men became representatives and made speeches, entitled: "To be an honest farmer, not a socialist daredevil". The person who presided over the meeting was the secretary who came to squat a point. The secretary gave an opening speech, and the first sentence of the old man Guo was: "Secretary × told us to be socialist daredevils......俩老头后来一见这位书记，当面就叫他“社会主义的冒失鬼”。书记一点办法没有。看来他这顶“冒失鬼”的帽子得戴几年。
一九八〇年一月五日写成
五月廿九日修改
When the two old men later saw the secretary, they called him a "socialist daredevil" in person. The secretary had no way at all. It seems that his "daredevil" hat will have to be worn for several years. Written on January 5, 1980 Revised on May 29

[2] 此地方言，把锅烧热了做饭，叫做“抓”。

黄油烙饼

黄油烙饼[1]
[1] This article was originally published in Beijing Literature and Art, No. 9, 1980; First received "Selected Short Stories of Wang Zengqi", Beijing Publishing House, February 1982. [2] In this dialect, heating a pot and cooking is called "catching". Butter pancakes[1]萧胜跟着爸爸到口外去。
Xiao Sheng followed his father out of the mouth.萧胜满七岁，进八岁了。他这些年一直跟着奶奶过。他爸的工作一直不固定。一会儿修水库啦，一会儿大炼钢铁啦。他妈也是调来调去。奶奶一个人在家乡，说是冷清得很。他三岁那年，就被送回老家来了。他在家乡吃了好些萝卜白菜，小米面饼子，玉米面饼子，长高了。
Xiao Sheng is seven years old and has entered eight. He has been following his grandmother all these years. His father's job has been irregular. Build a reservoir for a while, and make steel a lot later. His mother also moved around. Grandma was alone in her hometown, and she said it was very deserted. When he was three years old, he was sent back to his hometown. He ate a lot of radishes and cabbage, millet flour cakes, cornmeal cakes in his hometown, and grew taller.奶奶不怎么管他。奶奶有事。她老是找出一些零碎料子给他接衣裳，接褂子，接裤子，接棉袄，接棉裤。他的衣服都是接成一道一道的，一道青，一道蓝。倒是挺干净的。奶奶还给他做鞋。自己打袼褙，剪样子，纳底子，自己绱。奶奶老是说：“你的脚上有牙，有嘴？”“你的脚是铁打的！”再就是给他做吃的。小米面饼子，玉米面饼子，萝卜白菜——炒鸡蛋，熬小鱼。他整天在外面玩。奶奶把饭做得了，就在门口嚷：“胜儿！回来吃饭咧！——”
Grandma doesn't care much about him. Grandma has something to do. She always finds some bits and pieces to pick up clothes, coats, pants, jackets, and pants for him. His clothes are all made one by one, one green and one blue. It's quite clean. Grandma also made shoes for him. Make your own coat, cut your look, put on the bottom, and tie it yourself. Grandma always said: "You have teeth on your feet and a mouth?" "Your feet are made of iron!" Then I made food for him. Millet flour cakes, cornmeal cakes, radish cabbage - scrambled eggs, boiled fish. He played outside all day. Grandma finished the meal and shouted at the door: "Sheng'er! Come back for dinner!" ——”后来办了食堂。奶奶把家里的两口锅交上去，从食堂里打饭回来吃。真不赖！白面馒头，大烙饼，卤虾酱炒豆腐，闷茄子，猪头肉！食堂的大师傅穿着白衣服，戴着白帽子，在蒸笼的白蒙蒙的热气中晃来晃去，拿铲子敲着锅边，还大声嚷叫。人也胖了，猪也肥了。真不赖！
Later, a canteen was set up. Grandma handed over the two pots at home and came back from the canteen to eat. It's not bad! White noodle steamed buns, big pancakes, fried tofu with marinated shrimp paste, stuffed eggplant, pig's head meat! The master of the canteen was wearing white clothes and a white hat, dangling in the white heat of the steamer, tapping the edge of the pot with a shovel, and shouting loudly. People are fat, and pigs are fat. It's not bad!后来就不行了。还是小米面饼子，玉米面饼子。
Then it won't work. Or millet flour cakes, cornmeal cakes.后来小米面饼子里有糠，玉米面饼子里有玉米核磨出的碴子，拉嗓子。人也瘦了，猪也瘦了。往年，撵个猪可费劲哪。今年，一伸手就把猪后腿攥住了。挺大一个克郎，一挤它，咕咚就倒了。掺假的饼子不好吃，可是萧胜还是吃得挺香。他饿。
Later, there was bran in the millet flour cake, and there was ballast from corn kernels in the cornmeal cake, which pulled the throat. People have lost weight, and so have pigs. In previous years, it was difficult to catch a pig. This year, he stretched out his hand and grabbed the pig's hind legs. It's quite a klang, and as soon as you squeeze it, it collapses. The adulterated cakes are not delicious, but Xiao Sheng still eats them very deliciously. He was hungry.奶奶吃得不香。她从食堂打回饭来，掰半块饼子，嚼半天。其余的，都归了萧胜。
Grandma didn't eat well. She came back from the cafeteria, broke half a cake, and chewed it for a long time. The rest belonged to Xiao Sheng.奶奶的身体原来就不好。她有个气喘的病。每年冬天都犯。白天还好，晚上难熬。萧胜躺在炕上，听奶奶喝喽喝喽地喘。睡醒了，还听她喝喽喝喽。他想，奶奶喝喽了一夜。可是奶奶还是喝喽着起来了，喝喽着给他到食堂去打早饭，打掺了假的小米饼子，玉米饼子。
Grandma's health turned out to be bad. She has asthma. Every winter. It's okay during the day, but hard at night. Xiao Sheng lay on the kang and listened to his grandmother drinking and panting. When I woke up, I heard her drinking. He thought, grandma drank all night.
