The red sorghum cakes in the cafeteria are getting worse and worse because they are mixed with bran. The beet leaf soup is also getting worse and worse because there is no oil at all. He hates this kind of red sorghum cake mixed with chaff, and he hates this beet leaf soup without oil! He still goes around to play and run around.大队食堂外面忽然热闹起来。起先是拉了一牛车的羊砖来。他问爸爸这是什么，爸爸说：“羊砖。”——“羊砖是啥？”——“羊粪压紧了，切成一块一块。”——“干啥用？”——“烧。”——“这能烧吗？”——“好烧着呢！火顶旺。”后来盘了个大灶。后来杀了十来只羊。萧胜就站在旁边看杀羊。他还没有见过杀羊。嘿，一点血都流不到外面，完完整整就把一张羊皮剥下来了！
The outside of the brigade canteen suddenly became lively. At first, a sheep brick from an ox cart was pulled. He asked his father what it was, and his father said, "Sheep brick." "——"What is a sheep brick?" "——" Sheep manure was pressed tightly and cut into pieces. "——"What is it for? "——" Burning. "——"Can this be burned?" "——"It's so burning! The fire is booming." "Later, a big stove was set up. Later, more than ten sheep were killed. Xiao Sheng stood next to him and watched the sheep being killed. He has never seen a sheep killed. Hey, no blood flowed outside, and a sheepskin was completely peeled off!这是要干啥呢？
爸爸说，要开三级干部会。
“啥叫三级干部会？”
“等你长大了就知道了！”
三级干部会就是三级干部吃饭。
What is this for? Dad said that he would hold a three-level cadre meeting. "What is a three-level cadre meeting?" "You'll know when you grow up!" The third-level cadres will eat at the third-level cadres.大队原来有两个食堂，南食堂，北食堂，当中隔一个院子，院子里还搭了个小棚，下雨天也可以两个食堂来回串。原来“社员”们分在两个食堂吃饭。开三级干部会，就都挤到北食堂来。南食堂空出来给开会干部用。
The brigade originally had two canteens, the south canteen and the north canteen, separated by a yard, and a small shed was built in the yard, and the two canteens could also go back and forth on rainy days. It turned out that the "members" ate in two canteens. When the three-level cadre meeting was held, they all crowded into the north canteen. The south canteen was vacated for the cadres at the meeting.三级干部会开了三天，吃了三天饭。头一天中午，羊肉口蘑臊子蘸莜面。第二天炖肉大米饭。第三天，黄油烙饼。晚饭倒是马马虎虎的。
The third-level cadre meeting was held for three days and ate for three days. At noon on the first day, mutton mushrooms dipped in noodles. The second day stewed meat and rice. On the third day, butter pancakes. Dinner was so-so.“社员”和“干部”同时开饭。社员在北食堂，干部在南食堂。北食堂还是红高粱饼子，甜菜叶子汤。北食堂的人闻到南食堂里飘过来的香味，就说：“羊肉口蘑臊子蘸莜面，好香好香！”“炖肉大米饭，好香好香！”“黄油烙饼，好香好香！”
"Members" and "cadres" eat at the same time. Members are in the north canteen, and cadres are in the south canteen. The north canteen is still red sorghum cakes and beet leaf soup. The people in the north canteen smelled the fragrance floating from the south canteen and said, "Mutton mushroom soup dipped in noodles, so fragrant!" "Stewed meat and rice, so fragrant!" "Butter pancakes, so fragrant!"萧胜每天去打饭，也闻到南食堂的香味。羊肉、米饭，他倒不稀罕；他见过，也吃过。黄油烙饼他连闻都没闻过。是香，闻着这种香味，真想吃一口。
回家，吃着红高粱饼子，他问爸爸：“他们为什么吃黄油烙饼？”
Xiao Sheng goes to eat every day, and he also smells the fragrance of the South Canteen. Lamb and rice are not uncommon to him; he has seen and eaten them. He has never even smelled butter pancakes. It's fragrant, smelling this fragrance, I really want to take a bite. When he got home and ate red sorghum pancakes, he asked his father, "Why do they eat butter pancakes?" ”“他们开会。”
“开会干嘛吃黄油烙饼？”
“他们是干部。”
“干部为啥吃黄油烙饼？”
“哎呀！你问得太多了！吃你的红高粱饼子吧！”
"They have a meeting." "Why are you eating butter pancakes in a meeting?" "They are cadres." "Why do cadres eat butter pancakes?" "Oops! You're asking too much! Eat your red sorghum cakes! ”正在咽着红饼子的萧胜的妈忽然站起来，把缸里的一点白面倒出来，又从柜子里取出一瓶奶奶没有动过的黄油，启开瓶盖，挖了一大块，抓了一把白糖，兑点起子，擀了两张黄油发面饼。抓了一把莜麦秸塞进灶火，烙熟了。黄油烙饼发出香味，和南食堂里的一样。妈把黄油烙饼放在萧胜面前，说：
Xiao Sheng's mother, who was swallowing red cakes, suddenly stood up, poured out a little white noodles from the jar, took out a bottle of butter that grandma hadn't touched from the cabinet, opened the bottle cap, dug a large piece, grabbed a handful of sugar, mixed it with a screwdriver, and rolled out two butter breads. Grabbed a handful of barley straw and stuffed it into the stove fire, and it was cooked. The butter pancakes emit a fragrance, just like the ones in the South Canteen. Mom put the butter pancakes in front of Xiao Sheng and said:“吃吧，儿子，别问了。”
萧胜吃了两口，真好吃。他忽然咧开嘴痛哭起来，高叫了一声：“奶奶！”
妈妈的眼睛里都是泪。
爸爸说：“别哭了，吃吧。”
"Eat, son, don't ask." Xiao Sheng took two bites, it was delicious. He suddenly grinned and cried bitterly, shouting, "Grandma! ” Mom's eyes were full of tears. Dad said, "Don't cry, eat." ”萧胜一边流着一串一串的眼泪，一边吃黄油烙饼。他的眼泪流进了嘴里。黄油烙饼是甜的，眼泪是咸的。
Xiao Sheng ate butter pancakes while shedding strings of tears. His tears flowed into his mouth. Butter pancakes are sweet, and tears are salty.
[1] 本篇原载《新观察》1980年第二期；初收《汪曾祺短篇小说选》，北京出版社，1982年2月，略有改动。

异秉（二）

异秉（二）[1]
王二是这条街的人看着他发达起来的。
[1] This article was originally published in the second issue of "New Observation" in 1980; "Selected Short Stories of Wang Zengqi", Beijing Publishing House, February 1982, with slight changes. Heterogeneity (2){{id_0000}} Wang Er is the people on this street who watched him develop.不知从什么时候起，他就在保全堂药店廊檐下摆一个熏烧摊子。“熏烧”就是卤味。他下午来，上午在家里。
I don't know when he set up a smoked stall under the eaves of the pharmacy of the Baoban Hall. "Fumigation" is braised meat. He came in the afternoon and was at home in the morning.他家在后街濒河的高坡上，四面不挨人家。房子很旧了，碎砖墙，草顶泥地，倒是不仄逼，也很干净，夏天很凉快。一共三间。正中是堂屋，在“天地君亲师”的下面便是一具石磨。一边是厨房，也就是作坊。一边是卧房，住着王二的一家。他上无父母，嫡亲的只有四口人，一个媳妇，一儿一女。这家总是那么安静，从外面听不到什么声音。后街的人家总是吵吵闹闹的。男人揪着头发打老婆，女人拿火叉打孩子，老太婆用菜刀剁着砧板诅咒偷了她的下蛋鸡的贼。王家从来没有这些声音。他们家起得很早。天不亮王二就起来备料，然后就烧煮。他媳妇梳好头就推磨磨豆腐。——王二的熏烧摊每天要卖出很多回卤豆腐干，这豆腐干是自家做的。磨得了豆腐，就帮王二烧火。火光照得她的圆盘脸红红的。（附近的空气里弥漫着王二家飘出的五香味。）后来王二喂了一头小毛驴，她就不用围着磨盘转了，只要把小驴牵上磨，不时往磨眼里倒半碗豆子，注一点水就行了。省出时间，好做针线。一家四口，大裁小剪，很费功夫。两个孩子，大儿子长得像妈，圆乎乎的脸，两个眼睛笑起来一道缝。小女儿像父亲，瘦长脸，眼睛挺大。儿子念了几年私塾，能记账了，就不念了。他一天就是牵了小驴去饮，放它到草地上去打滚。到大了一点，就帮父亲洗料备料做生意，放驴的差事就归了妹妹了。
His house is on a high slope near the river in the back street, and it is not close to anyone on all sides. The house is very old, with broken brick walls and grass roofs and mud floors, but it is not cramped, very clean, and very cool in summer. There are three rooms in total. In the middle is the main house, and under the "Heaven and Earth Lord Teacher" is a stone mill. On one side is the kitchen, which is the workshop. On the other side is the bedroom, where Wang Er's family lives. He has no parents, only four relatives, a daughter-in-law, a son and a daughter. The house is always so quiet that no sound can be heard from outside. The houses in the back street are always noisy. Men beat their wives by the hair, women beat their children with fire forks, and the old woman chops the cutting board with a kitchen knife to curse the thief who stole her laying hens. The Wang family has never had these sounds. Their family gets up very early. Before dawn, Wang Er got up to prepare the ingredients and then cooked. His daughter-in-law combed her hair and grinded the tofu. ——Wang Er's smoked stall sells a lot of marinated dried tofu every day, which is made by himself. If you can grind the tofu, you will help Wang Er light the fire. The fire made her disc blush. (The nearby air was filled with the fragrance of Wang Er's family.) Later, Wang Er fed a little donkey, so she didn't have to go around the grinding disc, just lead the little donkey to the mill, pour half a bowl of beans into the grinding eye from time to time, and pour a little water. Save time and make needlework. A family of four, big cutting and cutting, is very laborious. Two children, the eldest son looks like his mother, with a round face, and his eyes smile and slit. The youngest daughter is like her father, with a slender face and big eyes. My son went to a private school for a few years, and when he could keep accounts, he stopped reading. He took the little donkey to drink one day and let it roll on the grass. When he was a little older, he helped his father wash and prepare materials for business, and the errand of releasing the donkey belonged to his sister.每天下午，在上学的孩子放学，人家淘晚饭米的时候，他就来摆他的摊子。他为什么选中保全堂来摆他的摊子呢？是因为这地点好，东街西街和附近几条巷子到这里都不远；因为保全堂的廊檐宽，柜台到铺门有相当的余地；还是因为这是一家药店，药店到晚上生意就比较清淡，——很少人晚上上药铺抓药的，他摆个摊子碍不着人家的买卖，都说不清。当初还一定是请人向药店的东家说了好话，亲自登门叩谢过的。反正，有年头了。他的摊子的全副“生财”——这地方把做买卖的用具叫做“生财”，就寄放在药店店堂的后面过道里，挨墙放着，上面就是悬在二梁上的赵公元帅的神龛。这些“生财”包括两块长板，两条三条腿的高板凳，以及好几个一面装了玻璃的匣子。他把板凳支好，长板放平，玻璃匣子排开。这些玻璃匣子里装的是黑瓜子、白瓜子、盐炒豌豆、油炸豌豆、兰花豆、五香花生米。长板的一头摆开“熏烧”。“熏烧”除回卤豆腐干之外，主要是牛肉、蒲包肉和猪头肉。这地方一般人家是不大吃牛肉的。吃，也极少红烧、清炖，只是到熏烧摊子去买。这种牛肉是五香加盐煮好，外面染了通红的红曲，一大块一大块的堆在那里。买多少，现切，放在送过来的盘子里，抓一把清蒜，浇一勺辣椒糊。蒲包肉似乎是这个县里特有的。用一个三寸来长直径寸半的蒲包，里面衬上豆腐皮，塞满了加了粉子的碎肉，封了口，拦腰用一道麻绳系紧，成一个葫芦形。煮熟以后，倒出来，也是一个带有蒲包印迹的葫芦。切成片，很香。猪头肉则分门别类的卖，拱嘴、耳朵、脸子，——脸子有个专门名词，叫“大肥”。要什么，切什么。到了上灯以后，王二的生意就到了高潮。只见他拿了刀不停地切，一面还忙着收钱，包油炸的、盐炒的豌豆、瓜子，很少有歇一歇的时候。一直忙到九点多钟，在他的两盏高罩的煤油灯里煤油已经点去了一多半，装熏烧的盘子和装豌豆的匣子都已经见了底的时候，他媳妇给他送饭来了，他才用热水擦一把脸，吃晚饭。吃完晚饭，总还有一些零零星星的生意，他不忙收摊子，就端了一杯热茶，坐到保全堂店堂里的椅子上，听人聊天，一面拿眼睛瞟着他的摊子，见有人走来，就起身切一盘，包两包。他的主顾都是熟人，谁什么时候来，买什么，他心里都是有数的。
Every afternoon, when the children who go to school are out of school and people are looking for dinner rice, he comes to set up his stall. Why did he choose the security hall to set up his stall? Because of the good location, East Street and West Street and several nearby alleys are not far from here; because the eaves of the security hall are wide, there is quite a bit of room from the counter to the shop door; or because this is a pharmacy, the business of the pharmacy is relatively light at night,—— few people go to the pharmacy at night to grab medicine, and he can't tell if he sets up a stall that can't hinder other people's business. At the beginning, he must have asked someone to say good things to the owner of the pharmacy and personally came to thank him. Anyway, it's been a year. The whole set of "wealth" of his stall - this place calls the tools for buying and selling "wealth", and it is stored in the back aisle of the pharmacy, next to the wall, and above is the shrine of Marshal Zhao Yuan hanging on the second beam. These "wealth" include two longboards, two high benches with three legs, and several boxes with glass on one side. He propped up the benches, flattened the boards, and lined up the glass boxes. These glass boxes contain black melon seeds, white melon seeds, fried peas with salt, fried peas, orchid beans, and spiced peanuts. One end of the longboard is set up for "fumigation". In addition to braised dried tofu, "fumigation" is mainly beef, cattail meat and pig's head meat. Most people in this place don't eat much beef. Eat, there are very few braised and stewed, just go to the smoked stall to buy it. This kind of beef is cooked with spices and salt, and the outside is dyed red yeast rice, and large pieces are piled up there. How much to buy, cut it fresh, put it on the plate that was delivered, grab a handful of garlic, and pour a spoonful of chili paste. Pubao meat seems to be unique to this county. Use a cattail bag with a diameter of three inches to an inch and a half, lined with tofu skin, stuffed with minced meat with flour, sealed, and tied with a hemp rope to form a gourd shape. After cooking, pour it out, and it is also a gourd with cattail imprints. Cut into slices, very fragrant. Pig's head meat is sold in different categories, and there is a special term for arching the mouth, ears, face,—— and face, called "big fat". What you want, what you cut. After the lights were turned on, Wang Er's business reached its climax. I saw him taking a knife and cutting non-stop, while still busy collecting money, including fried and salt-fried peas and melon seeds, and rarely took a break. He was busy until more than nine o'clock, when the kerosene had been lit more than half of his two high-cover kerosene lamps, and the smoked plate and the box containing the peas had bottomed out, his daughter-in-law brought him food, and he wiped his face with hot water and had dinner. After dinner, there was always some sporadic business, he was not busy closing the stall, so he brought a cup of hot tea, sat on the chair in the shop hall of the security hall, listened to people chatting, and glanced at his stall with his eyes, and when he saw someone coming, he got up to cut a plate and wrapped two packs. His customers are all acquaintances, and he knows who comes and when and what he buys.这一条街上的店铺、摆摊的，生意如何，彼此都很清楚。近几年，景况都不大好。有几家好一些，但也只是能维持。有的是逐渐地败落下来了。先是货架上的东西越来越空，只出不进，最后就出让“生财”，关门歇业。只有王二的生意却越做越兴旺。他的摊子越摆越大，装炒货的匣子，装熏烧的洋磁盘子，越来越多。每天晚上到了买卖高潮的时候，摊子外面有时会拥着好些人。好天气还好，遇上下雨下雪（下雨下雪买他的东西的比平常更多），叫主顾在当街打伞站着，实在很不过意。于是经人说合，出了租钱，他就把他的摊子搬到隔壁源昌烟店的店堂里去了。
The shops and stalls on this street know each other very well what the business is. In recent years, the situation has not been very good. A few are better, but they can only be maintained. Some are gradually declining. First, the things on the shelves became more and more empty, and they could not get in and out, and finally they sold them to "make money" and closed their doors. Only Wang Er's business is getting bigger and bigger. His stall is getting bigger and bigger, with more and more boxes for fried goods and fumigated disks. Every night when the climax of trading comes, there are sometimes many people outside the stall. The weather is good, but when it rains and snows (more people buy his things than usual when it rains and snows), it is really unpleasant to ask the patron to stand on the street with an umbrella. So after being negotiated and paying the rent, he moved his stall to the shop hall of the Yuanchang tobacco shop next door.源昌烟店是个老字号，专卖旱烟，做门市，也做批发。一边是柜台，一边是刨烟的作坊。这一带抽的旱烟是刨成丝的。刨烟师傅把烟叶子一张一张立着迭在一个特制的木床子上，用皮绳木楔卡紧，两腿夹着床子，用一个刨刃有半尺宽的大刨子刨。烟是黄的。他们都穿了白布套裤。这套裤也都变黄了。下了工，脱了套裤，他们身上也到处是黄的。头发也是黄的。——手艺人都带着他那个行业特有的颜色。染坊师傅的指甲缝里都是蓝的，碾米师傅的眉毛总是白蒙蒙的。原来，源昌号每天有四个师傅、四副床子刨烟。每天总有一些大人孩子站在旁边看。后来减成三个，两个，一个。最后连这一个也辞了。这家的东家就靠卖一点纸烟、火柴、零包的茶叶维持生活，也还卖一点趸来的旱烟、皮丝烟。不知道为什么，原来挺敞亮的店堂变得黑暗了，牌匾上的金字也都无精打采了。那座柜台显得特别的大。大，而空。
Yuanchang Tobacco Shop is a time-honored brand, specializing in dry tobacco, a store, and also a wholesale. On one side is the counter, and on the other side is the tobacco workshop. The dry tobacco smoked in this area is shaved into shreds. The tobacco planer stacked the tobacco leaves one by one on a special wooden bed, clamped them with leather rope wooden wedges, clamped the bed between his legs, and used a large planer with a blade half a foot wide. The smoke is yellow. They all wore white cloth pants. The pants also turned yellow. After work, they took off their pants, and their bodies were yellow everywhere. The hair is also yellow. ——The craftsmen all wear the unique colors of his industry. The nails of the dyeing master are all blue, and the eyebrows of the rice milling master are always white. It turned out that Yuanchang had four masters and four sets of beds every day. There are always some adults and children standing by every day to watch. Later, it was reduced to three, two, one. In the end, even this one quit. The owner of this house makes a living by selling a little cigarettes, matches, and a small package of tea, as well as a little dry tobacco and leather tobacco. I don't know why, the originally bright shop hall has become dark, and the gold letters on the plaque are listless. The counter looks very big. Big, but empty.王二来了，就占了半边店堂，就是原来刨烟师傅刨烟的地方。他的摊子原来在保全堂廊檐是东西向横放着的，迁到源昌，就改成南北向，直放了。所以，已经不能算是一个摊子，而是半个店铺了。他在原有的板子之外增加了一块，摆成一个曲尺形，俨然也就是一个柜台。他所卖的东西的品种也增加了。即以熏烧而论，除了原有的回卤豆腐干、牛肉、猪头肉、蒲包肉之外，春天，卖一种叫做“”的野味，——这是一种候鸟，长嘴长脚，因为是桃花开时来的，不知是哪位文人雅士给它起了一个名称叫“桃花”；卖鹌鹑；入冬以后，他就挂起一个长条形的玻璃镜框，里面用大红蜡笺写了泥金字：“即日起新添美味羊糕五香兔肉”。这地方人没有自己家里做羊肉的，都是从熏烧摊上买。只有一种吃法：带皮白煮，冻实，切片，加青蒜、辣椒糊，还有一把必不可少的胡萝卜丝（据说这是最能解膻气的）。酱油、醋，买回来自己加。兔肉，也像牛肉似的加盐和五香煮，染了通红的红曲。
When Wang Er came, he occupied half of the shop, which was the place where the original tobacco planer shaved the tobacco. His stall was originally placed horizontally in the east-west direction of the eaves of the security hall, but when it was moved to Yuanchang, it was changed to a north-south direction and placed vertically. Therefore, it can no longer be regarded as a stall, but half a store. He added a piece to the original board and arranged it in a curved ruler, just like a counter. The variety of things he sells has also increased. That is, in terms of fumigation, in addition to the original marinated dried tofu, beef, pig's head meat, and cattail meat, in spring, a game called "" is sold,—— This is a migratory bird with a long beak and long legs, because it came when the peach blossoms bloomed, I don't know which literati gave it a name called "Peach Blossom "; selling quails; After winter, he hung a long glass frame, which was written in large red wax paper: "From now on, new delicious sheep cake and spiced rabbit meat will be added". People in this place do not make mutton at home, so they buy it from smoked stalls. There is only one way to eat it: boil it with the skin, freeze it, slice it, add green garlic, chili paste, and a handful of essential shredded carrots (it is said to be the most deodorant). Soy sauce and vinegar, buy it and add it yourself. Rabbit meat, also like beef, is salted and spiced, dyed red yeast rice.这条街上过年时的春联是各式各样的。有的是特制嵌了字号的。比如保全堂，就是由该店拔贡出身的东家拟制的“保我黎民，全登寿域”；有些大字号，比如布店，口气很大，贴的是“生涯宗子贡，贸易效陶朱”，最常见的是“生意兴隆通四海，财源茂盛达三江”；小本经营的买卖的则很谦虚地写出：“生意三春草，财源雨后花”。这末一副春联，用于王二的超摊子准铺子，真是再贴切不过了，虽然王二并没有想到贴这样一副春联，——他也没处贴呀，这铺面的字号还是“源昌”。他的生意真是三春草、雨后花一样的起来了。“起来”最显眼的标志是他把长罩煤油灯撤掉，挂起一盏呼呼作响的汽灯。须知，汽灯这东西只有钱庄、绸缎庄才用，而王二，居然在一个熏烧摊子的上面，挂起来了。这白亮白亮的汽灯，越显得源昌柜台里的一盏煤油灯十分的暗淡了。
There are various Spring Festival couplets during the Chinese New Year on this street. Some are specially embedded with font sizes. For example, the Baoan Hall is the "Protect My Li Min, All Deng Shou Yu" proposed by the owner of the store; Some large fonts, such as cloth shops, have a very large tone, and the post is "Career Zongzi Gong, trade imitates Tao Zhu", the most common is "business is prosperous all over the world, and the wealth is prosperous to the three rivers"; the small business business is very modestly written: "Business is three spring grass, and wealth is flowered after the rain". Although Wang Er didn't expect to post such a pair of Spring Festival couplets,—— he had nowhere to post it, and the font number of this shop was still "Yuanchang". His business is really like spring grass and flowers after the rain. The most conspicuous sign of "getting up" is that he removed the long-cover kerosene lamp and hung up a whirring steam lamp. It should be noted that the steam lamp is only used in the money bank and the silk shop, and Wang Er actually hung it on top of a smoked stall. This bright white steam lamp makes it look very dim that a kerosene lamp in the Yuanchang counter is very dim.王二的发达，是从他的生活也看得出来的。第一，他可以自由地去听书。王二最爱听书。走到街上，在形形色色招贴告示中间，他最注意的是说书的报条。那是三寸宽，四尺来长的一条黄颜色的纸，浓墨写道：“特聘维扬×××先生在×××（茶馆）开讲××（三国、水浒、岳传……）是月×日起风雨无阻”。以前去听书都要经过考虑。一是花钱，二是费时间，更主要的是考虑这于他的身份不大相称：一个卖熏烧的，常常听书，怕人议论。近年来，他觉得可以了，想听就去。小蓬莱、五柳园（这都是说书的茶馆），都去，三国、水浒、岳传，都听。尤其是夏天，天长，穿了竹布的或夏布的长衫，拿了一吊钱，就去了。下午的书一点开书，不到四点钟就“明日请早”了（这里说书的规矩是在说书先生说到预定的地方，留下一个扣子，跑堂的茶房高喝一声“明日请早——！”听客们就纷纷起身散场），这耽误不了他的生意。他一天忙到晚，只有这一段时间得空。第二，过年推牌九，他在下注时不犹豫。王二平常绝不赌钱，只有过年赌五天。过年赌钱不犯禁，家家店铺里都可赌钱。初一起，不做生意，铺门关起来，里面黑洞洞的。保全堂柜台里身，有一个小穿堂，是供神农祖师的地方，上面有个天窗，比较亮堂。拉开神农画像前的一张方桌，哗啦一声，骨牌和骰子就倒出来了。打麻将多是社会地位相近的，推牌九则不论。谁都可以来。保全堂的“同仁”（除了陶先生和陈相公），替人家收房钱的抡元，卖活鱼的疤眼——他曾得外症，治愈后左眼留一大疤，小学生给他起了个外号叫“巴颜喀拉山”，这外号竟传开了，一街人都叫他巴颜喀拉山，虽然有人不知道这是什么意思，——王二。输赢说大不大，说小可也不小。十吊钱推一庄。十吊钱相当于三块洋钱。下注稍大的是一吊钱三三四。一吊钱分三道：三百、三百、四百。七点赢一道，八点赢两道，若是抓到一副九点或是天地杠，庄家赔一吊钱。王二下“三三四”是常事。有时竟会下到五吊钱一注孤丁，把五吊钱稳稳地推出去，心不跳，手不抖。（收房钱的抡元下到五百钱一注时手就抖个不住。）赢得多了，他也能上去推两庄。推牌九这玩意，财越大，气越粗，王二输的时候竟不多。
Wang Er's development can also be seen from his life. First, he is free to listen to books. Wang Er loves to listen to books. Walking on the street, among all kinds of posters and notices, he paid the most attention to the storytelling reports. It was a yellow paper three inches wide and four feet long, and it was written in thick ink: "Mr. Wei Yang××× gave a lecture in ××× (teahouse×× (Three Kingdoms, Water Margin, Yue Chuan...... It is rain or shine from the × of the month." In the past, you had to think about listening to books. One is to spend money, the other is to spend time, and more importantly, it is considered that this is not very commensurate with his status: a smoked and burned man, often listens to books, and is afraid of being talked about. In recent years, he thinks it's okay and can listen if he wants. Xiao Penglai, Wuliuyuan (these are all storytelling teahouses), all go, Three Kingdoms, Water Margin, Yue Chuan, all listen. Especially in summer, the days are long, wearing bamboo cloth or summer cloth robes, taking a hanging of money, and going. The afternoon book opens at one o'clock, and before four o'clock, it is "please come early tomorrow" (the rule of storytelling here is that the storyteller says that when he reaches the predetermined place, he leaves a button, and the tea room in the hall shouts "Please come early tomorrow——! The listeners got up and left), which could not delay his business. He was busy all day long, and only this period of time was free. Second, he did not hesitate to bet on Pai Gow during the New Year. Wang Er usually never gambles, only for five days during the Chinese New Year. Gambling during the New Year is not prohibited, and you can gamble in every store. At the beginning of the new year, if you don't do business, the shop door is closed, and the inside is black. Inside the counter of the security hall, there is a small hall, which is a place for the patriarch of Shennong, and there is a skylight on it, which is relatively bright. Pull open a square table in front of the portrait of Shennong, and with a bang, dominoes and dice are poured out. Most of the people who play mahjong are of similar social status, and it doesn't matter if you push the nine. Anyone can come. The "colleagues" of the security hall (except for Mr. Tao and Chen Xianggong), who collect money for the house for others, the scar eye of selling live fish - he once had an external disease, and after healing, he left a large scar on his left eye, and the primary school student gave him a nickname called "Bayan Karashan", which spread, and people on the street called him Bayan Karashan, although some people don't know what this means,—— Wang Er. Winning or losing is not big, but it is not small. Ten hanging money pushes a bank. Ten hanging money is equivalent to three foreign coins. The bet is slightly larger than one hanging money, three three or four. There are three ways to hang money: three hundred, three hundred, and four hundred. Seven o'clock wins one, eight o'clock wins two, if you catch a pair of nine points or heaven and earth bars, the dealer will lose a hanging money. It is common for Wang Er to play "three, three, four". Sometimes he will go down to five hanging coins and one bet, and push out the five hanging money steadily, without beating his heart and shaking his hands. (The money collected from the house money goes down to five hundred yuan, and the hand can't shake.) If he wins more, he can also go up and push the two banks. Pushing Pai Gow, the bigger the money, the thicker the anger, and Wang Er doesn't lose much.王二把他的买卖乔迁到隔壁源昌去了，但是每天九点以后他一定还是端了一杯茶到保全堂店堂里来坐个点把钟。儿子大了，晚上再来的零星生意，他一个人就可以应付了。
且说保全堂。
Wang Er moved his business to Yuanchang next door, but after nine o'clock every day, he must still bring a cup of tea to the security hall to sit for a while. When his son is older, he can handle the sporadic business that comes at night by himself. Let's talk about the preservation hall.这是一家门面不大的药店。不知为什么，这药店的东家用人，不用本地人，从上到下，从管事的到挑水的，一律是淮城人。他们每年有一个月的假期，轮流回家，去干传宗接代的事。其余十一个月，都住在店里。他们的老婆就守十一个月的寡。药店的“同仁”，一律称为“先生”。先生里分为几等。一等的是“管事”，即经理。当了管事就是终身职务，很少听说过有东家把管事辞了的。除非老管事病故，才会延聘一位新管事。当了管事，就有“身股”，或称“人股”，到了年底可以按股分红。因此，他对生意是兢兢业业，忠心耿耿的。东家从不到店，管事负责一切。他照例一个人单独睡在神农像后面的一间屋子里，名叫“后柜”。总账、银钱，贵重的药材如犀角、羚羊、麝香，都锁在这间屋子里，钥匙在他身上，——人参、鹿茸不算什么贵重东西。吃饭的时候，管事总是坐在横头末席，以示代表东家奉陪诸位先生。熬到“管事”能有几人？全城一共才有那么几家药店。保全堂的管事姓卢。二等的叫“刀上”，管切药和“跌”丸药。药店每天都有很多药要切。“饮片”切得整齐不整齐，漂亮不漂亮，直接影响生意好坏。内行人一看，就知道这药是什么人切出来的。“刀上”是个技术人员，薪金最高，在店中地位也最尊。吃饭时他照例坐在上首的二席，——除了有客，头席总是虚着的。逢年过节，药王生日（药王不是神农氏，却是孙思邈），有酒，管事的举杯，必得“刀上”先喝一口，大家才喝。保全堂的“刀上”是全县头一把刀，他要是闹脾气辞职，马上就有别家抢着请他去。好在此人虽有点高傲，有点倔，却轻易不发脾气。他姓许。其余的都叫“同事”。那读法却有点特别，重音在“同”字上。他们的职务就是抓药，写账。“同事”是没有什么了不起的，每年都有被辞退的可能。辞退时“管事”并不说话，只是在腊月有一桌辞年酒，算是东家向“同仁”道一年的辛苦，只要是把哪位“同事”请到上席去，该“同事”就二话不说，客客气气地卷起铺盖另谋高就。当然，事前就从旁漏出一点风声的，并不当真是打一闷棍。该辞退“同事”在八月节后就有预感。有的早就和别家谈好，很潇洒地走了；有的则请人斡旋，留一年再看。后一种，总要作一点“检讨”，下一点“保证”。“回炉的烧饼不香”，辞而不去，面上无光，身价就低了。保全堂的陶先生，就已经有三次要被请到上席了。他咳嗽痰喘，人也不精明。终于没有坐上席，一则是同行店伙纷纷来说情；辞了他，他上谁家去呢？谁家会要这样一个痰篓子呢？这岂非绝了他的生计？二则，他还有一点好处，即不回家。他四十多岁了，却没有传宗接代的任务，因为他没有娶过亲。这样，陶先生就只有更加勤勉，更加谨慎了。每逢他的喘病发作时，有人问：“陶先生，你这两天又不大好吧？”他就一面喘嗽着一面说：“啊不，很好，很（呼噜呼噜）好！”
This is a small pharmacy. For some reason, the owners of this pharmacy, not locals, from top to bottom, from stewards to water carriers, are all from Huaicheng. They have a month off every year, taking turns going home to do the work of passing on the lineage. The remaining eleven months live in the store. Their wives are widowed for eleven months. The "colleagues" of the pharmacy are all called "Mr. "Sir". Mr. is divided into several levels. The first class is the "steward", that is, the manager. Being a steward is a lifelong position, and I have rarely heard of an owner resigning from the steward. Unless the old steward dies of illness, a new steward will be hired. When you become a steward, you have "body shares", or "human shares", and you can pay dividends according to shares at the end of the year. Therefore, he is conscientious and loyal to business. The owner never comes to the store, and the steward is responsible for everything. He slept alone in a room behind the statue of Shennong as usual, called the "back cabinet". The general ledger, silver coins, and valuable medicinal materials such as rhinoceros horn, antelope, and musk are all locked in this room, and the key is on him,—— ginseng and deer antler are not valuable things. When eating, the steward always sits at the end of the table to show that he represents the owner to accompany the gentlemen. How many people can survive to the "steward"? There are only a few pharmacies in the city. The steward of the security hall is surnamed Lu. The second-class is called "on the knife", which is responsible for cutting medicine and "falling" pills. There are many medicines to cut in pharmacies every day. Whether the "decoction pieces" are cut neatly or not, whether they are beautiful or not, directly affects the quality of business. Insiders can tell who cut this medicine at a glance. "On the knife" is a technician with the highest salary and the most respected status in the store. During meals, he sat at the top two seats as usual,—— except for guests, the first seat was always empty. During the New Year's holidays, the birthday of the medicine king (the medicine king is not Shennong, but Sun Simiao), there is wine, and the steward raises a glass, and he must take a sip "on the knife" first, and everyone will drink it. The "knife" of the security hall is the first knife in the county, and if he resigns in a tantrum, someone else will immediately rush to invite him. Fortunately, although this person is a little arrogant and a little stubborn, he does not lose his temper easily. His surname is Xu. The rest are called "colleagues". The reading is a bit special, with an emphasis on the word "same". Their job is to catch medicine and write accounts. There is nothing great about "colleagues", and they can be fired every year. When dismissed, the "steward" did not speak, but there was a table of resignation wine in the twelfth lunar month, which was regarded as the owner telling the "colleagues" about a year's hard work. Of course, those who leaked a little rumor from the side in advance are not really slapped up. The "colleagues" who should be dismissed have a premonition after the August Festival. Some have already negotiated with other families and left very chicly; some ask someone to mediate and stay for a year before looking at it. The latter always requires a little "review" and a little "guarantee". "The sesame cakes that return to the oven are not fragrant", he resigned, his face was dull, and his worth was low. Mr. Tao of the security hall has been invited to the table three times. He coughs and wheezes, and people are not shrewd. Finally, he didn't sit at the table, and one was that the fellow shopkeepers interceded one after another; If he quit him, who would he go to? Who would want such a phlegm basket? Isn't this ruining his livelihood? Second, he has another advantage, that is, he does not go home. He is in his forties, but he has no task of passing on the family line, because he has not married. In this way, Mr. Tao can only be more diligent and cautious. Whenever he had an asthma attack, someone asked, "Mr. Tao, how have you been these past two days?" He said while panting, "Ah no, it's good, it's very good!" ”以上，是“先生”一级。“先生”以下，是学生意的。药店管学生意的却有一个奇怪称呼，叫做“相公”。
因此，这药店除煮饭挑水的之外，实有四等人：“管事”、“刀上”、“同事”、“相公”。
The above is the first level of "Mr. "Sir". Below "Mr.", it is the meaning of the student. The pharmacy manages the student but has a strange name, called "Xianggong". Therefore, in addition to those who cook and carry water, this pharmacy actually has four people: "steward", "knife", "colleague", and "husband".保全堂的几位“相公”都已经过了三年零一节，满师走了。现有的“相公”姓陈。
陈相公脑袋大大的，眼睛圆圆的，嘴唇厚厚的，说话声气粗粗的——呜噜呜噜地说不清楚。
Several "Xianggong" in the security hall have passed three years and one section, and the full division has left. The existing "Xianggong" is surnamed Chen. Chen Xianggong has a big head, round eyes, thick lips, and a coarse voice - whining and not being able to explain clearly.他一天的生活如下：起得比谁都早。起来就把“先生”们的尿壶都倒了涮干净控在厕所里。扫地。擦桌椅、擦柜台。到处掸土。开门。这地方的店铺大都是“铺闼子门”，——一列宽可一尺的厚厚的门板嵌在门框和门槛的槽子里。陈相公就一块一块卸出来，按“东一”、“东二”、“东三”、“东四”，“西一”、“西二”、“西三”、“西四”次序，靠墙竖好。晒药，收药。太阳出来时，把许先生切好的“饮片”、“跌”好的丸药，——都放在匾筛里，用头顶着，爬上梯子，到屋顶的晒台上放好；傍晚时再收下来。这是他一天最快乐的时候。他可以登高四望。看得见许多店铺和人家的房顶，都是黑黑的。看得见远处的绿树，绿树后面缓缓移动的帆。看得见鸽子，看得见飘动摇摆的风筝。到了七月，傍晚，还可以看巧云。七月的云多变幻，当地叫做“巧云”。那是真好看呀：灰的、白的、黄的、橘红的，镶着金边，一会一个样，像狮子的，像老虎的，像马、像狗的。此时的陈相公，真是古人所说的“心旷神怡”。其余的时候，就很刻板枯燥了。碾药。两脚踏着木板，在一个船形的铁碾槽子里碾。倘若碾的是胡椒，就要不停地打嚏喷。裁纸。用一个大弯刀，把一沓一沓的白粉连纸裁成大小不等的方块，包药用。刷印包装纸。他每天还有两项例行的公事。上午，要搓很多抽水烟用的纸枚子。把装铜钱的钱板翻过来，用“表心纸”一根一根地搓。保全堂没有人抽水烟，但不知什么道理每天都要搓许多纸枚子，谁来都可取几根，这已经成了一种“传统”。下午，擦灯罩。药店里里外外，要用十来盏煤油灯。所有灯罩，每天都要擦一遍。晚上，摊膏药。从上灯起，直到王二过店堂里来闲坐，他一直都在摊膏药。到十点多钟，把先生们的尿壶都放到他们的床下，该吹灭的灯都吹灭了，上了门，他就可以准备睡觉了。先生们都睡在后面的厢屋里，陈相公睡在店堂里。把铺板一放，铺盖摊开，这就是他一个人的天地了。临睡前他总要背两篇《汤头歌诀》，——药店的先生总要懂一点医道。小户人家有病不求医，到药店来说明病状，先生们随口就要说出：“吃一剂小柴胡汤吧”，“服三服藿香正气丸”，“上一点七厘散”。有时，坐在被窝里想一会家，想想他的多年守寡的母亲，想想他家房门背后的一张贴了多年的麒麟送子的年画。想不一会，困了，把脑袋放倒，立刻就响起了很大的鼾声。
His life is as follows: Get up earlier than anyone else. When he got up, he poured out the urinals of the "gentlemen" and put them in the toilet. Sweeping. Wipe tables and chairs, wipe counters. Dust everywhere. Open the door. Most of the shops in this place are "doors",—— a row of thick door panels about a foot wide are embedded in the slots of the door frame and threshold. Chen Xianggong unloaded them one by one, and erected them against the wall in the order of "East One", "East Two", "East Three", "East Four", "West One", "West Two", "West Three", and "West Four". Drying medicine and collecting medicine. When the sun comes out, put Mr. Xu's cut "decoction pieces" and "dropped" pills,—— in a plaque sieve, hold them on your head, climb up the ladder, and put them on the sundeck on the roof; take them away in the evening. This is the happiest time of his day. He can climb high and look around. You can see many shops and roofs, all black. You can see the green trees in the distance, and the sails slowly moving behind the green trees. You can see pigeons and swaying kites. In July, in the evening, you can still see Qiaoyun. The clouds in July are changeable, and the local area is called "Qiaoyun". That's really beautiful: gray, white, yellow, orange-red, inlaid with gold edges, like lions, tigers, horses, and dogs. At this time, Chen Xianggong is really what the ancients called "cheerful". The rest of the time, it is very rigid and boring. Grinding medicine. Step on the wooden board with both feet and grind in a boat-shaped iron milling trough. If you grind pepper, you have to keep sneezing. Cut paper. Use a large scimitar to cut stacks of white powder and paper into squares of different sizes for medicinal purposes. Brush and print wrapping paper. He also has two routine errands a day. In the morning, he has to rub a lot of paper for smoking hookahs. Turn over the money plate containing the copper coins and rub them one by one with the "heart paper". No one smokes hookah in the security hall, but for some reason, many pieces of paper are rubbed every day, and anyone who comes can take a few, which has become a "tradition". In the afternoon, wipe the lampshade. The pharmacy uses about a dozen kerosene lamps inside and out. All lampshades must be wiped every day. In the evening, spread the plaster. From the time the lamp was turned on until Wang Er came to sit idly in the shop, he was spreading the plaster all the time. At more than ten o'clock, the gentlemen's urinals were put under their beds, the lights that should be blown out were blown out, and when he went to the door, he was ready to go to bed. The gentlemen slept in the back room, and Chen Xianggong slept in the shop. Put the paving board and spread the cover, this is his world alone. Before going to bed, he always has to memorize two "Soup Songs",—— the gentleman in the pharmacy always has to understand a little medical way. When a small family is sick and does not seek medical treatment, they go to the pharmacy to explain the condition, and the gentlemen casually say: "Take a dose of Xiao Chai Hu Soup", "Take three doses of Huoxiang Zhengqi Pills", "Go to one point and seven cents". Sometimes, sitting in bed and thinking about home for a while, thinking about his mother who has been widowed for many years, thinking about a New Year's painting of a qilin sending a son behind the door of his house for many years. After thinking about it for a while, I was sleepy, put my head down, and immediately heard a loud snoring.陈相公已经学了一年多生意了。他已经给赵公元帅和神农爷烧了三十次香。初一、十五，都要给这二位烧香，这照例是陈相公的事。赵公元帅手执金鞭，身骑黑虎，两旁有一副八寸长的小对联：“手执金鞭驱宝至，身骑黑虎送财来”。神农爷虬髯披发，赤身露体，腰里围着一圈很大的树叶，手指甲、脚指甲都很长，一只手捏着一棵灵芝草，坐在一块石头上。陈相公对这二位看得很熟，烧香的时候很虔敬。
Chen Xianggong has been studying business for more than a year. He has burned incense for Marshal Zhao and Shennong thirty times. On the first and fifteenth days of the new year, incense must be burned for these two, which is Chen Xianggong's business as usual. Marshal Zhao held a golden whip in his hand and rode a black tiger, with a pair of small eight-inch-long couplets on both sides: "Holding a golden whip to drive treasures, riding a black tiger to send wealth." Shennong Ye had a beard and hair, naked, a circle of large leaves around his waist, long fingernails and toenails, and one hand pinched a Ganoderma lucidum grass and sat on a stone. Chen Xianggong was very familiar with these two and was very reverent when burning incense.陈相公老是挨打。学生意没有不挨打的，陈相公挨打的次数也似稍多了一点。挨打的原因大都是因为做错了事：纸裁歪了，灯罩擦破了。这孩子也好像不大聪明，记性不好，做事迟钝。打他的多是卢先生。卢先生不是暴脾气，打他是为他好，要他成人。有一次可挨了大打。他收药，下梯一脚踩空了，把一匾筛泽泻翻到了阴沟里。这回打他的是许先生。他用一根闩门的木棍没头没脸的把他痛打了一顿，打得这孩子哇哇地乱叫：“哎呀！哎呀！我下回不了！下回不了！哎呀！哎呀！我错了！哎呀！哎呀！”谁也不能去劝，因为知道许先生的脾气，越劝越打得凶，何况他这回的错是不小。后来还是煮饭的老朱来劝住了。这老朱来得比谁都早，人又出名的忠诚梗直。他从来没有正经吃过一顿饭，都是把大家吃剩的残汤剩水泡一点锅巴吃。因此，一店人都对他很敬畏。他一把夺过许先生手里的门闩，说了一句话：“他也是人生父母养的！”
Chen Xianggong is always beaten. The student did not mean not to be beaten, and Chen Xianggong seemed to be beaten a little more. Most of the reasons for being beaten were because of doing something wrong: the paper was crooked, and the lampshade was scratched. This child also doesn't seem to be very smart, has a bad memory, and is slow to do things. Most of the people who beat him were Mr. Lu. Mr. Lu was not a violent temper, he beat him for his own good, and he wanted him to be an adult. Once he was beaten. He collected the medicine, stepped on the air when he went down the stairs, and poured a plaque into the gutter. This time it was Mr. Xu who hit him. He beat him headlessly and shamelessly with a wooden stick that latched the door, causing the child to scream: "Oh! Ah! I can't go back next time! I can't go back next time! Ah! Ah! I was wrong! Ah! Ah! No one can persuade him, because he knows Mr. Xu's temper, and the more he persuades him, the more fierce he becomes, not to mention that his mistake this time is not small. Later, Lao Zhu, who was still cooking, came to persuade him. This Lao Zhu came earlier than anyone else, and he was famous for his loyalty and straightforwardness. He has never had a serious meal, and he has soaked the leftover soup and leftovers from everyone's food in a pot. Therefore, everyone in the shop was in awe of him. He snatched the door latch from Mr. Xu's hand and said, "He was also raised by his parents!" ”陈相公挨了打，当时没敢哭。到了晚上，上了门，一个人呜呜地哭了半天。他向他远在故乡的母亲说：“妈妈，我又挨打了！妈妈，不要紧的，再挨两年打，我就能养活你老人家了！”
Chen Xianggong was beaten and didn't dare to cry at that time. At night, when he came to the door, he cried alone for a long time. He said to his mother in his hometown: "Mom, I'm beaten again! Mom, it doesn't matter, if you get beaten for another two years, I will be able to support your old man!" ”王二每天到保全堂店堂里来，是因为这里热闹。别的店铺到九点多钟，就没有什么人，往往只有一个管事在算账，一个学徒在打盹。保全堂正是高朋满座的时候。这些先生都是无家可归的光棍，这时都聚集到店堂里来。还有几个常客，收房钱的抡元，卖活鱼的巴颜喀拉山，给人家熬鸦片烟的老炳，还有一个张汉。这张汉是对门万顺酱园连家的一个亲戚兼食客，全名是张汉轩，大家却都叫他张汉。此人有七十岁了，长得活脱像一个伏尔泰，一个尖尖的鼻子。他年轻时在外地做过幕，走过很多地方，见多识广，什么都知道，是个百事通。比如说抽烟，他就告诉你烟有五种：水、旱、鼻、雅、潮，“雅”是鸦片。“潮”是潮烟，这地方谁也没见过。说喝酒，他就能说出山东黄、状元红、莲花白……说喝茶，他就告诉你狮峰龙井、苏州的碧螺春，云南的“烤茶”是在怎样一个罐里烤的，福建的功夫茶的茶杯比酒盅还小，就是吃了一只炖肘子，也只能喝三杯，这茶太酽了。他熟读《子不语》、《夜雨秋灯录》，能讲许多鬼狐故事。他还知道云南怎样放蛊，湘西怎样赶尸。他还亲眼见到过旱魃、僵尸、狐狸精，有时间，有地点，有鼻子有眼。三教九流，医、卜、星、相，他全知道。他读过《麻衣神相》、《柳庄神相》，会算“奇门遁甲”、“六壬课”、“灵棋经”。他总要到快九点钟时才出现（白天不知道他干什么），他一来，大家精神为之一振，这一晚上就全听他一个人话。他很会讲，起承转合，抑扬顿挫，有声有色。他也像说书先生一样，说到筋节处就停住了，慢慢地抽烟，急得大家一劲地催他：“后来呢？后来呢？”这也是陈相公一天比较快乐的时候。他一边摊着膏药，一边听着。有时，听得太入神了，摊膏药的扦子停留在油纸上，会废掉一张膏药。他一发现，赶紧偷偷塞进口袋里。这时也不会被发现，不会挨打。
Wang Er comes to the security hall every day because it is lively. In other shops, there is no one until more than nine o'clock, often only one steward is settling accounts and an apprentice is taking a nap. The security hall is full of friends. These gentlemen are all homeless bachelors, and they all gather in the store at this time. There are also a few regular customers, the yuan that collects the house money, Bayan Karashan, who sells live fish, Lao Bing, who boils opium smoke for others, and Zhang Han. This Han is a relative and diner of the Wanshun Sauce Garden across the street, his full name is Zhang Hanxuan, but everyone calls him Zhang Han. This man is seventy years old, looks like a Voltaire, with a pointed nose. When he was young, he worked in other places, traveled to many places, was well-informed, knew everything, and was a jack-of-all-trades. For example, when it comes to smoking, he tells you that there are five types of cigarettes: water, drought, nose, elegance, and tide, and "Ya" is opium. "Tide" is tide smoke, and no one has ever seen it in this place. When it comes to drinking, he can tell you Shandong yellow, Zhuangyuan red, and lotus white...... When it comes to drinking tea, he will tell you Shifeng Longjing, Suzhou's Biluochun, Yunnan's "roasted tea" in what kind of jar is roasted, and the teacup of Fujian's kung fu tea is smaller than a wine cup. He is familiar with "Zi Buyu" and "Night Rain Autumn Lantern Record", and can tell many ghost fox stories. He also knows how to release Gu in Yunnan and how to drive corpses in Xiangxi. He has also seen drought demons, zombies, and vixens with his own eyes, with time, place, nose and eyes. He knows all the three teachings and nine streams, medicine, divination, astrology, and physiognomy. He has read "Ma Yi Shen Xiang" and "Liuzhuang Shen Xiang", and can count "Qimen Dunjia", "Liu Ren Class", and "Ling Qi Jing". He always didn't appear until almost nine o'clock (I don't know what he was doing during the day), and as soon as he came, everyone was cheered up, and they all listened to him alone id_0000 that night. He is very good at speaking, starting and changing, intonation and frustration, sound and color. He was also like a storyteller, stopping when he talked about the tendons, smoking slowly, and everyone was so anxious that everyone urged him: "What happened later? What about later?" This is also the time when Chen Xianggong is happier in the day. He listened while spreading the plaster. Sometimes, if you listen too attentively, the skewer that spreads the plaster will stay on the oil paper and scrap a plaster. As soon as he found out, he quickly stuffed it into his pocket. At this time, he will not be discovered or beaten.有一天，张汉谈起人生有命。说朱洪武、沈万山、范丹是同年同月同日同时，都是丑时建生，鸡鸣头遍。但是一声鸡叫，可就命分三等了：抬头朱洪武，低头沈万山，勾一勾就是穷范丹。朱洪武贵为天子，沈万山富甲天下，穷范丹冻饿而死。他又说凡是成大事业，有大作为，兴旺发达的，都有异相，或有特殊的秉赋。汉高祖刘邦，股有七十二黑子，——就是屁股上有七十二颗黑痣，谁有过？明太祖朱元璋，生就是五岳朝天，——两额、两颧、下巴，都突出，状如五岳，谁有过？樊哙能把一个整猪腿生吃下去，燕人张翼德，睡着了也睁着眼睛。就是市井之人，凡有走了一步好运的，也莫不有与众不同之处。必有非常之人，乃成非常之事。大家听了，不禁暗暗点头。
One day, Zhang Han talked about life and fate. It is said that Zhu Hongwu, Shen Wanshan, and Fan Dan were born at the same time in the same year, month, and day. But a rooster crows, but life is divided into three classes: look up at Zhu Hongwu, bow your head to Shen Wanshan, and tick the poor Fan Dan. Zhu Hongwu is the Son of Heaven, Shen Wanshan is the richest in the world, and poor Fan Dan died of freezing and starvation. He also said that all those who have great causes, great achievements, and prosperity have different appearances or special endowments. Liu Bang, the ancestor of the Han Dynasty, had seventy-two black moles on his buttocks,—— who had them? Zhu Yuanzhang, the founder of the Ming Dynasty, was born with five mountains,—— two foreheads, two cheeks, and chin, all protruding, like the five mountains, who has ever had one? Fan Kuai can eat a whole pig's leg raw, and the Yan people Zhang Yide opened his eyes even when he fell asleep. Even the people in the market, anyone who has taken a step of good luck, is also different. There must be extraordinary people, and it will be an extraordinary thing. Everyone listened and couldn't help but nod secretly.张汉猛吸了几口旱烟，忽然话锋一转，向王二道：
“即以王二而论，他这些年飞黄腾达，财源茂盛，也必有其异秉。”
“……？”
"Okay, I'll catch it tonight." "No need to rush, you don't go to the ground tomorrow." "Okay." "From tomorrow, you don't want to work in the fields." “……？”王二不解何为“异秉”。
Zhang Han took a few puffs of dry smoke, and suddenly changed his mind and said to Wang Er: "That is, in terms of Wang Er, he has been prosperous over the years and has abundant financial resources, and he must also have his own unique talents." “……？” Wang Er didn't understand what "Yi Bing" was.“就是与众不同，和别人不一样的地方。你说说，你说说！”
大家也都怂恿王二：“说说！说说！”
王二虽然发了一点财，却随时不忘自己的身份，从不僭越自大，在大家敦促之下，只有很诚恳地欠一欠身说：
"It's what makes you different, different from others. Tell me, tell me! ” Everyone also encouraged Wang Er: "Tell me! Tell me!" ” Although Wang Er made a little rich, he never forgot his identity at any time, never overstepped his arrogance, and under everyone's urging, he only sincerely owed a yawn and said:“我呀，有那么一点：大小解分清。”他怕大家不懂，又解释道：“我解手时，总是先解小手，后解大手。”
张汉一听，拍了一下手，说：“就是说，不是屎尿一起来，难得！”
"I, there is a little bit: the big and small are clear." He was afraid that everyone would not understand, so he explained: "When I solve my hands, I always solve the small hands first, and then the big hands." ” When Zhang Han heard this, he clapped his hands and said, "That is to say, it is rare to come with feces and urine!" ”说着，已经过了十点半了，大家起身道别。该上门了。卢先生向柜台里一看，陈相公不见了，就大声喊：“陈相公！”
喊了几声，没人应声。
Saying that, it was already past half past ten, and everyone got up to say goodbye. It's time to come to the door. Mr. Lu looked into the counter and saw that Mr. Chen was gone, so he shouted loudly: "Mr. Chen!" ” shouted a few times, but no one answered.原来陈相公在厕所里。这是陶先生发现的。他一头走进厕所，发现陈相公已经蹲在那里。本来，这时候都不是他们俩解大手的时候。

受戒

受戒[1]
明海出家已经四年了。
他是十三岁来的。
[1] This article was originally published in the first issue of "Rain Flowers" in 1981, which is a rewrite of an old work with the same title; First received "Selected Short Stories of Wang Zengqi", Beijing Publishing House, February 1982. Ordination{{id_0000}} Minghai has been a monk for four years. He came at the age of thirteen.这个地方的地名有点怪，叫庵赵庄。赵，是因为庄上大都姓赵。叫做庄，可是人家住得很分散，这里两三家，那里两三家。一出门，远远可以看到，走起来得走一会，因为没有大路，都是弯弯曲曲的田埂。庵，是因为有一个庵。庵叫菩提庵，可是大家叫讹了，叫成荸荠庵。连庵里的和尚也这样叫。“宝刹何处？”——“荸荠庵。”庵本来是住尼姑的。“和尚庙”、“尼姑庵”嘛。可是荸荠庵住的是和尚。也许因为荸荠庵不大，大者为庙，小者为庵。
The place name of this place is a bit strange, it is called An Zhao Zhuang. Zhao, because most of the villages are surnamed Zhao. It's called Zhuang, but people live very scattered, two or three here, two or three there. As soon as you go out, you can see from a distance that you have to walk for a while, because there is no road, and it is all winding ridges. The nunnery is because there is a nunnery. The nunnery is called Bodhi Monastery, but everyone calls it a water chestnut monastery. Even the monks in the nunnery are called that. "Where is the treasure temple?" ——"Water chestnut hermitage. "The nunnery originally lived in nuns." Monk temple", "nunnery nunnery". But water chestnut monastery lives in monks. Perhaps because the water chestnut hermitage is not big, the big one is a temple, and the small one is a temple.明海在家叫小明子。他是从小就确定要出家的。他的家乡不叫“出家”，叫“当和尚”。他的家乡出和尚。就像有的地方出劁猪的，有的地方出织席子的，有的地方出箍桶的，有的地方出弹棉花的，有的地方出画匠，有的地方出婊子，他的家乡出和尚。人家弟兄多，就派一个出去当和尚。当和尚也要通过关系，也有帮。这地方的和尚有的走得很远。有到杭州灵隐寺的、上海静安寺的、镇江金山寺的、扬州天宁寺的。一般的就在本县的寺庙。明海家田少，老大、老二、老三，就足够种的了。他是老四。他七岁那年，他当和尚的舅舅回家，他爹、他娘就和舅舅商议，决定叫他当和尚。他当时在旁边，觉得这实在是在情在理，没有理由反对。当和尚有很多好处。一是可以吃现成饭。哪个庙里都是管饭的。二是可以攒钱。只要学会了放瑜伽焰口，拜梁皇忏，可以按例分到辛苦钱。积攒起来，将来还俗娶亲也可以；不想还俗，买几亩田也可以。当和尚也不容易，一要面如朗月，二要声如钟磬，三要聪明记性好。他舅舅给他相了相面，叫他前走几步，后走几步，又叫他喊了一声赶牛打场的号子：“格当嘚——”，说是“明子准能当个好和尚，我包了！”要当和尚，得下点本，——念几年书。哪有不认字的和尚呢！于是明子就开蒙入学，读了《三字经》、《百家姓》、《四言杂字》、《幼学琼林》、《上论、下论》、《上孟、下孟》，每天还写一张仿。村里都夸他字写得好，很黑。
Minghai is called Xiao Mingzi at home. He has been determined to become a monk since he was a child. His hometown is not called "monk", but "being a monk". His hometown produces monks. Just like some places produce pigs, some places produce mats, some places produce hoops and buckets, some places produce cotton, some places produce painters, some places produce bitches, and his hometown produces monks. If there are many brothers, send one out to be a monk. Being a monk also has to be through relationships and help. Some monks in this place have gone far. Some went to Lingyin Temple in Hangzhou, Jing'an Temple in Shanghai, Jinshan Temple in Zhenjiang, and Tianning Temple in Yangzhou. Generally it is a temple in this county. Minghai's family has few fields, and the eldest, second, and third are enough to plant. He is the fourth child. When he was seven years old, his uncle who was a monk came home, and his father and mother discussed with his uncle and decided to make him a monk. He was next to him at the time, and felt that this was really reasonable and there was no reason to object. There are many benefits to being a monk. First, you can eat ready-made meals. Every temple is in charge of food. Second, you can save money. As long as you learn to put on yoga flames and worship Liang Huang, you can get the hard-earned money according to the rules. If you accumulate it, you can marry a commoner in the future; if you don't want to return to the world, you can buy a few acres of land. It is not easy to be a monk, one must have a face like a bright moon, the second must be like a bell and chime, and the third must be smart and have a good memory. His uncle gave him a face-to-face, told him to take a few steps forward and a few steps back, and asked him to shout the number of the cattle to fight: "Gedang-", saying, "Mingzi can definitely be a good monk, I will take care of it!" "If you want to be a monk, you have to study for a few years ,—— a few years. How can there be a monk who doesn't read! So Mingzi enlightened and enrolled, read the "Three Character Classic", "Hundred Family Surnames", "Four Words and Miscellaneous Characters", "Preschool Qionglin", "Shanglun, Xia Lun", "Shangmeng, Xia Meng", and wrote a copy every day. The village praised him for his good writing and very dark.舅舅按照约定的日期又回了家，带了一件他自己穿的和尚领的短衫，叫明子娘改小一点，给明子穿上。明子穿了这件和尚短衫，下身还是在家穿的紫花裤子，赤脚穿了一双新布鞋，跟他爹、他娘磕了一个头，就随舅舅走了。
The uncle went home according to the agreed date, brought a short shirt with a monk's collar that he wore, and asked Mingzi's mother to change it to a little smaller and put it on Mingzi. Mingzi wore this monk's short shirt, the purple flower pants he wore at home, a pair of new cloth shoes barefoot, kowtowed to his father and mother, and left with his uncle.他上学时起了个学名，叫明海。舅舅说，不用改了。于是“明海”就从学名变成了法名。
When he was in school, he had a scientific name, Minghai. My uncle said, no need to change it. So "Minghai" changed from a scientific name to a Dharma name.过了一个湖。好大一个湖！穿过一个县城。县城真热闹：官盐店，税务局，肉铺里挂着成边的猪，一个驴子在磨芝麻，满街都是小磨香油的香味，布店，卖茉莉粉、梳头油的什么斋，卖绒花的，卖丝线的，打把式卖膏药的，吹糖人的，耍蛇的，……他什么都想看看。舅舅一劲地推他：“快走！快走！”
Crossed a lake. What a big lake! Passing through a county seat. The county seat is really lively: the official salt shop, the tax bureau, the butcher shop is hanging with pigs on the edges, a donkey is grinding sesame seeds, the streets are full of the fragrance of small grinding sesame oil, cloth shops, what fasts sell jasmine powder, comb oil and other vegetarians, velvet flowers, silk threads, plasters, sugar blowers, snake tricks,...... 这里的人相信，在流星掉下来的时候在裤带上打一个结，心里想什么好事，就能如愿。
"Ah! I forgot to tie a knot on my trouser belt!" Xiao Yingzi said. People here believe that when a meteor falls, tie a knot on your trouser belt and think of something good in your heart, and you can get your wish.…………
“”荸荠，这是小英子最爱干的生活。秋天过去了，地净场光，荸荠的叶子枯了，——荸荠的笔直的小葱一样的圆叶子里是一格一格的，用手一捋，哔哔地响，小英子最爱捋着玩，——荸荠藏在烂泥里。赤了脚，在凉浸浸滑溜溜的泥里踩着，——哎，一个硬疙瘩！伸手下去，一个红紫红紫的荸荠。她自己爱干这生活，还拉了明子一起去。她老是故意用自己的光脚去踩明子的脚。
"" Water chestnuts, this is Xiao Yingzi's favorite life. Autumn has passed, the ground is clear, the leaves of water chestnuts have withered,—— the straight shallot-like round leaves of water chestnuts are grid by grid, with a touch of hands, beeping, Xiao Yingzi loves to play with ,—— water chestnuts are hidden in the mud. Barefoot, stepping on the cool soaked and slippery mud,——Hey, a hard pimple! Reach out, a red, purple, and purple water chestnut. She loves to do this life herself, and she also took Mingzi with her. She always deliberately used her bare feet to step on Mingzi's feet.她挎着一篮子荸荠回去了，在柔软的田埂上留了一串脚印。明海看着她的脚印，傻了。五个小小的趾头，脚掌平平的，脚跟细细的，脚弓部分缺了一块。明海身上有一种从来没有过的感觉，他觉得心里痒痒的。这一串美丽的脚印把小和尚的心搞乱了。
She went back with a basket of water chestnuts on her back, leaving a string of footprints on the soft ridges. Minghai looked at her footprints and was dumbfounded. Five small toes, the soles of the feet are flat, the heels are thin, and the arch part is missing. Minghai had a feeling he had never felt before, and he felt itchy in his heart. This beautiful string of footprints messed up the little monk's heart.…………
明子常搭赵家的船进城，给庵里买香烛，买油盐。闲时是赵大伯划船；忙时是小英子去，划船的是明子。
Mingzi often took the Zhao family's boat into the city to buy incense candles and oil and salt for the nunnery. In his spare time, Uncle Zhao rows; when he is busy, Xiao Yingzi goes, and Mingzi rows.从庵赵庄到县城，当中要经过一片很大的芦花荡子。芦苇长得密密的，当中一条水路，四边不见人。划到这里，明子总是无端端地觉得心里很紧张，他就使劲地划桨。
小英子喊起来：
From Anzhao Village to the county seat, you have to pass through a large reed swing in the middle. The reeds grew densely, and there was a waterway in the middle, and there were no people on all sides. When he rowed here, Mingzi always felt very nervous for no reason, so he paddled hard. Xiao Yingzi shouted:“明子！明子！你怎么啦？你发疯啦？为什么划得这么快？”
…………
明海到善因寺去受戒。
“你真的要去烧戒疤呀？”
“真的。”
“好好的头皮上烧八个洞，那不疼死啦？”
"Mingzi! Mingzi! What's wrong with you? Are you crazy? Why are you rowing so fast?" ” Minghai went to Shanyin Temple to receive ordination. "Are you really going to burn the scar?" "Really." "If you burn eight holes in your scalp, won't it hurt to death?"“咬咬牙。舅舅说这是当和尚的一大关，总要过的。”
“不受戒不行吗？”
“不受戒的是野和尚。”
“受了戒有啥好处？”
“受了戒就可以到处云游，逢寺挂褡。”
“什么叫‘挂褡’？”
Gritted his teeth. My uncle said that this is a big hurdle to be a monk, and it must be passed. ” "Can't you not be ordained?" "It is the wild monk who is not ordained." "What are the benefits of taking precepts?" "After receiving the precepts, you can travel everywhere and hang up your clothes in the temple." "What is a 'hanging coat'?"“就是在庙里住。有斋就吃。”
“不把钱？”
“不把钱。有法事，还得先尽外来的师父。”
“怪不得都说‘远来的和尚会念经’。就凭头上这几个戒疤？”
“还要有一份戒牒。”
"It is to live in the temple. If there is fasting, eat it. ” "Don't give money?" "Don't give money. If there is a Dharma, you have to do it first. ” "No wonder they all say, 'Monks from afar can chant scriptures'. Just by virtue of these few ring scars on your head? ” "There must also be a warning."“闹半天，受戒就是领一张和尚的合格文凭呀！”
“就是！”
“我划船送你去。”
“好。”
小英子早早就把船划到荸荠庵门前。不知是什么道理，她兴奋得很。她充满了好奇心，想去看看善因寺这座大庙，看看受戒是个啥样子。
Xiao Yingzi rowed the boat to the door of the Water Chestnut Monastery early. I don't know why, she was very excited. She was full of curiosity and wanted to see the big temple of Shanyin Temple and see what it was like to be ordained.善因寺是全县第一大庙，在东门外，面临一条水很深的护城河，三面都是大树，寺在树林子里，远处只能隐隐约约看到一点金碧辉煌的屋顶，不知道有多大。树上到处挂着“谨防恶犬”的牌子。这寺里的狗出名的厉害。平常不大有人进去。放戒期间，任人游看，恶狗都锁起来了。
Shanyin Temple is the largest temple in the county, outside the east gate, facing a very deep moat, surrounded by big trees on three sides, the temple is in the woods, and you can only faintly see a little resplendent roof in the distance, I don't know how big it is. There are signs on the trees that say "Beware of vicious dogs". The dogs in this temple are notoriously powerful. Usually not many people go in. During the precepts, people were allowed to watch, and the vicious dogs were locked.好大一座庙！庙门的门坎比小英子的肐膝都高。迎门矗着两块大牌，一边一块，一块写着斗大两个大字：“放戒”，一块是：“禁止喧哗”。这庙里果然是气象庄严，到了这里谁也不敢大声咳嗽。明海自去报名办事，小英子就到处看看。好家伙，这哼哈二将、四大天王，有三丈多高，都是簇新的，才装修了不久。天井有二亩地大，铺着青石，种着苍松翠柏。“大雄宝殿”，这才真是个“大殿”！一进去，凉嗖嗖的。到处都是金光耀眼。释迦牟尼佛坐在一个莲花座上。单是莲座，就比小英子还高。抬起头来也看不全他的脸，只看到一个微微闭着的嘴唇和胖敦敦的下巴。两边的两根大红蜡烛，一搂多粗。佛像前的大供桌上供着鲜花、绒花、绢花，还有珊瑚树、玉如意、整棵的大象牙。香炉里烧着檀香。小英子出了庙，闻着自己的衣服都是香的。挂了好些幡。这些幡不知是什么缎子的，那么厚重，绣的花真细。这么大一口磬，里头能装五担水！这么大一个木鱼，有一头牛大，漆得通红的。她又去转了转罗汉堂，爬到千佛楼上看了看。真有一千个小佛！她还跟着一些人去看了看藏经楼。藏经楼没有什么看头，都是经书！妈吔！逛了这么一圈，腿都酸了。小英子想起还要给家里打油，替姐姐配丝线，给娘买鞋面布，给自己买两个坠围裙飘带的银蝴蝶，给爹买旱烟，就出庙了。
What a big temple! The threshold of the temple gate is higher than Xiao Yingzi's knees. There are two big signs standing at the door, one on one side and the other with the words "Put the Ring" written on it: "Release the ring", and the other is: "No noise". The weather in this temple is really solemn, and no one dares to cough loudly here. Since Minghai went to sign up for errands, Xiao Yingzi looked around. Good guy, this second general and the four heavenly kings are more than three feet high, all of which are new and have only been renovated for a long time. The courtyard is two acres large, paved with bluestone, and planted with green pines and cypresses. "Daxiong Treasure Hall", this is really a "hall"! As soon as you enter, it was cool. Golden light dazzled everywhere. Shakyamuni Buddha sat on a lotus seat. The rosette alone is taller than Xiao Yingzi. When I raised my head, I couldn't see his face, only a slightly closed lip and a fat chin. The two big red candles on both sides are thick together. The large offering table in front of the Buddha statue is filled with flowers, velvet flowers, silk flowers, as well as coral trees, jade ruyi, and whole elephant tusks. Sandalwood burns in the incense burner. Xiaoyingzi left the temple and smelled that her clothes were incense. Hang many flags. I don't know what kind of satin these flags are, they are so thick, and the embroidered flowers are really fine. Such a big chime can hold five loads of water in it! Such a big wooden fish, the size of a cow, painted red. She went around the Luohan Hall again and climbed to the Thousand Buddha Tower to take a look. There are really a thousand little Buddhas! She also followed some people to see the scripture building. There is nothing to see in the scripture building, it's all scriptures! Mom! After walking around like this, my legs were sore. Xiao Yingzi remembered that she still had to oil the family, match silk thread for her sister, buy upper cloth for her mother, buy two silver butterflies with apron streamers for herself, and buy dry tobacco for her father, and left the temple.等把事情办齐，晌午了。她又到庙里看了看，和尚正在吃粥。好大一个“膳堂”，坐得下八百个和尚。吃粥也有这样多讲究：正面法座上摆着两个锡胆瓶，里面插着红绒花，后面盘膝坐着一个穿了大红满金绣袈裟的和尚，手里拿了戒尺。这戒尺是要打人的。哪个和尚吃粥吃出了声音，他下来就是一戒尺。不过他并不真的打人，只是做个样子。真稀奇，那么多的和尚吃粥，竟然不出一点声音！她看见明子也坐在里面，想跟他打个招呼又不好打。想了想，管他禁止不禁止喧哗，就大声喊了一句：“我走啦！”她看见明子目不斜视地微微点了点头，就不管很多人都朝自己看，大摇大摆地走了。
When things are done, it's noon. She went to the temple again to see that the monk was eating porridge. What a big "dining hall" that can seat 800 monks. There are also so many particularities about eating porridge: there are two tin bottles on the front seat, with red velvet flowers inserted in them, and a monk wearing a bright red and gold embroidered cassock sitting cross-legged behind him, holding a ruler in his hand. This ruler is meant to hit people. Which monk eats porridge and makes a sound, he comes down with a ruler. But he didn't really hit people, he just pretended to be. It's really strange that so many monks eat porridge without making a sound! She saw that Mingzi was also sitting inside, and wanted to say hello to him, but it was not easy to fight. After thinking about it, regardless of whether he forbade the noise or not, he shouted loudly: "I'm leaving!" She saw Akiko nodding slightly without squinting, so she swaggered away regardless of how many people looked at her.第四天一大清早小英子就去看明子。她知道明子受戒是第三天半夜，——烧戒疤是不许人看的。她知道要请老剃头师傅剃头，要剃得横摸顺摸都摸不出头发茬子，要不然一烧，就会“走”了戒，烧成了一片。她知道是用枣泥子先点在头皮上，然后用香头子点着。她知道烧了戒疤就喝一碗蘑菇汤，让它“发”，还不能躺下，要不停地走动，叫做“散戒”。这些都是明子告诉她的。明子是听舅舅说的。
Early in the morning of the fourth day, Xiao Yingzi went to see Mingzi. She knew that Mingzi was ordained in the middle of the night on the third day,—— and the burning scar was not allowed to be seen. She knew that if she had to ask the old shaving master to shave her head, she would not be able to find the hair stubble even if she shaved it horizontally, otherwise she would "leave" the ring and burn into pieces. She knew that she would use jujube mud to light the scalp first, and then light it with incense heads. She knew that after burning the ring scar, she drank a bowl of mushroom soup to let it "hair", and she couldn't lie down, she had to keep walking, which was called "loose precepts". These are all things Mingzi told her. Mingzi listened to her uncle.她一看，和尚真在那里“散戒”，在城墙根底下的荒地里。一个一个，穿了新海青，光光的头皮上都有八个黑点子。——这黑疤掉了，才会露出白白的、圆圆的“戒疤”。和尚都笑嘻嘻的，好像很高兴。她一眼就看见了明子。隔着一条护城河，就喊他：
When she saw it, the monk was really "loosening the rings" there, in the wasteland under the base of the city wall. One by one, wearing new sea green, there were eight black dots on the shiny scalp. ——When this black scar falls off, the white and round "ring scar" will be revealed. The monks were all smiling, as if they were very happy. She saw Akiko at a glance. Across a moat, he called him:“明子！”
“小英子！”
“你受了戒啦？”
“受了。”
“疼吗？”
“疼。”
“现在还疼吗？”
“现在疼过去了。”
“你哪天回去？”
“后天。”
“上午？下午？”
"Mingzi!" "Little Yingzi!" "Are you ordained?" "Suffer." "Does it hurt?" "It hurts." "Does it still hurt now?" "It hurts now." "When will you go back?" "The day after tomorrow." "Morning? Afternoon? ”“下午。”
“我来接你！”
“好！”
…………
小英子把明海接上船。
"Afternoon." "I'll pick you up!" "Okay!" Xiao Yingzi took Minghai onto the boat.小英子这天穿了一件细白夏布上衣，下边是黑洋纱的裤子，赤脚穿了一双龙须草的细草鞋，头上一边插着一朵栀子花，一边插着一朵石榴花。她看见明子穿了新海青，里面露出短褂子的白领子，就说：“把你那外面的一件脱了，你不热呀！”
Xiaoyingzi wore a thin white summer cloth top that day, black gauze pants underneath, a pair of dragon beard straw sandals barefoot, and a gardenia flower on one side and a pomegranate flower on the other. She saw that Mingzi was wearing a new sea green, and the white collar with a short coat was exposed inside, so she said, "Take off your outer one, you're not hot!" ”他们一人一把桨。小英子在中舱，明子扳艄，在船尾。
她一路问了明子很多话，好像一年没有看见了。
她问，烧戒疤的时候，有人哭吗？喊吗？
明子说，没有人哭。有个山东和尚骂人：
Each of them has an oar. Xiao Yingzi is in the middle cabin, and Mingzi is in the stern of the boat. She asked Akiko a lot of words along the way, as if she hadn't seen her for a year. She asked, when the ring scar was burned, did anyone cry? Shout? Mingzi said, no one cried. A Shandong monk scolded:“俺日你奶奶！俺不烧了！”
她问善因寺的方丈石桥是相貌和声音都很出众吗？
“是的。”

“讲究。什么东西都是绣花的。”
“他屋里很香？”
"My day, your grandma! I won't burn anymore!" ” She asked the abbot of Shanyin Temple, Shiqiao, if he had outstanding appearance and voice? "Yes." "Say that his abbot is more particular than the young lady's embroidery room?" "Particular. Everything is embroidered. ” "His house smells good?"“很香。他烧的是伽楠香，贵得很。”
“听说他会做诗。会画画，会写字？”
“会。庙里走廊两头的砖额上，都刻着他写的大字。”
“他是有个小老婆吗？”
“有一个。”
“才十九岁？”
"It's very fragrant. He burned ganan incense, which was very expensive. ” "I heard that he can write poetry. Can draw, can write? ” "Yes. The bricks at both ends of the corridor in the temple are engraved with the big characters he wrote. ” "Does he have a little wife?" "There is one." "Only nineteen years old?"“听说。”
“好看吗？”
“都说好看。”
“你没看见？”
“我怎么会看见？我关在庙里。”
明子告诉她，善因寺一个老和尚告诉他，寺里有意选他当沙弥尾，不过还没有定，要等主事的和尚商议。
"I heard." "Does it look good?" "They all say it's good-looking." "Didn't you see it?" "How could I see it? I'm locked up in the temple. ” Akiko told her that an old monk from the Zenyin Temple told him that the temple intended to choose him as a novice, but it had not yet been decided, and he had to wait for the monk in charge to discuss.“什么叫‘沙弥尾’？”
“放一堂戒，要选出一个沙弥头，一个沙弥尾。沙弥头要老成，要会念很多经。沙弥尾要年轻，聪明，相貌好。”
“当了沙弥尾跟别的和尚有什么不同？”
"What is 'novice tail'?" "To put a precept, you must choose a novice head and a novice tail. The novice head must be mature and able to recite many scriptures. The novice tail should be young, smart, and good-looking. ” "What is the difference between being a novice tail and other monks?"“沙弥头，沙弥尾，将来都能当方丈。现在的方丈退居了，就当。石桥原来就是沙弥尾。”

“还不一定哪。”
“你当方丈，管善因寺？管这么大一个庙？！”
“还早呐！”
"The head of the novice, the tail of the novice, can be an abbot in the future. The current abbot has retired, just be. The stone bridge turned out to be the tail of the novice. ” "Are you a novice tail?" "Not necessarily." "You are the abbot, in charge of the Good Cause Temple? Take care of such a big temple?! ” "It's still early!"划了一气，小英子说：“你不要当方丈！”
“好，不当。”
“你也不要当沙弥尾！”
“好，不当。”
又划了一气，看见那一片芦花荡子了。
After a stroke, Xiao Yingzi said: "Don't be an abbot!" ” "Okay, no." "Don't be a novice tail either!" "Okay, not right." I took another breath and saw the reed flower prodigal.小英子忽然把桨放下，走到船尾，趴在明子的耳朵旁边，小声地说：
“我给你当老婆，你要不要？”
明子眼睛鼓得大大的。
“你说话呀！”
明子说：“嗯。”
“什么叫‘嗯’呀！要不要，要不要？”
Xiao Yingzi suddenly put down the oar, walked to the stern of the boat, lay down next to Mingzi's ear, and whispered: "I'll be your wife, do you want it?" Mingzi's eyes bulged wide. "You talk!" Akiko said, "Hmm." ” "What do you mean by 'um'! Do you want it, do you want it? ”明子大声地说：“要！”
“你喊什么！”
明子小小声说：“要——！”
“快点划！”
英子跳到中舱，两只桨飞快地划起来，划进了芦花荡。
Akiko said loudly: "Yes! ” "What are you shouting!" Mingzi whispered, "I want to ——! ” "Hurry up and row!" Yingzi jumped to the middle cabin, and the two oars quickly rowed up and rowed into Luhuadang.芦花才吐新穗。紫灰色的芦穗，发着银光，软软的，滑溜溜的，像一串丝线。有的地方结了蒲棒，通红的，像一枝一枝小蜡烛。青浮萍，紫浮萍。长脚蚊子，水蜘蛛。野菱角开着四瓣的小白花。惊起一只青桩（一种水鸟），擦着芦穗，扑鲁鲁鲁飞远了。
The reeds spit out new ears. The purple-gray reed ears glow silvery, soft, slippery, like a string of silk threads. In some places, cattails are tied, bright red, like small candles. Green duckweed, purple duckweed. Long-legged mosquitoes, water spiders. Wild water chestnuts bloom with four-petaled small white flowers. Startled a green stake (a kind of water bird), rubbed the reed ears, and flew away.…………
一九八〇年八月十二日，写四十三年前的一个梦

岁寒三友

岁寒三友[1]
On August 12, 1980, I wrote a dream from forty-three years ago [1] This article was originally published in Beijing Literature, No. 10, 1980; First received "Selected Short Stories of Wang Zengqi", Beijing Publishing House, February 1982. Three friends [1]这三个人是：王瘦吾、陶虎臣、靳彝甫。王瘦吾原先开绒线店，陶虎臣开炮仗店，靳彝甫是个画画的。他们是从小一块长大的。这是三个说上不上，说下不下的人。既不是缙绅先生，也不是引车卖浆者流。他们的日子时好时坏。好的时候桌上有两个菜，一荤一素，还能烫二两酒；坏的时候，喝粥，甚至断炊。三个人的名声倒都是好的。他们都没有做过伤天害理的事，对人从不尖酸刻薄，对地方的公益，从不袖手旁观。某处的桥坍了，要修一修；哪里发现一名“路倒”，要掩埋起来；闹时疫的时候，在码头路口设一口瓷缸，内装药茶，施给来往行人；一场大火之后，请道士打醮禳灾……遇有这一类的事，需要捐款，首事者把捐簿伸到他们的面前时，他们都会提笔写下一个谁看了也会点头的数目。因此，他们走在街上，一街的熟人都跟他们很客气地点头打招呼。
These three people are: Wang Shouwu, Tao Huchen, and Jin Yifu. Wang Shouwu originally opened a velvet thread shop, Tao Huchen opened a firecracker shop, and Jin Yifu was a painter. They grew up together. These are three people who can't talk about it. They are neither gentlemen nor pulp sellers. Their lives are good and bad. When it's good, there are two dishes on the table, one meat and one vegetarian, and you can scald two or two taels of wine; when it's bad, you drink porridge and even stop cooking. The reputation of all three is good. None of them have done anything harmful to nature, they are never bitter to people, and they never stand by for local public welfare.
