Or a jar of Shaoxing flower carvings, or ham, shad, white sand loquat, or a set of exquisite Yixing purple sand tea sets, or two large pots of Jianlan that are thriving. Most of their paintings are freehand, or half-work-and-half-writing. They are impatient to paint gongbi paintings, and they won't.一种是画匠。他们所画的，是神像。画得最多的是“家神菩萨”。这“家神菩萨”是一个大家族：头一层是南海观音的一伙，第二层是玉皇大帝和他的朝臣，第三层是关帝老爷和周仓、关平，最下一层是财神爷。他们也在玻璃的反面用油漆画福禄寿三星（这种画美术史家称之为“玻璃油画”），作插屏。他们是在制造一种商品，不是作画。而且是流水作业，描衣纹的是一个人（照着底子描），“开脸”的是一个人，着色的是另一个人。他们的作坊，叫做“画匠店”。一个画匠店里常有七八个人同时做活，却听不到一点声音，因为画匠多半是哑巴。
One is the painter. What they paint is a statue. The most painted is the "Family God Bodhisattva". This "Family God Bodhisattva" is a big family: the first floor is the group of Guanyin in the South Sea, the second layer is the Jade Emperor and his courtiers, the third layer is Emperor Guan and Zhou Cang and Guan Ping, and the bottom layer is the God of Wealth. They also painted the three stars of Fu Lushou (this kind of painting art historian calls it "glass oil painting") on the reverse side of the glass as an interstitial screen. They are making a commodity, not painting. And it is a flowing operation, one person is tracing the clothes (according to the bottom), one person is "opening the face", and the other is coloring. Their workshop is called the "painter's shop". There are often seven or eight people working at the same time in a painter's shop, but they can't hear a sound, because most of the painters are mute.靳彝甫两者都不是。也可以说是介乎两者之间的那么一种人。比较贴切些，应该称之为“画师”，不过本地无此说法，只是说“画画的”。他是靠卖画吃饭的，但不像画匠店那样在门口设摊或批发给卖门神“欢乐”的纸店[5]，他是等人登门求画的（所以挂“画寓”的招牌）。他的画按尺论价，大青大绿另加，可以点题。来求画的，多半是茶馆酒肆、茶叶店、参行、钱庄的老板或管事。也有那些闲钱不多，送不起重礼，攀不上高门第的画家，又不甘于家里只有四堵素壁的中等人家。他们往往喜欢看着他画，靳彝甫也就欣然对客挥毫。主客双方，都很满意。他的画署名（画匠的作品是从不署名的），但都不题上款，因为不好称呼，深了不是，浅了不是，题了，人家也未必高兴，所以只是简单地写四个字：“彝甫靳铭”。若是佛像，则题“靳铭沐手敬绘”。
Jin Yifu is neither. It can also be said that he is a kind of person in between. It is more appropriate to call him a "painter", but there is no such term in the local area, just "painter". He made a living by selling paintings, but unlike the painter's shop, he set up a stall at the door or wholesaled paper shops that sold the "joy" of the door god [5], he waited for people to come to ask for paintings (so he hung the sign of "Painting Residence"). His paintings are priced according to the ruler, and the big green and green are added, and you can click on the title. Most of the people who come to ask for paintings are the owners or stewards of teahouses, taverns, tea shops, canxing, and banks. There are also painters who don't have much spare money, can't afford to give heavy gifts, and can't climb to a high family, and are not willing to be a middle-aged family with only four plain walls at home. They often like to watch him paint, and Jin Yifu is happy to wave to the guests. Both the host and the guest are very satisfied. His paintings are signed (the painter's works are never signed), but they are not inscribed, because they are not easy to call, they are not deep, not shallow, and people may not be happy if they are asked, so they simply write four words: "Yifu Jin Ming". If it is a Buddha statue, it is inscribed with "Jin Ming Mu Shu Respectful Painting".靳家三代都是画画的。家里积存的画稿很多。因为要投合不同的兴趣，山水、人物、翎毛、花卉，什么都画。工笔、写意、浅绛、重彩不拘。
Three generations of the Jin family have been painting. There are many paintings accumulated at home. Because it is necessary to combine different interests, landscapes, figures, feathers, flowers, everything is painted. Gongbi, freehand, light crimson, heavy color is not restrained.他家家传会写真，都能画行乐图（生活像）和喜神图（遗像）。中国的画像是有诀窍的。画师家都藏有一套历代相传的“百脸图”。把人的头面五官加以分析，定出一百种类型。画时端详着对象，确定属于哪一类，然后在此基础上加减，画出来总是有几分像的。靳彝甫多年不画喜神了。因为画这种像，经常是在死人刚刚断气时，被请了去，在床前对着勾描。他不愿看死人。因此，除了至亲好友，这种活计，一概不应。有来求的，就说不会。行乐图，自从有了照相馆之后，也很少有人来要画了。
His family will take pictures, and he can draw pictures of joy (life portraits) and happy gods (posthumous portraits). Chinese portraits have a trick. Painters have a set of "hundred face pictures" passed down through the ages. Analyze the facial features of a person's head and face to determine a hundred types. When painting, look at the object to determine which category it belongs to, and then add or subtract on this basis. Jin Yifu has not painted a happy god for many years. Because this kind of portrait is often drawn when the dead have just passed away, they are invited to sketch in front of the bed. He doesn't want to look at the dead. Therefore, except for close relatives and friends, this kind of work should not be done. If you come to ask, say no. Since the establishment of the photo studio, few people have come to draw pictures.靳彝甫自己喜欢画的，是青绿山水和工笔人物。青绿山水、工笔人物，一年能收几件呢？因此，除了每年端午，他画几十张各式各样的钟馗，挂在巷口如意楼酒馆标价出售，能够有较多的收入，其余的时候，全家都是半饥半饱。
What Jin Yifu likes to paint is green landscapes and gongbi figures. How many green landscapes and gongbi figures can you receive a year? Therefore, in addition to the Dragon Boat Festival every year, he painted dozens of various Zhong Kui and hung them on the Ruyi Building Tavern at the entrance of the alley to sell them at a price, which could have a lot of income, and the rest of the time, the whole family was half hungry and half full.虽然是半饥半饱，他可是活得有滋有味。他的画室里挂着一块小匾，上书“四时佳兴”。画室前有一个很小的天井。靠墙种了几竿玉屏箫竹。石条上摆着茶花、月季。一个很大的均窑平盘里养着一块玲珑剔透的上水石，蒙了半寸厚的绿苔，长着虎耳草和铁线草。冬天，他总要养几头单瓣的水仙。不到三寸长的碧绿的叶子，开着白玉一样的繁花。春天，放风筝。他会那样耐烦地用一个称金子用的小戥子约着蜈蚣风筝两边脚上的鸡毛（鸡毛分量稍差，蜈蚣上天就会打滚）。夏天，用莲子种出荷花。不大的荷叶，直径三寸的花，下面养了一二分长的小鱼。秋天，养蟋蟀。他家藏有一本托名贾似道撰写的《秋虫谱》。养蟋蟀的泥罐还是他祖父留下来的旧物。每天晚上，他点一个灯笼，到阴城去掏蟋蟀。财神庙的那个侉子，常常一边喝酒、吃狗肉，一边看这位大胆的画师的灯笼走走，停停，忽上，忽下。
Although he was half hungry and half full, he lived a good life. There is a small plaque hanging in his studio with the inscription "Four Seasons of Jiaxing". There is a small patio in front of the studio. A few jade screen bamboo poles are planted against the wall. Camellias and roses are placed on the stone strips. A large flat plate of the kiln has a delicate and transparent water stone, covered with half an inch of green moss, and grows saxifrage and clematis. In winter, he always has to raise a few single-petaled daffodils. The turquoise leaves are less than three inches long and bloom like white jade. In spring, fly a kite. He would patiently use a small bamboo stick called gold to make an appointment with the chicken feathers on both sides of the centipede's feet (if the weight of the chicken feathers is slightly worse, the centipede will roll in the sky). In summer, use lotus seeds to plant flowers. The small lotus leaves, flowers with a diameter of three inches, and small fish that are one or two minutes long are raised below. In autumn, raise crickets. His family has a copy of the "Autumn Insect Genealogy" written by Jia Sidao. The clay pot for raising crickets is still an old thing left by his grandfather. Every night, he lit a lantern and went to Yincheng to dig out crickets. The nephew in the Temple of Wealth often drank and ate dog meat while watching the bold painter's lantern walk, stopping, going up and down.他有一盒爱若性命的东西，是三块田黄石章。这三块田黄都不大，可是跟三块鸡油一样！一块是方的，一块略长，还有一块不成形。数这块不成形的值钱，它有文三桥[6]刻的边款（篆文不知叫一个什么无知的人磨去了）。文三桥呀，可着全中国，你能找出几块？有一次，邻居家失火，他什么也没拿，只抢了这三块图章往外走。吃不饱的时候，只要把这三块图章拿出来看看，他就觉得对这个世界没有什么可抱怨的了。
He has a box of things that he loves like life, which are three pieces of Tian Huang Shizhang. These three pieces of Tian Huang are not big, but they are the same as three pieces of chanterelle! One piece is square, one is slightly longer, and the other is shapeless. Counting the value of this shapeless piece, it has the edge of Wen Sanqiao [6] engraved (I don't know what kind of ignorant person grinded it down). Wen Sanqiao, but all over China, how many can you find? Once, when a neighbor's house caught fire, he didn't take anything, only grabbed the three stamps and walked out. When he couldn't get enough to eat, as long as he took out these three stamps and looked at them, he felt that he had nothing to complain about the world.这一年，这三个人忽然都交了好运。
This year, all three of them suddenly had good luck.王瘦吾的绳厂赚了钱。他可又觉得这个买卖货源、销路都有限，他早就想好了另外一宗生意。这个县北乡高田多种麦，出极好的麦秸，当地农民多以掐草帽辫为副业。每年有外地行商来，以极便宜的价钱收去。稍经加工，就成了草帽，又以高价卖给农民。王瘦吾想：为什么不能就地制成草帽呢？这钱为什么要给外地人赚去呢？主意已定，他就把两台绞绳机盘出去，买了四架扎草帽的机子，请了一个师傅，教出三个徒弟，就在原来绳厂的旧址，办起了一个草帽厂。城里的买卖人都说：王瘦吾这步棋看得准，必赚无疑！草帽厂开张的那天，来道喜和看热闹的人很多。一盘草帽辫，在师傅手里，通过机针一扎，哒哒地响，一会儿功夫，哎，草帽盔出来了！——又一会，草帽边！——成了！一顶一顶草帽，顷刻之间，摞得很高。这不是草帽，这是大洋钱呀！这一天，靳彝甫送来一张“得利图”，画着一个白须的渔翁，背着鱼篓，提着两尾金鳞赤尾的大鲤鱼。凡看了这张画的，无不大笑：这渔翁的长相，活脱就是王瘦吾！陶虎臣特地送来一挂遍地桃花满堂红的一千头的大鞭，砰砰磅磅响了好半天！
Wang Shouwu's rope factory made money. He felt that the source of goods and sales was limited, and he had already thought of another business. In this county, Beixiang Gaotian, there are many varieties of wheat and excellent wheat straw, and most local farmers use straw hat braiding as a side business. Every year, foreign merchants come and collect them at a very cheap price. After a little processing, it becomes a straw hat and sells it to farmers at a high price. Wang Shouwu thought: Why can't straw hats be made on the spot? Why should this money be earned by outsiders? With the idea made, he took out two rope twisting machines, bought four straw hat machines, hired a master, taught three apprentices, and set up a straw hat factory on the site of the original rope factory. The buyers and sellers in the city all said: Wang Shouwu's move is accurate, and he will definitely make money! On the day the straw hat factory opened, there were many people who came to celebrate and watch the excitement. A plate of straw hat braids, in the hands of the master, was pierced through a machine needle, and it clicked, and after a while, hey, the straw hat helmet came out! ——Another moment, the edge of the straw hat! ——It's done! One straw hat after another, in an instant, stacked very high. This is not a straw hat, this is a big foreign money! On this day, Jin Yifu sent a "profit map", depicting a white-bearded fisherman, carrying a fish basket and carrying two big carp with golden scales and red tails. Everyone who looked at this painting laughed: This fisherman's appearance is that of Wang Shouwu! Tao Huchen specially sent a thousand big whips with peach blossoms all over the place, and they rang for a long time!陶虎臣从来没有做过这么大的焰火生意。这一年闹大水。运河平了漕。西北风一起，大浪头翻上来，把河堤上丈把长的青石都卷了起来。看来，非破堤不可。很多人家扎了筏子，预备了大澡盆，天天晚上不敢睡，只等堤决水下来时逃命。不料，河水从下游泻出，伏汛安然度过，保住了无数人畜。秋收在望，市面繁荣，城乡一片喜气。有好事者倡议：今年放放焰火！东西南北四城，都放！一台七套，四七二十八套。陶家独家承做了十四套，——其余的，他匀给别的同行了。
Tao Huchen has never done such a big fireworks business. There was a big flood this year. The canal is flat. With the northwest wind, the big waves rolled up and rolled up the long bluestones on the river embankment. It seems that the embankment must be broken. Many people built rafts and prepared large bathtubs, and did not dare to sleep every night, just waiting for the embankment to break and flee for their lives. Unexpectedly, the river water poured out from downstream, and the flood was safely saved, saving countless people and animals. The autumn harvest is in sight, the market is prosperous, and the urban and rural areas are full of joy. Some good people proposed: set off fireworks this year! The four cities in the east, west, south, north, and south, all are set off! One set of seven, four seven and twenty-eight sets. The Tao family exclusively undertook to make fourteen sets,—— and the rest were given to other peers.四城的焰火错开了日子，——为的是人们可以轮流赶着去看。东城定在七月十五。地点：阴城。
The fireworks in the four cities are staggered so that people can take turns to see them,—— The East City is scheduled for July 15th. Location: Yin City.这天天气特别好。万里无云，一天皓月。阴城的正中，立起一个四丈多高的架子。有人早早吃了晚饭，就扛了板凳来等着了。各种卖小吃的都来了。卖牛肉高粱酒的，卖回卤豆腐干的，卖五香花生米的，芝麻灌香糖的，卖豆腐脑的，卖煮荸荠的，还有卖河鲜——卖紫皮鲜菱角和新剥鸡头米的……到处是“气死风”的四角玻璃灯，到处是白蒙蒙的热气、香喷喷的茴香八角气味。人们寻亲访友，说短道长，来来往往，亲亲热热。阴城的草都被踏倒了。人们的鞋底也叫秋草的浓汁磨得滑溜溜的。
The weather was particularly good that day. Cloudless, a bright moon. In the middle of Yin City, a shelf more than four feet high was erected. Someone had dinner early and came to wait. All kinds of snacks are here. Those who sell beef and sorghum wine, those who sell braised tofu, those who sell spiced peanuts, those who fill sesame with gum, those who sell tofu brain, boiled water chestnuts, and those who sell river fresh - purple-skinned water chestnuts and freshly peeled chicken head rice...... There are four-corner glass lamps everywhere, white heat, and fragrant fennel and star anise. People are looking for relatives and friends, saying that the road is short, coming and going, and making out. The grass in Yincheng has been trampled down. People's soles are also called the thick juice of autumn grass and grind smoothly.忽然，上万双眼睛一齐朝着一个方向看。人们的眼睛一会儿睁大，一会儿眯细；人们的嘴一会儿张开，一会儿又合上；一阵阵叫喊，一阵阵欢笑，一阵阵掌声。——陶虎臣点着了焰火了！
Suddenly, tens of thousands of pairs of eyes looked in one direction together. People's eyes opened wide for a while and squinted for a while; people's mouths opened for a while, and closed again for a while; bursts of shouting, bursts of laughter, bursts of applause. ——Tao Huchen lit fireworks!这种花盒子是有一点简单的故事情节的。最热闹的是“炮打泗州城”。起先是梅、兰、竹、菊四种花，接着是万花齐放。万花齐放之后，有一个间歇，木架子下面黑黑的，有人以为这一套已经放完了。不料一声炮响，花盒子又落下一层，照眼的灯球之中有一座四方的城，眼睛好的还能看见城门上“泗州”两个字（不知道为什么是泗州而不是别的城）。城外向里打炮，城里向外打，灯球飞舞，砰磅有声。最有趣的是“芦蜂追瘌子”，这是一个喜剧性的焰火。一阵火花之后，出现一个人，——一个泥头的纸人，这人是个瘌痢头，手里拿着一把破芭蕉扇。霎时间飞来了许多马蜂，这些马蜂——火花，纷纷扑向瘌痢头，瘌痢头四面躲闪，手里的芭蕉扇不停地挥舞起来。看到这里，满场大笑。这些辛苦得近于麻木的人，是难得这样开怀一笑的呀。最后一套是平平常常的，只是一阵火花之后，扑鲁扑鲁吊下四个大字：“天下太平”。字是灯球组成的。虽然平淡，人们还是舍不得离开。火光炎炎，逐渐消隐，这时才听到人们呼唤：
This kind of flower box has a bit of a simple storyline. The most lively is "bombarding Sizhou City". At first, there were four kinds of flowers: plum, orchid, bamboo, and chrysanthemum, and then there were thousands of flowers. After the flowers bloomed, there was a break, and the wooden shelf was dark, and some people thought that this set had been put out. Unexpectedly, there was a cannon sound, and the flower box fell to the next floor, and there was a square city in the light bulb, and the word "Sizhou" on the city gate with good eyes could also be seen (I don't know why it was Sizhou and not other cities). Cannons are fired outside the city, and the city is outward, and the light balls are flying and banging. The most interesting thing is "Reed Bee Chasing Lepers", which is a comedic firework. After a burst of sparks, a person appeared ,—— a muddy paper man, this person was a leprosy head holding a broken banana fan in his hand. In an instant, many wasps flew in, and these wasps - sparks pounced on the leprosy head, which dodged on all sides, and the banana fan in his hand kept waving. Seeing this, the audience laughed. These people who have worked so hard that they are almost numb are rare to laugh like this. The last set is ordinary, but after a burst of sparks, four big characters are hung: "The world is peaceful". The words are made up of light balls. Although it is flat, people are still reluctant to leave. The fire was blazing and gradually disappeared, and then people were called:“二丫头，回家咧！”
“四儿，你在哪儿哪？”
“奶奶，等等我，我鞋掉了！”
人们摸摸板凳，才知道：呀，露水下来了。
"Second girl, go home!" "Si'er, where are you?" "Grandma, wait for me, my shoes fell off!" People touched the bench and realized: Ah, the dew is coming down.靳彝甫捉到一只蟹壳青蟋蟀。消息很快就传开了。每天有人提了几罐蟋蟀来斗。都不是对手，而且都只是一个回合就分胜负。这只蟹壳青的打法很特别。它轻易不开牙，只是不动声色，稳稳地站着。突然扑上去，一口就咬破对方的肚子（据说蟋蟀的打法各有自己的风格，这种咬肚子的打法是最厉害的）。它瞿瞿地叫起来，上下摆动它的触须，就像戏台上的武生耍翎子。负伤的败将，怎么下“探子”[7]，也再不敢回头。于是有人怂恿他到兴化去。兴化养蟋蟀之风很盛，每年秋天有一个斗蟋蟀的集会。靳彝甫被人们说得心动了。王瘦吾、陶虎臣给他凑了一笔路费和赌本，他就带了几罐蟋蟀，搭船走了。
Jin Yifu caught a crab shell green cricket. The news spread quickly. Someone brought a few cans of crickets to fight every day. None of them are opponents, and they all win or lose in just one round. This crab shell green has a very special way of playing. It doesn't open its teeth easily, but stands quietly and steadily. Suddenly pounced on it and bit the opponent's stomach in one bite (it is said that crickets have their own styles of play, and this style of biting the stomach is the most powerful). It screamed and swayed its tentacles up and down, like a martial artist playing feathers on the stage. The wounded defeated general, how to "spy" [7], never dared to look back. So someone encouraged him to go to Xinghua. Xinghua has a very strong trend of raising crickets, and there is a cricket fighting rally every autumn. Jin Yifu was moved by people's words. Cricket fighting, like wrestling and boxing, first ask about the weight of the athlete. Only when the weight is equal can the game be started. If the weight is lower than the opponent and voluntarily leaves, listen to it.没想到，这只蟋蟀给他赢了四十块钱。——四十块钱相当于一个小学教员两个月的薪水！靳彝甫很高兴，在如意楼定了几个菜，约王瘦吾、陶虎臣来喝酒。

Jin Yifu is back. As soon as he arrived home, when he heard about Tao Huchen, he didn't even wash his face, and went to Tao's house with his feet. Tao Huchen was lying on a broken reed mat, holding a piece of torn cotton wool. Jin Yifu took out five yuan and said, "Huchen, I just came back, I don't have much money with me, you wait for me for a day!" ”跟脚，他又奔王瘦吾家。瘦吾也是家徒四壁了。他正在对着空屋发呆。靳彝甫也掏出五块钱，说：“瘦吾，你等我一天！”
Following his feet, he went to Wang Shouwu's house again. Shouwu is also a family empty. He was in a daze at the empty house. Jin Yifu also took out five yuan and said, "Thin Wu, you wait for me for a day!" ”第三天，靳彝甫约王瘦吾、陶虎臣到如意楼喝酒。他从内衣口袋里掏出两封洋钱，外面裹着红纸。一看就知道，一封是一百。他在两位老友面前，各放了一封。
“先用着。”
“这钱——？”
靳彝甫笑了笑。
On the third day, Jin Yifu invited Wang Shouwu and Tao Huchen to drink at Ruyi Building. He took out two foreign coins from his underwear pocket, wrapped in red paper. At a glance, you can tell that one is a hundred. He put one in front of his two old friends. "Use it first." "This money ——?" Jin Yifu smiled.那两个都明白了：彝甫把三块田黄给季匋民送去了。
靳彝甫端起酒杯说：“咱们今天醉一次。”
那两个同意。
“好，醉一次！”
Those two understood: Yifu sent three pieces of Tianhuang to Ji Kumin. Jin Yifu picked up his wine glass and said, "Let's get drunk today." ” The two agreed. "Okay, get drunk once!"这天是腊月三十。这样的时候，是不会有人上酒馆喝酒的。如意楼空荡荡的，就只有这三个人。
外面，正下着大雪。

寂寞和温暖

寂寞和温暖[1]
[9] The doors of the shops in this place are generally long and narrow door panels, which are placed in the grooves of the thresholds, called "shops". Loneliness and warmth[1]这个女同志在这个农业科学研究所的科研人员当中显得有点特别。她有很多文学书。屠格涅夫的、契诃夫的、梅里美的。都保存得很干净。她的衣着、用物都很素净。白床单、白枕套，连洗脸盆都是白的。她住在一间四白落地的狭长的单身宿舍里，只有一面墙上一个四方块里有一点颜色。那是一个相当精致的画框，里面经常更换画片：列宾的《伏尔加纤夫》、列维坦的风景……
This lesbian is a bit special among the researchers of this Institute of Agricultural Sciences. She has a lot of literary books. Turgenev's, Chekhov's, Merimi's. They are all very well preserved. Her clothes and utensils are very simple. White sheets, white pillowcases, and even the washbasin are all white. She lived in a long, narrow single dormitory with four white floors, with only a little color in a square on one wall. It was a rather delicate frame, in which the pictures were often changed: Repin's "Volga Fiber", Levitan's landscape......她叫沈沅，却不是湖南人。
Her name is Shen Yuan, but she is not from Hunan.她的家乡是福建的一个侨乡。她生在马来西亚的一个滨海的小城里。母亲死得早，她是跟父亲长大的。父亲开机帆船，往来运货，早出晚归。她从小就常常一个人过一天，坐在门外的海滩上，望着海，等着父亲回来。她后来想起父亲，首先想起的是父亲身上很咸的海水气味和他的五个趾头一般齐，几乎是长方形的脚。——常年在海船上生活的人的脚，大都是这样。
Her hometown is an overseas Chinese hometown in Fujian. She was born in a small coastal town in Malaysia. Her mother died early, and she grew up with her father. My father started a sailboat, transported goods back and forth, and left early and returned late. Since she was a child, she often spent a day alone, sitting on the beach outside the door, looking at the sea, waiting for her father to come back. Later, when she thought of her father, the first thing she thought of was that the smell of salty seawater on her father was as level as his five toes, almost rectangular feet. ——Most of the feet of people who live on sea boats all year round are like this.她在南洋读了小学，以后回国来上学。父亲还留在南洋。她从初中到大学，都是在学校的宿舍里度过的。她在国内没有亲人，只有一个舅舅。上初中时，放暑假，她还到舅舅家住一阵。舅舅家很穷。他们家炒什么菜都放虾油。多少年后，她还记得舅舅家自渍的虾油的气味。高中以后，就是寒暑假，也是在学校里过了。一到节假日、星期天，她总是打一盆水洗洗头，然后拿一本小说，一边看小说，一边等风把头发吹干，嘴里咬着一个鲜橄榄。
She went to elementary school in Nanyang and returned to China to go to school. My father still stayed in Nanyang. She spent her time in the school dormitory from junior high school to college. She has no relatives in China, only one uncle. When she was in junior high school, during the summer vacation, she also lived at her uncle's house for a while. My uncle's family is very poor. They put shrimp oil in everything they fry. Many years later, she still remembers the smell of her uncle's self-soaked shrimp oil. After high school, even the winter and summer vacations, I spent it in school. On holidays and Sundays, she always washes her hair with a basin of water, then takes a novel, reads the novel, waits for the wind to dry her hair, and bites a fresh olive in her mouth.她父亲是被贫瘠而狭小的土地抛到海外去的。他没有一寸土，却希望他的家乡人能吃到饱饭。她在高中毕业后，就按照父亲的天真而善良的愿望，考进了北京的农业大学。
Her father was thrown overseas by the barren and small land. He didn't have an inch of land, but he hoped that the people in his hometown could eat as much as they wanted. After graduating from high school, she was admitted to the Agricultural University in Beijing in accordance with her father's innocent and kind wishes.大学毕业，就分配到了这个农业科学研究所。那年她二十五岁。
After graduating from university, she was assigned to this Institute of Agricultural Sciences. She was twenty-five years old that year.二十五岁，过得很平静。既没有生老病死（母亲死的时候，她还不大记事），也没有柴米油盐。她在学习上从来没有感到过吃力，从来没有做过因为考外文、考数学答不出题来而急得浑身出汗的那种梦。
At the age of twenty-five, she lived a very peaceful life. There was neither birth, old age, illness or death (she didn't remember much when her mother died), nor firewood, rice, oil and salt. She never felt difficult in her studies, and she never had the kind of dream that she was sweating because she couldn't answer the questions in foreign languages and mathematics.她长得很高。在学校站队时，从来是女生的第一名。这个所里的女工、女干部，也没有一个她那样高的。
她长得很清秀。
这个所的农业工人有一个风气，爱给干部和科研人员起外号。
She is tall. When standing in line at school, she has always been the first among girls. None of the female workers and cadres in this institute are as tall as her. She is very beautiful. The agricultural workers of this institute have a culture of loving to give nicknames to cadres and scientific researchers.有一个年轻的技术员叫王作祜，工人们叫他王咋唬。
There was a young technician named Wang Zuohu, and the workers called him Wang Hui.有一个中年的技师，叫俊哥儿李。有一个时期，所里有三个技师都姓李。为怕混淆，工人们就把他们区别为黑李、白李、俊哥儿李。黑李、白李，因为肤色不同（这二李后来都调走了）。俊哥儿李是因为他长得端正，衣着整齐，还因为他冬天也不戴帽子。这地方冬天有时冷到零下三十七八度，工人们花多少钱，也愿意置一顶狐皮的或者貉绒的皮帽。至不济，也要戴一顶山羊头的。俊哥儿李是不论什么天气也是光着脑袋，头发梳得一丝不乱。
There is a middle-aged technician named Jun Geer Li. There was a period when there were three technicians in the institute whose surname was Li. For fear of confusion, the workers distinguished them as Black Li, White Li, and Jun Geer Li. Black Li and White Li have different skin colors (these two Li were later transferred). Jun Ge Li is because he is well-looked, neatly dressed, and because he doesn't wear a hat in winter. It is sometimes as cold as minus 37 or 8 degrees Celsius in winter, and the workers are willing to buy a fox skin or raccoon wool fur hat no matter how much it costs. If it doesn't work, you have to wear a goat's head. Jun Ge Li has a bare head no matter what the weather is, and his hair is combed neatly.有一个技师姓张，在所里年岁最大，资历也最老。工人们当面叫他张老，背后叫他早稻田。他是个水稻专家，每天起得最早，一起来就到水稻试验田去。他是日本留学生。这个所的历史很久了，有一些老工人敌伪时期就来了，他们多少知道一点日本的事。他们听说日本有个早稻田大学，就不管他是不是这个大学毕业的，派给他一个“早稻田”的外号。
There is a technician surnamed Zhang, who is the oldest and the oldest in the institute. The workers call him Zhang Lao in front and Waseda behind his back. He is a rice expert, and he gets up early every day and goes to the rice test field together. He is a Japanese student. This institute has a long history, and some old workers came during the period of enemy and puppetry, and they knew a little about Japan. They heard that there was a Waseda University in Japan, so they gave him the nickname "Waseda", regardless of whether he graduated from this university or not.沈沅来了不久，工人们也给她起了外号，叫沈三元。这是因为她刚来的时候，所里一个姓胡的支部书记在大会上把她的名字念错了，把“沅”字拆成了两个字，念成“沈三元”。工人们想起老年间的吉利话：“连中三元”，就说“沈三元”，这名字不赖！他们还听说她在学校时先是团员，后是党员，刚来了又是技术员，于是又叫她“沈三员”。“沈三元”也罢，“沈三员”也罢，含意都差不多：少年得志，前程万里。
Not long after Shen Yuan came, the workers also gave her a nickname, Shen Sanyuan. This is because when she first came, a branch secretary surnamed Hu in the institute mispronounced her name at the conference, split the word "Yuan" into two words, and pronounced it as "Shen Sanyuan". The workers remembered the auspicious saying in old age: "Even if they hit three yuan", they said "Shen Sanyuan", this name is not bad! They also heard that she was a member of the league when she was in school, then a party member, and a technician when she first came, so they called her "Shen Sanyuan" again. Whether it is "Shen Sanyuan" or "Shen Sanyuan", the meaning is the same: the young man is ambitious and has a long future.有一些年轻的技术员背后也叫她沈三员，那意味就不一样了。他们知道沈沅在政治条件上、业务能力上，都比他们优越，他们在提到“沈三员”时，就流露出相当复杂的情绪：嫉妒、羨慕，又有点讽刺。
Some young technicians also call her Shen Sanyuan behind her back, which means a different thing. They knew that Shen Yuan was superior to them in terms of political conditions and business ability, and when they mentioned "Shen Sanyuan", they showed quite mixed emotions: jealousy, envy, and a little irony.沈沅来了之后，引起一些人的注目，也引起一些人侧目。
这些，沈沅自己都不知道。
After Shen Yuan came, it attracted the attention of some people and also caused some people to look sideways. Shen Yuan himself didn't know these.她一直清清楚楚地记得第一天到这里时的情景。天刚刚亮，在一个小火车站下了车，空气很清凉。所里派了一个老工人赶了一辆单套车来接她。这老工人叫王栓。出了站，是一条很平整的碎石马路，两旁种着高高的加拿大白杨。她觉得这条路很美。不到半个钟头，王栓用鞭子一指：“到了。过了石桥，就是农科所。”她放眼一望：整齐而结实的房屋，高大明亮的玻璃窗。一匹马在什么地方喷着响鼻。大树下原来亮着的植保研究室的诱捕灯忽然灭掉了。她心里非常感动。
She always clearly remembers the first day she arrived here. It was just dawn, and I got off at a small train station, and the air was cool. The institute sent an old worker to pick her up in a single car. The old worker's name is Wang Shuo. Outside the station, there is a very smooth gravel road lined with tall Canadian poplars. She thought the road was beautiful. In less than half an hour, Wang Shuo pointed with his whip: "It's here." After crossing the stone bridge, there is the Institute of Agricultural Sciences. She looked around: neat and sturdy houses, tall and bright glass windows. A horse was snorting somewhere. The trapping light of the plant protection laboratory that was originally on under the big tree suddenly went out. She was very moved.这是一个地区一级的农科所，但是历史很久，积累的资料多，研究人员的水平也比较高，是全省的先进单位，全华北也是有数的。
This is a regional-level agricultural science institute, but it has a long history, accumulated a lot of information, and the level of researchers is relatively high.她到各处看了看。大田、果园、菜园、苗圃、温室、种籽仓库、水闸、马号、羊舍、猪场……这些东西她是熟悉的。她参观过好几个这样的农科所，大体上都差不多。不过，过去，这对她说起来好像是一幅一幅画；现在，她走到画里来了。晚上，一个人躺在床上，想：我也许会在这里生活一辈子。
She looked everywhere. Fields, orchards, vegetable gardens, nurseries, greenhouses, seed warehouses, sluices, horses, sheep houses, pig farms...... She was familiar with these things. She had visited several of these agricultural institutes, and they were generally the same. In the past, however, it seemed like a painting to her; now, she came to the paintings. At night, she lay alone in bed and thought: I might live here for the rest of my life.她的工作分配在大田作物研究组，主要是作早稻田的助手。她很高兴。她在学校时就读过张老的论文，对他很钦佩。
她到早稻田的研究室去见他。
Her work was assigned to the field crop research group, mainly as an assistant in the early rice fields. She was very happy. She had read Zhang Lao's papers in school and admired him very much. She went to Waseda's laboratory to meet him.张老摘下眼镜，站起来跟她握手。他的握手的姿态特别恳挚，有点像日本人。
“你的学习成绩我看过了，很好。你写的《京西水稻调查》，我读过，很好。我摘录了一部分。”
Zhang Lao took off his glasses and stood up to shake hands with her. His handshake gesture was very sincere, a bit like a Japanese. "I have seen your academic performance, and it is very good. I have read the "Rice Survey in Western Beijing" written by you, and it is very good. I have excerpted a part. ”早稻田抽出几张卡片和沈沅写的调查报告的铅印本。报告上有几处用红铅笔划了道。
沈沅不知说什么好，只好说：“很幼稚。”
“你很年轻，是个女同志。”
沈沅正捉摸着他这句话是什么意思，他说：
Waseda took out a few cards and a lead print of the investigation report written by Shen Yuan. There were several places on the report that were marked with a red pencil. Shen Yuan didn't know what to say, so he had to say: "Very naïve." ” "You're young, you're a lesbian." Shen Yuan was figuring out what he meant by this sentence, and he said:“搞农业科学研究，是寂寞的。要安于寂寞。——一个水稻良种培育成功，到真正确定它的种性，要几年？”
“正常的情况下，要八年。”
"Engaging in agricultural scientific research is lonely. Be content with loneliness. ——How many years does it take for a rice variety to be successfully cultivated to truly determine its germ characteristics? ” "Under normal circumstances, it takes eight years."“八年。以后会缩短。作物一年只生长一次。不能性急。搞农业，不要想一鸣惊人。农业研究，有很大的连续性。路，是很长的。在这条漫长的路上，没有敲锣打鼓，也没有欢呼。是的，很寂寞。但是乐在其中。”
"Eight years. It will be shortened in the future. Crops only grow once a year. Don't be impatient. Engage in agriculture, don't think about blockbusters. Agricultural research has a lot of continuity. The road is very long. On this long road, there is no gong or drum, no cheering. Yes, it's lonely. But enjoy it. ”张老的话给她留下很深刻的印象。
从此以后，她每天一早起来，就跟着早稻田到稻田去观察、记录。白天整理资料。晚上看书，或者翻译一点外文资料。
除了早稻田，她比较接近的人是俊哥儿李。
Zhang Lao's words left a deep impression on her. From then on, she got up early every morning and followed the rice fields to observe and record. Organize information during the day. Read books at night, or translate some foreign materials. In addition to Waseda, the person she is closer to is Jun Ge Li.俊哥儿李她早就认识了。老李也是农大的，比沈沅早好几年。沈沅进校时，老李早就毕业走了。但是他的爱人留在农大搞研究，沈沅跟她很熟。她姓褚，沈沅叫她褚大姐。沈沅在褚大姐那里见过俊哥儿李好多次。
Brother Jun Li has known her for a long time. Lao Li is also from Agricultural University, several years earlier than Shen Yuan. When Shen Yuan entered the school, Lao Li had already graduated and left. But his lover stayed at Agricultural University to do research, and Shen Yuan was very familiar with her. Her surname is Chu, and Shen Yuan calls her Sister Chu. Shen Yuan has seen Brother Jun Li many times at Sister Chu's place.俊哥儿李是个谷子专家。他认识好几个县的种谷能手。谷子是低产作物。他们的共同愿望，就是想摘掉谷子的低产帽子。俊哥儿李经常下乡。这些种谷能手也常来找他。一来，就坐满了一屋子。看看俊哥儿李那样一个衣履整齐，衬衫的领口、袖口雪白，头发一丝不乱的人，坐在一些戴皮帽的、戴毡帽的、系着羊肚子手巾的、长着黑胡子、白胡子、花白胡子的老农之间，彼此却是那样的自然，那样的亲热，是很有趣的。
Jun Geer Li is a millet expert. He knows grain farmers in several counties. Millet is a low-yielding crop. Their common wish is to take off the low-yield hat of millet. Jun Geer Li often goes to the countryside. These grain planting experts also often come to him. As soon as he came, the room was full. It is very interesting to see Jun Geer Li, a person with neat clothes, snow-white collar and cuffs of his shirt, and unkempt hair, sitting among some old farmers wearing leather hats, felt hats, sheep's belly handkerchiefs, and blackbeards, white beards, and white beards.这些种谷能手来的时候，沈沅就到俊哥儿李屋里去。听他们谈话，同时也帮着做做记录。

The main problem, on which the main basis for the characterization is based is one of her diaries. Her father had been wandering on the seas of a foreign country for half his life, and he had always wanted to have a small piece of land of his own. He sent the money he had saved over the years back to China, asked Shen Yuan's uncle to buy a little land, and built a house with one floor and one floor. He wanted to return to his hometown to live for a few years in his later years, and then bury it on this land, with a grave, and a small stone monument erected on the grave to let future generations know that he had worked hard all his life. Land reform in 1951. Shen Yuan returned to the house, washed his hair with a basin of cold water, lay down, and fell asleep immediately. She slept very soundly, not even a dream. She seemed to have disappeared. Purple-red pot, turquoise moss, dark green saxifrage round leaves, pale white leaf patterns. Shen Yuan couldn't help but exclaim:“真好看！”
“好看吗？——送你！”
“……赵所长，您找我？”
"It's so beautiful!" "Is it good-looking? - I'll send you!" ” “…… Director Zhao, are you looking for me? ”“你这篇《京西水稻调查》，写得不错呀！有材料，有见解，文笔也好。科学论文，也要讲究一点文笔嘛！——文如其人！朴素，准确，清秀。——你这样看着我，是说我这个打仗出身的人不该谈论文章风格吗？”
"Your "Rice Survey in Western Beijing" is well written! There are materials, opinions, and good writing. Scientific papers should also pay attention to a little writing! ——The article is like a person! Simple, accurate and elegant. ——When you look at me like this, do you mean that I, a person from a war background, shouldn't talk about the style of writing? ”“……您不像个所长。”
“所长？所长是什么？——大概是从七品！——这是一篇俄文资料，张老想请你翻译出来。”
沈沅接过一本俄文杂志，说：
“我现在能做这样的事吗？”
“为什么不能？”
“…… You don't look like a director. ” "Director? What is the director?" ——Probably from the seventh grade! ——This is a Russian material, Zhang Lao would like to ask you to translate it. ” Shen Yuan took a Russian-language magazine and said: "Can I do something like this now?" "Why not?"“好，我今天晚上赶一赶。”
“不用赶，你明天不要下地了。”
“好。”
“从明天起，你不要下地干活了。”
“……？”
"Okay, I'll catch it tonight." "No need to rush, you don't go to the ground tomorrow." "Okay." "From tomorrow, you don't want to work in the fields." “……？”“我这个人，存不住话。告诉你，准备给你摘掉右派的帽子。报告已经写上去了，估计不会有问题。本来可以晚几天告诉你，何必呢？早一天告诉你，让你高兴高兴，不好吗？有的同志，办事总是那么拖拉。他不知道，人家是度日如年呀！——祝贺你！”
"I'm a person who can't hold back my words. I tell you, I'm going to take off your rightist hat. The report has been written, and it is estimated that there will be no problem. I could have told you a few days later, why bother? Tell you a day earlier to make you happy, isn't it? Some comrades always procrastinate so much. He doesn't know that people live like years! ——Congratulations! ”他伸出手来。沈沅握着他的温暖的手，眼睛湿了。
“谢谢您！”
He stretched out his hand. Shen Yuan held his warm hand, his eyes wet. "Thank you!"“谢我干什么？我们需要人，我们迫切地需要人！你是党培养出来的知识分子。种地的，哪有把自己种出来的好苗锄掉的呢？没这个道理嘛！你有什么想法，什么打算？”
“这事来得太突然了。”
"What are you thanking me for? We need people, we urgently need people! You are an intellectual cultivated by the party. How can a farmer hoe out the good seedlings he has planted? There is no reason for this! What are your thoughts and plans? ” "This came too suddenly."“不突然。事情总要有一个过程。有的过程，付出的代价太大了！我这人，老犯错误。我这些话，叫别人听见，大概又是错误。有一些话，我现在不能跟你讲呀！——我看，你先回去一趟。”
“回去？”
"Not suddenly. There must be a process in things. Some processes are too costly! I always make mistakes. My words are probably mistakes for others to hear. There are some things I can't tell you now! ——I see, you go back first. ” "Go back?"“对。回一趟你的老家。”
“我家里没有人了。”
“我知道。”
"Yes. Go back to your hometown. ” "I have no one in my house anymore." "I know."三个多月前，沈沅接到舅舅一封信，说她父亲得了严重的肺气肿，回国来了，想看看他的女儿。沈沅拿了信去找胡支书，问她能不能请假。胡支书说：“……你现在这个情况。好吧，等我们研究研究。”过了一个星期。舅舅来了一封电报，她的父亲已经死了。她拿了电报去向胡支书汇报。胡支书说：
More than three months ago, Shen Yuan received a letter from her uncle, saying that her father had severe emphysema and had returned to China to see his daughter. Shen Yuan took the letter to Hu Zhishu and asked her if she could ask for leave. Hu Zhishu said: "...... You are in this situation now. Okay, wait for us to study it." "A week passed. My uncle sent a telegram that her father was dead. She took the telegram to report to Hu Zhishu Hu Zhishu said:“死了。死了也好嘛！你可以少背一点包袱。——埋了吗？”
“埋了。”
“埋了就得了。——好好劳动。”
"Dead. It's okay to be dead! You can carry less baggage." - Buried? ” "Buried." "Just bury it. ——Work hard. ”沈沅没有哭，也没有戴孝。白天还是下地干活，晚上一个人坐着。她想看书，看不下去。她觉得非常对不起她的父亲。父亲劳苦了一生，现在，他死了。她觉得父亲的病和死都是她所招致的。她没有把自己这些年的遭遇告诉父亲。但是她觉得他好像知道了，她觉得父亲的晚景和她划成右派有着直接的关系。好几天，她不停地胡思乱想。她觉得她的命不好。她自己也觉得很奇怪，一个年轻的，受过大学教育的共产党员，怎么会相信起命来呢？——人到了无可奈何的时候是很容易想起“命”这个东西来的。
Shen Yuan did not cry or wear filial piety. She still worked in the fields during the day and sat alone at night. She wanted to read but couldn't stand it. She felt very sorry for her father. My father worked hard all his life, and now, he is dead. She felt that her father's illness and death were caused by her. She didn't tell her father what had happened to her over the years. But she felt that he seemed to know, and she felt that her father's evening scene was directly related to her classification as a rightist. For several days, she kept thinking about it. She felt that her life was not good. She herself felt very strange, how could a young, college-educated Communist Party member believe in life? ——When people have no choice, it is easy to think of the word "life".好容易，她的伤痛才渐渐平息。
赵所长怎么会知道她家里已经没有人了呢？
“你还是回去看看。人死了，看看他的坟。我看可以给他立一块石碑。”
“您怎么知道我父亲想在坟头立一块石碑的？”
It was easy for her pain to subside. How could Director Zhao know that there was no one in her family? "You should go back and take a look. When a man dies, look at his grave. I think we can erect a stone monument for him." ” "How do you know that my father wants to erect a stone monument on the grave?"“你的档案材料里有嘛！你的右派结论里不也写着吗？——‘一心为其地主父亲树碑立传’。这都是什么话呢！一个老船工，在海外漂泊多年，这样一点心愿为什么不能满足他呢？我们是无鬼论者，我们并不真的相信泉下有知。但是人总是人嘛，人总有一颗心嘛。共产党员也是人，也有心嘛。共产党员不是没有感情的。无情的人，不是共产党员！——我有点激动了！你大概也知道我为什么激动。本来，你没有直系亲属了，没有探亲假。我可以批准你这次例外的探亲假。如果有人说这不合制度，我负责！你明天把资料翻译出来，——不长。后天就走。我送你。叫王栓套车。”
"You have it in your archives! Isn't it also written in your rightist conclusions? ——'Wholeheartedly erecting a monument for his landlord's father'. What are these words! An old boatman who has been wandering overseas for many years, why can't such a wish be fulfilled? We are anarchists, and we don't really believe in knowledge. But people are always people, and they always have a heart. Communist Party members are also people and have hearts. Communist Party members are not emotionless. Ruthless people are not Communist Party members! ——I'm a little excited! You probably know why I'm excited. Originally, you had no immediate family members and no family leave. I can approve your exceptional family visit leave this time. If someone says it's not in accordance with the system, I'll be responsible! It won't take long for you to translate the information tomorrow,—— I'll leave the day after tomorrow. I'll see you off. Call Wang Shuo to set up the car. ”沈沅哭了。
“哭什么？我们是同志嘛！”
沈沅哭得更厉害了。
“不要这样。你的工作，回来再谈。这盆虎耳草，我替你养着。你回来，就端走。你那屋里，太素了！年轻人，需要一点颜色。”
Shen Yuan cried. "Why cry? We are comrades! ” Shen Yuan cried even harder. "Don't do this. We'll talk about your work when you come back. I'll keep this pot of saxifrage for you. When you come back, take it away. Your house is too plain! Young people, you need a little color. ”一只绿豆大的通红的七星瓢虫飞进来，收起它的黑色的膜翅，落在虎耳草墨绿色的圆叶上。赵所长的眼睛一亮，说：
“真美！”
不到假满，沈沅就回来了。
她的工作，和原先一样，还是做早稻田的助手。
A reddish seven-star ladybug the size of a mung bean flew in, put away its black membrane wings, and landed on the dark green round leaves of saxifrage. Director Zhao's eyes lit up and said: "It's so beautiful!" Before the holiday was over, Shen Yuan came back. Her job, as before, is still an assistant to Waseda.很快到年底了。又开一年一度的先进工作者评比会了。赵所长叫沈沅也参加。
沈沅走进大田作物研究组的大办公室。她已经五年没有走进这间屋子了。俊哥儿李主持会议。他拉着一张椅子，亲切地让沈沅坐下。
It's almost the end of the year. The annual advanced worker evaluation meeting is held again. Director Zhao asked Shen Yuan to also participate. Shen Yuan walked into the large office of the field crop research group. She hadn't walked into this room for five years. Brother Jun Li presided over the meeting. He pulled a chair and kindly asked Shen Yuan to sit down.“这还是你的那张椅子。”
沈沅坐下，跟所有的人都打了招呼。别人也向她点头致意。王作祜装着低头削铅笔。
在酝酿候选人名单时，一向很少说话的早稻田头一个发言。
“我提一个人。”
“……谁？”
"This is still your chair." Shen Yuan sat down and greeted everyone. Others also nodded to her. Wang Zuohu lowered his head to sharpen his pencil. When the list of candidates was being drafted, Waseda, who has always rarely spoken, was the first to speak. "I'll mention someone." “…… Who? ”“沈沅。”
大家先是一愣，接着，都笑了。连沈沅自己也笑了。早稻田是很严肃的，他没有笑。
"Shen Yuan." Everyone was stunned for a moment, and then they all laughed. Even Shen Yuan himself laughed. Waseda was very serious, he didn't laugh.会议进行得很热烈。赵所长靠窗坐着，一面很注意地听着发言，一面好像想着什么事。会议快结束时，下雪了。好雪！赵所长半眯着眼睛，看着窗外大片大片的雪花无声地落在广阔的田野上。他是在赏雪么？
The meeting was very lively. Director Zhao sat by the window, listening attentively to the speech as if he was thinking about something. Towards the end of the meeting, it was snowing. Good snow! Director Zhao half-squinted his eyes and watched the large snowflakes outside the window fall silently on the vast field. Was he enjoying the snow?俊哥儿李叫他：“赵所长，您讲讲吧！”
早稻田也说：“是呀，您有什么指示呀？”
Brother Jun Li called him: "Director Zhao, tell me!" ” Waseda also said, "Yes, what instructions do you have?" ”“指示？——没有。我在想：我，能不能附张老的议，投她——沈沅一票。好像不能。刚才张老提出来，大家不是都笑了吗？是呀，我们毕竟都还生活在现实的世界里，还不能摆脱世俗的习惯和观念。那，就等一年吧。”
"Instructions? ——No. I was thinking: Can I agree with Zhang Lao's proposal and vote for her - Shen Yuan. It seems that it can't. Didn't everyone laugh when Zhang Lao brought it up just now? Yes, after all, we are still living in the real world, and we can't get rid of worldly habits and concepts. Then, just wait a year. ”他念了两句龚定盦的诗：
我劝天公重抖擞，
不拘一格降人才。
接着，又用沉重的声音，念了两句《离骚》：
亦余心之所善兮，
虽九死其犹未悔！
沈沅在心里想：
“你真不像个所长。”
He read two poems by Gong Dingxi: I urge the heavens to shake it again, Eclectic talent. Then, in a heavy voice, he read two sentences of "Li Sao": This is also what I love in my heart, Even if I die nine times, I still have no regrets! Shen Yuan thought to himself: "You really don't look like a director."一九八〇年十二月十一日六稿

天鹅之死

天鹅之死[1]
[3] Part-time workers, that is, minor workers. [4] Leeks grow from perennial roots, and if you shovel up a piece of soil from the roots and move it elsewhere, you can harvest it steadily. This piece of soil is called "leek skin". Death of the Swan[1]“阿姨，都白天了，怎么还有月亮呀？
“阿姨，月亮是白色的，跟云的颜色一样。
“阿姨，天真蓝呀。
“蓝色的天，白色的月亮，月亮里有蓝色的云，真好看呀！”
“真好看！”
“阿姨，树叶都落光了。树是紫色的。树干是紫色的。树枝也是紫色的。树上的风也是紫色的。真好看！”
“真好看！”
“阿姨，你好看！”
“我从前好看。”
"Auntie, the leaves are all gone. The tree is purple. The trunk is purple. The branches are also purple. The wind on the tree is also purple. It's so beautiful! ” "It's so beautiful!" "Auntie, you look good!" "I used to look good."“不！你现在也好看。你的眼睛好看。你的脖子，你的肩，你的腰，你的手，都好看。你的腿好看。你的腿多长呀。阿姨，我们爱你！”
“小朋友，我也爱你们！”
“阿姨，你的腿这两天疼了吗？”
"No! You look good now. Your eyes are good. Your neck, your shoulders, your waist, your hands are all good. Your legs are beautiful. How long are your legs. Auntie, we love you! ” "Children, I love you too!" "Auntie, has your leg hurt in the past two days?"“没有。要上坡了，小朋友，小心！”
“哦！看见玉渊潭了！”
“玉渊潭的水真清呀！”
“阿姨，那是什么？雪白雪白的，像花一样的发亮，一，二，三，四。”
白蕤从心里发出一声惊呼：
"Nope. It's going uphill, kids, be careful!" ” "Oh! I saw Yuyuantan! ” "The water in Yuyuantan is so clear!" "Auntie, what is that? Snow white, shiny like a flower, one, two, three, four. ” Bai Rui let out an exclamation from his heart:“是天鹅！”
“是天鹅？”
“冬泳的叔叔，那是天鹅吗？”
“是的，小朋友。”
“它们是怎么来的？”
“它们自己飞来的。”
“它们从哪儿飞来？”
“从很远很远的北方。”
"It's a swan!" "Is it a swan?" "Uncle Dongyong, is that a swan?" "Yes, little friend." "How did they come about?" "They flew by themselves." "Where did they fly from?" "From far, far north."“是吗？——欢迎你，白天鹅！”
“欢迎你到我们这儿来作客！”
天鹅在天上飞翔，
去寻找温暖的地方。
飞过了大兴安岭，
雪压的落叶松的密林里，闪动着鄂温克族狩猎队篝火的红光。
"Really? - Welcome, white swan! ” "Welcome to our guest!" Swans fly in the sky, Go in search of warm places. flew over the Great Xing'an Mountains, In the dense forest of snow-pressed larch, the red light of the Evenk hunting team's bonfire flashed.白蕤去看乌兰诺娃，去看天鹅。
大提琴的柔风托起了乌兰诺娃的双臂，钢琴的露珠从她的指尖流出。
她的柔弱的双臂伏下了。
又轻轻地挣扎着，抬起了脖颈。
钢琴流尽了最后的露滴，再也没有声音了。
Bai Rui went to see Ulanova, went to see the swan. The gentle breeze of the cello lifted up Ulanova's arms, and the dew of the piano flowed from her fingertips. Her weak arms bowed. Struggling gently, he lifted his neck. The piano flowed the last drops of dew and there was no sound anymore.天鹅死了。
白蕤像是在一个梦里。
她的眼睛里都是泪水。
她的眼泪流进了她的梦。
天鹅在天上飞翔，
去寻找温暖的地方。
飞过了呼伦贝尔草原，
草原一片白茫茫。
圈儿河依恋着家乡，
The swan is dead. Bai Rui seemed to be in a dream. Her eyes were full of tears. Her tears flowed into her dreams. Swans fly in the sky, Go find a warm place. flew over the Hulunbuir grassland, The grassland is vast and white. The Circle River is attached to its hometown,它流去又回头。
在雪白的草原上，
画出了一个又一个铁青色的圆圈。
白蕤考进了芭蕾舞校。经过刻苦的训练，她的全身都变成了音乐。
她跳《天鹅之死》。
大提琴和钢琴的旋律吹动着她的肢体，她的手指和足尖都在想象。
天鹅在天上飞翔，
去寻找温暖的地方。
某某去看了芭蕾。
他用猥亵的声音说：
The melodies of the cello and piano blew her limbs, her fingers and toes were imagined. Swans fly in the sky, Go find a warm place. So-and-so went to see ballet. He said in an obscene voice:“这他妈的小妞儿！那胸脯，那小腰，那么好看的大腿！……”
他满嘴喷着酒气。
他做了一个淫荡的梦。
天鹅在天上飞翔，
去寻找温暖的地方。
“文化大革命”。中国的森林起了火了。
"This fucking chick! That breasts, that small waist, such good-looking thighs! ……” He was full of alcohol. He had a lewd dream. Swans fly in the sky, Go find a warm place. "Cultural Revolution". China's forests are on fire.白蕤被打成了现行反革命。因为她说：
“《天鹅之死》就是美！乌兰诺娃就是美！”
天鹅在天上飞翔。
某某成了“宣传队员”。他每天晚上都想出一种折磨演员的花样。
他叫她们背着床板在大街上跑步。
Bai Rui was branded as a current counter-revolutionary. Because she said: "The Death of the Swan is beautiful! Ulanova is beautiful! ” Swans fly in the sky. So-and-so became a "propaganda team member". He came up with a trick to torture actors every night. He told them to run on the street with their backs on their backs.他叫她们做折损骨骼的苦工。
他命令白蕤跳《天鹅之死》。
“你不是说《天鹅之死》就是美吗？你给我跳，跳一夜！”
录音机放出了音乐。音乐使她忘记了眼前的一切。她快乐。
她跳《天鹅之死》。
她看看某某，发现他的下牙突出在上牙之外。北京人管这种长相叫“地包天”。
她跳《天鹅之死》。
她羞耻。
她跳《天鹅之死》。
她愤怒。
她跳《天鹅之死》。
她摔倒了。
She looked at so-and-so and found that his lower teeth protruded from the upper teeth. Beijingers call this appearance "the earth covers the sky". She danced "Death of a Swan". She was ashamed. She danced "The Death of a Swan". She was furious. She danced "The Death of a Swan". She fell.她跳《天鹅之死》。
天鹅在天上飞翔，
去寻找温暖的地方。
飞过太阳岛，
飞过松花江。
飞过华北平原，
越冬的麦粒在松软的泥土里睡得正香。
She danced "Death of the Swan". Swans fly in the sky, Go in search of warm places. Flying over the Isle of the Sun, Fly over the Songhua River. Flying over the North China Plain, The overwintered wheat grains slept soundly in the soft soil.经过长途飞行，天鹅的体重减轻了，但是翅膀上增添了力量。
天鹅在天上飞翔，
在天上飞翔，
玉渊潭在月光下发亮。
“这儿真好呀！这儿的水不冻，这儿暖和，咱们就在这儿过冬，好吗？”
After a long flight, the swan lost weight, but added strength to the wings. Swans fly in the sky, Soaring in the sky, Yuyuantan shines in the moonlight. "It's so nice here! The water here is not frozen, it's warm here, let's spend the winter here, okay? ”四只天鹅翩然落在玉渊潭上。
白蕤转业了。她当了保育员。她还是那样美，只是因为左腿曾经骨折，每到阴天下雨，就隐隐发痛。
自从玉渊潭来了天鹅，她隔两三天就带着孩子们去看一次。
孩子们对天鹅说：
Four swans landed on the Yuyuan Pool. Bai Rui changed jobs. She became a nursery teacher. She is still so beautiful, just because her left leg was broken, and every time it rained on a cloudy day, she felt a faint pain. Since the swans came to Yuyuantan, she took her children to see them every two or three days. The children said to the swan:“天鹅天鹅你真美！”

A gunshot rang out, and a swan was killed. The other three, terrified, wailed all night. The partner of the killed swan did not cry or eat for a day the next day. I saw it at seven o'clock in the evening. In the middle of the night, it flew away.白蕤看着报纸，她的眼前浮现出一张“地包天”的脸。
