1981年

1981年
Their tears flew to the sky and became stars in the sky. Early morning of December 29, 1980 [1] This article was originally published in Beijing Daily, April 14, 1981; First received "Wang Zengqi's Self-Selected Collection", Lijiang Publishing House, October 1987. In 1981大淖记事[1]
一
Da Nao Records {{id_0000}} One这地方的地名很奇怪，叫做大淖。全县没有几个人认得这个淖字。县境之内，也再没有别的叫做什么淖的地方。据说这是蒙古话。那么这地名大概是元朝留下的。元朝以前这地方有没有，叫做什么，就无从查考了。
The place name of this place is very strange, it is called Dana. Few people in the county recognize this word. There is no other place called Nao within the county. It is said that this is Mongolian. So this place name was probably left by the Yuan Dynasty. Whether this place existed before the Yuan Dynasty and what it was called, there is no way to find out.淖，是一片大水。说是湖泊，似还不够，比一个池塘可要大得多，春夏水盛时，是颇为浩淼的。这是两条水道的河源。淖中央有一条狭长的沙洲。沙洲上长满茅草和芦荻。春初水暖，沙洲上冒出很多紫红色的芦芽和灰绿色的蒌蒿[2]，很快就是一片翠绿了。夏天，茅草、芦荻都吐出雪白的丝穗，在微风中不住地点头。秋天，全都枯黄了，就被人割去，加到自己的屋顶上去了。冬天，下雪，这里总比别处先白。化雪的时候，也比别处化得慢。河水解冻了，发绿了，沙洲上的残雪还亮晶晶地堆积着。这条沙洲是两条河水的分界处。从淖里坐船沿沙洲西面北行，可以看到高阜上的几家炕房。绿柳丛中，露出雪白的粉墙，黑漆大书四个字：“鸡鸭炕房”，非常显眼。炕房门外，照例都有一块小小土坪，有几个人坐在树桩上负曝闲谈。不时有人从门里挑出一副很大的扁圆的竹笼，笼口络着绳网，里面是松花黄色的，毛茸茸，挨挨挤挤，啾啾乱叫的小鸡小鸭。由沙洲往东，要经过一座浆坊。浆是浆衣服用的。这里的人，衣服被里洗过后，都要浆一浆。浆过的衣服，穿在身上沙沙作响。浆是芡实水磨，加一点明矾，澄去水分，晒干而成。这东西是不值什么钱的。一大盆衣被，只要到杂货店花两三个铜板，买一小块，用热水冲开，就足够用了。但是全县浆粉都由这家供应（这东西是家家用得着的），所以规模也不算小。浆坊有四五个师傅忙碌着。喂着两头毛驴，轮流上磨。浆坊门外，有一片平场，太阳好的时候，每天晒着浆块，白得叫人眼睛都睁不开。炕房、浆坊附近还有几家买卖荸荠、茨菇、菱角、鲜藕的鲜货行，集散鱼蟹的鱼行和收购青草的草行。过了炕房和浆坊，就都是田畴麦垅，牛棚水车，人家的墙上贴着黑黄色的牛屎粑粑，——牛粪和水，拍成饼状，直径半尺，整齐地贴在墙上晾干，作燃料，已经完全是农村的景色了。由大淖北去，可至北乡各村。东去可至一沟、二沟、三垛、樊川、界首，直达邻县兴化。
Nao is a big water. It seems that it is not enough, it is much larger than a pond, and it is quite vast in spring and summer. This is the source of two waterways. There is a long and narrow sandbar in the center of the marsh. The sandbar is overgrown with thatch and reeds. In early spring, when the water is warm, many purple-red reed buds and gray-green Artemisia id_0000 emerge from the sandbar, and soon it will be emerald green. In summer, the thatch and reeds spit out snow-white silk ears and nod incessantly in the breeze. In autumn, when they are all withered and yellow, they are cut off and added to their roofs. In winter, when it snows, it is always whiter here than elsewhere. When the snow melts, it melts more slowly than elsewhere. The river has thawed and turned green, and the remaining snow on the sandbar is still piled up. This sandbar is the boundary between two rivers. Take a boat north along the west side of the sandbar from the mud, and you can see several kang houses on the high hills. In the green willows, a snow-white pink wall is exposed, and the four words "chicken and duck kang room" are written in black paint, which is very conspicuous. Outside the door of the kang house, there is a small earthen flat as usual, and a few people are sitting on the stump and chatting. From time to time, someone picks out a pair of large flat bamboo cages from the door, with a rope net wrapped around the cage, which is pine yellow, hairy, crowded, chirping. From the sandbar to the east, you have to pass a pulp mill. The pulp is used for pulp clothes. People here have to pulp their clothes after they are washed. The pulped clothes rustle on the body. The pulp is made by grinding gourd, adding a little alum, clarifying the water, and drying it. This thing is worthless. A large pot of clothes and quilts, as long as you go to the grocery store to spend two or three copper plates, buy a small piece, and rinse it with hot water, it is enough. But the pulp powder in the county is supplied by this one (this thing is used by every family), so the scale is not small. There are four or five masters busy in the pulp mill. Feed two donkeys and take turns grinding. Outside the door of the pulp mill, there is a flat field, when the sun is good, the pulp blocks are sunbathed every day, so white that people can't open their eyes. There are also several fresh goods shops near the kang house and pulp mill, which buy and sell water chestnuts, mushrooms, water chestnuts, and fresh lotus roots, as well as fish shops that distribute fish and crabs, and grass shops that buy grass. After the kang house and the pulp mill, there are fields and wheat ridges, cattle sheds, and cow dung and water are pasted on the walls of people's houses,—— and black and yellow cow dung baba, cow dung and water, slapped into cake shapes, half a foot in diameter, neatly pasted on the wall to dry, and used as fuel, which is already a completely rural scenery. From the north of Danao, you can go to the villages of Beixiang. To the east, you can go to Yigou, Ergou, Sanduo, Fanchuan, Jieshou, and go directly to Xinghua, a neighboring county.大淖的南岸，有一座漆成绿色的木板房，房顶、地面，都是木板的。这原是一个轮船公司。靠外手是候船的休息室。往里去，临水，就是码头。原来曾有一只小轮船，往来本城和兴化，隔日一班，单日开走，双日返回。小轮船漆得花花绿绿的，飘着万国旗，机器突突地响，烟筒冒着黑烟，装货、卸货，上客、下客，也有卖牛肉、高粱酒、花生瓜子、芝麻灌香糖的小贩，喝喝，是热闹过一阵的。后来因为公司赔了本，股东无意继续经营，就卖船停业了。这间木板房子倒没有拆去。现在里面空荡荡、冷清清，只有附近的野孩子到候船室来唱戏玩，棍棍棒棒，乱打一气；或到码头上比赛撒尿。七八个小家伙，齐齐地站成一排，把一泡泡骚尿哗哗地撒到水里，看谁尿得最远。
On the south bank of the big marsh, there is a wooden house painted green, and the roof and floor are all made of wood. This was originally a steamship company. On the outside hand is the lounge for waiting for ships. Go inside, near the water, is the wharf. It turned out that there was a small steamer that ran between the city and Xinghua, every other day, sailed away on a single day, and returned on two days. The steamer was painted green, with the flag of all nations fluttering, the machine rattled suddenly, the chimney was emitting black smoke, loading and unloading, picking up and unloading passengers, and there were also vendors selling beef, sorghum wine, peanuts, melon seeds, and sesame sugar id_00001 id_0000. Later, because the company lost its capital, the shareholders had no intention of continuing to operate, so they sold the boat and closed down. This wooden house was not demolished. Now it is empty and deserted, and only nearby wild children come to the waiting room to sing and play, stick sticks, and beat up indiscriminately; or go to the dock to compete and pee. Seven or eight little guys stood in a row and sprinkled a bubble of pee into the water to see who peed the farthest.大淖指的是这片水，也指水边的陆地。这里是城区和乡下的交界处。从轮船公司往南，穿过一条深巷，就是北门外东大街了。坐在大淖的水边，可以听到远远地一阵一阵朦朦胧胧的市声，但是这里的一切和街里不一样。这里没有一家店铺。这里的颜色、声音、气味和街里不一样。这里的人也不一样。他们的生活，他们的风俗，他们的是非标准、伦理道德观念和街里的穿长衣念过“子曰”的人完全不同。
Danao refers to this water, and also refers to the land by the water. This is the junction between the city and the countryside. From the steamship company to the south, through a deep alley, is the East Street outside the North Gate. Sitting by the water, you can hear the hazy sound of the city in the distance, but everything here is different from the street. There is not a single shop here. The colors, sounds, and smells here are different from those on the street. The people here are also different. Their lives, their customs, their standards of right and wrong, ethics and morality are completely different from the people on the street who wear long clothes and read "Ziyue".二
由轮船公司往东往西，各距一箭之遥，有两丛住户人家。这两丛人家，也是互不相同的，各是各乡风。
Two From the steamship company to the east and west, each a stone's throw away, there are two clusters of households. These two clusters of households are also different from each other, each with its own local style.西边是几排错错落落的低矮的瓦屋。这里住的是做小生意的。他们大都不是本地人，是从里下河一带，兴化、泰州、东台等处来的客户。卖紫萝卜的（紫萝卜是比荸荠略大的扁圆形的萝卜，外皮染成深蓝紫色，极甜脆），卖风菱的（风菱是很大的两角的菱角，壳极硬），卖山里红的，卖熟藕（藕孔里塞了糯米煮熟）的。还有一个从宝应来的卖眼镜的，一个从杭州来的卖天竺筷的。他们像一些候鸟，来去都有定时。来时，向相熟的人家租一间半间屋子，住上一阵，有的住得长一些，有的短一些，到生意做完，就走了。他们都是日出而作，日入而息。吃罢早饭，各自背着、扛着、挎着、举着自己的货色，用不同的乡音，不同的腔调，吟唱、唤着上街了。到太阳落山，又都像鸟似的回到自己的窝里。于是从这些低矮的屋檐下就都飘出带点甜味而又呛人的炊烟（所烧的柴草都是半干不湿的）。他们做的都是小本生意，赚钱不大。因为是在客边，对人很和气，凡事忍让，所以这一带平常总是安安静静的，很少有吵嘴打架的事情发生。
To the west are several rows of low tiled houses. People live here in small businesses. Most of them are not locals, but customers from the Lixiahe area, Xinghua, Taizhou, Dongtai and other places. Those who sell purple radishes (purple radishes are flat and round radishes slightly larger than water chestnuts, the skin is dyed dark blue and purple, extremely sweet and crispy), those who sell Fengling (Fengling is a large two-cornered water chestnut, the shell is extremely hard), the red one in the mountains, and the cooked lotus root (the lotus root hole is stuffed with glutinous rice and cooked). There is also a person who sells glasses from Baoying and a seller of Tianzhu chopsticks from Hangzhou. They are like some migratory birds, and they come and go regularly. When they came, they rented a half-room room from a familiar family and lived for a while, some lived longer, some shorter, and left when the business was done. They all work at sunrise and rest at sunset. After breakfast, each of them carried it on their backs, carried it, carried it on their shoulders, and held their own goods, singing and calling out to the street in different dialects and id_0000 different tones. When the sun sets, they all return to their nests like birds. So from under these low eaves, a little sweet and choking smoke wafted out (the firewood burned was half dry). They are all small businesses and don't make much money. Because it is on the side of guests, it is very kind to people and tolerant of everything, so this area is usually quiet, and there are few quarrels and fights.这里还住着二十来个锡匠，都是兴化帮。这地方兴用锡器，家家都有几件锡制的家伙。香炉、蜡台、痰盂、茶叶罐、水壶、茶壶、酒壶，甚至尿壶，都是锡的。嫁闺女时都要赔送一套锡器。最少也要有两个能容四五升米的大锡罐，摆在柜顶上，否则就不成其为嫁妆。出阁的闺女生了孩子，娘家要送两大罐糯米粥（另外还要有两只老母鸡，一百鸡蛋），装粥用的就是娘柜顶上的这两个锡罐。因此，二十来个锡匠并不显多。
There are also more than 20 tinsmiths living here, all of whom are from the Xinghua Gang. Pewter is used in this place, and every family has a few pieces of tin. Incense burners, wax tables, spittoons, tea jars, kettles, teapots, wine pots, and even urinals are all made of tin. When marrying a daughter, you have to give a set of pewterware. At least two large tin cans that can hold four or five liters of rice must be placed on the top of the cabinet, otherwise they will not be considered dowry. When a girl who goes out of the cabinet gives birth to a child, her mother's family will send two large cans of glutinous rice porridge (in addition to two old hens and one hundred eggs), and the porridge is used for these two tin cans on the top of the mother's cabinet. Therefore, there are not many tinsmiths in their twenties.锡匠的手艺不算费事，所用的家什也较简单。一副锡匠担子，一头是风箱，绳系里夹着几块锡板；一头是炭炉和两块二尺见方，一面裱着好几层表芯纸的方砖。锡器是打出来的，不是铸出来的。人家叫锡匠来打锡器，一般都是自己备料，——把几件残旧的锡器回炉重打。锡匠在人家门道里或是街边空地上，支起担子，拉动风箱，在锅里把旧锡化成锡水，——锡的熔点很低，不大一会就化了；然后把两块方砖对合着（裱纸的一面朝里），在两砖之间压一条绳子，绳子按照要打的锡器圈成近似的形状，绳头留在砖外，把锡水由绳口倾倒过去，两砖一压，就成了锡片；然后，用一个大剪子剪剪，用一个木棰在铁砧上敲敲打打，大约一两顿饭工夫就成型了。锡是软的，打锡器不像打铜器那样费劲，也不那样吵人。粗使的锡器，就这样就能交活。若是细巧的，就还要用刮刀刮一遍，用砂纸打一打，用竹节草（这种草中药店有卖的）磨得锃亮。
The tinsmith's craftsmanship is not laborious, and the furniture used is relatively simple. A pair of tinsmith's burden, one end is a bellows, and a few tin plates are sandwiched in the rope; one end is a charcoal furnace and two square bricks with several layers of core paper mounted on the other. The tinware is made, not cast. When people call tinsmiths to make tinware, they usually prepare their own materials ,—— return a few pieces of old tinware to the furnace to re-beat them. In the doorway or in the open space on the street, the tinsmith props up the burden, pulls the bellows, and turns the old tin into tin water in the pot,—— the melting point of the tin is very low, and it will melt after a while; Then the two square bricks are paired together (the side of the mounting paper is facing inward), and a rope is pressed between the two bricks, and the rope is circled into a similar shape according to the pewter to be beaten, the rope head is left outside the brick, and the tin water is poured out of the rope mouth. Then, use a large pair of scissors to cut and use a wooden stick to beat on the anvil, and it will take about one or two meals to form. Tin is soft, and tinware is not as strenuous and noisy as copper ware. Rough tinware can be handed over in this way. If it is delicate, it must be scraped with a scraper, beaten with sandpaper, and ground with bamboo grass (this herb is sold in Chinese medicine stores) to make it shiny.这一帮锡匠很讲义气。他们扶持疾病，互通有无，从不抢生意。若是合伙做活，工钱也分得很公道。这帮锡匠有一个头领，是个老锡匠，他说话没有人不听。老锡匠人很耿直，对其余的锡匠（不是他的晚辈就是他的徒弟）管教得很紧。他不许他们赌钱喝酒；嘱咐他们出外做活，要童叟无欺，手脚要干净；不许和妇道嬉皮笑脸。他教他们不要怕事，也绝不要惹事。除了上市应活，平常不让到处闲游乱窜。
This group of tinsmiths is very loyal. They support the disease, communicate with each other, and never rob business. If you work in partnership, the wages are also fairly divided. This gang of tinsmiths has a leader, an old tinsmith, and no one listens to him. The old tinsmith is very upright and disciplines the rest of the tinsmiths (either his juniors or his apprentices) very tightly. He did not allow them to gamble and drink; instructed them to go out to work, to be free from bullying, and to keep their hands and feet clean; they were not allowed to smile with women. He taught them not to be afraid of things and never cause trouble. In addition to going public, he is usually not allowed to wander around.老锡匠会打拳，别的锡匠也跟着练武。他屋里有好些白蜡杆，三节棍，没事便搬到外面场地上打对儿。老锡匠说：这是消遣，也可以防身，出门在外，会几手拳脚不吃亏。除此之外，锡匠们的娱乐便是唱唱戏。他们唱的这种戏叫做“小开口”，是一种地方小戏，唱腔本是萨满教的香火（巫师）请神唱的调子，所以又叫“香火戏”。这些锡匠并不信萨满教，但大都会唱香火戏。戏的曲调虽简单，内容却是成本大套，李三娘挑水推磨，生下咬脐郎；白娘子水漫金山；刘金定招亲；方卿唱道情……可以坐唱，也可以化了装彩唱。遇到阴天下雨，不能出街，他们能吹打弹唱一整天。附近的姑娘媳妇都挤过来看，——听。
The old tinsmith can punch, and other tinsmiths also practice martial arts. He has a lot of ash sticks and three-section sticks in his house, so he moves to the outside field to fight right. The old tinsmith said: This is a pastime, but also for self-defense, and when you go out, you will not suffer a few punches and feet. In addition, the entertainment of the tinsmiths is singing. The play they sing is called "small opening", which is a kind of local drama, and the singing is originally the tune of the shamanic incense (sorcerer) to invite the gods to sing, so it is also called "incense play". These tinsmiths do not believe in shamanism, but most of them sing incense operas. Although the tune of the play is simple, the content is a large cost, Li Sanniang carries water and grinds, giving birth to a navel-biting man; the white lady is full of golden mountains; Liu Jinding recruited relatives; Fang Qing sang love ...... You can sit and sing, or you can sing in color. When it rains on a cloudy day, they can't go out on the street, so they can play and sing all day. Nearby girls and daughters-in-law all squeezed over to watch ,—— listen.老锡匠有个徒弟，也是他的侄儿，在家大排行第十一，小名就叫个十一子，外人都只叫他小锡匠。这十一子是老锡匠的一件心事。因为他太聪明，长得又太好看了。他长得挺拔厮称，肩宽腰细，唇红齿白，浓眉大眼，头戴遮阳草帽，青鞋净袜，全身衣服整齐合体。天热的时候，敞开衣扣，露出扇面也似的胸脯，五寸宽的雪白的板带煞得很紧。走起路来，高抬脚，轻着地，麻溜利索。锡匠里出了这样一个一表人才，真是鸡窝里飞出了金凤凰。老锡匠心里明白：唱“小开口”的时候，那些挤过来的姑娘媳妇，其实都是来看这位十一郎的。
The old tinsmith has an apprentice, who is also his nephew, ranking eleventh in the family, and his nickname is Eleventh Son, and outsiders only call him the little tinsmith. This eleventh son is a concern of the old tinsmith. Because he is too smart and so good-looking. He is tall and tall, with broad shoulders and thin waist, red lips and white teeth, thick eyebrows and big eyes, wearing a sunshade straw hat, green shoes and clean socks, and his whole body is neatly fitted. When it's hot, open the buttons to reveal the chest that looks like a fan, and the snow-white ribbon five inches wide is very tight. Walk up, raise your feet high, land lightly, and be neat. There is such a talent in the tinsmith, it is really a golden phoenix flying out of the chicken coop. Lao Xi Jiang understood in his heart: When singing "Little Opening", those girls and daughters-in-law who squeezed over actually came to see this Shiyilang.老锡匠经常告诫十一子，不要和此地的姑娘媳妇拉拉扯扯，尤其不要和东头的姑娘媳妇有什么勾搭：“她们和我们不是一样的人！”
三
The old tinsmith often warned the eleventh son not to pull and pull with the girls and daughters-in-law here, especially not to hook up with the girls and daughters-in-law in the east: "They are not the same people as us!" ” Three轮船公司东头都是草房，茅草盖顶，黄土打墙，房顶两头多盖着半片破缸破瓮，防止大风时把茅草刮走。这里的人，世代相传，都是挑夫。男人、女人、大人、孩子，都靠肩膀吃饭。
The east end of the steamship company is full of thatched houses, thatched roofs, loess walls, and more than half of the broken tanks and urns are covered at both ends of the roof to prevent the thatch from being scraped away when the wind blows away. The people here, for generations, are porters. Men, women, adults, and children all eat on their shoulders.挑得最多的是稻子。东乡、北乡的稻船，都在大淖靠岸。满船的稻子，都由这些挑夫挑走。或送到米店，或送进哪家大户的廒仓，或挑到南门外琵琶闸的大船上，沿运河外运。有时还会一直挑到车逻、马棚湾这样很远的码头上。单程一趟，或五六里，或七八里、十多里不等。一二十人走成一串，步子走得很匀，很快。一担稻子二百斤，中途不歇肩。一路不停地打着号子。换肩时一齐换肩。打头的一个，手往扁担上一搭，一二十副担子就同时由右肩转到左肩上来了。每挑一担，领一根“筹子”，——尺半长，一寸宽的竹牌，上涂白漆，一头是红的。到傍晚凭筹领钱。
The most picked is rice. The rice boats in Dongxiang and Beixiang are all docked at Danao. The boats full of rice are all picked up by these porters. Or sent to the rice shop, or sent to the warehouse of a large family, or to the big ship at the Pipa Gate outside the south gate, and transported along the canal. Sometimes it is carried all the way to a far wharf such as Cheluo and Mapeng Bay. One way, five or six miles, or seven or eight miles, or more than ten miles. Twenty people walk in a string, walking very evenly and quickly. A load of two hundred pounds of rice, without resting on the shoulder. Keep trumpeting all the way. Change shoulders when changing shoulders. The one who hit the head put his hand on the flat pole, and one or twenty sets of burdens turned from the right shoulder to the left shoulder at the same time. For each load, he received a "chip" ,—— foot and a half long and one inch wide bamboo card, painted with white paint and red at one end. In the evening, the money was received by chipping.稻谷之外，什么都挑。砖瓦、石灰、竹子（挑竹子一头拖在地上，在砖铺的街面上擦得刷刷地响）、桐油（桐油很重，使扁担不行，得用木杠，两人抬一桶）……因此，一年三百六十天，天天有活干，饿不着。
Pick everything except rice. Bricks, lime, bamboo (pick bamboo and drag it on the ground and rub it on the brick street), tung oil (tung oil is very heavy, so you can't do it, you have to use a wooden pole, and two people carry a bucket)...... Therefore, three hundred and sixty days a year, there is work to do every day, and you can't starve.十三四岁的孩子就开始挑了。起初挑半担，用两个柳条笆斗。练上一二年，人长高了，力气也够了，就挑整担，像大人一样的挣钱了。
Thirteen or fourteen-year-old children started picking. At first, I carried half a load and used two wicker fences. After practicing for a year or two, when people grow taller and have enough strength, they pick up the whole load and earn money like adults.挑夫们的生活很简单：卖力气，吃饭。一天三顿，都是干饭。这些人家都不盘灶，烧的是“锅腔子”——黄土烧成的矮瓮，一面开口烧火。烧柴是不花钱的。淖边常有草船，乡下人挑芦柴入街去卖，一路总要撒下一些。凡是尚未挑担挣钱的孩子，就一人一把竹筢，到处去搂。因此，这些顽童得到一个稍带侮辱性的称呼，叫做“筢草鬼子”。有时懒得费事，就从乡下人的草担上猛力拽出一把，拔腿就溜。等乡下人撂下担子叫骂时，他们早就没影儿了。锅腔子无处出烟，烟子就横溢出来，飘到大淖水面上，平铺开来，停留不散。这些人家无隔宿之粮，都是当天买，当天吃。吃的都是脱粟的糙米。一到饭时，就看见这些茅草房子的门口蹲着一些男子汉，捧着一个蓝花大海碗，碗里是骨堆堆的一碗紫红紫红的米饭，一边堆着青菜小鱼、臭豆腐、腌辣椒，大口大口地在吞食。他们吃饭不怎么嚼，只在嘴里打一个滚，咕咚一声就咽下去了。看他们吃得那样香，你会觉得世界上再没有比这个饭更好吃的饭了。
The life of porters is very simple: work hard and eat. Three meals a day, all dry food. These people don't have a stove, they burn a "pot cavity" - a low urn made of loess, and they open their mouths to burn fire. Burning firewood does not cost money. There are often grass boats on the edge of the marsh, and the countrymen carry reeds into the street to sell, and they always have to scatter some along the way. All the children who have not yet carried the burden to earn money will hug each person with a bamboo basket and hug it everywhere. Therefore, these urchins are given a slightly insulting title, called "bamboo devils". Sometimes they are too lazy to bother, so they pull out a handful from the grass burden of the countrymen and slip away. By the time the countrymen put down their burdens and scolded, they were long gone. The pot cavity has nowhere to smoke, and the smoke overflows, floats to the surface of the muddy water, spreads flat, and stays there. These people don't have overnight food, they buy it on the same day and eat it on the same day. They eat all brown rice that has been stripped of corn. As soon as it was time to eat, I saw some men squatting at the door of these thatched houses, holding a blue flower bowl, which was a bowl of purple and red rice piled up with bones, while piled with small vegetables, stinky tofu, and pickled peppers, and they were devouring it with big mouths. They didn't chew much, they just rolled in their mouths and swallowed it with a gurgling sound. Seeing how delicious they eat, you will feel that there is no better meal in the world than this one.他们也有年，也有节。逢年过节，除了换一件干净衣裳，吃得好一些，就是聚在一起赌钱。赌具，也是钱。打钱，滚钱。打钱：各人拿出一二十铜元，叠成很高的一摞。参与者远远地用一个钱向这摞铜钱砸去，砸倒多少取多少。滚钱又叫“滚五七寸”。在一片空场上，各人放一摞钱；一块整砖支起一个斜坡，用一个铜元由砖面落下，向钱注密处滚去，钱停住后，用事前备好的两根草棍量一量，如距钱注五寸，滚钱者即可吃掉这一注；距离七寸，反赔出与此注相同之数。这种古老的博法使挑夫们得到极大的快乐。旁观的闲人也不时大声喝采，为他们助兴。
They also have years and festivals. During the New Year's holidays, in addition to changing into clean clothes and eating better, they get together to gamble. Gambling tools are also money. Play money, roll money. Money: Each person takes out one or two copper dollars and stacks them into a very high stack. Participants smash a coin at the stack of copper coins from a distance, and take as much as they knock. Rolling money is also called "rolling five or seven inches". On an empty field, each person puts a stack of money; a whole brick supports a slope, uses a copper dollar to fall from the brick surface, rolls to the money injection secret place, after the money stops, use the two straw sticks prepared in advance to measure it, such as five inches away from the money bet, the money roller can eat the bet; seven inches away, the same amount as this bet is lost. This ancient game of game brought great joy to the porters. The idlers on the sidelines also cheered loudly from time to time to cheer them up.这里的姑娘媳妇也都能挑。她们挑得不比男人少，走得不比男人慢。挑鲜货是她们的专业。大概是觉得这种水淋淋的东西对女人更相宜，男人们是不屑于去挑的。这些“女将”都生得颀长俊俏，浓黑的头发上涂了很多梳头油，梳得油光水滑（照当地说法是：苍蝇站上去都会闪了腿）。脑后的发髻都极大。发髻的大红头绳的发根长到二寸，老远就看到通红的一截。她们的发髻的一侧总要插一点什么东西。清明插一个柳球（杨柳的嫩枝，一头拿牙咬着，把柳枝的外皮连同鹅黄的柳叶使劲往下一抹，成一个小小球形），端午插一丛艾叶，有鲜花时插一朵栀子、一朵夹竹桃，无鲜花时插一朵大红剪绒花。因为常年挑担，衣服的肩膀处易破，她们的托肩多半是换过的。旧衣服，新托肩，颜色不一样，这几乎成了大淖妇女的特有的服饰。一二十个姑娘媳妇，挑着一担担紫红的荸荠、碧绿的菱角、雪白的连枝藕，走成一长串，风摆柳似的嚓嚓地走过，好看得很！
The girls and daughters-in-law here can also pick. They pick no less than men, and they walk no slower than men. Picking fresh goods is their specialty. Probably think that this kind of watery thing is more suitable for women, and men disdain to pick it. These "female generals" are all tall and handsome, and their thick black hair is coated with a lot of comb oil, which is shiny and smooth (according to the local parlance: flies will flash their legs when they stand up). The buns on the back of the head are extremely large. The roots of the big red headband in the bun grow to two inches, and you can see a red section from afar. There is always something inserted on one side of their bun. Insert a willow ball (the young branches of the willow, bite with teeth at one end, and wipe the outer skin of the willow branches together with the goose-yellow willow leaves to form a small spherical shape), insert a clump of mugwort leaves during the Dragon Boat Festival, insert a gardenia and an oleander when there are flowers, and insert a big red velvet flower when there are no flowers. Because they carry burdens all year round, the shoulders of their clothes are easy to break, and most of their shoulders are replaced. Old clothes, new shoulders, and different colors, have almost become the unique costumes of Da Nao women. Twenty girls and daughters-in-law, carrying loads of purple and red water chestnuts, turquoise water chestnuts, and snow-white lotus roots, walked in a long string, walking like willows in the wind, which is very beautiful!她们像男人一样的挣钱，走相、坐相也像男人。走起来一阵风，坐下来两条腿叉得很开。她们像男人一样赤脚穿草鞋（脚指甲却用凤仙花染红）。她们嘴里不忌生冷，男人怎么说话她们怎么说话，她们也用男人骂人的话骂人。打起号子来也是“好大娘个歪歪子咧！”——“歪歪子咧……”
They earn money like men, and they walk and sit like men. There was a gust of wind when he walked, and when he sat down, his legs were spread wide. They wear straw sandals barefoot like men (their toenails are dyed red with impatiens). They don't avoid being cold in their mouths, and how they talk when men speak, they also scold people with men's scolding words. When I started calling it, it was also "What a crooked lady!" ——"Crooked ......"没出门子的姑娘还文雅一点，一做了媳妇就简直是“姜太公在此百无禁忌”，要多野有多野。有一个老光棍黄海龙，年轻时也是挑夫，后来腿脚有了点毛病，就在码头上看看稻船，收收筹子。这老头儿老没正经，一把胡子了，还喜欢在媳妇们的胸前屁股上摸一把，拧一下。按辈份，他应当被这些媳妇称呼一声叔公，可是谁都管他叫“老骚胡子”。有一天，他又动手动脚的，几个媳妇一咬耳朵，一二三，一齐上手，眨眼之间叔公的裤子就挂在大树顶上了。有一回，叔公听见卖饺面[3]的挑着担子，敲着竹梆走来，他又来劲了：“你们敢不敢到淖里洗个澡？——敢，我一个人输你们两碗饺面！”——“真的？”——“真的！”——“好！”几个媳妇脱了衣服跳到淖里扑通扑通洗了一会。爬上岸就大声喊叫：
The girl who didn't go out was more elegant, and as soon as she became a daughter-in-law, she was simply "Jiang Taigong has no taboos here", and she wanted to be wild. There was an old bachelor Huang Hailong, who was also a porter when he was young, but later had some problems with his legs and feet, so he looked at the rice boats on the pier and collected the chips. This old man is old and unserious, he has a beard, and he likes to touch and twist the chest and buttocks of his daughters-in-law. According to seniority, he should be called uncle by these daughters-in-law, but everyone calls him "old beard". One day, he moved his hands and feet again, and several daughters-in-law bit their ears, one, two, three, and started together, and in the blink of an eye, his uncle's pants were hanging on the top of the big tree. Once, my uncle heard the dumpling noodle seller [3] carrying a burden and knocking on the bamboo stick, and he was energetic again: "Do you dare to take a bath in the mud? ——Dare, I will lose you two bowls of dumplings by myself!" ——"Really?" ——"Really!" ——"Okay!" Several daughters-in-law took off their clothes and jumped into the mud to wash for a while. Climbing ashore, he shouted loudly:“下面！”
"Below!"这里人家的婚嫁极少明媒正娶，花轿吹鼓手是挣不着他们的钱的。媳妇，多是自己跑来的；姑娘，一般是自己找人。她们在男女关系上是比较随便的。姑娘在家生私孩子；一个媳妇，在丈夫之外，再“靠”一个，不是稀奇事。这里的女人和男人好，还是恼，只有一个标准：情愿。有的姑娘、媳妇相与了一个男人，自然也跟他要钱买花戴，但是有的不但不要他们的钱，反而把钱给他花，叫做“倒贴”。
There are very few marriages here that the bright media are marrying, and the sedan chair drummers can't earn their money. Daughters-in-law mostly come by themselves; girls usually find someone by themselves. They are relatively casual in the relationship between men and women. Girls give birth to private children at home; it is not uncommon for a daughter-in-law to "rely on" another other than her husband. Women here are good with men, or they are annoyed, and there is only one criterion: willingness. Some girls and daughters-in-law are with a man, and naturally ask him for money to buy flowers and wear them, but some not only don't want their money, but spend the money on him, which is called "upside down".因此，街里的人说这里“风气不好”。
到底是哪里的风气更好一些呢？难说。
四
Therefore, people on the street say that the atmosphere here is "not good". Where is the atmosphere better? Hard. Four大淖东头有一户人家。这一家只有两口人，父亲和女儿。父亲名叫黄海蛟，是黄海龙的堂弟（挑夫里姓黄的多）。原来是挑夫里的一把好手。他专能上高跳。这地方大粮行的“窝积”（长条芦席围成的粮囤），高到三四丈，只支一只单跳，很陡。上高跳要提着气一口气窜上去，中途不能停留。遇到上了一点岁数的或者“女将”，抬头看看高跳，有点含胡，他就走过去接过二百斤的担子，一支箭似的上到跳顶，两手一提，把两箩稻子倒在“窝积”里，随即三五步就下到平地。因为为人忠诚老实，二十五岁了，还没有成亲。那年在车逻挑粮食，遇到一个姑娘向他问路。这姑娘留着长长的刘海，梳了一个“苏州俏”的发髻，还抹了一点胭脂，眼色张皇，神情焦急，她问路，可是连一个准地名都说不清，一看就知道是大户人家逃出来的使女。黄海蛟和她攀谈了一会，这姑娘就表示愿意跟着他过。她叫莲子。——这地方丫头、使女多叫莲子。
There is a family at the east end of Danao. There are only two people in this family, father and daughter. His father's name is Huang Haijiao, and he is Huang Hailong's cousin (there are many porters with the surname Huang). It turned out to be a good hand in the porter. He can jump high. The "nest" (grain hoard surrounded by long reed mats) in this place is three or four feet high, and only one single jump is very steep. The high jump has to be carried up in one breath, and you can't stop halfway. When he met a little old or a "female general", he looked up at the high jump, a little bearded, he walked over and took the burden of 200 pounds, went up to the top of the jump like an arrow, lifted it with both hands, poured two baskets of rice into the "nest", and then went down to the flat ground in three or five steps. Because he is loyal and honest, he is twenty-five years old and has not yet married. That year, while picking up grain in Cheluo, he met a girl who asked him for directions. The girl had long bangs, combed a "Suzhou pretty" bun, and smeared a little rouge, her eyes were open, and she looked anxious, she asked for directions, but she couldn't even tell a quasi-place name, and at a glance she knew that she was a maid who escaped from a large family. Huang Haijiao chatted with her for a while, and the girl expressed her willingness to follow him. Her name is Lianzi. ——The girls and maids in this place are often called Lianzi.莲子和黄海蛟过了一年，给他生了个女儿。七月生的，生下的时候满天都是五色云彩，就取名叫做巧云。
Lianzi and Huang Haijiao gave birth to a daughter to him after a year. Born in July, the sky was full of five-colored clouds when he was born, so he was named Qiaoyun.莲子的手很巧，也勤快，只是爱穿件华丝葛的裤子，爱吃点瓜子零食，还爱唱“打牙牌”之类的小调：“凉月子一出照楼梢，打个呵欠伸懒腰，瞌睡子又上来了。哎哟，哎哟，瞌睡子又上来了……”这和大淖的乡风不大一样。
Lianzi's hands are very skillful and diligent, but she just likes to wear a pair of flower kudzu pants, eat some melon seed snacks, and love to sing tunes such as "playing tooth cards": "As soon as Liang Yuezi came out of the building, he yawned and stretched, and the sleepy man came up again. Ouch, ouch, the sleepy man came up again......" This is not very different from the rural style of Danao.巧云三岁那年，她的妈莲子，终于和一个过路戏班子的一个唱小生的跑了。那天，黄海蛟正在马棚湾。莲子把黄海蛟的衣裳都浆洗了一遍，巧云的小衣裳也收拾在一起，焖了一锅饭，还给老黄打了半斤酒，把孩子托给邻居，说是她出门有点事，锁了门，从此就不知去向了。
When Qiaoyun was three years old, her mother Lianzi finally ran away with a singer from a passing troupe. That day, Huang Haijiao was in Mapeng Bay. Lianzi washed Huang Haijiao's clothes, and Qiaoyun's small clothes were also packed together, stewed a pot of rice, and gave Lao Huang half a catty of wine, entrusting the child to the neighbors, saying that she had something to do when she went out, locked the door, and disappeared since.巧云的妈跑了，黄海蛟倒没有怎么伤心难过。这种事情在大淖这个地方也值不得大惊小怪。养熟的鸟还有飞走的时候呢，何况是一个人！只是她留下的这块肉，黄海蛟实在是疼得不行。他不愿巧云在后娘的眼皮底下委委屈屈地生活，因此发心不再续娶。他就又当爹又当妈，和女儿巧云在一起过了十几年。他不愿巧云去挑扁担，巧云从十四岁就学会结鱼网和打芦席。
Qiaoyun's mother ran away, but Huang Haijiao was not very sad. This kind of thing is not worth the fuss in this place of Danao. There are times when a cooked bird flies away, let alone alone! It's just that the piece of meat she left behind, Huang Haijiao really hurts. He didn't want Qiaoyun to live aggrieved under his stepmother's nose, so he decided not to remarry. He became a father and a mother again, and spent more than ten years with his daughter Qiaoyun. He didn't want Qiaoyun to carry a flat pole, and Qiaoyun learned to make fishing nets and reed mats since he was fourteen years old.巧云十五岁，长成了一朵花。身材、脸盘都像妈。瓜子脸，一边有个很深的酒窝。眉毛黑如鸦翅，长入鬓角。眼角有点吊，是一双凤眼。睫毛很长，因此显得眼睛经常是眯睎着；忽然回头，睁得大大的，带点吃惊而专注的神情，好像听到远处有人叫她似的。她在门外的两棵树杈之间结网，在淖边平地上织席，就有一些少年人装着有事的样子来来去去。她上街买东西，甭管是买肉、买菜，打油、打酒，撕布、量头绳，买梳头油、雪花膏，买石碱、浆块，同样的钱，她买回来，份量都比别人多，东西都比别人的好。这个奥秘早被大娘、大婶们发现，她们都托她买东西。只要巧云一上街，都挎了好几个竹篮，回来时压得两个胳臂酸疼酸疼。泰山庙唱戏，人家都自己扛了板凳去。巧云散着手就去了。一去了，总有人给她找一个得看的好座。台上的戏唱得正热闹，但是没有多少人叫好。因为好些人不是在看戏，是看她。
Qiaoyun was fifteen years old and grew into a flower. The figure and face are like mothers. The melon seed face has a deep dimple on one side. The eyebrows are as black as crow's wings, growing into the sideburns. The corners of the eyes are a little hanging, and they are a pair of phoenix eyes. The eyelashes are very long, so it seems that the eyes are often squinting; suddenly turned around, wide open, with a slightly surprised and focused expression, as if she heard someone calling her in the distance. She weaved a net between the two branches outside the door, weaving mats on the flat ground by the mud, and there were some young people coming and going pretending to be something. She went to the street to buy things, whether it was buying meat, vegetables, oil, wine, tearing cloth, measuring ropes, combing oil, alabaster paste, stone alkali, pulp, the same money, she bought back, the amount was more than others, and the things were better than others. This mystery was already discovered by the aunts and aunts, and they all asked her to buy things. As long as Qiaoyun went to the street, she carried several bamboo baskets, and when she came back, her arms were sore and sore. When Qiaoyun sang in Taishan Temple, everyone carried the bench by themselves. Qiaoyun left with his hands. As soon as she went, someone always found her a good seat to see. The play on the stage was singing lively, but not many people applauded. Because many people are not watching the play, but watching her.巧云十六了，该张罗着自己的事了。谁家会把这朵花迎走呢？炕房的老大？浆坊的老二？鲜货行的老三？他们都有这意思。这点意思黄海蛟知道了，巧云也知道。不然他们老到淖东头来回晃摇是干什么呢？但是巧云没怎么往心里去。
Qiaoyun is sixteen years old, and it's time to take care of his own business. Who will welcome this flower away? The boss of the kang room? The second child of the pulp mill? The third child of the fresh goods store? They all mean this. Huang Haijiao knows this meaning, and Qiaoyun also knows it. Otherwise, what are they doing when they are old and swaying back and forth in Naodongtou? But Qiaoyun didn't take it to heart.巧云十七岁，命运发生了一个急转直下的变化。她的父亲黄海蛟在一次挑重担上高跳时，一脚踏空，从三丈高的跳板上摔下来，摔断了腰。起初以为不要紧，养养就好了。不想喝了好多药酒，贴了好多膏药，还不见效。她爹半瘫了，他的腰再也直不起来了。他有时下床，扶着一个剃头担子上用的高板凳，格登格登地走一截，平常就只好半躺下靠在一摞被窝上。他不能用自己的肩膀为女儿挣几件新衣裳，买两枝花，却只能由女儿用一双手养活自己了。还不到五十岁的男子汉，只能做一点老太婆做的事：绩了一捆又一捆的供女儿结网用的麻线。事情很清楚：巧云不会撇下她这个老实可怜的残废爹。谁要愿意，只能上这家来当一个倒插门的养老女婿。谁愿意呢？这家的全部家产只有三间草屋（巧云和爹各住一间，当中是一个小小的堂屋）。老大、老二、老三时不时走来走去，拿眼睛瞟着隔着一层鱼网或者坐在雪白的芦席上的一个苗条的身子。他们的眼睛依然不缺乏爱慕，但是减少了几分急切。
Qiaoyun was seventeen years old, and his fate took a sharp turn. Her father, Huang Haijiao, broke his waist when he jumped high on a heavy burden, fell off a three-foot-high springboard, and broke his waist. At first, I thought it didn't matter, just raise it. I didn't want to drink a lot of medicinal wine and put a lot of plasters on it, but it didn't work. Her father was half paralyzed, and his waist could no longer be straightened. Sometimes he got out of bed, held on to a high bench for shaving his head, and walked for a while, usually lying down and leaning on a stack of quilts. He couldn't use his shoulders to buy a few new clothes for his daughter and buy two flowers, but he could only support himself with his daughter's hands. A man who is not yet fifty years old can only do a little of what an old woman does: bundles of twine for his daughter to weave nets. Things are clear: Qiaoyun will not leave her honest and poor crippled father. Whoever wants to do so can only go to this house to be a pensioner's son-in-law with an upside-down door. Who wants to? There are only three thatched houses in this family (Qiaoyun and his father each live in one, and one of them is a small hall). The eldest, second, and third children walked around from time to time, glancing at a slender body through a layer of fishing nets or sitting on a snow-white reed mat. Their eyes were still not lacking in admiration, but they were a little less eager.老锡匠告诫十一子不要老往淖东头跑，但是小锡匠还短不了要来。大娘、大婶、姑娘、媳妇有旧壶翻新，总喜欢叫小锡匠来；从大淖过深巷上大街也要经过这里，巧云家门前的柳阴是一个等待雇主的好地方。巧云织席，十一子化锡，正好做伴。有时巧云停下活计，帮小锡匠拉风箱。有时巧云要回家看看她的残废爹，问他想不想吃烟喝水，小锡匠就压住炉里的火，帮她织一气席。巧云的手指划破了（织席很容易划破手，压扁的芦苇薄片，刀一样地锋快），十一子就帮她吮吸指头肚子上的血。巧云从十一子口里知道他家里的事：他是个独子，没有兄弟姐妹。他有一个老娘，守寡多年了。他娘在家给人家做针线，眼睛越来越不好，他很担心她有一天会瞎……
The old tinsmith warned the eleventh son not to run to the east of the nao all the time, but the little tinsmith was not long in coming. Aunts, aunts, girls, and daughters-in-law have old pots renovated and always like to call the little tinsmith; from the big nao to the deep alley to the street, you also have to pass here, and the willow shade in front of Qiaoyun's house is a good place to wait for the employer. Qiaoyun weaves mats, and the eleventh son turns tin, just as a companion. Sometimes Qiaoyun stops working and helps the little tinsmith pull the bellows. Sometimes Qiaoyun wanted to go home to see her crippled father and ask him if he wanted to smoke and drink water, and the little tinsmith would suppress the fire in the stove and help her weave a mat. Qiaoyun's fingers were cut (the mat was easy to scratch her hands, the flattened reeds were as sharp as a knife), and Eleven helped her suck the blood on her fingers and stomach. Qiaoyun knew about his family from the mouth of the eleventh son: he was an only son and had no brothers or sisters. He has an old mother who has been widowed for many years. His mother was doing needlework for others at home, and her eyes were getting worse and worse, and he was very worried that she would be blind one day......好心的大人路过时会想：这倒真是两只鸳鸯，可是配不成对。一家要招一个养老女婿，一家要接一个当家媳妇，弄不到一起。他们俩呢，只是很愿意在一处谈谈坐坐。都到岁数了，心里不是没有。只是像一片薄薄的云，飘过来，飘过去，下不成雨。
Kind-hearted adults will think when passing by: These are really two mandarin ducks, but they are not a match. A family wants to recruit a son-in-law for the elderly, and a family wants to pick up a daughter-in-law, but they can't get it together. As for the two of them, they are just willing to talk and sit in one place. It's all about the age of sitting, and it's not that I don't have it. It's just like a thin cloud, floating over, floating over, and it can't rain.有一天晚上，好月亮，巧云到淖边一只空船上去洗衣裳（这里的船泊定后，把浆拖到岸上，寄放在熟人家，船就拴在这里，无人看管，谁都可以上去）。她正在船头把身子往前倾着，用力涮着一件大衣裳，一个不知轻重的顽皮野孩子轻轻走到她身后，伸出两手咯吱她的腰。她冷不妨，一头栽进了水里。她本会一点水，但是一下子懵了。这几天水又大，流很急。她挣扎了两下，喊救人，接连喝了几口水。她被水冲走了！正赶上十一子在炕房门外土坪上打拳，看见一个人冲了过来，头发在水上漂着。他褪下鞋子，一猛子扎到水底，从水里把她托了起来。
One night, on the good moon, Qiaoyun went to an empty boat by the mud to wash clothes (after the boat here was anchored, the pulp was dragged to the shore and stored at an acquaintance's house, and the boat was tied here, unattended, and anyone could go up). She was leaning forward at the bow of the boat, soaking up a coat, and a naughty wild child who didn't know the weight walked behind her gently and stretched out his hands to squeak her waist. She was cold and plunged headlong into the water. She would have had a little water, but she was stunned. The water has been heavy and fast these days. She struggled twice, shouted for help, and drank a few sips of water in succession. She was swept away by the water! Just as he was catching up with Shiyi Zi punching on the dirt flat outside the kang room, he saw a person rushing over, his hair floating on the water. He took off his shoes, and Yi Meng Zi plunged to the bottom of the water and lifted her up from the water.十一子把她肚子里的水控了出来，巧云还是昏迷不醒。十一子只好把她横抱着，像抱一个婴儿似的，把她送回去。她浑身是湿的，软绵绵，热乎乎的。十一子觉得巧云紧紧挨着他，越挨越紧。十一子的心怦怦地跳。
Eleven Zi controlled the water in her stomach, but Qiaoyun was still unconscious. Eleven Zi had to hug her horizontally, like a baby, and send her back. She was wet, soft, and hot. Eleven Zi felt that Qiaoyun was close to him, getting tighter and tighter. Eleven Son's heart was pounding.到了家，巧云醒来了。（她早就醒来了！）十一子把她放在床上。巧云换了湿衣裳（月光照出她的美丽的少女的身体）。十一子抓一把草，给她熬了半铞子姜糖水，让她喝下去，就走了。
When she got home, Qiaoyun woke up. (She woke up a long time ago!) Eleven Zi put her on the bed. Qiaoyun changed into wet clothes (the moonlight shone on her beautiful girl's body). Shiyi Zi grabbed a handful of grass, boiled half a ginger syrup for her, asked her to drink it, and left.巧云起来关了门，躺下。她好像看见自己躺在床上的样子。月亮真好。
巧云在心里说：“你是个呆子！”
她说出声来了。
不大一会，她也就睡死了。
就在这一天夜里，另外一个人，拨开了巧云家的门。
Qiaoyun got up, closed the door, and lay down. She seemed to see herself lying on the bed. The moon is so good. Qiaoyun said in his heart: "You are a fool! ” She spoke up. After a while, she fell asleep. On this night, another person opened the door of Qiaoyun's house.五
Five由轮船公司对面的巷子转东大街，往西不远，有一个道士观，叫做炼阳观。现在没有道士了，里面住了不到一营水上保安队。这水上保安队是地方武装。他们名义上归县政府官辖，饷银却由县商会开销，水上保安队的任务是下乡剿土匪。这一带土匪很多，他们抢了人，绑了票，大都藏匿在芦荡湖泊中的船上（这地方到处是水），如遇追捕，便于脱逃。因此，地方绅商觉得很需要成立一个特殊的武装力量来对付这些成帮结伙的土匪。水上保安队装备是很好的。他们乘的船是“铁板划子”——船的三面都有半人高、三四分厚的铁板，子弹是打不透的。铁板划子就停在大淖岸边，样子很高傲。一有任务，就看见大兵们扛着两挺水机关，用箩筐抬着多半筐子弹（子弹不用箱装，却使箩抬，颇奇怪），上了船，开走了。
From the alley opposite the steamship company to East Street, not far to the west, there is a Taoist temple called Lianyang Temple. Now there are no Taoist priests, and there is less than a battalion of water security teams living inside. This water security team is a local armed force. They are nominally under the jurisdiction of the county government, but the salary is paid by the county chamber of commerce, and the task of the water security team is to go to the countryside to suppress bandits. There are many bandits in this area, they rob people, tie up tickets, and hide in boats in Ludang Lake (this place is full of water). Therefore, local gentry and merchants felt the need to set up a special armed force to deal with these gangs of bandits. The water security team is very well equipped. The boat they ride on is an "iron plate paddle" - there are iron plates half a person high and three or four points thick on three sides of the boat, and bullets cannot penetrate. The iron plate paddle was parked on the shore of the big mud, looking very arrogant. As soon as there was a task, I saw the soldiers carrying two water mechanisms, carrying most of the baskets of bullets in baskets (bullets are not boxed, but they are carried by baskets, which is quite strange), got on the boat, and drove away.或七八天，或十天半月，他们得胜回来了（他们有铁板划子，又有水机关，对土匪有压倒优势，很少有伤亡）。铁板划子靠了岸，上岸列队，由深巷，上大街，直奔县政府。这队伍是四列纵队。前面是号队。这不到一营的人，却有十二支号。一上大街，就“打打打滴打大打滴大打”，齐齐整整地吹起来。后面是全队弟兄，一律荷枪实弹。号队之后，大队之前的正中，是捉来的土匪。有时三个五个，有时只有一个，都是五花大绑。这队伍是很神气的。最妙的是被绑着的土匪也一律都合着号音，步伐整齐，雄赳赳气昂昂地走着。甚至值日官喊“一、二、三、四”，他们也随着大声地喊。大队上街之前，要由地保事先通知沿街店铺，凡有鸟笼的（有的店铺是养八哥、画眉的），都要收起来，因为土匪大哥看见不高兴，这是他们忌讳的（他们到了县政府，都下在大狱里，看见笼中鸟，就无出狱希望了）。看看这样的铜号放光，刺刀雪亮，还夹着几个带有传奇色彩的土匪英雄的威武雄壮的队伍，是这条街上的民众的一件快乐事情。其快乐程度不下于看狮子、龙灯、高跷、抬阁和僧道齐全、六十四杠的大出丧。
Or seven or eight days, or ten and a half days, they came back victorious (they had iron plate paddles and water mechanisms, and had an overwhelming advantage over bandits, and there were few casualties). The iron plate paddles docked on the shore, went ashore and lined up, from the deep alleys to the streets, and went straight to the county government. This team is a four-column column. In front is the trumpet team. This is less than a battalion, but there are twelve trumpets. As soon as they went on the street, they "beat and beat big and beat", and they blew up neatly. Behind them were the brothers of the whole team, all armed with live ammunition. After the trumpet team, in the middle of the front of the brigade were the captured bandits. Sometimes there are three or five, sometimes only one, all tied together. This team is very spirited. The best thing is that the tied bandits also all chose the trumpet, walking neatly and majestically with high spirits. Even the officers on duty shouted "one, two, three, four", and they shouted loudly. Before the brigade goes to the street, the land security must notify the shops along the street in advance, and all those with bird cages (some shops raise starlings and thrushes) must be put away, because the bandit brother is unhappy when he sees it, which is taboo for them (when they arrive at the county government, they are all in prison, and when they see the caged bird, they have no hope of being released from prison). Looking at such a brass trumpet shining, the bayonets are shining, and there are several legendary bandit heroes in the majestic and majestic team, it is a happy thing for the people on this street. Its happiness is no less than watching lions, dragon lanterns, stilts, pavilions and monks and Taoists, and the sixty-four bars.除了下乡办差，保安队的弟兄们没有什么事。他们除了把两挺水机关扛到大淖边突突地打两梭（把淖岸上的泥土打得簌簌地往下掉），平常是难得出操、打野外的。使人们感觉到这营把人的存在的，是这十二个号兵早晚练号。早晨八九点钟，下午四五点钟，他们就到大淖边来了。先是拔长音，然后各自吹几段，最后是合吹进行曲、三环号（他们吹三环号只是吹着玩，因为从来没有接受检阅的时候）。吹完号，就解散，想干什么干什么。有的，就轻手轻脚，走进一家的门外，咳嗽一声，随着，走了进去，门就关起来了。
Except for going to the countryside to do errands, the brothers in the security team had nothing to do. In addition to carrying two water mechanisms to the edge of the marsh and suddenly hitting two shuttles (beating the soil on the mud bank down with a rustle), it is usually difficult to practice and fight in the wild. What makes people feel the existence of this battalion is that these twelve trumpeters practice horns in the morning and evening. At eight or nine o'clock in the morning and four or five o'clock in the afternoon, they came to the edge of the marsh. First, they played a long note, then each played a few sections, and finally played the march and the three-ring horn together (they played the three-ring horn just for fun, because they were never reviewed). After blowing the horn, they disbanded and did whatever they wanted. Some, they walked into the door of a house, coughed, and then walked in, and the door closed.这些号兵大都衣着整齐，干净爱俏。他们除了吹吹号，整天无事干，有的是闲空。他们的钱来得容易，——饷钱倒不多，但每次下乡，总有犒赏；有时与土匪遭遇，双方谈条件，也常从对方手中得到一笔钱，手面很大方，花钱不在乎。他们是保护地方绅商的军人，身后有靠山，即或出一点什么事，谁也无奈他何。因此，这些大爷就觉得不风流风流，实在对不起自己，也辜负了别人。
Most of these trumpeters are neatly dressed, clean and pretty. They have nothing to do all day except blowing the trumpet, and some are idle. Their money comes easily,—— and the salary is not much, but every time they go to the countryside, there is always a reward; sometimes when encountering bandits, the two sides negotiate conditions, and often get a sum of money from each other, and they are very generous and don't care about spending money. They are soldiers who protect local gentry and businessmen, and they have backers behind them, even if something happens, no one can do anything about it. Therefore, these uncles feel that they are not romantic, and they are really sorry for themselves and have let others down.十二个号兵，有一个号长，姓刘，大家都叫他刘号长。这刘号长前后跟大淖几家的媳妇都很熟。
拨开巧云家的门的，就是这个号长！
号长走的时候留下十块钱。
Twelve soldiers, one of whom is surnamed Liu, and everyone calls him Captain Liu. This captain Liu is very familiar with the daughters-in-law of the Danao family. The one who opened the door of Qiaoyun's house was this captain! When the captain left, he left ten yuan.这种事在大淖不是第一次发生。巧云的残废爹当时就知道了。他拿着这十块钱，只是长长地叹了一口气。邻居们知道了，姑娘、媳妇并未多议论，只骂了一句：“这个该死的！”
This is not the first time this kind of thing has happened in Danao. Qiaoyun's crippled father knew at the time. He took the ten yuan and just let out a long sigh. The neighbors found out, but the girl and daughter-in-law didn't talk much, only scolded: "This damn it!" ”巧云破了身子，她没有淌眼泪，更没有想到跳到淖里淹死。人生在世，总有这么一遭！只是为什么是这个人？真不该是这个人！怎么办？拿把菜刀杀了他？放火烧了炼阳观？不行！她还有个残废爹。她怔怔地坐在床上，心里乱糟糟的。她想起该起来烧早饭了。她还得结网，织席，还得上街。她想起小时候上人家看新娘子，新娘子穿了一双粉红的缎子花鞋。她想起她的远在天边的妈。她记不得妈的样子，只记得妈用一个筷子头蘸了胭脂给她点了一点眉心红。她拿起镜子照照，她好像第一次看清楚自己的模样。她想起十一子给她吮手指上的血，这血一定是咸的。她觉得对不起十一子，好像自己做错了什么事。她非常失悔：没有把自己给了十一子！
Qiaoyun broke her body, she didn't shed tears, let alone jump into the mud and drown. In life, there is always such a thing! But why is this person? It really shouldn't be this person! What to do? Kill him with a kitchen knife? Set fire to the Lianyang Temple? No way! She also has a crippled father. She sat on the bed in a daze, her heart in a mess. She remembered that it was time to get up and cook breakfast. She still had to weave nets, weave mats, and go to the streets. She remembered that when she was a child, she went to see the bride, and the bride wore a pair of pink satin flower shoes. She thought of her mother who was far away. She couldn't remember what her mother looked like, only that her mother dipped a chopstick tip in rouge and gave her a little eyebrow blush. She picked up the mirror and looked at it, as if she was seeing her appearance clearly for the first time. She remembered that Eleven Son sucked the blood on her finger, and the blood must be salty. She felt sorry for Eleven Son, as if she had done something wrong. She was very regretful: she didn't give herself to Eleven Son!她的这个念头越来越强烈。这个号长来一次，她的念头就更强烈一分。
水上保安队又下乡了。
一天，巧云找到十一子，说：“晚上你到大淖东边来，我有话跟你说。”
Her thought became stronger and stronger. Once this captain came, her thoughts became even stronger. The water security team went to the countryside again. One day, Qiaoyun found Eleven Son and said, "You come to the east of Danao in the evening, I have something to tell you." ”十一子到了淖边。巧云踏在一只“鸭撇子”上（放鸭子用的小船，极小，仅容一人。这是一只公船，平常就拴在淖边。大淖人谁都可以撑着它到沙洲上挑蒌蒿，割茅草，拣野鸭蛋），把篙子一点，撑向淖中央的沙洲，对十一子说：“你来！”
Eleven Sons arrived at the edge of the marsh. Qiaoyun stepped on a "duck skimmer" (a small boat for ducks, extremely small, only for one person. This is a public boat, usually tied to the edge of the marsh. Anyone in the big nao can carry it to the sandbar to pick mugwort, cut thatch, and pick wild duck eggs), put a pole on the sandbar, prop it up to the sandbar in the center of the marsh, and say to Eleven Son: "You come!" ”过了一会，十一子泅水到了沙洲上。
他们在沙洲的茅草丛里一直呆到月到中天。
月亮真好啊！
六
After a while, Eleven Zi swam to the sandbar. They stayed in the thatched thickets of the sandbar until the middle of the month. The moon is so good! Six十一子和巧云的事，师兄们都知道，只瞒着老锡匠一个人。他们偷偷地给他留着门，在门窝子里倒了水（这样推门进来没有声音）。十一子常常到天快亮的时候才回来。有一天，又是这时候才推开门。刚刚要钻被窝，听见老锡匠说：
The senior brothers knew about the eleventh son and Qiaoyun, and they only hid it from the old tinsmith. They secretly kept the door for him and poured water into the door socket (so that there was no sound when the door was pushed in). Eleven often didn't come back until dawn. One day, it was at this time that the door was pushed open again. Just as he was about to get into the bed, he heard the old tinsmith say:“你不要命啦！”
"You don't want to die!"这种事情怎么瞒得住人呢？终于，传到刘号长的耳朵里。其实没有人跟他嚼舌头，刘号长自己还不知道？巧云看见他都讨厌，她的全身都是冷淡的。刘号长咽不下这口气。本来，他跟巧云又没有拜过堂，完过花烛，闲花野草，断了就断了。可是一个小锡匠，夺走了他的人，这丢了当兵的脸。太岁头上动土，这还行！这种事从来没有发生过。连保安队的弟兄也都觉得面上无光，在人前矬了一截。他是只许自己在别人头上拉屎撒尿，不许别人在他脸上溅一星唾沫的。若是闭着眼过去，往后，保安队的人还混不混了？
How can this kind of thing be hidden from others? Finally, it reached the ears of Captain Liu. In fact, no one chewed his tongue with him, and Captain Liu himself didn't know? Qiaoyun hated him when she saw him, and her whole body was cold. Commander Liu couldn't swallow this breath. Originally, he and Qiaoyun had never worshipped in court, and they had finished the candles, idle flowers and weeds, and they would break if they were broken. But a little tinsmith took away his people, which was a disgrace to be a soldier. Tai Sui broke ground on his head, which is okay! This kind of thing has never happened. Even the brothers in the security team felt dull on their faces and scolded in front of others. He only allowed himself to poop and pee on other people's heads, and did not allow others to spit on his face. If you go over with your eyes closed, will the security team still mix in the future?有一天，天还没亮，刘号长带了几个弟兄，踢开巧云家的门，从被窝里拉起了小锡匠，把他捆了起来。把黄海蛟、巧云的手脚也都捆了，怕他们去叫人。
One day, before dawn, Liu Haochang took a few brothers, kicked open the door of Qiaoyun's house, pulled the little tinsmith out of the bed, and tied him up. Huang Haijiao and Qiaoyun's hands and feet were also tied, for fear that they would call someone.他们把小锡匠弄到泰山庙后面的坟地里，一人一根棍子，搂头盖脸地打他。
他们要小锡匠卷铺盖走人，回他的兴化，不许再留在大淖。
小锡匠不说话。
他们要小锡匠答应不再走进黄家的门，不挨巧云的身子。
They took the little tinsmith to the cemetery behind the Taishan Temple, and beat him with a stick and covered his head. They asked the little tinsmith to roll up and leave, return to his Xinghua, and not stay in Danao anymore. The little tinsmith didn't speak. They asked the little tinsmith to promise not to walk into the door of the Huang family again, and not to be close to Qiaoyun's body.小锡匠还是不说话。
他们要小锡匠告一声饶，认一个错。
小锡匠的牙咬得紧紧的。
The little tinsmith still didn't speak. They asked the little tinsmith to say forgiveness and admit a mistake. The little tinsmith's teeth were clenched.小锡匠的硬铮把这些向来是横着膀子走路的家伙惹怒了，“你这样硬！打不死你！”——“打”，七八根棍子风一样、雨一样打在小锡匠的身子。
小锡匠被他们打死了。
The little tinsmith's stiffness angered these guys who had always walked cross-armed, "You are so hard! I can't beat you to death!" ——"Hit", seven or eight sticks hit the little tinsmith's body like wind and rain. The little tinsmith was beaten to death by them.锡匠们听说十一子被保安队的人绑走了，他们四处找，找到了泰山庙。
The tinsmiths heard that Eleven Son had been kidnapped by the security team, and they searched around and found the Taishan Temple.老锡匠用手一探，十一子还有一丝悠悠气。老锡匠叫人赶紧去找陈年的尿桶。他经验过这种事，打死的人，只有喝了从桶里刮出来的尿碱，才有救。
十一子的牙关咬得很紧，灌不进去。
The old tinsmith reached out with his hand, and there was still a trace of leisure in the eleventh son. The old tinsmith asked people to hurry up and find the old urine bucket. He had experienced this kind of thing, and the person who killed him could only be saved if he drank the urine alkali scraped out of the bucket. Eleven's teeth were very tight and could not be inserted.巧云捧了一碗尿碱汤，在十一子的耳边说：“十一子，十一子，你喝了！”
十一子微微听见一点声音，他睁了睁眼。巧云把一碗尿碱汤灌进了十一子的喉咙。
不知道为什么，她自己也尝了一口。
Qiaoyun held a bowl of urine-alkali soup and said in Eleven's ear: "Eleven, Eleven, you drink it!" ” Eleven Son heard a slight sound, and he opened his eyes. Qiaoyun poured a bowl of urine-alkali soup into Eleven's throat. I don't know why, but she took a bite herself.锡匠们摘了一块门板，把十一子放在门板上，往家里抬。
他们抬着十一子，到了大淖东头，还要往西走。巧云拦住了：
“不要。抬到我家里。”
老锡匠点点头。
The tinsmiths took off a door panel, put the eleventh son on the door panel, and carried it home. They carried the eleventh son to the east end of the big nao, and they had to go west. Qiaoyun stopped: "Don't. Carry it to my house. ” The old tinsmith nodded.巧云把屋里存着的鱼网和芦席都拿到街上卖了，买了七厘散，医治十一子身子里的瘀血。
东头的几家大娘、大婶杀了下蛋的老母鸡，给巧云送来了。
锡匠们凑了钱，买了人参，熬了参汤。
Qiaoyun took the fish nets and reed mats stored in the house to the street and sold them, bought seven cents, and healed the blood stasis in the body of the eleventh son. Several aunts and aunts in the east killed the old hen that laid eggs and sent them to Qiaoyun. The tinsmiths pooled money, bought ginseng, and boiled ginseng soup.挑夫，锡匠，姑娘，媳妇，川流不息地来看望十一子。他们把平时在辛苦而单调的生活中不常表现的热情和好心都拿出来了。他们觉得十一子和巧云做的事都很应该，很对。大淖出了这样一对年轻人，使他们觉得骄傲。大家的心喜洋洋，热乎乎的，好像在过年。
Porters, tinsmiths, girls, daughters-in-law, and the river flowed endlessly to visit Eleven. They took out the enthusiasm and kindness that they usually don't often show in their hard and monotonous lives. They felt that what Eleven Son and Qiaoyun did was very appropriate and right. Da Nao produced such a pair of young people, which made them feel proud. Everyone's hearts were overjoyed and warm, as if they were celebrating the New Year.刘号长打了人，不敢再露面。他那几个弟兄也都躲在保安队的队部里不出来。保安队的门口加了双岗。这些好汉原来都是一窝“草鸡”！
锡匠们开了会。他们向县政府递了呈子，要求保安队把姓刘的交出来。
Liu Haochang beat someone and did not dare to show up again. His brothers also hid in the headquarters of the security team and did not come out. A double post was added to the door of the security team. These heroes turned out to be a nest of "grass chickens"! The tinsmiths held a meeting. They handed over a petition to the county government and asked the security team to hand over the one surnamed Liu.县政府没有答复。
The county government did not respond.锡匠们上街游行。这个游行队伍是很多人从未见过的。没有旗子，没有标语，就是二十来个锡匠挑着二十来副锡匠担子，在全城的大街上慢慢地走。这是个沉默的队伍，但是非常严肃。他们表现出不可侵犯的威严和不可动摇的决心。这个带有中世纪行帮色彩的游行队伍十分动人。
The tinsmiths marched through the streets. This procession was something many people had never seen before. There were no flags, no slogans, just about 20 tinsmiths carrying more than 20 pairs of tinsmiths' burdens and walking slowly on the streets of the city. This was a silent procession, but very serious. They showed inviolable majesty and unshakable determination. This parade with medieval gang colors is very moving.游行继续了三天。
The march continued for three days.第三天，他们举行了“顶香请愿”。二十来个锡匠，在县政府照壁前坐着，每人头上用木盘顶着一炉炽旺的香。这是一个古老的风俗：民有沉冤，官不受理，被逼急了的百姓可以用香火把县大堂烧了，据说这不算犯法。
On the third day, they held a "petition for incense". More than 20 tinsmiths sat in front of the county government, each holding a burning incense burner on a wooden plate on their heads. This is an ancient custom: if the people have grievances, the officials will not accept them, and the people who are forced can burn the county lobby with incense, which is said to be not illegal.这条规矩不载于《六法全书》，现在不是大清国，县政府可以不理会这种“陋习”。但是这些锡匠是横了心的，他们当真干起来，后果是严重的。县长邀请县里的绅商商议，一致认为这件事不能再不管。于是由商会会长出面，约请了有关的人：一个承审——作为县长代表，保安队的副官，老锡匠和另外两个年长的锡匠，还有代表挑夫的黄海龙，四邻见证，——卖眼镜的宝应人，卖天竺筷的杭州人，在一家大茶馆里举行会谈，来“了”这件事。
This rule is not contained in the "Complete Book of Six Laws", and now it is not the Qing Dynasty, and the county government can ignore this "bad habit". But these tinsmiths were cross-hearted, and if they really did it, the consequences would be serious. The county magistrate invited the gentry and businessmen in the county to discuss, and agreed that this matter could no longer be ignored. So the president of the Chamber of Commerce came forward and invited the relevant people: a judge - as a representative of the county magistrate, the adjutant of the security team, the old tinsmith and two other older tinsmiths, as well as Huang Hailong, who represented the porters, and the neighbors witnessed the ,——Baoying people who sold glasses and Hangzhou people who sold Tianzhu chopsticks, held talks in a large teahouse and "came" about this matter.会谈的结果是：小锡匠养伤的药钱由保安队负担（实际是商会拿钱），刘号长驱逐出境。由刘号长画押具结。老锡匠觉得这样就给锡匠和挑夫都挣了面子，可以见好就收了。只是要求在刘某人的甘结上写上一条：如果他再踏进县城一步，任凭老锡匠一个人把他收拾了！
The result of the talks was that the medicine money for the little tinsmith's healing was borne by the security team (in fact, the Chamber of Commerce took the money), and Liu was expelled. Liu Haochang drew the escort knot. The old tinsmith felt that this would earn face for both the tinsmith and the porter, and he could accept it when he saw it. Just asked to write a piece on Liu's sweet knot: If he takes another step into the county seat, let the old tinsmith clean him up alone!过了两天，刘号长就由两个弟兄持枪护送，悄悄地走了。他被调到三垛去当了税警。
十一子能进一点饮食，能说话了。巧云问他：
Two days later, Captain Liu was escorted by two brothers with guns and left quietly. He was transferred to Sanduo to become a tax policeman. Eleven can eat a little and can talk. Qiaoyun asked him:“他们打你，你只要说不再进我家的门，就不打你了，你就不会吃这样大的苦了。你为什么不说？”
“你要我说么？”
“不要。”
“我知道你不要。”
“你值么？”
“我值。”
"If they beat you, as long as you say that you won't enter my house again, they won't beat you, and you won't suffer so much. Why don't you say it? ” "Do you want me to say it?" "Don't." "I know you don't." "Are you worth it?" "I'm worth it."“十一子，你真好！我喜欢你！你快点好。”
“你亲我一下，我就好得快。”
“好，亲你！”
"Eleven Son, you are so good! I like you! Hurry up. ” "You kiss me, and I'll get better quickly." "Okay, kiss you!"巧云一家有了三张嘴。两个男的不能挣钱，但要吃饭。大淖东头的人家都没有积蓄，也没有什么东西可以变卖典押。结鱼网，打芦席，都不能当时见钱。十一子的伤一时半会不会好，日子长了，怎么过呢？巧云没有经过太多考虑，把爹用过的箩筐找出来，磕磕尘土，就去挑担挣“活钱”去了。姑娘媳妇都很佩服她。起初她们怕她挑不惯，后来看她脚下很快，很匀，也就放心了。从此，巧云就和邻居的姑娘媳妇在一起，挑着紫红的荸荠、碧绿的菱角、雪白的连枝藕，风摆柳似地穿街过市，发髻的一侧插着大红花。她的眼睛还是那么亮，长睫毛忽扇忽扇的。但是眼神显得更深沉，更坚定了。她从一个姑娘变成了一个很能干的小媳妇。
Qiaoyun's family has three mouths. The two men can't make money, but they have to eat. The people in the east end of Danao have no savings, and they have nothing to sell and pawn. Tie fish nets and play reed mats, but you can't see the money at that time. Will the eleventh son's injury heal for a while, how will he live after a long time? Qiaoyun didn't think too much, found out the basket his father used, knocked dust, and went to pick up the burden to earn "living money". The girl and daughter-in-law admired her very much. At first, they were afraid that she would not be used to picking, but later they saw that her feet were fast and even, so they were relieved. Since then, Qiaoyun has been with the neighbor's girl and daughter-in-law, picking purple and red water chestnuts, turquoise water chestnuts, and snow-white lotus roots, and walking through the streets like willows, with big red flowers inserted on one side of her bun. Her eyes are still so bright, and her long eyelashes are flapping. But the eyes look deeper and more determined. She has changed from a girl to a very capable little daughter-in-law.十一子的伤会好么？
会。
当然会！
一九八一年二月四日，旧历大年三十

七里茶坊

七里茶坊[1]
我在七里茶坊住过几天。
[3] Half wonton and half noodles together, locally called dumpling noodles. Qili Tea House {{id_0000}} I stayed at Qili Tea House for a few days.我很喜欢七里茶坊这个地名。这地方在张家口东南七里，当初想必是有一些茶坊的。中国的许多计里的地名，大都是行路人给取的。如三里河、二里沟、三十里铺。七里茶坊大概也是这样。远来的行人到了这里，说：“快到了，还有七里，到茶坊里喝一口再走。”送客上路的，到了这里，客人就说：“已经送出七里了，请回吧！”主客到茶坊又喝了一壶茶，说了些话，出门一揖，就此分别了。七里茶坊一定萦系过很多人的感情。不过现在却并无一家茶坊。我去找了找，连遗址也无人知道。“茶坊”是古语，在《清明上河图》、《东京梦华录》、《水浒传》里还能见到。现在一般都叫“茶馆”了。可见，这地名的由来已久。
I like the place name Qili Tea House very much. This place is seven miles southeast of Zhangjiakou, and there must have been some tea houses at the beginning. Most of the place names in China are given by passers-by. Such as Sanli River, Erligou, and Thirty Lipu. The same is probably true for Qili Tea House. Pedestrians from afar arrived here and said, "It's almost here, there are still seven miles left, go to the tea house for a sip before leaving." The guest sent the guest on the road, and when he arrived here, the guest said, "Seven miles have been sent out, please go back!" The host went to the teahouse and drank another pot of tea, said some words, bowed when he went out, and parted. Qili Tea House must have haunted many people's feelings. But there is no tea house now. I went to look for it, and no one even knew the ruins. "Tea house" is an ancient saying, which can still be seen in "Qingming River Map", "Tokyo Menghualu", and "Water Margin". Now it is generally called "teahouse". It can be seen that this place name has a long history.这是一个中国北方的普通的市镇。有一个供销社，货架上空空的，只有几包火柴、一堆杮饼。两只乌金釉的酒坛子擦得很亮，放在旁边的酒提子却是干的。柜台上放着一盆麦麸子做的大酱。有一个理发店，两张椅子，没有理发的，理发员坐着打瞌睡。有一个邮局。一个新华书店，只有几套毛选和一些小册子。路口矗着一面黑板，写着鼓动冬季积肥的快板，文后署名“文化馆宣”，说明这里还有个文化馆。快板里写道：“天寒地冻百不咋[2]，心里装着全天下。”轰轰烈烈的大跃进已经过去，这种豪言壮语已经失去热力。前两天下过一场小雨，雨点在黑板上抽打出一条一条斜道。路很宽，是土路。两旁的住户人家，也都是土墙土顶（这地方风雪大，房顶多是平的）。连路边的树也都带着黄土的颜色。这个长城以外的土色的冬天的市镇，使人起悲凉的感觉。
This is an ordinary town in northern China. There is a supply and marketing cooperative, and the shelves are empty, with only a few packs of matches and a bunch of cakes. This is the first time I have lived in this kind of carriage and horse shop. I have been working in a research institute of agricultural sciences for two years. Digging out the public toilet is actually not digging, but chiseling. It was so cold that the dung in the septic tank was frozen, so it had to be chiseled with an ice shovel, broken into ice cubes of one or two square sizes, picked up with a shovel, loaded on a single set of vehicles, transported to the Qili Tea House, and piled up in the empty field outside the street. There is always some thin manure at the bottom of the pond that has not been frozen, so it is scraped out and poured into the dry soil laid in advance, reconciled like mud. Lao Liu is an old long-term worker, an old bachelor. He has worked as a long-term worker in several counties in Zhangjiakou District, and when he was young, he went to the dam to cut wheat every year. Because he has been a long-term worker for many years, he is proficient in all crop work. He had a wife and ran away because he couldn't support her. The head was a tall man, in his fifties, with a rectangular face and a fiery red fox skin hat. One was in his forties, a short and fat man with several large acne scars on his face and a dogskin hat. The other was a young man who was about the same age as Xiao Wang, and his snow-white goat-headed hat covered his eyes, making him look like a girl. ——His face was rosy, and his eyes were so good-looking! They were all holding a short stick more than two feet long with six wooden sticks. Although he had been beating outside the door for a long time just now, there were still a lot of snowflakes stuck to his hat and body.掌柜的说：“给你们作饭？——带着面了吗？”
“带着哩。”
后生解开老羊皮袄， 取出一口面口袋。——他把面口袋系在腰带上，怪不道他看起来身上鼓鼓囊囊的。
“推窝窝？”
The shopkeeper said, "Cook for you? ——Did you bring noodles?" ” "With it." The young man unbuttoned his old sheepskin jacket and took out a face pocket. ——He tied the face pocket to his belt, no wonder he looked bulging. "Push the nest?"高个儿把面口袋交给掌柜的：
“不吃莜面！一天吃莜面。你给俺们到老乡家换几个粑粑头[6]吃。多时不吃粑粑头，想吃个粑粑头。把火弄得旺旺的，烧点水，俺们喝一口。——没酒？”
The tall man handed the face pocket to the shopkeeper: "Don't eat noodles! Eat noodles a day. You go to our fellow villagers to exchange for a few baba heads [6] to eat. I don't eat baba tou for a long time, I want to eat a baba head. Make the fire vigorous, boil some water, and let's take a sip. ——No wine? ”“没。”
“没咸菜？”
“没。”
“那就甜[7]吃！”
"Nothing." "No pickles?" "Nothing." "Then eat sweet [7]!"老刘小声跟我说：“是坝上来的。坝上人管窝窝头叫粑粑头。是赶牲口的，——赶牛的。你看他们拿的六道木的棍子。”随即，他和这三个坝上人搭起来：
“今天一早从张北动的身？”
Lao Liu whispered to me: "It's from the dam." The people on the dam call the head of the nest called Ba Ba Tou. It is the one who drives the livestock ,—— the cattle. Look at the six wooden sticks they are holding. Immediately, he and the three people on the dam got up {{id_0000}}: "Moved from Zhang Bei early this morning?"“是。——这天气！”
“就你们仨？”
“还有仨。”
“那仨呢？”
“在十多里外，两头牛掉进雪窟窿里了。他们仨在往上弄。俺们把其余的牛先送到食品公司屠宰场，到店里等他们。”
"Yes. - This weather! ” "Just the three of you?" "There are still three." "What about the three?" "More than ten miles away, two cows fell into a snow hole. The three of them are going up. We sent the rest of the cows to the food company's slaughterhouse first and waited for them in the store. ”“这样天气，你们还往下送牛？”
“没法子。快过年了。过年，怎么也得叫坝下人吃上一口肉！”
"In such weather, are you still sending cattle down?" "No way. It's almost the New Year. During the New Year, you have to ask the people under the dam to eat a bite of meat! ”不大一会，掌柜的搞了粑粑头和几个腌蔓菁来。他们把粑粑头放在火里烧，水开了，把烧焦的粑粑头拍打拍打，就吃喝起来。
老乔就把我们的酱碗给他们送过去。
“你们那里今年年景咋样？”
After a while, the shopkeeper brought baba heads and a few pickled turnips. They put the baba head in the fire and boiled it, and when the water boiled, they slapped the burnt baba head and ate and drank. Lao Qiao sent our sauce bowl to them. "How is the New Year's Eve there this year?"“好！”高个儿回答得斩钉截铁。显然这是反话，因为痘疤脸和后生都噗嗤一声笑了。
“不是说去年你们已经过了‘黄河’了？”
“过了！那还不过！”
老乔知道他话里有话，就问：
“也是假的？”
"Okay!" The tall man replied categorically. Obviously this is the opposite, because the acne scar face and the young man both laughed. "Didn't you say that you crossed the 'Yellow River' last year?" "It's over! That's not enough! ” Lao Qiao knew that there was something in his words, so he asked: "It's also fake?"“不假。搞了‘标准田’。”
“啥叫‘标准田’？”
“把几块地里打的粮算在一起。”
“其余的地？”
“不算产量。”
"That's right. Engaged in 'standard fields'. ” "What is a 'standard field'?" "Count the grain in several fields together." "The rest of the land?" "It doesn't count as production."“坝上过‘黄河’？不用什么‘科学家’，我就知道，不行！”老刘用了一个很不文雅的字眼说：“过‘黄河’，过毬的个河吧！”
"Crossing the 'Yellow River' on the dam? I don't need any 'scientists', I know, no!" Lao Liu used a very inelegant word and said: "Cross the 'Yellow River', cross the river!" ”老乔解释：“老刘说的对。坝上的土层只有五寸，下面全是石头。坝上一向是广种薄收，要求单位面积产量，是主观主义。”
Lao Qiao explained: "Lao Liu is right. The soil layer on the dam is only five inches, and the bottom is full of stones. The dam has always been widely planted and harvested, and the yield per unit area is required, which is subjectivism. ”痘疤脸说：“就是！俺们和公社的书记说，这产量是虚的。但人家说：有了虚的，就会带来实的。”
后生说：“还说这是：以虚带实。”
我还从来没有听说过“以虚带实”是这样的解释的。
Acne Scarface said: "That's it! We told the secretary of the commune that this output is virtual. But people say: If there is a virtual one, it will bring real things. ” The young man said: "It is also said that this is: with the virtual with the real." ” I have never heard of such an explanation of "bringing reality with falsehood".高个儿沉重地叹了一口气：“这年月！当官的都说谎！”
老刘接口说：“当官的说谎，老百姓遭殃！”
老乔把烟口袋递给他们：
“牲畜不错？”
The tall man sighed heavily: "These years! Officials lie!" ” Lao Liu said: "If an official lies, the people will suffer!" ” Old Joe handed them the cigarette bag: "Good livestock?"“不错！也经不起胡糟践。头二年，大跃进，大炼钢铁，夜战，把牛牵到地里，杀了，在地头架起了大锅，大块大块地煮烂，大伙儿，吃！那会儿吃了个痛快；这会儿，想去吧！——他们仨咋还不来？去看看。”
"Not bad! I can't stand the bad practice. In the first two years, the Great Leap Forward, the Great Leap Forward, the Great Smelting of Steel, the night battle, the cattle were led into the ground, killed, a cauldron was set up on the ground, and the large pieces were boiled, everyone, eat! I had a good meal at that time; at this moment, I want to go! ——Why haven't they come yet? Go and take a look. ”高个儿说着又把老羊皮袄又系紧了。
痘疤脸说：“我们俩去。你啦就甭去了。”
“去！”
他们和掌柜的借了两根木杠，把我们车上的钢绳也借去了，拉开门，就走了。
The tall man said and fastened the old sheepskin jacket again. Acne scarface said, "Let's go. You just don't go." ” "Go!" They borrowed two wooden poles from the shopkeeper, borrowed the steel rope from our car, opened the door, and left.听见后生在门外大声说：“雪更大了！”
老刘起来解手，把地下三根六道木的棍子归在一起，上了炕，说：
“他们真辛苦！”
过了一会，又自言自语地说：
“咱们也很辛苦。”
I heard the young man shouting outside the door: "The snow is bigger!" ” Lao Liu got up to relieve himself, put the three wooden sticks in the ground together, got on the kang, and said: "They are so hard!" After a while, he said to himself: "We are also very hard."老乔一面钻被窝，一面说：
“中国人都很辛苦啊！”
小王已经睡着了。
“过年，怎么也得叫坝下人吃上一口肉！”我老是想着大个儿的这句话，心里很感动，很久未能入睡。这是一句朴素、美丽的话。
Old Joe said while getting into the bed: "Chinese are very hard!" Xiao Wang was already asleep. "For the New Year, you have to ask the people under the dam to eat a bite of meat!" I always thought about this sentence of the big man, and I was very moved, and I couldn't sleep for a long time. This is a simple and beautiful sentence.半夜，朦朦胧胧地听到几个人轻手轻脚走进来，我睁开眼，问：
“牛弄上来了？”
高个儿轻轻地说：
“弄上来了。把你吵醒了！睡吧！”
他们睡在对面的炕上。
In the middle of the night, I vaguely heard a few people walking in lightly, I opened my eyes and asked: "The cow is here?" The tall man said softly: "Get it up. Wake you up!" Go to sleep! ” They slept on the kang opposite.第二天，我们起得很晚。醒来时，这六个赶牛的坝上人已经走了。

The next day, we got up late. When we woke up, the six people on the dam who were driving cattle had already left. Written on May 11, 1981 [1] This article was originally published in the fifth issue of "Harvest" in 1981; "Selected Short Stories of Wang Zengqi", Beijing Publishing House, February 1982.[2] “百不咋”是无所谓、没关系的意思。
[3] 那时农村宣传“共产主义”，都说是“楼上楼下，电灯电话”。慕，是思量、向往的意思。这是很古的语言，元曲中常见。张家口地区保留了很多宋元古语。
[2] "Bai Bu Wei" means indifferent and okay. [3] At that time, the rural propaganda of "communism" was said to be "upstairs and downstairs, electric lights and telephones". Mu means contemplation and yearning. This is a very ancient language, common in Yuan songs. The Zhangjiakou area retains many ancient Song and Yuan languages.[4] 鸡是一种菌，长在白蚁窝上，味极腴美。
[5] “供书”是拿钱供学生读书的意思。
[6] 他们说“粑粑头”，“粑粑”作入声。

鸡毛

鸡毛[1]
西南联大有一个文嫂。
[7] The Zhangjiakou area does not say "light", but "sweet". Chicken feathers{{id_0000}} Southwest Associated University has a literary sister-in-law.她不是西南联大的人。她不属于教职员工，更不是学生。西南联大的各种名册上都没有“文嫂”这个名字。她只是在西南联大里住着，是一个住在联大里的校外的人。然而她又的的确确是“西南联大”的一个组成部分。她住在西南联大的新校舍。
She is not from Southwest Associated University. She is not a faculty member, let alone a student. There is no name "Wen Sao" on the various rosters of Southwest Associated University. She just lives in Southwest Associated University, and she is an off-campus person who lives in the United University. However, she is indeed an integral part of "Southwest Associated University". She lives in the new campus of Southwest Associated University.西南联大有许多部分：新校舍、昆中南院、昆中北院、昆华师范、工学院……其他部分都是借用的原有的房屋，新校舍是新建的，也是联大的主要部分。图书馆、大部分教室、各系的办公室、男生宿舍……都在新校舍。
Southwest Associated University has many parts: the new campus, Kunzhong South Campus, Kunzhong North Campus, Kunhua Normal University, and the School of Engineering...... The other parts are borrowed from the original houses, and the new campus building is newly built and is also the main part of the United University. The library, most of the classrooms, the offices of various departments, and the boys' dormitory...... are all in the new campus.新校舍在昆明大西门外，原是一片荒地。有很多坟，几户零零落落的人家。坟多无主。有的坟主大概已经绝了后，不难处理。有一个很大的坟头，一直还留着，四面环水，如一小岛，春夏之交，开满了野玫瑰，香气袭人，成了一处风景。其余的，都平了。坟前的墓碑，有的相当高大，都搭在几条水沟上，成了小桥。碑上显考显妣的姓名分明可见，全都平躺着了。每天有许多名师大儒、莘莘学子从上面走过。住户呢，由学校出几个钱，都搬迁了。文嫂也是这里的住户。她不搬。说什么也不搬。她说她在这里住惯了。联大的当局是很讲人道主义的，人家不愿搬，不能逼人家走。可是她这两间破破烂烂的草屋，不当不间地戳在那里，实在也不成个样子。新校舍建筑虽然极其简陋，但是是经过土木工程系的名教授设计过的，房屋安排疏密有致，空间利用十分合理。那怎么办呢？主其事者跟文嫂商量，把她两间草房拆了，另外给她盖一间，质料比她原来的要好一些。她同意了，只要求再给她盖一个鸡窝。那好办。
The new school building is outside the west gate of Kunming, which was originally a wasteland. There are many graves and a few scattered families. There are many graves without owners. Some grave owners are probably extinct, so it is not difficult to deal with them. There is a large grave, which has always been preserved, surrounded by water, like a small island, at the turn of spring and summer, full of wild roses, fragrant, and has become a landscape. The rest are flat. The tombstones in front of the graves, some of which are quite tall, are built on several ditches and become small bridges. The names of Xiankao Xianyu are clearly visible on the stele, and they are all lying flat. Many famous teachers and students walk through it every day. As for the residents, the school paid a few dollars and relocated. Wen's sister-in-law is also a resident here. She doesn't move. Say nothing to move. She said she was used to living here. The authorities of the United Nations University are very humanitarian, and people are unwilling to move and cannot force them to leave. But her two dilapidated grass houses are inappropriately poked there, and they really don't look like them. Although the new school building is extremely simple, it was designed by a famous professor from the Department of Civil Engineering, and the housing arrangement is dense and the space is very reasonable. So what should I do? The person in charge discussed with Sister Wen to demolish her two grass houses and build another one for her, which was made of better materials than her original. She agreed, only asking to build her another chicken coop. That's easy to do.她这间小屋，土墙草顶，有两个窗户（没有窗扇，只有一个窗洞，有几根直立着的带皮的树棍），一扇板门。紧靠西面围墙，离二十五号宿舍不远。
Her hut, with earthen walls and a grass roof, had two windows (no sashes, only a window opening, and a few upright barked sticks), and a panel door. It was close to the west wall, not far from dormitory No. 25.宿舍旁边住着这样一户人家，学生们倒也没有人觉得奇怪。学生叫她文嫂。她管这些学生叫“先生”。时间长了，也能分得出张先生、李先生、金先生、朱先生……但是，相处这些年了，竟没有一个先生知道文嫂的身世，只知道她是一个寡妇，有一个女儿。人很老实。虽然没有知识，但是洁身自好，不贪小便宜。除非你给她，她从不伸手要东西。学生丢了牙膏肥皂、小东小西，从来不会怀疑是她顺手牵羊拿了去。学生洗了衬衫，晾在外面，被风吹跑了，她必为捡了，等学生回来时交出：“金先生，你的衣服。”除了下雨，她一天都是在屋外呆着。她的屋门也都是敞开着的。她的所作所为，都在天日之下，人人可以看到。
There is such a family living next to the dormitory, and no one among the students finds it strange. The student called her Wen's sister-in-law. She called these students "Mr. Wen". After a long time, you can also tell Mr. Zhang, Mr. Li, Mr. Jin, and Mr. Zhu...... However, after all these years of getting along, no gentleman knows about Wen's life experience, only that she is a widow and has a daughter. People are very honest. Although she has no knowledge, she is clean and not greedy. She never reaches out for something unless you give it to her. The student lost toothpaste and soap, and she never suspected that she took it by the hand. The student washed his shirt, hung it outside, and was blown away by the wind, she would pick it up and hand it over when the student came back: "Mr. Jin, your clothes." "Except for the rain, she stays outside the house all day. Her doors are also open. Everything she does is under the sun, and everyone can see it.她靠给学生洗衣服、拆被窝维持生活。每天大盆大盆地洗。她在门前的两棵半大榆树之间拴了两根棕绳，拧成了麻花。洗得的衣服，夹紧在两绳之间。风把这些衣服吹得来回摆动，霍霍作响。大太阳的天气，常常看见她坐在草地上（昆明的草多丰茸齐整而极干净）做被窝，一针一针，专心致意。衣服被窝洗好做得了，为了避免嫌疑，她从不送到学生宿舍里去，只是叫女儿隔着窗户喊：“张先生，来取衣服。”——“李先生，取被窝。”
She makes a living by washing clothes for students and dismantling quilts. Wash in large basins every day. She tied two brown ropes between two and a half elm trees in front of the door and twisted them into twists. The washed clothes are clamped between the two ropes. The wind blows these clothes back and forth, making a whirlwind. In the sunny weather, she is often seen sitting on the grass (the grass in Kunming is lush and neat and extremely clean) to make a quilt, stitch by stitch, concentrating. In order to avoid suspicion, she never sent it to the student dormitory, but asked her daughter to shout through the window: "Mr. Zhang, come and get the clothes." ——"Mr. Li, get the quilt." ”她的女儿能帮上忙了，能到井边去提水，踮着脚往绳子上晾衣服，在床上把衣服抹煞平整了，叠起来。
Her daughter can help, she can go to the well to carry water, tiptoe to dry clothes on the rope, and wipe the clothes flat and fold them on the bed.文嫂养了二十来只鸡（也许她原是靠喂鸡过日子的）。联大到处是青草，草里有昆虫蚱蜢种种活食，这些鸡都长得极肥大，很肯下蛋。隔多半个月，文嫂就挎了半篮鸡蛋，领着女儿，上市去卖。蛋大，也红润好看，卖得很快。回来时，带了盐巴、辣子，有时还用马兰草提着一块够一个猫吃的肉。
Sister-in-law Wen raised more than 20 chickens (maybe she originally lived by feeding chickens). The United University is full of grass, and there are insects and grasshoppers in the grass, and these chickens are extremely fat and willing to lay eggs. After more than half a month, Sister-in-law Wen carried half a basket of eggs, took her daughter, and went to the market to sell. The eggs are big, rosy and good-looking, and sell quickly. When I came back, I brought salt, chili peppers, and sometimes used maran grass to carry a piece of meat enough for a cat.每天一早，文嫂打开鸡窝门，这些鸡就急急忙忙，迫不及待地奔出来，散到草丛中去，不停地啄食。有时又抬起头来，把一个小脑袋很有节奏地转来转去，顾盼自若，——鸡转头不是一下子转过来，都是一顿一顿地那么转动。到觉得肚子里那个蛋快要坠下时，就赶紧跑回来，红着脸把一个蛋下在鸡窝里。随即得意非凡地高唱起来：“郭格答！郭格答！”文嫂或她的女儿伸手到鸡窝里取出一颗热烘烘的蛋，顺手赏了母鸡一块土坷垃：“去去去！先生要用功，莫吵！”这鸡婆子就只好咕咕地叫着，很不平地走到丛草里去了。到了傍晚，文嫂抓了一把碎米，一面撒着，一面“啯啯，啯啯”叫着，这些母鸡就都即即足足地回来了。它们把碎米啄尽，就鱼贯进入鸡窝。进窝时还故意把脑袋低一低，把尾巴向下耷拉一下，以示雍容文雅，很有鸡教。鸡窝门有一道小坎，这些鸡还都一定两脚并齐，站在门坎上，然后向前一跳。这种礼节，其实大可不必。进窝以后，咕咕囔囔一会，就寂然了。于是夜色就降临抗战时期最高学府之一，国立西南联合大学的新校舍了。阿门。
Every morning, when Sister-in-law Wen opened the door of the chicken coop, these chickens hurriedly ran out, scattered into the grass, and kept pecking. Sometimes he raised his head and turned his little head around rhythmically, looking at it freely,—— the chickens did not turn their heads all at once, but turned them one by one. When he felt that the egg in his stomach was about to fall, he hurriedly ran back and put an egg in the chicken coop with a red face. Then he sang proudly: "Guo Ge answered! Guo Ge answered!" Sister-in-law Wen or her daughter reached out to the chicken coop and took out a hot egg, and rewarded the hen with a piece of dirt: "Go, go! Sir, you have to work hard, don't make noise!" The chicken woman had no choice but to coo and walk into the grass very unevenly. In the evening, Sister-in-law Wen grabbed a handful of broken rice, sprinkled it, and screamed "chirp, chirp", and these hens came back immediately. Sister-in-law Wen is fat.男生宿舍全都一样，是一个窄长的大屋子，土墼墙，房顶铺着木板，木板都没有刨过，留着锯齿的痕迹，上盖稻草；两面的墙上开着一列像文嫂的窗洞一样的窗洞。每间宿舍里摆着二十张双层木床。这些床很笨重结实，一个大学生可以在上面放放心心地睡四年，一直睡到毕业，无须修理。床本来都是规规矩矩地靠墙排列着的，一边十张。可是这些大学生需要自己的单独的环境，于是把它们重新调动了一下，有的两张床摆成一个曲尺形，有的三张床摆成一个凹字形，就成了一个一个小天地。按规定，每一间住四十人，实际都住不满。有人占了一个铺位，或由别人替他占了一个铺位而根本不来住；也有不是铺主却长期睡在这张铺上的；有根本不是联大学生，却在新校舍住了好几年的。这些曲尺形或凹字形的单元里，大都只有两三个人。个别的，只有一个。一间宿舍住的学生，各系的都有。有一些互相熟悉，白天一同进出，晚上联床夜话；也有些老死不相往来，连贵姓都不打听。二十五号南头一张双层床上住着一个历史系学生，一个中文系学生，一个上铺，一个下铺，两个人合住了一年，彼此连面都没有见过：因为这二位的作息时间完全不同。中文系学生是个夜猫子，每晚在系图书馆夜读，天亮才回来；而历史系学生却是个早起早睡的正常的人。因此，上铺的铺主睡觉时，下铺是空的；下铺在酣睡时，上铺没有人。
The boys' dormitories are all the same, a large narrow room, with earthen walls, wooden planks on the roof, which have not been planed, leaving jagged marks, and covered with straw; on both sides of the walls are a row of window openings like Wen's window holes. There are twenty double-decker wooden beds in each dormitory. These beds are bulky and sturdy, and a college student can sleep comfortably on them for four years until graduation without repair. The beds were originally arranged neatly against the wall, ten on each side.
