When her daughter left, Sister-in-law Wen was devastated and a little stupid. But she still has to live, she has to live, she has to eat, and she has to let the chickens out and close the chicken coop every day. I also have to wash clothes and make quilts. There are many gentlemen who have graduated and want to leave Kunming, and they have to be clean before leaving, and there are many people who come to Sister-in-law Wen to wash clothes and dismantle quilts.这几天文嫂常上先生们的宿舍里去。有的先生要走了，行李收拾好了，总还有一些带不了的破旧衣物，一件鱼网似的毛衣，一个压扁了的脸盆，几只配不成对的皮鞋——那有洞的鞋底至少掌鞋还有用……这些先生就把文嫂叫了来，随她自己去挑拣。挑完了，文嫂必让先生看一看，然后就替他们把曲尺形或凹字形的单元打扫一下。
These days, Sister-in-law Wen often goes to the gentlemen's dormitory. Some gentlemen are leaving, their luggage is packed, and there are always some worn-out clothes that they can't bring, a sweater like a fishnet, a flattened basin, and a few mismatched leather shoes - the soles with holes are at least useful...... These gentlemen called Sister-in-law Wen over and let her pick them herself. After picking, Sister-in-law Wen would let her take a look, and then clean the ruler-shaped or concave glyph units for them.因为洗衣服、拣破烂，文嫂还能岔乎岔乎，心里不至太乱。不过她明显地瘦了。
金昌焕不声不响地走了。二十五号的朱先生叫文嫂也来看看，这位“怪现状”是不是也留下一些还值得一拣的东西。
Because of washing clothes and picking rags, Sister-in-law Wen can still be confused, and her heart is not too chaotic. But she has lost weight obviously. Jin Changhuan left silently. Mr. Zhu on the 25th asked Sister Wen to also come and see if this "strange status quo" also left something worth picking up.什么都没有。金先生把一根布丝都带走了。他的凹形王国里空空如也，只留下一个跟文嫂借用的鼎罐。文嫂毫无所得，然而她也照样替金先生打扫了一下。她的笤帚扫到床下，失声惊叫了起来：床底下有三堆鸡毛，一堆笋壳色的，一堆黑的，一堆芦花的！
Nothing. Mr. Jin took away a piece of cloth silk. His concave kingdom was empty, leaving only a cauldron that he borrowed from Sister-in-law. Sister-in-law Wen gained nothing, but she also cleaned Mr. Jin as well. Her broom swept under the bed and screamed: There were three piles of chicken feathers under the bed, a pile of bamboo shoots, a pile of black, and a bunch of reeds!文嫂把三堆鸡毛抱出来，一屁股坐在地下，大哭起来。
Sister-in-law Wen took out three piles of chicken feathers, sat on the ground, and cried.“啊呀天呐，这是我鸡呀！我笋壳鸡呀！我黑母鸡，我芦花鸡呀！……”
"Oh my God, this is my  chicken! My  bamboo shell chicken! My  black hen, my  reed chicken! ……”“我寡妇失业几十年哪，你咋个要偷我鸡呀！……”
“我风里来雨里去呀，我的命多苦，多艰难呀，你咋个要偷我鸡呀！……”
"My widow has been unemployed for decades, why are you stealing my  chicken! ……” "I'm in the wind and rain, how hard my life is, how difficult it is, why do you want to steal my  chicken! ……”“你先生是要做大事，赚大钱的呀，你咋个要偷我鸡呀！……”
"Your husband is going to do big things and make a lot of money, why are you stealing my  chicken! ……”“我女婿死在贵州十八盘，连尸都还没有收呀，你咋个要偷我鸡呀！……”
"My  son-in-law died in Guizhou Shibapan, and even the body has not been collected, why are you stealing my  chicken! ……”她哭得很伤心，很悲痛。好像要把一辈子所受的委屈、不幸、孤单和无告全都哭了出来。
这金昌焕真是缺德，偷了文嫂的鸡，还借了文嫂的鼎罐来炖了。至于他怎么偷的鸡，怎样宰了，怎样退的鸡毛，谁都无从想象。
She cried very sadly and sadly. It was as if she wanted to cry out all the grievances, misfortunes, loneliness and helplessness she had suffered all her life. This Jin Changhuan was really immoral, he stole Sister-in-law's chicken, and borrowed Sister-in-law's cauldron to stew. As for how he stole the chicken, how he slaughtered it, and how he returned the chicken feathers, no one could imagine.林子大了，什么鸟都有。
一九八一年六月六日

[1] 本篇原载《文汇月刊》1981年第九期；初收《晚饭花集》，人民文学出版社，1985年3月。

故里杂记

故里杂记[1]
李三
The forest is big, and there are all kinds of birds. June 6, 1981 [1] This article was originally published in the ninth issue of "Wenhui Monthly" in 1981; "Dinner Flower Collection", People's Literature Publishing House, March 1985. Hometown Miscellaneous Notes {{id_0000}} Li San李三是地保，又是更夫。他住在土地祠。土地祠每坊都有一个。“坊”后来改称为保了。只有死了人，和尚放焰口，写疏文，写明死者籍贯，还沿用旧称：“南赡部洲中华民国某省某县某坊信士某某……”云云。疏文是写给阴间的公事。大概阴间还没有改过来。土地是阴间的保长。其职权范围与阳间的保长相等，不能越界理事，故称“当坊土地”。李三所管的，也只是这一坊之事。出了本坊，哪怕只差一步，不论出了什么事，死人失火，他都不问。一个坊或一个保的疆界，保长清楚，李三也清楚。
Li San is the land protector and the watchman. He lives in the land temple. There is one in each square of the land temple. "Fang" was later renamed Bao. Only the dead man, the monk set off the flames, wrote a memorial, wrote the place of origin of the deceased, and still used the old name: "Nanshanbu Zhou, a certain province and county of the Republic of China...... The memorial is written to the underworld. Probably the underworld has not changed. The land is the protector of the underworld. Its scope of reference is equal to that of the protector of the underworld, and it cannot cross the boundary of the director, so it is called "the land of the square". What Li San is in charge of is only the affairs of this workshop. Out of the workshop, even if it is only one step away, no matter what happens, the dead are on fire, he does not ask. The boundaries of a square or a guarantee are clear to the chief, and Li San is also clear.土地祠是俗称，正名是“福德神祠”。这四个字刻在庙门的砖额上，蓝地金字。这是个很小的庙。外面原有两根旗杆。西边的一根有一年教雷劈了（这雷也真怪，把旗杆劈得粉碎，劈成了一片一片一尺来长的细木条），只剩东边的一根了。进门有一个门道，两边各有一间耳房。东边的，住着李三。西边的一间，租给了一个卖糜饭饼子的。——糜饭饼子是米粥捣成糜，发酵后在一个平锅上烙成的，一面焦黄，一面是白的，有一点酸酸的甜味。再往里，过一个两步就跨过的天井，便是神殿。迎面塑着土地老爷的神像。神像不大，比一个常人还小一些。这土地老爷是单身，——不像乡下的土地庙里给他配一个土地奶奶。是一个笑眯眯的老头，一嘴的白胡子。头戴员外巾，身穿蓝色道袍。神像前是一个很狭的神案。神案上有一具铁制蜡烛架，横列一排烛钎，能插二十来根蜡烛。一个瓦香炉。神案前是一个收香钱的木柜。木柜前留着几尺可供磕头的砖地。如此而已。
The land shrine is commonly known as the "Shrine of Virtue". These four words are engraved on the brick forehead of the temple door, with gold letters on a blue background. This is a very small temple. There were originally two flagpoles outside. The one on the west side was struck by lightning one year (this thunder was really strange, it smashed the flagpole into pieces of thin wooden strips about a foot long), and only the one on the east side remained. There is a doorway at the entrance, and there is an ear room on each side. On the east side, Li San lives. The one on the west side is rented to a seller of rice cakes. ——Rice cakes are made from rice porridge pounded into porridge, fermented and baked on a flat pot, browned on one side and white on the other, with a little sour sweetness. Further inside, crossing a patio in two steps is the temple. In front of him is a statue of the land master. The statue is not big, smaller than an ordinary person. This land master is single,—— unlike the land temple in the countryside that gives him a land grandmother. It is a smiling old man with a white beard. He wears a headscarf and a blue Taoist robe. In front of the statue is a very narrow altar. There is an iron candle holder on the altar, with a row of candle brakers lined up, which can hold more than 20 candles. A tile incense burner. In front of the altar is a wooden cabinet for collecting incense money. In front of the wooden cabinet, there is a brick floor for kowtowing. So much for.李三同时又是庙祝。庙祝也没有多少事。初一、十五，把土地祠里外打扫一下，准备有人来进香。过年的时候，把两个“灯对子”找出来，挂在庙门两边。灯对子是长方形的纸灯，里面是木条钉成的框子，外糊白纸，上书大字，一边是“风调雨顺”，一边是“国泰民安”。灯对子里有横隔，可以点蜡烛。从正月初一，一直点到灯节。这半个多月，土地祠门前明晃晃的，很有点节日气氛。这半个月，进香的也多。每逢香期，到了晚上，李三就把收香钱的柜子打开，把香钱倒出来，一五一十地数一数。
Li San is also a temple priest. There is not much to do with the temple priest. On the first and fifteenth days of the first month, clean the land temple inside and out, and prepare for someone to come to incense. During the Chinese New Year, find out the two "lamp pairs" and hang them on both sides of the temple door. The lamp pair is a rectangular paper lamp, with a frame nailed to wooden strips inside, pasted with white paper, and written in large characters, with "Good Weather and Rain" on one side and "Guotai Min'an" on the other. There is a horizontal partition in the lamp pair, and candles can be lit. From the first day of the first lunar month, it is lit until the Lantern Festival. For more than half a month, the front of the land temple is bright, and it has a bit of a festive atmosphere. In the past half month, there have been many incense offerings. Every incense period, at night, Li San would open the cabinet for collecting incense money, pour out the incense money, and count it one by one.偶尔有人来赌咒。两家为一件事分辩不清，——常见的是东家丢了东西，怀疑是西家偷了，两家对骂了一阵，就各备一份香烛到土地祠来赌咒。两个人同时磕了头，一个说：“土地老爷在上，若是某某偷了我的东西，就叫他现世现报！”另一个说：“土地老爷在上，我若做了此事，就叫我家死人失天火！他诬赖我，也一样！”咒已赌完，各自回家。李三就把只点了小半截的蜡烛吹灭，拔下，收好，备用。
Occasionally, someone comes to gamble. The two families couldn't distinguish between one thing,—— it was common for the owner to lose something, suspecting that the west family had stolen it, and the two families scolded each other for a while, so they each prepared an incense candle to the land shrine to gamble on the curse. The two people kowtowed at the same time, and one said: "The land master is above, if so-and-so steals my things, he will be called to report in this world!" The other said: "The land master is on top, if I do this, I will make my dead family lose the fire! He lied to me, too!" The curse was over, and they went home. Li San blew out the candle that was only lit in small halves, pulled it out, put it away, and set it aside.李三最高兴的事，是有人来还愿。坊里有人家出了事，例如老人病重，或是孩子出了天花，就到土地祠来许愿。老人病好了，孩子天花出过了，就来还愿。仪式很隆重：给菩萨“挂匾”——送一块横宽二三尺的红布匾，上写四字：“有求必应”。满炉的香，红蜡烛把铁架都插满了（这种蜡烛很小，只二寸长，叫做“小牙”）。最重要的是：供一个猪头。因此，谁家许了愿，李三就很关心，随时打听。这是很容易打听到的。老人病好，会出来扶杖而行。孩子出了天花，在衣领的后面就会缝一条二指宽三寸长的红布，上写“天花已过”。于是李三就满怀希望地等着。这猪头到了晚上，就进了李三的砂罐了。一个七斤半重的猪头，够李三消受好几天。这几天，李三的脸上随时都是红喷喷的。
The happiest thing about Li San is that someone comes to make a wish. If something happens to someone in the neighborhood, such as an old man who is seriously ill or a child has smallpox, he goes to the land temple to make a wish. When the old man is cured and the child has smallpox, he comes to make a wish. The ceremony is very grand: "hang a plaque" for the bodhisattva - give a red cloth plaque two or three feet wide with four words written on it: "Respond to requests". The incense is full, and the red candle fills the iron frame (this candle is very small, only two inches long, called "small teeth"). The most important thing is to offer a pig's head. Therefore, whoever makes a wish, Li San is very concerned and inquires at any time. This is easy to find. When the old man is sick, he will come out and walk with a cane. When the child has smallpox, he will sew a red cloth three inches wide and three inches wide on the back of the collar, with the words "Smallpox has passed". So Li San waited hopefully. At night, the pig's head entered Li San's sand jar. A pig's head weighing seven and a half pounds is enough for Li San to endure for several days. In the past few days, Li San's face has been red at any time.地保所管的事，主要的就是死人失火。一般人家死了人，他是不管的，他管的是无后的孤寡和“路倒”。一个孤寡老人死在床上，或是哪里发现一具无名男尸，在本坊地界，李三就有事了：拿了一个捐簿，到几家殷实店铺去化钱。然后买一口薄皮棺材装殓起来；省事一点，就用芦席一卷，草绳一捆（这有个名堂，叫做“万字纹的棺材，三道紫金箍”），用一把锄头背着，送到乱葬冈去埋掉。因此本地流传一句骂人的话：“叫李三把你背出去吧！”李三很愿意本坊常发生这样的事，因为募化得来的钱怎样花销，是谁也不来查账的。李三拿埋葬费用的余数来喝酒，实在也在情在理，没有什么说不过去。这种事，谁愿承揽，就请来试试！哼，你以为这几杯酒喝到肚里容易呀！不过，为了心安理得，无愧于神鬼，他在埋了死人后，照例还为他烧一陌纸钱，磕三个头。
The main thing that the land protection is in charge of is the fire of the dead. Ordinary people don't care about the dead, he cares about the lonely widow and the "road fall". A lonely old man died in bed, or an unknown male corpse was found somewhere, and Li San had something to do in this area: he took a donation book and went to a few prosperous shops to make money. Then buy a thin coffin and put it for burial; to save a little trouble, use a roll of reed mats and a bundle of straw rope (this has a name, called "a coffin with a swastika pattern, three purple gold hoops"), carry it with a hoe, and send it to the mass grave to be buried. Therefore, there is a curse in the local area: "Ask Li San to carry you out!" Li San is very willing to do this kind of thing often in this workshop, because no one will come to check how the money raised is spent. Li San took the balance of the burial fee to drink, which is really reasonable, and there is nothing that cannot be said. Whoever wants to undertake this kind of thing, please try it! Hmph, do you think it's easy to drink these glasses of wine in your stomach! However, in order to have peace of mind and be worthy of the gods and ghosts, after burying the dead, he burned a piece of paper money for him as usual and kowtowed three times.李三瘦小干枯，精神不足，拖拖沓沓，迷迷瞪瞪，随时总像没有睡醒，——他夜晚打更，白天办事，睡觉也是断断续续的，看见他时他也真是刚从床上爬起来一会，想不到有时他竟能跑得那样快！那是本坊有了火警的时候。这地方把失火叫成“走水”，大概是讳言火字，所以反说着了。一有人家走水，李三就拿起他的更锣，用一个锣棒使劲地敲着，没命地飞跑，嘴里还大声地嚷叫：“××巷×家走水啦！××巷×家走水啦！”一坊失火，各坊的水龙都要来救，所以李三这回就跑出坊界，绕遍全城。
Li San was thin and dry, lacking energy, procrastinating, staring in a daze, always as if he hadn't woken up at any time,——, he worked the night watch, did errands during the day, and slept intermittently, and when he saw him, he really just got up from the bed for a while, and he didn't expect that sometimes he could run so fast! That was when there was a fire in the workshop. This place calls the fire "walking water", probably because it is a taboo word for fire, so it is said the other way around. As soon as someone went out of the water, Li San picked up his more gong, struck it hard with a gong stick, flew away lifelessly, and shouted loudly: "×× alley × the water is gone!" ×× alley × the water is gone! "There was a fire in the first square, and the water dragons in each neighborhood had to come to save it, so Li San ran out of the neighborhood this time and went around the city.李三希望人家失火么？哎，话怎么能这样说呢！换一个说法：他希望火不成灾，及时救灭。火灭之后，如果这一家损失不大，他就跑去道喜：“恭喜恭喜，越烧越旺！”如果这家烧得片瓦无存，他就去向幸免殃及的四邻去道喜：“恭喜恭喜，土地菩萨保佑！”他还会说：火势没有蔓延，也多亏水龙来得快。言下之意也很清楚：水龙来得快，是因为他没命的飞跑。听话的人并不是傻子。他飞跑着敲锣报警，不会白跑，总是能拿到相当可观的酒钱的。
Does Li San want someone to catch fire? Hey, how can you say that! In other words: he hopes that the fire will not become a disaster and be extinguished in time. After the fire was extinguished, if the family did not suffer much damage, he would run to say goodbye: "Congratulations, congratulations, the more it burns, the more it burns!" If the house burned to the ground, he would go to the neighbors who survived the disaster: "Congratulations, congratulations, the Bodhisattva of the land blesses!" He would also say: The fire did not spread, thanks to the water dragon coming quickly. The implication is also very clear: the water dragon came fast because he flew away without his life. Obedient people are not fools. He runs and beats the gong to call the police, he will not run in vain, and he can always get a considerable amount of wine money.地保的另一项职务是管叫花子。这里的花子有两种，一种是专赶各庙的香期的。初一、十五，各庙都有人进香。逢到菩萨生日（这些菩萨都有一个生日，不知是怎么查考出来的），香火尤盛。这些花子就从庙门、甬道，一直到大殿，密密地跪了两排。有的装做瞎子，有的用蜡烛油画成烂腿（画得很像），“老爷太太”不住地喊叫。进香的信女们就很自觉地把铜钱丢在他们面前破瓢里，她们认为把钱给花子，是进香仪式的一部分，不如此便显得不虔诚。因此，这些花子要到的钱是不少的。这些虔诚的香客大概不知道花子的黑话。花子彼此相遇，不是问要了多少钱，而说是“唤了多少狗！”这种花子是有帮的，他们都住在船上。每年还做花子会，很多花子船都集中在一起，也很热闹。这一种在帮的花子李三惹不起，他们也不碍李三的事，井水不犯河水。李三能管的是串街的花子。串街要钱的，他也只管那种只会伸着手赖着不走的软弱疲赖角色。李三提了一根竹棍，看见了，就举起竹棍大喝一声：“去去去！”有三等串街的他不管。一等是唱道情的。这是斯文一脉，穿着破旧长衫，念过两句书，又和吕洞宾、郑板桥有些瓜葛。店铺里等他唱了几句“老渔翁，一钓竿”，就会往柜台上丢一个铜板。他们是很清高的，取钱都不用手，只是用两片简板一夹，咚的一声丢在渔鼓筒里。另外两等，一是耍青龙（即耍蛇）的，一是吹筒子的。耍青龙的弄两条菜花蛇盘在脖子里，蛇信子簌簌地直探。吹筒子的吹一个外面包了火赤练蛇皮的竹筒，“布——呜！”声音很难听，样子也难看。他们之一要是往店堂一站，半天不走，这家店铺就甭打算做生意了：女人、孩子都吓得远远地绕开走了。照规矩（不知是谁定的规矩），这两等，李三是有权赶他们走的。然而他偏不赶，只是在一个背人处把他们拦住，向他们索要例规。讨价还价，照例要争执半天。双方会谈的地方，最多的是官茅房——公共厕所。
Another job of the land protector is to call the flowers. There are two kinds of flowers here, one is dedicated to the incense period of each temple. On the first and fifteenth days of the new year, people in each temple offer incense. On the birthday of the Bodhisattva (these bodhisattvas all have a birthday, I don't know how to find out), the incense is particularly prosperous. These flowers knelt in two rows from the temple gate, the corridor, and all the way to the main hall. Some pretended to be blind, some painted rotten legs with candle oil (very similar), and the "old lady" kept shouting. They thought that giving the money to the flowers was part of the incense ceremony, otherwise it would be unreligious. Therefore, these flowers ask for a lot of money. These devout pilgrims probably don't know Hanako's black words. When Hanako met each other, they didn't ask how much money they asked, but said, "How many dogs were called!" This kind of flower is helpful, and they all live on boats. Every year, there is also a flower party, and many flower boats are gathered together, which is also very lively. This kind of flower child Li San can't afford to mess with Li San, and they don't interfere with Li San's business, and the well water does not violate the river water. In this place, people who speak with a Shandong accent north of Xuzhou are called nephews. There are many nephews in this county. Most of them live under the canal embankment, pulling , pushing wheelbarrows to transport goods (the most transported are stones used by river workers), grinding stone powder (the stones are finely ground, and the hemp tung oil used for repairing large ships is mixed with hemp tung oil to fill the gaps of the boats), baking pot helmets (this kind of dry, thick and hard dough cake is also mainly sold to nephews), and beef offal soup (locals also specially run to the canal embankment to taste this smell......侉奶奶想必本是一个侉子的家属，她应当有过一个丈夫，一个侉老爹。她的丈夫哪里去了呢？死了？还是“贩了桃子”——扔下她跑了？不知道。她丈夫姓什么？她姓什么？很少人知道。大家都叫她侉奶奶。大人、小孩，穷苦人、有钱的，都这样叫。倒好像她就姓侉似的。

Grandma lives outside an alley. There is a door at the entrance of this alley, which is probably the so-called inner door. The cow worked the canal embankment, pulled , pushed carts, and crushed stones. He came to see his adopted mother every ten and a half days. He had a lot of people and couldn't bring anything to his mother, only a pot helmet weighing three pounds. When my mother saw the cow coming, she went to the street and went to the stall of Wang Er, who sold smoked meat, to cut two hundred yuan of pig's head meat, and held it with half a lotus leaf. In addition, I can't forget to buy a few green onions and half a bowl of sauce. The two of them had a solid meal in Shandong.侉奶奶的八棵榆树一年一年地长大了。香店的杨老板几次托甲长丁裁缝来探过侉奶奶的口风，问她卖不卖。榆皮，是做香的原料。——这种事由买主亲自出面，总不合适。老街旧邻的，总得有个居间的人出来说话。这样要价、还价，才有余地。丁裁缝来一趟，侉奶奶总是说：“树还小咧，叫它再长长。”
Grandma's eight elm trees have grown year by year. Boss Yang of the incense shop came to visit Grandma Ding several times and asked her if she could sell it. Elm bark is the raw material for making incense. ——It is always inappropriate for the buyer to come forward in person. The old neighbors of the old street must have an intermediary to come out and talk. In this way, there is room for asking and counter-offering. When Tailor Ding came, Grandma Ding always said: "The tree is still small, let it grow longer." ”人们私下议论：侉奶奶不卖榆树，她是指着它当棺材本哪。
榆树一年一年地长。侉奶奶一年一年地活着，一年一年地纳鞋底。
People privately discussed: Grandma doesn't sell elm trees, she points to it as a coffin. The elm tree grows year after year. Grandma lives year after year, and puts in the soles of her shoes year after year.侉奶奶的生活实在是平淡之至。除了看驴打滚，看孩子捉蚂蚱、捉油葫芦，还有些什么值得一提的事呢？——这些捉蚂蚱的孩子一年比一年大。侉奶奶纳他们穿的鞋底，尺码一年比一年放出来了。
值得一提的有：
Grandma's life is really ordinary. In addition to watching the donkey roll, watching the children catch grasshoppers and oil gourds, what else is worth mentioning? ——These children who catch grasshoppers are getting older and older year by year. Grandma accepted the soles of the shoes they wore, and the size was released year by year. It is worth mentioning that:有一年，杨家香店的作坊接连着了三次火，查不出起火原因。人说这是“狐火”，是狐狸用尾巴蹭出来的。于是在香店作坊的墙外盖了一个三尺高的“狐仙庙”，常常有人来烧香。着火的时候，满天通红，乌鸦乱飞乱叫，火光照着侉奶奶的八棵榆树也是通红的，像是火树一样。
One year, the workshop of Yangjiaxiangdian caught fire three times in a row, and the cause of the fire could not be found. People say that this is a "fox fire", which was rubbed out by a fox with its tail. So a three-foot-high "Fox Fairy Temple" was built outside the wall of the incense shop workshop, and people often came to burn incense. When the fire broke out, the sky was red, crows were flying and screaming, and the eight elm trees where the fire shone on the grandmother were also red, like fire trees.有一天，不知怎么发现了海潮庵里藏着一窝土匪。地方保安队来捉他们。里面往外打枪，外面往里打枪，乒乒乓乓。最后是有人献计用火攻，——在庵外墙根堆了稻草，放火烧！土匪吃不住劲，只好把枪丢出，举着手出来就擒了。海潮庵就在侉奶奶家前面不远，两边开仗的情形，她看得清清楚楚。她很奇怪，离得这么近，她怎么就不知道庵里藏着土匪呢？
One day, I somehow found a nest of bandits hiding in Haichao Monastery. The local security team came to catch them. Shooting outside inside, shooting inside outside, ping pong bong. In the end, someone suggested attacking with fire,—— piled straw at the base of the outer wall of the nunnery and set it on fire! The bandits couldn't stand it, so they had to throw their guns out, raise their hands and come out to capture them. Haichao'an is not far from Grandma's house, and she can clearly see the situation of the war on both sides. She was very strange, so close, why didn't she know that there were bandits hiding in the nunnery?这些，使侉奶奶留下深刻印象，然而与她的生活无关。
使她的生活发生一点变化的是：——
These left a deep impression on Grandma Neighbour, but it had nothing to do with her life. What changed her life a little was:——有一个乡下人赶了一头水牛进城，牛老了，他要把它卖给屠宰场去。这牛走到越塘边，说什么也不肯走了，跪着，眼睛里叭哒叭哒直往下掉泪。围了好些人看。有人报给甲长丁裁缝。这是发生在本甲之内的事，丁甲长要是不管，将为人神不喜。他出面求告了几家吃斋念佛的老太太，凑了牛价，把这头老牛买了下来，作为老太太们的放生牛。这牛谁来养呢？大家都觉得交侉奶奶养合适。丁甲长对侉奶奶说，这是一甲人信得过她，侉奶奶就答应下了。这养老牛还有一笔基金（牛总要吃点干草呀），就交给侉奶奶放印子。从此侉奶奶就多了几件事：早起把牛放出来，尽它到草地上去吃青草。青草没有了，就喂它吃干草。一早一晚，牵到河边去饮。傍晚拿了收印子钱的摺子，沿街串乡去收印子。晚上，牛就和她睡在一个屋里。牛卧着，安安静静地倒嚼，侉奶奶可觉得比往常累得多。她觉得骨头疼，半夜了，还没有睡着。
A countryman drove a buffalo into the city, and when the cow was old, he wanted to sell it to the slaughterhouse. The cow walked to the edge of Yuetang, said nothing, and refused to leave, kneeling, tears streaming down from his eyes. There were many people around. Someone reported it to the tailor Ding. This is what happened within this armor, and if Ding Jia Chang doesn't care, he will be disliked by the gods. He came forward to ask several old ladies who were fasting and chanting Buddha, collected the price of the cow, and bought the old cow as a release cow for the old ladies. Who will raise this cow? Everyone thought it was suitable to raise Grandma Nie. Ding Jiachang said to Grandma that this was a person who could trust her, and Grandma agreed. The old cow still has a fund (the cow always needs to eat some hay), so it is handed over to the grandmother to put the seal. Since then, the grandmother has had a few more things: get up early and let the cow out and let it go to the grass to eat grass. The grass is gone, so feed it hay. Morning and night, take it to the river to drink. In the evening, I took the fold to collect the seal money and went along the street to collect the seal. At night, the cow slept in the same room with her. The cow lay down, chewing quietly, and Grandma felt much more tired than usual. She felt a pain in her bones, and it was midnight and she hadn't fallen asleep yet.不到半年，这头牛老死了。侉奶奶把放印子的摺子交还丁甲长，还是整天坐在门外纳鞋底。
In less than half a year, the cow died of old age. Grandma returned the fold with the seal to Ding Jiachang, and still sat outside the door all day to put in the soles of her shoes.牛一死。侉奶奶也像老了好多。她时常病病歪歪的，连粥都不想吃，在她的黑洞洞的草屋里躺着。有时出来坐坐，扶着门框往外走。
As soon as the cow died. Grandma also seems to be much older. She was often sick and crooked, didn't even want to eat porridge, and lay in her black grass hut. Sometimes I came out to sit and walked out holding on to the door frame.一天夜里下大雨。瓢泼大雨不停地下了一夜。很多人家都进了水。丁裁缝怕侉奶奶家也进了水了，她屋外的榆树都浸在水里了。他赤着脚走过去，推开侉奶奶的门一看：侉奶奶死了。
丁裁缝派人把她的侄子牛叫了来。
It rained heavily one night. The pouring rain kept falling all night. Many families were in the water. Tailor Ding was afraid that Grandma's house would also be flooded, and the elm trees outside her house were submerged in water. He walked over barefoot, pushed open Grandma's door, and looked: Grandma was dead. Tailor Ding sent someone to call her nephew Niu.得给侉奶奶办后事呀。侉奶奶没有留下什么钱，牛也拿不出钱，只有卖榆树。
I have to do the funeral for my grandmother. Grandma didn't leave any money, and the cows couldn't take out any money, so they could only sell elms.丁甲长找到杨老板。杨老板倒很仁义，说是先不忙谈榆树的事，这都好说，由他先垫出一笔钱来，给侉奶奶买一身老衣，一副杉木棺材，把侉奶奶埋了。
Ding Jiachang found Boss Yang. Boss Yang was very benevolent, saying that he was not busy talking about the elm tree first, which was easy to say, and he first advanced a sum of money to buy an old clothes and a pair of fir coffins for Grandma Neung, and buried Grandma Neung.侉奶奶安葬以后，榆树生意也就谈妥了。杨老板雇了人来，咯嗤咯嗤，把八棵榆树都放倒了。新锯倒的榆树，发出很浓的香味。
After Grandma was buried, the elm business was negotiated. Boss Yang hired someone, snorted, and put down all eight elm trees. The freshly sawn elm trees emit a strong fragrance.杨老板把八棵榆树的树皮剥了，把树干卖给了木器店。据人了解，他卖的八棵树干的钱就比他垫出和付给牛的钱还要多。他等于白得了八张榆树皮，又捞了一笔钱。
鱼
Boss Yang peeled the bark of the eight elm trees and sold the trunks to the woodwork shop. It is understood that the money he sold for eight tree trunks was more than the money he paid to the cattle. He got eight elm barks for nothing and made another sum of money. fish臭水河和越塘原是连着的。不知从哪年起，螺蛳坝以下淤塞了，就隔断了。风和人一年一年把干土烂草往河槽里填，河槽变成很浅了。不过旧日的河槽依然可以看得出来。两旁的柳树还能标出原来河的宽度。这还是一条河，一条没有水的干河。
The stinky water river and Yuetang were originally connected. I don't know from when, the bottom of the snail dam was silted up and cut off. The wind and people fill the dry soil and grass into the river trough year by year, and the trough becomes very shallow. However, the old river trough can still be seen. The willow trees on both sides can also mark the width of the original river. This is still a river, a dry river without water.干河的北岸种了菜。南岸有几户人家。这几家都是做嫁妆的，主要是做嫁妆之中的各种盆桶，脚盆、马桶、子。这些盆桶是街上嫁妆店的订货，他们并不卖门市。这几家只是本钱不大，材料不多的作坊。这几家的大人、孩子，都是做盆桶的工人。他们整天在门外柳树下锯、刨。他们使用的刨子很特别。木匠使刨子是往前推，桶匠使刨子是往后拉。因为盆桶是圆的，这么使才方便。这种刨子叫做刮刨。盆桶成型后，要用砂纸打一遍，然后上漆。上漆之前，先要用猪血打一道底子。刷了猪血，得晾干。因此老远地就看见干河南岸，绿柳荫中排列着好些通红的盆盆桶桶，看起来很热闹，画出了这几家作坊的一种忙碌的兴旺气象。
Vegetables are planted on the north bank of the dry river. There are several families on the south bank. These families are all dowries, mainly for dowries, foot basins, toilets, and . These pots and buckets are ordered by dowry shops on the street, and they do not sell stores. These are just workshops with little capital and few materials. The adults and children of these families are all workers who make pots and buckets. They sawed and planed under the willow trees outside the door all day long. The planers they use are very special. The carpenter pushes the planer forward, and the barrel maker pulls the planer back. Because the pot and bucket are round, it is convenient to use. This kind of planer is called a scraper. After the pot and bucket are formed, they must be beaten with sandpaper and then painted. Before painting, a base must be made with pig's blood. Brushed with pig blood, it has to be dried. Therefore, I saw from afar on the south bank of the Ganhe River, with many bright red pots and buckets lined up in the shade of green willows, which looked very lively, painting a busy and prosperous atmosphere of these workshops.桶匠有本钱，有手艺，在越塘一带，比起那些完全靠力气吃饭的挑夫、轿夫要富足一些。和杀猪的庞家就不能相比了。
The cooper maker has capital and craftsmanship, and in the Yuetang area, he is richer than those porters and bearers who rely entirely on their strength to eat. It cannot be compared with the Pang family who killed pigs.从侉奶奶家旁边向南伸出的后街到往螺蛳坝方向，拐了一个直角。庞家就在这拐角处，门朝南，正对越塘。他家的地势很高，从街面到屋基，要上七八层台阶。房屋在这一片算是最高大的。房屋盖起的时间不久，砖瓦木料都还很新。檩粗板厚，瓦密砖齐。两边各有两间卧房，正中是一个很宽敞的穿堂。坐在穿堂里，可以清清楚楚看到越塘边和淤塞的旧河交接处的一条从南到北的土路，看到越塘的水，和越塘对岸的一切，眼界很开阔。这前面的新房子是住人的。养猪的猪圈，烧水、杀猪的场屋都在后面。
From the back street extending south next to my grandmother's house to the direction of Luoshiba, there is a right corner. The Pang family is at this corner, with the door facing south, directly facing Yuetang. The terrain of his house is very high, and it takes seven or eight steps from the street to the foundation. The house is the tallest in this area. The house was built not long ago, and the bricks and timber were still very new. The purlins are thick and the tiles are dense. There are two bedrooms on each side, and in the middle is a very spacious hall. Sitting in the hall, you can clearly see a dirt road from south to north at the junction of the edge of Yuetang and the silted old river, and see the water of Yuetang and everything on the other side of Yuetang. The new house in front of this is inhabited. The pigsty for raising pigs, the farm house for boiling water and killing pigs are all behind.庞家兄弟三个，各有分工。老大经营擘划，总管一切。老二专管各处收买生猪。他们家不买现成的肥猪，都是买半大猪回来自养。老二带一个伙计，一趟能赶二三十头猪回来。因为杀的猪多，他经常要外出。杀猪是老三的事，——当然要有两个下手伙计。每天五更头，东方才现一点鱼肚白，这一带人家就听到猪尖声嚎叫，知道庞家杀猪了。猪杀得了，放了血，在杀猪盆里用开水烫透，吹气，刮毛。杀猪盆是一种特制的长圆形的木盆，盆帮很高。二百来斤的猪躺在里面，富富有余。杀几头猪，没有一定，按时令不同。少则两头，多则三头四头，到年下人家腌肉时就杀得更多了。因此庞家有四个极大的木盆，几个伙计同时动手洗刮。
The three brothers of the Pang family each have their own division of labor. The eldest manages and manages everything. The second child is in charge of buying pigs everywhere. Their family does not buy ready-made fat pigs, they buy half a large pig to raise themselves. The second child brought a guy and could drive twenty or thirty pigs back in one trip. Because he kills a lot of pigs, he often has to go out. Killing pigs is the third child's business,—— of course there must be two partners. At the beginning of the fifth watch every day, a little fish belly white appeared in the east, and people in this area heard the sharp howl of pigs and knew that the Pang family had killed pigs. The pig can be killed, bleed, scalded with boiling water, blown, and shaved. The pig killing basin is a special oblong wooden basin with a very high basin. About 200 pounds of pigs lie in it, rich and rich. Killing a few pigs is not certain, depending on the season. As few as two, as many as three or four, and more when people cure meat. Therefore, the Pang family has four extremely large wooden basins, and several guys wash and scrape them at the same time.这地方不兴叫屠户，也不叫杀猪的，大概嫌这种叫法不好听，大都叫“开肉案子的”。“开”肉案子，就是掌柜老板一流，显得身份高了。庞家肉案子生意很好，因为一条东大街上只有这一家肉案子。早起人进人出，剁刀响，铜钱响，票子响。不到晌午，几片猪就卖得差不多了。这里人一天吃的肉都是上午一次买齐，很少下午来割肉的。庞家肉案到午饭后，只留一两块后臀硬肋等待某些家临时来了客人的主顾，留一个人照顾着。一天的生意已经做完，店堂闲下来了。
This place is not called a butcher, nor is it called a pig slaughterer, probably because this name is not good, and most of them are called "meat cases". "Opening" a meat case means that the shopkeeper and boss are first-class, and they seem to have a high status. The business of the Pang family meat case is very good, because there is only this meat case on an east street. People come in and out early, chopping knives, copper coins, and tickets. Before noon, a few pieces of pigs were almost sold. The meat that people eat here in a day is bought once in the morning, and they rarely come to cut the meat in the afternoon. After lunch, only one or two pieces of the back buttocks are left to wait for some customers to come temporarily, leaving one person to take care of them. The day's business has been done, and the shop hall is idle.店堂闲下来了。别的肉案子，闲着就闲着吧。庞家的人可真会想法子。他们在肉案子的对面，设了一道拦柜，卖茶叶。茶叶和猪肉是两码事，怎么能卖到一起去呢？——可是，又为什么一定不能卖到一起去呢？东大街没有一家茶叶店，要买茶叶就得走一趟北市口。有了这样一个卖茶叶的地方，省走好多路。卖茶叶，有一个人盯着就行了。有时叫一个小伙计来支应。有时老大或老三来看一会。有时，庞家的三妯娌之一，也来店堂里坐着，包包茶叶，收收钱。这半间店堂的茶叶店生意很好。
The shop is idle. Other meat cases, just be idle. The people of the Pang family really know how to think. They set up a locker opposite the meat case to sell tea. Tea and pork are two different things, how can they be sold together? ——But why can't they be sold together? There is no tea shop on East Street, and you have to go to Beishikou to buy tea. With such a place to sell tea, you have to walk a lot of roads. When selling tea, just have one person watching. Sometimes a young man is called to support. Sometimes the eldest or third child comes to see for a while. Sometimes, one of the three sisters of the Pang family also came to sit in the shop, wrapping tea and collecting money. The tea shop in this half of the shop is doing very well.庞家三弟兄一个是一个。老大稳重，老二干练，老三是个文武全才。他们长得比别人高出一头。老三尤其肥白高大。他下午没事，常在越塘高空场上练石担子、石锁。他还会写字，写刘石庵体的行书。这里店铺都兴装着花槅子。槅子留出一方空白，可以贴字画。别家都是请人写画的。庞家肉案子是庞老三自己写的字。他大概很崇拜赵子龙。别人家槅心里写的是“春眠不觉晓，处处闻啼鸟”，“夫天地者万物之逆旅，光阴者百代之过客”之类，他写的都是《三国演义》里赞赵子龙的诗。
One of the three brothers of the Pang family is one. The eldest is stable, the second is capable, and the third is an all-rounder. They look taller than others. The third is especially fat and tall. He has nothing to do in the afternoon, and often practices stone burdens and stone locks on the Yuetang high-altitude field. He can also write, writing Liu Shi'an's running script. The shops here are all equipped with flower barrels. The barrel leaves a blank space where calligraphy and painting can be pasted. Other families ask people to paint. The Pang family meat case was written by Pang Laosan himself. He probably admires Zhao Zilong very much. In other people's hearts, he wrote "Spring sleep without realizing dawn, hearing birds singing everywhere", "Heaven and earth are the inn of all things, and time is a passerby for a hundred generations", etc., and he wrote poems praising Zhao Zilong in "Romance of the Three Kingdoms".庞家这三个妯娌：一个赛似一个的漂亮，一个赛似一个的能干。她们都非常勤快。天不亮就起来，烧水，煮猪食，喂猪。白天就坐在穿堂里做针线。都是光梳头，净洗脸，穿得整整齐齐，头上戴着金簪子，手上戴着麻花银镯。人们走到庞家门前，就觉得跟前一亮。
The three sisters of the Pang family: one is as beautiful as the other, and the other is as capable as the other. They are all very diligent. Get up before dawn, boil water, cook pig food, and feed pigs. During the day, they sit in the hall and do needlework. They all comb their hair, wash their faces, dress neatly, wear gold hairpins on their heads, and wear twist silver bracelets on their hands. When people walk to the door of the Pang family, they feel that they are shining in front of them.到粥厂放粥，她们就一人拎一个子去打粥。
When they go to the porridge factory to put porridge, they each carry a  to make porridge.这不免会引起人们议论：“戴着金簪子去打粥！——侉奶奶打粥，你庞家也打粥？！”大家都知道，她们打了粥来是不吃的，——喂猪！因此，越塘、螺蛳坝一带人对庞家虽很羡慕并不亲近。都觉得庞家的人太精了。庞家的人缘不算好。别人也知道，庞家人从心里看不起别人，尤其是这三个女的。
This will inevitably cause people to talk: "Wear a gold hairpin to make porridge!" ——Grandma makes porridge, and your Pang family also makes porridge?!" Everyone knows that they don't eat porridge ,—— feed the pigs! Therefore, although the people in Yuetang and Luoshiba are very envious of the Pang family, they are not close to them. They all think that the people of the Pang family are too smart. The Pang family's popularity is not good. Others also know that the Pang family looks down on others from the bottom of their hearts, especially these three women.越塘边发生了从未见过的奇事。
A strange thing happened that I had never seen before.这一年雨水特别大，臭水河的水平了岸，水都漫到后街街面上来了。地方上的居民铺户共同商议，决定挖开螺蛳坝，在淤塞的旧河槽挖一道沟，把臭水河的水引到越塘河里去。这道沟只两尺宽。臭水河的水位比越塘高得多。水在沟里流得像一枝箭。
This year, the rain was particularly heavy, and the stinky water river was leveled, and the water overflowed to the back street. The local residents and shopkeepers discussed together and decided to dig a snail dam and dig a ditch in the silted old river trough to divert the water from the stinky water river into the Yuetang River. The ditch is only two feet wide. The water level of the stinky water river is much higher than that of Yuetang. The water flows like an arrow in the ditch.流着，流着，一个在岸边做桶的孩子忽然惊叫起来：
“鱼！”
一条长有尺半的大鲤鱼叭的一声蹦到岸上来了。接着，一条，一条，又一条，鲤鱼！鲤鱼！鲤鱼！
Flowing, flowing, a child making a bucket on the shore suddenly exclaimed: "Fish!" A large carp about a foot and a half long jumped to the shore with a sound. Then, one, one, another, carp! Carp! Carp!不知从哪里来的那么多的鲤鱼。它们戗着急水往上窜，不断地蹦到岸上。桶店家的男人、女人、大人、小孩，都奔到沟边来捉鱼。有人搬了脚盆放在沟边，等鲤鱼往里跳。大家约定，每家的盆，放在自己家门口，鱼跳进谁家的盆算谁的。
So many carp came from nowhere. They rushed up through the rushing water and kept jumping to the shore. The men, women, adults, and children of the bucket shop all ran to the edge of the ditch to catch fish. Someone moved the foot basin and placed it on the edge of the ditch, waiting for the carp to jump in. Everyone agreed that each family's basin would be placed at their doorstep, and whose pot the fish jumped into would be whose own.他们正在商议，庞家的几个人搬了四个大杀猪盆，在水沟流入越塘入口处挨排放好了。人们小声嘟囔：“真是手尖眼快啊！”但也没有办法。不是说谁家的盆放在谁家门口么？庞家的盆是放在庞家的门口（当然他家门口到河槽还有一个距离），庞家杀猪盆又大，放的地方又好，鱼直往里跳。人们不满意，但是好在家家的盆里都不断跳进鱼来，人们不断地欢呼，狂叫，简直好像做着一个欢喜而又荒唐的梦，高兴压过了不平。
They were discussing that several people from the Pang family moved four large pig killing basins and discharged them at the entrance of the ditch into the Yuetang. People muttered in a low voice: "It's really sharp-eyed!" But there is no way. Isn't it about whose pot is placed at whose doorstep? The Pang family's basin was placed at the door of the Pang family (of course, there is still a distance from his door to the river trough), the Pang family's pig killing basin was big, the place to put it was good, and the fish jumped straight in. People were not satisfied, but fortunately, the fish kept jumping into the basins of the family, and people kept cheering and screaming, as if they were having a happy and absurd dream, and the joy overwhelmed the injustice.这两天，桶匠家家家吃鱼，喝酒。这一辈子没有这样痛快地吃过鱼。一面开怀地嚼着鱼肉，一面还觉得天地间竟有这等怪事：鱼往盆里跳，实在不可思议。
In the past two days, every cooper eats fish and drinks. I have never eaten fish so happily in my life. While chewing fish happily, I also felt that there was such a strange thing in heaven and earth: fish jumping into the basin, which was incredible.两天后，臭水河的积水流泄得差不多了，螺蛳坝重新堵上，沟里没有水了，也没有鱼了，岸上到处是鱼鳞。
Two days later, the stagnant water of the Stinky Water River was almost drained, and the snail dam was re-blocked, there was no water in the ditch, no fish, and the shore was full of fish scales.庞家桶里的鱼最多。但是庞家这两天没有吃鱼。他家吃的是鱼籽、鱼脏。鱼呢？这妯娌三个都把来用盐揉了，肚皮里撑一根芦柴棍，一条一条挂在门口的檐下晾着，挂了一溜。
The Pang family has the most fish in the bucket. But the Pang family has not eaten fish in the past two days. His family eats fish roe and fish dirt. Where is the fish? The three of them rubbed it with salt, and put a reed stick in their belly, hanging it one by one under the eaves at the door, and hung it for a while.把鱼已经通通吃光了的桶匠走到庞家门前，一个对一个说：“真是鱼有眼睛，谁家兴旺，它就往谁家盆里跳啊！”
The cooper who had eaten all the fish walked to the door of the Pang family and said to the other one by one: "Fish really have eyes, whoever prospers, it will jump into whose basin!" ”正在穿堂里做针线的妯娌三个都听见了。三嫂子抬头看了二嫂子一眼，二嫂子看了大嫂子一眼，大嫂子又向两个弟媳妇都看了一眼。她们低下头来继续做针线。她们的嘴角都挂着一种说不清的表情。是对自己的得意？是对别人的鄙夷？
The three sisters-in-law who were doing needlework in the hall all heard it. The third sister-in-law looked up at the second sister-in-law, the second sister-in-law glanced at the eldest sister-in-law, and the eldest sister-in-law glanced at both sisters-in-law. June 18, 1981 Chengde Summer Resort [1] This article was originally published in the second issue of "Beijing Literature", 1982; First Received "Dinner Flower Collection", People's Literature Publishing House, March 1985.[2] 清末邑人谈人格有《警火》诗即咏此事，诗有小序，并录如下：警火送灶后里胥沿街鸣锣于黄昏时，呼“小心火烛”。岁除即叩户乞赏。烛双辉，香一炷，敬惟司命朝天去。云车风马未归来，连宵灯火谁持护。铜钲入耳警黄昏，侧耳有语还重申：“缸注水，灶徙薪”，沿街一一呼之频。唇干舌燥诚苦辛，不谋而告君何人？烹羊酌醴欢除夕，司命归来醉一得。今宵无用更鸣钲，一笑敲门索酒值。从谈的诗中我们知道两件事。一是这种习俗原来由来已久，敲锣喊叫的正是李三这样的“里胥”。二是为什么在那样日子喊叫。原来是因为那时灶王爷上天去了，火烛没人管了。这实在是很有意思。不过，真实的原因还是岁暮风高，容易失火，与灶王的上天去汇报工作关系不大。
[2] At the end of the Qing Dynasty, the townspeople talked about the personality of the poem "Police Fire", which sang about this matter, and the poem had a small preface, and it was recorded as follows:  After sending the stove id_00001, the neighbor sounded the gong along the street at dusk, shouting "Be careful of the fire". At the end of the year, knock on the door and beg for rewards.  candles are twinked, a stick of incense, and respectfully go to the sky. The cloud car and the wind horse have not returned, and who will protect the lights all night. The copper gong enters the ear to warn of dusk, and there is a word in the ear: "The tank is filled with water, and the stove moves firewood", and the call is frequent along the street. Dry lips and dry tongue are bitter and bitter, who will you tell you? Cook lamb and drink sweet Chinese New Year's Eve, and get drunk when you return. Tonight, it's useless to ring the gong, and knock on the door with a smile to ask for the value of the wine. From the poem discussed, we know two things. First, this custom has been around for a long time, and it is Li San who shouts the gong. The second is why he shouted on such a day. It turned out that it was because the Stove King went to heaven at that time, and no one took care of the fire. This is really interesting. However, the real reason is that the wind is high at the end of the year, and it is easy to catch fire, which has little to do with the Kitchen King's heaven to report the work.[3] “撂远些”是说不要挨床太近，以免炉中残火烧着被褥。

晚饭后的故事[1]
[3] "Stay away" means not to get too close to the bed, so as not to burn the bedding in the residual fire in the stove. Stories After Dinner[1]京剧导演郭庆春就着一碟猪耳朵喝了二两酒，咬着一条顶花带刺的黄瓜吃了半斤过了凉水的麻酱面，叼着前门烟，捏了一把芭蕉扇，坐在阳台上的竹躺椅上乘凉。他脱了个光脊梁，露出半身白肉。天渐渐黑下来了。楼下的马缨花散发着一阵一阵的清香。衡水老白干的饮后回甘和马缨花的香味，使得郭导演有点醺醺然了……
Peking Opera director Guo Qingchun drank two taels of wine with a plate of pig ears, ate half a pound of sesame sauce noodles with thorny cucumbers on the top flower, held a cigarette at the front door, pinched a banana fan, and sat on a bamboo lounge chair on the balcony to enjoy the coolness. He took off his bare spine and exposed half of his white flesh. It's getting dark. The lantana flowers downstairs exude bursts of fragrance. The sweetness of Hengshui Lao Baigan and the fragrance of lantana made Director Guo a little drunk......郭庆春小时候，家里很穷苦。父亲死得早，母亲靠缝穷维持一家三口的生活，——郭庆春还有个弟弟，比他小四岁。每天早上，母亲蒸好一屉窝头，留给他们哥俩，就夹着一个针线笸箩，上市去了。地点没有定准，哪里穿破衣服的人多就奔哪里。但总也不出那几个地方。郭庆春就留在家里看着弟弟。他有时也领着弟弟出去玩，去看过妈给人缝穷。妈靠墙坐在街边的一个马扎子上，在闹市之中，在车尘马足之间，在人们的腿脚之下，挣着他们明天要吃的杂和面儿。穷人家的孩子懂事早。冬天，郭庆春知道妈一定很冷；夏天，妈一定很热，很渴，很困。缝穷的冬天和夏天都特别长。郭庆春的街坊、亲戚都比较贫苦，但是郭庆春从小就知道缝穷的比许多人更卑屈，更低贱。他跟着大人和比他大些的孩子学会了说许多北京的俏皮话、歇后语：“武大郎盘杠子，——上下够不着”，“户不拉喂饭，——不正经玩儿”等等，有一句歇后语他绝对不说，小时候不说，长大以后也不说：“缝穷的撒尿，——瞅不冷子”。有一回一个大孩子当他面说了一句，他满脸通红，跟他打了一架。那孩子其实是无心说的，他不明白郭庆春为什么生那么大的气。
When Guo Qingchun was a child, his family was very poor. His father died early, and his mother relied on sewing to support the family of three,—— Guo Qingchun also had a younger brother, four years younger than him. Every morning, my mother steamed a drawer of nests, left them to their brothers, and went to the market with a needle and thread basket. The location is not fixed, and there are many people wearing torn clothes. But there are always those places. Guo Qingchun stayed at home to watch his brother. He sometimes took his younger brother out to play and saw his mother sew poorly. Mom sat against the wall on a horse on the street, in the busy city, between the dust of cars, under people's legs and feet, earning the mixed noodles they would eat tomorrow. Children from poor families are sensible early. In winter, Guo Qingchun knew that his mother must be cold; In summer, my mother must be very hot, thirsty, and sleepy. The winter and summer of poor sewing are particularly long. Guo Qingchun's neighbors and relatives are relatively poor, but Guo Qingchun has known since he was a child that the poor are more humble and lowly than many people. He learned to say a lot of Beijing witticism and afterwords from adults and children older than him: "Wu Dalang is a pole,—— you can't reach it", "Don't feed the household,——,—— it's not a serious game", etc. Once an older child said something in front of him, his face turned red and he got into a fight with him. The child actually said it unintentionally, he didn't understand why Guo Qingchun was so angry.这个穷苦的出身，日后给他带来了无限的好处。
郭庆春十二三岁就开始出去奔自己的衣食了。
This poor birth brought him infinite benefits in the future. Guo Qingchun began to go out to run for his own food and clothing when he was twelve or thirteen years old.他有个舅舅，是在剧场（那会不叫剧场，叫戏园子，或者更古老一些，叫戏馆子）里“写字”的。写字是写剧场门口的海报，和由失业的闲汉扛着走遍九城的海报牌。那会已有报纸，剧场都在报上登了广告，可是很多人还是看了海报牌，知道哪家剧场今天演什么戏，才去买票的。舅舅的光景比郭家好些，也好不到哪里去。他时常来瞧瞧他的唯一的妹妹。他提出，庆春长得快齐他的肩膀高了（舅舅是个矮子），能把自己吃的窝头挣出来了。舅舅出面向放印子的借了一笔本钱，趸了一担西瓜。郭庆春在陕西巷口外摆了一个西瓜摊，把瓜切成块，卖西瓜。

My uncle's situation was better than the Guo family, but not much better. He often came to see his only sister. He proposed that Qingchun was almost as tall as his shoulders (his uncle was a short man) and could earn his own food. 一天晚上，干冷干冷的。郭庆春穿了件小棉袄，蹲在墙旮旯。地面上的冷气从裆下一直透进他的后脊梁。一辆三轮车蹬了过来，车上坐了一个女的。
“三轮，停停。”
Beijing is not big. One night, it was cold and dry. Guo Qingchun wore a small padded jacket and squatted on the wall. The cold air on the ground penetrated from under his crotch into his back spine. A tricycle pedaled over, and a woman sat in the car. "Three rounds, stop."女的揭开盖在腿上的毛毯，下了车。
“这柿子不错，给我包四个。”
她扔下一条手绢，郭庆春挑了四个大的，包上了。他抬起头来，把手绢往上递：是许招弟！穿了一件长毛绒大衣。
许招弟一看，是郭庆春。
The woman lifted the blanket on her leg and got out of the car. "This persimmon is good, give me four." She threw down a handkerchief, and Guo Qingchun picked four large ones and wrapped them. He raised his head and handed the handkerchief up: It's Xu Zhaodi! Wearing a plush coat. Xu Zhaodi took a look and saw that it was Guo Qingchun.“你……这样了！”
郭庆春把脑袋低了下去。
许招弟把柿子钱丢在地下，坐上车，走了。
转过年来，夏天，郭庆春在陕西巷口卖西瓜，正吆唤着（他嗓子有了一点音了），巷里走出一个人来：
"You...... That's it! ” Guo Qingchun lowered his head. Xu Zhaodi threw the persimmon money on the ground, got into the car, and left. In the past year, in the summer, Guo Qingchun was selling watermelons at the entrance of Shaanxi Alley, shouting (his voice had a little sound), and a person came out of the alley:“卖西瓜的，递两个瓜来。——要好的。”
“没错！”
"Sell watermelons, hand over two melons. ——Okay. ” "That's right!"郭庆春挑了两个大黑皮瓜，对旁边的纸烟阁子的掌柜说：“劳您驾，给照看一下瓜摊。”——“你走吧。”郭庆春跟着要瓜的那人走，到了一家，这家正办喜事。堂屋正面挂着大红双喜幔帐，屋里屋外一股炮仗硝烟气味。两边摆着两桌酒。已经行过礼，客人入席了。郭庆春一看，新娘子是许招弟！她烫了发，抹了胭脂口红，耳朵下垂着水钻坠子。郭庆春把两个瓜放在旁边的小方桌上，拔腿就跑。听到后面有人喊：
Guo Qingchun picked two big black skin melons and said to the shopkeeper of the paper cigarette pavilion next to him: "Thank you for driving, take care of the melon stall." ——"You go." Guo Qingchun followed the man who asked for melons and arrived at a house where the house was having a happy event. There is a big red double happiness curtain hanging on the front of the hall, and there is a smell of firecrackers inside and outside the house. There are two tables of wine on both sides. The salute has been given and the guests are seated. Guo Qingchun saw that the bride was Xu Zhaodi! She permed her hair, smeared rouge lipstick, and had rhinestone pendants hanging down her ears. Guo Qingchun put the two melons on the small square table next to him, pulled out his legs and ran away. I heard someone shouting from behind:“卖西瓜的，给你瓜钱！”
这是一个张恨水式的故事，一点小市民的悲欢离合。这样的故事在北京城每天都有。
北京解放了。
"Watermelon sellers, give you melon money!" This is a story of hatred, a little bit of the joys and sorrows of the little citizens. Such stories happen every day in Beijing. Beijing was liberated.解放，使许多人的生活发生了急转直下的变化。许多故事产生了一个原来意想不到的结尾。
郭庆春万万没有想到，他会和一个老干部，一个科长结了婚，并且在结婚以后变成现在的郭导演。
Liberation has brought about a sharp change in the lives of many people. Many stories have produced an originally unexpected ending. Guo Qingchun never expected that he would marry an old cadre and a section chief, and after getting married, he would become the current Director Guo.北京解放以后，物价稳定，没有伤兵，剧场上座很好。很多改了行的演员又纷纷搭班唱戏了。他到他曾经唱过多次戏的剧场去听过几次蹭戏，紧锣密鼓，使他兴奋激动，筋肉伸张。随着锣经，他直替台上的同行使劲。
After the liberation of Beijing, prices were stable, there were no injured soldiers, and the theater was very good. Many actors who have changed their careers have joined classes to sing again. He went to the theater where he had sung many times to listen to the play, and the gong was in full swing, which made him excited and stretched. With the gong scripture, he worked hard for his peers on stage.一个外地剧经到北京来约人。那个贩卖鸡蛋的师哥来找郭庆春：
A foreign drama came to Beijing to make an appointment. The senior brother who sold eggs came to Guo Qingchun:“庆春，他们来找了我。我想去。我提了你。北京的戏不好唱。咱先到外地转转。你的功底我知道，这些年没有全撂下，稍稍练练，能捡回来。听你吆唤，嗓子出来了。咱们一块去吧。学了那些年，能就扔下吗？就你那几出戏，管保能震他们一下子。”
"Qingchun, they came to me. I want to go. I mentioned you. Beijing opera is not easy to sing. Let's go to other places first. I know your skills, I haven't left them all behind over the years, and with a little practice, I can pick them up. Listen to your shout, my voice comes out. Let's go together. After studying for so many years, can you throw it away? Just your few plays, the management and security can shock them all at once. ”郭庆春沉吟了一会，说：“去！”
Guo Qingchun pondered for a while and said, "Go!" ”到了那儿，安顿下了，剧团团长领他们几个新从北京约来的演员去见见当地文化局的领导。戏改科的杨科长接见了他们。杨科长很忙，一会儿接电话，一会在秘书送来的文件收文簿上签字，显得很果断，很有气魄。杨科长勉励了他们几句，说他们是剧团的“新血液”，希望他们发挥自己的专长，为人民服务。郭庆春连连称是。他对杨科长油然产生一种敬重之情。一个女的，能当科长，了不起！他觉得杨科长的举止动作，言谈话语，都像一个男人，不像是个女的。
When they arrived there, they settled down, and the head of the troupe led several of their newly invited actors from Beijing to meet the leaders of the local cultural bureau. Section Chief Yang of the Drama Reform Department received them. Section Chief Yang was very busy, answering the phone for a while, and signing the documents sent by the secretary for a while, looking very decisive and courageous. Section Chief Yang encouraged them a few words, saying that they were the "new blood" of the troupe, and hoped that they would give full play to their expertise and serve the people. Guo Qingchun said yes again and again. He had a sense of respect for Section Chief Yang. A woman can be a section chief, it's amazing! He felt that Section Chief Yang's demeanor, speech, and speech were like a man, not like a woman.重返舞台，心情紧张。一生成败，在此一举。三天“打炮”，提心吊胆。没有想到，一“炮”而红。他第一次听到台下的掌声，好像在做梦。第三天《恶虎村》，出来就有碰头好。以后“四记头”亮相，都有掌声。他扮相好，身上规矩，在台上很有人缘。他也的确是“卯上”了。经过了生活上的一番波折，他这才真正懂得在进科班时他妈跟他说的话：“要肚里长牙”。他在台上从不偷工惜力，他深深知道把戏唱砸了，出溜下来，会有什么后果。他的戏码逐渐往后挪，从开场头一二出挪到中间，又挪到了倒第二。他很知足了，这就到了头。在科班时他就知道自己唱不了大轴，不是那材料。一个人能吃几碗干饭，自己清楚，别人也清楚。
Back on stage, nervous. A lifetime of failure, in this move. Three days of "cannon", fear. Unexpectedly, a "cannon" became popular. He heard the applause from the audience for the first time, as if he was dreaming. On the third day of "Evil Tiger Village", there was a good meeting when he came out. In the future, the "four heads" will appear, and there will be applause. He looks good, has rules, and is very popular on stage. He is indeed "on the rabbit". After some twists and turns in life, he really understood what his mother told him when he entered the class: "You want teeth in your belly". He never cut corners on stage, and he knows what the consequences will be if he smashes the opera and slips out. His drama gradually moved backward, from the first and second outs of the opening scene to the middle, and then to the second to the bottom. He was very content, and this was the end. When he was in the professional class, he knew that he couldn't sing the big axis, not the material. A person can eat a few bowls of dry rice, he knows it himself, and others know it too.杨科长常去看京剧团的戏。一半由于职务，一半出于爱好。他万万没有想到，她后来竟成了他的爱人。
郭庆春在阳台上忽然一个人失声笑了出来。他的女儿在屋里问：“爸爸，你笑什么？”
Section Chief Yang often goes to see the plays of the Peking Opera Troupe. Half because of his position, half out of hobbies. He never expected that she would later become his lover. Guo Qingchun suddenly burst out laughing alone on the balcony. His daughter asked in the house: "Dad, what are you laughing at?" ”他笑他们那个讲习会。市里举办了第一届全市旧艺人讲习会。局长是主任，杨科长是副主任。讲《新民主主义论》、社会发展史、政治经济学。小组讨论，真是笑话百出。杨科长一次在讲课时说：“列宁说过……”一个拉胡琴的老艺人问：“列宁是唱什么的？”——“列宁不是唱戏的。”——“哦，不是唱戏的，那咱们不知道。”又有一次，杨科长鼓励大家要有主人翁思想，这位老艺人没有听明白前言后语，站起来说：“咱们是从旧社会来的，什么坏思想都有，就这主人翁思想，咱没有！”原来他以为主人翁思想就是想当班主的思想。
He laughed at their workshop. The city held the first city-wide workshop on old artists. The director is the director, and Section Chief Yang is the deputy director. He talks about "New Democracy", the history of social development, and political economy. The group discussion is really full of jokes. Section Chief Yang once said during a lecture: "Lenin said......" An old artist playing the huqin asked: "What did Lenin sing?" ——"Lenin didn't sing." ——"Oh, it's not a singer, then we don't know." The old artist did not understand the preface and afterword, stood up and said: "We are from the old society, we have all bad ideas, just this master idea, we don't have it!" It turned out that he thought that the idea of being the owner was the idea of wanting to be the class leader.讲习会要发展一批党员。郭庆春被列为培养对象。杨科长时常找他个别谈话。鼓励他建立革命人生观，提高阶级觉悟，提高政治水平，要在政治上有表现，会上积极发言。郭庆春很认真也很诚恳地照办了。他大小会都发言。讲的最多的是新旧社会对比。他有切身感受，无须准备，讲得很真实，很生动。同行的艺人多有类似经历，容易产生共鸣。讲的人、听的人个个热泪盈眶，效果很好。讲习班结业时，讨论发展党员名单，他因为出身好，政治表现突出，很顺利地通过了。他的入党介绍人是杨科长和局长。
The workshop should develop a group of party members. Guo Qingchun was listed as a training target. Section Chief Yang often talked to him individually. He was encouraged to establish a revolutionary outlook on life, improve class consciousness, improve political level, perform politically, and speak actively at the meeting. Guo Qingchun complied very seriously and sincerely. He spoke at both large and small meetings. What he talked about most was the comparison between old and new society. He had a personal feeling, no preparation, and spoke very truthfully and vividly. Many of the artists in the same industry have similar experiences and are easy to resonate with. The speakers and listeners all had tears in their eyes, and the effect was very good. At the end of the workshop, the list of party members was discussed, and he passed smoothly because of his good background and outstanding political performance. His introduction to the party was Section Chief Yang and Director Yang.第一批发展的党员，回到剧团，全都成了剧团的骨干。郭庆春被提升为副团长、艺委会主任。
The first batch of party members who developed returned to the troupe and all became the backbone of the troupe. Guo Qingchun was promoted to deputy head of the troupe and director of the art committee.因为时常要到局里请示汇报工作，他和杨科长接触的机会就更多了。熟了，就不那么拘谨了，有时也说点笑话，聊点闲天。局里很多人叫杨科长叫杨大姐或大姐，郭庆春也随着叫。虽然叫大姐，他还是觉得大姐很有男子气。
Because he often has to go to the bureau to ask for instructions and report on work, he has more opportunities to contact Section Chief Yang. Many people in the bureau call Section Chief Yang Sister Yang or Big Sister, and Guo Qingchun also calls him. Although he was called eldest sister, he still felt that the eldest sister was very manly.没想到，大姐提出要跟他结婚。他目瞪口呆，结结巴巴，不知说什么好。他觉得和一个领导结婚，简直有点乱伦的味道，他想也没有想过。天地良心，他在大姐面前从来没有起过邪念。他当然同意。
Unexpectedly, the eldest sister proposed to marry him. He was stunned, stammered, and didn't know what to say. He felt that marrying a leader was a bit incest, and he never thought about it. The conscience of heaven and earth, he has never had evil thoughts in front of his eldest sister. Of course he agreed.杨科长的老战友们听说她结了婚，很诧异。听说是和一个京剧演员结婚，尤其诧异。她们想：她这是图什么呢？她喜欢他什么？
Section Chief Yang's old comrades-in-arms were surprised to hear that she was married. They were especially surprised to hear that she was married to a Peking Opera actor. They thought: What is she trying to do? What does she like about him?虽然结了婚，他们的关系还是上下级。不论是在工作上，在家里，她是领导，他是被领导。他习惯于“服从命令听指挥”，觉得这样很舒服，很幸福。
Although they are married, their relationship is still between superiors and subordinates. Whether at work or at home, she is the leader, and he is the leader. He is used to "obeying orders and listening to commands", and he feels very comfortable and happy.杨科长是个目光远大的人，她得给庆春（和她自己）安排一个远景规划的蓝图。庆春目前一切都很顺利，但要看到下一步。唱武生的，能在台上蹦跶多少年呢？照戏班里的说法，要找一个“落劲”。中央戏剧学院举办导演训练班，学员由各省推荐。市里分到一个名额，杨科长提出给郭庆春，科里、局里都同意。郭庆春在导演训练班学了两年，听过苏联专家的课，比较系统的知道斯坦尼斯拉夫斯基体系。毕业之后，回到剧团，大家自然刮目相看。这个剧团原来没有导演，要排新戏，排《三打祝家庄》、《红娘子》，不是向外地剧团学，“刻模子”，就是请话剧团的导演来排。郭庆春学成归来，就成了专职导演。剧团里的人，有人希望他露两手，有人等着看他的笑话。接连排了两个戏，他全“拿”下来了。他并没有用一些斯坦尼的术语去唬人，他知道那样会招人反感。他用一些戏曲演员所熟悉，所能接受的行话临场指挥。比如，他不说“交流”，却说“过电”，——“你们俩得过电哪！”他不说什么“情绪的记忆”这样很玄妙的词儿，他只说是“神气”。“你要长神气。——长一点，再长一点！”他用的舞台调度也无非还是斜胡同、蛇蜕皮……但是变了一下，就使得演员既“过得去”、“走得上来”，又觉得新鲜。郭导演的威信建立起来了。从此，他不上舞台了。有时，有演员病了，他上去顶一角，人们就要竖大拇指：“瞧人家郭导演，不拿导演架子！好样儿的！”
Section Chief Yang is a big-sighted person, and she has to arrange a blueprint for long-term planning for Qingchun (and herself). Everything is going well for Qingchun so far, but we need to see the next step. How many years can a martial artist jump on stage? According to the opera class, you need to find a "down". The Central Academy of Drama holds a director training class, and the students are recommended by the provinces. The city allocated a place, and Section Chief Yang proposed it to Guo Qingchun, and Corey and the bureau agreed. Guo Qingchun studied in the director training class for two years, listened to the classes of Soviet experts, and knew the Stanislavsky system more systematically. After graduation, when he returned to the troupe, everyone was naturally impressed. This troupe originally had no director, and it had to rehearse new plays, such as "Three Dozen Zhujiazhuang" and "Red Lady", either to learn from foreign theater troupes, "carving molds", or to invite the director of the repertory troupe to rehearse. When Guo Qingchun returned from his studies, he became a full-time director. Some people in the troupe wanted him to show his hands, and some people waited to see his jokes. After rehearsing two plays in a row, he "took" them all. He didn't bluff people with some Stani terms, he knew it would be off-putting. He used some jargon that opera actors were familiar with and acceptable. For example, he didn't say "communication", but said "electricity",—— "You two have electricity!" He didn't say anything like a very mysterious word like "emotional memory", he only said "spirit". "You have to be spirited. ——Longer, longer!" The stage scheduling he used was nothing more than a slanted alley and a snake shedding ...... But after a change, the actors are both "passable" and "walkable", and they feel fresh. Director Guo's prestige has been established. Since then, he has not been on stage. Sometimes, when an actor is sick, he goes up to the top corner, and people have to give a thumbs up: "Look at Director Guo, don't take the director's shelf!" Looks good! ”不但在本剧团，外剧团也常请他。京剧、评剧、梆子，他全导过。一通百通，应付裕如。他导的戏，已经不止一出拍成了戏曲艺术片。郭庆春三个字印在影片的片头，街头的广告上。
他不会再卖西瓜，卖柿子了。
Not only in this troupe, but also in foreign troupes. Peking Opera, Pingju, Bangzi, he has directed them all. One is all about getting to the top. More than one of the plays he directed has been made into opera art films. Guo Qingchun's three words are printed at the beginning of the film, on the street advertisements. He won't sell watermelons or persimmons anymore.他曾经两次参加戏剧代表团出国，到过东欧、苏联，到过朝鲜。他听了曾经出过国的师哥的建议，带了一包五香粉，一瓶酱油，于是什么高加索烤羊肉、带血的煎牛排，他都能对付。他很想带一罐臭豆腐，经同行团员的劝阻，才没有带。量服装的时候，问他大衣要什么料子，他毫不迟疑地说：“长毛绒！”服装厂的同志说在外国，男人没有穿长毛绒的，这才改为海军呢。
He has participated in two theater delegations abroad, to Eastern Europe, the Soviet Union, and North Korea. He listened to the advice of his brother who had gone abroad, and brought a pack of five-spice powder and a bottle of soy sauce, so he could deal with any Caucasian roast lamb or bloody fried steak. He really wanted to bring a can of stinky tofu, but after being dissuaded by his fellow troupe members, he didn't bring it. When measuring clothes, he asked him what material he wanted for his coat, and he said without hesitation: "Plush!" The comrades in the garment factory said that in foreign countries, men did not wear plush, so they changed to the navy.他在国外照了好多照片，黑白的，还有彩色的。他的爱人一张一张地贴在仿古缎面的相册上。这些照片上的郭庆春全都是器宇轩昂，很像个大导演。
He took a lot of photos abroad, black and white, and color. His lover was pasted on antique satin albums one by one. Guo Qingchun in these photos is all magnificent, very much like a big director.由于爱人的活动（通过各种“老战友”的关系），他已经调到北京的剧团里来了。他的母亲还健在。他的弟弟由于他的资助，上了学，现在在一家工厂当出纳。他有了一个女儿，已经上小学了。他有一套三居室的单元。他在剧团里自然也有气儿不顺的时候：为一个戏置景置装的费用，演员的“人位”，和领导争得面红耳赤，摔门，拍桌子；偶尔有很“葛”的演员调皮捣蛋“吊腰子”，当面顶撞，出言不逊，气得他要休克，但是这样的时候不多，一年也只是七八次。总的说来，一切都很顺利。他对自己的生活很满意。因为满意，就没有理由不发胖，于是就发胖了。
Due to his lover's activities (through various "old comrades-in-arms"), he has been transferred to a troupe in Beijing. His mother is still alive. His younger brother went to school thanks to his financial support and is now working as a cashier in a factory. He has a daughter who is already in elementary school. He has a three-bedroom unit. He naturally had times when he was unhappy in the troupe: the cost of setting up the scenery for a play, the "position" of the actors, and the leader blushing, slamming doors, and slamming tables; Occasionally, there were very "Ge" actors who were mischievous and "hanging their waists", confronting them in person, speaking rudely, and being so angry that he was about to go into shock, but there were not many times like this, only seven or eight times a year. Overall, everything went well. He was very satisfied with his life. Because of satisfaction, there is no reason not to gain weight, so you get fat.他的感情是平稳的、柔软的、滑润的，像一块奶油（从国外回来，他养成爱吃奶油的习惯）。
今天遇见了一件事，使他的情绪有一点小小的波动。
His feelings are smooth, soft, and smooth, like a piece of cream (returning from abroad, he developed the habit of eating cream). Today I encountered something that made his mood fluctuate a little.剧团招收学员，他是主考。排练厅里摆了一张乒乓案子，几把椅子。他坐在正中的一把上。像当初他进科班时被教师考察一样，一个一个考察着来应试的男孩子、女孩子。看看他们的相貌，体格，叫他们唱两句，拉一个山膀，踢踢腿，——来应试的孩子多半在家里请人教过，都能唱几句，走几个“身上”。然后在名单上用铅笔做一些记号。来应试的女孩子里有一个叫于小玲。这孩子一走出来，郭庆春就一愣，这孩长得太像一个人了。他有点走神。于小玲的唱（她唱的是“苏三离了洪洞县”），所走的“身子”，他都没有认真地听，看，名单上于小玲的名字底下，什么记号也没有做。
The troupe recruits students, and he is the chief examiner. There was a table tennis table and a few chairs in the rehearsal hall. He sat on the middle one. Just like when he was inspected by teachers when he entered the class, he inspected the boys and girls who came to take the exam one by one. Look at their appearance and physique, ask them to sing a couple of sentences, pull a mountain, kick their legs,—— Most of the children who come to take the exam have been taught at home, and they can sing a few sentences and walk a few "bodies". Then make some marks with a pencil on the list. Among the girls who came to take the exam, there was a girl named Yu Xiaoling. As soon as this child came out, Guo Qingchun was stunned, this child looked too much like a person. He was a little distracted. Yu Xiaoling's singing (she sang "Su San left Hongdong County"), he didn't listen carefully to the "body" he walked, look, under Yu Xiaoling's name on the list, he didn't make any marks.学员都考完了，于小玲往外走。郭庆春叫住她：
“于小玲。”
于小玲站住：
“您叫我？”
“……你妈姓什么？”
“姓许。”
没错，是许招弟的女儿。
“你爸爸……对，姓于。他还好吗？”
The students finished the exam, and Yu Xiaoling walked out. Guo Qingchun stopped her: "Yu Xiaoling." Yu Xiaoling stopped: "You call me?" “…… What is your mother's last name? ” "My surname is Xu." That's right, it's Xu Zhaodi's daughter. "Your father...... Yes, surname Yu. Is he okay? ”“我爸死了，有五年了。”
“你妈挺好？”
“还可以。”
“……她还是那样吗？”
“您认得我妈？”
“认得。”
“我妈就在外面。妈——！”
于小玲走出排练厅，郭庆春也跟着走出来。
"My dad has been dead for five years." "Your mother is good?" "It's okay." “…… Is she still like that? ” "Do you recognize my mother?" "I recognize it." "My mom is outside. Mom——! ” Yu Xiaoling walked out of the rehearsal hall, and Guo Qingchun also walked out.迎面走过来许招弟。
许招弟还那样，只是憔悴瘦削，显老了。
“妈，这是郭导演。”
许招弟看着郭庆春，很客气地称呼一声：
“郭导演！”
Xu Zhaodi walked over to him. Xu Zhaodi is still like that, but he is haggard and thin, looking old. "Mom, this is Director Guo." Xu Zhaodi looked at Guo Qingchun and called out very politely: "Director Guo!"郭庆春不知怎么称呼她好，也不能像小时候一样叫她招弟，只好含含糊糊地应了一声，问道：
“您倒好？”
“还凑合。”
“多年不见了。”
“有年头了。——这孩子，您多关照。”
Guo Qingchun didn't know how to call her good, and he couldn't call her a brother like he did when he was a child, so he had to respond vaguely and asked: "Are you okay?" "It's still a good deal." "I haven't seen you for many years." "It's been a year. ——Take care of this child. ”“她不错。条件挺好。”
“回见啦。”
“回见！”
许招弟领着女儿转身走了。郭庆春看见她耳垂后面那颗红痣，有些怅惘。
"She's good. It's good. ” "See you again." "See you later!" Xu Zhaodi led his daughter to turn around and leave. Guo Qingchun saw the red mole behind her earlobe and was a little confused.以上，是京剧导演郭庆春在晚饭之后，微醺之中，闻着一阵一阵的马缨花的香味时所想的一些事。想的时候自然是飘飘忽忽，断断续续的。如果用意识流方法照实地记录下来，将会很长。为省篇幅，只能挑挑拣拣，加以剪裁，简单地勾出一个轮廓。
The above are some of the things that Peking Opera director Guo Qingchun thought when he was slightly drunk after dinner and smelled the fragrance of lantana. When I think about it, it is naturally floating and intermittent. If you use the stream-of-consciousness method to record it on the spot, it will be very long. In order to save space, you can only pick and choose, cut it, and simply outline an outline.郭导演想：……一个人走过的路真是很难预料。如果不是解放了，他会是什么样子呢？也许还是卖西瓜、卖柿子、拉菜车？……如果他出科时不倒仓，又会是什么样子呢？也许他就唱红了，也许就会和许招弟结了婚。那么于小玲就会是他的女儿，她会不姓于，而姓郭？……
Director Guo thought: ...... The road a person has traveled is really difficult to predict. If he hadn't been liberated, what would he be like? Maybe still selling watermelons, persimmons, and pulling food trucks? …… What would it be like if he didn't go out of school when he went out of the department? Maybe he will become popular, or maybe he will marry Xu Zhaodi. Then Yu Xiaoling will be his daughter, will she not be surnamed Yu, but surnamed Guo? ……他正在这样漫无边际地想下去，他的女儿在屋里娇声喊道：
“爸，你进来，我要你！”
正好夹在手里的大前门已经吸完，烟头烧痛了他的手指，他把烟头往楼下的马缨花树帽上一扔，进屋去了。
He was thinking about it so casually, and his daughter cried softly in the house: "Dad, come in, I want you!" The big front door that happened to be clamped in his hand had already finished smoking, and the cigarette butt burned his fingers, so he threw the cigarette butt downstairs on the lantana tree hat and went into the house.第二天，郭导演上午导了一场戏，中午，几个小青年拉他去挑西瓜。
“郭导演，给我们挑一个瓜。”
“去一边去！当导演的还管挑西瓜呀！”
The next day, Director Guo directed a scene in the morning, and at noon, several young people pulled him to pick watermelons. "Director Guo, pick a melon for us." "Go aside! As a director, you still have to pick watermelons! ”但还是被他们连推带拽地去了。他站在一堆西瓜前面巡视一下，挑了一个，用右手大拇指按在瓜皮上，用力往前一蹭，放在耳朵边听一听，轻轻拍一下：
“就这个！保证脆沙瓤。生了，瘘了，我给钱！”
But they still pushed and dragged him to the ground. He stood in front of a pile of watermelons and looked around, picked one, pressed his right thumb on the melon skin, rubbed it forward, put it next to his ear to listen, and patted it gently: "That's it! Guaranteed to be crisp sand. Born, fistula, I'll give you money!" ”他抄起案子上的西瓜刀，一刀切过去，只听见咯喳一声，瓜裂开了：薄皮、红瓤、黑籽。
卖瓜的惊奇地问：
“您卖过瓜？”
“我卖瓜的那阵，还没有你哪！哈哈哈哈……”
He picked up the watermelon knife on the case, cut it with a knife, and only heard a clucking sound, and the melon cracked: thin skin, red pulp, black seeds. The melon seller asked in surprise: "Have you ever sold melons?" "When I sold melons, I didn't have you! Hahahaha......"他大笑着走回剧团。谁也不知道他的笑声里包含了多少东西。
过了几天，招考学员发了榜，于小玲考取了。人们都说，是郭导演给她使了劲。
He laughed and walked back to the troupe. No one knew how much was in his laughter. A few days later, the recruitment students were announced, and Yu Xiaoling was admitted. People said that it was Director Guo who worked hard for her.

[1] This article was originally published in the eighth issue of "People's Literature", 1981; "Dinner Flower Collection", People's Literature Publishing House, March 1985. Move [1]北溟有鱼，其名为鲲。鲲之大，不知其几千里也；化而为鸟，其名为鹏，鹏之背，不知其几千里也。怒而飞，其翼若垂天之云。是鸟也，海运则将徙于南溟。
《庄子·逍遥游》
很多歌消失了。
There is a fish in the North Sea, and its name is Kun. The size of the kun is unknown for thousands of miles; it turns into a bird, its name is Peng, and the back of the peng is thousands of miles away. It flies angrily, and its wings are like clouds hanging in the sky. It is a bird, and the sea will migrate to the South Sea. "Zhuangzi Xiaoyaoyou" Many songs disappeared.许多歌的词、曲的作者没有人知道。
有些歌只有极少数的人唱，别人都不知道。比如一些学校的校歌。
The lyrics of many songs and the author of the song are unknown. Some songs are only sung by a very small number of people, and others don't know about them. For example, some school songs.县立第五小学历年毕业了不少学生。他们多数已经是过六十的人了。他们之中不少人还记得母校的校歌，有人能够一字不差地唱出来。
西挹神山爽气，
东来邻寺疏钟，
看吾校巍巍峻峻，
连云栉比列其中。
Many students have graduated from the county fifth primary school over the years. Most of them are already over sixty. Many of them still remember the school song of their alma mater, and some of them can sing it word for word. Xiyi Shenshan refreshing, The sparse bell of the neighboring temple from the east, Look at the majesty of our school, The clouds are lined up in the middle.半城半郭成调元，
无女无男教育同。
桃红李白，
芬芳馥郁，
一堂济济坐春风。
愿少年，
乘风破浪，
他日毋忘化雨功！
Half city and half city into a tune yuan, No girls or boys are educated the same. Peach red and plum white, fragrant and fragrant, The hall is full of people sitting in the spring breeze. May the youth, Plough the waves Don't forget the rain in the future!每逢“纪念周”，每天上课前的“朝会”，放学前的“晚会”，开头照例是唱“党歌”，最后是唱校歌。一个担任司仪的高年级同学高声喊道：“唱——校——歌！”全校学生，三百来个孩子，就用玻璃一样脆亮的童音，拼足了力气，高唱起来。好像屋上的瓦片、树上的树叶都在唱。他们接连唱了六年，直到毕业离校，真是深深地印在脑子里了。说不定临死的时候还会想起这支歌。
Every "commemorative week", the "morning meeting" before class every day, and the "evening party" before school, as usual, start with singing the "party song" and finally sing the school song. A senior student who served as the emcee shouted loudly: "Sing - school - song!" The whole school, more than 300 children, used a child's voice as crisp as glass to sing with all their strength. It seemed that the tiles on the house and the leaves on the trees were singing. They sang for six years in a row until they graduated and left school, which was really deeply imprinted in their minds. Maybe you will remember this song when you are dying.歌词的意思是没有人解释过的。低年级的学生几乎完全不懂它说的是什么。他们只是使劲地唱，并且倾注了全部感情。到了四五年级，就逐渐明白了，因为唱的次数太多，天天就生活在这首歌里，慢慢地自己就琢磨出来了。最先懂得的是第二句。学校的东边紧挨一个寺，叫做承天寺。承天寺有一口钟。钟撞起来嗡嗡地响。“神山爽气”是这个县的“八景”之一。神山在哪里，“爽气”是什么样的“气”，小学生不知道，只是无端地觉得很美，而且有一种神秘感。下面的歌词也朦朦胧胧地理解了：是说学校有很多房屋，在城外，是个男女合校，有很多同学。总的说来是说这个学校很好。十来岁的孩子很为自己的学校骄傲，觉得它很了不起，并且相信别的学校一定没有这样一首歌。到了六年级，他们才真正理解了这首歌。毕业典礼上（这是他们第一次“毕业”），几位老师们讲过了话，司仪高声喊道：“唱——校——歌！”这是他们最后一次大家聚在一起唱这支歌了。他们唱得异常庄重，异常激动。玻璃一样的童声高唱起来：
The meaning of the lyrics has not been explained by anyone. The younger students almost completely did not understand what it was talking about. They just sang hard and poured all their emotions into it. In the fourth or fifth grade, I gradually understood, because I sang too many times, I lived in this song every day, and slowly figured it out by myself. The first thing I understood was the second sentence. There is a temple next to the east of the school called Chengtian Temple. Chengtian Temple has a bell. The bell buzzes when it strikes. "Shenshan Refreshing" is one of the "Eight Views" of this county. Elementary school students don't know where the sacred mountain is and what kind of "refreshing air" is, but they just think it is beautiful for no reason, and there is a sense of mystery. The lyrics below are also vaguely understood: It means that the school has many houses, outside the city, it is a coeducational school, and there are many classmates. In general, it means that this school is very good. The teenagers are very proud of their school, think it is amazing, and believe that other schools must not have such a song. It wasn't until the sixth grade that they really understood the song. At the graduation ceremony (this was their first "graduation"), several teachers spoke, and the emcee shouted, "Sing-school-song!" This was the last time they got together to sing this song. They sang extremely solemnly and excitedly. The glass-like children's voices sang:西挹神山爽气，
东来邻寺疏钟……
唱到“愿少年，乘风破浪，他日毋忘化雨功”，大家的心里都是酸酸的。眼泪在乌黑的眼睛里发光。这是这首歌的立意所在，点睛之笔，其余的，不过是敷陈其事。从语气看，像是少年对自己的勗勉，同时又像是学校老师对教了六年的学生的嘱咐，一种遗憾、悲哀而酸苦的嘱咐。他们知道，毕业出去的学生，日后多半是会把他们忘记的。
Singing "May the young man, ride the wind and waves, and don't forget the rain in the future", everyone's hearts were sour. Tears glowed in the dark eyes. This is the idea of this song, the finishing touch, and the rest is just a story. Judging from the tone, it seems to be a teenager's encouragement to himself, and at the same time, it is like a school teacher's instruction to the students he has taught for six years, a regretful, sad and bitter instruction. They know that most of the students who graduate will forget them in the future.毕业生中有一些是乘风破浪，做了一番事业的；有的离校后就成为泯然众人，为衣食奔走了一生；有的，死掉了。
Some of the graduates have ridden the wind and waves and made a career; some have become disappeared after leaving school and have worked for food and clothing all their lives; some have died.这不是一支了不起的歌，但很贴切。朴朴实实，平平常常，和学校很相称。一个在寺庙的废基上改建成的普通的六年制小学，又能写出多少诗情画意呢？人们有时想起，只是为了从干枯的记忆里找回一点淡淡的童年，在歌声中想起那些校园里的蔷薇花，冬青树，擦了无数次的教室的玻璃，上课下课的钟声，和球场上像烟火一样升到空中的一阵一阵的明亮的欢笑……
It's not a great song, but it's very appropriate. Simple, ordinary, and very suitable for school. How much poetry can an ordinary six-year primary school converted from the ruins of a temple write? People sometimes think of it just to find a little bit of childhood from dry memories, and in the song, they think of the roses and holly trees on the campus, the glass of the classroom that has been wiped countless times, the bells of class and class, and the bursts of bright laughter that rise into the air like fireworks on the court......校歌的作者是高先生，有些人知道，有些人不知道。
The author of the school song is Mr. Gao, some people know it, some people don't.先生名鹏，字北溟，三十后，以字行。家世业儒。祖父、父亲都没有考取功名，靠当塾师、教蒙学，以维生计。三代都住在东街租来的一所百年老屋之中，临街有两扇白木的板门，真是所谓寒门。先生少孤。尝受业于邑中名士谈甓渔，为谈先生之高足。
Mr. Peng's name is Peng, the word Beiming, after thirty, with the word line. Family Confucianism. Neither grandfather nor father achieved fame, and relied on being a private school teacher and teaching Mongolian studies to make a living. Three generations lived in a century-old house rented on East Street, with two white wooden board doors facing the street, which was really a so-called cold door. Mr. was lonely at a young age. He once studied brick fishing under the famous scholar in the town, and was Mr. Tan's high foot.这谈甓渔是个诗人，也是个怪人。他功名不高，只中过举人，名气却很大。中举之后，累考不进，无意仕途，就在江南江北，沭阳溧阳等地就馆。他教出来的学生，有不少中了进士，谈先生于是身价百倍，高门大族，争相延致。晚年惮于舟车，就用学生谢师的银子，回乡盖了一处很大的房子，闭户著书。书是著了，门却是大开着的。他家门楼特别高大。为什么盖得这样高大？据说是盖窄了怕碰了他的那些做了大官的学生的纱帽翅儿。其实，哪会呢？清朝的官戴的都是顶子，缨帽花翎，没有帽翅。地方上人这样的口传，无非是说谈老先生的阔学生很多。这座大门里每年进出的知县、知府，确实不在少数。门楼宽大，是为了供轿夫休息用的。往年，两边放了极其宽长的条凳，柏木的凳面都被人的屁股磨得光光滑滑的了。谈家门楼巍然突出，老远的就能看见，成了指明方位的一个标志，一个地名。一说“谈家门楼”东边，“谈家门楼”斜对过，人们就立刻明白了。谈甓渔的故事很多。他念了很多书，学问很大，可是不识数，不会数钱。他家里什么都有，可是他愿意到处闲逛，到茶馆里喝茶，到酒馆里喝酒，烟馆里抽烟。每天出门，家里都要把他需用的烟钱、茶钱、酒钱分别装在布口袋里，给他挂在拐杖上，成了名副其实的“杖头钱”。他常常傍花随柳，信步所之，喝得半醉，找不到自己的家。他爱吃螃蟹，可是自己不会剥，得由家里人把蟹肉剥好，又装回蟹壳里，原样摆成一个完整的螃蟹。两个螃蟹能吃三四个小时，热了凉，凉了又热。他一边吃蟹，一边喝酒，一边看书。他没有架子，没大没小，无分贵贱，三教九流，贩夫走卒，都谈得来，是个很通达的人。然而，品望很高。就是点过翰林的李三麻子远远从轿帘里看见谈老先生曳杖而来，也要赶紧下轿，避立道侧。他教学生，教时文八股，也教古文词赋，经史百家。他说：“我不愿谈甓渔教出来的学生，如郑板桥所说，对案至不能就一札！”他大概很会教书，经他教过的学生，不通的很少。
This Tan Piyu is a poet and a strange person. He is not famous, he has only passed the examination, but he is very famous. After passing the examination, he failed to pass the exam and had no intention of career, so he went to the library in Jiangnan and Jiangbei, Shuyang, Liyang and other places. Many of the students he taught won the Jinshi, so Mr. Tan was worth a hundred times more than a hundred times, and the noble family competed to extend it. In his later years, he was afraid of boats and cars, so he used the money from the student Xie Shi to return to his hometown to build a big house and write books behind closed doors. The book is on, but the door is wide open. His gatehouse is very tall. Why is it so tall? It is said that the cover is narrow for fear of touching the wings of his students who have become high officials. Actually, how could it be? Officials in the Qing Dynasty wore hats, tassels and hats, and no hat wings. Such an oral tradition from local masters is nothing more than saying that there are many students of Mr. Tan. There are indeed not a few county magistrates and prefects who enter and exit this gate every year. The gatehouse is wide and is for the palanquin bearers to rest. In previous years, extremely wide and long benches were placed on both sides, and the cypress stools were polished smooth and smooth by people's buttocks. The Tanjia Gate Tower stands out majestically and can be seen from afar, becoming a sign and a place name indicating the direction. As soon as it is said that the east side of the "Tanjia Gate Tower" and the "Tanjia Gate Tower" are diagonally opposite, people immediately understand. There are many stories about Tan Brick Fishing. He read a lot of books and was very knowledgeable, but he couldn't count and couldn't count money. He has everything at home, but he is willing to wander around, drink tea in teahouses, drink in taverns, and smoke in tobacco shops. Every day when he goes out, his family has to put the cigarette money, tea money, and wine money he needs in a cloth pocket and hang it on his crutches, which has become a veritable "cane money". He often followed the flowers and willows, strolled around, drunk half-drunk, and couldn't find his home. He loves to eat crabs, but he can't peel them himself, so he has to have his family peel the crab meat, put it back in the crab shell, and put it back into the crab shell, and put it back into a complete crab as it is. Two crabs can eat for three or four hours, hot and cold, cold and hot. He ate crabs and drank while reading. He has no shelf, no big or small, no distinction between rich and lowly, three teachings and nine streams, peddlers and pawns, all of which can be talked about, and he is a very knowledgeable person. However, the reputation is very high. It was Li Sanmazi, who had ordered the Hanlin Academy, to see Mr. Tan coming with a cane from a distance from the curtain of the sedan chair, and he had to quickly get out of the sedan chair and avoid the side of the road. He taught students, taught the eight strands of poetry, ancient literature, and classics and history.
