He is probably very good at teaching, and there are very few students he has taught.谈老先生知道高家很穷，他教高先生书，不受修金。每回高先生的母亲封了节敬送去，谈老先生必亲自上门退回，说：
Mr. Tan knew that the Gao family was very poor, and he taught Mr. Gao to read, but he did not accept repairs. Every time Mr. Gao's mother sealed the festival and sent it away, Mr. Tan would personally come to the door to return it, saying:“老嫂子，我与高鹏的父亲是贫贱之交，总角之交，你千万不要这样！我一定格外用心地教他，不负故人。高鹏的天资，虽只是中上，但很知发愤。他深知先人为他取的名、字的用意。他的诗文都很有可观，高氏有子矣。北溟之鹏终将徙于南溟。高了，不敢说。青一衿，我看，如拾芥耳。我好歹要让他中一名秀才。”
"Old sister-in-law, Gao Peng's father and I are poor friends, and we are friends of the general angle, so don't be like this! I will definitely teach him with extra care and live up to his old friends. Gao Peng's talent, although he is only in the upper middle, knows how to be angry. He knows the intention of the name and words his ancestors gave him. His poems are very impressive, and Gao has a son. The Peng of the North Sea will eventually move to the South Sea. It's high, I dare not say it. Qing Yijin, I see, is like picking up mustard. I want him to be a scholar anyway. ”果然，高先生在十六岁的时候，高高地中了一名秀才。众人说：高家的风水转了。
不想，第二年就停了科举。
Sure enough, when Mr. Gao was sixteen years old, he won a scholar in Gao Gao. Everyone said: The feng shui of the Gao family has changed. I didn't want to, so I stopped the imperial examination the following year.废科举，兴学校，这个小县城里增添了几个疯子。有人投河跳井，有人跑到明伦堂[2]去痛哭。就在高先生所住的东街的最东头，有一姓徐的呆子。这人不知应考了多少次，到头来还是一个白丁。平常就有点迂迂磨磨，颠颠倒倒。说起话满嘴之乎者也。他老婆骂他：“晚饭米都没得一颗，还你妈的之乎——者也！”徐呆子全然不顾，朗吟道：“之乎者也矣焉哉，七字安排好秀才！”自从停了科举，他又添了一宗新花样。每逢初一、十五，或不是正日，而受了老婆的气，邻居的奚落，他就双手捧了一个木盘，盘中置一香炉，点了几根香，到大街上去背诵他的八股窗稿。穿着油腻的长衫，靸着破鞋，一边走，一边念。随着文气的起承转合，步履忽快忽慢；词句的抑扬顿挫，声音时高时低。念到曾经业师浓圈密点的得意之处，摇头晃脑，昂首向天，面带微笑，如醉如痴，仿佛大街上没有一个人，天地间只有他的字字珠玑的好文章。一直念到两颊绯红，双眼出火，口沫横飞，声嘶气竭。长歌当哭，其声冤苦。街上人给他这种举动起了一个名字，叫做“哭圣人”。
Abolished the imperial examination and built a school, adding a few madmen to this small county. Some people jumped into the river and jumped into the well, and some ran to Minglun Hall [2] to cry bitterly. At the easternmost end of East Street where Mr. Gao lived, there was a fool surnamed Xu. I don't know how many times this person has taken the exam, but in the end he is still a white man. Usually a little roundabout and upside down. He is also full of words. His wife scolded him: "I didn't get a single rice for dinner, and I will give you back the fuck!" Xu Fool ignored it completely and recited: "It's a good thing, the seven characters are arranged to be a scholar!" Since the imperial examination was stopped, he has added a new trick. Every time on the first and fifteenth days of the new year, or not the first day, and he was angry with his wife and ridiculed by his neighbors, he held a wooden plate in both hands, put an incense burner in the plate, lit a few sticks of incense, and went to the street to recite his eight-strand window manuscript. Wearing a greasy robe and tattered shoes, he walked and read at the same time. With the rise and fall of the literary style, the steps are fast and slow; the intonation of the words is faltering, and the voice is high and low. Thinking of the pride of the former teacher, he shook his head, held his head high to the sky, smiled, and was drunk, as if there was no one on the street, and there was only his good articles in the world. I read it until my cheeks were crimson, my eyes were on fire, my mouth was foaming, and my voice was hoarse. The long song should cry, and its voice will be bitter. The people on the street gave him a name for this action, called "Crying Saint".他这样哭了几年，一口气上不来，死在街上了。
高北溟坐在百年老屋之中，常常听到徐呆子从门外哭过来，哭过去。他恍恍惚惚觉得，哭的是他自己。
功名道断，高北溟怎么办呢？
He cried like this for several years, couldn't get up in one breath, and died on the street. Gao Beiming sat in a century-old house and often heard Xu Duzi crying from outside the door. He felt in a trance that he was crying. Fame is broken, what should Gao Beiming do?头二年，他还能靠笔耕生活。谈先生还没有死。有人求谈先生的文字，碑文墓志，寿序挽联，谈先生都推给了高先生。所得润笔，尚可粥。谈先生寿终，高北溟缌麻服孝，尽礼致哀，写了一篇长长的祭文，泣读之后，忧心如焚。
In the first two years, he was still able to live on his pen. Mr. Tan is not dead yet. Someone asked Mr. Tan for his words, epitaphs, and life prefaces, and Mr. Tan pushed them to Mr. Gao. The pen obtained is still  porridge. When Mr. Tan died, Gao Beiming wore filial piety, mourned with courtesy, and wrote a long memorial text.他也曾像他的祖父和父亲一样，开设私塾教几个小小蒙童，教他们读三（字经）、百（家姓）、千（字文），《幼学琼林》、《龙文鞭影》。然而除了少数极其守旧的人家，都已经把孩子送进学校了。他也曾挂牌行医看眼科。谈甓渔老先生的祖上本是眼科医生。他中举之后，还偶尔为人看眼疾。他劝高鹏也看看眼科医书，给他讲过平热泻肝之道。万一功名不就，也有一技之长，能够糊口。可是城里近年害眼的不多。有患赤红火眼的，多半到药店里买一副鹅翎眼药（装在一根鹅毛翎管里的红色的眼药），清水化开，用灯草点进眼内，就好了。眼科，不像“男妇内外大小方脉”那样有“走时”的时候。文章不能锅里煮，百无一用是书生，一家四口，每天至少要升半米下锅，如之何？如之何？
Like his grandfather and father, he also opened a private school to teach a few little Meng children, teaching them to read three (character scriptures), hundred (family surname), thousand (character text), "Preschool Qionglin", and "Longwen Whip Shadow". However, except for a few extremely conservative families, they have already sent their children to school. He has also been listed to practice ophthalmology. Mr. Tan Piyu's ancestors were ophthalmologists. After he passed the examination, he occasionally saw eye diseases. He persuaded Gao Peng to also read the ophthalmologist's book and told him how to calm the heat and drain the liver. In case you don't get fame, you also have a skill and can make a living. However, there are not many eye harm in the city in recent years. If you have red eyes, most of them will go to the pharmacy to buy a pair of goose feather eye drops (red eye drops in a goose feather tube), dissolve the water, and use lamp grass to light into the eyes. Ophthalmology, unlike "men and women's internal and external square veins", has a "time". The article can't be cooked in a pot, it's useless It's a scholar, a family of four, at least half a meter a day to put it in the pot, what should I do? What to do?正在书空咄咄，百无聊赖，有一个平素很少来往的世交沈石君来看他。沈石君比高北溟大几岁，也曾跟谈甓渔读过书，开笔成篇以后，到苏州进了书院。书院改成学堂，革命、“光复”……他就成了新派，多年在外边做事。他有志办教育，在省里当督学。回乡视察了几个小学之后，拍开了高家的白木板门。他劝高北溟去读两年简易师范，取得一个资格，教书。
He was bored and bored, and a friend Shen Shijun, who rarely interacted with him, came to see him. Shen Shijun was a few years older than Gao Beiming, and he had also read books with Tan Piyu, and after writing a book, he went to Suzhou to enter the academy. The academy was changed to a school, revolution, "restoration"...... He became a new school and worked outside for many years. He aspires to run education and work as an inspector in the province. After returning to his hometown to inspect several primary schools, he opened the white wooden door of the Gao family. He persuaded Gao Beiming to study at a simple normal school for two years, obtain a qualification, and teach.读师范是被人看不起的。师范不收学费，每月还可有伙食津贴，师范生被人称为“师范花子”，但这在高北溟是一条可行的路，虽然现在还来入学读书，岁数实在太大些了。好在同学中年纪差近的也还有，而且“简师”只有两年，一晃也就过去了。
Studying in normal is looked down upon. Normal students are called "normal flowers", but this is a feasible way in Gao Beiming, although they are still coming to school to study, and the age is too old. Fortunately, there are still some classmates who are close in age, and the "Jian Shi" is only two years, and it has passed in a flash.简师毕业，高先生在“五小”任教。
高先生有了职业，有了虽不丰厚但却可靠的收入，可以免于冻饿，不致像徐呆子似的死在街上了。
After graduating from Jian Shi, Mr. Gao taught in the "Five Primary Schools". Mr. Gao has a career and a reliable income, which is not rich but reliable, so he can avoid freezing and starvation, and he will not die on the street like Xu Idio.按规定，简师毕业，只能教初、中年级，因为高先生是谈甓渔的高足，中过秀才，声名籍籍，叫他去教“大狗跳，小狗叫，大狗跳一跳，小狗叫一叫”，实在说不过去，因此，破格担任了五、六年级的国文。即使是这样，当然也还不能展其所长，尽其所学。高先生并不意满志得。然而高先生教书是认真的。讲课、改作文，郑重其事，一丝不苟。
According to the regulations, after graduating, Master Jian can only teach junior and middle grades, because Mr. Gao is a master of talking about brick fishing, a scholar, and a famous person, so he asked him to teach "big dog jumping, puppy barking, big dog jumping, puppy barking", which is really unreasonable, so he served as the fifth and sixth grade Chinese. Even so, of course, he still can't show his strengths and learn to the best of his ability. Mr. Gao is not satisfied. However, Mr. Gao is serious about teaching. Lectures, revised compositions, solemn and meticulous.同事起初对他很敬重，渐渐地在背后议论起来，说这个人的脾气很“方”。是这样。高先生落落寡合，不苟言笑，不爱闲谈，不喜交际。他按时到校，到教务处和大家略点一点头，拿了粉笔、点名册就上教室。下了课就走。有时当中一节没有课，就坐在教务处看书。小学教师的品类也很杂。有正派的教师；也有头上涂着司丹康、脸上搽着雪花膏的纨绔子弟；戴着瓜皮秋帽、留着小胡子，琵琶襟坎肩的纽子挂着青天白日徽章，一说话不停地挤鼓眼的幕僚式的人物。他们时常凑在一起谈牌经，评“花榜”[3]，交换庸俗无聊的社会新闻，说猥亵下流的荤笑话。高先生总是正襟危坐，不作一声。同事之间为了“联络感情”，时常轮流做东，约好了在星期天早上“吃早茶”。这地方“吃早茶”不是喝茶，主要是吃各种点心——蟹肉包子、火腿烧麦、冬笋蒸馒、脂油千层糕。还可叫一个三鲜煮干丝，小酌两杯。这种聚会，高先生概不参加。小学校的人事说简单也简单，说复杂也挺复杂。教员当中也有派别，为了一点小小私利，排挤倾轧，勾心斗角，飞短流长，造谣中伤。这些派别之间的明暗斗争，又与地方上的党政权势息息相关，且和省中当局遥相呼应。千丝万缕，变幻无常。高先生对这种派别之争，从不介入。有人曾试图对他笼络（高先生素负文名，受人景仰，拉过来是个“实力”），被高先生冷冷地拒绝了。他教学生，也是因材施教，无所阿私，只看品学，不问家庭。每一班都有一两个他特别心爱的学生。高先生看来是个冷面寡情的人，其实不是这样，只是他对得意的学生的喜爱不形于色，不像有些婆婆妈妈的教员，时常摸着学生的头，拉着他的手，满脸含笑，问长问短。他只是把他的热情倾注在教学之中。他讲书，眼睛首先看着这一两个学生，看他们领会了没有。改作文，改得特别仔细。听这一两个学生回讲课文，批改他们的作文课卷，是他的一大乐事。只有在这样的时候，他觉得不负此生，做了一点有意义的事。对于平常的学生，他亦以平常的精力对待之。对于资质顽劣，不守校规的学生，他常常痛加训斥，不管他的爸爸是什么局长还是什么党部委员。有些话说得比较厉害，甚至侵及他们的家长。因这些，校中同事不喜欢他，又有点怕他。他们为他和自己的不同处而忿忿不平，说他是自命清高，沽名钓誉，不近人情，有的干脆说：“这是绝户脾气！”
At first, his colleagues respected him very much, but gradually talked behind his back, saying that this person's temper was very "square". That's right. Mr. Gao is sloppy, unsmiling, not fond of small talk, and not sociable. He arrived at school on time, nodded slightly to the Academic Affairs Office, took the chalk and roll call list and went to the classroom. Leave after class. Sometimes there is no class in one class, so I sit in the academic affairs office and read. The categories of primary school teachers are also very mixed. There are decent teachers; there are also gentle children with Stankang on their heads and alabaster paste on their faces; Wearing a melon skin hat, a mustache, a blue sky and white sun badge hanging from the button on the shoulder of the pipa, and a staff-like figure who keeps squeezing his eyes as he speaks. They often get together to talk about card classics, comment on the "flower list" [3], exchange vulgar and boring social news, and say obscene meat jokes. Mr. Gao always sits upright and does not say a word. In order to "connect feelings", colleagues often take turns to do things and make an appointment to "have morning tea" on Sunday mornings. "Morning tea" in this place is not tea, but mainly a variety of snacks - crab buns, ham roasted wheat, steamed buns with winter bamboo shoots, and mille-feuille cakes with fat and oil. You can also order a three-fresh boiled dried shreds and have two drinks. Mr. Gao does not participate in this kind of party. The personnel of the primary school are simple and complicated. There are also factions among the faculty members, who, for a little selfish gain, exclude and squeeze, intrigue, fly short and long, and spread rumors and slander. The light and dark struggle between these factions is closely related to the local party and government power, and echoes the provincial authorities. Inextricable and changeable. Mr. Gao never intervened in this kind of factional dispute. Someone tried to win him over (Mr. Gao was famous for his literary talent, admired, and pulled over as a "strength"), but Mr. Gao coldly refused. He taught students according to their aptitude, without selfishness, only looking at character and learning, and not asking about their families. Each class has one or two students he particularly loves. Mr. Gao seems to be a cold-faced and heartless person, but his love for proud students is not visible, unlike some mothers-in-law's teachers, who often touch students' heads, hold his hands, smile on their faces, and ask long and short questions. He just poured his enthusiasm into teaching. When he lectured, he first looked at these two students to see if they understood. Change the composition, change it very carefully. Listening to these two students give back to the text and correct their composition papers is a great pleasure for him. Only at times like this did he feel that he lived up to this life and did something meaningful. He also treats ordinary students with ordinary energy. He often reprimands students who are stubborn and do not abide by school rules, no matter what director or party committee member his father is. Some of them said more violently, even invading their parents. Because of this, his colleagues in the school didn't like him and were a little afraid of him. They were indignant about the differences between him and themselves, saying that he was pretentious, seeking fame and reputation, and was unkind, and some simply said: "This is a desperate temper!" ”高先生没有儿子，只有两个女儿。
Mr. Gao has no sons, only two daughters.高先生性子很急，爱生气。生起气来不说话，满脸通红，脑袋不停地剧烈地摇动。他家世寒微，资格不高，故多疑。有时别人说了一两句不中听的话，或有意，或无意，高先生都会多心。比如有的教员为一点不顺心的事而牢骚，说：“家有三担粮，不当孩子王！我祖上还有几亩薄田，饿不死。不为五斗米折腰，我辞职，不干了！”——“老子不是那不花钱的学校毕业的，我不受这份窝囊气！”高先生都以为这是敲打他，他气得太阳穴的青筋都绷起来了。看样子他就会拍桌大骂，和人吵一架，然而他强忍下了，他只是不停地剧烈地摇着脑袋。
Mr. Gao is very impatient and loves to get angry. When he was angry, he didn't speak, his face was red, and his head kept shaking violently. His family background is humble and his qualifications are not high, so he is suspicious. Sometimes others say something unpleasant, either intentionally or unintentionally, and Mr. Gao will be careful. For example, some teachers complained about something unsatisfactory, saying: "The family has three loads of grain, and it is not the king of children!" My ancestors still have a few acres of thin fields, and they will not starve. If I don't bend my waist for five buckets of rice, I will resign and quit!" ——"I didn't graduate from that school that didn't cost money, and I don't feel like I'm angry!" Mr. Gao thought it was a beating to him, and he was so angry that the veins on his temples were tense. It seemed that he would slap the table and curse and quarrel with people, but he endured it, he just kept shaking his head violently.高先生很孤僻，不出人情，不随份子，几乎与人不通庆吊。他家从不请客，他也从不赴宴。他教书之外，也还为人写寿序，撰挽联，委托的人家照例都得请请他。知单[4]送到，他照例都在自己的名字下书一“谢”字。久而久之，都知道他这脾气，也就不来多此一举了。
Mr. Gao is very withdrawn, unkind, unobedient, and almost never communicates with others. His family never treats guests, and he never goes to banquets. In addition to teaching, he also wrote birthday prefaces and elegies for people, and the people he entrusted had to invite him as usual. When the notice sheet [4] was delivered, he wrote the word "thank you" under his name as usual. Over time, everyone knew his temper, so he didn't do more.他不吃烟，不饮酒，不打牌，不看戏。除了学校和自己的家，哪里也不去。每天他清早出门，傍晚回家。拍拍白木的板门，过了一会，门开了。进门是一条狭长的过道，砖缝里长着扫帚苗，苦艾，和一种名叫“七里香”其实是闻不出什么气味，开着蓝色的碎花的野草，有两个黄蝴蝶寂寞地飞着。高先生就从这些野草丛中踏着沉重的步子走进去，走进里面一个小门，好像走进了一个深深的洞穴，高大的背影消失了。木板门又关了，把门上的一副春联关在外面。
He doesn't smoke, drink, play cards, or watch plays. He doesn't go anywhere except school and his own home. Every day he goes out early in the morning and returns home in the evening. He patted the white wooden wooden door, and after a while, the door opened. Entering the door is a long and narrow aisle, with broom seedlings, absinthe, and a weed called "Qili Xiang" actually smelling nothing, blooming blue flowers, and two yellow butterflies flying lonely. Mr. Gao walked in with heavy steps from these weeds, and walked into a small door inside, as if he had walked into a deep cave, and his tall back disappeared. The wooden door closed again, and a pair of Spring Festival couplets on the door were closed outside.高先生家的春联都是自撰的，逐年更换。不像一般人家是迎祥纳福的吉利话，都是述怀抱、舒愤懑的词句，全城少见。
这年是辛未年，板门上贴的春联嵌了高先生自己的名、字：
辛夸高岭桂
未徙北溟鹏
The old house where Mr. Gao lived on East Street has collapsed, and the walls and white wooden doors facing the street have not yet collapsed. The Spring Festival couplets written by Mr. Gao on the board door are still there. The big red red paper has been blown almost white by the wind and rain, but the handwriting in ink is still very thick and black. Singkwa Gaoling Gui He had not yet been transferred to the North Sea Peng也许这是一个好兆，“未徙”者“将徙”也。第二年，即壬申年，高北溟竟真的“徙”了。
Perhaps this is a good sign, and those who have not moved are "about to move". The second year, that is, the year of Renshen, Gao Beiming really "moved".这县里有一个初级中学。除了初中，还有一所初级师范，一所女子师范，都是为了培养小学师资的。只有初中生，是准备将来出外升学的，因此这初中俨然是本县的最高学府。可是一向办得很糟。名义上的校长是李三麻子，根本不来视事。教导主任张维谷（这个名字很怪）是个出名的吃白食的人。他有几句名言：“不愿我请人，不愿人请我，只愿人请人，当中有个我”。人品如此，学问可知。数学教员外号“杨半本”，他讲代数、几何，从来没有把一本书讲完过，大概后半本他自己也不甚了了。历史教员姓居，是个律师，学问还不如高尔础。他讲唐代的艺术一节，教科书上说唐代的书法分“方笔”和“圆笔”，他竟然望文生义，说方笔的笔杆是方的，圆笔的笔杆是圆的。连初中的孩子略想一想，也觉得无此道理。一个学生当时就站起来问：“笔杆是方的，那么笔头是不是也是方的呢？”这帮学混子简直是在误人子弟。学生家长，意见很大。到了暑假，学生闹了一次风潮（这是他们第一次参加的“学潮”）。事情还是从居大律师那里引起的。平日，学生在课堂上有什么不明白的问题问他，他的回答总是“书上有”。到学期考试时，学生搞了一次变相的罢考。卷子发下来，不到五分钟，一个学生以关窗为号，大家一起把卷子交了上去，每道试题下面一律写了三个字：“书上有”！张维谷及其一伙，实在有点“维谷”，混不下去了。
There is a junior high school in this county. In addition to junior high school, there is also a junior normal school and a women's normal school, all of which are aimed at training primary school teachers. Only junior high school students are preparing to go out to study in the future, so this junior high school is like the highest institution in the county. But it has always been done very poorly. The nominal principal is Li Sanmazi, who doesn't come to see things at all. The director of teaching, Zhang Weigu (this name is very strange), is a famous person who eats for nothing. He has a few famous sayings: "I don't want people to invite me, I don't want people to invite me, I just want people to invite people, and there is one of them in it." The character is like this, and the knowledge can be known. The mathematics teacher is nicknamed "Yang Banben", he talks about algebra and geometry, and he has never finished a book, and probably he doesn't know much about the second half of the book. The history teacher's surname is Ju, a lawyer, and his knowledge is not as good as that of Gao Erzha. He talked about the art of the Tang Dynasty, and the textbook said that the calligraphy of the Tang Dynasty was divided into "square pen" and "round pen". Even the junior high school children thought about it for a moment and felt that there was no such reason. A student stood up and asked, "The pen barrel is square, so is the pen tip also square?" These bastards are simply misleading their children. The parents of the students have a lot of opinions. During the summer vacation, the students had a trend (this was the first time they participated in the "student tide"). The incident still happened from the barrister. On weekdays, when students ask him questions they don't understand in class, his answer is always "in the book". When it came time for the semester exam, the students engaged in a disguised strike. The papers were sent, and in less than five minutes, a student closed the window, and everyone handed over the papers together, and three words were written under each test question: "On the book"! Zhang Weigu and his gang are really a bit "Weigu" and can't get along.教育局长不得不下决心对这个学校进行改组，——否则只怕连他这个局长也坐不稳。
The director of education had to make up his mind to reorganize the school,—— otherwise he would not be able to sit still.恰好沈石君因和厅里一个科长意见不合，愤而辞职，回家闲居，正在四处写信，托人找事，地方上人挽他出山来长初中。沈石君再三推辞，禁不住不断有人踵门劝说，也就答应了。他只提出一个条件：所有教员，由他决定。教育局长沉吟了一会，说：“可以。”
It happened that Shen Shijun resigned angrily because he disagreed with a section chief in the hall, went home to live idly, and was writing letters everywhere, asking people to find trouble, and the local superiors pulled him out of the mountains to grow junior high school. Shen Shijun repeatedly declined, and couldn't help but be persuaded by people who kept coming to the door, so he agreed. He only put forward one condition: all teachers are up to him. The director of education pondered for a while and said, "Yes." ”沈石君是想有一番作为的。他自然要考虑各种关系，也明知局长的口袋里装了几个人，想往初中里塞，不得不适当照顾，但是几门主要课程的教员绝对不能迁就。
国文教员，他聘了高北溟。许多人都感到意外。
Shen Shijun wanted to make a difference. He naturally had to consider various relationships, and he knew that the director had a few people in his pocket, and he wanted to stuff it into the junior high school, so he had to take proper care of it, but the teachers of several major courses must not be accommodated. Chinese language teacher, he hired Gao Beiming. Many people were surprised.高先生自然欣然同意。他谈了一些他对教学的想法。沈石君认为很有道理。
Mr. Gao naturally agreed. He talked about some of his ideas for teaching. Shen Shijun thought it made sense.高先生要求“随班走”。教一班学生，从初一教到初三，一直到送他们毕业，考上高中。他说别人教过的学生让他来教，如垦生荒，重头来起，事倍功半。教书教人，要了解学生，知己知彼。不管学生的程度，照本宣科，是为瞎教。学生已经懂得的，再来教他，是白费；暂时不能接受的，勉强教他，是徒劳。他要看着、守着他的学生，看到他是不是一月有一月的进步，一年有一年的进步。如同注水入瓶，随时知其深浅。他说当初谈老先生就是这样教他的。
Mr. Gao asked to "go with the class". Teach a class of students from the first to the third year of junior high school, until they graduate and are admitted to high school. He said that the students he has taught by others are asked to teach, such as reclaiming wasteland and starting over, and getting twice the result with half the effort. Teaching and teaching people must understand the students, know oneself and know the enemy. Regardless of the level of the student, teaching according to the script is blind teaching. What the student already understands, it is in vain to teach him again; if it is temporarily unacceptable, it is futile to teach him. He wants to watch and guard his students to see if he has made progress in January and January, and has made progress year by year. It's like pouring water into a bottle, knowing its depth at any time. He said that this is how Mr. Tan taught him at the beginning.他要求在部定课本之外，自选教材。他说教的是书，教书是高北溟。“只有我自己熟读，真懂，我所喜爱的文章，我自己为之感动过的，我才讲得好。”他强调教材要有一定的系统性，要有重点。他也讲《苛政猛于虎》、《晏子使楚》、《项羽本纪》、《出师表》、《陈情表》、韩、柳、欧、苏。集中地讲的是白居易、归有光、郑板桥。最后一学期讲的是朱自清的《背影》、都德的《磨坊文札》。他好像特别喜欢归有光的文章。一个学期内把《先妣事略》、《项脊轩志》、《寒花葬志》都讲了。他要把课堂讲授和课外阅读结合起来。课上讲了《卖炭翁》、《新丰折臂翁》，同时把白居易的新乐府全部印发给学生。讲了一篇《潍县署中寄弟墨》，把郑板桥的几封主要的家书、道情和一些题画的诗也都印发下去。学生看了，很有兴趣。这种做法，在当时的初中国文教员中极为少见。他选的文章看来有一个标准：有感慨，有性情，平易自然。这些文章有一个贯串性的思想倾向，这种倾向大体上可以归结为：人道主义。
He asked to choose his own textbooks in addition to the textbooks. He taught books, and taught Gao Beiming. "Only when I read and really understand the articles I like, and I have been moved by them, can I speak well." He emphasized that textbooks should be systematic and focused. He also talked about "Harsh Politics is Fiercer than a Tiger", "Yan Zi Envoy Chu", "Xiang Yu's Biography", "Teacher's Table", "Chen Qing Table", Han, Liu, Ou, and Su. He focused on Bai Juyi, Gui Youguang, and Zheng Banqiao. The last semester was Zhu Ziqing's "Back" and Dude's "Mill Paper". He seems to like Gui Youguang's articles. In one semester, he talked about "The Story of the First Mother", "Xiang Ji Xuan Zhi", and "Hanhua Funeral". He wants to combine classroom teaching with extracurricular reading. In class, he talked about "Charcoal Seller" and "Xinfeng Broken Arm Weng", and at the same time printed and distributed all of Bai Juyi's new Yuefu to students. He gave a lecture on "Weixian Office Sending Brother Ink", and printed and distributed several major family letters, Taoist feelings and some inscribed poems by Zheng Banqiao. The students read it and were very interested. This practice was extremely rare among the early Chinese teachers at that time. The articles he chose seemed to have a criterion: emotional, temperamental, plain and natural. These articles have a coherent ideological tendency, which can be roughly attributed to: humanitarianism.他非常重视作文。他说学国文的最终的目的，是把文章写通。学生作文他先眉批一道，指出好处和不好处，发下去由学生自己改一遍，或同学间互相改；交上来，他再改一遍，加点批，再发给学生，让学生自己誊一遍，留起来；要学生随时回过头来看看自己的文章。他说，作文要如使船，撑一篙是一篙，作一篇是一篇。不能像驴转磨，走了三年，只在磨道里转。
He attaches great importance to composition. He said that the ultimate goal of learning Chinese is to write the article through. He first commented on the student's composition, pointing out the advantages and disadvantages, and then sent it to the students themselves to correct it, or the classmates changed it to each other; when it was handed over, he changed it again, added some comments, and then sent it to the students, so that the students could transcribe it themselves and keep it; students were asked to look back at their articles at any time. He said that composition should be like a boat, one pole is a pole, and one pole is one article. You can't be like a donkey, walking for three years, only turning in the grinding road.为了帮助学生将来升学，他还自编了三种辅助教材。一年级是《字形音义辨》，二年级是《成语运用》，三年级是《国学常识》。
In order to help students go on to higher education in the future, he also compiled three auxiliary textbooks. The first grade is "Glyph Sound Meaning Discrimination", the second grade is "Idiom Use", and the third grade is "Common Sense of Chinese Studies".在县立初中读了三年的学生，大部分文字清通，知识丰富，他们在考高中，甚至日后在考大学时，国文分数都比较高，是高先生给他们打下的底子。更重要的是他们学会了欣赏文学——高先生讲过的文章的若干片段，许多学生过了三十年还背得；他们接受了高先生通过那些选文所传播的思想——人道主义，影响到他们一生的立身为人。呜呼，先生之泽远矣！
Most of the students who have studied in the county junior high school for three years are clear and knowledgeable, and their Chinese scores are relatively high when they take the high school entrance examination and even the university entrance examination in the future, which is the foundation laid for them by Mr. Gao. More importantly, they have learned to appreciate literature - several fragments of Mr. Gao's articles, and many students can still memorize them after thirty years; they accepted the ideas spread by Mr. Gao through those selected essays, humanism, which influenced their lifelong standing. Alas, Mr. Gao's grace is far away!（玻璃一样脆亮的童声高唱着。瓦片和树叶都在唱。）
(A child's voice as crisp as glass sings.) The tiles and leaves are singing. ）高先生的家也搬了。搬到老屋对面的一条巷子里。高先生用历年的积蓄，买了一所小小的四合院。房屋虽也旧了，但间架砖木都还结实。天井里花木扶疏，苔痕上阶，草色入帘，很是幽静。
Mr. Gao's house also moved. Moved to an alley opposite the old house. Mr. Gao used his savings over the years to buy a small courtyard house. Although the house is old, the bricks and wood are still strong. The flowers and trees in the courtyard are sparse, the moss traces go up the steps, and the grass is colorful, which is very quiet.高先生这几年心境很好，人也变随和了一些。他和沈石君以及一般同事相处甚得。沈石君每年暑假要请一次客，对校中同仁表示慰劳，席间也谈谈校务。高先生是不须催请，早早就到的。他还备了几样便菜，约几个志同道合的教员，在家里赏荷小聚。（五小的那位师爷式的教员听到此事，编了一条歇后语：“高北溟请客——破天荒”。）这几年，很少看到高先生气得脑袋不停的剧烈地摇动。
Mr. Gao has been in a good mood in recent years, and he has become a little more easy-going. He gets along well with Shen Shijun and ordinary colleagues. Shen Shijun invites guests once a year during the summer vacation to express his condolences to his colleagues in the school, and also talks about school affairs during the banquet. Mr. Gao arrived early without urging. He also prepared a few side dishes and invited a few like-minded teachers to enjoy the lotus at home. (The master-like teacher of the fifth primary school heard about this and made up a postscript: "Gao Beiming treats - unprecedented".) In recent years, it has been rare to see Mr. Gao shaking his head violently with anger.高先生有两件心事。
一件是想把谈老师的诗文刻印出来。
Mr. Gao has two things on his mind. One is to engrave Teacher Tan's poems.谈老先生死后，后人很没出息，游手好闲，坐吃山空，几年工夫，把谈先生挣下的家业败得精光，最后竟至靠拆卖房屋的破瓦维持生活。谈老先生的宅第几乎变成一片瓦砾，旧池乔木，荡然无存。门楼倒还在，也破落不堪了。供轿夫休息的长凳早没有了，剩了一个空空的架子。里面有一算卦的摆了一个卦摊。条桌上放着签筒。桌前系着桌帷，白色的圆“光”里写了四个字：“文王神课”。算卦的伏在桌上打盹。这地方还叫做“谈家门楼”。过路人走过，都有不胜今昔之感，觉得沧海桑田，人生如梦。
After Mr. Tan's death, the descendants were very unpromising, idle, sitting and eating, and after a few years of work, Mr. Tan's family business was completely ruined, and finally he relied on the broken tiles of the house to make a living. Mr. Tan's mansion was almost in rubble, and the old pond trees were gone. The gatehouse is still there, and it is also dilapidated. The bench for the palanquin driver to rest is long gone, leaving an empty shelf. There is a fortune teller set up a hexagram stall inside. There is a sign tube on the table. There is a table curtain tied in front of the table, and four words are written in the white circle "light": "King Wen's Divine Class". The fortune teller lay on the table and took a nap. This place is also called "Tan Jia Gate Tower". Passers-by have a sense of the past and the present, and feel that life is like a dream.谈老先生的哲嗣名叫幼渔。到无米下锅时，就到谈先生的学生家去打秋风。到了高北溟家，高先生总要周济他一块、两块、三块、五块。总不让他空着手回去。每年腊月，还得为他准备几斗米，一方腌肉，两条风鱼，否则这个年幼渔师弟过不去。
Mr. Tan's heir is named Youyu. When there is no rice to be cooked, he goes to Mr. Tan's student's house to fight the autumn breeze. When he arrived at Gao Beiming's house, Mr. Gao always had to help him with one, two, three, or five pieces. Don't let him go back empty-handed. Every year, in the twelfth lunar month, he has to prepare a few buckets of rice, one side of cured meat, and two wind fish, otherwise this young fisherman brother will not be able to get by.高北溟和谈先生的学生周济谈幼渔，是为了不忘师恩，是怕他把谈先生的文稿卖了。他已经几次要卖这部文稿。买主是有的，就是李三麻子（此人老而不死）。高先生知道，李三麻子买到文稿，改头换面，就成了他的著作。李三麻子惯于欺世盗名，这种事干得出。李三麻子出价一百，告诉幼渔，稿到即付。
Gao Beiming and Mr. Tan's student Zhou Jitan Youyu were afraid that he would sell Mr. Tan's manuscript in order not to forget his teacher's kindness. He has sold this manuscript several times. There is a buyer, that is, Li Sanmazi (this person is old but not dead). Mr. Gao knew that Li Sanmazi bought the manuscript and changed it, and it became his book. Li Sanmazi is used to deceiving the world and stealing his name, and this kind of thing can be done. Li Sanmazi bid 100 and told Youyu that the manuscript would be paid as soon as it arrived.高先生狠了狠心，拿出一百块钱，跟谈幼渔把稿子买了。
Mr. Gao was ruthless, took out a hundred yuan, and bought the manuscript with Tan Youyu.想刻印，却很难。松华斋可以铅印，尚古房可以雕板。问了问价钱，都贵得吓人，为高北溟力所不及。稿子放在架上，逐年摊晒。高先生觉得对不起老师，心里很不安。
另一件心事是女儿高雪的前途和婚事。
I want to engrave it, but it's difficult. Songhuazhai can be printed with lead, and Shanggufang can be carved with boards. When I asked about the price, it was terribly expensive, and Gao Beiming couldn't afford it. The manuscript is placed on the shelf and spread out year by year. Mr. Gao felt sorry for the teacher and felt very uneasy. Another thing on my mind is the future and marriage of my daughter Gao Xue.高先生的两个女儿，长名高水，次名高雪。
Mr. Gao's two daughters, the eldest named Gao Shui and the second named Gao Xue.高雪从小很受宠，一家子都惯她，很娇。她用的东西都和姐姐不一样。姐姐夏天穿的衣是府绸的，她穿的是湖纺。姐姐穿白麻纱袜，她却有两条长筒丝袜。姐姐穿自己做的布鞋，她却一会是“千底一带”，一会是白网球鞋，并且在初中二年级就穿了从上海买回来的皮鞋。姐姐不嫉妒，倒说：“你的脚好看，应该穿好鞋。”姐姐冬天烘黄铜的手炉，她的手炉是白铜的。姐姐扇细芭蕉扇，她扇檀香扇。东西也一样。吃鱼，脊梁、肚皮是她的（姐姐吃鱼头、鱼尾，且说她爱吃），吃鸡，一只鸡腿归她（另一只是高先生的）。她还爱吃陈皮梅、嘉应子、橄榄。她一个人吃。家务事也不管。扫地、抹桌、买菜、煮饭，都是姐姐。高起兴来，打了井水，把家里什么都洗一遍，砖地也洗一遍，大门也洗一遍，弄得家里水漫金山，人人只好缩着脚坐在凳子上。除了自己的衣服，她不洗别人的。被褥帐子，都是姐姐洗。姐姐在天井里一大盆一大盆，洗得汗马淋漓，她却躺在高先生的藤椅上看《茵梦湖》。高先生的藤椅，除了她，谁也不坐，这是一家之主的象征。只有一件事，她乐意做：浇花。这是她的特权，别人不许浇。
Gao Xue has been favored since she was a child, and the family is used to her and is very delicate. The things she uses are different from her sister's. My sister wears poplin clothes in summer, and she wears lake spinning. My sister wears white linen gauze socks, but she has two stockings. My sister wears her own cloth shoes, but she will wear white tennis shoes for a while, and she will wear leather shoes bought from Shanghai in the second grade of junior high school. My sister was not jealous, but said: "Your feet look good, you should wear good shoes." My sister bakes brass stoves in winter, and her hand stoves are made of cupronickel. My sister fanned a fine banana fan, and she fan a sandalwood fan. The same goes for things. Eating fish, the backbone and belly are hers (my sister eats fish heads and tails, and says she loves to eat), eat chicken, and one chicken leg belongs to her (the other is Mr. Gao's). She also loves to eat tangerine peel, Jiayingzi, and olives. She eats alone. I don't care about housework. Sweeping the floor, wiping the table, buying vegetables, and cooking are all sisters. Excitedly, he dug well water, washed everything in the house, washed the brick floor, and washed the door. She doesn't wash other people's clothes except for her own clothes. The bedding and tents are all washed by my sister. My sister was washing a large basin in the patio, but she was lying on Mr. Gao's rattan chair watching "Yinmeng Lake". Mr. Gao's rattan chair, no one sits on it except her, which is a symbol of the head of the family. There is only one thing she is willing to do: water the flowers. This is her privilege, and others are not allowed to water it.高先生治家很严，高师母、高水都怕他。只有对高雪，从未碰过一指头。在外面生了一点气，回来看看这个“欢喜团”，气也就消了。她要什么，高先生都依她。只有一次例外。
Mr. Gao is very strict in managing the house, and Mrs. Gao and Gao Shui are afraid of him. Only to Gao Xue, he has never touched a finger. I was a little angry outside, and when I came back to see this "happy group", the anger disappeared. Whatever she wants, Mr. Gao depends on her. There is only one exception.高雪初三毕业，要升学（高水没有读中学，小学毕业，就在本城读了女师，已经在教书）。她要考高中，将来到北平上大学。高先生不同意，只许她报师范。高雪哭，不吃饭。妈妈和姐姐坐在床前轮流劝她。
Gao Xue graduated from junior high school and wanted to go on to higher education (Gao Shui did not go to middle school, graduated from elementary school, and studied as a female teacher in the city and was already teaching). She wants to take the high school entrance examination and will go to college in Peking. Mr. Gao disagreed and only allowed her to apply for normal school. Gao Xue cried and did not eat. Her mother and sister sat in front of the bed and took turns persuading her.“不要这样。多不好。爸爸不是不想让你向高处飞，爸爸没有钱。三年高中，四年大学，路费、学费、膳费、宿费，得好一笔钱。”
“他有钱！”
“他哪有钱呀！”
“在柜子里锁着！”

There are gradually some rumors in the city. There are many people who are light-tongued and thin-tongued. For a beautiful girl, some people especially love to use their dirty tongues to ruin her, and the words are very ugly, saying that there are people outside her, and saying ...... Alas, don't mention this.高雪在学校是经常收到情书。有的摘录了李后主、秦少游的词，满纸伤感惆怅。有的抄了一些外国诗。有一位抄了一大段拜伦的情诗的原文，害得她还得查字典。这些信大都也有一点感情，但又都不像很认真。高雪有时也回信，写的也是一些虚无缥缈的话。她并没有一个真正的情人。
Gao Xue often received love letters at school. Some excerpted the words of Li Houzhu and Qin Shaoyou, and the paper was full of sadness and melancholy. Some copied some foreign poems. There was a person who copied a large number of original texts of Byron's love poems, which caused her to have to look up the dictionary. Most of these letters also have a little emotion, but they don't seem to be very serious. Gao Xue sometimes replied, writing some ethereal words. She doesn't have a real lover.本县的小学里不断有人向她献殷勤，她一个也看不上，觉得他们讨厌。
汪厚基又托媒人来说了几次媒， 都被用不同的委婉言词拒绝了。——每次家里问高雪，她都是摇摇头。
There are constantly people in the primary schools in this county who are courteous to her, but she doesn't like any of them and thinks they hate them. Wang Houji asked the matchmaker to talk to the matchmaker several times, but was rejected with different euphemistic words. ——Every time the family asked Gao Xue, she shook her head.一次又一次，高家全家的心都活了，连高水也改变了态度。她和高雪谈了半夜。
Again and again, the hearts of the Gao family were alive, and even Gao Shui changed his attitude. She talked with Gao Xue in the middle of the night.“行了吧。汪厚基对你是真心。他说他非你不娶，是实话。他脾气好，一定会对你很体贴。人也不俗。你们不是也还谈得来么？你还挑什么呢？你想要一个什么人？你想要的，这个县城里没有！妹妹，你不小了。听姐姐话，再拖下去，你真要留在家里当老姑娘？这是命，你心高命薄。退一步看，想宽一点。花开堪折直须折，莫待无花空折枝呀……”
"Okay. Wang Houji is sincere to you. He said he would not marry you, which was the truth. He has a good temper and will definitely be considerate to you. People are not bad either. Aren't you still able to talk? What else do you choose? Who do you want? What do you want, there is no one in this county! Sister, you are not young anymore. Listen to your sister, and if you drag it on, do you really want to stay at home as an old girl? This is fate, you have a high heart. Take a step back and want to be wider. Flowers can be broken, don't wait for flowers to break branches......高雪一直没有说话。
Gao Xue never spoke.高雪同意和汪厚基结婚了。婚后的生活是平静的。汪厚基待高雪，真是含在口里怕她化了，体贴到不能再体贴。每天下床，都是厚基给她穿袜子，穿鞋。她梳头，厚基在后面捧着镜子。天凉了，天热了，厚基早给她把该换的衣服找出来放着。嫂子们常常偷偷在窗外看这小两口的无穷无尽的蜜月新婚，抿着嘴笑。
Gao Xue agreed to marry Wang Houji. Life after marriage is peaceful. Wang Houji treated Gao Xue in his mouth, really afraid that she would melt, and he was so considerate that he could no longer be considerate. Every day when he got out of bed, Houji put socks and shoes on her. She combed her hair, and Houji held the mirror in the back. It was cold and hot, and Houji had already found out the clothes she needed to change and put them away. The sisters-in-law often secretly watched the endless honeymoon newlyweds of the young couple outside the window, pursing their lips and laughing.然而高雪并不快乐，她的笑总有点凄凉。半年之后，她病了。
However, Gao Xue was not happy, and her smile was always a little desolate. Half a year later, she fell ill.汪厚基自己给她看病，亲自到药店去抓药，亲自煎药，还亲自尝一尝。他把全部学识都拿了出来了。然而高雪的病没有起色。他把全城同行名医，包括几个西医，都请来给高雪看病。可是大家都说不出一个所以然，连一个准病名都说不出，一人一个说法。一个西医说了一个很长的拉丁病名，汪厚基请教是什么意思，这位西医说：“忧郁症”。
Wang Houji saw her himself, went to the pharmacy to grab the medicine, decocted the medicine himself, and tasted it himself. He took out all his knowledge. However, Gao Xue's illness did not improve. He invited famous doctors from all over the city, including several Western doctors, to see Gao Xue. But no one could say a reason, not even a quasi-disease name, one for each person. A Western doctor said a long Latin disease name, Wang Houji asked what it meant, and the Western doctor said: "Depression".病了半年，百药罔效，高雪瘦得剩了一把骨头。厚基抱她起来，轻得像一个孩子。高雪觉得自己不行了，叫厚基给她穿衣裳。衣裳穿好了，袜子也穿好了，高雪微微皱了皱眉，说左边的袜跟没有拉平。厚基给她把袜跟拉平了，她用非常温柔的眼光看着厚基，说：“厚基，你真好！”随即闭了眼睛。
After being sick for half a year, all medicines were ineffective, and Gao Xue was so thin that only a handful of bones remained. Houji hugged her up, as light as a child. Gao Xue felt that she couldn't do it anymore, so she asked Houji to dress her. The clothes were put on, and the socks were also put on, Gao Xue frowned slightly, saying that the heel of the sock on the left was not flattened. Houji flattened the heel of the sock for her, and she looked at Houji with very gentle eyes and said, "Houji, you are so good!" Then he closed his eyes.汪厚基到高先生家去报信。他详详细细叙说了高雪临死的情形，说她到最后还很清醒，“我给她穿袜子，她还说左边的袜跟没有拉平。”高师母忍不住，到房里坐在床上痛哭。高水的眼泪不断流出来，喊了一声：“妹妹，你想飞，你没有飞出去呀！”高先生捶着书桌说：“怪我！怪我！怪我！”他的脑袋不停地摇动起来。——高先生近年不只在生气的时候，只要感情一激动，就摇脑袋。
Wang Houji went to Mr. Gao's house to report the news. He described Gao Xue's dying situation in detail, saying that she was still very sober in the end, "I put socks on her, and she also said that the heel of the left sock was not leveled." Mrs. Gao couldn't help but go to the room and sit on the bed and cry bitterly. Gao Shui's tears kept flowing out, and he shouted: "Sister, you want to fly, you didn't fly out!" Mr. Gao pounded on the desk and said, "Blame me! Blame me! Blame me!" His head kept shaking. ——In recent years, Mr. Gao has not only shaken his head when he is angry, but as long as he is emotionally excited, he will shake his head.汪厚基把牌子摘了下来，他不再行医了。“我连高雪的病都看不好，我还给别人看什么？”这位医生对医药彻底发生怀疑：“医道，没有用！——骗人！”他变得有点傻了，遇见熟人就说：“她到最后还很清醒，我给她穿袜子，她还说左边袜跟没有拉平……”他不知道，他已经跟这人说过几次了。他的眼光呆滞，反应也很迟钝了。他的那点聪明灵气已经全部消失。他整天无所事事，一起来就到处乱走。家里人等他吃饭，每回看不见他，一找，他都在高雪的坟旁坐着。
Wang Houji took off the sign, and he stopped practicing medicine. "I can't even see Gao Xue's illness well, what else can I show others?" The doctor was completely suspicious of medicine: "Medicine is useless! ——Liar!" He became a little stupid, and when he met an acquaintance, he said: "She was still awake in the end, I put socks on her, and she also said that the left sock heel was not leveled......" He didn't know, he had told this person several times. His eyes were dull and his reaction was slow. His little bit of intelligence and aura have all disappeared. He had nothing to do all day, and he wandered around when he came together. The family waited for him to eat, and every time they couldn't see him, they found him, and when they looked for him, he was sitting next to Gao Xue's grave.高先生已经死了几年了。
五小的学生还在唱：
西挹神山爽气，
东来邻寺疏钟……
墓草萋萋，落照昏黄，歌声犹在，斯人邈矣。
Mr. Gao has been dead for several years. The students of the fifth primary school are still singing: The refreshing air of the Xiyi Sacred Mountain, A sparse bell from the neighboring temple came from the east...... The grave is overgrown with grass, the setting sun is dim, and the singing is still there.高先生在东街住过的老屋倒塌了，临街的墙壁和白木板门倒还没有倒。板门上高先生写的春联也还在。大红朱笺被风雨漂得几乎是白色的了，墨写的字迹却还很浓，很黑。
辛夸高岭桂
未徙北溟鹏
The old house where Mr. Gao lived on East Street has collapsed, and the walls and white wooden doors facing the street have not yet collapsed. The Spring Festival couplets written by Mr. Gao on the board door are still there. The big red red paper has been blown almost white by the wind and rain, but the handwriting in ink is still very thick and black. 故乡人[1]

女人很少打鱼。

If the invited person writes the word "accompany the last seat" or a "know" under his name, it means that he will be on time; if he writes the word "thank you", it means that he cannot do it. Hometown people{{id_0000}} Fishing Women rarely fish.打鱼的有几种。
There are several types of fishing.一种用两只三桅大船，乘着大西北风，张了满帆，在大湖的激浪中并排前进，船行如飞，两船之间挂了极大的拖网，一网上来，能打上千斤鱼。而且都是大鱼。一条大铜头鱼（这种鱼头部尖锐，颜色如新擦的黄铜，肉细味美，有的地方叫做黄段），一条大青鱼，往往长达七八尺。较小的，也都在五斤以上。起网的时候，如果觉得分量太沉，会把鱼放掉一些，否则有把船拽翻了的危险。这种豪迈壮观的打鱼，只能在严寒的冬天进行，一年只能打几次。鱼船的船主都是个小财主，虽然他们也随船下湖，驾船拉网，勇敢麻利处不比雇来的水性极好的伙计差到哪里去。
One uses two three-masted boats, riding the strong northwest wind, with full sails, and moving side by side in the waves of the great lake, the boat travels like flying, and there is a huge trawl between the two boats, and a net can catch a thousand pounds of fish. And they are all big fish. A large copperhead (this fish has a sharp head, the color is like freshly polished brass, the meat is fine and delicious, and in some places it is called the yellow section), a large herring, often seven or eight feet long. The smaller ones are also more than five pounds. When raising the net, if you feel that the weight is too heavy, you will release some fish, otherwise there is a risk of dragging the boat over. This kind of heroic and spectacular fishing can only be carried out in the harsh winter, only a few times a year. The owners of the fishing boats were all small rich men, although they also went down to the lake with the boat, pulled the net, and were no worse than the hired men with excellent water quality.一种是放鱼鹰的。鱼鹰分清水、浑水两种。浑水鹰比清水鹰值钱得多。浑水鹰能在浑水里睁眼，清水鹰不能。湍急的浑水里才有大鱼，名贵的鱼。清水里只有普通的鱼，不肥大，味道也差。站在高高的运河堤上，看人放鹰捉鱼，真是一件快事。一般是两个人，一个撑船，一个管鹰。一船鱼鹰，多的可到二十只。这些鱼鹰歇在木架上，一个一个都好像很兴奋，不停地鼓膆子，扇翅膀，有点迫不及待的样子。管鹰的把篙子一摆，二十只鱼鹰扑通扑通一齐钻进水里，不大一会，接二连三的上来了。嘴里都叼着一条一尺多长的鳜鱼，鱼尾不停地搏动。没有一只落空。有时两只鱼鹰合抬着一条大鱼。喝！这条大鳜鱼！烧出来以后，哪里去找这样大的鱼盘来盛它呢？
One is to release ospreys. Ospreys are divided into two types: clear water and muddy water. Muddy water eagles are much more valuable than clear water eagles. Muddy water eagles can open their eyes in muddy water, but clear water eagles cannot. Only in turbulent muddy water can there be big fish, precious fish. There are only ordinary fish in clear water, not fat, and the taste is poor. Standing on the high canal embankment and watching people release eagles to catch fish, it's really a pleasure. Usually two people, one holding the boat and the other managing the eagle. A boat of ospreys can be as many as twenty. These ospreys rested on wooden frames, and each one seemed to be very excited, constantly puffing their chests and flapping their wings, looking a little impatient. The eagle swung the pole, and the twenty ospreys fluttered into the water together, and after a while, they came up one after another. There was a mandarin fish more than a foot long in its mouth, and the tail kept beating. None of them missed. Sometimes two ospreys carry a big fish together. Drink! This big mandarin fish! After it is burned, where can I find such a big fish plate to hold it?一种是扳罾的。
一种是撒网的。……
One is the pulling net. One is to cast a net. ……还有一种打鱼的：两个人，都穿了牛皮缝制的连鞋子、裤子带上衣的罩衣，颜色白黄白黄的，站在齐腰的水里。一个张着一面八尺来宽的兜网；另一个按着一个下宽上窄的梯形的竹架，从一个距离之外，对面走来，一边一步一步地走，一边把竹架在水底一戳一戳地戳着，把鱼赶进网里。这样的打鱼的，只有在静止的浅水里，或者在虽然流动但水不深，流不急的河里，如护城河这样的地方，才能见到。这种打鱼的，每天打不了多少，而且没有很大的，很好的鱼。大都是不到半斤的鲤鱼拐子、鲫瓜子、鲶鱼。连不到二寸的“罗汉狗子”，薄得无肉的“猫杀子”，他们也都要。他们时常会打到乌龟。
There is also a kind of fishing: two people, both wearing cowhide sewn with shoes, pants and tops, white, yellow, and yellow in color, standing in waist-length water. One has a net about eight feet wide; the other presses a trapezoidal bamboo frame with a wide bottom and narrow top, walking from a distance away, on the opposite side, walking step by step, while poking the bamboo rack at the bottom of the water and poking it one by one, driving the fish into the net. Such fishermen can only be seen in still shallow water, or in rivers that are flowing but not deep and not rushed, such as moats. This kind of fisherman can't catch much every day, and there are no big, very good fish. Most of them are carp abductors, crucian melon seeds, and catfish less than half a catty. They also want to have a "Luohan dog" that is less than two inches long and a "cat killing children" that is so thin that it has no meat. They often hit turtles.在小学校后面的苇塘里，臭水河，常常可以看到两个这样的打鱼的。一男一女。他们是两口子。男的张网，女的赶鱼。奇怪的是，他们打了一天的鱼，却听不到他们说一句话。他们的脸上既看不出高兴，也看不出失望、忧愁，总是那样平平淡淡的，平淡得近于木然。除了举网时听到歘的一声，和梯形的竹架间或搅动出一点水声，听不到一点声音。就是举网和搅水的声音，也很轻。
In the reed pond behind the primary school, in the stinky river, you can often see two such fishermen. A man and a woman. They are a couple. The man sets the net, and the woman catches the fish. Strangely, they have been fishing for a day, but they can't hear them say a word. Their faces showed neither happiness, nor disappointment or sorrow, and they were always so plain, almost dull. Except for the sound of a crackle when lifting the net, and the sound of water stirring between the trapezoidal bamboo frames, there is no sound to be heard. Even the sound of lifting the net and stirring the water is also very light.有几天不看见这两个穿着黄白黄白的牛皮罩衣的打鱼的了。又过了几天，他们又来了。按着梯形竹架赶鱼的换了一个人，一个十五六岁的小姑娘。辫根缠了白头绳。一看就知道，是打鱼人的女儿。她妈死了，得的是伤寒。她来顶替妈的职务了。她穿着妈穿过的皮罩衣，太大了，腰里窝着一块，更加显得臃肿。她也像妈一样，按着梯形竹架，一戳一戳地戳着，一步一步地往前走。
For a few days, I didn't see these two fishermen wearing yellow, white, yellow and white cowhide overcoats. A few days later, they came again. The person who chased the fish according to the trapezoidal bamboo frame was replaced by another person, a fifteen or sixteen-year-old girl. The braid root was wrapped in a white rope. At a glance, you can tell that it is the daughter of a fisherman. Her mother died and got typhoid fever. She came to take over her mother's position. She was wearing the leather overcoat worn by her mother, which was too big, and she had a piece nested in her waist, making her look even more bloated. Like her mother, she pressed the trapezoidal bamboo frame, poking it one by one, and walked forward step by step.她一定觉得：这身湿了水的牛皮罩衣很重，秋天的水已经很凉，父亲的话越来越少了。
金大力
She must have felt that this wet cowhide cover was very heavy, the water was already very cold in autumn, and her father was talking less and less. Jin Dali金大力想必是有个大名的，但大家都叫他金大力，当面也这样叫。为什么叫他金大力，已经无从查考。他姓金，块头倒是很大。他家放剩饭的淘箩，年下腌制的风鱼咸肉，都挂得很高，别人够不着，他一伸手就能取下来，不用使竹竿叉棍去挑，也不用垫一张凳子。 身大力不亏。但是他是不是有很大的力气，没法证明。关于他的大力，没有什么传说的故事，他没有表演过一次，也没有人和他较量过。他这人是不会当众表演，更不会和任何人较量的。因此，大力只是想当然耳。是不是和戏里的金大力有什么关系呢？也说不定。也许有。他很老实，也没有什么本事，这一点倒和戏里的金大力有点像。戏里的金大力只是个傻大个儿，哪次打架都有他，有黄天霸就有他，但哪回他也没有打得很出色。人们在提起金大力时，并不和戏台上那个戴着红缨帽或盘着一条大辫子，拿着一根可笑的武器，——一根红漆的木棍的那个金大力的形象联系起来。这个金大力和那个金大力不大相干。这个金大力只是一个块头很大的，家里开着一爿茶水炉子，本人是个瓦匠头儿的老实人。
Jin Dali must have a big name, but everyone calls him Jin Dali, and he calls him that way in person. Why he was called Jin Dali is no longer available. His surname is Jin, and he is very big. His family's leftover basket and the marinated wind fish and salted meat are all hung very high, and others can't reach them, so he can take them off as soon as he reaches out, without using bamboo poles and forks to pick them up, and he doesn't need to put a stool on them. There is no loss of strength. But whether he has a lot of strength cannot be proven. There is no legendary story about his Dali, he has never performed once, and no one has competed with him. He will not perform in public, let alone compete with anyone. Therefore, Dali just takes it for granted. Does it have anything to do with Jin Dali in the play? Maybe. Maybe. He is very honest and has no ability, which is a bit similar to Jin Dali in the play. Jin Dali in the play is just a stupid big man, he has him in every fight, and there is Huang Tianba, but he has not fought very well every time. When people mention Jin Dali, they do not associate it with the image of Jin Dali on the stage wearing a red tassel hat or a big braid, holding a ridiculous weapon ,—— a red lacquered wooden stick. This Jin Dali has nothing to do with that Jin Dali. This Jin Dali is just a big man, with a tea stove at home, and he is an honest man who is a bricklayer.他怎么会当了瓦匠头儿呢？
How did he become the head bricklayer?按说，瓦匠里当头儿的，得要年高望重，手艺好，有两手绝活，能压众，有口才，会讲话，能应付场面，还得有个好人缘儿。前面几条，金大力都不沾。金大力是个很不够格的瓦匠，他的手艺比一个刚刚学徒的小工强不了多少，什么活也拿不起来。一般老师傅会做的活，不用说相地定基，估工算料，砌墙时挂线，布瓦时堆瓦脊两边翘起的山尖，用一把瓦刀舀起半桶青灰在瓦脊正中塑出花开四面的浮雕……这些他统统不会，他连砌墙都砌不直！当了一辈子瓦匠，砌墙会砌出一个鼓肚子，真也是少有。他是一个瓦匠头，只能干一些小工活，和灰送料，传砖递瓦。这人很拙于言词，一天说不了几句话，老是闷声不响，他不会说几句恭喜发财，大吉大利的应酬门面话讨主人家喜欢；也不会说几句夸赞奉承，道劳致谢的漂亮话叫同行高兴；更不会长篇大套地训教小工以显示一个头儿的身份。他说的只是几句实实在在的大实话。说话很慢，声音很低，跟他那副大骨架很不相符。只有一条，他倒是具备的：他有一个好人缘儿。不知道为什么，他的人缘儿会那么好。
It is said that the head of the bricklayer must be old, respected, good in craftsmanship, have two unique skills, be able to overwhelm the crowd, be eloquent, be able to speak, be able to cope with the scene, and have a good popularity. The first few ones, Jin Dali is not touched. Jin Dali is a very unqualified bricklayer, his craftsmanship is not much better than that of a small worker who has just apprenticed, and he can't pick up any work. The work that ordinary masters will do, not to mention the determination of the foundation, estimation of the work, hanging lines when building walls, piling up the raised mountain peaks on both sides of the tile ridge when closing, and using a brick knife to scoop up half a bucket of green ash to create reliefs on all sides of the tile ridge...... He can't do any of this, he can't even build a wall straight! Being a bricklayer all his life, it is really rare to build a bulge belly when building a wall. He is a bricklayer, and he can only do some small work, feed ash, and pass bricks and tiles. This person is very clumsy in words, he can't say a few words a day, he is always muffled, he can't say a few words Wishing you prosperity, and he can't say a few words to please the owner; he won't say a few words of praise and flattery, and beautiful words of gratitude to make his peers happy; he will not train small workers in a long way to show the identity of a leader. He only said a few real truths. He speaks very slowly and his voice is very low, which is very inconsistent with his big skeleton. There is only one thing, but he has it: he has a good popularity. I don't know why, his popularity is so good.这一带人家，凡有较大的泥工瓦活，都愿意找他。一般的零活，比如检个漏，修补一下被雨水冲坍的山墙，这些，直接雇两个瓦匠来就行了，不必通过金大力。若是新建房屋，或翻盖旧房，就会把金大力叫来。金大力听明白了是一个多大的工程，就告辞出来。他算不来所需工料、完工日期，就去找有经验的同行商议。第二天，带了一个木匠头儿，一个瓦匠老师傅，拿着工料单子，向主人家据实复告。主人家点了头，他就去约人、备料。到窑上订砖、订瓦，到石灰行去订石灰、麻刀、纸脚。他一辈子经手了数不清的砖瓦石灰，可是没有得过一手钱的好处。
People in this area are willing to find him for any larger masonry tile work. General odd jobs, such as checking for leaks and repairing gables washed away by rain, can be done directly by hiring two bricklayers without going through Jin Dali. If it is a new house or an old house, Jin Dali will be called. Jin Dali understood how big the project was, so he took his leave. He couldn't calculate the required materials and completion date, so he went to discuss with an experienced peer. The next day, he brought a carpenter and a bricklayer master, took the bill of materials, and replied to the owner based on the facts. The master nodded, and he went to make an appointment and prepare materials. Go to the kiln to order bricks and tiles, and go to the lime shop to order lime, sacks, and paper feet. He has handled countless bricks and tiles and lime in his life, but he has not received the benefit of a handful of money.这里兴建动工有许多风俗。先得“破土”。由金大力用铁锨挖起一小块土，铲得四方四正，用红纸包好，供在神像前面。——这一方土要到完工时才撤去。然后，主人家要请一桌酒。这桌酒有两点特别处，一是席面所用器皿都十分粗糙，红漆筷子，蓝花粗瓷大碗；二是，菜除了猪肉、豆腐外，必有一道泥鳅。这好像有一点是和泥瓦匠开玩笑，但瓦匠都不见怪，因为这是规矩。这桌酒，主人是不陪的，只是出来道一声“诸位多辛苦”，然后就委托金大力：“金师傅，你陪陪吧！”金大力就代替了主人，举起酒杯，喝下一口淡酒。这时木匠已经把房架立好，到了择定吉日的五更头，上了梁，——梁柱上贴了一副大红对子：“登柱喜逢黄道日，上梁正遇紫微星”，两边各立了一面筛子，筛子里斜贴了大红斗方，斗方的四角写着“吉星高照”，金大力点起一挂鞭，泥瓦工程就开始了。
There are many customs for construction here. First of all, you have to "break the ground". Jin Dali dug up a small piece of soil with a shovel, shoveled it squarely, wrapped it in red paper, and offered it in front of the statue. ——This square of soil will not be removed until it is completed. Then, the host wants to invite a table of wine. There are two special features about this table of wine, one is that the utensils used on the table are very rough, red lacquer chopsticks, and blue and floral porcelain bowls; second, in addition to pork and tofu, there must be a loach. This seems to be a joke with the mason, but the bricklayer is not surprised, because this is the rule. The master did not accompany this table of wine, but just came out and said, "How hard you all worked", and then entrusted Jin Dali: "Master Jin, you accompany me!" Jin Dali took the place of the master, raised his wine glass, and took a sip of light wine. At this time, the carpenter had already set up the house, and at the beginning of the fifth watch on the auspicious day, he went to the beam,—— and a pair of big red pairs were pasted on the beam pillars: "The pillar is happy to meet the zodiac day, and the beam is meeting the purple star", a sieve was set up on both sides, and a big red bucket square was diagonally pasted in the sieve, and the four corners of the bucket square were written "Jixing Gaozhao", Jin Dali lit a whip, and the brick project began.每天，金大力都是头一个来，比别人要早半小时。来了，把孩子们搬下来搭桥、搭鸡窝玩的砖头捡回砖堆上去，把碍手碍脚的棍棍棒棒归置归置，清除“脚手”板子上昨天滴下的灰泥，把“脚手”往上提一提，捆“脚手”的麻绳紧一紧，扫扫地，然后，挑了两担水来，用铁锹抓钩和青灰，——石灰里兑了锅烟；和黄泥。灰泥和好，伙计们也就来上工了。他是个瓦匠，上工时照例也在腰带里掖一把瓦刀，手里提着一个抿子。可是他的瓦刀抿子几乎随时都是干的。他一天使的家伙就是铁锹抓钩，他老是在和灰、和泥。他只能干这种小工活，也就甘心干小工活。他从来不想去露一手，去逞能卖嘴，指手画脚，到了半前晌和半后晌，伙计们照例要下来歇一会，金大力看看太阳，提起两把极大的紫砂壶就走。在壶里撮了两大把茶叶梗子，到他自己家的茶水炉上，灌了两壶水，把茶水筛在大碗里，就抬头叫嚷：“哎，下来喝茶来！”傍晚收工时，他总是最后一个走。他要各处看看，看看今天的进度、质量（他的手艺不高，这些都还是会看的），也看看有没有留下火星 （木匠熬胶要点火，瓦匠里有抽烟的）。然后，解下腰带，从头到脚，抽打一遍。走到主人家窗下，扬声告别：“明儿见啦！晚上你们照看着点！”——“好来，我们会照看。明儿见，金师傅！”
Every day, Jin Dali is the first to come, half an hour earlier than others. When he came, he moved down the bricks from the children to build bridges and build chicken coops to play with, picked up the bricks and put them on the brick pile, put the sticks and sticks in the way of his hands and feet, removed the plaster dripping yesterday on the "scaffolding" board, lifted the "scaffolding" up, tightened the hemp rope to tie the "scaffolding", swept the floor, and then, picked up two loads of water, and mixed the pot of smoke with a shovel grappling hook and green ash ,—— lime; and yellow mud. The plaster was reconciled, and the guys came to work. He was a bricklayer, and as usual, he tucked a brick knife in his belt and carried a clay in his hand. But his brick knife was dry almost all the time. His angel guy is a shovel grappling hook, and he is always mixing ash and mud. He can only do this kind of small work, and he is willing to do small work. He never wanted to show his hands, show off his words, point fingers, and when he was halfway up and half, the guys wanted to come down to rest for a while as usual, Jin Dali looked at the sun, picked up two very large purple clay pots and left. He took two large tea stems from the pot, went to his own tea stove, poured two pots of water, sifted the tea into a large bowl, and shouted, "Hey, come down and have tea!" At the end of the evening, he was always the last to go. He wants to look everywhere to see today's progress and quality (his skills are not high, but he will still look at these things), and see if there are any sparks left (carpenters need to light a fire when boiling glue, and bricklayers smoke). Then, untie the belt and beat it from head to toe. Walk to the window of the master's house and say goodbye: "See you tomorrow! You will take care of it at night!" ——"Okay, we will take care of it. See you tomorrow, Master Jin!" ”金大力是个瓦匠头儿，可是拿的工钱很低，比一个小工多不多少。同行师傅们过意不去，几次提出要给金头儿涨涨工钱。金大力说：“不。干什么活，拿什么钱。再说，我家里还开着一爿茶水炉子，我不比你们指身为业。这我就知足。”
Jin Dali is a bricklayer, but the wages he receives are very low, not much more than a small worker. The fellow masters were unhappy and proposed to increase the wages for Jin Tou'er several times. Jin Dali said: "No. What work do you do, what money do you get?" Besides, I still have a tea stove at home, and I am no more than you. I am content with this. ”金家茶炉子生意很好。一早、晌午、傍黑，来打开水的人很多，提着木子的，提着洋铁壶、暖壶、茶壶的，川流不息。这一带店铺人家一般不烧开水，要用开水，多到茶炉子上去买，这比自己家烧方便。茶水炉子，是一个砖砌的长方形的台子，四角安四个很深很大的铁罐，当中有一个火口。这玩意，有的地方叫做“老虎灶”。烧的是稻糠。稻糠着得快，火力也猛。但这东西不经烧，要不断地往里续。烧火的是金大力的老婆。这是个很结实也很利索的女人。只见她用一个小铁簸箕，一簸箕一簸箕地往火口里倒糠。火光轰轰地一阵一阵往上冒，照得她满脸通红。半箩稻糠烧完，四个铁罐里的水就哗哗地开了，她就等着人来买水，一舀子一舀子往各种容器里倒。到罐里水快见底时，再烧。一天也不见她闲着。（稻糠的灰堆在墙角，是很好的肥料，卖给乡下人垩田，一个月能卖不少钱。）
The business of the Jin family tea stove is very good. Early in the morning, at noon, and in the dark, there are many people who come to turn on the water, carrying wooden id_0000 pots, iron kettles, warm pots, and teapots, and the river flows endlessly. Shops in this area generally do not boil water, but use boiling water, and go to the tea stove to buy more, which is more convenient than burning at home. The tea stove is a brick rectangular platform with four deep and large iron cans placed in the corners, and there is a fire pit in the middle. This thing is called "tiger stove" in some places. It burns rice bran. The rice bran burns quickly and the firepower is fierce. But this thing is not burned, it has to be continued. The one who burns the fire is Jin Dali's wife. This is a very strong and neat woman. I saw her using a small iron dustpan to pour chaff into the fire with a dustpan and a dustpan. The fire rose up one after another, making her face flushed. After half a basket of rice chaff was burned, the water in the four iron cans opened with a loud noise, and she waited for someone to buy water, scooping and pouring it into various containers. When the water in the jar is about to bottom, burn it again. I didn't see her idle for a day. (The ash of rice bran is piled up in the corner, which is a good fertilizer, and it can be sold to the countrymen in the chalk fields, and it can be sold for a lot of money a month.) ）茶炉子用水很多。金家茶炉的一半地方是三口大水缸。因为缸很深，一半埋在地里。一口缸容水八担，金家一天至少要用二十四担水。这二十四担水都是金大力挑的。有活时，他早晚挑；没活时（瓦匠不能每天有活）白天挑。因为经常挑水，总要撒泼出一些，金家茶炉一边的地总是湿漉漉的，铺地的砖发深黑色（另一边的砖地是浅黑色）。你要是路过金家茶炉子，常常可以看见金大力坐在一根搭在两只水桶的扁担上休息，好像随时就会站起身来去挑一担水。
The tea stove uses a lot of water. Half of the Jin family's tea stove is three large water tanks. Because the tank is very deep, half of it is buried in the ground. A jar can hold eight loads of water, and the Jin family uses at least 24 loads of water a day. These 24 loads of water are all picked by Jin Dali. When there is work, he picks it up morning and evening; when he is not active (bricklayers cannot work every day), he picks it during the day. Because I often carry water, I always have to spill some, and the ground on one side of the Jin family tea stove is always wet, and the bricks on the floor are dark black (the brick floor on the other side is light black). If you pass by the Jin family tea stove, you can often see Jin Dali sitting on a flat pole resting on two buckets, as if he will stand up and pick up a load of water at any time.金大力不变样，多少年都是那个样子。高大结实，沉默寡言。
不，他也老了。他的头发已经有了几根白的了，虽然还不大显，墨里藏针。
钓鱼的医生
这个医生几乎每天钓鱼。
Jin Dali has not changed, and he has been like that for many years. Tall and strong, taciturn. No, he is old too. His hair already has a few white strands, although it is not very obvious, and there are needles hidden in the ink. Fishing doctor This doctor fishes almost every day.他家挨着一条河。出门走几步，就到了河边。这条河不宽。会打水撇子（有的地方叫打水飘，有的地方叫打水片）的孩子，检一片薄薄的破瓦，一扬手忒忒忒忒，打出二十多个，瓦片贴水飘过河面，还能蹦到对面的岸上。这条河下游淤塞了，水几乎是不流动的。河里没有船。也很少有孩子到这里来游水，因为河里淹死过人，都说有水鬼。这条河没有什么用处。因为水不流，也没有人挑来吃。只有南岸的种菜园的每天挑了浇菜。再就是有人家把鸭子赶到河里来放。河南岸都是大柳树。有的欹侧着，柳叶都拖到了水里。河里鱼不少，是个钓鱼的好地方。
His house is next to a river. A few steps out of the house, you will reach the river. The river is not wide. Children who can play water skimming (in some places it is called water floating, in some places it is called water padding), check a thin broken tile, raise their hand, and hit more than 20 tiles. The lower reaches of this river are silted up, and the water is almost immobile. There are no boats in the river. There are few children who come here to swim, because people have drowned in the river, and they say there are water ghosts. This river is of no use. Because the water does not flow, no one picks it to eat. Only the vegetable garden on the south bank picks and waters every day. Then some people drive ducks into the river to release them. The south bank of the river is full of big willow trees. Some were tilted, and the willow leaves were dragged into the water. There are a lot of fish in the river, and it is a good place for fishing.你大概没有见过这样的钓鱼的。
You probably haven't seen fishing like this.他搬了一把小竹椅，坐着。随身带着一个白泥小炭炉子，一口小锅，提盒里葱姜作料俱全，还有一瓶酒。他钓鱼很有经验。钓竿很短，鱼线也不长，而且不用漂子，就这样把钓线甩在水里，看到线头动了，提起来就是一条。都是三四寸长的鲫鱼。——这条河里的鱼以白条子和鲫鱼为多。白条子他是不钓的，他这种钓法，是钓鲫鱼的。钓上来一条，刮刮鳞洗净了，就手就放到锅里。不大一会，鱼就熟了。他就一边吃鱼，一边喝酒，一边甩钩再钓。这种出水就烹制的鱼味美无比，叫做“起水鲜”。到听见女儿在门口喊：“爸——！”知道是有人来看病了，就把火盖上，把鱼竿插在岸边湿泥里，起身往家里走。不一会，就有一只钢蓝色的蜻蜓落在他的鱼竿上了。
He moved a small bamboo chair and sat down. He carried a small charcoal stove with white mud, a small pot, a box with green onions and ginger, and a bottle of wine. He is very experienced in fishing. The fishing rod is very short, the line is not long, and there is no drifter, so I threw the fishing line into the water, and when I saw the line moving, I lifted it and it was one. They are all crucian carp three or four inches long. ——The fish in this river are mostly white strips and crucian carp. He doesn't fish for white strips, his fishing method is for crucian carp. Catch one, scrape the scales and wash it, and put it in the pot. After a while, the fish was cooked. He ate fish, drank alcohol, and fished again with a hook. This kind of fish cooked out of the water is extremely delicious, called "fresh water". Until I heard my daughter shouting at the door: "Dad——! Knowing that someone was coming to see a doctor, he covered the fire, inserted the fishing rod into the wet mud on the shore, got up and walked home. After a while, a steel-blue dragonfly landed on his fishing rod.这位老兄姓王，字淡人。中国以淡人为字的好像特别多，而且多半姓王。他们大都是阴历九月生的，大名里一定还带一个菊字。古人的一句“人淡如菊”的诗，造就了多少人的名字。
This old man's surname is Wang, and the word is Danren. There seem to be a lot of people in China who use Danren as the word, and most of them have the surname Wang. Most of them were born in the ninth month of the lunar calendar, and there must be a chrysanthemum in their names. A poem by the ancients that "people are as light as chrysanthemums" has created many people's names.王淡人的家很好认。门口倒没有特别的标志。大门总是开着的，望里一看，就看到通道里挂了好几块大匾。匾上写的是“功同良相”、“济世救人”、“仁心仁术”、“术绍岐黄”、“杏林春暖”、“橘井流芳”、“妙手回春”、“起我沉疴”……医生家的匾都是这一套。这是亲友或病家送给王淡人的祖父和父亲的。匾都有年头了，匾上的金字都已经发暗。到王淡人的时候，就不大兴送匾了。送给王淡人的只有一块，匾很新，漆地乌亮，匾字发光，是去年才送的。这块匾与医术无关，或关系不大，匾上写的是“急公好义”，字是颜体。
Wang Danren's home is easy to recognize. There is no special sign at the door. The gate is always open, and when you look inside, you can see several large plaques hanging in the passage. The plaques are written as "Meritorious Goodness", "Saving the World", "Benevolence and Benevolence", "Shu Shao Qihuang", "Xinglin Spring Warmth", "Tachibana Well Liufang", "Wonderful Hands Rejuvenation", "Rising My Illness"...... The doctor's plaque is all like this. This is a gift from relatives, friends or patients to Wang Danren's grandfather and father. The plaques are all old, and the gold letters on the plaques have darkened. When Wang Danren arrived, he was not very interested in giving away plaques. There is only one piece given to Wang Danren, the plaque is very new, the lacquer is shiny, and the plaque is shiny, which was only given last year. This plaque has nothing to do with medical skills, or has little to do with it, and the plaque reads "Urgent Public and Good Righteousness", and the words are Yan Ti.进了过道，是一个小院子。院里种着鸡冠、秋葵、凤仙一类既不花钱，又不费事的草花。有一架扁豆。还有一畦瓢菜。这地方不吃瓢菜，也没有人种。这一畦瓢菜是王淡人从外地找了种子，特为种来和扁豆配对的。王淡人的医室里挂着一副郑板桥写的（木板刻印的）对子：“一庭春雨瓢儿菜，满架秋风扁豆花。”他很喜欢这副对子。这点淡泊的风雅，和一个不求闻达的寒士是非常配称的。其实呢？何必一定是瓢儿菜，种什么别的菜也不是一样吗？王淡人花费心思去找了瓢菜的菜种来种，也可看出其天真处。自从他种了瓢菜，他的一些穷朋友在来喝酒的时候，除了吃王淡人自己钓的鱼，就还能尝到这种清苦清苦的菜蔬了。
Entering the aisle, it is a small yard. The courtyard is planted with chicken combs, okra, impatiens and other flowers that cost neither money nor trouble. There is a lentil. There is also a field of gourd. There is no gourd in this place, and no one grows it. This field of gourd was found by Wang Danren from other places and specially planted to pair with lentils. In Wang Danren's doctor's office, there is a pair written by Zheng Banqiao (carved on a wooden board): "A courtyard of spring rain ladle vegetables, full of autumn wind lentil flowers." He liked this pair very much. This indifferent elegance is very suitable for a humble scholar who does not seek fame. Actually? Why must it be a gourd dish, isn't it the same to plant other vegetables? Wang Danren spent a lot of time to find the seeds of gourd to plant, and his innocence can also be seen. Since he planted gourd vegetables, some of his poor friends can taste this kind of bitter and bitter vegetables in addition to eating the fish that Wang Danren caught himself.过了小院，是三间正房，当中是堂屋，一边是卧房，一边是他的医室。
After passing the small courtyard, there were three main rooms, one of which was the main room, one side was the bedroom, and the other was his doctor's room.他的医室和别的医生的不一样，像一个小药铺。架子上摆着许多青花小磁坛，坛口塞了棉纸卷紧的塞子，坛肚子上贴着浅黄蜡笺的签子，写着“九一丹”、“珍珠散”、“冰片散”……到处还有一些大大小小的乳钵，药碾子、药臼、嘴刀、剪子、镊子、钳子、钎子、往耳朵和喉咙里吹药用的铜鼓……他这个医生是“男妇内外大小方脉”，就是说内科、外科、妇科、儿科，什么病都看。王家三代都是如此。外科用的药，大都是“散”——药面子。“神仙难识丸散”，多有经验的医生和药铺的店伙也鉴定不出散的真假成色，都是一些粉红的或雪白的粉末。虽然每一家药铺都挂着一块小匾“修合存心”，但是王淡人还是不相信。外科散药里有许多贵重药：麝香、珍珠、冰片……哪家的药铺能用足？因此，他自己炮制。他的老婆、儿女，都是他的助手，经常看到他们抱着一个乳钵，握着乳锤，一圈一圈慢慢地磨研（散要研得极细，都是加了水“乳”的）。另外，找他看病的多一半是乡下来的，即使是看内科，他们也不愿上药铺去抓药，希望先生开了方子就给配一服，因此，他还得预备一些常用的内科药。
His clinic is different from other doctors, like a small pharmacy. There are many small blue and white magnetic jars on the shelves, the mouth of the jar is stuffed with a tight cotton paper stopper, and the belly of the jar is pasted with sticks of light yellow wax paper, which reads "Jiuyi Dan", "Pearl Powder", and "Ice Flake Powder"...... There are also some large and small nipples everywhere, medicine mills, mortars, mouth knives, scissors, tweezers, pliers, brazers, and copper drums for blowing medicine into the ears and throat...... His doctor is "inside and outside the man's and women's internal and external squares", that is, internal medicine, surgery, gynecology, pediatrics, all diseases. This is the case for all three generations of the Wang family. Most of the drugs used in surgery are "loose" - medicine face. "Immortals are difficult to recognize pill powder", and many experienced doctors and pharmacy shop staff cannot identify the true or false quality of the powder, all of which are pink or snow-white powders. Although every pharmacy hangs a small plaque "Repairing the Heart", Wang Danren still doesn't believe it. There are many valuable drugs in surgical powders: musk, pearls, ice flakes...... Which pharmacy can use enough? Therefore, he concocted it himself. His wife and children are all his assistants, and he is often seen holding a nipple bowl, holding a nipple hammer, and slowly grinding it round by circle (the powder must be ground very finely, all of which are added with water "milk"). In addition, more than half of the people who came to see him were from the countryside, and even if they saw internal medicine, they were reluctant to go to the pharmacy to grab medicine, hoping that the husband would prescribe a prescription and give him a dose, so he had to prepare some commonly used internal medicine medicines.城里外科医生不多，——不知道为什么，大家对外科医生都不大看得起，觉得都有点“江湖”，不如内科清高，因此，王淡人看外科的时间比较多。一年也看不了几起痈疽重症，多半是生疮长疖子，而且大都是七八岁狗都嫌的半大小子。常常看见一个大人带着生瘌痢头的瘦小子，或一个长痄腮的胖小子走进王淡人家的大门；不多一会，就又看见领着出来了。生瘌痢的涂了一头青黛，把一个秃光光的脑袋涂成了蓝的；生痄腮的腮帮上画着一个乌黑的大圆饼子，——是用掺了冰片研出的陈墨画的。
There are not many surgeons in the city,—— I don't know why, everyone doesn't think highly of surgeons, and they feel that they are a bit "rivers and lakes", not as high as internal medicine, so Wang Danren spends more time seeing surgery. I can't see a few severe carbuncles a year, most of them are sores and boils, and most of them are half-sized children that even seven or eight-year-old dogs dislike. I often see an adult with a thin boy with a leprosy head, or a fat boy with leprosy walking into the door of Wang Dan's house; after a while, I saw him led out again. The leprosy was painted with a green daisy, and a bald head was painted blue; a large black round cake was painted on the cheeks of the scabies,—— which was painted with Chen Mo mixed with ice flakes.这些生疮长疖子的小病症，是不好意思多收钱的，——那时还没有挂号收费这一说。而且本地规矩，熟人看病，很少当下交款，都得要等“三节算账”，——端午、中秋、过年。忘倒不会忘的，多少可就“各凭良心”了。有的也许为了高雅，其实为了省钱，不送现钱，却送来一些华而不实的礼物：枇杷、扇子、月饼、莲蓬、天竺果子、腊梅花。乡下来人看病，一般倒是当时付酬，但常常不是现钞，或是二十个鸡蛋、或一升芝麻、或一只鸡、或半布袋鹌鹑！遇有实在困难，什么也拿不出来的，就由病人的儿女趴下来磕一个头。王淡人看看病人身上盖着的破被，鼻子一酸，就不但诊费免收，连药钱也白送了。王淡人家吃饭不致断顿，——吃扁豆、瓢菜、小鱼、糙米——和炸鹑鹌！穿衣可就很紧了。淡人夫妇，十多年没添置过衣裳。只有儿子女儿一年一年长高，不得不给他们换换季。有人说：王淡人很傻。
These minor diseases with sores and boils are embarrassing to charge more money,—— there was no such thing as a registered fee at that time. Moreover, according to local rules, acquaintances rarely pay at the moment when they see a doctor, and they have to wait for the "three festivals" ,—— Dragon Boat Festival, Mid-Autumn Festival, and Chinese New Year. If you don't forget it, you can "rely on your conscience". Some may be for elegance, but in fact, in order to save money, they do not give cash, but send some flashy gifts: loquats, fans, mooncakes, lotus pods, Tianzhu fruits, and wax plum blossoms. People in the countryside usually pay at that time to see a doctor, but often it is not cash, or twenty eggs, or a liter of sesame seeds, or a chicken, or a half-cloth bag quail! When there is a real difficulty and nothing can be taken out, the patient's children will lie down and kowtow. Wang Danren looked at the torn quilt covered by the patient, and when his nose was sore, not only was the consultation fee waived, but even the medicine money was given away in vain. Wang Danren eats without interruption,—— eat lentils, gourd vegetables, small fish, brown rice - and fried quail! Dressing is very tight. The Danren couple has not bought clothes for more than ten years. Only the son and daughter grow taller year by year, and they have to change the seasons. Some people say: Wang Danren is stupid.王淡人是有点傻。去年、今年，就办了两件傻事。
Wang Danren is a bit stupid. Last year and this year, I did two stupid things.去年闹大水。这个县的地势，四边高，当中低，像一个水壶，别名就叫做盂城。城西的运河河底，比城里的南北大街的街面还要高。站在运河堤上，可以俯瞰城中鳞次栉比的瓦屋的屋顶；城里小孩放的风筝，在河堤游人的脚底下飘着。因此，这地方常闹水灾。水灾好像有周期，十年大闹一次。去年闹了一次大水。王淡人在河边钓鱼，傍晚听见蛤蟆爬在柳树顶上叫，叫得他心惊肉跳，他知道这是不祥之兆。蛤蟆有一种特殊的灵感，水涨多高，他就在多高处叫。十年前大水灾就是这样。果然，连天暴雨，一夜西风，运河决了口，浊黄色的洪水倒灌下来，平地水深丈二，大街上成了大河。大河里流着箱子、柜子、死牛、死人。这一年死于大水的，有上万人。大水十多天未退，有很多人困在房顶、树顶和孤岛一样的高岗子上挨饿；还有许多人生病：上吐下泻，痢疾伤寒。王淡人就用了一根结结实实的撑船用的长竹篙拄着，在齐胸的大水里来往奔波，为人治病。他会水，在水特深的地方，就横执着这根竹篙，泅水过去。他听说泰山庙北边有一个被大水围着的孤村子，一村子人都病倒了。但是泰山庙那里正是洪水的出口，水流很急，不能容舟，过不去！他和四个水性极好的专在救生船上救人的水手商量，弄了一只船，在他的腰上系了四根铁链，每一根又分在一个水手的腰里，这样，即使是船翻了，他们之中也可能有一个人把他救起来。船开了，看着的人的眼睛里都蒙了一层眼泪。眼看这只船在惊涛骇浪里颠簸出没，终于靠到了那个孤村，大家发出了雷鸣一样的欢呼。这真是玩儿命的事！
There was a big flood last year. The terrain of this county is high on all sides and low in the middle, like a kettle, and is also called Yucheng. The bottom of the canal in the west of the city is higher than the street surface of the north and south streets in the city. Standing on the canal embankment, you can overlook the roofs of the rows of tiled houses in the city; kites flown by children in the city float under the feet of tourists on the river embankment. Therefore, there are frequent floods in this place. Floods seem to have a cycle, once every ten years. There was a big flood last year. Wang Danren was fishing by the river, and in the evening he heard a toad climbing on the top of a willow tree and calling, which made him tremble, and he knew it was a bad omen. The toad has a special inspiration, no matter how high the water rises, he calls at any height. This was the case with the great flood ten years ago. Sure enough, heavy rain for days, west wind overnight, the canal burst, the turbid yellow flood poured back, the water on the flat ground was twelve feet deep, and the street became a big river. The river flowed with boxes, cabinets, dead cattle, and dead people. Tens of thousands of people died in the flood this year. The flood did not recede for more than ten days, and many people were trapped on the rooftops, treetops, and high hills like islands and starved; many people were sick: vomiting and diarrhea, dysentery and typhoid fever. Wang Danren used a strong long bamboo pole to support the boat, running back and forth in the chest-high water to treat people. He knew water, and in the deep water, he held on to this bamboo pole and swam over. He heard that there was a lonely village surrounded by floods to the north of the Taishan Temple, and the whole village fell ill. But the Taishan Temple was the outlet of the flood, and the water was so fast that it could not accommodate the boat, and it was impossible to pass! He discussed with four sailors who specialized in saving people on lifeboats with excellent water conditions, and got a boat, tied four iron chains around his waist, each of which was divided into a sailor's waist, so that even if the boat capsized, one of them might save him. The boat sailed, and the eyes of the onlookers were covered with tears. Seeing that the boat was bumping and haunting in the stormy waves, and finally approached the lonely village, everyone cheered like thunder. This is really a matter of life!水退之后，那个村里的人合送了他一块匾，就是那块“急公好义”。
拿一条命换一块匾，这是一件傻事。
另一件傻事是给汪炳治搭背，今年。
After the water receded, the people in the village gave him a plaque, which was the "urgent public and righteousness". It's a stupid thing to exchange a life for a plaque. Another stupid thing is to give Wang Bingzhi a back, this year.汪炳是和他小时候一块掏蛐蛐，放风筝的朋友。这人原先很阔。这一街的老人到现在还常常谈起他娶亲的时候，新娘子花鞋上缀的八颗珍珠，每一颗都有指头顶子那样大！这家伙，吃喝嫖赌抽大烟，把家业败得精光，连一片瓦都没有，最后只好在几家亲戚家寄食。这一家住三个月，那一家住两个月。就这样，他还抽鸦片！他给人家熬大烟，报酬是烟灰和一点膏子。他一天夜里觉得背上疼痛，浑身发烧，早上歪歪倒倒地来找王淡人。
Wang Bing was a friend of him who played crickets and flew kites when he was a child. This man was originally very wide. The old people on this street still often talk about the eight pearls embellished on the bride's flower shoes when he got married, each of which was as big as the top of his finger! This guy, eating, drinking, gambling, and smoking, ruined the family business, and didn't even have a single tile, so he had to live in a few relatives' houses. This family lived for three months, and that family lived for two months. In this way, he also smoked opium! He made a big cigarette for others, and the reward was soot and a little ointment. He felt pain in his back and fever all over his body one night, and fell to Wang Danren in the morning.王淡人一看，这是个有名有姓的外症：搭背。说：“你不用走了！”
Wang Danren saw that this was a famous external disease: backing. Said: "You don't have to go!" ”王淡人把汪炳留在家里住，管吃、管喝，还管他抽鸦片，——他把王淡人留着配药的一块云土抽去了一半。王淡人祖上传下来的麝香、冰片也为他用去了三分之一。一个多月以后，汪炳的搭背收口生肌，好了。
Wang Danren left Wang Bing at home, taking care of eating, drinking, and smoking opium,—— he took away half of the cloud soil that Wang Danren kept dispensing medicine. Wang Danren's ancestors also used one-third of the musk and ice flakes passed down for him. More than a month later, Wang Bing's back closed his mouth and became muscle, and it was okay.有人问王淡人：“你干吗为他治病？”王淡人倒对这话有点不解，说：“我不给他治，他会死的呀。”
Someone asked Wang Danren: "Why are you treating him?" Wang Danren was a little puzzled by this, and said, "If I don't treat him, he will die." ”汪炳没有一个钱。白吃，白喝，白治病。病好后，他只能写了很多鸣谢的帖子，贴在满城的街上，为王淡人传名。帖子上的言词倒真是淋漓尽致，充满感情。
Wang Bing didn't have a single money. Eat for nothing, drink for nothing, and treat for nothing. After recovering from his illness, he could only write a lot of posts of praise and post them on the streets of the city to spread his name for Wang Danren. The words on the post are really vivid and full of emotion.王淡人的老婆是很贤惠的，对王淡人所做的事没有说过一个不字。但是她忍不住要问问淡人：“你给汪炳用掉的麝香、冰片，值多少钱？”王淡人笑一笑，说：“没有多少钱。——我还有。”他老婆也只好笑一笑，摇摇头。
Wang Danren's wife is very virtuous and has never said a word about what Wang Danren did. But she couldn't help but ask Danren: "How much is the musk and ice flakes you used up for Wang Bing worth?" Wang Danren smiled and said, "Not much money. ——I still have it." His wife had no choice but to smile and shake her head.王淡人就是这样，给人看病，看“男女内外大小方脉”，做傻事，每天钓鱼。一庭春雨，满架秋风。
你好，王淡人先生！
一九八一年八月十九日
Wang Danren is like this, treating people, looking at "men and women's internal and external veins", doing stupid things, and fishing every day. A courtyard of spring rain and autumn wind. Hello, Mr. Wang Danren! August 19, 1981
