晚饭花

晚饭花[1]
[1] This article was originally published in the tenth issue of "Rain Flowers" in 1981; First Received "Dinner Flower Collection", People's Literature Publishing House, March 1985. Dinner Flowers [1]晚饭花就是野茉莉。因为是在黄昏时开花，晚饭前后开得最为闹哄，故又名晚饭花。
The dinner flower is wild jasmine. Because it blooms at dusk, it blooms the most noisily before and after dinner, so it is also called dinner flower.野茉莉，处处有之，极易繁衍。高二三尺，枝叶披纷，肥者可荫五六尺。花如茉莉而长大，其色多种易变。子如豆，深黑有细纹。中有瓤，白色，可作粉，故又名粉豆花。曝干作蔬，与马兰头相类。根大者如拳、黑硬，俚医以治吐血。
野茉莉，处处有之，极易繁衍。 高二三尺，枝叶披纷，肥者可荫五六尺。 花如茉莉而长大，其色多种易变。 子如豆，深黑有细纹。 中有瓤，白色，可作粉，故又名粉豆花。 曝干作蔬，与马兰头相类。 根大者如拳、黑硬，俚医以治吐血。——吴其濬：《植物名实图考》
珠子灯
——Wu Qijun: "Illustrated Examination of Botanical Names and Facts" Bead Lamp这里的风俗，有钱人家的小姐出嫁的第二年，娘家要送灯。送灯的用意是祈求多子。元宵节前几天，街上常常可以看到送灯的队伍。几个女用人，穿了干净的衣服，头梳得光光的，戴着双喜字大红绒花，一人手里提着一盏灯；前面有几个吹鼓手吹着细乐。远远听到送灯的箫笛，很多人家的门就开了。姑娘、媳妇走出来，倚门而看，且指指点点，悄悄评论。这也是一年的元宵节景。
The custom here is that in the second year of the marriage of a wealthy lady, her mother's family wants to send lanterns. The intention of sending lanterns is to pray for more children. A few days before the Lantern Festival, you can often see lantern queues on the streets. Several female servants wore clean clothes, their hair was combed, they wore big red velvet flowers with the word double happiness, and one person was holding a lamp in their hands; there were several drummers playing soft music in front. Hearing the flute of the lanterns in the distance, the doors of many houses opened. The girl and daughter-in-law came out, leaned against the door and looked, pointed and commented quietly. This is also the Lantern Festival of the year.一堂灯一般是六盏。四盏较小，大都是染成红色或白色，而且画了红花的羊角琉璃泡子。一盏是麒麟送子：一个染色的琉璃角片扎成的娃娃骑在一匹麒麟上。还有一盏是珠子灯：绿色的玻璃珠子穿扎成的很大的宫灯。灯体是八扇玻璃，漆着红色的各体寿字，其余部分都是珠子，顶盖上伸出八个珠子的凤头，凤嘴里衔着珠子的小幡，下缀珠子的流苏。这盏灯分量相当的重，送来的时候，得两个人用一根扁担抬着。这是一盏主灯，挂在房间的正中。旁边是麒麟送子，琉璃泡子挂在四角。
There are generally six lamps in a hall. Four are smaller, most of them are dyed red or white, and are painted with red flowers. One is a unicorn sending a child: a doll made of dyed glazed horns riding on a unicorn. Another is a bead lamp: a large palace lamp made of green glass beads. The lamp body is eight pieces of glass, painted with red shou characters, and the rest are beads, with a crested head with eight beads sticking out on the top cover, a small flag with beads in its mouth, and tassels with beads below. This lamp is quite heavy, and when it is delivered, it has to be carried by two people on a flat pole. This is a main lamp hanging in the middle of the room. Next to it is a unicorn sending a child, and the glass bubbles are hanging in the four corners.到了“灯节”的晚上，这些灯里就插了红蜡烛，点亮了。从十三“上灯”到十八“落灯”，接连点几个晚上。平常这些灯是不点的。
On the night of the "Lantern Festival", red candles were inserted into these lamps and lit. From the thirteenth "lights" to the eighteenth "down", they were lit for several nights in succession. Usually these lights are not lit.屋里点了灯，气氛就很不一样了。这些灯都不怎么亮（点灯的目的原不是为了照明），但很柔和。尤其是那盏珠子灯，洒下一片淡绿的光。绿光中珠幡的影子轻轻地摇曳，如梦如水，显得异常安静。元宵的灯光扩散着吉祥、幸福和朦胧暧昧的希望。
When the lights are lit in the house, the atmosphere is very different. These lights are not very bright (the purpose of lighting is not for lighting), but they are very soft. Especially the bead lamp, which sprinkles a pale green light. The shadow of the bead flag in the green light sways gently, like a dream and water, and it seems extremely quiet. The lights of the Lantern Festival spread auspiciousness, happiness and hazy hope.孙家的大小姐孙淑芸嫁给了王家的二少爷王常生。她屋里就挂了这样六盏灯。不过这六盏灯只点过一次。
Sun Shuyun, the eldest lady of the Sun family, married Wang Changsheng, the second young master of the Wang family. There are six lamps hanging in her house. However, these six lamps were only lit once.王常生在南京读书，秘密地加入了革命党，思想很新。订婚以后，他请媒人捎话过去：请孙小姐把脚放了。孙小姐的脚当真放得很好，看起来就不像裹过的。
Wang Changsheng studied in Nanjing and secretly joined the Revolutionary Party, and his ideas were very new. After getting engaged, he asked the matchmaker to carry the message: ask Miss Sun to put her feet down. Miss Sun's feet are really well placed, and they don't look like they have been wrapped.孙小姐是个才女。孙家对女儿的教育很特别，教女儿读诗词。除了《长恨歌》、《琵琶行》，孙小姐能背全本《西厢记》。嫁过来以后，她也看王常生带回来的黄遵宪的《日本国志》和林译小说《迦茵小传》、《茶花女遗事》……
Miss Sun is a talented woman. The Sun family has a special education for their daughter, teaching them to read poetry. Three sisters get married Qin Laoji is a burden seller of wontons. His wonton burden is unique in the city, and his wontons are also unique in the city.这副担子非常特别。一头是一个木柜，上面有七八个扁扁的抽屉；一头是安放在木柜里的烧松柴的小缸灶，上面支一口紫铜浅锅。铜锅分两格，一格是骨头汤，一格是下馄饨的清水。扁担不是套在两头的柜子上，而是打的时候就安在柜子上，和两个柜子成一体。扁担不是直的，是弯的，像一个罗锅桥。这副担子是楠木的，雕着花，细巧玲珑，很好看。这好像是《东京梦华录》时期的东西，李嵩笔下画出来的玩艺儿。秦老吉老远地来了，他挑的不像是馄饨担子，倒好像挑着一件什么文物。这副担子不知道传了多少代了，因为材料结实，做工精细，到现在还很完好。
This burden is very special. One end is a wooden cabinet with seven or eight flat drawers on it; one end is a small jar stove for burning pine wood placed in a wooden cabinet, and a copper shallow pot is supported on top. The copper pot is divided into two compartments, one is bone soup and the other is the water for wontons. The pole is not put on the cabinet at both ends, but is installed on the cabinet when it is beaten, and it is integrated with the two cabinets. The pole is not straight, it is curved, like a Luo pot bridge. This burden is made of nanmu, carved with flowers, delicate and exquisite, and very beautiful. This seems to be something from the period of "Tokyo Menghualu", a play painted by Li Song. Qin Laoji came all the way, he didn't pick a wonton burden, but seemed to be carrying some kind of cultural relic. I don't know how many generations of this burden has been passed down, because the material is strong and the workmanship is fine, and it is still very intact.别人卖的馄饨只有一种，葱花水打猪肉馅。他的馄饨除了猪肉馅的，还有鸡肉馅的、螃蟹馅的，最讲究的是荠菜冬笋肉末馅的，——这种肉馅不是用刀刃而是用刀背剁的！作料也特别齐全，除了酱油、醋，还有花椒油、辣椒油、虾皮、紫菜、葱末、蒜泥、韭花、芹菜和本地人一般不吃的芫荽。馄饨分别放在几个抽屉里，作料敞放在外面，任凭顾客各按口味调配。

The three sisters are all older. One is eighteen, one is seventeen, and the other is sixteen. It's time to marry. Which sycamore tree are these three phoenixes going to fly to? The three sisters all have a family. The eldest sister promised a cobbler, the second sister promised a hairshave, and the younger sister promised a sugar seller.皮匠的脸上有几颗麻子，一街人都叫他麻皮匠。他在东街的“乾陞和”茶食店廊檐下摆一副皮匠担子。“乾陞和”的门面很宽大，除了一个柜台，两边竖着的两块碎白石底子堆刻黑漆大字的木牌——一块写着“应时糕点”，一块写着“满汉饽饽”。这之外，没有什么东西，放一副皮匠担子一点不碍事。麻皮匠每天一早，“乾陞和”才开了门，就拿起一把长柄的笤帚把店堂打扫干净，然后就在“满汉饽饽”下面支起担子，开始绱鞋。他是个手脚很快的人。走起路来腿快，绱起鞋来手快。只见他把锥子在头发里“光”两下，一锥子扎过鞋帮鞋底，把两根用猪鬃引着的蜡线对穿过去，噌——噌，两把就绱了一针。流利合拍，均匀紧凑。他绱鞋的时候，常有人歪着头看。绱鞋，本来没有看头，但是麻皮匠绱鞋就能吸引人。大概什么事做得很精熟，就很美了。因为手快，麻皮匠一天能比别的皮匠多绱好几双鞋。不但快，绱得也好。针脚细密，楦得也到家，穿在脚上，不易走样。因此，他生意很好。也因此，落下“麻皮匠”这样一个称号。人家做好了鞋，叫佣人或孩子送去绱，总要叮嘱一句：“送到麻皮匠那里去。”这街上还有几个别的皮匠。怕送错了。他脸上的那几颗麻子就成了他的标志。他姓什么呢？好像是姓马。
The cobbler had a few pockmarks on his face, and people on the street called him a cobbler. He placed a pair of cobbler's burden under the eaves of the "Qianshenghe" tea shop on East Street. The façade of "Qianshenghe" is very wide, except for a counter, and two wooden signs with large black lacquer characters on the base of two broken stones erected on both sides - one says "Pastry in Time" and the other says "Manchu Han Dumplings". Other than that, there is nothing to put a pair of cobbler's burden in the way. Every morning, when the cobbler opens the door, he picks up a long-handled broom to clean the shop, and then puts up the burden under the "Manchu Han dumplings" and begins to tie his shoes. He is a person with fast hands and feet. He walks quickly with his legs and quick with his shoes. I saw him "light" the awl in his hair twice, one awl through the sole of the upper, and threaded two wax threads led by pig's bristles through each other. Fluent and compatible, even and compact. When he wears shoes, people often tilt their heads to look. Silk shoes are not worth looking at, but sack shoes can attract people. Probably if you do something very skillfully, it will be beautiful. Because of his quick hands, the hemp cobbler can tie several pairs of shoes a day than other cobblers. Not only is it fast, but it is also good. The stitches are fine, and the last is also home, and it is not easy to get out of shape when worn on the feet. Therefore, his business is very good. Therefore, he has the title of "hemp cobbler". When people make shoes and ask servants or children to send them to the shoes, they always have to say: "Send them to the hemp cobbler." There are several other cobblers on this street. I'm afraid I sent it wrong. The pockmarks on his face became his trademark. What is his surname? It seems to be Ma's surname.二姑娘的婆家姓时。老公公名叫时福海。他开了一爿剃头店，字号也就是“时福海记”。剃头的本属于“下九流”，他的店铺每年贴的春联却是：“头等事业，顶上生涯”。自从满清推翻，建立民国，人们剪了辫子，他的店铺主要是剃光头，以“水热刀快”为号召。时福海像所有的老剃头待诏一样，还擅长向阳取耳（掏耳朵），捶背拿筋。剃完头，用两只拳头给顾客哔哔剥剥地捶背（捶出各种节奏和清浊阴阳的脆响），噔噔地揪肩胛后的“懒筋”——捶、揪之后，真是“浑身通泰”。他还专会治“落枕”。睡落了枕，歪着脖子走进去，时福海把你的脑袋搁在他躬起的大腿上，两手扶着下颚，轻试两下，“咔叭”——就扳正了！老年间，剃头匠是半个跌打医生。
The second girl's in-laws' surname is Shi. The husband's name is Shi Fuhai. He opened a shaving shop, and the font name is "Shi Fuhai Ji". The head shaving originally belongs to the "lower ninth stream", but the Spring Festival couplets posted by his shop every year are: "First-class career, top career". Since the overthrow of the Manchu Qing Dynasty and the establishment of the Republic of China, people have cut their braids, and his shop is mainly shaved heads, with the call of "water and hot knives are fast". Shi Fuhai, like all old shaved heads, is also good at taking ears (picking out ears) from the sun and beating the back to get tendons. After shaving his head, he used two fists to beat the customer's back peeling (beating out various rhythms and crisp sounds of clear and turbid yin and yang), and grabbed the "lazy tendons" behind the shoulder blades - after beating and pulling, it was really "full of peace". He also specializes in treating "stiff neck". Fell asleep on the pillow and walked in with a crooked neck, Shi Fuhai put your head on his bowed thigh, held his chin with both hands, tried twice, and "clicked" - and it was straight! In old age, the shaving was half a doctor.这地方不知怎么会有这么一个传统，剃头的多半也是吹鼓手（不是所有的剃头匠都是吹鼓手，也不是所有的吹鼓手都是剃头匠）。时福海就也是一个吹鼓手。他吹唢呐，两腮鼓起两个圆圆的鼓包，憋得满脸通红。他还会“进曲”。好像一城的吹鼓手里只有他会，或只有他擅长于这个玩艺儿。人家办丧事，“六七”开吊，在“初献”、“亚献”之后，有“进曲”这个项目。赞礼的礼生喝道“进——曲！”时福海就拿了一面荸荠鼓，由两个鼓手双笛伴奏，唱一段曲子。曲词比昆曲还要古，内容是“神仙道化”，感叹人生无常，有《薤露》、《蒿里》遗意，很可能是元代的散曲。时福海自己也不知道唱的是什么，但还是唱得感慨唏嘘，自己心里都酸溜溜的。
I don't know how there is such a tradition in this place, and most of the people who shave their heads are also drummers (not all shavers are drummers, and not all drummers are shavers). Shi Fuhai is also a drummer. He played the suona, and his cheeks bulged two round drum bags, and his face was flushed. He can also "enter the song". It seems that he is the only drummer in the city, or he is the only one who is good at this game. People hold funerals, "June and Seven" hang, and after the "first offering" and "second offering", there is the project of "entering the song". The praising Lisheng shouted, "Enter-song!" Shi Fuhai took a water chestnut drum, accompanied by two drummers and two flutes, and sang a song. The lyrics are older than Kunqu Opera, and the content is "immortal Taoism", lamenting the impermanence of life, with the will of "Garlic Dew" and "Artemisia Li", which is likely to be a loose song of the Yuan Dynasty. Shi Fuhai himself didn't know what he was singing, but he still sang with emotion and sighed, and his heart was sour.时代变迁，时福海的这一套有点吃不开了。剃光头的人少了，“水热刀快”不那么有号召力了。卫生部门天天宣传挖鼻孔、挖耳朵不卫生。懂得享受捶背揪懒筋的乐趣的人也不多了。时福海忽然变成一个举动迟钝的老头。
Times have changed, and Shi Fuhai's set is a bit unintable. There are fewer people shaving their heads, and "water hot knife fast" is not so appealing. The health department advertises that nose picking and ear picking are unhygienic every day. There are not many people who know how to enjoy the fun of beating their backs and lazy tendons. Shi Fuhai suddenly became a slow old man.时福海有两个儿子。下等人不避父讳，大儿子叫大福子，小儿子叫小福子。
Shi Fuhai had two sons. The lower class did not shy away from their fathers, the eldest son was called Dafuzi, and the youngest son was called Xiao Fuzi.大福子很能赶潮流。他把逐渐暗淡下去的“时福海记”重新装修了一下，门窗柱壁，油漆一新，全都是奶油色，添了三面四尺高、二尺宽的大玻璃镜子。三面大镜之间挂了两个狭长的镜框，里面嵌了磁青砑银的蜡笺对联，请一个擅长书法的医生汪厚基浓墨写了一副对子：
Dafuzi is very good at catching up with the trend. He redecorated the gradually fading "Shifu Haiji", the doors, windows, columns, and walls, all painted, all cream, and added three large glass mirrors four feet high and two feet wide. Two long and narrow frames were hung between the three large mirrors, and a wax paper couplet with magnetic blue silver was embedded inside, and a doctor who was good at calligraphy was asked to write a pair of thick ink:不教白发催人老
更喜春风满面生
Don't let gray hair hasten you to age I am even more delighted with the spring breeze他还置办了“夜巴黎”的香水，“司丹康”的发蜡。顶棚上安了一面白布制成的“风扇”，有滑车牵引，叫小福子坐着，一下一下地拉“风扇”的绳子，使理发的人觉得“清风徐来”，十分爽快。这样，“时福海记”就又兴旺起来了。
He also bought the perfume of "Night Paris" and the hair wax of "Stankang". A "fan" made of white cloth was installed on the ceiling, pulled by a pulley, and Xiao Fuzi was asked to sit on it, pulling the rope of the "fan" one by one, so that the barber felt that "the breeze was blowing" and was very refreshing. In this way, "Shifu Haiji" prospered again.大福子也学了吹鼓手。笙箫管笛，无不精通。
Dafuzi also learned to play the drummer. Shengxiao and flute are all proficient.这地方不知怎么会流传“倒扳桨”、“跌断桥”、“剪靛花”之类的《霓裳续谱》、《白雪遗音》时期的小曲。平常人不唱，唱的多是理发的、搓澡的、修脚的、裁缝、做豆腐的年轻子弟。他们晚上常常聚在“时福海记”唱，大福子弹琵琶。“时福海记”外面站了好些人在听。
I don't know how to spread small songs from the period of "Rewind Paddle", "Broken Bridge", "Cutting Indigo", etc. from the period of "Continuation of the Rainbow Dress" and "White Snow Legacy". Ordinary people don't sing, and most of them are young people who get haircuts, scrub baths, get pedicures, tailors, and make tofu. They often gather at the "Shifu Haiji" at night to sing, and the Dafu bullet plays the pipa. There were many people standing outside the "Shifu Haiji" listening.二凤要嫁的就是大福子。
The one Erfeng wants to marry is Dafuzi.三姑娘许的这家苦一点，姓吴，小人叫吴顺福，是个遗腹子。家里只有两个人，一个老母亲，是个踮脚，走起路来一踮一踮的。母子二人，相依为命。妈妈很慈祥，儿子很孝顺。吴顺福是个很聪明的人，十五岁上就开始卖糖。卖糖和卖糖可不一样。他卖的不是普通的芝麻糖、花生糖，他卖的是“样糖”。他跟一个师叔学会了一宗手艺：能把白糖化了，倒在模子里，做成大小不等的福禄寿三星、财神爷、麒麟送子。高的二尺，矮的五寸，衣纹生动，须眉清楚；还能把糖里加了色，不用模子，随手吹出各种瓜果，桃、梨、苹果、佛手，跟真的一样，最好看的是南瓜：金黄的瓜，碧绿的蒂子，还开着一朵淡黄的瓜花。这种糖，人家买去，都是当摆设，不吃。——吃起来有什么意思呢，还不是都是糖的甜味！卖得最多的是糖兔子。白糖加麦芽糖熬了，切成梭子形的一块一块，两头用剪刀剪开，一头窝进腹下，是脚；一头便是耳朵。耳朵下捏一下，便是兔子脸，两边嵌进两粒马料豆，一个兔子就成了！马料豆有绿豆大，一头是通红的，一头是漆黑的。这种豆药店里卖，平常配药很少用它，好像是天生就为了做糖兔的眼睛用的！这种糖兔子很便宜，一般的孩子都买得起。也吃了，也玩了。
The third girl's family is a little bitter, surnamed Wu, the villain's name is Wu Shunfu, and he is a posthumous child. There are only two people in the family, an old mother, who is a tiptoe and walks on tiptoe. Mother and son depend on each other. The mother is very kind and the son is very filial. Wu Shunfu is a very smart person who started selling sugar at the age of fifteen. Selling sugar is not the same as selling sugar. He doesn't sell ordinary sesame candy or peanut candy, he sells "sample sugar". He learned a craft from an uncle: he can sugar it, pour it into molds, and make it into three stars of different sizes, God of Wealth, and Qilin to send children. Two feet high, five inches short, with vivid clothing patterns and clear eyebrows; You can also add color to the sugar, without a mold, you can blow out all kinds of melons and fruits, peaches, pears, apples, bergamot, just like the real thing, the best thing to look at is the pumpkin: golden melon, turquoise stem, and a pale yellow melon flower. This kind of sugar, people buy it, they are all decorations, not eaten. ——What's the point of eating it, it's not all the sweetness of sugar! The most sold is the sugar rabbit. White sugar and maltose are boiled, cut into shuttle-shaped pieces one by one, cut with scissors at both ends, and nested under the abdomen at one end, which is the foot; one end is the ear. Pinch under the ear, it is a rabbit face, two horse beans embedded on both sides, and a rabbit will be! Horse beans are the size of mung beans, one end is bright red and the other end is pitch black. This kind of bean is sold in pharmacies, and it is rarely used in medicine, as if it was born for the eyes of sugar rabbits! This kind of sugar rabbit is very cheap and ordinary children can afford it. I also ate and played.师叔死后，这门手艺成了绝活儿，全城只有吴顺福一个人会，因此，他的生意是不错的。
他做的这些艺术品都放在擦得晶亮的玻璃橱子里，在肩上挑着。他的糖担子好像一个小型的展览会，歇在哪里，都有人看。
After the death of his uncle, this craft became a unique skill, and only Wu Shunfu knew it in the city, so his business was good. The works of art he made were placed in polished glass cabinets and carried on his shoulders. His sugar burden was like a small exhibition, and wherever he rested, people looked at it.麻皮匠、大福子、吴顺福，都住得离秦老吉家不远。大姑娘、二姑娘、三姑娘几乎每天都能看到她们的女婿。姐儿仨有时在一起互相嘲戏。三姑娘小凤是个镴嘴子[2]，咭咭呱呱，对大姐姐说：
The hemp cobbler, Dafuzi, and Wu Shunfu all live not far from Qin Laoji's house. The eldest girl, the second girl, and the third girl can see their son-in-law almost every day. The three sisters sometimes laugh at each other together. The third girl, Xiao Feng, is a mouthful [2], and said to the eldest sister:“十个麻子九个俏，不是麻子没人要！”
大姐啐了她一口。
她又对二姐姐说：
“姑娘姑娘真不丑，一嫁嫁个吹鼓手。吃冷饭，喝冷酒，坐人家大门口！”[3]
二姐也啐了她一口。
"Ten pockmarks and nine pretty ones, no one wants them unless they are pockmarks!" The eldest sister took a bite of her. She said to the second sister again: "Girl, girl is really not ugly, marry a drummer. Eat cold food, drink cold wine, and sit at the gate of someone's house! ”{{id_0000}} The second sister also took a bite of her.两个姐姐容不得小凤如此放肆，就一齐反唇相讥：
“敲锣卖糖，各干各行！”
小妹妹不干了，用拳头捶两个姐姐：
“卖糖怎么啦！卖糖怎么啦！”
秦老吉正在外面拌馅儿，听见女儿打闹，就厉声训斥道：
The two sisters couldn't tolerate Xiao Feng being so presumptuous, so they mocked each other together: "Knock gongs and sell sugar, do your own thing!" The little sister stopped and punched the two sisters with her fists: "What's wrong with selling sugar! What's wrong with selling sugar! ” Qin Laoji was mixing stuffing outside, and when he heard his daughter fighting, he reprimanded sharply:“靠本事吃饭，比谁也不低。麻油拌芥菜，各有心中爱，谁也不许笑话谁！”
三姊妹听了，都吐了舌头。
"Eating by ability is not lower than anyone else. Sesame oil mixed with mustard greens, each has their own love, no one is allowed to laugh at anyone! ” When the three sisters heard this, they all stuck out their tongues.姐儿仨同一天出门子，都是腊月二十三。一顶花轿接连送了三个人。时辰倒是错开了。头一个是小凤，日落酉时。第二个是大凤，戌时。最后才是二凤。因为大福子要吹唢呐送小姨子，又要吹唢呐送大姨子。轮到他拜堂时已是亥时。给他吹唢呐的是他的爸爸时福海。时福海吹了一气，又坐到喜堂去受礼。
The three sisters went out on the same day, all on the 23rd day of the twelfth lunar month. A sedan chair sent three people one after another. The time is staggered. The first one is Xiao Feng, at sunset at the hour of You. The second is Da Feng, at the hour of the dog. The last is the second phoenix. Because Da Fuzi wants to blow suona to send his sister-in-law, and he wants to blow suona to send his sister-in-law. It was already Hai hour when it was his turn to worship. It was his father Shi Fuhai who blew the suona. Shi Fuhai blew on it and sat in the wedding hall to receive the gift.三天回门。三个姑爷，三个女儿都到了。秦老吉办了一桌酒，除了鸡鸭鱼肉，他特意包了加料三鲜馅的绉纱馄饨，让姑爷尝尝他的手艺。鲜美清香，自不必说。
Three days back. Three uncles and three daughters have arrived. Qin Laoji held a table of wine, in addition to chicken, duck and fish, he specially wrapped crepe wontons with three fresh fillings for his uncle to taste his craftsmanship. Delicious and fragrant, needless to say.三个女儿的婆家，都住得不远，两三步就能回来看看父亲。炊煮扫除，浆洗缝补，一如往日。有点小灾小病，头疼脑热，三个女儿抢着来伺候，比没出门时还殷勤。秦老吉心满意足，毫无遗憾。他只是有点发愁：他一朝撒手，谁来传下他的这副馄饨担子呢？
The three daughters' in-laws all live not far away, and they can come back to see their father in two or three steps. Cooking, cleaning, washing and sewing, as usual. A little sick, headache and brain fever, the three daughters rushed to serve, more attentive than when they didn't go out. Qin Laoji was satisfied and had no regrets. He was just a little worried: once he passed away, who would pass on his wonton burden?笃——笃笃，秦老吉还是挑着担子卖馄饨。
真格的，谁来继承他的这副古典的，南宋时期的，楠木的馄饨担子呢？

皮凤三楦房子

皮凤三楦房子[1]
[3] This is a local nursery rhyme. "Eat cold rice, drink cold wine" is also said to be "eat other people's food and drink other people's wine". Pi Feng Sanzhu House[1]皮凤三是清代评书《清风闸》里的人物。《清风闸》现在好像没有人说了，在当时，乾隆年间，在扬州一带，可是曾经风行过一时的。这是一部很奇特的书。既不是朴刀棒杖、长枪大马，也不是倚翠偷期、烟粉灵怪。《珍珠塔》、《玉蜻蜓》、《绿牡丹》、《八窍珠》，统统不是。它说的是一个市井无赖的故事。这部书虽有几个大关目，但都无关紧要。主要是一个一个的小故事。这些故事也不太连贯。其间也没有多少“扣子”，或北方评书艺人所谓“拴马桩”——即新文学家所谓“悬念”。然而人们还是津津有味地一回一回接着听下去。龚午亭是个擅说《清风闸》的说书先生，时人为之语曰：“要听龚午亭，吃饭莫打停”。为什么它能那样吸引人呢？大概是因为通过这些故事，淋漓尽致地刻画了扬州一带的世态人情，说出一些人们心中想说的话。
Pi Fengsan is a character in the Qing Dynasty storytelling "Qingfeng Gate". "Qingfeng Gate" seems to be said by no one now, at that time, during the Qianlong period, in the Yangzhou area, but it was once popular. This is a very peculiar book. It is neither a simple knife or a stick, nor a horse with a spear, nor a smoke powder monster. "Pearl Tower", "Jade Dragonfly", "Green Peony", "Eight Orifice Pearls", all not. It tells the story of a scoundrel. Although this book has several major points, they are irrelevant. Mainly small stories. These stories are also not very coherent. There are not many "buttons" in between, or the so-called "horse stakes" of northern storytellers - that is, the so-called "suspense" of new writers. However, people still listen to it again and again with relish. Gong Wuting is a storyteller who is good at talking about "Qingfeng Gate", and people at the time said: "If you want to listen to Gong Wuting, don't stop eating." Why is it so attractive? Probably because through these stories, the world and human feelings in Yangzhou are vividly portrayed, and some people want to say what they want to say.这个无赖即皮凤三，行五，而，故又名皮五子。这个人说好也好，说坏也坏。他也仗义疏财，打抱不平。对于倚财仗势欺负人的人，尤其是欺负到他头上来的人，他常常用一些很促狭的办法整得该人（按：“该人”一词见之于政工干部在外调材料之类后面所加的附注中，他们如认为被调查的人本身有问题，就提笔写道：“该人”如何如何，“所提供情况，仅供参考”云云）狼狈不堪，哭笑不得。“促狭”一词原来倒是全国各地皆有的。《红楼梦》第二十六回就有这个词。但后来在北方似乎失传了。在吴语和苏北官话里是还存在的。其意思很难翻译。刁、赖、阴、损、缺德……庶几近之。此外还有使人意想不到的含意。他有时也为了自己，使一些无辜的或并不太坏的人蒙受一点不大的损失，“楦房子”即是一例。皮凤三家的房子太紧了，他声言要把房子楦一楦，左右四邻都没有意见。心想：房子不是鞋，怎么个楦法呢？办法很简单：他把他的三面墙向邻居家扩展了一尺。因为事前已经打了招呼，邻居只好没得话说。
This scoundrel is Pi Fengsan, Xing Wu, and , so he is also known as Pi Wu . This person is good or bad. He also relied on righteousness and wealth and fought injustice. For people who rely on money and power to bully others, especially those who bully him, he often uses some very narrow methods to get rid of that person (note: the word "person" is seen in the notes added by political cadres after external transfer materials, etc., if they think that the person being investigated has a problem with themselves, they will write "how is the person", "the information provided is for reference only") The word "narrow" turned out to be found all over the country. This word is found in the twenty-sixth episode of "Dream of Red Mansions". But later it seems to have been lost in the north. It still exists in Wu and northern Jiangsu Mandarin. Its meaning is difficult to translate. Diao, Lai, Yin, Damage, Lack of Virtue...... Almost close. In addition, there are unexpected meanings. He sometimes caused some innocent or not too bad people to suffer a little loss for himself, and the "last house" is an example. The house of the three Pi Feng families was too tight, and he claimed to make the house last, and the neighbors on the left and right had no objections. I thought: The house is not a shoe, how to make a last? The method is very simple: he extended his three walls to the neighbor's house by one foot. Because he had already said hello beforehand, the neighbor had nothing to say.对皮凤三其人不宜评价过高。他的所作所为，即使是打抱不平，也都不能触动那个社会的本质。他的促狭只能施之于市民中的暴发户。对于真正的达官巨贾，是连一个指头也不敢碰的。
It is not appropriate to overestimate Pi Fengsan. What he does, even if he fights injustice, cannot touch the essence of that society. His narrow-mindedness can only be applied to the nouveau riche among the citizens. For real dignitaries and tycoons, they don't even dare to touch a finger.为什么在那个时代（那个时代即扬州八怪产生的时代）会产生《清风闸》这样的评书和皮凤三这样的人物？产生这样的评书、这样的人物的社会背景是什么？喔，这样的问题过于严肃，还是留给文学史家去研究吧。如今却说一个人因为一件事，在原来的外号之外又得了一个皮凤三这样的外号的故事。
Why did there be a storytelling like "Qingfeng Gate" and characters like Pi Fengsan in that era (that era was the era when the Eight Monsters of Yangzhou was born)? What is the social background that produced such storytelling and such characters? Oh, such a question is too serious, so let's leave it to literary historians to study. Now it is said that a person got a nickname like Pi Fengsan in addition to his original nickname because of one thing.此人名叫高大头。这当然是个外号。他当然是有个大名的。大名也不难查考，他家的户口本上“户主”一栏里就写着。但是他的大名很少有人叫。在他有挂号信的时候，邮递员会在老远的地方就扬声高叫：“高××，拿图章！”但是他这些年似乎很少收到挂号信。在换购粮本的时候，他的老婆去领，街道办事处的负责人喊了几声“高××”，他老婆也不应声，直到该负责人怒喝了一声“高大头！”他老婆才恍然大悟，连忙答应：“有！有！有！”就是在“文化大革命”被批斗的时候，他挂的牌子上写的也是：
This person's name is Gao Datou. Of course this is a nickname. Of course he has a big name. The name is not difficult to check, and it is written in the "head of household" column in his family's household registration book. But his name is rarely called. When he had a registered letter, the postman would shout from afar: "××, get a stamp!" But he seems to have rarely received registered letters over the years. When exchanging the grain book, his wife went to collect it, and the person in charge of the sub-district office shouted "high ××" a few times, but his wife did not respond, until the person in charge shouted angrily, "Gaotou!" His wife suddenly realized and quickly agreed: "Yes! Yes! Yes! It was when the "Cultural Revolution" was criticized, and the sign he hung also read:
“高大头”三字上照式用红笔打了叉子，因为排版不便，故从略。
The three words "tall head" were forked with a red pen according to the style, because the typesetting was inconvenient, so it was omitted.（谨按：在人的姓名上打叉，是个由来已久的古法。封建时代，刑人的布告上，照例要在犯人的姓名上用红笔打叉，以示此人即将于人世中注销。这办法似已失传有年矣，不知怎么被造反派考查出来，沿用了。其实，这倒是货真价实的“四旧”。至于把人的姓名中的字倒过来写，横过来写，以为这就可以产生一种诅咒的力量、可以置人于死地，于残忍中带有游戏成分，这手段可以上推到巫术时代，其来历可求之于马道婆。总而言之，“文化大革命”的许多恶作剧都是变态心理学所不得不研究的材料。）
(Note: Crossing a person's name is an ancient law with a long history.) In the feudal era, the prisoner's name was crossed with a red pen as usual to indicate that the person was about to be canceled from the world. This method seems to have been lost for many years, and somehow it was discovered by the rebels and used. In fact, this is the real "four olds". As for writing the words in a person's name upside down and horizontally, thinking that this can produce a cursing power, can put people to death, and has a game element in cruelty, this method can be pushed up to the age of witchcraft, and its origin can be traced back to Ma Dao Po. All in all, many of the pranks of the "Cultural Revolution" are materials that perverted psychology has to study. ）“高大头”不只是说姓高而头大，意思要更丰富一些，是说此人姓高，人很高大，而又有一个大头。他生得很魁梧，虎背熊腰。他的脑袋和身材很厮称。通体看来，并不显得特别的大。只有单看脑袋，才觉得大得有点异乎常人。这个脑袋长得很好。既不是四方四楞，像一个老式的装茶叶的锡罐；也不是圆圆乎乎的像一个冬瓜，而是上额宽广，下颚微狭，有一点像一只倒放着的鸭梨。这样的脑袋和体格，如果陪同外宾，一同步入宴会厅，拍下一张照片，是会很有气派的。但详考高大头的一生，似乎没有和外宾干过一次杯。他只是整天坐在门前的马扎子上，用一把木锉锉着一只胶鞋的磨歪了的后跟，用毛笔饱蘸了白色的乳胶涂在上面，选一块大小厚薄合适的胶皮贴上去，用他的厚厚实实的手掌按紧，连头也不大抬。只当有什么值得注意的人从他面前二三尺远的地方走过，他才从眼镜框上面看一眼。他家在南市口，是个热闹去处，但往来的大都是熟人。卖青菜的、卖麻团的、箍桶的、拉板车的、吹糖人的……他从他们的吆唤声、说话声、脚步声、喘气声，甚至从他们身上的气味，就能辨别出来，无须抬头一看。他的隔着一条巷子的紧邻针灸医生朱雪桥下班回家，他老远就听见他的苍老的咳嗽声，于是放下手里的活计，等着跟他打个招呼。朱雪桥走过，仍旧做活。一天就是这样，动作从容不迫，神色安静平和。他戴着一副黑框窄片的花镜，有点像个教授，不像个修鞋的手艺人。但是这个小县城里来了什么生人，他是立刻就会发现的，不会放过。而且只要那样看一眼，大体上就能判断这是省里来的，还是地区来的，是粮食部门的，还是水产部门的，是作家，还是来作专题报道的新闻记者。他那从眼镜框上面露出来的眼睛是彬彬有礼的，含蓄的，不露声色的，但又是机警的，而且相当的锋利。
"Tall head" is not just a surname high and a big head, the meaning is richer, it means that this person's surname is high, he is very tall, and he has a big head. He was born very burly, with a tiger back and a bear waist. His head and figure are very good. The whole body does not look particularly big. Only by looking at the head does it feel a little different from ordinary people. This head grows very well. It is neither square nor four-edged, like an old-fashioned tin can for tea; it is not round like a winter melon, but has a wide forehead and a slightly narrow jaw, a bit like an upside-down duck pear. Such a head and physique, if you accompany foreign guests, enter the banquet hall at the same time and take a photo, it will be very imposing. But a detailed examination of the tall head's life, it seems that he has never had a drink with a foreign guest. He just sat on the maza in front of the door all day, filed the crooked heel of a rubber shoe with a wooden file, dipped a brush in white latex and applied it to it, chose a piece of rubber of the right size and thickness to paste on it, and pressed it tightly with his thick palm, without even raising his head. Only when something noteworthy walked two or three feet away in front of him did he take a look at the frame of his glasses. His home is in Nanshikou, which is a lively place, but most of the people who come and go are acquaintances. Selling vegetables, selling hemp balls, hooping buckets, pulling carts, and blowing sugar...... He could tell from their shouts, talking, footsteps, panting, and even the smell on their bodies, without looking up. When Zhu Xueqiao, an acupuncturist next to his neighbor across an alley, came home from get off work, he heard his old cough from afar, so he put down his work and waited to say hello to him. Zhu Xueqiao walked past and still worked. The day was like this, his movements were calm and his expression was quiet and peaceful. He wore a pair of black-framed narrow-bladed flower glasses, a bit like a professor, not like a shoe repairer. But if there are any strangers in this small county, he will find out immediately and will not let them go. And just by looking at it like that, you can generally judge whether it is from the province, from the region, from the grain department, from the fisheries department, whether it is a writer, or a journalist who has come to make a special report. His eyes peeking out of the frames of his glasses are polite, subtle, quiet, but alert and quite sharp.高大头是个修鞋的，是个平头百姓，并无一官半职，虽有点走资本主义道路，却不当权，“文化大革命”怎么会触及到他，会把他也拿来挂牌、游街、批斗呢？答曰：因为他是牛鬼蛇神，故在横扫之列。此“文化大革命”之所以为“大”也。
Although he took the capitalist road, he was not in power, how could the "Cultural Revolution" touch him, and he would also be used to list, parade the streets, and criticize? Answer: Because he is a bull, ghost and snake god, he is among the sweepers. This is the reason why the "Cultural Revolution" is "big".小地方的人有一种传奇癖，爱听异闻。对一个生活经历稍为复杂一点的人，他们往往对他的历史添油加醋，任意夸张，说得神乎其神。这种捕风捉影的事，茶余酒后，巷议街谈，倒也无伤大雅。就是本人听到，也不暇去一一订正。有喜欢吹牛说大话的，还可能随声附和，补充细节，自高身价。一到运动，严肃地进行审查，可就惹了麻烦，跳进黄河也洗不清了。高大头就是这样。
People in small places have a habit of legends and love to hear strange stories. For a person with a slightly more complex life experience, they often add fuel to his history, exaggerate arbitrarily, and say it to the gods. This kind of chasing the wind and shadows, after tea and drink, it doesn't hurt to talk in the streets. Even if I hear it, I don't have time to correct it one by one. Some people like to brag and talk big, and they may echo along with the voice, add details, and raise their own value. As soon as it comes to sports, serious censorship will cause trouble, and jumping into the Yellow River will not be washed away. That's how tall heads are.高大头的简历如下：小时在家学铜匠。后到外地学开汽车，当了多年司机。解放前夕，因亲戚介绍，在一家营造厂“跑外”——当采购员。三五反后，营造厂停办，他又到专区一个师范学校当了几年总务。以后，即回乡从事补鞋。他走的地方多，认识的人多，在走出五里坝就要修家书的本地人看来，的确很不简单。
The resume of the tall head is as follows: He learned to be a coppersmith at home when he was a child. Later, he went to other places to learn to drive a car and worked as a driver for many years. On the eve of liberation, due to the introduction of relatives, he "ran out" in a construction factory - as a buyer. After the three-five rebellion, the construction factory was closed, and he went to a normal school in the special area to work as a general manager for several years. After that, he returned to his hometown to engage in shoe repair. He has traveled many places and met many people, and it is indeed not easy for the locals who want to repair their family letters when they walk out of Wuliba.但是本地很多人相信他进过黄埔军校，当过土匪，坐过日本人的牢，坐过国民党的牢，也坐过新四军的牢。
But many local people believe that he entered the Whampoa Military Academy, worked as a bandit, sat in the prison of the Japanese, the Kuomintang, and the New Fourth Army.事出有因，查无实据。黄埔军校早就不存在，他那样的年龄不可能进去过，而且他从来也没有到过广东。所以有此“疑点”，是因为他年轻时为了好玩，曾跟一个朋友借了一身军服照过一张照片，还佩了一柄“军人魂”的短剑。他大概曾经跟人吹过，说这种剑只有军校毕业生才有。这张照片早已不存在，但确有不止一个人见过，写有旁证材料。说他当过土匪，是因为他学铜匠的时候，有一师父会修枪。过去地方商会所办“保卫团”有枪坏了，曾拿给他去修过。于是就传成他会造枪，说他给乡下的土匪造过枪。于是就联系到高大头：他师父给土匪造枪，他师父就是土匪；他是土匪的徒弟，所以也是土匪。这种逻辑，颇为谨严。至于坐牢，倒是确有其事。他是司机，难免夹带一点私货，跑跑单帮。抗日战争时期从敌占区运到国统区；解放战争时期从国统区运到解放区。的确有两次被伪军和国民党军队查抄出来，关押了几天。关押的目的是敲竹杠。他花了一笔钱，托了朋友，也就保释出来了。所运的私货无非是日用所需，洋广杂货。其中也有违禁物资，如西药、煤油。但是很多人说他运的是枪枝弹药。就算是枪枝弹药吧：抗日战争时期，国共还在合作，由日本人那里偷运给国民党军队，不是坏事；解放战争时期由国民党军队那里偷运给新四军，这岂不是好事？然而不，这都是反革命行为。他确也被新四军扣留审查过几天，那是因为不清楚他的来历。后来已有新四军当时的负责人写了证明，说这是出于误会。以上诸问题，本不难澄清，但是有关部门一直未作明确结论，作为悬案挂在那里。他之所以被专区的师范解职，就是因为：历史复杂。
There is a reason for the incident, and there is no evidence. The Whampoa Military Academy has long since existed, it is impossible for him to go in at that age, and he has never been to Guangdong. So there is this "suspicion" because when he was young, he borrowed a military uniform from a friend to take a photo, and also wore a short sword with a "soldier's soul". He probably once blew to someone that this kind of sword is only available to military academy graduates. This photo no longer exists, but more than one person has seen it, and there is circumstantial evidence written on it. He said that he was a bandit because when he was studying coppersmithing, there was a master who could repair guns. In the past, the "security group" run by the local chamber of commerce had a broken gun and was given to him to repair. So it was rumored that he could make guns, saying that he had made guns for bandits in the countryside. So he contacted the tall head: his master made guns for the bandits, and his master was a bandit; he was a bandit's apprentice, so he was also a bandit. This logic is quite rigorous. As for going to jail, it is true. He is a driver, so it is inevitable that he will carry a little private goods and run around alone. During the War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression, it was transported from the enemy-occupied area to the Kuomintang area; during the War of Liberation, it was transported from the Kuomintang area to the liberated area. It was indeed raided twice by the puppet army and the Kuomintang army, and was imprisoned for several days. The purpose of the detention was to rob the bamboo bar. He spent a sum of money, entrusted a friend, and was released on bail. The private goods transported were nothing more than daily necessities, foreign groceries. There are also prohibited materials, such as Western medicine and kerosene. But many people say that he was transporting guns and ammunition. Even if it is guns and ammunition: during the War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression, the Kuomintang and the Communist Party were still cooperating, and it was not a bad thing to be smuggled to the Kuomintang army by the Japanese; Wouldn't it be a good thing to be smuggled from the Kuomintang army to the New Fourth Army during the War of Liberation? However, no, this is all counter-revolutionary acts. He was indeed detained by the New Fourth Army for a few days because his origin was unknown. Later, the person in charge of the New Fourth Army at the time wrote a certificate, saying that this was due to a misunderstanding. The above issues are not difficult to clarify, but the relevant departments have not made a clear conclusion and are hanging there as an unsolved case. The reason why he was dismissed from the normal school of the special district is because: the history is complicated.“文化大革命”，旧案重提，他被揪了出来。地方上的造反派为之成立了专案。专案组的组长是当时造反派的头头，后来的财政局长谭凌霄，专案组成员之一是后来的房产管理处主任高宗汉。因为有此因缘，就逼得高大头终于不得不把他的房子楦一楦。此是后话。
"Cultural Revolution", the old case was brought up again, and he was caught. The local rebels set up a special case for it. The leader of the task force was Tan Lingxiao, the leader of the rebels at that time, and the later director of the Finance Bureau, and one of the members of the task force was Gao Zonghan, the later director of the real estate management office. Because of this reason, the tall head finally had to close his house. This is a later story.“文化大革命”山呼海啸，席卷全国。高大头算个什么呢，真是沧海之一粟。不过他在本地却是出足了风头，因为案情复杂而且严重。南市口离县革会不远，县革会门前有一面大照壁。照壁上贴得满满一壁关于高大头的大字报，还有漫画插图。谭凌霄原来在文化馆工作，高宗汉原是电影院的美工，他们都能写会画，把高大头画得很像。他的形象特征很好掌握，一个鸭梨形的比身体还要大的头。在批斗他的时候，喊的口号也特别热闹：
The "Cultural Revolution" screamed and swept across the country. What is a tall head, it is really a drop in the ocean. However, he was in the limelight locally because the case was complex and serious. Nanshikou is not far from the county revolutionary committee, and there is a large photo wall in front of the county revolutionary committee. The wall is full of big-character posters about tall heads, as well as comic illustrations. Tan Lingxiao used to work in the cultural center, and Gao Zonghan was originally an artist in the cinema, and they could both write and paint, and the tall head was very similar. His image characteristics are easy to grasp, a duck pear-shaped head that is larger than the body. When criticizing him, the slogans shouted were also very lively: “打倒反动军官高大头！”
“打倒土匪高大头！”
“打倒军火商高大头！”
“打倒三开分子高大头！”
剃头、画脸、游街、抄家、挨打、罚跪，应有尽有，不必细说。
"Down with the reactionary officer Tall!" "Down with the bandits!" "Down with the arms dealer!" "Down with the big head of the three-opening molecule!" Shaving heads, painting faces, parading the streets, raiding houses, being beaten, punishing kneeling, there are everything, no need to go into details.高大头是个曾经沧海的人，“文化大革命”虽然是史无前例，他却以一种古已有之的态度对待之：逆来顺受。批斗、游街，随叫随到。低头的角度很低，时间很长。挨打挨踢，面无愠色。他身体结实，这些都经受得住。检查材料交了一大摞，写得很详细，很工整。时间、地点、经过、证明人，清清楚楚。一次一次，不厌其烦。但是这种检查越看越叫人生气。
Although the "Cultural Revolution" is unprecedented, he treats it with an ancient attitude: obedience. Criticize, parade the streets, and be on call. The reporter wrote a report on this matter in the name of "reporter of this newspaper" and brought it back to the newspaper.也活该谭凌霄倒楣，他赶到坎上了，现在正是大抓不正之风的时候。报社决定用这篇稿子。打了清样，寄到本县县委，征求他们的意见，是否同意发表。县委书记看了清样，正在考虑，奚县长正在旁边，说：“这件事你要是压下来，将来问题深化了，你也会被牵扯进去，这是一；如果不同意发表这篇报道，那将来本县的消息要见省报，可就困难了，这是二。”县委书记击案说：“好！同意！”奚县长抓起笔就写了一封复信：
He also deserved Tan Lingxiao's misfortune, he rushed to the hurdle, and now is the time to catch the unhealthy trend. The newspaper decided to use this manuscript. After making a clear sample, it was sent to the county party committee of the county to ask for their opinions and whether to agree to publish it. The secretary of the county party committee looked at the sample and was considering it, and County Magistrate Xi was next to him, and said: "If you suppress this matter, the problem will deepen in the future, and you will also be involved, this is one; if you don't agree to publish this report, then it will be difficult to see the provincial newspaper in the future, this is two." The secretary of the county party committee said: "Okay! Agree! County Magistrate Xi grabbed a pen and wrote a reply:此稿报道情况完全属实，同意发表。这对我们整顿党政作风，很有帮助，特此表示感谢。
报道在省报发表后，全城轰动。很多居民买了鞭炮到大街上来放，好像过年一样。
This report is completely true, and I agree to publish it. This is very helpful to us in rectifying the party and government style, and I would like to express my gratitude. After the report was published in the provincial newspaper, it caused a sensation in the city. Many residents bought firecrackers and put them on the street, as if they were Chinese New Year.高大头当真在他的九平米的地基上盖起了一所新房子（在修建新房时，他借住了朱雪桥原来住的厢房）。这座房子一共三十六平米。他盖了个两楼一底。底层还是九米。上面一层却有十二米。他把上层的楼板向下层的檐外伸出了一截，突出在街面上。紧挨上层，他又向南伸展，盖了一间过街楼，那一头接到朱雪桥家厢房房顶。这间过街楼相当高，楼下可过车辆行人，不碍交通。过街楼有十五平米。这样，高大头家四口人，每人就有九平米，很宽绰了。高大头的儿子就是要结婚，也完全有地方。这两楼一底是高大头自己设计的。他干过营造厂嘛。来来往往的人看了高大头的这所十分别致的房子，都说：“这家伙真是个皮凤三，他硬把九平方米楦成了三十六平方米，神了！”
The tall head really built a new house on his nine-square-meter foundation (when building the new house, he borrowed the wing room where Zhu Xueqiao originally lived). The house has a total of 36 square meters. He built two floors and one bottom. The ground floor is still nine meters. The upper floor is twelve meters. He extended the upper floor slab out of the eaves of the lower floor and protruded on the street. Next to the upper floor, he stretched south and built a crossing building, which connected to the roof of Zhu Xueqiao's wing room. This crossing building is quite high, and vehicles and pedestrians can pass downstairs without obstructing traffic. The crossing building is fifteen square meters. In this way, the tall family of four has nine square meters each, which is very spacious. The tall son is getting married and has a place to go. The bottom of these two floors was designed by the tall head himself. He has worked in a construction factory. People who came and went looked at this very chic house with a tall head, and they all said: "This guy is really a Pi Fengsan, he forced the last of nine square meters into thirty-six square meters, god!" ”谭凌霄、高宗汉忽然在同一天被撤了职。这消息可靠。据财政局的人说，他们自己已接到通知，只是还没有公开宣布。他们这两天已经不到机关上班了。因为要是再去，别人叫他们“局长”、“主任”，答应也不好，不答应也不好。
Tan Lingxiao and Gao Zonghan were suddenly dismissed on the same day. This news is reliable. According to people from the Finance Bureau, they themselves have been notified, but they have not yet announced it publicly. They have not gone to work at the agency in the past two days. Because if they go again, others will call them "director" and "director", and it is not good to agree or not agree.在听到他们俩撤职的消息后，城里人有没有放鞭炮呢？没有。他们是很讲恕道的。
After hearing the news of their dismissal, did the people in the city set off firecrackers? No. They are very forgiving.这二位到底为什么被撤职呢？众说纷纭。有人说是他们在住房问题上对群众刁难勒索，太招恨了；有人说是他们通同作弊，修盖私人住宅；有人说：因为他们是造反派！究竟如何，且听下回分解。
Why were these two dismissed? Accounts differ and opinions vary. Some people say that they are making things difficult and blackmailing the masses on housing issues, which is too hateful; some people say that they cheat and build private houses; some people say: Because they are rebels! How is it, and listen to the next breakdown.一九八一年十二月二十五日

1982年

1982年
钓人的孩子[1]
钓人的孩子
December 25, 1981 [1] This article was originally published in the third issue of "Shanghai Literature" in 1982; "Dinner Flower Collection", People's Literature Publishing House, March 1985. In 1982 Fisherman's Child {{id_0000}} Fishing Children抗日战争时期。昆明大西门外。
米市，菜市，肉市。柴驮子，炭驮子。马粪。粗细瓷碗，砂锅铁锅。焖鸡米线，烧饵块。金钱片腿，牛干巴。炒菜的油烟，炸辣子的呛人的气味。红黄蓝白黑，酸甜苦辣咸。
During the War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression. Outside the West Gate of Kunming. Rice market, vegetable market, meat market. Firewood pack, charcoal pack. Horse manure. Thick and thin porcelain bowls, casseroles and iron pots. Braised chicken rice noodles, roasted bait cubes. Money sliced legs, beef dry. The fumes of stir-frying, the choking smell of fried peppers. Red, yellow, blue, white, black, sweet, sour, bitter, spicy and salty.每个人带着一生的历史，半个月的哀乐，在街上走。栖栖惶惶，忙忙碌碌。谁都希望意外地发一笔小财，在路上捡到一笔钱。
一张对摺着的钞票躺在人行道上。
Everyone walks on the street with a lifetime of history and half a month of sorrow and joy. Qiqi is panicked and busy. Everyone hopes to make a small fortune unexpectedly and pick up a sum of money on the road. A bill folded in half lies on the sidewalk.用这张钞票可以量五升米，割三斤肉，或扯六尺细白布，——够做一件汗褂，或到大西门里牛肉馆要一盘冷片、一碗汤片、一大碗饭、四两酒，美美地吃一顿。
一个人弯腰去捡钞票。
With this banknote, you can measure five liters of rice, cut three pounds of meat, or pull a six-foot fine white cloth ,—— enough to make a sweat coat, or go to the Daximenli Beef Restaurant to ask for a plate of cold slices, a bowl of soup slices, a large bowl of rice, four taels of wine, and eat a beautiful meal. A man bends over to pick up the bill.噌——，钞票飞进了一家店铺的门里。
一个胖胖的孩子坐在门背后。他把钞票丢在人行道上，钞票上拴了一根黑线，线头捏在他的手里。他偷眼看着钞票，只等有人弯腰来拾，他就猛地一抽线头。
——, money flew into the door of a store. A chubby child sat behind the door. He threw the bill on the sidewalk, and a black thread was tied to the bill, and the thread was pinched in his hand. He stole a glance at the banknote, and when someone bent down to pick it up, he suddenly pulled the thread.他玩着这种捉弄人的游戏，已经玩了半天。上当的已经有好几个人了。
胖孩子满脸是狡猾的笑容。
这是一个小魔鬼。
He has been playing this kind of tricky game for a long time. There are already several people who have been fooled. The fat boy's face was full of sly smiles. This is a little devil.这孩子长大了，将会变成一个什么人呢？日后如果有人提起他的恶作剧，他多半会否认。——也许他真的已经忘了。
捡金子
Who will this child become when he grows up? If someone mentions his pranks in the future, he will most likely deny it. - Maybe he has really forgotten. Picking up gold这是一个怪人，很孤傲，跟谁也不来往，尤其是女同学。他是哲学系的研究生。他只有两个“听众”，都是中文系四年级的学生。他们每天一起坐茶馆，在茶馆里喝清茶，磕葵花子，看书，谈天，骂人。哲学研究生高谈阔论的时候多，那两位只有插话的份儿，所以是“听众”。他们都有点玩世不恭。哲学研究生的玩世不恭是真的，那两位有点是装出来的。他们说话很尖刻，动不动骂人是“卑劣的动物”。他们有一套独特的语言。他们把漂亮的女同学叫做“虎”，把谈恋爱叫做“杀虎”，把钱叫做“刀”。有刀则可以杀虎，无刀则不能。诸如此类。他们都没有杀过一次虎。
This is a strange person, very arrogant, and does not associate with anyone, especially female classmates. He is a graduate student in the Department of Philosophy. He only has two "listeners", both of whom are fourth-year students in the Chinese Department. They sit together in the teahouse every day, drink tea in the teahouse, knock on sunflower seeds, read books, talk about the sky, and scold people. Philosophy graduate students often talk about it, but those two only interject, so they are "listeners". They are both a bit cynical. The cynicism of philosophy graduate students is real, but those two are a bit pretending. They speak very sharply and call people "despicable animals" at every turn. They have a unique set of language. They call beautiful female classmates "tigers", fall in love "killing tigers", and money "knives". If you have a knife, you can kill a tiger, but if you don't have a knife, you can't. Etcetera. None of them have killed a tiger once.这个怪人做过一件怪事，捡金子。昆明经常有日本飞机来空袭。一有空袭就拉警报。一有警报人们就都跑到城外的山野里躲避，叫做“逃警报”。哲学研究生推论：逃警报的人一定会把值钱的东西带在身边，包括金子；有人带金子，就会有人丢掉金子；有人丢掉金子，一定会有人捡到；人会捡到金子；我是人，故我可以捡到金子。这一套逻辑推理实在是无懈可击。于是在逃警报时他就沿路注意。他当真捡到金戒指，而且不止一次，不止一枚。
This strange man did a strange thing, picking up gold. Japanese planes often come to Kunming to carry air raids. As soon as there is an air raid, the alarm is raised. As soon as there is an alarm, people run to the mountains outside the city to hide, which is called "escaping the alarm". The philosophy graduate student reasoned: People who escape the alarm will definitely take valuable things with them, including gold; if someone brings gold, someone will throw away the gold; if someone loses gold, someone will definitely pick it up; people will pick up gold; I am a human being, so I can pick up gold. This set of logical reasoning is really impeccable. So when he was fleeing the alarm, he paid attention along the way. He really picked up a gold ring, and more than once, more than one.此人后来不知所终。
有人说他到了重庆，给《中央日报》写社论，骂共产党。
航空奖券
This person later disappeared. Some people say that when he arrived in Chongqing, he wrote an editorial for the Central Daily and scolded the Communist Party. Airline Tickets国民党的中央政府发行了一种航空救国奖券，头奖二百五十万元，月月开奖。虽然通货膨胀，钞票贬值，这二百五十万元一直还是一个相当大的数目。这就是说，在国民党统治范围的中国，每个月要凭空出现一个财主。花不多的钱，买一个很大的希望，因此人们趋之若鹜，代卖奖券的店铺的生意很兴隆。
The central government of the Kuomintang issued an aviation national salvation lottery ticket, with a jackpot of 2.5 million yuan, which was drawn every month. Although inflation and banknotes depreciated, the 2.5 million yuan has always been a considerable amount. This means that in China, which is ruled by the Kuomintang, a rich man appears out of thin air every month. Spend a little money to buy a big hope, so people flock to it, and the business of the shops selling lottery tickets is very prosperous.中文系学生彭振铎高中毕业后曾教过两年小学，岁数比同班同学都大。他相貌平常，衣装朴素，为人端谨。他除了每月领助学金（当时叫做“贷金”），还在中学兼课，有一点微薄的薪水。他过得很俭省，除了买买书，买肥皂牙膏，从不乱花钱。不抽烟，不饮酒。只有他的一个表哥来的时候，他的生活才有一点变化。这位表哥往来重庆、贵阳、昆明，跑买卖。虽是做生意的人，却不忘情诗书，谈吐不俗。他来了，总是住在爱群旅社，必把彭振铎邀去，洗洗澡，吃吃馆子，然后在旅馆里长谈一夜。谈家乡往事，物价行情，也谈诗。平常，彭振铎总是吃食堂，吃有耗子屎的发霉的红米饭，吃炒芸豆，还有一种叫做芋磨豆腐的紫灰色的烂糊糊的东西。他读书很用功，但是没有一个教授特别赏识他，没有人把他当作才子来看。然而他在内心深处却是一个诗人，一个忠实的浪漫主义者。在中国诗人里他喜欢李商隐，外国诗人里喜欢雪莱，现代作家里喜欢何其芳。他把《预言》和《画梦录》读得几乎能背下来。他自己也不断地写一些格律严谨的诗和满纸烟云的散文。定稿后抄在一个黑漆布面的厚练习本里，抄得很工整。这些作品，偶尔也拿出来给人看，但只限于少数他所钦服而嘴又不太损的同学。同班同学中有一个写小说的，他就请他看过。这位小说家认真地看了一遍，说：“很像何其芳。”
Peng Zhenduo, a Chinese student, taught elementary school for two years after graduating from high school, and was older than his classmates. He has an ordinary appearance, simple clothes, and is dignified. In addition to receiving monthly bursaries (called "loans" at the time), he also taught part-time in middle school and had a meager salary. He lived a frugal life, except for buying books and soap and toothpaste, and never spent money indiscriminately. Don't smoke, don't drink. Only when one of his cousins came, his life changed a little. This cousin travels between Chongqing, Guiyang, and Kunming, running business. Although he is a businessman, he does not forget to love poetry and books, and he talks well. When he came, he always stayed at the Aiqun Hotel, and he would invite Peng Zhenduo to take a bath, eat in a restaurant, and then talk for a long time in the hotel. Talk about the past of his hometown, price quotes, and poetry. Usually, Peng Zhenduo always eats in the cafeteria, eating moldy red rice with rat droppings, fried kidney beans, and a purple-gray mushy thing called taro ground tofu. He studied very hard, but no professor particularly appreciated him, and no one regarded him as a talent. However, deep down he is a poet, a loyal romantic. Among Chinese poets, he likes Li Shangyin, among foreign poets he likes Shelley, and among modern writers, he likes He Qifang. He read "Prophecy" and "Painting Dreams" almost by memory. He himself continued to write some metrical poems and prose full of smoke. After finalizing, it was copied in a thick exercise book with a black lacquer cloth surface, and it was copied very neatly. These works are occasionally taken out for people to see, but only to a few classmates who admire them and whose mouths are not too bad. One of his classmates wrote a novel, and he asked him to read it. The novelist read it carefully and said, "It's very similar to He Qifang." ”然而这位浪漫主义诗人却干了一件不大有诗意的事：他按月购买一条航空奖券。
他买航空奖券不是为了自己。
However, the romantic poet did something not very poetic: he bought an airline ticket per month. He didn't buy airline tickets for himself.系里有个女同学名叫柳曦，长得很漂亮。然而天然不俗，落落大方，不像那些漂亮的或自以为漂亮的女同学整天浓妆艳抹，有明星气、少奶奶气或教会气。她并不怎样着意打扮，总是一件蓝阴丹士林旗袍，——天凉了则加一件玫瑰红的毛衣。她走起路来微微偏着一点脑袋，两只脚几乎走在一条线上，有一种说不出来的风致，真是一株风前柳，不枉了小名儿唤做柳曦。彭振铎和她一同上创作课。她写的散文也极清秀，文如其人，彭振铎自愧弗如。
There is a female classmate in the department named Liu Xi, who is very beautiful. However, she is natural and generous, unlike those female students who are beautiful or think they are beautiful and wear heavy makeup all day long, with a star, a young grandmother or a church spirit. She doesn't pay much attention to dressing up, she always wears a blue yin Dan Shilin cheongsam,—— and a rose red sweater when it's cold. She walked with her head slightly tilted, her feet were almost in a line, and she had an indescribable style. Peng Zhenduo took a creative class with her. The prose she wrote was also very beautiful, and the writing was as good as she was, and Peng Zhenduo was ashamed of herself.尤其使彭振铎动心的是她有一段不幸的身世。有一个男的时常来找她。这个男的比柳曦要大五六岁，有时穿一件藏青哔叽的中山装，有时穿一套咖啡色西服。这是柳曦的未婚夫，在资源委员会当科长。柳曦的婚姻是勉强的。她的父亲早故，家境贫寒。这个男人看上了柳曦，拿钱供柳曦读了中学，又读了大学，还负担她的母亲和弟妹的生活。柳曦在高中一年级就跟他订婚了。她实际上是卖给了这个男人。怪不道彭振铎觉得柳曦的眉头总有点蹙着（虽然这更增加了她的美的深度），而且那位未婚夫来找她，两人一同往外走她总是和他离得远远的。
What particularly touched Peng Zhenduo was that she had an unfortunate life experience. There is a man who often comes to her. This man is five or six years older than Liu Xi, sometimes wearing a navy blue beeping tunic, and sometimes a coffee-colored suit. This is Liu Xi's fiancé, who works as a section chief in the Resources Committee. Liu Xi's marriage was reluctant. Her father died early and her family was poor. This man took a fancy to Liu Xi and took money for Liu Xi to go to middle school, college, and burden her mother and younger siblings. Liu Xi got engaged to him in his first year of high school. She actually sold it to this man. No wonder Peng Zhenduo felt that Liu Xi's brows were always a little frowned (although this added depth to her beauty), and the fiancé came to her, and the two went out together, and she was always far away from him.这是那位写小说的同学告诉彭振铎的。小说家和柳曦是小同乡，中学同学。
This is what the classmate who wrote the novel told Peng Zhenduo. The novelist and Liu Xi are childhood classmates, middle school classmates.彭振铎很不平了。他要搞一笔钱，让柳曦把那个男人在她身上花的钱全部还清，把自己赎出来，恢复自由。于是他就按月购买航空奖券。他老是梦想他中了头奖，把二百五十万元连同那一册诗文一起捧给柳曦。这些诗文都是写给柳曦的。柳曦感动了，流了眼泪。投在他的怀里。
Peng Zhenduo was very upset. He wanted to get a sum of money and ask Liu Xi to pay off all the money the man had spent on her, redeem himself, and restore his freedom. So he bought airline tickets on a monthly basis. He always dreamed that he had won the jackpot and gave 2.5 million yuan to Liu Xi along with that volume of poems. These poems were all written to Liu Xi. Liu Xi was moved and shed tears. Throw it into his arms.彭振铎的表哥又来了。彭振铎去看表哥，顺便买了一条航空奖券。到了爱群旅社，适逢表哥因事外出，留字请他少候。彭振铎躺在床上看书。房门开着。
Peng Zhenduo's cousin is here again. Peng Zhenduo went to see his cousin and bought an airline ticket by the way. When he arrived at the Aiqun Hotel, his cousin was out for some business, so he left a message asking him to wait. Peng Zhenduo was lying on the bed reading. The door was open.彭振铎看见两个人从门外走过，是柳曦和她的未婚夫！他们走进隔壁的房间。不大一会儿，就听见柳曦的放浪的笑声。
彭振铎如遭电殛。
他觉得心里很不是滋味。
Peng Zhenduo saw two people walking outside the door, it was Liu Xi and her fiancé! They walked into the next room. After a while, I heard Liu Xi's unbridled laughter. Peng Zhenduo felt as if he had been struck by lightning. He felt very uncomfortable.而且他渐渐觉得柳曦的不幸的身世、勉强的婚姻，都是那个写小说的同学编出来的。这个玩笑开得可太大了！
他怎么坐得住呢？只有走。
And he gradually felt that Liu Xi's unfortunate life experience and reluctant marriage were all made up by the classmate who wrote the novel. This joke is too big! How can he sit still? Only go.他回到宿舍，把那一册诗文翻出来看看。他并没有把它们烧掉。这些诗文虽然几乎篇篇都有柳，柳风、柳影、柳絮、杨花、浮萍……但并未点出柳曦的名字。留着，将来有机会献给另外一个人，也还是可以的。
He returned to the dormitory and turned out the poems to read. He didn't burn them. Although almost all of these poems have willows, willow wind, willow shadows, willow catkins, poplars, and duckweed...... But Liu Xi's name was not named. If you keep it, you will have the opportunity to dedicate it to another person in the future, and it is still possible.航空奖券，他还是按月买，因为已经成了习惯。
一九八二年二月二日

鉴赏家

鉴赏家[1]
He still buys airline tickets on a monthly basis because it has become a habit. February 2, 1982 [1] This article was originally published in the fourth issue of "Haiyan" in 1982; First received "Dinner Flower Collection", People's Literature Publishing House, March 1985. Connoisseur[1]全县第一个大画家是季匋民，第一个鉴赏家是叶三。
The first great painter in the county was Ji Kuimin, and the first connoisseur was Ye San.叶三是个卖果子的。他这个卖果子的和别的卖果子的不一样。不是开铺子的，不是摆摊的，也不是挑着担子走街串巷的。他专给大宅门送果子。也就是给二三十家送。这些人家他走得很熟，看门的和狗都认识他。到了一定的日子，他就来了。里面听到他敲门的声音，就知道：是叶三。挎着一个金丝篾篮，篮子上插一把小秤，他走进堂屋，扬声称呼主人。主人有时走出来跟他见见面，有时就隔着房门说话。“给您称——？”——“五斤”。什么果子，是看也不用看的，因为到了什么节令送什么果子都是一定的。叶三卖果子从不说价。买果子的人家也总不会亏待他。有的人家当时就给钱，大多数是到节下（端节、中秋、新年）再说。叶三把果子称好，放在八仙桌上，道一声“得罪”，就走了。他的果子不用挑，个个都是好的。他的果子的好处，第一是得四时之先。市上还没有见这种果子，他的篮子里已经有了。第二是都很大，都均匀，很香，很甜，很好看。他的果子全都从他手里过过，有疤的、有虫眼的、挤筐、破皮、变色、过小的全都剔下来，贱价卖给别的果贩。他的果子都是原装；有些是直接到产地采办来的，都是“树熟”，——不是在米糠里闷熟了的。他经常出外，出去买果子比他卖果子的时间要多得多。他也很喜欢到处跑。四乡八镇，哪个园子里，什么人家，有一棵什么出名的好果树，他都知道，而且和园主打了多年交道，熟得像是亲家一样了。——别的卖果子的下不了这样的功夫，也不知道这些路道。到处走，能看很多好景致，知道各地乡风，可资谈助，对身体也好。他很少得病，就是因为路走得多。
Ye San is a fruit seller. He is a fruit seller and other fruit sellers. He is not a shopkeeper, a stall, or a burden walking through the streets. He specializes in delivering fruit to the door of the mansion. That is, to twenty or thirty families. He was very familiar with these people, and the gatekeepers and dogs knew him. On a certain day, he came. When he heard him knocking on the door, he knew: It was Ye San. Carrying a gold silk basket and a small scale stuck in the basket, he walked into the hall and claimed to be the master. Sometimes the master came out to meet him, and sometimes he spoke through the door. "Weigh ——? you" ——"Five pounds". You don't have to look at any fruit, because what fruit is given in any season. Ye San never bargains when selling fruit. People who buy fruit will never treat him badly. Some people give money at that time, and most of them talk about it after the festival (Dragon Festival, Mid-Autumn Festival, New Year). Ye San weighed the fruit, put it on the table of the Eight Immortals, said "offended", and left. His fruits don't need to be picked, they are all good. The first advantage of his fruit is that it has to be four seasons ahead. I haven't seen this kind of fruit on the market yet, but he already has it in his basket. The second is that they are all very large, uniform, fragrant, sweet, and beautiful. All his fruits have passed through his hands, and those with scars, insect eyes, squeezed baskets, broken skins, discoloration, and small ones are all removed and sold to other fruit vendors at a low price. His fruits are all original; some are purchased directly from the place of origin, and they are all "ripe",—— not stuffed in the rice bran. He often goes out and spends much more time buying fruit than he sells fruit. He also likes to run around. He knows all the four towns and eight towns, which garden, what kind of person, and what good fruit tree is famous, and he has dealt with the owner for many years, and he is as ripe as his in-laws. ——Other fruit sellers can't do such effort, and they don't know these roads. Walking around, you can see a lot of good scenery, know the local customs of various places, and you can talk about help, which is good for your health. He rarely gets sick because he walks a lot.立春前后，卖青萝卜。“棒打萝卜”，摔在地下就裂开了。杏子、桃子下来时卖鸡蛋大的香白杏，白得像一团雪，只嘴儿以下有一根红线的“一线红”蜜桃。再下来是樱桃，红的像珊瑚，白的像玛瑙。端午前后，枇杷。夏天卖瓜。七八月卖河鲜：鲜菱、鸡头、莲蓬、花下藕。卖马牙枣，卖葡萄。重阳近了，卖梨：河间府的鸭梨、莱阳的半斤酥，还有一种叫做“黄金坠子”的香气扑人个儿不大的甜梨。菊花开过了，卖金橘，卖蒂部起脐子的福州蜜橘。入冬以后，卖栗子、卖山药（粗如小儿臂）、卖百合（大如拳）、卖碧绿生鲜的檀香橄榄。
Before and after the beginning of spring, sell green radish. "Stick the radish" and crack when it falls to the ground. When apricots and peaches come down, they sell egg-sized fragrant white apricots, as white as a ball of snow, and a "line of red" peaches with a red line below their mouths. Then there are cherries, red like coral, white like agate. Before and after the Dragon Boat Festival, loquats. Sell melons in summer. Sell river fresh in July and August: fresh water chestnuts, chicken heads, lotus pods, and lotus roots. Sell horse tooth dates and grapes. The Double Ninth Festival is approaching, selling pears: duck pears in Hejian Prefecture, half a pound of crisps in Laiyang, and a sweet pear with a small aroma called "golden pendant". Chrysanthemums have bloomed, selling kumquats, and Fuzhou tangerines with navels. After winter, chestnuts, yam (as thick as a child's arm), lilies (as big as a fist), and green and fresh sandalwood olives are sold.他还卖佛手、香橼。人家买去，配架装盘，书斋清供，闻香观赏。
不少深居简出的人，是看到叶三送来的果子，才想起现在是什么节令了的。
He also sells bergamot and citron. People buy them, put them on a rack, and offer them in the study, smell the fragrance and enjoy it. Many people who live in seclusion remember what season it is now when they see the fruit sent by Ye San.叶三卖了三十多年果子，他的两个儿子都成人了。他们都是学布店的，都出了师了。老二是三柜，老大已经升为二柜了。谁都认为老大将来是会升为头柜，并且会当管事的。他天生是一块好材料。他是店里头一把算盘，年终结总时总得由他坐在账房里哔哔剥剥打好几天。接待厂家的客人，研究进货（进货是个大学问，是一年的大计，下年多进哪路货，少进哪路货，哪些必须常备，哪些可以试销，关系全年的盈亏），都少不了他。老二也很能干。量尺、撕布（撕布不用剪子开口，两手的两个指头夹着，借一点巧劲，嗤——的一声，布就撕到头了），干净利落。店伙的动作快慢，也是一个布店的招牌。顾客总愿意从手脚麻利的店伙手里买布。这是天分，也靠练习。有人就一辈子都是迟钝笨拙，改不过来。不管干哪一行，都是人比人，这是没有办法的事。弟兄俩都长得很神气，眉清目秀，不高不矮。布店的店伙穿得都很好。什么料子时新，他们就穿什么料子。他们的衣料当然是价廉物美的。他们买衣料是按进货价算的，不加利润；若是零头，还有折扣。这是布店的规矩，也是老板乐为之的。因为店伙穿得时髦，也是给店里装门面的事。有的顾客来买布，常常指着店伙的长衫或翻在外面的短衫的袖子：“照你这样的，给我来一件。”
Ye San has been selling fruit for more than 30 years, and his two sons are adults. They are all from the cloth shop and have all gone out of school. The second child is the third cabinet, and the eldest has been promoted to the second cabinet. Everyone thinks that the boss will be promoted to the head cabinet in the future and will be a steward. He is a good material by nature. He is the first abacus in the store, and at the end of the year, he always has to sit in the account room and beep for several days. He is indispensable for receiving customers from manufacturers and studying purchases (purchasing goods is a university question, it is a year's plan, which goods to buy more next year, which goods to buy less, which must be prepared, which can be tested and sold, and which are related to the profit and loss of the whole year). The second child is also very capable. Measuring tape and tearing cloth (tearing cloth does not need to be opened with scissors, two fingers of both hands are clamped, borrow a little skill, snort, and the cloth will be torn to the head), clean and neat. The fast and slow movements of the shopkeeper are also the signature of a cloth shop. Customers are always willing to buy cloth from the hands of the shopkeeper who is quick-witted. This is talent and practice. Some people are dull and clumsy all their lives and cannot be changed. No matter which line of work you do, you are better than others, and there is nothing you can do. Both brothers are very spirited, with clear eyebrows and handsome eyebrows, neither tall nor short. The shopkeepers in the cloth shop are all very well-dressed. They wear whatever material is new. Of course, their clothing is cheap and high-quality. They buy clothes based on the purchase price, without adding profit; If it is a fraction, there is a discount. This is the rule of the cloth shop, and it is also the boss who is happy to do it. Because the shopkeeper is dressed fashionably, it is also a matter of decorating the store. Some customers come to buy cloth, often pointing to the sleeves of the shopkeeper's long shirt or short shirt turned out: "If you are like this, give me one." ”弟兄俩都已经成了家，老大已经有一个孩子，——叶三抱孙子了。
这年是叶三五十岁整生日，一家子商量怎么给老爷子做寿。老大老二都提出爹不要走宅门卖果子了，他们养得起他。
叶三有点生气了：
Both brothers have become a family, and the eldest already has a child,—— Ye San has a grandson. This year is Ye San's fiftieth birthday, and the family discussed how to celebrate the old man's birthday. The eldest and second brothers both proposed that their father should not go to the house to sell fruit, and they could afford to support him. Ye San was a little angry:“嫌我给你们丢人？两位大布店的‘先生’，有一个卖果子的老爹，不好看？”
儿子连忙解释：
“不是的。你老人家岁数大了，老在外面跑，风里雨里，水路旱路，做儿子的心里不安。”
"Do you think I'm embarrassing for you? The two 'gentlemen' of the big cloth shop have a father who sells fruit, not good-looking? ” The son quickly explained: "No. Your old man is old, always running outside, in the wind and rain, on the dry road, and the heart of a son is uneasy. ”“我跑惯了。我给这些人家送惯了果子。就为了季四太爷一个人，我也得卖果子。”
季四太爷即季匋民。他大排行是老四，城里人都称之为四太爷。
"I'm used to running. I'm used to giving fruit to these people. Just for Mr. Ji Si alone, I also have to sell fruit. ” Ji Si Taiye is Ji Kuimin. He is the fourth oldest, and the people in the city call him the fourth grandfather.“你们也不用给我做什么寿。你们要是有孝心，把四太爷送我的画拿出去裱了，再给我打一口寿材。”这里有这样一种风俗，早早就把寿材准备下了，为的讨个吉利：添福添寿。于是就都依了他。
叶三还是卖果子。
"You don't have to give me any longevity. If you are filial, take out the painting given to me by the fourth grandfather and frame it, and give me a mouthful of longevity materials. "There is such a custom here that the longevity materials are prepared early in order to seek good luck: blessings and longevity. So they all followed him. Ye San still sells fruit.他真是为了季匋民一个人卖果子的。他给别人家送果子是为了挣钱，他给季匋民送果子是为了爱他的画。
He really sold fruit for Ji Kumin alone. He gave fruit to other people's families to make money, and he gave fruit to Ji Kuomin to love his paintings.季匋民有一个脾气，一边画画，一边喝酒。喝酒不就菜，就水果。画两笔，凑着壶嘴喝一大口酒，左手拈一片水果，右手执笔接着画。画一张画要喝二斤花雕，吃斤半水果。
Ji Kuomin has a temper, painting and drinking at the same time. Drinking is not about food, it's about fruit. Draw two strokes, take a big sip of wine with the spout of the pot, hold a piece of fruit in your left hand, and continue drawing with a pen in your right hand. To draw a painting, you need to drink two pounds of flower carvings and eat a pound and a half of fruit.叶三搜罗到最好的水果，总是首先给季匋民送去。
Ye San collected the best fruits and always sent them to Ji Kuimin first.季匋民每天一起来就走进他的小书房——画室。叶三不须通报，由一个小六角门进去，走过一条碎石铺成的冰花曲径，隔窗看见季匋民，就提着、捧着他的鲜果走进去。
“四太爷，枇杷，白沙的！”
Ji Kuomin came together every day and walked into his small study, the studio. Ye San didn't need to report, he entered through a small hexagonal door, walked through a gravel ice flower winding path, and saw Ji Kumin through the window, so he carried and held his fresh fruit in. "Fourth grandfather, loquat, white sand!"“四太爷，东墩的西瓜，三白！——这种三白瓜有点梨花香味，别处没有！”
"Fourth grandfather, the watermelon of Dongdun, three whites! ——This kind of three white melons have a bit of pear blossom fragrance, and there is no other place! ”他给季匋民送果子，一来就是半天。他给季匋民磨墨、漂朱膘、研石青石绿，抻纸。季匋民画的时候，他站在旁边很入神地看，专心致意，连大气都不出。有时看到精采处，就情不自禁的深深吸一口气，甚至小声地惊呼起来。凡是叶三吸气、惊呼的地方，也正是季匋民的得意之笔。季匋民从不当众作画，他画画有时是把书房门锁起来的。对叶三可例外，他很愿意有这样一个人在旁边看着，他认为叶三真懂，叶三的赞赏是出于肺腑，不是假充内行，也不是谀媚。
He gave Ji Kumin fruit, and it took half a day. He grinded ink, bleached vermilion, ground stone bluestone, and twisted paper. When Ji Kuimin painted, he stood next to him and looked at it very attentively, concentrating on it, and didn't even let out the atmosphere. Sometimes when I see the highlights, I can't help but take a deep breath, and even exclaim in a low voice. Wherever Ye San inhales and exclaims, it is also Ji Kuimin's proud brush. Ji Kuomin never paints in public, and he sometimes locks the door of his study when he paints. He thinks that Ye San really understands, Ye San's appreciation comes from the heart, not pretending to be an expert, nor flattering.季匋民最讨厌听人谈画。他很少到亲戚家应酬。实在不得不去的，他也是到一到，喝半盏茶就道别。因为席间必有一些假名士高谈阔论。因为季匋民是大画家，这些名士就特别爱在他面前评书论画，借以卖弄自己高雅博学。这种议论全都是道听途说，似通不通。季匋民听了，实在难受。他还知道，他如果随声答音，应付几句，某一名士就会在别的应酬场所重贩他的高论，且说：“兄弟此言，季匋民亦深为首肯。”
Ji Kuimin hates listening to people talk about paintings. He rarely goes to relatives' houses to socialize. He really had to go, and he also said goodbye after drinking half a cup of tea when he arrived. Because there must be some pseudo-celebrities talking about it during the banquet. Because Ji Kuimin is a great painter, these celebrities especially love to comment on books and paintings in front of him to show off their elegance and erudition. This kind of discussion is all hearsay and seems to make sense. Ji Kuimin was really uncomfortable when he heard it. He also knew that if he answered with the sound and responded to a few words, a certain scholar would resell his high theories in other entertainment venues, and said: "Brother, Ji Kuomin also deeply agreed. ”但是他对叶三另眼相看。
But he looked at Ye San differently.季匋民最佩服李复堂[2]。他认为扬州八怪里李复堂功力最深，大幅小品都好，有笔有墨，也奔放，也严谨，也浑厚，也秀润，而且不装模作样，没有江湖气。有一天叶三给他送来四开李复堂的册页，使季匋民大吃一惊：这四开册页是真的！季匋民问他是多少钱买的，叶三说没花钱。他到三垛贩果子，看见一家的橱柜的玻璃里镶了四幅画，——他在四太爷这里看过不少李复堂的画，能辨认，他用四张“苏州片”[3]跟那家换了。“苏州片”花花绿绿的，又是簇新的，那家还很高兴。
Ji Kuomin admired Li Futang the most[2]. He believes that Li Futang has the deepest skills among the Eight Monsters in Yangzhou, and the large sketches are good, with pen and ink, unrestrained, rigorous, thick, and beautiful, and not pretending, no jianghu atmosphere. One day, Ye San sent him four pages of Li Futang, which surprised Ji Futang: These four pages are real! Ji Kuimin asked him how much he bought it, and Ye San said that he didn't spend any money. He went to the three stacks to sell fruit and saw four paintings inlaid in the glass of a cabinet,—— he had seen a lot of Li Futang's paintings from the fourth grandfather, and he could recognize it, and he exchanged four "Suzhou pieces" [3] with that one. The "Suzhou film" is colorful and new, and the family is still very happy.叶三只是从心里喜欢画，他从不瞎评论。季匋民画完了画，钉在壁上，自己负手远看，有时会问叶三：
“好不好？”
“好！”
“好在哪里？”
叶三大都能一句话说出好在何处。
Ye San just likes to paint from the bottom of his heart, and he never comments blindly. After Ji Kuomin finished painting, he nailed it to the wall, looked at it from a distance, and sometimes asked Ye San: "Is it okay?" "Okay!" "What's good?" Ye San can tell what is good in one sentence.季匋民画了一幅紫藤，问叶三。
叶三说：“紫藤里有风。”
“唔！你怎么知道？”
“花是乱的。”
“对极了！”
季匋民提笔题了两句词：
“深院悄无人，风拂紫藤花乱。”
Ji Kuomin drew a wisteria and asked Ye San. Ye San said: "There is wind in the wisteria. ” "Hmm! How do you know? ” "Flowers are messy." "That's right!" Ji Kuomin wrote two sentences: "The deep courtyard is quiet and uninhabited, and the wind blows the wisteria flowers."季匋民画了一张小品，老鼠上灯台。叶三说：“这是一只小老鼠。”
“何以见得。”
“老鼠把尾巴卷在灯台柱上。它很顽皮。”
“对！”
Ji Kuomin drew a sketch of a mouse on the lampstand. Ye San said: "This is a little mouse." ” "How can I see it?" "The mouse curled its tail on the lampstand post. It was naughty. ” "Yes!"季匋民最爱画荷花。他画的都是墨荷。他佩服李复堂，但是画风和复堂不似。李画多凝重，季匋民飘逸。李画多用中锋，季匋民微用侧笔，——他写字写的是章草。李复堂有时水墨淋漓，粗头乱眼，意在笔先；季匋民没有那样的恣悍，他的画是大写意，但总是笔意俱到，收拾得很干净，而且笔致疏朗，善于利用空白。他的墨荷参用了张大千，但更为舒展。他画的荷叶不勾筋，荷梗不点刺，且喜作长幅，荷梗甚长，一笔到底。
Ji Kuomin loves to paint lotus flowers. He paints ink lotus. He admires Li Futang, but his painting style is not similar to Futang. Li painting is more dignified, and Ji Kuomin is elegant. Li Huimin mostly uses the center, Ji Kuimin uses a side pen,—— he writes in zhangcao. Li Futang sometimes has dripping ink, thick heads and eyes, and the intention is to write first; Ji Kuimin is not so arrogant, his paintings are freehand, but they are always well-thought-out, clean, and the brushwork is sparse, and he is good at using blanks. His ink lotus refers to Zhang Daqian, but it is more stretched. The lotus leaves he paints do not hook the tendons, the lotus stems do not thorn, and he likes to make long paintings, with long lotus stems, and he is good at using blank spaces.有一天，叶三送了一大把莲蓬来，季匋民一高兴，画了一幅墨荷，好些莲蓬。画完了，问叶三：“如何？”
叶三说：“四太爷，你这画不对。”
“不对？”
One day, Ye San sent a large handful of lotus pods, and Ji Kuomin was so happy that he painted a picture of ink lotus and lotus pods. After painting, he asked Ye San: "How?" ” Ye San said: "Fourth Master, your painting is not right." ” "Isn't it?"“‘红花莲子白花藕’。你画的是白荷花，莲蓬却这样大，莲子饱，墨色也深，这是红荷花的莲子。”
“是吗？我头一回听见！”
季匋民于是展开一张八尺生宣，画了一张红莲花，题了一首诗：
"'Red lotus seed white lotus'. You are painting a white lotus, but the lotus pod is so big, the lotus seeds are full, and the ink is dark, this is the lotus seeds of the red lotus. ” "Really? This is the first time I've heard it! ” Ji Kuomin then unfolded an eight-foot proclamation, drew a red lotus, and inscribed a poem:“红花莲子白花藕，
“红花莲子白花藕，果贩叶三是我师。
果贩叶三是我师。惭愧画家少见识，
惭愧画家少见识，为君破例著胭脂。”
为君破例著胭脂。 ”季匋民送了叶三很多画。——有时季匋民画了一张画，不满意，团掉了。叶三捡起来，过些日子送给季匋民看看，季匋民觉得也还不错，就略改改，加了题，又送给了叶三。季匋民送给叶三的画都是题了上款的。叶三也有个学名。他五行缺水，起名润生。季匋民给他起了个字，叫泽之。送给叶三的画上，常题“泽之三兄雅正”。有时径题“画与叶三”。季匋民还向他解释：以排行称呼，是古人风气，不是看不起他。
Ji Kuomin gave Ye San a lot of paintings. ——Sometimes Ji Kuomin painted a painting, was not satisfied, and the group fell. Ye San picked it up and gave it to Ji Kuomin to see it in a few days, Ji Kuomin thought it was not bad, so he changed it slightly, added a title, and gave it to Ye San. The paintings that Ji Kuimin gave to Ye San were all inscribed with the above paragraph. Ye San also has a scientific name. He lacked water in the five elements and was named Runsheng. Ji Kuimin gave him a word, called Zezhi. The painting given to Ye San is often inscribed "Zezhi Third Brother Yazheng". Sometimes the title is "Painting and Ye San". Ji Kuomin also explained to him: Calling him by ranking is the custom of the ancients, not looking down on him.有时季匋民给叶三画了画，说：“这张不题上款吧，你可以拿去卖钱，——有上款不好卖。”
叶三说：“题不题上款都行。不过您的画我不卖。”
“不卖？”
“一张也不卖！”
Sometimes Ji Kuomin drew a picture for Ye San and said, "This one is not inscribed, you can use it to sell for money,—— it is not easy to sell if there is a payment." ” Ye San said: "It's okay to write or not. But I won't sell your paintings." ” "Don't sell?" "Don't sell a single one!"他把季匋民送他的画都放在他的棺材里。
十多年过去了。
季匋民死了。叶三已经不卖果子，但是他四季八节，还四处寻觅鲜果，到季匋民坟上供一供。
He put all the paintings Ji Kuomin gave him in his coffin. More than ten years have passed. Ji Kuimin died. Ye San no longer sells fruit, but he still looks for fresh fruit in all seasons and eight festivals, and goes to Ji Kuimin's grave to make a offering.季匋民死后，他的画价大增。日本有人专门收藏他的画。大家知道叶三手里有很多季匋民的画，都是精品。很多人想买叶三的藏画。叶三说：
“不卖。”
有一天有一个外地人来拜望叶三，叶三看了他的名片，这人的姓很奇怪，姓“辻”，叫“辻听涛”。一问，是日本人。辻听涛说他是专程来看他收藏的季匋民的画的。
One day, a foreigner came to visit Ye San, Ye San looked at his business card, this person's surname was very strange, his surname was "Tsuji", his name was "Tsuji Tingtao". When asked, it was Japanese. Tsuji heard Tao say that he made a special trip to see his collection of Ji Kuimin's paintings.因为是远道来的，叶三只得把画拿出来。辻听涛非常虔诚，要了清水洗了手，焚了一炷香，还先对画轴拜了三拜，然后才展开。他一边看，一边不停地赞叹：
“喔！喔！真好！真是神品！”
Because he came from afar, Ye San had to take out the painting. Tsuji Tingtao was very religious, asked for water to wash his hands, burned a stick of incense, and bowed three times to the scroll before unfolding. As he watched, he kept praising: "Oh! Oh! That's nice! What a divine product! ”辻听涛要买这些画，要多少钱都行。
叶三说：
“不卖。”
辻听涛只好怅然而去。
叶三死了。他的儿子遵照父亲的遗嘱，把季匋民的画和父亲一起装在棺材里，埋了。
一九八二年二月二十八日
Tsuji Tingtao wants to buy these paintings, no matter how much he wants. Ye San said: "Not for sale." Tsuji listened to Tao and had no choice but to leave. Ye San died. His son followed his father's will and put Ji Kumin's painting in a coffin with his father and buried it. February 28, 1982
