[2] Li Futang, named , the character Zongyang, Futang is his number, also known as the Taoist priest. He was a scholar during the Kangxi period, and he was the magistrate of Teng County, but because he offended his superiors, his fame and official were dismissed, and he only worked as a painter all year round. He sometimes had to borrow paper from Zheng Banqiao to paint, and he was probably quite poor. He is a painter and a court painter Jiang Tingxi. Later, he went to Yangzhou, changed his painting freehand, and his teacher was highly respected, influenced by Xu Qingteng, Bada, and Shi Tao, his demeanor changed greatly, and he became a family of his own.[3] 仿旧的画，多为工笔花鸟，设色娇艳，旧时多为苏州画工所作，行销各地，故称“苏州片”。苏州片也有仿制得很好的，并不俗气。

王四海的黄昏

王四海的黄昏[1]
[3] The distressed paintings are mostly gongbi flowers and birds, with delicate colors, and in the old days, they were mostly made by Suzhou painters and sold all over the world, so they were called "Suzhou films". Suzhou films are also well imitated and not tacky. Wang Sihai's Twilight[1]北门外有一条承志河。承志河上有一道承志桥，是南北的通道，每天往来行人很多。这是座木桥，相当的宽。这桥的特别处是上面有个顶子，不方不圆而长，形状有点像一个船篷。桥两边有栏杆，栏杆下有宽可一尺的长板，就形成两排靠背椅。夏天，常有人坐在上面歇脚、吃瓜；下雨天，躲雨。人们很喜欢这座桥。
There is a Chengzhi River outside the north gate. There is a Chengzhi Bridge on the Chengzhi River, which is a north-south passage, and there are many pedestrians coming and going every day. This is a wooden bridge, quite wide. The special thing about this bridge is that there is a top on it, which is neither square nor round but long, and the shape is a bit like a canopy. There are railings on both sides of the bridge, and there are long boards about a foot wide under the railing, forming two rows of back chairs. In summer, people often sit on it to rest and eat melons; on rainy days, take shelter from the rain. People like this bridge very much.桥南是一片旷地。据说早先这里是有人家的，后来一把火烧得精光，就再也没有人来盖房子。这不知是哪一年的事了。现在只是一片平地，有一点像一个校场。这就成了放风筝、踢毽子的好地方。小学生放了学，常到这里来踢皮球。把几个书包往两边一放，这就是球门。奔跑叫喊了一气，滚得一身都是土。不知是谁喊了一声：“回家吃饭啰！”于是提着书包，紧紧裤子，一窝蜂散去。
The south of the bridge is an open land. It is said that there were houses here earlier, but later a fire burned out, and no one came to build a house again. I don't know what year it was. Now it's just a flat land, a bit like a school field. This has become a good place to fly kites and kick shuttlecocks. After school, elementary school students often come here to play ball. Put a few schoolbags on both sides, and this is the goal. ran and shouted, rolling all over the ground. I don't know who shouted: "Go home for dinner!" So he carried his schoolbag, tightened his pants, and dispersed in a swarm.这又是各种卖艺人作场的地方。耍猴的。猴能爬旗杆，还能串戏——自己打开箱子盖，自己戴帽子，戴胡子。最好看的是猴子戴了“鬼脸”——面具，穿一件红袄，帽子上还有两根野鸡毛，骑羊。老绵羊围着场子飞跑，颈项里挂了一串铜铃，哗稜稜稜地响。耍木头人戏的，老是那一出：《王香打虎》。王香的父亲上山砍柴，被老虎吃了。王香赶去，把老虎打死，从老虎的肚子里把父亲拉出来。父亲活了。父子两人抱在一起——完了。王香知道父亲被老虎吃了，感情很激动。那表达的方式却颇为特别：把一个木头脑袋在“台”口的栏杆上磕碰，碰得笃笃地响，“嘴”里“呜丢丢，呜丢丢”地哭诉着。这大概是所谓“呼天抢地”吧。围看的大人和小孩也不知看了多少次《王香打虎》了（王香已经打了八百年的老虎了，——从宋朝算起），但当看到王香那样激烈地磕碰木头脑袋，还是会很有兴趣地哄笑起来。耍把戏。……——！铜锣声切住。“在家靠父母，出外靠朋友。有钱的帮个钱场子，没钱的帮着人场子。”——“小把戏！玩几套？”——“玩三套！”于是一个瘦骨伶仃的孩子，脱光了上衣（耍把戏多是冬天），两手握着一根小棍，把两臂从后面撅——撅——撅，直到有人“哗叉哗叉”——投出铜钱，这才撅过来。一到要表演“大卸八块”了，有的妇女就急忙丢下几个钱，神色紧张地掉头走了。有时，腊月送灶以后，旷场上立起两根三丈长的杉篙，当中又横搭一根，人们就知道这是来了耍“大把戏”的，大年初一，要表演“三上吊”了。所谓“三上吊”，是把一个女孩的头发（长发，原来梳着辫子），用烧酒打湿，在头顶心攥紧，系得实实的；头发挽扣，一根长绳，掏进发扣，用滑车拉上去，这女孩就吊在半空中了。下面的大人，把这女孩来回推晃，女孩子就在半空中悠动起来。除了做寒鸭凫水、童子拜观音等等动作外，还要做脱裤子、穿裤子的动作。这女孩子穿了八条裤子，在空中把七条裤子一条一条脱下，又一条一条穿上。这女孩子悠过来，悠过去，就是她那一把头发拴在绳子上……
This is also a place where all kinds of artists work. Monkey. Monkeys can climb flagpoles and play - open the lid of the box by themselves, wear a hat and a beard. The best thing to see is that the monkey wears a "grimace" - a mask, wears a red jacket, and has two pheasant feathers on the hat, riding a sheep. The old sheep flew around the field, with a string of bronze bells hanging around their necks, ringing loudly. The wooden man play is always the one: "Wang Xiang Fights the Tiger". Wang Xiang's father went up the mountain to chop wood and was eaten by a tiger. Wang Xiang rushed over, beat the tiger to death, and pulled his father out of the tiger's belly. The father is alive. The father and son hugged each other - it's over. Wang Xiang knew that his father was eaten by a tiger, and he was very excited. The way of expression is quite special: bumping a wooden head on the railing at the entrance of the "stage", making a bang, crying in the "mouth". This is probably the so-called "crying out to the sky and grabbing the earth". The adults and children watching don't know how many times they have watched "Wang Xiang Fights the Tiger" (Wang Xiang has been fighting tigers for 800 years,—— counting from the Song Dynasty), but when they see Wang Xiang bumping on the wooden head so violently, they will still laugh with great interest. Tricks.    ……   ——！ The sound of the gong cuts. "Rely on your parents at home and rely on your friends when you go out. Those who have money help the money, and those who don't have money help others." ——"Little tricks! How many sets to play?" ——"Play three sets!" So a skinny child, stripped off his shirt (most of the tricks were played in winter), held a small stick in both hands, and pouted his arms from behind, until someone "pouted" - threw out copper coins, and then pouted. When it was time to perform "unloading eight yuan", some women hurriedly dropped a few coins and turned around and left nervously. Sometimes, after the stove is sent in the twelfth lunar month, two three-foot-long fir poles are erected in the open field, and one is placed horizontally in the middle, and people know that this is a "big trick", and on the first day of the Lunar New Year, it is going to perform "three hangings". The so-called "three hangings" is to wet a girl's hair (long hair, originally braided), squeeze it tightly on the top of her head, and tie it tightly; the hair is buttoned, a long rope, pulled into the hair buckle, pulled up with a pulley, and the girl is hanging in mid-air. The adults below pushed the girl back and forth, and the girl moved leisurely in mid-air. In addition to doing actions such as cold ducks and duck water, and children worshiping Guanyin, they also had to take off their pants and put them on. The girl wore eight pairs of pants, took off the seven pants one by one in the air, and put them on one by one. The girl came over, and it was her hair tied to the rope......到了有卖艺人作场，承志桥南的旷场周围就来了许多卖吃食的。卖烂藕的，卖煮荸荠的，卖牛肉高粱酒，卖回卤豆腐干，卖豆腐脑的，吆吆喝喝，异常热闹。还有卖梨膏糖的。梨膏糖是糖稀、白砂糖，加一点从药店里买来的梨膏熬制成的，有一点梨香。一块有半个火柴盒大，一分厚，一块一块在一方木板上摆列着。卖梨膏糖的总有个四脚交叉的架子，上铺木板，还装饰着一些绒球、干电池小灯泡。卖梨膏糖全凭唱。他有那么一个六角形的小手风琴。本地人不识手风琴，管那玩意叫“呜哩哇”，因为这东西只能发出这样三个声音。卖梨膏糖的把木架支好，就拉起“呜哩哇”唱起来：
When there were artists selling the field, there were many people selling food around the open field south of Chengzhi Bridge. Those who sell rotten lotus root, boiled water chestnuts, beef and sorghum wine, braised dried tofu, and tofu brains are shouting and drinking, which is extremely lively. There are also those who sell pear paste candy. Pear paste candy is made of thin sugar and white sugar, with a little pear paste bought from a pharmacy, which has a little pear aroma. One piece is the size of half a matchbox, one point thick, and is arranged one by one on a wooden board. The pear paste candy seller always has a four-legged shelf with wooden boards on top, and is decorated with some pompoms and small light bulbs with dry batteries. Selling pear paste candy is all about singing. He has such a small hexagonal accordion. The locals don't know the accordion, so they call it "woo wow", because this thing can only make such three sounds. The pear candy seller set up the wooden frame and pulled up the "woo wow" and sang:“太阳出来一点（呐）红，
秦琼卖马下山（的）东。
秦琼卖了他的黄骠（的）马啊，
五湖四海就访（啦）宾（的）朋！”
“呜哩呜哩哇，
呜哩呜哩哇……”
"The sun comes out a little red, Qin Qiong sold his horse down the mountain (of) the east. Qin Qiong sold his yellow horse, Visit guests from all over the world! ” "Whoa, whoa, Whoa......这些玩艺，年复一年，都是那一套，大家不免有点看厌了，虽则到时还会哄然大笑，会神色紧张。终于有一天，来了王四海。
有人跟卖梨膏糖的说：
“嗨，卖梨膏糖的，你的嘴还真灵，你把王四海给唱来了！”
These tricks, year after year, are all the same, everyone can't help but get a little tired of it, although they will laugh and look nervous. Finally one day, Wang Sihai came. Someone said to the pear paste candy seller: "Hi, the pear paste candy seller, your mouth is really smart, you sang Wang Sihai!"“我？”
“你不是唱‘五湖四海访宾朋’吗？王四海来啦！”
“王四海？”
卖梨膏糖的不知王四海是何许人。
"Me?" "Didn't you sing 'Visiting Guests and Friends from All Over the World'? Wang Sihai is here! ” "Wang Sihai?" I don't know who Wang Sihai is who sells pear paste.王四海一行人下了船，走在大街上，就引起城里人的注意。一共七个人。走在前面的是一个小小子，一个小姑娘，一个瘦小但很精神的年轻人，一个四十开外的彪形大汉。他们都是短打扮，但是衣服的式样、颜色都很时髦。他们各自背着行李，提着皮箱。皮箱上贴满了轮船、汽车和旅馆的圆形的或椭圆形的标记。虽然是走了长路，但并不显得风尘仆仆。脚步矫健，气色很好。后面是王四海。他戴了一顶兔灰色的呢帽，穿了一件酱紫色烤花呢的大衣，——虽然大衣已经旧了，可能是在哪个大城市的拍卖行里买来的。他空着手，什么也不拿。他一边走，一边时时抱拳向路旁伫看的人们致意。后面两个看来是伙计，穿着就和一般耍把戏的差不多了。他们一个挑着一对木箱，一个扛着一捆兵器，——枪尖刀刃都用布套套着，一只手里牵着一头水牛。他们走进了五湖居客栈。
Wang Sihai and his party got off the boat and walked on the street, attracting the attention of the city. There were seven people in total. Walking in front was a little boy, a little girl, a thin but energetic young man, and a burly man in his forties. They were all dressed short, but the styles and colors of their clothes were very fashionable. They each carried their luggage and suitcases. The suitcases were covered with round or oval markings of ships, cars and hotels. Although it was a long walk, it did not look dusty. His steps were vigorous and his complexion was good. Behind him was Wang Sihai. He wore a rabbit-gray woolen hat and a sauce-purple tweed coat,—— although the coat was old, it might have been bought at an auction house in some big city. He was empty-handed and took nothing. As he walked, he clenched his fists and greeted the people watching on the side of the road. The last two seemed to be guys, dressed almost like ordinary tricks. One of them carried a pair of wooden boxes, the other carried a bundle of weapons,—— the tip of the gun was covered with a cloth sheath, and one hand held a buffalo. They walked into the Wuhuju Inn.卖艺的住客栈，少有。——一般耍把戏卖艺的都是住庙，有的就住在船上。有人议论：“五湖四海，这倒真应了典了。”
There are very few inns that sell art. ——Generally, those who play tricks live in temples, and some live on boats. Some people discussed: "All over the world, this is really a classic." ”这地方把住人的旅店分为两大类：房间“高尚”，设备新颖，软缎被窝，雪白毛巾，带点洋气的，叫旅馆，门外的招牌上则写作“××旅社”；较小的仍保留古老的习惯，叫客栈，甚至更古老一点，还有称之为“下处”的。客栈的格局大都是这样：两进房屋，当中有个天井，有十来个房间。砖墙、矮窗。不知什么道理，客栈的房间哪一间都见不着太阳。一进了客栈，除了觉得空气潮湿，还闻到一股长期造成的洗脸水和小便的气味。这种气味一下子就抓住了旅客，使他们觉得非常亲切。对！这就是他们住惯了的那种客栈！他们就好像到了家了。客栈房金低廉，若是长住，还可打个八折、七折。住客栈的大都是办货收账的行商、细批流年的命相家、卖字画的、看风水的、走方郎中、草台班子“重金礼聘”的名角、寻亲不遇的落魄才子……一到晚上，客栈门口就挂出一个很大的灯笼。灯笼两侧贴着扁宋体的红字，一侧写道：“招商客栈”，一侧是“近悦远来”。
This place divides the inns into two categories: the rooms are "noble", the equipment is novel, the soft satin quilts, the snow-white towels, the ones with a bit of foreign style, are called hotels, and the sign outside the door reads "×× Hotel"; the smaller ones still retain the old habits, called inns, or even more ancient, and there are also called "lower places". The layout of inns is mostly like this: two houses, a patio in the middle, and more than a dozen rooms. Brick walls and low windows. For some reason, none of the rooms in the inn could see the sun. As soon as I entered the inn, in addition to feeling that the air was humid, I also smelled the smell of long-term washing water and urine. This smell immediately caught the passengers and made them feel very kind. Right! This is the kind of inn they are used to staying in! They feel like they have arrived at home. The inn is cheap, and if you stay for a long time, you can get an 80% or 70% discount. Most of the inns are merchants who handle goods and collect accounts, fortune tellers who carefully criticize the passing years, those who sell calligraphy and paintings, those who read feng shui, the doctors who go to the square, the famous characters of the grass platform team who "pay a lot of money", and the down-and-out talents who are looking for relatives...... At night, a large lantern is hung at the door of the inn. The spring water of the Chengzhi River has risen, the willow branches have turned green, and before you know it, Wang Sihai has been here for almost two months. The flowers are not red for a hundred days, and the climax of Wang Sihai's performance has passed. The number of spectators is gradually decreasing. Many people in the city have seen "Lisheng Buffalo" seven or eight times, and the countrymen have seen it once and don't want to watch it again,—— they feel sorry for the cow.这天晚上，老大（彪形大汉）、老六（精干青年）找老四（王四海）说“事”。他们劝老四见好就收。他们走了那么多码头，都是十天半拉月，顶多一个“号头”（一个月，这是上海话），像这样连演四十多场（刨去下雨下雪），还没有过。葱烧海参，也不能天天吃。就是海京伯来了，也不能连满仨月。要是“瞎”在这儿，败了名声，下个码头都不好走。
That night, the eldest (burly man) and the sixth (capable young man) went to the fourth (Wang Sihai) to talk about "things". They advised the fourth child to accept it when he saw it. They have walked so many docks, all of which are ten and a half days and a month, at most one "trumpet" (a month, this is Shanghainese), and they have performed more than forty times like this (planing to rain and snow), but they have not yet passed. Roasted sea cucumbers with green onions cannot be eaten every day. Even if Haijingbo comes, he can't stay for three months. If you are "blind" here and lose your reputation, it will not be easy to go to the next pier.王四海不说话。
他们知道四海为什么留恋这个屁帘子大的小城市，就干脆把话挑明了。
Wang Sihai didn't speak. They knew why the whole world was nostalgic for this small city with a big fart curtain, so they simply made it clear.“俺们走江湖卖艺的，最怕在娘们身上栽了跟头。寻欢作乐，露水夫妻，那不碍。过去，哥没问过你。你三十往外了，还没成家，不能老叫花猫吃豆腐。可是这种事，认不得真，着不得迷。你这回，是认了真，着了迷了！你打算怎么着？难道真要在这儿当个吕布？你正是好时候，功夫、卖相，都在那儿摆着。有多少白花花的大洋钱等着你去挣。你可别把一片锦绣前程自己白白地葬送了！俺们老王家，可就指望着你啦！”
"We who go to the rivers and lakes to perform their tricks, and we are most afraid of planting somersaults on our daughters. Seeking pleasure, dew couples, that's not a problem. In the past, my brother never asked you. You are thirty years old, and you haven't started a family yet, so you can't always ask the cat to eat tofu. But this kind of thing is not true, and you can't be fascinated. This time, you are serious and fascinated! What are you going to do? Do you really want to be a Lu Bu here? You are in a good time, kung fu and appearance, are all there. How many white flowers are waiting for you to earn. Don't bury a splendid future in vain! Our old Wang family is counting on you! ”“好事不出门，坏事传千里，没有不透风的墙。你听到这儿人的闲言碎语了么？别看这小地方的人，不是好欺的。墙里开花墙外香，他们不服这口气。要是叫人家堵住了，敲一笔竹杠是小事；绳捆索绑，押送出境，可就现了大眼了。一世英名，付之流水。四哥，听兄弟一句话，走吧！”
"Good things don't go out, bad things spread thousands of miles, and there is no impermeable wall. Did you hear the gossip of the people here? Don't look at the people in this small place, it's not easy to bully. Flowers bloom inside the wall and fragrance outside the wall, and they don't accept this breath. If you block it, knocking on a bamboo pole is a trivial matter; tie it with a rope and escort it out of the country, but you will have big eyes. A lifetime of fame will be wasted. Fourth brother, listen to your brother's words, let's go! ”王四海还是不说话。
“你说话，说一句话呀！”
王四海说：“再续半个月，再说。”
老大、老六摇头。
Wang Sihai still didn't speak. "You speak, say a word!" Wang Sihai said: "Continue for another half month, and let's talk about it." ” The eldest and the sixth shook their heads.王四海的武术班子真是走了下坡路了，一天不如一天。老大、老六、侄儿、侄女都不卖力气。就是两个伙计敲打的锣鼓，也是没精打采的。王四海怪不得他们，只有自己格外“卯上”。山膀拉得更足，小翻多翻了三个，“嗨咿”一声也喊得更为威武。就是这样，也还是没有多少人叫好。
Wang Sihai's martial arts team has really gone downhill, and it is not as good as day by day. The eldest brother, the sixth child, the nephew, and the niece are not working hard. Even the gongs and drums beaten by the two guys are listless. Wang Sihai can't blame them, only he is extra "up". The mountain arms were pulled more tightly, the small flip was turned over three more, and the "hi" shouted more powerfully. That's it, and there are still not many people applauding.这一天，王四海和老牛摔了几个回合，到最后由牛的身后蹿出，扳住牛角，大喝一声，牛竟没有倒。
On this day, Wang Sihai and the old cow wrestled for a few rounds, and finally jumped out from behind the cow, grabbed the cow's horns, and shouted, but the cow did not fall.观众议论起来。有人说王四海的力气不行了，有人说他的力气已经用在别处了。这两人就对了对眼光，哈哈一笑。有人说：“不然，这是故意卖关子。王四海今天准有更精采的表演。——瞧！”
The audience started talking. Some people say that Wang Sihai's strength is no longer good, and some people say that his strength has been used elsewhere. The two looked at each other and laughed. Someone said: "Otherwise, this is deliberately selling guanzi." Wang Sihai must have a more exciting performance today. ——Look! ”王四海有点沉不住气，寻思：这牛今天是怎么了？一面又绕场一周，运气，准备再摔。不料，在他绕场、运气的时候，还没有接近老牛，离牛还有八丈远，这牛“吭腾”一声，自己倒了！
Wang Sihai couldn't hold his breath and thought: What happened to this cow today? On the other hand, he circled the field again, lucky, ready to fall again. Unexpectedly, when he went around the field and luck, he had not yet approached the old cow, and he was still eight feet away from the cow.观众哗然，他们大笑起来。他们明白了：“力胜牯牛”原来是假的。这牛是驯好了的。每回它都是自己倒下，王四海不过是在那里装腔作势做做样子。这回不知怎么出了岔子，露了馅了。也许是这牛犯了牛脾气，再不就是它老了，反应迟钝了……大家一哄而散。
The audience was in an uproar and they burst into laughter. They understood: "Strength over the yak" turned out to be fake. This cow is tamed. Every time it fell by itself, Wang Sihai was just pretending to be there. This time something went wrong and the filling was revealed. Maybe the cow had a bad temper, or it was old and slow to react...... Everyone dispersed.王家班开了一个全体会议，连侄儿、侄女都参加。一致决议：走！明天就走！
王四海说，他不走。
Wang Jiaban held a plenary meeting, and even his nephews and nieces participated. Unanimous resolution: Let's go! Let's go tomorrow! Wang Sihai said that he would not leave.“还不走？！你真是害了花疯啦！那好，将军不下马，各自奔前程。你不走，俺们走，可别怪自己弟兄不义气！栽到这份上，还有脸再在这城里呆下去吗？”
"Don't leave yet?! You're really crazy! Well, the general doesn't dismount and goes his own way. If you don't leave, we will go, don't blame your brothers for being unrighteous! If you are planted in this, do you still have the face to stay in this city again? ”王四海觉得对不起叔伯兄弟，他什么也不要，只留下一对护手钩，其余的，什么都叫他们带走。他们走了，连那条老牛也牵走了。王四海把他们送到码头上。
Wang Sihai felt sorry for his uncle and brother, he didn't want anything, only a pair of handguards, and the rest, they were asked to take everything away. They left, and even the old cow was taken away. Wang Sihai sent them to the dock.老大说：“四兄弟，我们这就分手了。到了那儿，给你来信。你要是还想回来，啥时候都行。”
王四海点点头。
The boss said: "Four brothers, we will break up. When we get there, I will write to you. If you still want to come back, you can do it anytime." ” Wang Sihai nodded. The sixth said: "Fourth brother, take care." ——Be careful! ” Wang Sihai nodded.老六说：“四哥，多保重。——小心着点！”
王四海点点头。
The boss said: "Four brothers, we will break up. When we get there, I will write to you. If you still want to come back, you can do it anytime." ” Wang Sihai nodded. The sixth said: "Fourth brother, take care." ——Be careful! ” Wang Sihai nodded.侄儿侄女给王四海行了礼，说：“四叔，俺们走了！”说着，这两个孩子的眼泪就下来了。王四海的心里也是酸酸的。
王四海一个人留下来，卖膏药。
The nephew and niece saluted Wang Sihai and said, "Fourth uncle, we are leaving!" As he spoke, the tears of the two children fell. Wang Sihai's heart was also sour. Wang Sihai stayed alone and sold plasters.他到德寿堂找了管事苏先生。苏先生以为他又要来赊膏药黐子，问他这回要多少。王四海说：
“苏先生，我来求恁一件事。”
“什么事？”
“能不能给我几个膏药的方子？”
He went to Deshou Hall to find Mr. Su, the steward. Mr. Su thought he was going to come to the plaster on credit again, so he asked him how much he wanted this time. Wang Sihai said: "Mr. Su, I'm here to ask you for something." "What's the matter?" "Can you give me a few plaster recipes?"“膏药方子？你以前卖的膏药都放了什么药？”
“什么也没有，就是恁这儿的膏药黐子。”
“那怎么摊出来乌黑雪亮的？”
“掺了点松香。”
“那你还卖那种膏药不行吗？”
"Plaster prescription? What kind of medicine did you put in the plasters you sold before? ” "Nothing, it's just your plaster here." "Then how did you spread out the black and snowy?" "Mixed with some rosin." "Then can't you still sell that kind of plaster?"“苏先生！要是过路卖艺，日子短，卖点假膏药，不要紧。这治不了病，可也送不了命。等买的主发现膏药不灵，我已经走了，他也找不到我。我想在贵宝地长住下去，不能老这么骗人。往后我就指着这吃饭，得卖点真东西。”
"Mr. Su! If you are passing by and your days are short, it doesn't matter if you sell some fake plasters. This can't cure the disease, but it can't save your life. When the buyer finds that the plaster is not working, I have already left, and he can't find me. I want to live in the precious land for a long time, and I can't keep deceiving people like this. From now on, I will point to this place to eat, and I have to sell some real things. ”苏先生觉得这是几句有良心的话，说得也很恳切；德寿堂是个大药店，不靠卖膏药赚钱，就答应了。
Mr. Su felt that these were a few words of conscience, and he said it very sincerely; Deshou Tang is a big pharmacy, and he didn't make money by selling plasters, so he agreed.苏先生还把王四海的这番话传了出去，大家都知道王四海如今卖的是真膏药。大家还议论，这个走江湖的人品不错。王四海膏药店的生意颇为不恶。
Mr. Su also spread Wang Sihai's words, and everyone knows that Wang Sihai is now selling real plasters. Everyone also talks about the good character of this person who goes to the rivers and lakes. The business of Wang Sihai's plaster shop is quite good.不久，五湖居害痨病的掌柜死了，王四海就和貂蝉名正言顺地在一起过了。
他不愿人议论他是贪图五湖居的产业而要了貂蝉的，五湖居的店务他一概不问。他还是开他的膏药店。
Soon, the shopkeeper of Wuhu Ju died, and Wang Sihai and Diao Chan lived together justifiably. He didn't want anyone to talk about him because he wanted Diao Chan for the property of Wuhuju, and he didn't care about the store affairs of Wuhuju. He still opened his plaster shop.光阴荏苒，眨眼的工夫，几年过去了。貂蝉生了个白胖小子，已经满地里跑了。
Time flies, and in the blink of an eye, a few years have passed. Diao Chan gave birth to a white fat boy and had already run all over the ground.王四海穿起了长衫，戴了罗宋帽，看起来和一般生意人差不多，除了他走路抓地（练武的人走路都是这个走法，脚趾头抓着地），已经不像个打把势卖艺的了。他的语声也变了。腔调还是山东腔，所用的字眼很多却是地道的本地话。头顶有点秃，而且发胖了。
Wang Sihai wore a long shirt and a borscht hat, looking similar to an ordinary businessman, except that he walked and grabbed the ground (people who practice martial arts walk in this way, and grab the ground with their toes), he no longer looks like a showman. His tone has also changed. The tone is still Shandong, and many of the words used are authentic local dialects. The top of his head is a little bald and fat.他还保留一点练过武艺人的习惯，每天清早黄昏要出去蹓蹓弯，在承志桥上坐坐，看看来往行人。
He also retained a little habit of practicing martial arts, and every morning and dusk he would go out to stroll around, sit on the Chengzhi Bridge, and watch the pedestrians passing by.这天他收到老大、老六的信，看完了，放在信插子里，依旧去蹓弯。他坐在承志桥的靠背椅上，听见远处有什么地方在吹奏“得胜令”，他忽然想起大世界、民众乐园，想起霓虹灯、马戏团的音乐。他好像有点惆怅。他很想把那对护手钩取来耍一会。不大一会，连这点意兴也消失了。
On this day, he received letters from the eldest and the sixth, and after reading them, he put them in the letter insert and still went to the bend. He sat on the back chair of the Chengzhi Bridge, and heard something playing "Victory Order" in the distance, and he suddenly thought of the big world, the people's paradise, the neon lights, and the music of the circus. He seemed a little melancholic. He really wanted to take the pair of handguards and play with them for a while. After a while, even this interest disappeared.王四海站起来，沿着承志河，漫无目的地走着。夕阳把他的影子拉得很长。

Wang Sihai stood up and walked aimlessly along the Chengzhi River. The setting sun stretched his shadow very long. [1] This article was originally published in the second issue of "Novel World", 1982; First Received "Dinner Flower Collection", People's Literature Publishing House, March 1985.
